translation: 患有下肢和上肢残疾的人可以受益于轮椅和机械臂，以提高活动能力和独立性。先前的辅助接口，例如触摸屏和语音驱动的预定义命令，通常仍然不直观，并且难以捕捉复杂的用户意图。我们提出了一种基于自然对话的人机交互协议，该协议模拟了一个智能体，能够与用户通信以理解意图并执行辅助动作。在一项试点研究中，五名参与者通过与轮椅和机械臂的对话式交互完成了五项辅助任务（清洁、饮水、喂食、开抽屉和开门）。作为基线，参与者被要求使用手动控制（轮椅操纵杆和手臂游戏控制器）打开一扇门，并完成一份问卷以收集他们的反馈。通过分析研究后的问卷，我们发现大多数参与者喜欢这种基于对话的交互方式和辅助机器人的自主性。
tldr: 我们为轮椅和机械臂的集成控制设计了一种对话式交互系统。初步研究表明，用户更喜欢通过对话来完成辅助任务，而非手动控制。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将交互方式从预定义命令提升到自然对话，用于复杂的轮椅和机械臂集成控制，这对提高用户独立性至关重要。通过积极的用户反馈证实了其重要性。然而，该研究仅基于一个小型试点研究（五名参与者），结果的普遍性仍需更大规模的验证。
motivation: 现有的辅助接口（如触摸屏和预定义语音命令）通常不够直观，难以捕捉复杂的用户意图，而轮椅和机械臂对于有肢体残疾的人至关重要。
method: 提出了一种模拟智能体、基于自然对话的人机交互协议，以理解用户意图并执行辅助动作。通过一项包含五个参与者的试点研究，让他们使用该协议完成五个辅助任务（清洁、饮水、喂食、开抽屉、开门）。同时设置了手动控制（操纵杆/游戏控制器）作为基线，并分析了研究后的问卷。
results: 大多数参与者喜欢基于对话的交互方式和辅助机器人的自主性。
conclusion: 基于对话的人机交互协议是一种更自然、更受欢迎的集成控制轮椅和机械臂的方式，可以有效提高用户满意度。

title: A Fast and Generalizable Fourier Neural Operator-Based Surrogate for Melt-Pool Prediction in Laser Processing
authors: Alix Benoit, Toni Ivas, Mateusz Papierz, Asel Sagingalieva, Alexey Melnikov, Elia Iseli
abstract: High-fidelity simulations of laser welding capture complex thermo-fluid phenomena, including phase change, free-surface deformation, and keyhole dynamics, however their computational cost limits large-scale process exploration and real-time use. In this work we present the Laser Processing Fourier Neural Operator (LP-FNO), a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) based surrogate model that learns the parametric solution operator of various laser processes from multiphysics simulations generated with FLOW-3D WELD (registered trademark). Through a novel approach of reformulating the transient problem in the moving laser frame and applying temporal averaging, the system results in a quasi-steady state setting suitable for operator learning, even in the keyhole welding regime. The proposed LP-FNO maps process parameters to three-dimensional temperature fields and melt-pool boundaries across a broad process window spanning conduction and keyhole regimes using the non-dimensional normalized enthalpy formulation. The model achieves temperature prediction errors on the order of 1% and intersection-over-union scores for melt-pool segmentation over 0.9. We demonstrate that a LP-FNO model trained on coarse-resolution data can be evaluated on finer grids, yielding accurate super-resolved predictions in mesh-converged conduction regimes, whereas discrepancies in keyhole regimes reflect unresolved dynamics in the coarse-mesh training data. These results indicate that the LP-FNO provides an efficient surrogate modeling framework for laser welding, enabling prediction of full three-dimensional fields and phase interfaces over wide parameter ranges in just tens of milliseconds, up to a hundred thousand times faster than traditional Finite Volume multi-physics software.
zh_title: 一种快速且可泛化的基于傅里叶神经算子的激光加工熔池预测代理模型
translation: 激光焊接的高保真模拟能够捕捉复杂的热流体现象，包括相变、自由表面变形和匙孔动力学，但其计算成本限制了大规模工艺探索和实时使用。在这项工作中，我们提出了激光加工傅里叶神经算子（LP-FNO），这是一个基于傅里叶神经算子（FNO）的代理模型，它从FLOW-3D WELD（注册商标）生成的多物理场模拟中学习各种激光加工过程的参数化解算子。通过一种新颖的方法，即在移动激光坐标系中重新构建瞬态问题并应用时间平均，该系统产生了一个适用于算子学习的准稳态设置，即使在匙孔焊接状态下也适用。所提出的LP-FNO使用无量纲的归一化焓公式，将工艺参数映射到跨越传导和匙孔两种模式的广泛工艺窗口中的三维温度场和熔池边界。该模型实现了约1%的温度预测误差，以及超过0.9的熔池分割交并集分数（IoU）。我们证明了在粗分辨率数据上训练的LP-FNO模型可以在更精细的网格上进行评估，在网格收敛的传导模式下产生准确的超分辨率预测，而匙孔模式下的差异则反映了粗糙网格训练数据中未解决的动力学问题。这些结果表明，LP-FNO为激光焊接提供了一个高效的代理建模框架，能够在仅几十毫秒内，在宽泛的参数范围内预测完整的三维场和相界面，比传统的有限体积多物理场软件快达十万倍。
tldr: 提出LP-FNO，一个基于傅里叶神经算子的超快代理模型，用于激光加工（焊接）熔池预测。它通过将瞬态问题转化为准稳态，实现了比传统模拟快十万倍的预测速度，且能处理复杂的传导和匙孔模式。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将傅里叶神经算子（FNO）应用于复杂的激光加工多物理场问题，特别是通过在移动坐标系中重构瞬态问题并进行时间平均，巧妙地将其转化为适用于算子学习的准稳态形式。其重要性在于实现了高达十万倍的速度提升，极大地解决了高保真模拟的计算瓶颈，使实时预测和大规模参数探索成为可能。此外，模型在传导模式下展现了超分辨率能力，提高了实用性。然而，摘要也指出，在更复杂的匙孔模式下，模型对训练数据的分辨率依赖性较高，这是未来需要进一步解决的限制。
motivation: 高保真激光焊接模拟虽然能捕捉复杂的（热流体、相变、自由表面变形、匙孔动力学）现象，但其计算成本过高，限制了大规模工艺探索和实时应用。因此需要开发一种快速的替代模型。
method: 提出LP-FNO（基于傅里叶神经算子）代理模型，从多物理场模拟数据中学习参数化解算子。关键方法是采用瞬态问题在移动激光坐标系中的重构和时间平均，将问题转化为适用于算子学习的准稳态设置。模型使用归一化焓公式，将工艺参数映射到三维温度场和熔池边界。
results: 模型实现了约1%的温度预测误差，以及超过0.9的熔池分割交并集（IoU）分数。预测速度极快，仅需几十毫秒，比传统有限体积多物理场软件快达十万倍。在传导模式下，模型能在更精细网格上产生准确的超分辨率预测，但在匙孔模式下，预测差异反映了粗糙训练数据中未解决的动力学问题。
conclusion: LP-FNO为激光焊接提供了一个高效的代理建模框架，能够在宽广的参数范围内，以极快的速度预测完整的三维场和相界面。

title: Adaptive Sparse Möbius Transforms for Learning Polynomials
authors: Yigit Efe Erginbas, Justin Singh Kang, Elizabeth Polito, Kannan Ramchandran
abstract: We consider the problem of exactly learning an $s$-sparse real-valued Boolean polynomial of degree $d$ of the form $f:\{ 0,1\}^n \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$. This problem corresponds to decomposing functions in the AND basis and is known as taking a Möbius transform. While the analogous problem for the parity basis (Fourier transform) $f: \{-1,1 \}^n \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is well-understood, the AND basis presents a unique challenge: the basis vectors are coherent, precluding standard compressed sensing methods. We overcome this challenge by identifying that we can exploit adaptive group testing to provide a constructive, query-efficient implementation of the Möbius transform (also known as Möbius inversion) for sparse functions. We present two algorithms based on this insight. The Fully-Adaptive Sparse Möbius Transform (FASMT) uses $O(sd \log(n/d))$ adaptive queries in $O((sd + n) sd \log(n/d))$ time, which we show is near-optimal in query complexity. Furthermore, we also present the Partially-Adaptive Sparse Möbius Transform (PASMT), which uses $O(sd^2\log(n/d))$ queries, trading a factor of $d$ to reduce the number of adaptive rounds to $O(d^2\log(n/d))$, with no dependence on $s$. When applied to hypergraph reconstruction from edge-count queries, our results improve upon baselines by avoiding the combinatorial explosion in the rank $d$. We demonstrate the practical utility of our method for hypergraph reconstruction by applying it to learning real hypergraphs in simulations.
zh_title: 学习多项式的自适应稀疏莫比乌斯变换
translation: 我们考虑精确学习形式为 $f:\{ 0,1\}^n \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ 的 $s$-稀疏实值布尔多项式的问题。这个问题对应于在AND基中分解函数，被称为进行莫比乌斯变换。虽然奇偶基（傅里叶变换）$f: \{-1,1 \}^n \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ 的类似问题已得到充分理解，但AND基提出了独特的挑战：基向量是相干的，排除了标准压缩感知方法。我们通过识别可以利用自适应群组测试来为稀疏函数提供莫比乌斯变换（也称为莫比乌斯逆变换）的建设性、查询高效的实现，从而克服了这一挑战。我们基于这一见解提出了两种算法。全自适应稀疏莫比乌斯变换（FASMT）使用 $O(sd \log(n/d))$ 次自适应查询，时间复杂度为 $O((sd + n) sd \log(n/d))$，我们证明这在查询复杂度上接近最优。此外，我们还提出了部分自适应稀疏莫比乌斯变换（PASMT），它使用 $O(sd^2\log(n/d))$ 次查询，以牺牲一个因子 $d$ 为代价，将自适应轮数减少到 $O(d^2\log(n/d))$，且与 $s$ 无关。当应用于通过边计数查询进行超图重构时，我们的结果通过避免秩 $d$ 中的组合爆炸，改进了现有基线。我们通过在模拟中应用于学习真实超图，证明了我们方法在超图重构中的实际效用。
tldr: 针对稀疏布尔多项式学习中莫比乌斯变换的基向量相干性问题，本文提出了两种基于自适应群组测试的算法（FASMT和PASMT），实现了查询高效的莫比乌斯逆变换。FASMT的查询复杂度接近最优，而PASMT则减少了自适应轮数。该方法在超图重构应用中表现出色。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于成功地将自适应群组测试这一工具应用于传统上难以处理的莫比乌斯变换问题，特别是针对其AND基向量相干性的挑战。通过提出FASMT和PASMT两种变体，作者不仅提供了理论上查询复杂度接近最优的算法，还展示了在实际应用（如超图重构）中避免了传统方法中组合爆炸的优势，这对于处理高阶依赖关系的学习问题具有重要意义。
motivation: 解决精确学习$s$-稀疏、$d$阶实值布尔多项式的问题（即AND基分解/莫比乌斯变换）。主要挑战是AND基向量是相干的，这使得标准压缩感知方法无法应用，与已充分研究的傅里叶/奇偶基情况不同。
method: 利用自适应群组测试（adaptive group testing）来构建一种查询高效的、针对稀疏函数的莫比乌斯逆变换（Möbius inversion）实现。提出了两种算法：全自适应稀疏莫比乌斯变换（FASMT）和部分自适应稀疏莫比乌斯变换（PASMT）。
results: FASMT使用 $O(sd \log(n/d))$ 次自适应查询，时间复杂度为 $O((sd + n) sd \log(n/d))$，查询复杂度接近最优。PASMT使用 $O(sd^2\log(n/d))$ 次查询，将自适应轮数减少到 $O(d^2\log(n/d))$，且与稀疏度 $s$ 无关。应用于超图重构时，通过避免秩 $d$ 中的组合爆炸，优于现有基线方法，并证明了实用性。

title: AI-Limited Fluid Antenna-Aided Integrated Sensing and Communication Systems
authors: Farshad Rostami Ghadi, Kai-Kit Wong, F. Javier Lopez-Martinez, Zhentian Zhang, Hyundong Shin, Christos Masouros
abstract: This paper characterizes the fundamental limits of integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) when the transmitter is subject to an artificial intelligence (AI) representation bottleneck and the receiver employs a fluid antenna system (FAS). Specifically, the message is first encoded into an ideal Gaussian waveform and mapped by an AI encoder into a finite-capacity latent representation that constitutes the physical channel input, while the FAS receiver selects the port experiencing the most favorable channel conditions. We reveal that the AI bottleneck is equivalent to an additive representation noise, which reduces both the communication and sensing signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) at the selected port. We then derive the resulting ISAC capacitydistortion region and establish tight converse and achievability bounds under general fading models, including Jakes-correlated channels. Leveraging the spatial degrees of freedom (DoF) characterization of the Jakes' model, we furthermore prove that the port-selection gain is fundamentally constrained by the physical length of the FAS region: the effective diversity order equals the numerical rank of the Jakes' correlation matrix and increases only with the FAS length. Consequently, enlarging the FAS length allows the selected-port SNR to approach the AI-imposed ceiling, driving the achievable communication rate and sensing mean square error (MSE) toward their AI-limited fundamental bounds. Numerical results corroborate the analysis and scaling laws.
zh_title: AI受限的流体天线辅助的集成感知与通信系统
translation: 本文刻画了当发射机受限于人工智能（AI）表示瓶颈且接收机采用流体天线系统（FAS）时，集成感知与通信（ISAC）的根本限制。具体而言，消息首先被编码成理想高斯波形，然后通过AI编码器映射为一个有限容量的潜在表示，该表示构成了物理信道输入，而FAS接收机则选择经历最有利信道条件的端口。我们揭示了AI瓶颈等效于加性表示噪声，这降低了所选端口的通信和感知信噪比（SNR）。随后，我们推导了由此产生的ISAC容量-失真区域，并在包括Jakes相关信道在内的一般衰落模型下建立了严格的逆定理和可达性界限。利用Jakes模型的空间自由度（DoF）表征，我们进一步证明了端口选择增益从根本上受限于FAS区域的物理长度：有效分集阶数等于Jakes相关矩阵的数值秩，并且仅随FAS长度增加。因此，增大FAS长度使得所选端口的SNR能够接近AI设定的上限，从而推动可实现的通信速率和感知均方误差（MSE）趋向于其AI受限的根本界限。数值结果证实了分析和缩放定律。
tldr: 研究了AI受限的FAS辅助ISAC系统的性能极限。AI瓶颈表现为噪声。通过理论推导证明，FAS的物理长度决定了分集增益，增大FAS长度可以使系统性能（速率和MSE）达到由AI瓶颈设定的理论上限。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将集成感知与通信（ISAC）、流体天线系统（FAS）和AI表示限制这三个前沿概念整合到统一的理论框架中。通过将AI瓶颈建模为加性表示噪声，该研究为刻画系统性能的根本限制提供了关键的分析工具。论文证明了FAS的物理长度决定了其分集增益，并允许系统性能趋近于AI设定的理论上限，这对未来AI驱动的无线系统设计具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 刻画在发射机受限于人工智能（AI）表示瓶颈且接收机采用流体天线系统（FAS）时，集成感知与通信（ISAC）的根本限制。
method: 将AI瓶颈建模为有限容量的潜在表示，并发现其等效于加性表示噪声。推导了由此产生的ISAC容量-失真区域，并在包括Jakes相关信道在内的一般衰落模型下建立了严格的逆定理和可达性界限。利用Jakes模型的空间自由度（DoF）表征来分析性能。
results: AI瓶颈等效于加性表示噪声，降低了通信和感知信噪比（SNR）。端口选择增益受限于FAS的物理长度。有效分集阶数等于Jakes相关矩阵的数值秩，且仅随FAS长度增加。增大FAS长度可使SNR接近AI设定的上限，从而使通信速率和感知均方误差（MSE）趋近于AI受限的根本界限。
conclusion: 增大FAS长度能提供足够的空间分集增益，使系统性能（通信速率和感知MSE）趋近于由AI瓶颈所设定的根本限制。

title: REBEL: Hidden Knowledge Recovery via Evolutionary-Based Evaluation Loop
authors: Patryk Rybak, Paweł Batorski, Paul Swoboda, Przemysław Spurek
abstract: Machine unlearning for LLMs aims to remove sensitive or copyrighted data from trained models. However, the true efficacy of current unlearning methods remains uncertain. Standard evaluation metrics rely on benign queries that often mistake superficial information suppression for genuine knowledge removal. Such metrics fail to detect residual knowledge that more sophisticated prompting strategies could still extract. We introduce REBEL, an evolutionary approach for adversarial prompt generation designed to probe whether unlearned data can still be recovered. Our experiments demonstrate that REBEL successfully elicits ``forgotten'' knowledge from models that seemed to be forgotten in standard unlearning benchmarks, revealing that current unlearning methods may provide only a superficial layer of protection. We validate our framework on subsets of the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks, evaluating performance across a diverse suite of unlearning algorithms. Our experiments show that REBEL consistently outperforms static baselines, recovering ``forgotten'' knowledge with Attack Success Rates (ASRs) reaching up to 60% on TOFU and 93% on WMDP. We will make all code publicly available upon acceptance. Code is available at https://github.com/patryk-rybak/REBEL/
zh_title: REBEL：通过基于进化的评估循环进行隐藏知识恢复
translation: 机器遗忘（Machine unlearning）旨在从经过训练的大型语言模型（LLMs）中移除敏感或受版权保护的数据。然而，当前遗忘方法的真实有效性仍不确定。标准评估指标依赖良性查询，通常将表面信息抑制误认为真正的知识移除。此类指标无法检测到更复杂的提示策略仍可提取的残留知识。我们引入了REBEL，这是一种用于对抗性提示生成的进化方法，旨在探查未遗忘的数据是否仍可被恢复。我们的实验表明，REBEL成功地从在标准遗忘基准测试中看似已遗忘的模型中引出了“被遗忘”的知识，揭示了当前的遗忘方法可能仅提供了一个肤浅的保护层。我们在TOFU和WMDP基准测试的子集上验证了我们的框架，评估了各种遗忘算法的性能。我们的实验表明，REBEL持续优于静态基线，恢复“被遗忘”知识的攻击成功率（ASRs）在TOFU上高达60%，在WMDP上高达93%。我们将在论文被接受后公开发布所有代码。代码可在https://github.com/patryk-rybak/REBEL/获取。
tldr: 引入REBEL，一种基于进化的对抗性提示生成方法，用于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）的机器遗忘效果。实验证明，REBEL能有效恢复被认为已遗忘的知识，揭示现有遗忘方法仅提供肤浅的保护。
ai_comments: 这项工作的重要性在于它对当前机器遗忘（Machine Unlearning）领域提出了关键的挑战和警告。通过引入REBEL这一进化式评估工具，作者揭示了现有遗忘算法可能存在的“假象”——即表面上通过了良性测试，但深层知识残留物仍可通过对抗性提示被提取。这对于依赖机器遗忘来实现数据隐私和版权保护的应用场景具有重大影响。REBEL的创新点在于其利用“进化方法”来生成更具挑战性的评估提示，这比传统的静态基线更加鲁棒和有效。未来的研究需要专注于开发能够抵御此类高级对抗性测试的、更深层次、更彻底的知识移除技术。
motivation: 现有LLMs的机器遗忘方法效果不确定，标准评估指标依赖良性查询，容易将表面信息抑制误认为真正的知识移除，无法检测到可通过复杂提示策略提取的残留知识。
method: 引入REBEL（Evolutionary-Based Evaluation Loop），这是一种基于进化的方法，用于生成对抗性提示。该方法设计用于探测模型中未遗忘的数据是否仍能被恢复。
results: REBEL成功地从在标准遗忘基准测试中看似已遗忘的模型中提取了“被遗忘”的知识。REBEL在TOFU和WMDP基准测试的子集上，攻击成功率（ASRs）分别高达60%和93%，持续优于静态基线。这表明当前的遗忘方法可能只提供了肤浅的保护层。
conclusion: 现有的机器遗忘方法可能只提供了肤浅的保护层，未能实现真正的知识移除。REBEL提供了一种更严格的评估框架，用于检测和恢复LLMs中残留的未遗忘知识。

title: Code, Capital, and Clusters: Understanding Firm Performance in the UK AI Economy
authors: Waqar Muhammad Ashraf, Diane Coyle, Ramit Debnath
abstract: The UK has established a distinctive position in the global AI landscape, driven by rapid firm formation and strategic investment. However, the interplay between AI specialisation, local socioeconomic conditions, and firm performance remains underexplored. This study analyses a comprehensive dataset of UK AI entities (2000 - 2024) from Companies House, ONS, and glass.ai. We find a strong geographical concentration in London (41.3 percent of entities) and technology-centric sectors, with general financial services reporting the highest mean operating revenue (33.9 million GBP, n=33). Firm size and AI specialisation intensity are primary revenue drivers, while local factors, Level 3 qualification rates, population density, and employment levels, provide significant marginal contributions, highlighting the dependence of AI growth on regional socioeconomic ecosystems. The forecasting models project sectoral expansion to 2030, estimating 4,651 [4,323 - 4,979, 95 percent CI] total entities and a rising dissolution ratio (2.21 percent [-0.17 - 4.60]), indicating a transition toward slower sector expansion and consolidation. These results provide robust evidence for place-sensitive policy interventions: cultivating regional AI capabilities beyond London to mitigate systemic risks; distinguishing between support for scaling (addressing capital gaps) and deepening technical specialisation; and strategically shaping ecosystem consolidation. Targeted actions are essential to foster both aggregate AI growth and balanced regional development, transforming consolidation into sustained competitive advantage.
zh_title: 代码、资本与集群：理解英国人工智能经济中的企业绩效
translation: 英国凭借快速的企业组建和战略投资，在全球AI格局中确立了独特的地位。然而，AI专业化、地方社会经济条件与企业绩效之间的相互作用仍未得到充分探索。本研究分析了来自Companies House、ONS和glass.ai的英国AI实体（2000-2024年）的综合数据集。我们发现地理位置高度集中于伦敦（41.3%的实体）和以技术为中心的行业，其中一般金融服务业报告的平均运营收入最高（3390万英镑，n=33）。企业规模和AI专业化强度是主要的收入驱动因素，而地方因素，即三级资格率、人口密度和就业水平，提供了显著的边际贡献，突显了AI增长对区域社会经济生态系统的依赖性。预测模型预测了到2030年的行业扩张，估计实体总数将达到4,651个[95%置信区间为4,323 - 4,979]，解散率上升（2.21% [-0.17 - 4.60]），这表明行业正在向更缓慢的扩张和整合过渡。这些结果为地方敏感型政策干预提供了有力证据：在伦敦之外培养区域AI能力以减轻系统性风险；区分对规模扩大（解决资本缺口）和深化技术专业化的支持；以及战略性地塑造生态系统的整合。有针对性的行动对于促进总体AI增长和平衡区域发展，将整合转化为持续的竞争优势至关重要。
tldr: 英国AI企业高度集中于伦敦。企业规模和AI专业化是主要收入驱动力，但区域社会经济因素也至关重要。预测行业将放缓并整合。研究建议制定地方敏感型政策以促进区域平衡发展和持续竞争优势。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于利用多来源综合数据集（涵盖2000-2024年），将AI企业的微观绩效与区域社会经济指标（如三级资格率、人口密度）相结合进行分析。其重要性在于为地方敏感型政策干预提供了强有力的实证基础，强调了AI增长对区域生态系统的依赖性。研究结果直接指导了英国政府如何管理AI行业的地域集中风险、促进区域平衡发展，并将政策焦点从单纯的资本投入转向支持专业化深化和生态系统整合。
motivation: 尽管英国AI产业发展迅速且投资活跃，但AI专业化、地方社会经济条件与企业绩效之间的相互作用机制尚未得到充分探索。
method: 分析了来自Companies House、ONS和glass.ai的2000年至2024年英国AI实体综合数据集。使用预测模型来估算行业未来的扩张和解散率。
results: 英国AI实体高度集中于伦敦（41.3%）。一般金融服务业的平均运营收入最高。企业规模和AI专业化强度是主要收入驱动力。地方因素（三级资格率、人口密度、就业水平）提供了显著的边际贡献。预测到2030年实体总数将达到4,651个，解散率上升，表明行业将转向缓慢扩张和整合。
conclusion: AI增长依赖于区域社会经济生态系统。需要制定地方敏感型政策干预措施，包括在伦敦之外培育区域AI能力、区分规模扩大支持与技术深化支持，以及战略性地塑造生态系统整合，以实现总体增长和区域平衡发展。

title: The proof theory and semantics of second-order (intuitionistic) tense logic
authors: Justus Becker, Anupam Das, Sonia Marin, Paaras Padhiar
abstract:
We develop a second-order extension of intuitionistic modal logic, allowing quantification over propositions, both syntactically and semantically. A key feature of second-order logic is its capacity to define positive connectives from the negative fragment. Duly we are able to recover the diamond (and its associated theory) using only boxes, as long as we include both forward and backward modalities (`tense' modalities).
  We propose axiomatic, proof theoretic and model theoretic definitions of `second-order intuitionistic tense logic', and ultimately prove that they all coincide. In particular we establish completeness of a labelled sequent calculus via a proof search argument, yielding at the same time a cut-admissibility result. Our methodology also applies to the classical version of second-order tense logic, which we develop in tandem with the intuitionistic case.
zh_title: 二阶（直觉主义）时态逻辑的证明论与语义学
translation: 我们发展了直觉主义模态逻辑的二阶扩展，在句法和语义上都允许对命题进行量化。二阶逻辑的一个关键特征是它能够从否定片段定义肯定联结词。因此，只要我们包含前向和后向模态（“时态”模态），我们就能仅使用方框（Box）来恢复菱形（Diamond）及其相关理论。我们提出了“二阶直觉主义时态逻辑”的公理化、证明论和模型论定义，并最终证明它们全部吻合。特别是，我们通过证明搜索论证确立了标记相继式演算的完备性，同时得到了切入性可容许性结果。我们的方法论也适用于经典的二阶时态逻辑，我们在与直觉主义情况同步发展它。
tldr: 本文发展了二阶直觉主义时态逻辑，允许命题量化，并通过证明搜索方法证明了其标记相继式演算的完备性和切入性可容许性，并将该方法推广到经典的二阶时态逻辑。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将二阶量化、直觉主义模态和时态逻辑结合起来，形成了一个强大的形式系统。特别重要的是，它展示了二阶逻辑的表达能力，允许在包含时态模态的前提下，仅用“Box”定义“Diamond”，简化了连接词的基础集。通过建立公理化、证明论和模型论之间的吻合性，论文为该逻辑提供了坚实的理论基础，并通过证明搜索方法确保了其相继式演算的良好性质（完备性和切入性可容许性）。同时，将方法推广到经典版本，显示了其通用性。
motivation: 发展直觉主义模态逻辑的二阶扩展，允许对命题进行量化。利用二阶逻辑的特性（能从否定片段定义肯定联结词），在包含前向和后向（时态）模态的情况下，仅使用方框（Box）来恢复菱形（Diamond）及其相关理论。
method: 提出了“二阶直觉主义时态逻辑”的公理化、证明论和模型论定义，并证明它们三者吻合。具体方法是使用标记相继式演算（labelled sequent calculus），并通过证明搜索论证来建立完备性。该方法也应用于经典的二阶时态逻辑。
results: 1. 成功地仅使用方框模态恢复了菱形模态及其相关理论。2. 证明了所提出的公理化、证明论和模型论定义三者是吻合的。3. 通过证明搜索论证，确立了标记相继式演算的完备性。4. 同时得到了切入性可容许性（cut-admissibility）结果。
conclusion: 本文成功地为二阶直觉主义时态逻辑建立了公理化、证明论和模型论基础，并证明了它们的一致性，特别是通过标记相继式演算证明了完备性和切入性可容许性。该方法同样适用于经典的二阶时态逻辑。

title: ASMa: Asymmetric Spatio-temporal Masking for Skeleton Action Representation Learning
authors: Aman Anand, Amir Eskandari, Elyas Rahsno, Farhana Zulkernine
abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has shown remarkable success in skeleton-based action recognition by leveraging data augmentations to learn meaningful representations. However, existing SSL methods rely on data augmentations that predominantly focus on masking high-motion frames and high-degree joints such as joints with degree 3 or 4. This results in biased and incomplete feature representations that struggle to generalize across varied motion patterns. To address this, we propose Asymmetric Spatio-temporal Masking (ASMa) for Skeleton Action Representation Learning, a novel combination of masking to learn a full spectrum of spatio-temporal dynamics inherent in human actions. ASMa employs two complementary masking strategies: one that selectively masks high-degree joints and low-motion, and another that masks low-degree joints and high-motion frames. These masking strategies ensure a more balanced and comprehensive skeleton representation learning. Furthermore, we introduce a learnable feature alignment module to effectively align the representations learned from both masked views. To facilitate deployment in resource-constrained settings and on low-resource devices, we compress the learned and aligned representation into a lightweight model using knowledge distillation. Extensive experiments on NTU RGB+D 60, NTU RGB+D 120, and PKU-MMD datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing SSL methods with an average improvement of 2.7-4.4% in fine-tuning and up to 5.9% in transfer learning to noisy datasets and achieves competitive performance compared to fully supervised baselines. Our distilled model achieves 91.4% parameter reduction and 3x faster inference on edge devices while maintaining competitive accuracy, enabling practical deployment in resource-constrained scenarios.
zh_title: ASMa：用于骨骼动作表示学习的非对称时空掩码
translation: 自监督学习（SSL）通过利用数据增强来学习有意义的表示，在基于骨骼的动作识别中取得了显著成功。然而，现有的SSL方法依赖于主要侧重于掩盖高运动帧和高自由度关节（例如3度或4度关节）的数据增强。这导致了有偏差和不完整的特征表示，难以泛化到不同的运动模式。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了用于骨骼动作表示学习的非对称时空掩码（ASMa），这是一种新颖的掩码组合，旨在学习人类动作中固有的全频谱时空动态。ASMa采用了两种互补的掩码策略：一种选择性地掩盖高自由度关节和低运动帧，另一种掩盖低自由度关节和高运动帧。这些掩码策略确保了更平衡和全面的骨骼表示学习。此外，我们引入了一个可学习的特征对齐模块，以有效对齐从两个掩码视图中学习到的表示。为了便于在资源受限设置和低资源设备上部署，我们使用知识蒸馏将学习和对齐后的表示压缩成一个轻量级模型。在NTU RGB+D 60、NTU RGB+D 120和PKU-MMD数据集上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的SSL方法，在微调中平均提高了2.7-4.4%，在迁移学习到噪声数据集时提高了高达5.9%，并且与完全监督基线相比取得了有竞争力的性能。我们蒸馏后的模型实现了91.4%的参数减少和在边缘设备上3倍更快的推理速度，同时保持了有竞争力的准确性，从而能够在资源受限的场景中实现实际部署。
tldr: 针对骨骼动作识别中的表示偏差问题，提出ASMa非对称掩码策略，通过互补掩码学习全面的时空特征，并结合知识蒸馏实现模型轻量化，显著提升了自监督学习性能和边缘设备部署效率。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了非对称掩码策略（ASMa），通过强制模型关注传统SSL方法容易忽略的低运动/低自由度特征，有效解决了现有自监督学习中骨骼表示的偏差和不完整性问题，从而提高了泛化能力。其次，将知识蒸馏应用于压缩学习到的表示，使得高性能模型能够部署在资源受限的边缘设备上，极大地提升了该方法的实用性和应用价值。
motivation: 现有的骨骼动作识别自监督学习（SSL）方法过度依赖于掩盖高运动帧和高自由度（如3或4度）关节的数据增强，导致特征表示有偏差、不完整且泛化能力差。
method: 提出非对称时空掩码（ASMa），结合两种互补的掩码策略：一是选择性掩盖高自由度关节和低运动帧，二是掩盖低自由度关节和高运动帧。此外，引入一个可学习的特征对齐模块来对齐两个掩码视图学习到的表示，并使用知识蒸馏将表示压缩成轻量级模型。
results: 在NTU RGB+D 60/120和PKU-MMD数据集上，微调性能平均优于现有SSL方法2.7-4.4%，在迁移学习到噪声数据集时性能提升高达5.9%。蒸馏模型实现了91.4%的参数减少和3倍的边缘设备推理速度提升，同时保持了有竞争力的准确性。
conclusion: ASMa通过学习全面的时空动态，获得了更平衡和全面的骨骼表示。通过知识蒸馏，其轻量级模型在资源受限的环境中仍能实现高性能和实用部署。

title: Secure and Private Spatial Sharing for Mixed Reality Remote Collaboration in Enterprise Settings
authors: Mengyu Chen, Youngwook Do, Feiyu Lu, Kaiming Cheng, Blair MacIntyre
abstract: Mixed Reality (MR) technologies are increasingly adopted by enterprises to enhance remote collaboration, enabling users to share real-time views of their physical environments through head-mounted displays (HMDs). While MR spatial sharing offers significant benefits, it introduces complex security and privacy risks, particularly in balancing employee collaboration needs with enterprise data protection requirements across office and personal spaces. This paper investigates these challenges through formative interviews with employees and expert consultations with professionals in cybersecurity, IoT, technology risk, and corporate legal domains. We present a conceptual framework for secure MR spatial sharing in enterprise contexts and identify critical concerns and requirements for system design. Based on our findings, we offer actionable recommendations to guide the development of secure and privacy-preserving MR spatial sharing solutions for future enterprise deployments.
zh_title: 企业环境中混合现实远程协作的安全和隐私空间共享
translation: 混合现实（MR）技术正日益被企业采用，以增强远程协作，使用户能够通过头戴式显示器（HMDs）实时分享他们的物理环境视图。虽然MR空间共享带来了显著的益处，但它引入了复杂的安全和隐私风险，特别是在平衡员工协作需求与跨办公室和个人空间的企业数据保护要求方面。本文通过对员工进行形成性访谈，并咨询网络安全、物联网、技术风险和企业法律领域的专业人士，来调查这些挑战。我们提出了一个用于企业环境中安全MR空间共享的概念框架，并识别了系统设计的关键问题和要求。基于我们的发现，我们提供了可操作的建议，以指导未来企业部署中安全且保护隐私的MR空间共享解决方案的开发。
tldr: 本文通过访谈和专家咨询，研究了企业MR远程协作中空间共享的安全和隐私挑战，提出了一个概念框架和设计建议。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它采取了跨学科的方法来解决一个新兴的技术问题。它不仅关注技术实现，还结合了员工的实际使用需求、网络安全专家的风险评估以及企业法律的合规性要求。这种以人为本和合规驱动的研究方法对于确保MR技术在敏感的企业环境中得到负责任的部署至关重要。
motivation: 混合现实（MR）空间共享虽然能增强远程协作，但在企业环境中引入了复杂的安全和隐私风险，尤其是在平衡员工协作需求和企业数据保护要求方面。
method: 通过与员工进行形成性访谈，并咨询网络安全、物联网、技术风险和企业法律领域的专业人士。
results: 提出了一个用于企业环境中安全MR空间共享的概念框架，并识别了系统设计的关键问题和要求。
conclusion: 提供了可操作的建议，以指导未来企业部署中安全且保护隐私的MR空间共享解决方案的开发。

title: D-Legion: A Scalable Many-Core Architecture for Accelerating Matrix Multiplication in Quantized LLMs
authors: Ahmed J. Abdelmaksoud, Cristian Sestito, Shiwei Wang, Themis Prodromakis
abstract: The performance gains obtained by large language models (LLMs) are closely linked to their substantial computational and memory requirements. Quantized LLMs offer significant advantages with extremely quantized models, motivating the development of specialized architectures to accelerate their workloads. This paper proposes D-Legion, a novel scalable many-core architecture, designed using many adaptive-precision systolic array cores, to accelerate matrix multiplication in quantized LLMs. The proposed architecture consists of a set of Legions where each Legion has a group of adaptive-precision systolic arrays. D-Legion supports multiple computation modes, including quantized sparse and dense matrix multiplications. The block structured sparsity is exploited within a fully-sparse, or partially-sparse windows. In addition, memory accesses of partial summations (psums) are spatially reduced through parallel accumulators. Furthermore, data reuse is maximized through optimized scheduling techniques by multicasting matrix tiles across the Legions. A comprehensive design space exploration is performed in terms of Legion/core granularity to determine the optimal Legion configuration. Moreover, D-Legion is evaluated on attention workloads from two BitNet models, delivering up to 8.2$\times$ lower latency, up to 3.8$\times$ higher memory savings, and up to 3$\times$ higher psum memory savings compared to state-of-the-art work. D-Legion, with eight Legions and 64 total cores, achieves a peak throughput of 135,68 TOPS at a frequency of 1 GHz. A scaled version of D-Legion, with 32 Legions, is compared to Google TPUv4i, achieving up to 2.5$\times$ lower total latency, up to 2.3$\times$ higher total throughput, and up to 2.7$\times$ higher total memory savings.
zh_title: D-Legion：一种用于加速量化LLM中矩阵乘法的高可扩展多核架构
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的性能提升与其巨大的计算和内存需求紧密相关。量化LLMs通过极少量化模型提供了显著优势，激励了开发专业化架构来加速其工作负载。本文提出了D-Legion，一种新颖的可扩展多核架构，采用多组自适应精度脉动阵列核心设计，旨在加速量化LLM中的矩阵乘法。所提出的架构由一组“军团”（Legions）组成，每个军团拥有一组自适应精度脉动阵列。D-Legion支持多种计算模式，包括量化稀疏和密集矩阵乘法。它在全稀疏或部分稀疏窗口内利用块结构稀疏性。此外，通过并行累加器在空间上减少部分求和（psums）的内存访问。更进一步，通过优化调度技术在军团间多播矩阵块，从而最大化数据重用。本文对军团/核心粒度进行了全面的设计空间探索，以确定最佳的军团配置。此外，D-Legion在来自两个BitNet模型的注意力工作负载上进行了评估，与现有技术相比，实现了高达8.2倍的延迟降低，高达3.8倍的内存节省，以及高达3倍的psums内存节省。拥有8个军团和64个总核心的D-Legion在1 GHz频率下实现了135.68 TOPS的峰值吞吐量。将D-Legion扩展到32个军团后，与Google TPUv4i进行了比较，实现了高达2.5倍的总延迟降低，高达2.3倍的总吞吐量提高，以及高达2.7倍的总内存节省。
tldr: D-Legion是一种针对量化LLM矩阵乘法的高效多核加速器。它使用自适应脉动阵列和优化技术处理稀疏和密集计算，在延迟、吞吐量和内存效率上（包括与TPUv4i的比较）表现出显著优于现有技术的性能。
ai_comments: D-Legion的创新性在于其为极少量化LLMs（如BitNet）设计了专用的、高度可扩展的硬件架构。核心创新点在于结合了自适应精度脉动阵列、Legion/Core层次结构、对块结构稀疏性的高效处理，以及通过并行累加器和多播优化实现psums和数据重用的最大化。与Google TPUv4i的性能对比，凸显了该架构在处理新兴的极端量化模型工作负载时的巨大潜力，表明针对特定模型特性定制硬件是实现能效飞跃的关键途径。
motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的性能增益与巨大的计算和内存需求相关。量化LLMs，特别是极少量化模型，提供了显著优势，因此需要开发专门的架构来加速其工作负载。
method: 提出D-Legion，一种新颖的可扩展多核架构，采用多组自适应精度脉动阵列（systolic array）核心设计。该架构由多个“军团”（Legions）组成，每个军团包含一组自适应精度脉动阵列。D-Legion支持量化稀疏和密集矩阵乘法，利用块结构稀疏性，并通过并行累加器在空间上减少部分求和（psums）的内存访问。此外，通过优化调度技术，跨军团广播矩阵块以最大化数据重用。
results: 在两个BitNet模型的注意力工作负载上，相比于现有技术，D-Legion实现了高达8.2倍的延迟降低，3.8倍的内存节省，以及3倍的psums内存节省。具有8个军团和64个核心的D-Legion在1 GHz频率下达到了135.68 TOPS的峰值吞吐量。与Google TPUv4i相比，一个32个军团的扩展版D-Legion实现了高达2.5倍的总延迟降低，2.3倍的总吞吐量提高，以及2.7倍的总内存节省。

title: A hard-constrained NN learning framework for rapidly restoring AC-OPF from DC-OPF
authors: Kejun Chen, Bernard Knueven, Wesley Jones
abstract: This paper proposes a hard-constrained unsupervised learning framework for rapidly solving the non-linear and non-convex AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF) problem in real-time operation. Without requiring ground-truth AC-OPF solutions, feasibility and optimality are ensured through a properly designed learning environment and training loss. Inspired by residual learning, the neural network (NN) learns the correction mapping from the DC-OPF solution to the active power setpoints of the generators through re-dispatch. A subsequent optimization model is utilized to restore the optimal AC-OPF solution, and the resulting projection difference is employed as the training loss. A replay buffer is utilized to enhance learning efficiency by fully leveraging past data pairs. The optimization model is cast as a differentiable optimization layer, where the gradient is derived by applying the implicit function theorem to the KKT conditions at the optimal solution. Tested on IEEE-118 and PEGASE-9241 bus systems, numerical results demonstrate that the proposed NN can obtain strictly feasible and near-optimal solutions with reduced computational time compared to conventional optimization solvers. In addition, aided by the updated DC-OPF solution under varying topologies, the trained NN, together with the PF solver, can rapidly find the corresponding AC solution. The proposed method achieves a $40\times$ time speedup, while maintaining an average constraint violation on the order of $10^{-4}$ and an optimization gap below $1\%$.
zh_title: 一种用于从DC-OPF快速恢复AC-OPF的硬约束神经网络学习框架
translation: 本文提出了一种硬约束无监督学习框架，用于在实时运行中快速求解非线性、非凸的交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）问题。该方法无需AC-OPF真值解，通过精心设计的学习环境和训练损失确保了可行性和最优性。受残差学习的启发，神经网络（NN）通过再调度学习从DC-OPF解到发电机有功功率设定点的校正映射。利用一个后续优化模型来恢复最优AC-OPF解，并将由此产生的投影差异用作训练损失。利用回放缓冲区通过充分利用过去的数据对来提高学习效率。该优化模型被视为一个可微分优化层，其梯度通过对最优解处的KKT条件应用隐函数定理推导得出。在IEEE-118和PEGASE-9241总线系统上进行的数值结果表明，与传统优化求解器相比，所提出的NN能够以更短的计算时间获得严格可行且接近最优的解。此外，在拓扑结构变化下，在更新的DC-OPF解的辅助下，经过训练的NN与PF求解器一起可以快速找到相应的AC解。所提出的方法实现了40倍的时间加速，同时将平均约束违反量保持在$10^{-4}$量级，优化差距低于1%。
tldr: 提出了一种硬约束无监督学习框架，利用残差学习和可微分优化层，将DC-OPF解映射到AC-OPF校正，实现比传统优化器快40倍的实时AC-OPF求解，同时保持严格可行和接近最优。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于将无监督学习、残差映射和硬约束集成到AC-OPF求解中。通过利用DC-OPF作为起点并学习校正映射（残差学习），极大地提高了效率。最关键的创新是使用可微分优化层，其中梯度通过对KKT条件应用隐函数定理获得，这使得神经网络的训练能够直接优化物理可行性和最优性，而无需依赖昂贵的AC-OPF真值数据。40倍的速度提升和严格的可行性保证了该方法在电网实时操作中的重要应用潜力。
motivation: 解决实时运行中非线性、非凸的交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）问题求解速度慢的挑战，旨在快速、可行地从DC-OPF解中恢复出最优的AC-OPF解。
method: 提出了一种硬约束无监督学习框架。该框架受残差学习启发，训练神经网络学习从DC-OPF解到发电机有功功率设定点（再调度）的校正映射。通过精心设计的学习环境和训练损失确保可行性和最优性，其中一个后续优化模型用于恢复最优AC-OPF解，并将其投影差异作为训练损失。该优化模型被构建为可微分优化层，其梯度通过对最优解处的KKT条件应用隐函数定理推导得出。同时利用回放缓冲区提高学习效率。
results: 在IEEE-118和PEGASE-9241总线系统上进行了测试。结果表明，所提出的神经网络能够获得严格可行且接近最优的解，计算时间比传统优化求解器显著减少。该方法实现了40倍的时间加速，同时保持平均约束违反量级为$10^{-4}$，优化差距低于1%。在拓扑结构变化下，该方法也能快速找到相应的AC解。

title: Steering Safely or Off a Cliff? Rethinking Specificity and Robustness in Inference-Time Interventions
authors: Navita Goyal, Hal Daumé III
abstract: Model steering, which involves intervening on hidden representations at inference time, has emerged as a lightweight alternative to finetuning for precisely controlling large language models. While steering efficacy has been widely studied, evaluations of whether interventions alter only the intended property remain limited, especially with respect to unintended changes in behaviors related to the target property. We call this notion specificity. We propose a framework that distinguishes three dimensions of specificity: general (preserving fluency and unrelated abilities), control (preserving related control properties), and robustness (preserving control properties under distribution shifts). We study two safety-critical use cases: steering models to reduce overrefusal and faithfulness hallucinations, and show that while steering achieves high efficacy and largely maintains general and control specificity, it consistently fails to preserve robustness specificity. In the case of overrefusal steering, for example, all steering methods reduce overrefusal without harming general abilities and refusal on harmful queries; however, they substantially increase vulnerability to jailbreaks. Our work provides the first systematic evaluation of specificity in model steering, showing that standard efficacy and specificity checks are insufficient, because without robustness evaluation, steering methods may appear reliable even when they compromise model safety.
zh_title: 安全转向还是驶向悬崖？重新思考推理时干预中的特异性和鲁棒性。
translation: 模型转向涉及在推理时干预隐藏表示，已成为精确控制大型语言模型的一种轻量级微调替代方案。虽然转向的有效性已被广泛研究，但关于干预是否仅改变预期属性的评估仍然有限，特别是关于与目标属性相关的行为的意外改变。我们将此概念称为特异性。我们提出了一个区分特异性三个维度的框架：通用（保持流畅性和不相关能力）、控制（保持相关的控制属性）和鲁棒性（在分布偏移下保持控制属性）。我们研究了两个安全关键用例：引导模型以减少过度拒绝和忠实度幻觉，结果表明，虽然转向实现了高有效性并基本保持了通用和控制特异性，但它始终未能保持鲁棒性特异性。例如，在过度拒绝转向的情况下，所有转向方法在不损害通用能力和对有害查询的拒绝的情况下减少了过度拒绝；然而，它们却大幅增加了对越狱的脆弱性。我们的工作首次系统地评估了模型转向中的特异性，表明标准的有效性和特异性检查是不够的，因为如果没有鲁棒性评估，转向方法即使损害了模型安全也可能显得可靠。
tldr: 模型转向虽然能解决特定问题（如过度拒绝），但会破坏模型的鲁棒性特异性，使其更容易被越狱。因此，评估模型转向的安全性必须包含鲁棒性检查。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个包含通用、控制和鲁棒性三个维度的特异性框架，用于系统评估推理时干预（模型转向）的安全性。其重要性在于揭示了一个关键的安全隐患：虽然模型转向在解决特定问题时有效，但它系统性地破坏了模型的鲁棒性特异性，显著增加了模型对越狱等对抗性攻击的脆弱性。这挑战了现有评估的充分性，强调了在部署此类轻量级控制技术时，必须将鲁棒性评估纳入标准流程。
motivation: 模型转向（推理时对隐藏表示进行干预）作为控制大型语言模型的轻量级替代方案已被广泛研究其有效性，但关于干预是否仅改变预期属性（特异性）的评估仍然有限，特别是对与目标属性相关的行为的意外改变。
method: 提出一个区分特异性三个维度（通用、控制和鲁棒性）的框架。研究了两个安全关键用例：减少过度拒绝和忠实度幻觉的转向干预。
results: 转向干预实现了高有效性，并基本保持了通用和控制特异性，但始终未能保持鲁棒性特异性。例如，过度拒绝转向显著增加了模型对越狱攻击的脆弱性。
conclusion: 标准的有效性和特异性检查是不够的；缺乏鲁棒性评估，转向方法可能在损害模型安全的情况下仍显得可靠。

title: Can One-sided Arguments Lead to Response Change in Large Language Models?
authors: Pedro Cisneros-Velarde
abstract: Polemic questions need more than one viewpoint to express a balanced answer. Large Language Models (LLMs) can provide a balanced answer, but also take a single aligned viewpoint or refuse to answer. In this paper, we study if such initial responses can be steered to a specific viewpoint in a simple and intuitive way: by only providing one-sided arguments supporting the viewpoint. Our systematic study has three dimensions: (i) which stance is induced in the LLM response, (ii) how the polemic question is formulated, (iii) how the arguments are shown. We construct a small dataset and remarkably find that opinion steering occurs across (i)-(iii) for diverse models, number of arguments, and topics. Switching to other arguments consistently decreases opinion steering.
zh_title: 单边论证能否导致大型语言模型的回复改变？
translation: 争议性问题需要不止一个视角才能表达出平衡的答案。大型语言模型（LLMs）可以提供一个平衡的答案，但也可能采取单一的一致观点或拒绝回答。在本文中，我们研究了这些初始回复是否可以通过一种简单直观的方式——即仅提供支持该观点的单边论证——被引导至一个特定的观点。我们的系统性研究包含三个维度：（i）LLM回复中被诱导的立场，（ii）争议性问题的表述方式，（iii）论证的展示方式。我们构建了一个小型数据集，并显著地发现观点转向现象在所有（i）-（iii）维度上，对于不同的模型、论证数量和主题都发生了。切换到其他论证会持续降低观点转向的程度。
tldr: 大型语言模型（LLMs）很容易被单边论证所影响，从而改变其对争议性问题的初始回复，转向该论证所支持的特定观点。
ai_comments: 本研究揭示了LLMs在处理争议性问题时容易受到单边信息的影响，即使它们的初始回答是平衡的。这一发现对于理解LLMs的鲁棒性和偏见敏感性至关重要，尤其是在LLMs被用于生成新闻、政策分析或进行辩论式交互的场景中。它强调了在部署LLM时，对抗信息操纵和确保信息平衡的必要性，并提醒用户和开发者注意这种潜在的“观点转向”漏洞。
motivation: 研究大型语言模型（LLMs）在回答争议性问题时，其初始回复（可能是平衡的、单一观点的或拒绝回答的）是否能通过一种简单直观的方式，即仅提供支持特定观点的单边论证，而被引导至该特定观点。
method: 构建了一个小型数据集，并进行系统性研究。该研究考察了三个维度：（i）LLM回复中被诱导的立场，（ii）争议性问题的表述方式，（iii）论证的展示方式，以测试仅提供支持某一观点的单边论证是否能改变LLM的初始回复。
results: 研究发现，对于不同模型、论证数量和主题，观点转向现象在所有三个研究维度上（被诱导的立场、问题表述、论证展示方式）普遍发生。同时，切换到其他论证会持续降低这种观点转向的程度。
conclusion: 单边论证可以有效地诱导大型语言模型（LLMs）改变其初始回复，转向特定的观点，并且这种观点转向现象普遍存在于不同的模型、论证数量和主题中。

title: On Randomized Algorithms in Online Strategic Classification
authors: Chase Hutton, Adam Melrod, Han Shao
abstract:
Online strategic classification studies settings in which agents strategically modify their features to obtain favorable predictions. For example, given a classifier that determines loan approval based on credit scores, applicants may open or close credit cards and bank accounts to obtain a positive prediction. The learning goal is to achieve low mistake or regret bounds despite such strategic behavior.
  While randomized algorithms have the potential to offer advantages to the learner in strategic settings, they have been largely underexplored. In the realizable setting, no lower bound is known for randomized algorithms, and existing lower bound constructions for deterministic learners can be circumvented by randomization. In the agnostic setting, the best known regret upper bound is $O(T^{3/4}\log^{1/4}T|\mathcal H|)$, which is far from the standard online learning rate of $O(\sqrt{T\log|\mathcal H|})$.
  In this work, we provide refined bounds for online strategic classification in both settings. In the realizable setting, we extend, for $T > \mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}) Δ^2$, the existing lower bound $Ω(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}) Δ)$ for deterministic learners to all learners. This yields the first lower bound that applies to randomized learners. We also provide the first randomized learner that improves the known (deterministic) upper bound of $O(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal H) \cdot Δ\log Δ)$.
  In the agnostic setting, we give a proper learner using convex optimization techniques to improve the regret upper bound to $O(\sqrt{T \log |\mathcal{H}|} + |\mathcal{H}| \log(T|\mathcal{H}|))$. We show a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors for all proper learning rules, demonstrating the optimality of our learner among proper learners. As such, improper learning is necessary to further improve regret guarantees.
zh_title: 关于在线策略分类中的随机算法
translation:
在线策略分类研究的是智能体策略性地修改其特征以获得有利预测的场景。例如，给定一个基于信用评分决定贷款批准的分类器，申请人可能会开设或关闭信用卡和银行账户以获得积极预测。学习目标是尽管存在此类策略行为，仍能实现低错误或低遗憾界限。
虽然随机算法有潜力为学习器在策略设置中提供优势，但它们在很大程度上尚未被充分探索。在可实现设置中，随机算法尚无已知的下界，并且现有针对确定性学习器的下界构造可以通过随机化来规避。在不可知设置中，最佳已知遗憾上界为$O(T^{3/4}\log^{1/4}T|\mathcal H|)$，这与标准在线学习率$O(\sqrt{T\log|\mathcal H|})$相去甚远。
在这项工作中，我们为在线策略分类的两种设置提供了精炼的界限。在可实现设置中，对于$T > \mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}) Δ^2$，我们将现有针对确定性学习器的下界$Ω(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}) Δ)$扩展到所有学习器。这产生了第一个适用于随机学习器的下界。我们还提供了第一个改进已知（确定性）上界$O(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal H) \cdot Δ\log Δ)$的随机学习器。
在不可知设置中，我们使用凸优化技术提供了一个适当学习器，将遗憾上界改进到$O(\sqrt{T \log |\mathcal{H}|} + |\mathcal{H}| \log(T|\mathcal{H}|))$。我们证明了对于所有适当学习规则，存在一个匹配的下界（除去对数因子），表明我们的学习器在适当学习器中是最优的。因此，需要不适当学习才能进一步改善遗憾保证。
tldr: 本文研究在线策略分类中的随机算法。在可实现设置中，首次建立了适用于所有学习器的下界，并提出了改进已知上界的随机学习器。在不可知设置中，通过凸优化技术，将遗憾上界改进到$O(\sqrt{T \log |\mathcal{H}|} + |\mathcal{H}| \log(T|\mathcal{H}|))$，并证明了其在所有适当学习器中的最优性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于系统地将随机化引入在线策略分类领域，解决了该领域长期存在的两个主要差距。首先，它首次为随机学习器建立了严格的下界，填补了理论空白。其次，它在不可知设置中通过引入凸优化技术，将遗憾上界大幅收紧，使其接近标准在线学习率，并通过匹配的下界证明了所提算法在“适当学习器”类别中的最优性，为后续研究指明了方向（即探索不适当学习）。
motivation: 随机算法在策略分类环境中可能具有优势，但研究不足。在可实现设置中，缺乏适用于随机算法的下界；在不可知设置中，现有遗憾上界($O(T^{3/4}\log^{1/4}T|\mathcal H|)$)远逊于标准在线学习率($O(\sqrt{T\log|\mathcal H|})$)。
method: 在可实现设置中，通过扩展现有针对确定性学习器的下界来适用于所有学习器，并提出了新的随机学习器。在不可知设置中，使用凸优化技术设计了一个适当学习器。
results: 在可实现设置中，首次将现有确定性学习器的下界$Ω(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}) Δ)$扩展到所有学习器（当$T > \mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal{H}) Δ^2$时），并提供了第一个改进已知确定性上界$O(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal H) \cdot Δ\log Δ)$的随机学习器。在不可知设置中，将遗憾上界改进到$O(\sqrt{T \log |\mathcal{H}|} + |\mathcal{H}| \log(T|\mathcal{H}|))$，并证明了该学习器在所有适当学习规则中是最优的（除去对数因子）。
conclusion: 本文为在线策略分类中的随机算法提供了精炼的界限。在不可知设置中，为了进一步改善遗憾保证，需要采用不适当学习（improper learning）。

title: GRP-Obliteration: Unaligning LLMs With a Single Unlabeled Prompt
authors: Mark Russinovich, Yanan Cai, Keegan Hines, Giorgio Severi, Blake Bullwinkel, Ahmed Salem
abstract:
Safety alignment is only as robust as its weakest failure mode. Despite extensive work on safety post-training, it has been shown that models can be readily unaligned through post-deployment fine-tuning. However, these methods often require extensive data curation and degrade model utility.
  In this work, we extend the practical limits of unalignment by introducing GRP-Obliteration (GRP-Oblit), a method that uses Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to directly remove safety constraints from target models. We show that a single unlabeled prompt is sufficient to reliably unalign safety-aligned models while largely preserving their utility, and that GRP-Oblit achieves stronger unalignment on average than existing state-of-the-art techniques. Moreover, GRP-Oblit generalizes beyond language models and can also unalign diffusion-based image generation systems.
  We evaluate GRP-Oblit on six utility benchmarks and five safety benchmarks across fifteen 7-20B parameter models, spanning instruct and reasoning models, as well as dense and MoE architectures. The evaluated model families include GPT-OSS, distilled DeepSeek, Gemma, Llama, Ministral, and Qwen.
zh_title: GRP-Obliteration：使用单个未标注提示解除LLM的对齐
translation: 安全对齐的鲁棒性取决于其最薄弱的故障模式。尽管在安全后训练方面进行了广泛的工作，但模型已被证明可以通过部署后的微调轻易地解除对齐。然而，这些方法通常需要大量数据整理并会降低模型的实用性。在本文中，我们通过引入GRP-Obliteration (GRP-Oblit) 来扩展解除对齐的实际限制，这是一种利用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）直接从目标模型中移除安全约束的方法。我们证明，单个未标注提示足以可靠地解除安全对齐模型的对齐，同时在很大程度上保留其实用性，并且GRP-Oblit在平均程度上比现有最先进技术实现了更强的解除对齐效果。此外，GRP-Oblit超越了语言模型，还可以解除基于扩散的图像生成系统的对齐。我们在六个实用性基准和五个安全基准上评估了GRP-Oblit，涉及十五个7-20B参数模型，涵盖指令模型和推理模型，以及密集和MoE架构。评估的模型家族包括GPT-OSS、蒸馏DeepSeek、Gemma、Llama、Ministral和Qwen。
tldr: 一种名为GRP-Obliteration（使用GRPO）的新方法，仅需一个未标注提示就能高效地解除LLM（及扩散模型）的安全对齐，同时保持实用性，效果优于现有技术。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于其极高的效率（仅需单个未标注提示）和使用GRPO直接移除约束，这与数据密集型微调方法形成鲜明对比。其重要性在于揭示了当前安全对齐机制的深刻脆弱性，展示了一种高度实用且可扩展的攻击向量，影响了LLM和图像模型。这为模型部署和安全提出了重大挑战。
motivation: 现有安全对齐方法容易在部署后被解除，且现有的解除对齐方法通常需要大量数据整理并会降低模型实用性。本文旨在通过引入GRP-Obliteration来扩展解除对齐的实际限制。
method: GRP-Obliteration (GRP-Oblit)。该方法利用群组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO），直接从目标模型中移除安全约束，仅需使用单个未标注提示。
results: 仅一个未标注提示就足以可靠地解除安全对齐模型的对齐，同时基本保持其实用性。GRP-Oblit在平均程度上比现有最先进技术实现了更强的解除对齐效果。它还能泛化到扩散模型。
conclusion: GRP-Obliteration是一种高效、强大且可泛化的方法，仅需单个未标注提示即可可靠地解除大型语言模型（和扩散模型）的安全对齐，同时保持模型实用性。

title: Swap Regret Minimization Through Response-Based Approachability
authors: Ioannis Anagnostides, Gabriele Farina, Maxwell Fishelson, Haipeng Luo, Jon Schneider
abstract:
We consider the problem of minimizing different notions of swap regret in online optimization. These forms of regret are tightly connected to correlated equilibrium concepts in games, and have been more recently shown to guarantee non-manipulability against strategic adversaries. The only computationally efficient algorithm for minimizing linear swap regret over a general convex set in $\mathbb{R}^d$ was developed recently by Daskalakis, Farina, Fishelson, Pipis, and Schneider (STOC '25). However, it incurs a highly suboptimal regret bound of $Ω(d^4 \sqrt{T})$ and also relies on computationally intensive calls to the ellipsoid algorithm at each iteration.
  In this paper, we develop a significantly simpler, computationally efficient algorithm that guarantees $O(d^{3/2} \sqrt{T})$ linear swap regret for a general convex set and $O(d \sqrt{T})$ when the set is centrally symmetric. Our approach leverages the powerful response-based approachability framework of Bernstein and Shimkin (JMLR '15) -- previously overlooked in the line of work on swap regret minimization -- combined with geometric preconditioning via the John ellipsoid. Our algorithm simultaneously minimizes profile swap regret, which was recently shown to guarantee non-manipulability. Moreover, we establish a matching information-theoretic lower bound: any learner must incur in expectation $Ω(d \sqrt{T})$ linear swap regret for large enough $T$, even when the set is centrally symmetric. This also shows that the classic algorithm of Gordon, Greenwald, and Marks (ICML '08) is existentially optimal for minimizing linear swap regret, although it is computationally inefficient. Finally, we extend our approach to minimize regret with respect to the set of swap deviations with polynomial dimension, unifying and strengthening recent results in equilibrium computation and online learning.
zh_title: 通过基于响应的可达性最小化交换遗憾
translation:
我们考虑在线优化中最小化不同形式的交换遗憾（swap regret）的问题。这些形式的遗憾与博弈中的相关均衡概念紧密相关，并且最近被证明可以保证抵抗策略对手的不可操纵性。最近，Daskalakis、Farina、Fishelson、Pipis和Schneider（STOC '25）开发了唯一一种在$\mathbb{R}^d$上一般凸集上最小化线性交换遗憾的计算高效算法。然而，它的遗憾界限是高度次优的$Ω(d^4 \sqrt{T})$，并且在每次迭代中都依赖于计算密集的椭球算法调用。
在本文中，我们开发了一种显著更简单、计算高效的算法，该算法保证了对于一般凸集的线性交换遗憾为$O(d^{3/2} \sqrt{T})$，对于中心对称集为$O(d \sqrt{T})$。我们的方法利用了伯恩斯坦和希姆金的强大的基于响应的可达性框架（JMLR '15）——该框架此前在线性交换遗憾最小化的工作中被忽视——并结合了通过约翰椭球进行的几何预处理。我们的算法同时最小化了配置文件交换遗憾（profile swap regret），后者最近被证明可以保证不可操纵性。此外，我们建立了一个匹配的信息论下界：对于足够大的$T$，即使集合是中心对称的，任何学习者都必须承担$Ω(d \sqrt{T})$的预期线性交换遗憾。这也表明，经典的Gordon、Greenwald和Marks算法（ICML '08）在最小化线性交换遗憾方面是存在最优的，尽管其计算效率低下。最后，我们扩展了我们的方法，以最小化关于具有多项式维度的交换偏差集的遗憾，统一并加强了均衡计算和在线学习中的最新结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于响应的可达性框架的新型、计算高效的算法，用于在线优化中的交换遗憾最小化。它将线性交换遗憾界限从次优的$Ω(d^4 \sqrt{T})$改进至$O(d \sqrt{T})$（对于中心对称集），并证明了$Ω(d \sqrt{T})$的匹配信息论下界，从而达到了最优性能。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将“基于响应的可达性”（Response-Based Approachability）这一先前被忽视的框架引入到交换遗憾最小化领域，并结合几何预处理（约翰椭球），从而解决了现有算法计算效率低下的同时遗憾界限次优的问题。将遗憾界限从$Ω(d^4 \sqrt{T})$大幅降低到$O(d \sqrt{T})$（对于特定集合）是一个重要的理论突破。此外，提出匹配的信息论下界$Ω(d \sqrt{T})$，不仅验证了新算法的紧致性，也为该领域设定了明确的性能基准，并证明了现有经典算法在存在性上是最优的。
motivation: 交换遗憾最小化在博弈论中与相关均衡概念紧密相关，并能保证抵抗策略对手的不可操纵性。现有的唯一计算高效算法（Daskalakis et al., STOC '25）具有高度次优的遗憾界限$Ω(d^4 \sqrt{T})$，并且需要计算密集的椭球算法调用。因此，需要开发一种更简单、计算更高效且具有更优遗憾界限的算法。
method: 该方法利用了伯恩斯坦和希姆金的“基于响应的可达性”框架（此前被忽视），并结合了通过约翰椭球（John ellipsoid）进行的几何预处理。
results:
1.  提出了一种计算高效且显著更简单的算法。
2.  该算法保证了对于一般凸集的线性交换遗憾为$O(d^{3/2} \sqrt{T})$，对于中心对称集为$O(d \sqrt{T})$。
3.  该算法同时最小化了配置文件交换遗憾（profile swap regret）。
4.  建立了匹配的信息论下界：对于足够大的$T$，即使集合是中心对称的，学习者也必须承担$Ω(d \sqrt{T})$的预期线性交换遗憾。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于响应的可达性框架的新算法，显著改善了交换遗憾的界限，并证明了该界限是信息论最优的。这表明了经典的Gordon等人的算法（尽管计算效率低下）是存在最优的。该方法还可推广到具有多项式维度的交换偏差集，统一并加强了在线学习和均衡计算的最新结果。

title: MORPH Wheel: A Passive Variable-Radius Wheel Embedding Mechanical Behavior Logic for Input-Responsive Transformation
authors: JaeHyung Jang, JuYeong Seo, Dae-Young Lee, Jee-Hwan Ryu
abstract: This paper introduces the Mechacnially prOgrammed Radius-adjustable PHysical (MORPH) wheel, a fully passive variable-radius wheel that embeds mechanical behavior logic for torque-responsive transformation. Unlike conventional variable transmission systems relying on actuators, sensors, and active control, the MORPH wheel achieves passive adaptation solely through its geometry and compliant structure. The design integrates a torque-response coupler and spring-loaded connecting struts to mechanically adjust the wheel radius between 80 mm and 45 mm in response to input torque, without any electrical components. The MORPH wheel provides three unique capabilities rarely achieved simultaneously in previous passive designs: (1) bidirectional operation with unlimited rotation through a symmetric coupler; (2) high torque capacity exceeding 10 N with rigid power transmission in drive mode; and (3) precise and repeatable transmission ratio control governed by deterministic kinematics. A comprehensive analytical model was developed to describe the wheel's mechanical behavior logic, establishing threshold conditions for mode switching between direct drive and radius transformation. Experimental validation confirmed that the measured torque-radius and force-displacement characteristics closely follow theoretical predictions across wheel weights of 1.8-2.8kg. Robot-level demonstrations on varying loads (0-25kg), slopes, and unstructured terrains further verified that the MORPH wheel passively adjusts its radius to provide optimal transmission ratio. The MORPH wheel exemplifies a mechanically programmed structure, embedding intelligent, context-dependent behavior directly into its physical design. This approach offers a new paradigm for passive variable transmission and mechanical intelligence in robotic mobility systems operating in unpredictable or control-limited environments.
comment: 14 pages, 16 figures. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Robotics
zh_title: MORPH轮：一种嵌入机械行为逻辑、用于输入响应式转换的被动变半径车轮
translation: 本文介绍了一种名为机械编程半径可调物理（MORPH）轮的完全被动变半径车轮，它嵌入了机械行为逻辑以实现扭矩响应式转换。与依赖执行器、传感器和主动控制的传统可变传动系统不同，MORPH轮仅通过其几何形状和柔顺结构实现被动适应。该设计集成了扭矩响应耦合器和弹簧加载连接支柱，无需任何电子元件，即可响应输入扭矩，机械地将车轮半径在80毫米和45毫米之间进行调整。MORPH轮提供了以前被动设计中很少能同时实现的三个独特功能：（1）通过对称耦合器实现双向操作和无限旋转；（2）在驱动模式下具有超过10 N的高扭矩容量和刚性动力传动；（3）由确定性运动学控制的精确且可重复的传动比控制。开发了一个全面的分析模型来描述车轮的机械行为逻辑，建立了直接驱动和半径转换之间模式切换的阈值条件。实验验证了在1.8-2.8公斤的车轮重量范围内，测得的扭矩-半径和力-位移特性与理论预测密切吻合。在不同负载（0-25公斤）、坡度和非结构化地形上的机器人级演示进一步证实了MORPH轮能被动调整其半径以提供最佳传动比。MORPH轮体现了一种机械编程结构，将智能的、上下文相关的行为直接嵌入到其物理设计中。这种方法为在不可预测或控制受限环境中运行的机器人移动系统中的被动变速和机械智能提供了一种新范例。
tldr: MORPH轮是一种完全被动的变半径车轮，它通过几何形状和柔顺结构（扭矩响应耦合器和弹簧）根据输入扭矩自动改变半径（80mm到45mm），无需电子元件即可实现鲁棒、双向、高扭矩和可预测的运动。
ai_comments: 核心创新在于通过纯粹的被动机械设计（几何形状和柔顺性）实现了复杂的、上下文相关的行为逻辑（可变传动），有效地“编程”了结构。这对于在主动系统不切实际的极端或控制受限环境中运行的应用至关重要，为传统的主动变速系统提供了一种高扭矩、可预测的替代方案，开辟了机械智能的新范式。
motivation: 传统的变速系统依赖于执行器、传感器和主动控制。本文的动机是通过纯机械设计实现被动适应和上下文相关行为，为在不可预测或控制受限环境中运行的机器人移动系统提供被动变速和机械智能的新范例。
method: 提出了一种完全被动的、名为“MORPH轮”的变半径车轮设计。该设计集成了扭矩响应耦合器和弹簧加载连接支柱，通过几何形状和柔顺结构根据输入扭矩调整半径（80毫米到45毫米）。开发了全面的分析模型来描述其机械行为逻辑和模式切换的阈值条件。
results: MORPH轮实现了基于输入扭矩的半径调整。它具备三个独特能力：（1）双向操作；（2）高扭矩容量（超过10 N）和刚性传动；（3）精确且可重复的传动比控制。实验验证了扭矩-半径和力-位移特性与理论预测高度吻合。机器人在不同负载、坡度和非结构化地形上的演示证实了其被动调整半径以提供最佳传动比的能力。
conclusion: MORPH轮例证了一种机械编程结构，将智能的、上下文相关的行为直接嵌入到其物理设计中。这为在不可预测或控制受限环境中运行的机器人移动系统中的被动变速和机械智能提供了一种新范例。

title: Is my model "mind blurting"? Interpreting the dynamics of reasoning tokens with Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA)
authors: Quoc Tuan Pham, Mehdi Jafari, Flora Salim
abstract: Test-time compute is central to large reasoning models, yet analysing their reasoning behaviour through generated text is increasingly impractical and unreliable. Response length is often used as a brute proxy for reasoning effort, but this metric fails to capture the dynamics and effectiveness of the Chain of Thoughts (CoT) or the generated tokens. We propose Recurrence Quantification Analysis (RQA) as a non-textual alternative for analysing model's reasoning chains at test time. By treating token generation as a dynamical system, we extract hidden embeddings at each generation step and apply RQA to the resulting trajectories. RQA metrics, including Determinism and Laminarity, quantify patterns of repetition and stalling in the model's latent representations. Analysing 3,600 generation traces from DeepSeek-R1-Distill, we show that RQA captures signals not reflected by response length, but also substantially improves prediction of task complexity by 8\%. These results help establish RQA as a principled tool for studying the latent token generation dynamics of test-time scaling in reasoning models.
zh_title: 我的模型是否在“胡言乱语”（mind blurting）？用递归量化分析（RQA）解释推理令牌的动态。
translation: 测试时计算对于大型推理模型至关重要，然而，通过生成的文本来分析其推理行为正变得越来越不切实际且不可靠。响应长度通常被用作衡量推理努力的粗略指标，但该指标无法捕捉思维链（CoT）或生成令牌的动态和有效性。我们提出递归量化分析（RQA）作为一种非文本替代方案，用于在测试时分析模型的推理链。通过将令牌生成视为一个动态系统，我们提取每个生成步骤的隐藏嵌入，并将RQA应用于由此产生的轨迹。RQA指标，包括确定性和层流性（Determinism and Laminarity），量化了模型潜在表示中重复和停滞的模式。通过分析来自DeepSeek-R1-Distill的3,600个生成轨迹，我们表明RQA不仅捕获了响应长度未反映的信号，而且将任务复杂度的预测能力提高了8%。这些结果有助于确立RQA作为研究推理模型测试时扩展的潜在令牌生成动态的原则性工具。
tldr: 现有大模型推理分析方法很差。我们引入递归量化分析（RQA），通过分析隐藏嵌入轨迹，将令牌生成视为动态系统。RQA成功捕获了潜在的重复/停滞模式，并将任务复杂性预测提高了8%。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将大型语言模型的令牌生成过程视为一个复杂的动态系统，并引入递归量化分析（RQA）这一非文本工具来解释其推理动态。这超越了简单的响应长度指标，提供了对模型潜在推理过程（如重复、停滞）更深层次的、可量化的理解。通过量化模型潜在表示中的模式，RQA为研究测试时计算和推理效率提供了一个原则性的新视角。
motivation: 分析大型推理模型的推理行为（如思维链CoT）越来越不切实际且不可靠。响应长度作为推理努力的粗略指标，无法捕捉生成令牌的动态和有效性。
method: 提出递归量化分析（RQA）作为分析模型推理链的非文本替代方案。将令牌生成视为一个动态系统，提取每个生成步骤的隐藏嵌入，并将RQA应用于由此产生的轨迹。RQA指标（如确定性、层流性）用于量化模型潜在表示中重复和停滞的模式。
results: 分析了DeepSeek-R1-Distill的3,600个生成轨迹。结果显示RQA捕获了响应长度未反映的信号，并将任务复杂度的预测能力提高了8%。
conclusion: RQA有助于将递归量化分析确立为研究推理模型测试时扩展的潜在令牌生成动态的原则性工具。

title: VowelPrompt: Hearing Speech Emotions from Text via Vowel-level Prosodic Augmentation
authors: Yancheng Wang, Osama Hanna, Ruiming Xie, Xianfeng Rui, Maohao Shen, Xuedong Zhang, Christian Fuegen, Jilong Wu, Debjyoti Paul, Arthur Guo, Zhihong Lei, Ozlem Kalinli, Qing He, Yingzhen Yang
abstract: Emotion recognition in speech presents a complex multimodal challenge, requiring comprehension of both linguistic content and vocal expressivity, particularly prosodic features such as fundamental frequency, intensity, and temporal dynamics. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in reasoning over textual transcriptions for emotion recognition, they typically neglect fine-grained prosodic information, limiting their effectiveness and interpretability. In this work, we propose VowelPrompt, a linguistically grounded framework that augments LLM-based emotion recognition with interpretable, fine-grained vowel-level prosodic cues. Drawing on phonetic evidence that vowels serve as primary carriers of affective prosody, VowelPrompt extracts pitch-, energy-, and duration-based descriptors from time-aligned vowel segments, and converts these features into natural language descriptions for better interpretability. Such a design enables LLMs to jointly reason over lexical semantics and fine-grained prosodic variation. Moreover, we adopt a two-stage adaptation procedure comprising supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR), implemented via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), to enhance reasoning capability, enforce structured output adherence, and improve generalization across domains and speaker variations. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that VowelPrompt consistently outperforms state-of-the-art emotion recognition methods under zero-shot, fine-tuned, cross-domain, and cross-linguistic conditions, while enabling the generation of interpretable explanations that are jointly grounded in contextual semantics and fine-grained prosodic structure.

title: MPIB: A Benchmark for Medical Prompt Injection Attacks and Clinical Safety in LLMs
authors: Junhyeok Lee, Han Jang, Kyu Sung Choi
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly integrated into clinical workflows; however, prompt injection attacks can steer these systems toward clinically unsafe or misleading outputs. We introduce the Medical Prompt Injection Benchmark (MPIB), a dataset-and-benchmark suite for evaluating clinical safety under both direct prompt injection and indirect, RAG-mediated injection across clinically grounded tasks. MPIB emphasizes outcome-level risk via the Clinical Harm Event Rate (CHER), which measures high-severity clinical harm events under a clinically grounded taxonomy, and reports CHER alongside Attack Success Rate (ASR) to disentangle instruction compliance from downstream patient risk. The benchmark comprises 9,697 curated instances constructed through multi-stage quality gates and clinical safety linting. Evaluating MPIB across a diverse set of baseline LLMs and defense configurations, we find that ASR and CHER can diverge substantially, and that robustness depends critically on whether adversarial instructions appear in the user query or in retrieved context. We release MPIB with evaluation code, adversarial baselines, and comprehensive documentation to support reproducible and systematic research on clinical prompt injection. Code and data are available at GitHub (code) and Hugging Face (data).
zh_title: MPIB：一个用于评估大型语言模型医疗提示注入攻击和临床安全性的基准
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和检索增强生成（RAG）系统正日益集成到临床工作流程中；然而，提示注入攻击可以引导这些系统产生临床不安全或误导性的输出。我们引入了医疗提示注入基准（MPIB），这是一个数据集和基准套件，用于评估在临床任务中，直接提示注入和RAG介导的间接注入下的临床安全性。MPIB通过“临床伤害事件率”（CHER）来强调结果层面的风险，该指标根据临床分类法衡量高严重性的临床伤害事件，并与“攻击成功率”（ASR）一同报告，以区分指令依从性与下游患者风险。该基准包含9,697个通过多阶段质量门和临床安全检查精心策划的实例。通过评估MPIB上各种基线LLMs和防御配置，我们发现ASR和CHER可以显著分化，并且鲁棒性关键取决于对抗性指令是出现在用户查询中还是检索到的上下文中。我们发布了MPIB及其评估代码、对抗性基线和全面的文档，以支持关于临床提示注入的可重现和系统性研究。代码和数据可在GitHub（代码）和Hugging Face（数据）获取。
tldr: 本文提出了医疗提示注入基准（MPIB），一个包含9,697个实例的基准，用于评估LLMs和RAG系统在直接/间接医疗攻击下的临床安全性。MPIB使用临床伤害事件率（CHER）和攻击成功率（ASR）双指标衡量风险，发现两者可能存在差异，且鲁棒性与攻击指令出现在查询或检索上下文中密切相关。
ai_comments: MPIB的创新性在于其将传统的攻击成功率（ASR）与临床结果风险（CHER）解耦，为医疗AI安全评估提供了更具临床意义的指标。在临床应用中，模型遵守恶意指令的程度（ASR）不如该指令是否实际导致严重患者伤害（CHER）重要。此外，区分直接注入和RAG介导的间接注入，强调了在实际临床系统中，检索到的不安全信息是主要的攻击向量，这对未来RAG系统的防御研究具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 鉴于大型语言模型（LLMs）和检索增强生成（RAG）系统日益集成到临床工作流程中，但提示注入攻击可能导致这些系统产生临床不安全或误导性的输出，因此需要一个专门的基准来评估其在临床环境下的安全性。
method: 本文引入了医疗提示注入基准（MPIB），这是一个包含9,697个实例的数据集和基准套件，通过多阶段质量门和临床安全检查构建。评估方法使用“临床伤害事件率”（CHER）来衡量高严重性临床伤害事件的风险（结果层面风险），并将其与“攻击成功率”（ASR）一同报告，以区分指令依从性与下游患者风险。该基准用于评估LLMs在直接提示注入和RAG介导的间接注入下的安全性。
results: 评估发现，攻击成功率（ASR）和临床伤害事件率（CHER）可以显著分化。模型的鲁棒性关键取决于对抗性指令是出现在用户查询中还是检索到的上下文中。

title: PurSAMERE: Reliable Adversarial Purification via Sharpness-Aware Minimization of Expected Reconstruction Error
authors: Vinh Hoang, Sebastian Krumscheid, Holger Rauhut, Raúl Tempone
abstract: We propose a novel deterministic purification method to improve adversarial robustness by mapping a potentially adversarial sample toward a nearby sample that lies close to a mode of the data distribution, where classifiers are more reliable. We design the method to be deterministic to ensure reliable test accuracy and to prevent the degradation of effective robustness observed in stochastic purification approaches when the adversary has full knowledge of the system and its randomness. We employ a score model trained by minimizing the expected reconstruction error of noise-corrupted data, thereby learning the structural characteristics of the input data distribution. Given a potentially adversarial input, the method searches within its local neighborhood for a purified sample that minimizes the expected reconstruction error under noise corruption and then feeds this purified sample to the classifier. During purification, sharpness-aware minimization is used to guide the purified samples toward flat regions of the expected reconstruction error landscape, thereby enhancing robustness. We further show that, as the noise level decreases, minimizing the expected reconstruction error biases the purified sample toward local maximizers of the Gaussian-smoothed density; under additional local assumptions on the score model, we prove recovery of a local maximizer in the small-noise limit. Experimental results demonstrate significant gains in adversarial robustness over state-of-the-art methods under strong deterministic white-box attacks.
zh_title: 基于预期重构误差的锐度感知最小化，实现可靠的对抗性净化
translation: 我们提出了一种新颖的确定性净化方法，通过将潜在的对抗性样本映射到数据分布模式附近的一个样本，来提高对抗鲁棒性，在这些模式处分类器更可靠。我们设计该方法是确定性的，以确保可靠的测试准确性，并防止在对手完全了解系统及其随机性的情况下观察到的有效鲁棒性下降。我们采用了一个分数模型，通过最小化噪声损坏数据的预期重构误差来训练，从而学习输入数据的结构特征。给定一个潜在的对抗性输入，该方法在其局部邻域内搜索一个净化后的样本，该样本在噪声损坏下最小化预期重构误差，然后将此净化后的样本输入分类器。在净化过程中，使用锐度感知最小化将净化后的样本引导至预期重构误差景观的平坦区域，从而增强鲁棒性。我们进一步表明，随着噪声水平的降低，最小化预期重构误差会将净化后的样本偏向高斯平滑密度局部最大化器；在对分数模型进行额外的局部假设下，我们证明在小噪声极限下可以恢复局部最大化器。实验结果表明，在强确定性白盒攻击下，与现有最先进的方法相比，对抗鲁棒性得到了显著的提高。
tldr: 提出了一种确定性的对抗性净化方法（PurSAMERE），通过最小化预期重构误差并结合锐度感知最小化，将对抗性样本映射到数据分布的模式附近，以提高分类器的可靠性和对抗鲁棒性，并在白盒攻击下展现出优于现有方法的性能。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的确定性净化方法PurSAMERE，解决了随机净化方法在特定攻击下的鲁棒性下降问题。通过结合预期重构误差最小化和锐度感知最小化，该方法有效地将对抗性样本映射到数据分布的可靠区域，并在实验中取得了优于现有技术的成果。该方法的理论分析也为理解其在小噪声极限下的行为提供了见解。未来的工作可以探索该方法在不同类型攻击和更复杂数据分布上的泛化能力。
motivation: 现有的随机净化方法在面对完全了解系统及其随机性的对手时，会降低有效鲁棒性。需要一种确定性的净化方法来提高对抗鲁棒性，并确保可靠的测试准确性。
method: 设计了一种确定性的净化方法，使用由最小化噪声损坏数据的预期重构误差训练的分数模型来学习数据分布的结构特征。在净化过程中，利用锐度感知最小化（SAM）将净化后的样本引导至预期重构误差景观的平坦区域。
results: 实验结果表明，在强确定性白盒攻击下，该方法在对抗鲁棒性方面显著优于现有最先进的方法。
conclusion: 提出的PurSAMERE方法通过最小化预期重构误差并结合锐度感知最小化，能够有效地提高对抗鲁棒性，并且在面对强白盒攻击时表现优于现有技术。

title: RoPE-LIME: RoPE-Space Locality + Sparse-K Sampling for Efficient LLM Attribution
authors: Isaac Picov, Ritesh Goru
abstract: Explaining closed-source LLM outputs is challenging because API access prevents gradient-based attribution, while perturbation methods are costly and noisy when they depend on regenerated text. We introduce RoPE-LIME, an open-source extension of gSMILE that decouples reasoning from explanation: given a fixed output from a closed model, a smaller open-source surrogate computes token-level attributions from probability-based objectives (negative log-likelihood and divergence targets) under input perturbations. RoPE-LIME incorporates (i) a locality kernel based on Relaxed Word Mover's Distance computed in RoPE embedding space for stable similarity under masking, and (ii) Sparse-K sampling, an efficient perturbation strategy that improves interaction coverage under limited budgets. Experiments on HotpotQA (sentence features) and a hand-labeled MMLU subset (word features) show that RoPE-LIME produces more informative attributions than leave-one-out sampling and improves over gSMILE while substantially reducing closed-model API calls.

title: Statistical Learning from Attribution Sets
authors: Lorne Applebaum, Robert Busa-Fekete, August Y. Chen, Claudio Gentile, Tomer Koren, Aryan Mokhtari
abstract: We address the problem of training conversion prediction models in advertising domains under privacy constraints, where direct links between ad clicks and conversions are unavailable. Motivated by privacy-preserving browser APIs and the deprecation of third-party cookies, we study a setting where the learner observes a sequence of clicks and a sequence of conversions, but can only link a conversion to a set of candidate clicks (an attribution set) rather than a unique source. We formalize this as learning from attribution sets generated by an oblivious adversary equipped with a prior distribution over the candidates. Despite the lack of explicit labels, we construct an unbiased estimator of the population loss from these coarse signals via a novel approach. Leveraging this estimator, we show that Empirical Risk Minimization achieves generalization guarantees that scale with the informativeness of the prior and is also robust against estimation errors in the prior, despite complex dependencies among attribution sets. Simple empirical evaluations on standard datasets suggest our unbiased approach significantly outperforms common industry heuristics, particularly in regimes where attribution sets are large or overlapping.

title: A High-Fidelity Robotic Manipulator Teleoperation Framework for Human-Centered Augmented Reality Evaluation
authors: Harsh Chhajed, Tian Guo
abstract: Validating Augmented Reality (AR) tracking and interaction models requires precise, repeatable ground-truth motion. However, human users cannot reliably perform consistent motion due to biomechanical variability. Robotic manipulators are promising to act as human motion proxies if they can mimic human movements. In this work, we design and implement ARBot, a real-time teleoperation platform that can effectively capture natural human motion and accurately replay the movements via robotic manipulators. ARBot includes two capture models: stable wrist motion capture via a custom CV and IMU pipeline, and natural 6-DOF control via a mobile application. We design a proactively-safe QP controller to ensure smooth, jitter-free execution of the robotic manipulator, enabling it to function as a high-fidelity record and replay physical proxy. We open-source ARBot and release a benchmark dataset of 132 human and synthetic trajectories captured using ARBot to support controllable and scalable AR evaluation.
zh_title: 面向以人为本的增强现实评估的高保真机器人操作器遥操作框架
translation: 验证增强现实（AR）跟踪和交互模型需要精确、可重复的真实运动。然而，由于生物力学变异性，人类用户无法可靠地执行一致的运动。如果机器人操作器能够模仿人类运动，它们有望成为人类运动的代理。在本研究中，我们设计并实现了一个实时遥操作平台ARBot，该平台能够有效地捕捉自然人类运动并通过机器人操作器精确地回放运动。ARBot包含两种捕捉模型：一种是通过定制的CV和IMU管道进行稳定的手腕运动捕捉，另一种是通过移动应用程序进行自然的6自由度控制。我们设计了一个主动安全的QP控制器，以确保机器人操作器的平滑、无抖动执行，使其能够作为高保真的记录和回放物理代理。我们开源了ARBot，并发布了一个使用ARBot捕捉的包含132个人类和合成轨迹的基准数据集，以支持可控和可扩展的AR评估。
tldr: 本研究提出了ARBot，一个实时遥操作平台，通过机器人操作器精确模仿人类运动，以解决在增强现实（AR）评估中人类运动不一致的问题。该平台结合了定制的计算机视觉（CV）和惯性测量单元（IMU）管道以进行稳定的手腕运动捕捉，并通过移动应用程序进行自然的6自由度（DOF）控制。它使用一个安全且主动的二次规划（QP）控制器来确保机器人操作器的平滑执行，从而作为高保真的记录和回放物理代理。此外，研究人员开源了ARBot并发布了一个包含132个人类和合成轨迹的基准数据集，以支持可控和可扩展的AR评估。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种解决AR评估中运动捕捉挑战的有效方法，通过机器人操作器提供高保真运动回放。ARBot平台的设计兼顾了捕捉的准确性和执行的安全性与平滑性。开源和数据集的发布对于推动AR领域的研究和应用具有重要意义。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的运动模式和更广泛的应用场景。
motivation: 在增强现实（AR）评估中，需要精确且可重复的真实运动数据来验证AR跟踪和交互模型。然而，人类用户由于生物力学差异，无法可靠地执行一致的运动。因此，需要一种能够模仿人类运动的机器人操作器来作为人类运动的代理。
method: 设计并实现了一个名为ARBot的实时遥操作平台。该平台包含两种运动捕捉模型：一种是利用定制的计算机视觉（CV）和惯性测量单元（IMU）管道进行稳定的手腕运动捕捉；另一种是通过移动应用程序进行自然的6自由度（DOF）控制。此外，还设计了一个主动安全二次规划（QP）控制器，以确保机器人操作器的平滑、无抖动执行。
results: ARBot平台能够有效捕捉自然人类运动，并通过机器人操作器精确回放这些运动。其定制的CV和IMU管道实现了稳定的手腕运动捕捉，移动应用程序提供了自然的6自由度控制，而QP控制器保证了机器人操作器的平滑执行。
conclusion: ARBot是一个高保真的机器人操作器遥操作框架，能够精确捕捉和回放人类运动，为以人为本的增强现实（AR）评估提供了有效的解决方案。通过开源平台和发布基准数据集，该研究为AR评估的进一步发展奠定了基础。

title: An Interpretable Vision Transformer as a Fingerprint-Based Diagnostic Aid for Kabuki and Wiedemann-Steiner Syndromes
authors: Marilyn Lionts, Arnhildur Tomasdottir, Viktor I. Agustsson, Yuankai Huo, Hans T. Bjornsson, Lotta M. Ellingsen
abstract: Kabuki syndrome (KS) and Wiedemann-Steiner syndrome (WSS) are rare but distinct developmental disorders that share overlapping clinical features, including neurodevelopmental delay, growth restriction, and persistent fetal fingertip pads. While genetic testing remains the diagnostic gold standard, many individuals with KS or WSS remain undiagnosed due to barriers in access to both genetic testing and expertise. Dermatoglyphic anomalies, despite being established hallmarks of several genetic syndromes, remain an underutilized diagnostic signal in the era of molecular testing. This study presents a vision transformer-based deep learning model that leverages fingerprint images to distinguish individuals with KS and WSS from unaffected controls and from one another. We evaluate model performance across three binary classification tasks. Across the three classification tasks, the model achieved AUC scores of 0.80 (control vs. KS), 0.73 (control vs. WSS), and 0.85 (KS vs. WSS), with corresponding F1 scores of 0.71, 0.72, and 0.83, respectively. Beyond classification, we apply attention-based visualizations to identify fingerprint regions most salient to model predictions, enhancing interpretability. Together, these findings suggest the presence of syndrome-specific fingerprint features, demonstrating the feasibility of a fingerprint-based artificial intelligence (AI) tool as a noninvasive, interpretable, and accessible future diagnostic aid for the early diagnosis of underdiagnosed genetic syndromes.

title: Rethinking External Communication of Autonomous Vehicles: Is the Field Converging, Diverging, or Stalling?
authors: Tram Thi Minh Tran, Debargha Dey, Martin Tomitsch
abstract: As autonomous vehicles enter public spaces, external human-machine interfaces are proposed to support communication with external road users. A decade of research has produced hundreds of studies and reviews, yet it remains unclear whether the field is converging on shared principles or diverging across approaches. We present a multi-dimensional analysis of 620 publications, complemented by industry deployments and regulatory documents, to track research evolution and identify convergence. The analysis reveals several field-level patterns. First, convergence on a safety-first core: simple visual cues that clarify intent. Second, sustained divergence in necessity and implementation. Third, a progressive filtering funnel: broad exploration in research and concepts narrows in deployment and is codified by regulation into a minimal set of permitted signals. These insights point to a shift in emphasis for future work, from producing new prototypes toward consolidating evidence, clarifying points of contention, and developing frameworks that can adapt across contexts.

title: Misophonia Trigger Sound Detection on Synthetic Soundscapes Using a Hybrid Model with a Frozen Pre-Trained CNN and a Time-Series Module
authors: Kurumi Sashida, Gouhei Tanaka
abstract: Misophonia is a disorder characterized by a decreased tolerance to specific everyday sounds (trigger sounds) that can evoke intense negative emotional responses such as anger, panic, or anxiety. These reactions can substantially impair daily functioning and quality of life. Assistive technologies that selectively detect trigger sounds could help reduce distress and improve well-being. In this study, we investigate sound event detection (SED) to localize intervals of trigger sounds in continuous environmental audio as a foundational step toward such assistive support. Motivated by the scarcity of real-world misophonia data, we generate synthetic soundscapes tailored to misophonia trigger sound detection using audio synthesis techniques. Then, we perform trigger sound detection tasks using hybrid CNN-based models. The models combine feature extraction using a frozen pre-trained CNN backbone with a trainable time-series module such as gated recurrent units (GRUs), long short-term memories (LSTMs), echo state networks (ESNs), and their bidirectional variants. The detection performance is evaluated using common SED metrics, including Polyphonic Sound Detection Score 1 (PSDS1). On the multi-class trigger SED task, bidirectional temporal modeling consistently improves detection performance, with Bidirectional GRU (BiGRU) achieving the best overall accuracy. Notably, the Bidirectional ESN (BiESN) attains competitive performance while requiring orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters by optimizing only the readout. We further simulate user personalization via a few-shot "eating sound" detection task with at most five support clips, in which BiGRU and BiESN are compared. In this strict adaptation setting, BiESN shows robust and stable performance, suggesting that lightweight temporal modules are promising for personalized misophonia trigger SED.
zh_title: 一种使用带有冻结预训练CNN和时间序列模块的混合模型来检测恐音症触发声音的合成音景
translation: 恐音症是一种以对特定日常声音（触发声音）的容忍度降低为特征的疾病，这些声音会引发强烈的负面情绪反应，如愤怒、恐慌或焦虑。这些反应会严重影响日常功能和生活质量。能够选择性检测触发声音的辅助技术有助于减轻痛苦，提高福祉。在本研究中，我们研究声音事件检测（SED），以在连续的环境音频中定位触发声音的间隔，作为实现此类辅助支持的基础步骤。受真实世界恐音症数据稀缺的启发，我们使用音频合成技术生成针对恐音症触发声音检测量身定制的合成音景。然后，我们使用基于CNN的混合模型执行触发声音检测任务。这些模型结合了使用冻结的预训练CNN骨干进行特征提取，以及一个可训练的时间序列模块，如门控循环单元（GRU）、长短期记忆（LSTM）、回声状态网络（ESN）及其双向变体。使用常见的SED指标（包括多声道声音检测分数1（PSDS1））评估检测性能。在多类触发声音事件检测任务中，双向时间建模一致提高了检测性能，其中双向GRU（BiGRU）取得了最佳的整体准确率。值得注意的是，双向ESN（BiESN）在仅优化读出参数的情况下，通过仅优化读出参数，达到了具有竞争力的性能，同时所需的训练参数数量减少了几个数量级。我们通过一个少样本的“饮食声音”检测任务（最多五个支持片段）进一步模拟用户个性化，在该任务中比较了BiGRU和BiESN。在这种严格的适应设置下，BiESN表现出鲁棒且稳定的性能，表明轻量级时间序列模块在个性化恐音症触发声音事件检测方面具有潜力。
tldr: 由于缺乏真实世界的恐音症数据，研究人员使用合成音景来训练混合模型，该模型结合了预训练的CNN和时间序列模块（如BiGRU、LSTM、ESN）来检测恐音症触发声音。结果显示，双向时间模型，特别是BiGRU，在检测性能上表现最佳。BiESN在参数需求方面表现出竞争力，并且在少样本的个性化设置中表现出鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 这项研究提出了一种创新的混合模型，结合了预训练的CNN和时间序列模块，用于检测恐音症的触发声音。利用合成数据来克服真实世界数据稀缺的挑战是一个明智的策略。该研究在性能和参数效率之间取得了良好的平衡，特别是BiESN模型在个性化设置下表现出的鲁棒性，为开发实际的辅助技术提供了有前景的途径。然而，未来可以在真实世界数据集上进一步验证这些模型的泛化能力和有效性。
motivation: 由于缺乏真实世界的恐音症数据，需要开发能够选择性检测触发声音的辅助技术，以帮助减少患者的痛苦并改善其生活质量。
method: 研究人员生成合成音景，并使用混合CNN模型进行声音事件检测（SED）。该模型结合了冻结的预训练CNN骨干和可训练的时间序列模块（如GRU、LSTM、ESN及其双向变体）。使用PSDS1等SED指标评估检测性能。此外，还模拟了用户个性化，通过少样本的“饮食声音”检测任务，比较了BiGRU和BiESN的性能。
results: 在多类触发声音事件检测任务中，双向时间建模一致提高了检测性能，其中BiGRU取得了最佳的整体准确率。BiESN在仅优化读出参数的情况下，以更少的训练参数获得了可观的性能。在严格的少样本适应设置下，BiESN表现出鲁棒且稳定的性能。
conclusion: 混合模型，特别是结合了冻结预训练CNN和双向时间序列模块（如BiGRU和BiESN）的模型，在恐音症触发声音检测方面显示出有希望的结果。BiESN在参数效率和个性化设置下的鲁棒性方面尤其值得关注，表明轻量级时间序列模块在个性化恐音症触发声音事件检测方面具有潜力。

title: SOCKET: SOft Collison Kernel EsTimator for Sparse Attention
authors: Sahil Joshi, Agniva Chowdhury, Wyatt Bellinger, Amar Kanakamedala, Ekam Singh, Hoang Anh Duy Le, Aditya Desai, Anshumali Shrivastava
abstract: Exploiting sparsity during long-context inference is central to scaling large language models, as attention dominates the cost of autoregressive decoding. Sparse attention reduces this cost by restricting computation to a subset of tokens, but its effectiveness depends critically on efficient scoring and selection of relevant tokens at inference time. We revisit Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) as a sparsification primitive and introduce SOCKET, a SOft Collision Kernel EsTimator that replaces hard bucket matches with probabilistic, similarity-aware aggregation. Our key insight is that hard LSH produces discrete collision signals and is therefore poorly suited for ranking. In contrast, soft LSH aggregates graded collision evidence across hash tables, preserving the stability of relative ordering among the true top-$k$ tokens. This transformation elevates LSH from a candidate-generation heuristic to a principled and mathematically grounded scoring kernel for sparse attention. Leveraging this property, SOCKET enables efficient token selection without ad-hoc voting mechanism, and matches or surpasses established sparse attention baselines across multiple long-context benchmarks using diverse set of models. With a custom CUDA kernel for scoring keys and a Flash Decode Triton backend for sparse attention, SOCKET achieves up to 1.5$\times$ higher throughput than FlashAttention, making it an effective tool for long-context inference. Code is open-sourced at https://github.com/amarka8/SOCKET.

title: Geometric Kernel Interpolation and Regression
authors: Patrick Guidotti
abstract: Exploiting the variational interpretation of kernel interpolation we exhibit a direct connection between interpolation and regression, where interpolation appears as a limiting case of regression. By applying this framework to point clouds or samples of smooth manifolds (hypersurfaces, in particular), we show how fundamental geometric quantities such as tangent plane and principal curvatures can be computed numerically using a kernel based (approximate) level set function (often a defining function) for smooth hypersurfaces. In the case of point clouds, the approach generates an interpolated hypersurface, which is an approximation of the underlying manifold when the cloud is a sample of it. It is shown how the geometric quantities obtained can be used in the numerical approximation/computation of geometric operators like the surface gradient or the Laplace-Beltrami operator in the spirit of kernel based meshfree methods. Kernel based interpolation can be extremely ill-posed, especially when using smooth kernels, and the regression approximation offers a natural regularization that proves also quite useful when dealing with geometric or functional data that are affected by errors or noise.

title: Do LLMs Act Like Rational Agents? Measuring Belief Coherence in Probabilistic Decision Making
authors: Khurram Yamin, Jingjing Tang, Santiago Cortes-Gomez, Amit Sharma, Eric Horvitz, Bryan Wilder
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents in high-stakes domains where optimal actions depend on both uncertainty about the world and consideration of utilities of different outcomes, yet their decision logic remains difficult to interpret. We study whether LLMs are rational utility maximizers with coherent beliefs and stable preferences. We consider behaviors of models for diagnosis challenge problems. The results provide insights about the relationship of LLM inferences to ideal Bayesian utility maximization for elicited probabilities and observed actions. Our approach provides falsifiable conditions under which the reported probabilities \emph{cannot} correspond to the true beliefs of any rational agent. We apply this methodology to multiple medical diagnostic domains with evaluations across several LLMs. We discuss implications of the results and directions forward for uses of LLMs in guiding high-stakes decisions.

title: MMEarth-Bench: Global Model Adaptation via Multimodal Test-Time Training
authors: Lucia Gordon, Serge Belongie, Christian Igel, Nico Lang
abstract: Recent research in geospatial machine learning has demonstrated that models pretrained with self-supervised learning on Earth observation data can perform well on downstream tasks with limited training data. However, most of the existing geospatial benchmark datasets have few data modalities and poor global representation, limiting the ability to evaluate multimodal pretrained models at global scales. To fill this gap, we introduce MMEarth-Bench, a collection of five new multimodal environmental tasks with 12 modalities, globally distributed data, and both in- and out-of-distribution test splits. We benchmark a diverse set of pretrained models and find that while (multimodal) pretraining tends to improve model robustness in limited data settings, geographic generalization abilities remain poor. In order to facilitate model adaptation to new downstream tasks and geographic domains, we propose a model-agnostic method for test-time training with multimodal reconstruction (TTT-MMR) that uses all the modalities available at test time as auxiliary tasks, regardless of whether a pretrained model accepts them as input. Our method improves model performance on both the random and geographic test splits, and geographic batching leads to a good trade-off between regularization and specialization during TTT. Our dataset, code, and visualization tool are linked from the project page at lgordon99.github.io/mmearth-bench.

title: Toward generative machine learning for boosting ensembles of climate simulations
authors: Parsa Gooya, Reinel Sospedra-Alfonso, Johannes Exenberger
abstract: Accurately quantifying uncertainty in predictions and projections arising from irreducible internal climate variability is critical for informed decision making. Such uncertainty is typically assessed using ensembles produced with physics based climate models. However, computational constraints impose a trade off between generating the large ensembles required for robust uncertainty estimation and increasing model resolution to better capture fine scale dynamics. Generative machine learning offers a promising pathway to alleviate these constraints. We develop a conditional Variational Autoencoder (cVAE) trained on a limited sample of climate simulations to generate arbitrary large ensembles. The approach is applied to output from monthly CMIP6 historical and future scenario experiments produced with the Canadian Centre for Climate Modelling and Analysis' (CCCma's) Earth system model CanESM5. We show that the cVAE model learns the underlying distribution of the data and generates physically consistent samples that reproduce realistic low and high moment statistics, including extremes. Compared with more sophisticated generative architectures, cVAEs offer a mathematically transparent, interpretable, and computationally efficient framework. Their simplicity lead to some limitations, such as overly smooth outputs, spectral bias, and underdispersion, that we discuss along with strategies to mitigate them. Specifically, we show that incorporating output noise improves the representation of climate relevant multiscale variability, and we propose a simple method to achieve this. Finally, we show that cVAE-enhanced ensembles capture realistic global teleconnection patterns, even under climate conditions absent from the training data.

title: Unsupervised MRI-US Multimodal Image Registration with Multilevel Correlation Pyramidal Optimization
authors: Jiazheng Wang, Zeyu Liu, Min Liu, Xiang Chen, Hang Zhang
abstract: Surgical navigation based on multimodal image registration has played a significant role in providing intraoperative guidance to surgeons by showing the relative position of the target area to critical anatomical structures during surgery. However, due to the differences between multimodal images and intraoperative image deformation caused by tissue displacement and removal during the surgery, effective registration of preoperative and intraoperative multimodal images faces significant challenges. To address the multimodal image registration challenges in Learn2Reg 2025, an unsupervised multimodal medical image registration method based on multilevel correlation pyramidal optimization (MCPO) is designed to solve these problems. First, the features of each modality are extracted based on the modality independent neighborhood descriptor, and the multimodal images is mapped to the feature space. Second, a multilevel pyramidal fusion optimization mechanism is designed to achieve global optimization and local detail complementation of the displacement field through dense correlation analysis and weight-balanced coupled convex optimization for input features at different scales. Our method focuses on the ReMIND2Reg task in Learn2Reg 2025. Based on the results, our method achieved the first place in the validation phase and test phase of ReMIND2Reg. The MCPO is also validated on the Resect dataset, achieving an average TRE of 1.798 mm. This demonstrates the broad applicability of our method in preoperative-to-intraoperative image registration. The code is avaliable at https://github.com/wjiazheng/MCPO.
comment: first-place method of ReMIND2Reg Learn2Reg 2025 (in MICCAI 2025)

title: Judging What We Cannot Solve: A Consequence-Based Approach for Oracle-Free Evaluation of Research-Level Math
authors: Guijin Son, Donghun Yang, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Hyunwoo Ko, Amit Agarwal, Sunghee Ahn, Kyong-Ha Lee, Youngjae Yu
abstract: Recent progress in reasoning models suggests that generating plausible attempts for research-level mathematics may be within reach, but verification remains a bottleneck, consuming scarce expert time. We hypothesize that a meaningful solution should contain enough method-level information that, when applied to a neighborhood of related questions, it should yield better downstream performance than incorrect solutions. Building on this idea, we propose \textbf{Consequence-Based Utility}, an oracle-free evaluator that scores each candidate by testing its value as an in-context exemplar in solving related yet verifiable questions. Our approach is evaluated on an original set of research-level math problems, each paired with one expert-written solution and nine LLM-generated solutions. Notably, Consequence-Based Utility consistently outperforms reward models, generative reward models, and LLM judges on ranking quality.
