abstract: Current tokenization methods process sequential data without accounting for signal quality, limiting their effectiveness on noisy real-world corpora. We present QA-Token (Quality-Aware Tokenization), which incorporates data reliability directly into vocabulary construction. We make three key contributions: (i) a bilevel optimization formulation that jointly optimizes vocabulary construction and downstream performance, (ii) a reinforcement learning approach that learns merge policies through quality-aware rewards with convergence guarantees, and (iii) an adaptive parameter learning mechanism via Gumbel-Softmax relaxation for end-to-end optimization. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates consistent improvements: genomics (6.7 percentage point F1 gain in variant calling over BPE), finance (30% Sharpe ratio improvement). At foundation scale, we tokenize a pretraining corpus comprising 1.7 trillion base-pairs and achieve state-of-the-art pathogen detection (94.53 MCC) while reducing token count by 15%. We unlock noisy real-world corpora, spanning petabases of genomic sequences and terabytes of financial time series, for foundation model training with zero inference overhead.

title: InterFlow: Designing Unobtrusive AI to Empower Interviewers in Semi-Structured Interviews
authors: Yi Wen, Yu Zhang, Sriram Suresh, Zhicong Lu, Can Liu, Meng Xia
abstract: Semi-structured interviews are a common method in qualitative research. However, conducting high-quality interviews is challenging, as it requires interviewers to actively listen to participants, adapt their plans as the conversation unfolds, and probe effectively. We propose InterFlow, an AI-powered visual scaffold that helps interviewers manage the interview flow and facilitates real-time data sensemaking. The system dynamically adapts the interview script to the ongoing conversation and provides a visual timer to track interview progress and conversational balance. It further supports information capture with three levels of automation: manual entry, AI-assisted summary with user-specified focus, and a co-interview agent that proactively surfaces potential follow-up points. A within-subject user study (N = 12) indicates that InterFlow reduces interviewers' cognitive load and facilitates the interview process. Based on the user study findings, we provide design implications for unobtrusive and agency-preserving AI assistance under time-sensitive and cognitively demanding situations.

title: Empirical Analysis of Adversarial Robustness and Explainability Drift in Cybersecurity Classifiers
authors: Mona Rajhans, Vishal Khawarey
abstract: Machine learning (ML) models are increasingly deployed in cybersecurity applications such as phishing detection and network intrusion prevention. However, these models remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations small, deliberate input modifications that can degrade detection accuracy and compromise interpretability. This paper presents an empirical study of adversarial robustness and explainability drift across two cybersecurity domains phishing URL classification and network intrusion detection. We evaluate the impact of L (infinity) bounded Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) and Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) perturbations on model accuracy and introduce a quantitative metric, the Robustness Index (RI), defined as the area under the accuracy perturbation curve. Gradient based feature sensitivity and SHAP based attribution drift analyses reveal which input features are most susceptible to adversarial manipulation. Experiments on the Phishing Websites and UNSW NB15 datasets show consistent robustness trends, with adversarial training improving RI by up to 9 percent while maintaining clean-data accuracy. These findings highlight the coupling between robustness and interpretability degradation and underscore the importance of quantitative evaluation in the design of trustworthy, AI-driven cybersecurity systems.
comment: Accepted for publication in 18th ACM International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2026), Marbella, Spain

title: MeDocVL: A Visual Language Model for Medical Document Understanding and Parsing
authors: Wenjie Wang, Wei Wu, Ying Liu, Yuan Zhao, Xiaole Lv, Liang Diao, Zengjian Fan, Wenfeng Xie, Ziling Lin, De Shi, Lin Huang, Kaihe Xu, Hong Li
abstract: Medical document OCR is challenging due to complex layouts, domain-specific terminology, and noisy annotations, while requiring strict field-level exact matching. Existing OCR systems and general-purpose vision-language models often fail to reliably parse such documents. We propose MeDocVL, a post-trained vision-language model for query-driven medical document parsing. Our framework combines Training-driven Label Refinement to construct high-quality supervision from noisy annotations, with a Noise-aware Hybrid Post-training strategy that integrates reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning to achieve robust and precise extraction. Experiments on medical invoice benchmarks show that MeDocVL consistently outperforms conventional OCR systems and strong VLM baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance under noisy supervision.

title: TFusionOcc: Student's t-Distribution Based Object-Centric Multi-Sensor Fusion Framework for 3D Occupancy Prediction
authors: Zhenxing Ming, Julie Stephany Berrio, Mao Shan, Stewart Worrall
abstract: 3D semantic occupancy prediction enables autonomous vehicles (AVs) to perceive fine-grained geometric and semantic structure of their surroundings from onboard sensors, which is essential for safe decision-making and navigation. Recent models for 3D semantic occupancy prediction have successfully addressed the challenge of describing real-world objects with varied shapes and classes. However, the intermediate representations used by existing methods for 3D semantic occupancy prediction rely heavily on 3D voxel volumes or a set of 3D Gaussians, hindering the model's ability to efficiently and effectively capture fine-grained geometric details in the 3D driving environment. This paper introduces TFusionOcc, a novel object-centric multi-sensor fusion framework for predicting 3D semantic occupancy. By leveraging multi-stage multi-sensor fusion, Student's t-distribution, and the T-Mixture model (TMM), together with more geometrically flexible primitives, such as the deformable superquadric (superquadric with inverse warp), the proposed method achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the nuScenes benchmark. In addition, extensive experiments were conducted on the nuScenes-C dataset to demonstrate the robustness of the proposed method in different camera and lidar corruption scenarios. The code will be available at: https://github.com/DanielMing123/TFusionOcc

title: Near-Optimal Regret for Distributed Adversarial Bandits: A Black-Box Approach
authors: Hao Qiu, Mengxiao Zhang, Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi
abstract: We study distributed adversarial bandits, where $N$ agents cooperate to minimize the global average loss while observing only their own local losses. We show that the minimax regret for this problem is $\tildeΘ(\sqrt{(ρ^{-1/2}+K/N)T})$, where $T$ is the horizon, $K$ is the number of actions, and $ρ$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix. Our algorithm, based on a novel black-box reduction to bandits with delayed feedback, requires agents to communicate only through gossip. It achieves an upper bound that significantly improves over the previous best bound $\tilde{O}(ρ^{-1/3}(KT)^{2/3})$ of Yi and Vojnovic (2023). We complement this result with a matching lower bound, showing that the problem's difficulty decomposes into a communication cost $ρ^{-1/4}\sqrt{T}$ and a bandit cost $\sqrt{KT/N}$. We further demonstrate the versatility of our approach by deriving first-order and best-of-both-worlds bounds in the distributed adversarial setting. Finally, we extend our framework to distributed linear bandits in $R^d$, obtaining a regret bound of $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{(ρ^{-1/2}+1/N)dT})$, achieved with only $O(d)$ communication cost per agent and per round via a volumetric spanner.

title: A neuromorphic model of the insect visual system for natural image processing
authors: Adam D. Hines, Karin Nordström, Andrew B. Barron
abstract: Insect vision supports complex behaviors including associative learning, navigation, and object detection, and has long motivated computational models for understanding biological visual processing. However, many contemporary models prioritize task performance while neglecting biologically grounded processing pathways. Here, we introduce a bio-inspired vision model that captures principles of the insect visual system to transform dense visual input into sparse, discriminative codes. The model is trained using a fully self-supervised contrastive objective, enabling representation learning without labeled data and supporting reuse across tasks without reliance on domain-specific classifiers. We evaluated the resulting representations on flower recognition tasks and natural image benchmarks. The model consistently produced reliable sparse codes that distinguish visually similar inputs. To support different modelling and deployment uses, we have implemented the model as both an artificial neural network and a spiking neural network. In a simulated localization setting, our approach outperformed a simple image downsampling comparison baseline, highlighting the functional benefit of incorporating neuromorphic visual processing pathways. Collectively, these results advance insect computational modelling by providing a generalizable bio-inspired vision model capable of sparse computation across diverse tasks.

title: VENOMREC: Cross-Modal Interactive Poisoning for Targeted Promotion in Multimodal LLM Recommender Systems
authors: Guowei Guan, Yurong Hao, Jiaming Zhang, Tiantong Wu, Fuyao Zhang, Tianxiang Chen, Longtao Huang, Cyril Leung, Wei Yang Bryan Lim
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are pushing recommender systems (RecSys) toward content-grounded retrieval and ranking via cross-modal fusion. We find that while cross-modal consensus often mitigates conventional poisoning that manipulates interaction logs or perturbs a single modality, it also introduces a new attack surface where synchronised multimodal poisoning can reliably steer fused representations along stable semantic directions during fine-tuning. To characterise this threat, we formalise cross-modal interactive poisoning and propose VENOMREC, which performs Exposure Alignment to identify high-exposure regions in the joint embedding space and Cross-modal Interactive Perturbation to craft attention-guided coupled token-patch edits. Experiments on three real-world multimodal datasets demonstrate that VENOMREC consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving 0.73 mean ER@20 and improving over the strongest baseline by +0.52 absolute ER points on average, while maintaining comparable recommendation utility.

title: Point Virtual Transformer
authors: Veerain Sood, Bnalin, Gaurav Pandey
abstract: LiDAR-based 3D object detectors often struggle to detect far-field objects due to the sparsity of point clouds at long ranges, which limits the availability of reliable geometric cues. To address this, prior approaches augment LiDAR data with depth-completed virtual points derived from RGB images; however, directly incorporating all virtual points leads to increased computational cost and introduces challenges in effectively fusing real and virtual information. We present Point Virtual Transformer (PointViT), a transformer-based 3D object detection framework that jointly reasons over raw LiDAR points and selectively sampled virtual points. The framework examines multiple fusion strategies, ranging from early point-level fusion to BEV-based gated fusion, and analyses their trade-offs in terms of accuracy and efficiency. The fused point cloud is voxelized and encoded using sparse convolutions to form a BEV representation, from which a compact set of high-confidence object queries is initialised and refined through a transformer-based context aggregation module. Experiments on the KITTI benchmark report 91.16% 3D AP, 95.94% BEV AP, and 99.36% AP on the KITTI 2D detection benchmark for the Car class.

title: Stopping Computation for Converged Tokens in Masked Diffusion-LM Decoding
authors: Daisuke Oba, Danushka Bollegala, Masahiro Kaneko, Naoaki Okazaki
abstract: Masked Diffusion Language Models generate sequences via iterative sampling that progressively unmasks tokens. However, they still recompute the attention and feed-forward blocks for every token position at every step -- even when many unmasked tokens are essentially fixed, resulting in substantial waste in compute. We propose SureLock: when the posterior at an unmasked position has stabilized across steps (our sure condition), we lock that position -- thereafter skipping its query projection and feed-forward sublayers -- while caching its attention keys and values so other positions can continue to attend to it. This reduces the dominant per-iteration computational cost from $O(N^2d)$ to $O(MNd)$ where $N$ is the sequence length, $M$ is the number of unlocked token positions, and $d$ is the model dimension. In practice, $M$ decreases as the iteration progresses, yielding substantial savings. On LLaDA-8B, SureLock reduces algorithmic FLOPs by 30--50% relative to the same sampler without locking, while maintaining comparable generation quality. We also provide a theoretical analysis to justify the design rationale of SureLock: monitoring only the local KL at the lock step suffices to bound the deviation in final token probabilities. Our code will be available at https://daioba.github.io/surelock .

title: Adaptive Protein Tokenization
authors: Rohit Dilip, Ayush Varshney, David Van Valen
abstract: Tokenization is a promising path to multi-modal models capable of jointly understanding protein sequences, structure, and function. Existing protein structure tokenizers create tokens by pooling information from local neighborhoods, an approach that limits their performance on generative and representation tasks. In this work, we present a method for global tokenization of protein structures in which successive tokens contribute increasing levels of detail to a global representation. This change resolves several issues with generative models based on local protein tokenization: it mitigates error accumulation, provides embeddings without sequence-reduction operations, and allows task-specific adaptation of a tokenized sequence's information content. We validate our method on reconstruction, generative, and representation tasks and demonstrate that it matches or outperforms existing models based on local protein structure tokenizers. We show how adaptive tokens enable inference criteria based on information content, which boosts designability. We validate representations generated from our tokenizer on CATH classification tasks and demonstrate that non-linear probing on our tokenized sequences outperforms equivalent probing on representations from other tokenizers. Finally, we demonstrate how our method supports zero-shot protein shrinking and affinity maturation.

title: EEG Emotion Classification Using an Enhanced Transformer-CNN-BiLSTM Architecture with Dual Attention Mechanisms
authors: S M Rakib UI Karim, Wenyi Lu, Diponkor Bala, Rownak Ara Rasul, Sean Goggins
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based emotion recognition plays a critical role in affective computing and emerging decision-support systems, yet remains challenging due to high-dimensional, noisy, and subject-dependent signals. This study investigates whether hybrid deep learning architectures that integrate convolutional, recurrent, and attention-based components can improve emotion classification performance and robustness in EEG data. We propose an enhanced hybrid model that combines convolutional feature extraction, bidirectional temporal modeling, and self-attention mechanisms with regularization strategies to mitigate overfitting. Experiments conducted on a publicly available EEG dataset spanning three emotional states (neutral, positive, and negative) demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art classification performance, significantly outperforming classical machine learning and neural baselines. Statistical tests confirm the robustness of these performance gains under cross-validation. Feature-level analyses further reveal that covariance-based EEG features contribute most strongly to emotion discrimination, highlighting the importance of inter-channel relationships in affective modeling. These findings suggest that carefully designed hybrid architectures can effectively balance predictive accuracy, robustness, and interpretability in EEG-based emotion recognition, with implications for applied affective computing and human-centered intelligent systems.

title: Intrinsic Stability Limits of Autoregressive Reasoning: Structural Consequences for Long-Horizon Execution
authors: Hsien-Jyh Liao
abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet their performance often deteriorates sharply in long-horizon tasks, exhibiting systematic breakdown beyond certain scales. Conventional explanations primarily attribute this phenomenon to task complexity, such as combinatorial search explosion or long-term credit assignment challenges. In this work, we argue that these explanations are incomplete: even in linear, unbranched tasks without semantic ambiguity, autoregressive execution is subject to an intrinsic stability limit.
  We propose that the fundamental constraint on long-horizon reasoning arises from process-level instability in autoregressive generation rather than solely from search or task complexity, reframing long-horizon reasoning as a problem of structural governance. We derive Theorem~A, showing that decision advantage in single-path autoregressive reasoning decays exponentially with execution length, imposing a fundamental bound on maintainable reasoning chains. This result implies a structural consequence: stable long-horizon reasoning requires discrete segmentation, naturally inducing graph-like execution structures such as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs).
  Empirical studies in both synthetic environments and real TextWorld tasks reveal observable performance cliffs consistent with theoretical predictions. Our findings provide a dynamical perspective on long-horizon reasoning failure and suggest new limitations on maintaining long-term coherence under purely autoregressive architectures. Furthermore, we highlight that short-horizon evaluation protocols may obscure structural instability, indicating a potential shift from scaling toward structured governance in future reasoning systems.
comment: 16 Pages, 7 figures, Keyworda: Autoregressive Reasoning, Long-Horizon Stability, Chain-of-Thought Reasoning, Information-Theoretic Analysis, Structured Reasoning, Inference Dynamics

title: Learning Human Visual Attention on 3D Surfaces through Geometry-Queried Semantic Priors
authors: Soham Pahari, Sandeep C. Kumain
abstract: Human visual attention on three-dimensional objects emerges from the interplay between bottom-up geometric processing and top-down semantic recognition. Existing 3D saliency methods rely on hand-crafted geometric features or learning-based approaches that lack semantic awareness, failing to explain why humans fixate on semantically meaningful but geometrically unremarkable regions. We introduce SemGeo-AttentionNet, a dual-stream architecture that explicitly formalizes this dichotomy through asymmetric cross-modal fusion, leveraging diffusion-based semantic priors from geometry-conditioned multi-view rendering and point cloud transformers for geometric processing. Cross-attention ensures geometric features query semantic content, enabling bottom-up distinctiveness to guide top-down retrieval. We extend our framework to temporal scanpath generation through reinforcement learning, introducing the first formulation respecting 3D mesh topology with inhibition-of-return dynamics. Evaluation on SAL3D, NUS3D and 3DVA datasets demonstrates substantial improvements, validating how cognitively motivated architectures effectively model human visual attention on three-dimensional surfaces.
zh_title: 通过几何查询的语义先验学习三维表面上的人类视觉注意力
translation: 人类在三维物体上的视觉注意力源于自下而上的几何处理和自上而下的语义识别之间的相互作用。现有的3D显著性方法依赖于手工几何特征或缺乏语义意识的学习方法，无法解释人类为何会注视那些具有语义意义但几何特征不明显的区域。我们引入了SemGeo-AttentionNet，这是一个双流架构，通过非对称跨模态融合明确地形式化了这种二分法，它利用来自几何条件多视图渲染的基于扩散的语义先验和用于几何处理的点云Transformer。交叉注意力确保了几何特征查询语义内容，使得自下而上的显著性能够指导自上而下的检索。我们通过强化学习将我们的框架扩展到时间扫描路径生成，引入了第一个尊重3D网格拓扑并带有返回抑制动力学的公式。在SAL3D、NUS3D和3DVA数据集上的评估显示出实质性的改进，验证了认知驱动的架构如何有效地建模三维表面上的人类视觉注意力。
tldr: 提出SemGeo-AttentionNet，一个双流网络，使用交叉注意力机制将几何处理与扩散模型的语义先验结合起来，以更准确地预测3D表面上的人类视觉注意力，并在3D注视点和时间扫描路径生成方面取得了显著改进。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其认知驱动的架构设计，它明确地将人类视觉注意力的两个核心组成部分——自下而上的几何处理和自上而下的语义识别——形式化为一个双流网络（SemGeo-AttentionNet）。通过引入“几何查询的语义先验”和非对称跨模态融合，该方法有效地解决了现有3D显著性模型无法解释人类对语义区域注视的局限性。此外，将强化学习应用于尊重3D网格拓扑的时间扫描路径生成，是该领域的首次尝试，极大地扩展了3D注意力建模的应用范围和保真度。这一工作对于理解和模拟复杂3D环境中的人类感知具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的3D显著性方法依赖于手工几何特征或缺乏语义意识的学习方法，无法解释人类为何会注视那些具有语义意义但几何特征不明显的区域。
method: 引入SemGeo-AttentionNet，一个双流架构，通过非对称跨模态融合明确地形式化了几何处理和语义识别的二分法。它利用来自几何条件多视图渲染的基于扩散的语义先验和用于几何处理的点云Transformer。通过交叉注意力确保几何特征查询语义内容。该框架还通过强化学习扩展到时间扫描路径生成，并引入了首个尊重3D网格拓扑并带有返回抑制动力学的公式。
results: 在SAL3D、NUS3D和3DVA数据集上的评估显示出实质性的改进。
conclusion: 结果验证了认知驱动的架构可以有效地建模三维表面上的人类视觉注意力。

title: Alleviating Sparse Rewards by Modeling Step-Wise and Long-Term Sampling Effects in Flow-Based GRPO
authors: Yunze Tong, Mushui Liu, Canyu Zhao, Wanggui He, Shiyi Zhang, Hongwei Zhang, Peng Zhang, Jinlong Liu, Ju Huang, Jiamang Wang, Hao Jiang, Pipei Huang
abstract: Deploying GRPO on Flow Matching models has proven effective for text-to-image generation. However, existing paradigms typically propagate an outcome-based reward to all preceding denoising steps without distinguishing the local effect of each step. Moreover, current group-wise ranking mainly compares trajectories at matched timesteps and ignores within-trajectory dependencies, where certain early denoising actions can affect later states via delayed, implicit interactions. We propose TurningPoint-GRPO (TP-GRPO), a GRPO framework that alleviates step-wise reward sparsity and explicitly models long-term effects within the denoising trajectory. TP-GRPO makes two key innovations: (i) it replaces outcome-based rewards with step-level incremental rewards, providing a dense, step-aware learning signal that better isolates each denoising action's "pure" effect, and (ii) it identifies turning points-steps that flip the local reward trend and make subsequent reward evolution consistent with the overall trajectory trend-and assigns these actions an aggregated long-term reward to capture their delayed impact. Turning points are detected solely via sign changes in incremental rewards, making TP-GRPO efficient and hyperparameter-free. Extensive experiments also demonstrate that TP-GRPO exploits reward signals more effectively and consistently improves generation. Demo code is available at https://github.com/YunzeTong/TurningPoint-GRPO.
zh_title: 缓解稀疏奖励：在基于流的GRPO中建模分步和长期采样效应
translation: 在Flow Matching模型上部署GRPO已被证明对文本到图像生成是有效的。然而，现有范式通常将基于结果的奖励传播给所有先前的去噪步骤，而没有区分每一步的局部效应。此外，当前的组间排序主要比较匹配时间步的轨迹，并忽略了轨迹内的依赖关系，即某些早期的去噪动作可以通过延迟的、隐式的交互影响后来的状态。我们提出了TurningPoint-GRPO (TP-GRPO)，这是一个GRPO框架，它减轻了分步奖励的稀疏性，并明确建模了去噪轨迹内的长期效应。TP-GRPO有两个关键创新点：(i) 它用步级增量奖励取代了基于结果的奖励，提供了一个密集的、步骤感知的学习信号，更好地隔离了每个去噪动作的“纯粹”效应；(ii) 它识别了转折点——即翻转局部奖励趋势并使后续奖励演变与整体轨迹趋势保持一致的步骤——并为这些动作分配聚合的长期奖励，以捕捉它们的延迟影响。转折点仅通过增量奖励的符号变化来检测，这使得TP-GRPO高效且无需超参数。广泛的实验也表明TP-GRPO更有效地利用奖励信号并持续改进生成。演示代码可在https://github.com/YunzeTong/TurningPoint-GRPO获取。
tldr: TP-GRPO通过引入分步增量奖励和识别“转折点”来分配长期聚合奖励，解决了Flow-Based GRPO中的奖励稀疏和长期依赖问题，从而显著提高了文本到图像生成的效果。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于针对Flow Matching模型上的GRPO训练中存在的奖励稀疏性问题，提出了双重解决方案：首先，通过引入步级增量奖励，将稀疏的最终奖励转化为密集的局部学习信号，从而更好地隔离每个去噪动作的纯粹效应。其次，通过高效且无需超参数的“转折点”检测机制（基于增量奖励的符号变化），显式地建模了早期去噪行为对后续状态的延迟、长期影响。这种结合局部效应和长期效应的奖励塑造策略，为提高基于流模型的生成质量和训练效率提供了一个有效且优雅的框架。
motivation: 现有的GRPO范式将基于结果的奖励传播给所有先前的去噪步骤，但没有区分每一步的局部效应，导致分步奖励稀疏。此外，它忽略了轨迹内的依赖关系，即某些早期的去噪动作可以通过延迟的隐式交互影响后来的状态。
method: 提出TurningPoint-GRPO (TP-GRPO)框架。方法包含两个关键创新：(i) 用**步级增量奖励**取代基于结果的奖励，提供密集的、步骤感知的学习信号，以隔离去噪动作的“纯粹”效应。(ii) 识别**转折点**（即翻转局部奖励趋势的步骤），并为这些动作分配**聚合的长期奖励**以捕捉其延迟影响。转折点仅通过增量奖励的符号变化来检测，因此高效且无需超参数。
results: 广泛的实验证明TP-GRPO能更有效地利用奖励信号，并持续改进生成效果。

title: POPL-KF: A Pose-Only Geometric Representation-Based Kalman Filter for Point-Line-Based Visual-Inertial Odometry
authors: Aiping Wang, Zhaolong Yang, Shuwen Chen, Hai Zhang
abstract:
Mainstream Visual-inertial odometry 
(VIO) systems rely on point features for motion estimation and localization. However, their performance degrades in challenging scenarios. Moreover, the localization accuracy of multi-state constraint Kalman filter (MSCKF)-based VIO systems suffers from linearization errors associated with feature 3D coordinates and delayed measurement updates. To improve the performance of VIO in challenging scenes, we first propose a pose-only geometric representation for line features. Building on this, we develop POPL-KF, a Kalman filter-based VIO system that employs a pose-only geometric representation for both point and line features. POPL-KF mitigates linearization errors by explicitly eliminating both point and line feature coordinates from the measurement equations, while enabling immediate update of visual measurements. We also design a unified base-frames selection algorithm for both point and line features to ensure optimal constraints on camera poses within the pose-only measurement model. To further improve line feature quality, a line feature filter based on image grid segmentation and bidirectional optical flow consistency is proposed. Our system is evaluated on public datasets and real-world experiments, demonstrating that POPL-KF outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) filter-based methods (OpenVINS, PO-KF) and optimization-based methods (PL-VINS, EPLF-VINS), while maintaining real-time performance.
zh_title: POPL-KF：一种基于位姿几何表示的卡尔曼滤波器，用于点线视觉惯性里程计
translation: 主流视觉惯性里程计（VIO）系统依赖点特征进行运动估计和定位。然而，它们在具有挑战性的场景中性能会下降。此外，基于多状态约束卡尔曼滤波器（MSCKF）的VIO系统的定位精度受到与特征3D坐标相关的线性化误差和延迟测量更新的影响。为了提高VIO在挑战性场景中的性能，我们首先提出了一种针对线特征的“仅位姿”几何表示。在此基础上，我们开发了POPL-KF，一个基于卡尔曼滤波器的VIO系统，该系统对点特征和线特征均采用“仅位姿”几何表示。POPL-KF通过从测量方程中显式消除点和线特征坐标来减轻线性化误差，同时实现视觉测量的即时更新。我们还为点和线特征设计了一个统一的基准帧选择算法，以确保在“仅位姿”测量模型中对相机位姿施加最佳约束。为了进一步提高线特征质量，提出了一种基于图像网格分割和双向光流一致性的线特征滤波器。我们的系统在公共数据集和实际实验中进行了评估，结果表明POPL-KF优于现有的最先进（SOTA）滤波方法（OpenVINS、PO-KF）和基于优化的方法（PL-VINS、EPLF-VINS），同时保持了实时性能。
tldr: 提出POPL-KF，这是一种新的卡尔曼滤波VIO系统，它使用“仅位姿”几何表示来处理点特征和线特征。通过消除特征坐标，它减少了线性化误差并实现了即时测量更新，从而在保持实时性的同时优于现有SOTA方法。
ai_comments: 本文的关键创新在于将“仅位姿”几何表示扩展到线特征，并将其整合到一个统一的卡尔曼滤波框架（POPL-KF）中。这种方法巧妙地解决了基于MSCKF的VIO系统中的核心限制——特征坐标的线性化误差和测量延迟问题。通过同时利用点和线特征，并在测量模型中显式消除3D特征状态，该系统在提高定位精度的同时增强了在复杂环境下的鲁棒性。其超越SOTA优化方法的性能展示了基于滤波方法在特定设计下仍具有强大的竞争力。
motivation: 现有主流VIO系统（主要依赖点特征）在复杂场景中性能下降。此外，基于多状态约束卡尔曼滤波器（MSCKF）的VIO系统受到特征3D坐标线性化误差和延迟测量更新的影响，导致定位精度降低。
method: 1. 提出一种针对线特征的“仅位姿”几何表示。2. 开发POPL-KF，一个基于卡尔曼滤波器的VIO系统，对点特征和线特征均采用“仅位姿”几何表示。3. 通过从测量方程中显式消除点和线特征坐标来减轻线性化误差，并实现视觉测量的即时更新。4. 设计了一个统一的基准帧选择算法，以确保在“仅位姿”测量模型中对相机位姿施加最佳约束。5. 提出了基于图像网格分割和双向光流一致性的线特征滤波器，以提高线特征质量。
results: POPL-KF在公共数据集和实际实验中进行了评估，结果表明其性能优于现有的最先进（SOTA）滤波方法（OpenVINS、PO-KF）和基于优化的方法（PL-VINS、EPLF-VINS），同时保持了实时性能。

title: On the Wings of Imagination: Conflicting Script-based Multi-role Framework for Humor Caption Generation
authors: Wenbo Shang, Yuxi Sun, Jing Ma, Xin Huang
abstract: Humor is a commonly used and intricate human language in daily life. Humor generation, especially in multi-modal scenarios, is a challenging task for large language models (LLMs), which is typically as funny caption generation for images, requiring visual understanding, humor reasoning, creative imagination, and so on. Existing LLM-based approaches rely on reasoning chains or self-improvement, which suffer from limited creativity and interpretability. To address these bottlenecks, we develop a novel LLM-based humor generation mechanism based on a fundamental humor theory, GTVH. To produce funny and script-opposite captions, we introduce a humor-theory-driven multi-role LLM collaboration framework augmented with humor retrieval (HOMER). The framework consists of three LLM-based roles: (1) conflicting-script extractor that grounds humor in key script oppositions, forming the basis of caption generation; (2) retrieval-augmented hierarchical imaginator that identifies key humor targets and expands the creative space of them through diverse associations structured as imagination trees; and (3) caption generator that produces funny and diverse captions conditioned on the obtained knowledge. Extensive experiments on two New Yorker Cartoon benchmarking datasets show that HOMER outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and powerful LLM reasoning strategies on multi-modal humor captioning.
comment: Paper accepted as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
zh_title: 想象力的翅膀：基于冲突脚本的多角色幽默标题生成框架
translation: 幽默是日常生活中常用且复杂的人类语言。幽默生成，特别是在多模态场景中，对于大型语言模型（LLM）来说是一项具有挑战性的任务，通常表现为图像的幽默标题生成，需要视觉理解、幽默推理、创意想象等能力。现有的基于LLM的方法依赖推理链或自我改进，但它们存在创造力和可解释性有限的问题。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们基于一个基础幽默理论GTVH，开发了一种新型的基于LLM的幽默生成机制。为了生成有趣且与脚本相反的标题，我们引入了一个幽默理论驱动的多角色LLM协作框架，该框架通过幽默检索得到增强（HOMER）。该框架由三个基于LLM的角色组成：（1）冲突脚本提取器：将幽默根植于关键的脚本对立中，形成标题生成的基础；（2）检索增强分层想象器：识别关键幽默目标并通过结构化为想象树的多样化联想来扩展它们的创意空间；（3）标题生成器：根据获得的知识生成幽默且多样化的标题。在两个New Yorker Cartoon基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，HOMER在多模态幽默标题生成方面优于最先进的基线和强大的LLM推理策略。
tldr: 针对现有LLM幽默生成创意和可解释性不足的问题，本文基于幽默理论GTVH，提出了一个名为HOMER的多角色LLM协作框架，通过冲突脚本提取、检索增强分层想象和标题生成三个角色，显著提升了多模态幽默标题的生成效果。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将基础幽默理论（GTVH）系统地融入到LLM的生成机制中，增强了模型生成结果的可解释性，并指导了创意生成的过程。通过引入“冲突脚本提取”和“分层想象树”这两个明确的角色，它解决了现有LLM依赖通用推理链导致的创意受限问题。这种多角色、理论驱动的协作框架为复杂的创意性内容生成任务提供了一个有价值的参考范式。
motivation: 幽默生成，特别是在多模态场景中（如图像幽默标题生成），对LLM来说是一项挑战性任务，需要视觉理解、幽默推理和创意想象。现有基于LLM的方法依赖推理链或自我改进，但存在创造力和可解释性有限的瓶颈。
method: 提出了一种基于基础幽默理论GTVH的新型LLM幽默生成机制，并引入了一个幽默理论驱动的多角色LLM协作框架，名为HOMER（增强幽默检索）。HOMER包含三个LLM角色：（1）冲突脚本提取器：用于确定幽默的关键脚本对立。（2）检索增强分层想象器：通过结构化的想象树扩展创意空间。（3）标题生成器：根据获取的知识生成幽默且多样化的标题。
results: 在两个New Yorker Cartoon基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，HOMER在多模态幽默标题生成方面优于最先进的基线和强大的LLM推理策略。

title: Bridging the Indoor-Outdoor Gap: Vision-Centric Instruction-Guided Embodied Navigation for the Last Meters
authors: Yuxiang Zhao, Yirong Yang, Yanqing Zhu, Yanfen Shen, Chiyu Wang, Zhining Gu, Pei Shi, Wei Guo, Mu Xu
abstract: Embodied navigation holds significant promise for real-world applications such as last-mile delivery. However, most existing approaches are confined to either indoor or outdoor environments and rely heavily on strong assumptions, such as access to precise coordinate systems. While current outdoor methods can guide agents to the vicinity of a target using coarse-grained localization, they fail to enable fine-grained entry through specific building entrances, critically limiting their utility in practical deployment scenarios that require seamless outdoor-to-indoor transitions. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel task: out-to-in prior-free instruction-driven embodied navigation. This formulation explicitly eliminates reliance on accurate external priors, requiring agents to navigate solely based on egocentric visual observations guided by instructions. To tackle this task, we propose a vision-centric embodied navigation framework that leverages image-based prompts to drive decision-making. Additionally, we present the first open-source dataset for this task, featuring a pipeline that integrates trajectory-conditioned video synthesis into the data generation process. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across key metrics including success rate and path efficiency.
zh_title: 弥合室内外差距：面向最后一米的以视觉为中心的指令引导具身导航
translation: 具身导航对于最后一英里配送等实际应用具有重要前景。然而，大多数现有方法仅限于室内或室外环境，并且严重依赖诸如访问精确坐标系之类的强假设。虽然当前的室外方法可以使用粗粒度定位将智能体引导到目标附近，但它们无法实现通过特定建筑入口的细粒度进入，这严重限制了它们在需要无缝室外到室内过渡的实际部署场景中的实用性。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了一项新颖的任务：无先验、指令驱动的室外到室内具身导航。该公式明确消除了对准确外部先验的依赖，要求智能体仅根据自我中心视觉观察并由指令引导进行导航。为了解决这项任务，我们提出了一种以视觉为中心的具身导航框架，该框架利用基于图像的提示来驱动决策制定。此外，我们展示了针对该任务的首个开源数据集，其生成流程整合了轨迹条件视频合成。通过广泛的实验，我们证明了我们提出的方法在成功率和路径效率等关键指标上持续优于最先进的基线。
tldr: 针对最后一米（室外到室内）导航难题，我们提出了一个无需先验、以视觉为中心、指令引导的具身导航框架，并发布了首个开源数据集，实验证明优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于定义了一个关键且实用的导航任务（最后一米的室外到室内过渡），该任务超越了对GPS等强先验的依赖。通过纯粹依赖自我中心视觉和指令，所提出的框架解决了现实世界部署（尤其是最后一英里配送）中的一个主要限制。发布一个新的、整合了轨迹条件的视频合成数据集对于推动这一具有挑战性的、以视觉为中心的领域的研究至关重要。
motivation: 现有的具身导航方法局限于室内或室外环境，且严重依赖精确坐标系等强假设。目前的室外方法只能粗略定位到目标附近，无法实现通过特定建筑入口的细粒度导航，严重限制了其在需要无缝室外到室内过渡的实际部署场景中的实用性。
method: 提出了一种新的任务：无先验、指令驱动的室外到室内具身导航，要求智能体仅根据自我中心视觉观察和指令进行导航。提出了一种以视觉为中心的具身导航框架，利用基于图像的提示来驱动决策制定。同时，发布了首个针对该任务的开源数据集，该数据集的生成流程整合了轨迹条件视频合成。
results: 所提出的方法在成功率和路径效率等关键指标上持续优于现有最先进的基线方法。
conclusion: 通过引入无先验、指令驱动的室外到室内任务、以视觉为中心的框架和新的数据集，本文成功弥合了最后一米具身导航中的室内外差距，并展示了优越的性能。

title: Beyond Code Contributions: How Network Position, Temporal Bursts, and Code Review Activities Shape Contributor Influence in Large-Scale Open Source Ecosystems
authors: S M Rakib Ul Karim, Wenyi Lu, Sean Goggins
abstract: Open source software (OSS) projects rely on complex networks of contributors whose interactions drive innovation and sustainability. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of OSS contributor networks using advanced graph neural networks and temporal network analysis on data spanning 25 years from the Cloud Native Computing Foundation ecosystem, encompassing sandbox, incubating, and graduated projects. Our analysis of thousands of contributors across hundreds of repositories reveals that OSS networks exhibit strong power-law distributions in influence, with the top 1\% of contributors controlling a substantial portion of network influence. Using GPU-accelerated PageRank, betweenness centrality, and custom LSTM models, we identify five distinct contributor roles: Core, Bridge, Connector, Regular, and Peripheral, each with unique network positions and structural importance. Statistical analysis reveals significant correlations between specific action types (commits, pull requests, issues) and contributor influence, with multiple regression models explaining substantial variance in influence metrics. Temporal analysis shows that network density, clustering coefficients, and modularity exhibit statistically significant temporal trends, with distinct regime changes coinciding with major project milestones. Structural integrity simulations show that Bridge contributors, despite representing a small fraction of the network, have a disproportionate impact on network cohesion when removed. Our findings provide empirical evidence for strategic contributor retention policies and offer actionable insights into community health metrics.
zh_title: 超越代码贡献：网络位置、时间爆发和代码审查活动如何塑造大型开源生态系统中的贡献者影响力
translation: 开源软件（OSS）项目依赖于复杂的贡献者网络，这些网络的互动驱动创新和可持续性。本研究利用先进的图神经网络和时间网络分析，对跨越25年的云原生计算基金会（CNCF）生态系统数据（包括沙箱、孵化中和已毕业项目）进行了全面分析。我们对数百个仓库中的数千名贡献者的分析显示，OSS网络在影响力方面表现出强大的幂律分布，前1%的贡献者控制着网络影响力的绝大部分。我们使用GPU加速的PageRank、中介中心性（Betweenness Centrality）和定制的LSTM模型，识别出五种不同的贡献者角色：核心（Core）、桥梁（Bridge）、连接者（Connector）、常规（Regular）和外围（Peripheral），每种角色都具有独特的网络位置和结构重要性。统计分析揭示了特定行动类型（提交、拉取请求、问题）与贡献者影响力之间存在显著相关性，多重回归模型解释了影响力指标的很大一部分方差。时间分析表明，网络密度、聚类系数和模块化表现出统计学上显著的时间趋势，明显的制度变化与主要的里程碑事件相吻合。结构完整性模拟显示，“桥梁”贡献者尽管在网络中占比很小，但在被移除时对网络凝聚力有着不成比例的巨大影响。我们的研究结果为战略性贡献者保留政策提供了实证证据，并为社区健康指标提供了可操作的见解。
tldr: 本研究通过分析25年CNCF数据和使用图神经网络，发现开源贡献者影响力遵循幂律分布。我们识别了五种关键角色，并证明了“桥梁”贡献者对网络稳定性至关重要，为战略性贡献者保留提供了实证指导。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于超越了传统的代码贡献指标，利用图神经网络、时间网络分析和中心性度量（如PageRank）来量化大型开源生态系统中贡献者的真实影响力。研究使用了来自CNCF生态系统跨越25年的大规模数据集，这确保了结果的稳健性和普适性。尤其重要的是，研究识别出“桥梁”（Bridge）贡献者这一关键角色，并证明了他们在网络结构完整性中的不成比例的重要性。这一发现为开源社区面临的贡献者保留挑战提供了具体的、基于实证的战略指导，具有极高的实际应用价值。
motivation: 开源软件（OSS）项目的创新和可持续性依赖于复杂的贡献者网络及其相互作用。本研究旨在对这些贡献者网络进行全面分析，以理解和量化贡献者影响力。
method: 本研究采用了先进的图神经网络（GNN）和时间网络分析方法，对来自云原生计算基金会（CNCF）生态系统（涵盖沙箱、孵化中和已毕业项目）的跨越25年的数据进行了分析。具体方法包括使用GPU加速的PageRank、中介中心性（Betweenness Centrality）来识别网络位置，使用定制的LSTM模型进行时间分析，以及使用多重回归模型进行统计分析，并进行了结构完整性模拟。
results: OSS网络在影响力上表现出强大的幂律分布，前1%的贡献者控制着网络影响力的绝大部分。研究识别出五种不同的贡献者角色：核心、桥梁、连接者、常规和外围。特定行动类型（提交、拉取请求、问题）与贡献者影响力之间存在显著相关性。时间分析显示网络密度和模块化等指标具有显著的时间趋势。结构完整性模拟表明，“桥梁”贡献者对网络凝聚力具有不成比例的巨大影响。
conclusion: 研究结果为制定战略性贡献者保留政策提供了实证证据，并为评估社区健康指标提供了可操作的见解。

title: Reclaiming First Principles: A Differentiable Framework for Conceptual Hydrologic Models
authors: Jasper A. Vrugt, Jonathan M. Frame, Ethan Bollman
abstract: Conceptual hydrologic models remain the cornerstone of rainfall-runoff modeling, yet their calibration is often slow and numerically fragile. Most gradient-based parameter estimation methods rely on finite-difference approximations or automatic differentiation frameworks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow), which are computationally demanding and introduce truncation errors, solver instabilities, and substantial overhead. These limitations are particularly acute for the ODE systems of conceptual watershed models. Here we introduce a fully analytic and computationally efficient framework for differentiable hydrologic modeling based on exact parameter sensitivities. By augmenting the governing ODE system with sensitivity equations, we jointly evolve the model states and the Jacobian matrix with respect to all parameters. This Jacobian then provides fully analytic gradient vectors for any differentiable loss function. These include classical objective functions such as the sum of absolute and squared residuals, widely used hydrologic performance metrics such as the Nash-Sutcliffe and Kling-Gupta efficiencies, robust loss functions that down-weight extreme events, and hydrograph-based functionals such as flow-duration and recession curves. The analytic sensitivities eliminate the step-size dependence and noise inherent to numerical differentiation, while avoiding the instability of adjoint methods and the overhead of modern machine-learning autodiff toolchains. The resulting gradients are deterministic, physically interpretable, and straightforward to embed in gradient-based optimizers. Overall, this work enables rapid, stable, and transparent gradient-based calibration of conceptual hydrologic models, unlocking the full potential of differentiable modeling without reliance on external, opaque, or CPU-intensive automatic-differentiation libraries.
zh_title: 重拾第一原理：概念水文模型的一个可微分框架
translation: 概念水文模型仍然是降雨-径流建模的基石，但其校准通常缓慢且数值上不稳定。大多数基于梯度的参数估计方法依赖于有限差分近似或自动微分框架（例如 JAX、PyTorch 和 TensorFlow），这些方法计算要求高，并引入了截断误差、求解器不稳定性和大量的开销。这些局限性对于概念流域模型的常微分方程（ODE）系统尤其严重。本文介绍了一个基于精确参数敏感度的全解析且计算高效的可微分水文建模框架。通过用敏感度方程增强控制 ODE 系统，我们联合演化模型状态和相对于所有参数的雅可比矩阵。然后，该雅可比矩阵为任何可微分损失函数提供了全解析的梯度向量。这些损失函数包括经典的诸如绝对残差和平方残差之和的客观函数，广泛使用的水文性能指标如 Nash-Sutcliffe 和 Kling-Gupta 效率，对极端事件降权的鲁棒损失函数，以及基于水文过程线的泛函（如流量历时曲线和消退曲线）。解析敏感度消除了数值微分固有的步长依赖性和噪声，同时避免了伴随方法的不稳定性和现代机器学习自动微分工具链的开销。由此产生的梯度是确定性的、物理可解释的，并且很容易嵌入到基于梯度的优化器中。总的来说，这项工作实现了概念水文模型的快速、稳定和透明的基于梯度的校准，在不依赖外部、不透明或占用 CPU 的自动微分库的情况下，释放了可微分模型的全部潜力。
tldr: 提出了一个基于精确参数敏感度的全解析框架，通过增强ODE系统联合求解状态和雅可比矩阵，实现概念水文模型的快速、稳定、透明的梯度校准，避免了传统数值方法和自动微分框架的缺点。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将“第一原理”（即精确的解析敏感度方程）重新引入概念水文模型的梯度计算中，解决了水文领域在拥抱可微分建模时遇到的关键技术瓶颈。它通过直接增强ODE系统来联合求解雅可比矩阵，巧妙地规避了现代自动微分框架（如PyTorch/JAX）在处理复杂ODE系统时引入的巨大开销和潜在不稳定性，同时消除了传统有限差分方法的误差和噪声。这对于依赖ODE系统的地球系统科学和工程领域具有重要意义，因为它提供了一个既高效又物理透明的参数优化路径。
motivation: 概念水文模型（ODE系统）的校准通常缓慢且数值不稳定。现有的基于梯度的参数估计方法（如有限差分或自动微分框架）计算开销大、引入截断误差、求解器不稳定和大量开销。
method: 引入了一个基于精确参数敏感度的全解析、计算高效的可微分水文建模框架。通过使用敏感度方程增强控制ODE系统，该方法联合演化模型状态和关于所有参数的雅可比矩阵，从而提供全解析的梯度向量。
results: 该框架为任何可微分损失函数提供了全解析的梯度向量。解析敏感度消除了数值微分固有的步长依赖性和噪声，避免了伴随方法的不稳定性和现代自动微分工具链的开销。得到的梯度是确定性的、物理可解释的。
conclusion: 这项工作实现了概念水文模型的快速、稳定、透明的基于梯度的校准，无需依赖外部、不透明或占用CPU的自动微分库，释放了可微分模型的全部潜力。

title: Investigating the structure of emotions by analyzing similarity and association of emotion words
authors: Fumitaka Iwaki, Tatsuji Takahashi
abstract: In the field of natural language processing, some studies have attempted sentiment analysis on text by handling emotions as explanatory or response variables. One of the most popular emotion models used in this context is the wheel of emotion proposed by Plutchik. This model schematizes human emotions in a circular structure, and represents them in two or three dimensions. However, the validity of Plutchik's wheel of emotion has not been sufficiently examined. This study investigated the validity of the wheel by creating and analyzing a semantic networks of emotion words. Through our experiments, we collected data of similarity and association of ordered pairs of emotion words, and constructed networks using these data. We then analyzed the structure of the networks through community detection, and compared it with that of the wheel of emotion. The results showed that each network's structure was, for the most part, similar to that of the wheel of emotion, but locally different.
zh_title: 通过分析情感词的相似性和关联性来探究情感结构
translation: 在自然语言处理领域，一些研究试图通过将情感作为解释变量或响应变量来对文本进行情感分析。在这种背景下，最流行的情感模型之一是普拉奇克提出的情感轮。该模型将人类情感以圆形结构图解化，并以二维或三维表示。然而，普拉奇克情感轮的有效性尚未得到充分检验。本研究通过创建和分析情感词的语义网络来探究该情感轮的有效性。通过我们的实验，我们收集了情感词有序对的相似性和关联性数据，并利用这些数据构建了网络。然后，我们通过社区检测分析了网络的结构，并将其与情感轮的结构进行了比较。结果表明，每个网络的结构与情感轮的结构大体相似，但在局部存在差异。
tldr: 本研究通过收集情感词的相似性和关联性数据，构建语义网络并进行社区检测，验证了普拉奇克情感轮模型的有效性。结果显示网络结构与该模型大体相似但有局部差异。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于使用数据驱动的方法（收集相似性和关联性数据，构建语义网络和进行社区检测）来系统地验证一个长期被NLP领域广泛采用但有效性未经验证的经典情感模型——普拉奇克情感轮。其重要性在于为情感结构提供了实证基础，并可能指导未来情感分析模型在处理情感词关系时的局部优化，从而提高NLP任务的准确性。
motivation: 探究在自然语言处理（NLP）中常用的普拉奇克（Plutchik）情感轮模型的有效性/结构，因其有效性尚未得到充分检验。
method: 收集情感词有序对的相似性和关联性数据，构建情感词语义网络，并通过社区检测分析网络结构，将其与普拉奇克情感轮进行比较。
results: 构建的语义网络的结构与普拉奇克情感轮的结构大体相似，但在局部存在差异。

title: A methodology for analyzing financial needs hierarchy from social discussions using LLM
authors: Abhishek Jangra, Sachin Thukral, Arnab Chatterjee, Jayasree Raveendran
abstract: This study examines the hierarchical structure of financial needs as articulated in social media discourse, employing generative AI techniques to analyze large-scale textual data. While human needs encompass a broad spectrum from fundamental survival to psychological fulfillment financial needs are particularly critical, influencing both individual well-being and day-to-day decision-making. Our research advances the understanding of financial behavior by utilizing large language models (LLMs) to extract and analyze expressions of financial needs from social media posts. We hypothesize that financial needs are organized hierarchically, progressing from short-term essentials to long-term aspirations, consistent with theoretical frameworks established in the behavioral sciences. Through computational analysis, we demonstrate the feasibility of identifying these needs and validate the presence of a hierarchical structure within them. In addition to confirming this structure, our findings provide novel insights into the content and themes of financial discussions online. By inferring underlying needs from naturally occurring language, this approach offers a scalable and data-driven alternative to conventional survey methodologies, enabling a more dynamic and nuanced understanding of financial behavior in real-world contexts.
zh_title: 使用LLM分析社交讨论中金融需求层次结构的方法
translation: 本研究利用生成式人工智能技术分析大规模文本数据，考察社交媒体话语中阐述的金融需求的层次结构。虽然人类需求涵盖了从基本生存到心理满足的广泛范围，但金融需求尤其关键，影响着个人福祉和日常决策。我们的研究利用大型语言模型（LLM）从社交媒体帖子中提取和分析金融需求的表达，从而推动了对金融行为的理解。我们假设金融需求是分层组织的，从短期必需品到长期愿望逐步发展，这与行为科学中建立的理论框架一致。通过计算分析，我们证明了识别这些需求的可行性，并验证了其中存在层次结构。除了确认这一结构外，我们的发现还为在线金融讨论的内容和主题提供了新的见解。通过从自然产生的语言中推断潜在需求，这种方法提供了一种可扩展且数据驱动的替代传统调查方法，从而能够在现实世界的背景下对金融行为进行更动态和细致的理解。
tldr: 本研究利用大型语言模型（LLM）分析社交媒体文本，验证了金融需求存在从短期必需品到长期愿望的层次结构。这提供了一种可扩展、数据驱动的替代传统调查方法的新途径，以更好地理解现实世界中的金融行为。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将前沿的生成式AI技术（LLM）应用于社会科学领域，特别是行为金融学。它提供了一种处理大规模、非结构化数据的有效途径，克服了传统调查方法在数据量和实时性上的局限性。通过在社交媒体数据中验证金融需求的层次结构，研究不仅证实了既有的理论框架，还为金融机构和政策制定者提供了关于公众金融关注点的动态、细致的洞察。其可扩展性是其最大的优势。
motivation: 金融需求至关重要，影响个人福祉和日常决策。研究旨在利用大规模文本数据分析来深化对金融行为的理解，并检验金融需求是否像行为科学理论所假设的那样具有层次结构。
method: 采用生成式AI技术（特别是大型语言模型, LLM）对社交媒体帖子中的大规模文本数据进行计算分析，以提取和分析人们表达的金融需求。
results: 研究证明了识别这些金融需求的可行性，并验证了金融需求中存在层次结构（从短期必需品到长期愿望）。此外，研究还提供了关于在线金融讨论内容和主题的新见解。
conclusion: 通过从自然语言中推断潜在需求，该方法提供了一种可扩展、数据驱动的、替代传统调查方法的新选择，从而能够对现实世界中的金融行为产生更动态和细致的理解。

title: The Avatar Cache: Enabling On-Demand Security with Morphable Cache Architecture
authors: Anubhav Bhatla, Navneet Navneet, Moinuddin Qureshi, Biswabandan Panda
abstract: The sharing of the last-level cache (LLC) among multiple cores makes it vulnerable to cross-core conflict- and occupancy-based attacks. Despite extensive prior work, modern processors still employ non-secure set-associative LLCs. Existing secure LLC designs broadly fall into two categories: (i) randomized and (ii) partitioned. The state-of-the-art randomized design, Mirage, mitigates conflict-based attacks but incurs significant area overhead (20% additional storage) and design complexity. Partitioned LLCs mitigate both conflict- and occupancy-based attacks, but often suffer from large performance overheads (on average over 5% and up to 49%), require OS support in set-based schemes, or face scalability issues in way-based schemes. These factors pose major obstacles to the industrial adoption of secure LLCs. This paper asks whether strong LLC security can be achieved with minimal changes to a conventional set-associative LLC, enabling security only when needed while preserving low performance, power, and area overheads. We propose Avatar, a secure and morphable LLC that supports three modes: non-secure (Avatar-N), randomized secure (Avatar-R), and partitioned secure (Avatar-P), and can switch dynamically between them. Avatar closely resembles a conventional set-associative LLC, facilitating industrial adoption. Avatar-R introduces extra invalid entries and leverages high associativity to provide a strong security guarantee with little capacity loss, achieving only one set-associative eviction per $10^{30}$ years, while incurring 1.5% storage overhead, a 2.7% increase in static power, and a 0.2% slowdown over a 16~MB baseline. Avatar-P mitigates both conflict- and occupancy-based attacks with only a 3% performance overhead, substantially outperforming prior way-based partitioned LLCs. When security is unnecessary, Avatar switches to Avatar-N to maximize performance and energy efficiency.
zh_title: Avatar缓存：通过可塑性缓存架构实现按需安全
translation: 多个核心共享末级缓存（LLC）使其容易受到跨核冲突和基于占用的攻击。尽管之前进行了广泛的研究，但现代处理器仍采用非安全的组相联LLC。现有的安全LLC设计大致分为两类：（i）随机化和（ii）分区化。最先进的随机化设计Mirage缓解了基于冲突的攻击，但带来了显著的面积开销（20%的额外存储）和设计复杂性。分区化LLC缓解了基于冲突和基于占用的攻击，但通常会遭受较大的性能开销（平均超过5%，最高达49%），在基于组的方案中需要操作系统支持，或者在基于路的方案中面临可扩展性问题。这些因素对安全LLC的工业应用构成了主要障碍。本文旨在探讨是否可以通过对传统组相联LLC进行最小化改动，实现强大的LLC安全性，仅在需要时启用安全性，同时保持低性能、功耗和面积开销。我们提出了Avatar，一种安全且可塑的LLC，它支持三种模式：非安全（Avatar-N）、随机化安全（Avatar-R）和分区化安全（Avatar-P），并且可以在它们之间动态切换。Avatar与传统的组相联LLC非常相似，便于工业采用。Avatar-R引入了额外的无效条目并利用高关联性来提供强大的安全保证，容量损失很小，实现了每$10^{30}$年仅发生一次组相联驱逐，同时仅产生1.5%的存储开销、2.7%的静态功耗增加和0.2%的减速（基于16MB基线）。Avatar-P缓解了基于冲突和基于占用的攻击，性能开销仅为3%，大大优于现有的基于路的分区LLC。当安全性不必要时，Avatar切换到Avatar-N以最大限度地提高性能和能效。
tldr: 提出Avatar，一种可塑性末级缓存（LLC）架构，支持按需动态切换三种安全模式（非安全、随机化、分区化），在实现强大安全性的同时，将性能和面积开销降至最低。
ai_comments: 本文的核心创新在于提出了一种可塑性（Morphable）缓存架构Avatar，实现了按需安全，有效解决了现有安全LLC设计难以在工业界落地的主要障碍。通过动态切换三种模式，该方案能够在保持与传统LLC高度相似性的同时，提供极强的安全保证（Avatar-R模式下每$10^{30}$年一次驱逐），并将存储、功耗和性能开销控制在极低的水平（分别为1.5%、2.7%和0.2%），这对于平衡安全性和效率具有重要意义。
motivation: 末级缓存（LLC）的共享使其容易受到跨核冲突和基于占用的攻击。现有的安全LLC设计（如随机化或分区化）存在重大缺陷，如面积开销大、设计复杂性高或性能开销大（最高达49%），严重阻碍了工业应用。本文旨在探讨如何在最小化改动传统LLC的情况下实现强大的按需安全性。
method: 提出Avatar，一种可塑性LLC架构，支持动态切换三种模式：非安全（Avatar-N）、随机化安全（Avatar-R）和分区化安全（Avatar-P）。Avatar-R通过引入额外的无效条目和高关联性来提供强大的安全性。Avatar-P用于缓解冲突和占用攻击。当不需要安全性时，切换到Avatar-N以优化性能和能效。
results: Avatar-R在16MB基线上仅产生1.5%的存储开销、2.7%的静态功耗增加和0.2%的减速，并提供了极强的安全保证（每$10^{30}$年发生一次组相联驱逐）。Avatar-P的性能开销仅为3%，显著优于现有基于路的分区LLC。
conclusion: Avatar通过最小化对传统组相联LLC的改动，实现了强大的LLC按需安全，同时保持了低性能、功耗和面积开销，极大地促进了安全LLC在工业界的采用。

title: Is Gradient Ascent Really Necessary? Memorize to Forget for Machine Unlearning
authors: Zhuo Huang, Qizhou Wang, Ziming Hong, Shanshan Ye, Bo Han, Tongliang Liu
abstract: For ethical and safe AI, machine unlearning rises as a critical topic aiming to protect sensitive, private, and copyrighted knowledge from misuse. To achieve this goal, it is common to conduct gradient ascent (GA) to reverse the training on undesired data. However, such a reversal is prone to catastrophic collapse, which leads to serious performance degradation in general tasks. As a solution, we propose model extrapolation as an alternative to GA, which reaches the counterpart direction in the hypothesis space from one model given another reference model. Therefore, we leverage the original model as the reference, further train it to memorize undesired data while keeping prediction consistency on the rest retained data, to obtain a memorization model. Counterfactual as it might sound, a forget model can be obtained via extrapolation from the memorization model to the reference model. Hence, we avoid directly acquiring the forget model using GA, but proceed with gradient descent for the memorization model, which successfully stabilizes the machine unlearning process. Our model extrapolation is simple and efficient to implement, and it can also effectively converge throughout training to achieve improved unlearning performance.
zh_title: 梯度上升真的有必要吗？机器遗忘中的记忆以遗忘。
translation: 为了道德和安全的AI，机器遗忘作为一个关键主题出现，旨在保护敏感、私人和受版权保护的知识不被滥用。为了实现这一目标，通常会进行梯度上升（GA）来逆转对不希望数据的训练。然而，这种逆转容易导致灾难性崩溃，从而导致通用任务的性能严重下降。作为解决方案，我们提出模型外推法作为GA的替代方案，它可以在给定另一个参考模型的情况下，从一个模型在假设空间中到达相反的方向。因此，我们利用原始模型作为参考，进一步训练它来记忆不希望的数据，同时保持对其余保留数据的预测一致性，以获得一个记忆模型。尽管听起来与反事实（Counterfactual）相似，但可以通过从记忆模型到参考模型的外推来获得一个遗忘模型。因此，我们避免了使用GA直接获取遗忘模型，而是通过梯度下降来处理记忆模型，这成功稳定了机器遗忘过程。我们的模型外推法实现简单高效，并且可以在整个训练过程中有效收敛，以实现改进的遗忘性能。
tldr: 机器遗忘中常用的梯度上升（GA）易导致性能灾难性下降。本文提出一种稳定的替代方案：首先通过梯度下降训练一个“记忆模型”（记住不希望的数据），然后通过模型外推法从该记忆模型到原始模型来获得“遗忘模型”，从而避免使用不稳定的GA。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于其反直觉的方法：作者没有使用不稳定的梯度上升（GA）直接尝试“遗忘”，而是通过首先使用稳定的梯度下降（GD）明确地“记忆”需要遗忘的数据来稳定该过程。随后，利用假设空间中的几何特性（外推法）来实现遗忘效果。这种“先记忆再外推遗忘”的策略成功解决了传统基于GA的机器遗忘方法中普遍存在的稳定性问题，具有重要的实用价值。
motivation: 出于道德和安全考虑，机器遗忘是保护敏感、私人和受版权保护知识的关键主题。然而，实现遗忘的常用方法——梯度上升（GA）——容易导致灾难性崩溃和严重的通用任务性能下降。因此，本文旨在提出一种更稳定的替代方案。
method: 提出“模型外推”作为梯度上升的替代方案。具体步骤为：首先，使用原始模型作为参考模型，对其进行梯度下降训练，使其“记住”不希望的数据并保持对保留数据预测的一致性，从而获得一个“记忆模型”。然后，通过模型外推法，从该记忆模型外推到参考模型，即可获得“遗忘模型”。
results: 提出的模型外推法实现简单高效，并且能够在整个训练过程中有效收敛，从而实现改进的遗忘性能。
conclusion: 本文通过避免直接使用梯度上升，转而采用基于记忆步骤的模型外推法，成功稳定了机器遗忘过程，并实现了改进的遗忘性能。

title: ChatUMM: Robust Context Tracking for Conversational Interleaved Generation
authors: Wenxun Dai, Zhiyuan Zhao, Yule Zhong, Yiji Cheng, Jianwei Zhang, Linqing Wang, Shiyi Zhang, Yunlong Lin, Runze He, Fellix Song, Wayne Zhuang, Yong Liu, Haoji Zhang, Yansong Tang, Qinglin Lu, Chunyu Wang
abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have achieved remarkable progress yet remain constrained by a single-turn interaction paradigm, effectively functioning as solvers for independent requests rather than assistants in continuous dialogue. To bridge this gap, we present ChatUMM. As a conversational unified model, it excels at robust context tracking to sustain interleaved multimodal generation. ChatUMM derives its capabilities from two key innovations: an interleaved multi-turn training strategy that models serialized text-image streams as a continuous conversational flow, and a systematic conversational data synthesis pipeline. This pipeline transforms a diverse set of standard single-turn datasets into fluid dialogues through three progressive stages: constructing basic stateful dialogues, enforcing long-range dependency resolution via ``distractor'' turns with history-dependent query rewriting, and synthesizing naturally interleaved multimodal responses. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ChatUMM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source unified models on visual understanding and instruction-guided editing benchmarks, while maintaining competitive fidelity in text-to-image generation. Notably, ChatUMM exhibits superior robustness in complex multi-turn scenarios, ensuring fluid, context-aware dialogues.
zh_title: ChatUMM：用于对话式交错生成的鲁棒上下文跟踪
translation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）取得了显著的进展，但仍受限于单轮交互范式，有效地充当独立请求的解决者而非连续对话中的助手。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了ChatUMM。作为一个对话式统一模型，它擅长鲁棒的上下文跟踪，以维持交错式的多模态生成。ChatUMM的能力源于两项关键创新：一种交错式多轮训练策略，将序列化的文本-图像流建模为连续的对话流程；以及一个系统的对话数据合成流程。该流程通过三个渐进阶段将各种标准单轮数据集转化为流畅的对话：构建基本的有状态对话、通过带有历史依赖查询重写机制的“干扰”轮次来强化长距离依赖解析，以及合成自然的交错式多模态响应。广泛的评估表明，ChatUMM在视觉理解和指令引导编辑基准测试中，在开源统一模型中实现了最先进的性能，同时在文本到图像生成方面保持了有竞争力的保真度。值得注意的是，ChatUMM在复杂的多轮场景中表现出卓越的鲁棒性，确保了流畅、上下文感知的对话。
tldr: 摘要中提出了ChatUMM，这是一个对话式统一多模态模型，通过新的多轮训练策略和数据合成流程，实现了对连续、交错的文本-图像对话的鲁棒上下文跟踪，并在多轮场景中表现出卓越的性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将统一多模态模型（UMMs）从单轮交互范式扩展到连续对话领域。其核心贡献是定制化的训练策略和数据合成流程，特别是通过引入“干扰”轮次和历史依赖的查询重写来系统地强化模型对长距离上下文依赖的解析能力，这直接解决了复杂多模态对话中鲁棒上下文跟踪的难题。这项工作对于推动多模态AI从独立的求解器向实用的、上下文感知的对话助手的转变具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的统一多模态模型（UMMs）受限于单轮交互范式，只能作为独立请求的解决者，而非连续对话中的助手，缺乏鲁棒的上下文跟踪能力。
method: 提出了ChatUMM模型，其能力源于两项关键创新：1. 一种交错式多轮训练策略，将序列化的文本-图像流建模为连续的对话流程；2. 一个系统的对话数据合成流程，通过三个渐进阶段（包括构建有状态对话、通过“干扰”轮次强化长距离依赖解析、以及合成交错式多模态响应）将标准单轮数据集转化为流畅的对话。
results: 在视觉理解和指令引导编辑基准测试中，ChatUMM在开源统一模型中实现了最先进的（SOTA）性能，同时在文本到图像生成方面保持了有竞争力的保真度。特别是在复杂的多轮场景中表现出卓越的鲁棒性，确保了流畅、上下文感知的对话。
conclusion: ChatUMM成功地将统一多模态模型扩展到连续对话领域，通过鲁棒的上下文跟踪实现了流畅、上下文感知的多轮交错式生成，并在相关基准上达到了最先进的性能。

title: TrailBlazer: History-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box LLM Jailbreaking
authors: Sung-Hoon Yoon, Ruizhi Qian, Minda Zhao, Weiyue Li, Mengyu Wang
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become integral to many domains, making their safety a critical priority. Prior jailbreaking research has explored diverse approaches, including prompt optimization, automated red teaming, obfuscation, and reinforcement learning (RL) based methods. However, most existing techniques fail to effectively leverage vulnerabilities revealed in earlier interaction turns, resulting in inefficient and unstable attacks. Since jailbreaking involves sequential interactions in which each response influences future actions, reinforcement learning provides a natural framework for this problem. Motivated by this, we propose a history-aware RL-based jailbreak framework that analyzes and reweights vulnerability signals from prior steps to guide future decisions. We show that incorporating historical information alone improves jailbreak success rates. Building on this insight, we introduce an attention-based reweighting mechanism that highlights critical vulnerabilities within the interaction history, enabling more efficient exploration with fewer queries. Extensive experiments on AdvBench and HarmBench demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art jailbreak performance while significantly improving query efficiency. These results underscore the importance of historical vulnerability signals in reinforcement learning-driven jailbreak strategies and offer a principled pathway for advancing adversarial research on LLM safeguards.
zh_title: TrailBlazer：历史信息引导的黑盒LLM越狱强化学习
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）已成为许多领域不可或缺的一部分，因此它们的安全性成为一个关键优先事项。先前的越狱研究探索了各种方法，包括提示优化、自动化红队测试、混淆和基于强化学习（RL）的方法。然而，大多数现有技术未能有效利用早期交互回合中暴露的漏洞，导致攻击效率低下且不稳定。由于越狱涉及序列交互，其中每个响应都会影响未来的行动，因此强化学习为解决此问题提供了一个天然的框架。受此启发，我们提出了一个历史感知的基于RL的越狱框架，该框架分析并重新加权先前步骤中的漏洞信号，以指导未来的决策。我们证明，仅纳入历史信息就能提高越狱成功率。基于这一洞察，我们引入了一种基于注意力的重新加权机制，该机制突出交互历史中的关键漏洞，从而能够以更少的查询实现更高效的探索。在AdvBench和HarmBench上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的越狱性能，同时显著提高了查询效率。这些结果强调了历史漏洞信号在强化学习驱动的越狱策略中的重要性，并为推进LLM安全防护的对抗性研究提供了一条原则性途径。
tldr: 提出TrailBlazer，一种历史信息引导的强化学习框架，用于黑盒LLM越狱。它通过分析和重新加权历史漏洞信号，显著提高了攻击效率和越狱成功率，并实现了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将历史交互中的漏洞信号明确地整合到强化学习框架中，解决了传统RL越狱方法忽略序列性信息的缺陷。通过引入注意力机制对历史信号进行重新加权，提高了攻击的针对性和查询效率，这对于在实际环境中进行黑盒LLM安全研究和防御策略制定具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的越狱技术未能有效利用早期交互回合中暴露的漏洞，导致攻击效率低下且不稳定。由于越狱是一个涉及序列交互的问题，强化学习提供了一个天然的框架，因此需要一个能利用历史信息的RL方法来提高效率和稳定性。
method: 提出TrailBlazer，一个历史感知的基于强化学习的越狱框架。该方法分析并重新加权先前步骤中的漏洞信号，以指导未来的决策。它引入了一种基于注意力机制的重新加权机制来突出交互历史中的关键漏洞，从而实现更高效的探索。
results: 纳入历史信息本身就能提高越狱成功率。在AdvBench和HarmBench上的广泛实验表明，该方法实现了最先进的越狱性能，同时显著提高了查询效率。
conclusion: 结果强调了历史漏洞信号在强化学习驱动的越狱策略中的重要性，并为推进LLM安全防护的对抗性研究提供了一条原则性途径。

title: TrajAD: Trajectory Anomaly Detection for Trustworthy LLM Agents
authors: Yibing Liu, Chong Zhang, Zhongyi Han, Hansong Liu, Yong Wang, Yang Yu, Xiaoyan Wang, Yilong Yin
abstract: We address the problem of runtime trajectory anomaly detection, a critical capability for enabling trustworthy LLM agents. Current safety measures predominantly focus on static input/output filtering. However, we argue that ensuring LLM agents reliability requires auditing the intermediate execution process. In this work, we formulate the task of Trajectory Anomaly Detection. The goal is not merely detection, but precise error localization. This capability is essential for enabling efficient rollback-and-retry. To achieve this, we construct TrajBench, a dataset synthesized via a perturb-and-complete strategy to cover diverse procedural anomalies. Using this benchmark, we investigate the capability of models in process supervision. We observe that general-purpose LLMs, even with zero-shot prompting, struggle to identify and localize these anomalies. This reveals that generalized capabilities do not automatically translate to process reliability. To address this, we propose TrajAD, a specialized verifier trained with fine-grained process supervision. Our approach outperforms baselines, demonstrating that specialized supervision is essential for building trustworthy agents.
zh_title: TrajAD：用于可信赖LLM智能体的轨迹异常检测
translation: 我们解决了运行时轨迹异常检测问题，这是实现可信赖LLM智能体的关键能力。当前的安全措施主要侧重于静态的输入/输出过滤。然而，我们认为确保LLM智能体的可靠性需要审计中间执行过程。在这项工作中，我们提出了轨迹异常检测任务。其目标不仅仅是检测，而是精确的错误定位。这种能力对于实现高效的“回滚和重试”至关重要。为了实现这一目标，我们构建了TrajBench，这是一个通过“扰动和完成”策略合成的数据集，旨在涵盖多样化的程序性异常。利用这个基准，我们研究了模型在过程监督方面的能力。我们观察到，通用LLM，即使采用零样本提示，也难以识别和定位这些异常。这表明广义能力并不能自动转化为过程可靠性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了TrajAD，这是一个通过细粒度过程监督训练的专用验证器。我们的方法优于基线模型，证明了专业化监督对于构建可信赖的智能体至关重要。
tldr: 为提高LLM智能体的可靠性，本文提出了轨迹异常检测（TrajAD）任务，旨在精确定位执行过程中的错误。构建了TrajBench基准测试集，并提出TrajAD，一个通过细粒度过程监督训练的专用验证器，它显著优于通用LLM，证明了专业化监督是构建可信赖智能体的关键。
ai_comments: 该工作的创新点在于将LLM智能体的可靠性焦点从传统的静态输入/输出过滤，转移到动态的运行时轨迹审计。它不仅关注异常的检测，更强调精确的错误定位，这对于实现智能体在实际应用中的高效“回滚和重试”至关重要。通过构建TrajBench和提出专用的TrajAD验证器，该研究为评估和提高LLM智能体的过程可靠性提供了一个重要的基准和有效的专业化解决方案，突显了在复杂流程中，通用LLM能力难以直接替代细粒度过程监督的需求。
motivation: 当前的LLM智能体安全措施主要侧重于静态的输入/输出过滤。然而，为了确保LLM智能体的可靠性，需要对中间执行过程进行审计。因此，本文旨在解决运行时轨迹异常检测问题，并实现精确的错误定位，以便进行高效的“回滚和重试”（rollback-and-retry）。
method: 本文制定了轨迹异常检测（TrajAD）任务，目标是精确的错误定位。为了训练和评估，构建了TrajBench数据集，该数据集通过“扰动和完成”（perturb-and-complete）策略合成，以覆盖多样化的程序性异常。然后，提出了TrajAD，这是一个通过细粒度过程监督训练的专用验证器。
results: 通用LLM（即使采用零样本提示）在识别和定位这些异常方面表现不佳，表明广义能力不等于过程可靠性。提出的TrajAD方法优于基线模型，证明了专业化监督对于构建可信赖智能体至关重要。
conclusion: 专业化监督对于构建可信赖的LLM智能体至关重要。广义能力并不能自动转化为过程可靠性。通过TrajAD的成功，验证了轨迹异常检测和精确定位是实现可信赖智能体的关键能力。

title: ECO: Energy-Constrained Optimization with Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Walking
authors: Weidong Huang, Jingwen Zhang, Jiongye Li, Shibowen Zhang, Jiayang Wu, Jiayi Wang, Hangxin Liu, Yaodong Yang, Yao Su
abstract: Achieving stable and energy-efficient locomotion is essential for humanoid robots to operate continuously in real-world applications. Existing MPC and RL approaches often rely on energy-related metrics embedded within a multi-objective optimization framework, which require extensive hyperparameter tuning and often result in suboptimal policies. To address these challenges, we propose ECO (Energy-Constrained Optimization), a constrained RL framework that separates energy-related metrics from rewards, reformulating them as explicit inequality constraints. This method provides a clear and interpretable physical representation of energy costs, enabling more efficient and intuitive hyperparameter tuning for improved energy efficiency. ECO introduces dedicated constraints for energy consumption and reference motion, enforced by the Lagrangian method, to achieve stable, symmetric, and energy-efficient walking for humanoid robots. We evaluated ECO against MPC, standard RL with reward shaping, and four state-of-the-art constrained RL methods. Experiments, including sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfers on the kid-sized humanoid robot BRUCE, demonstrate that ECO significantly reduces energy consumption compared to baselines while maintaining robust walking performance. These results highlight a substantial advancement in energy-efficient humanoid locomotion. All experimental demonstrations can be found on the project website: https://sites.google.com/view/eco-humanoid.
comment: IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON AUTOMATION SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING. PREPRINT VERSION. ACCEPTED FEB, 2026
zh_title: ECO：基于强化学习的能量约束优化在类人机器人行走中的应用
translation: 实现稳定和节能的运动对于类人机器人在现实世界应用中持续运行至关重要。现有的模型预测控制（MPC）和强化学习（RL）方法通常依赖于嵌入在多目标优化框架中的能量相关指标，这需要大量的超参数调整，并经常导致次优策略。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ECO（能量约束优化），这是一个约束强化学习框架，它将能量相关指标从奖励中分离出来，并将它们重新表述为显式的、不等式约束。这种方法提供了一个清晰且可解释的能耗物理表示，从而能实现更高效、更直观的超参数调整，以提高能源效率。ECO引入了通过拉格朗日法实施的、针对能耗和参考运动的专用约束，以实现类人机器人的稳定、对称和节能行走。我们将ECO与MPC、带有奖励塑造的标准RL以及四种最先进的约束RL方法进行了评估。实验（包括在儿童尺寸类人机器人BRUCE上的sim-to-sim和sim-to-real迁移）表明，与基线方法相比，ECO显著降低了能耗，同时保持了鲁棒的行走性能。这些结果突显了节能类人机器人运动方面的重大进步。所有实验演示可在项目网站上找到。
tldr: 提出ECO（能量约束优化）框架，将能耗作为显式约束而非奖励项，显著提高了类人机器人（BRUCE）行走时的能效和稳定性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将能耗指标从传统的奖励塑造中分离出来，并将其重新构造为显式的物理约束（通过拉格朗日法）。这种方法不仅提高了能耗优化的可解释性和超参数调整效率，还直接解决了类人机器人在实际应用中持续运行的关键挑战——能源效率问题。通过sim-to-real验证，证明了该方法在实际机器人上的有效性，具有重要的工程实践价值。
motivation: 确保类人机器人在实际应用中能持续运行，稳定和节能的运动至关重要。现有的MPC和RL方法将能耗指标嵌入多目标优化框架，需要大量超参数调整，且常导致次优策略。
method: 提出ECO（能量约束优化），一个约束强化学习框架。它将能量相关指标与奖励分离，重新表述为显式的不等式约束。该方法通过拉格朗日法实施，引入了针对能耗和参考运动的专用约束，以实现稳定、对称且节能的行走。
results: 在BRUCE儿童尺寸类人机器人上进行了sim-to-sim和sim-to-real迁移实验。结果表明，与MPC、标准RL和四种最先进的约束RL基线方法相比，ECO显著降低了能耗，同时保持了鲁棒的行走性能。
conclusion: ECO框架在能效方面取得了实质性进展，极大地推进了节能型类人机器人运动控制技术。

title: Principle-Evolvable Scientific Discovery via Uncertainty Minimization
authors: Yingming Pu, Tao Lin, Hongyu Chen
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific agents have accelerated scientific discovery, yet they often suffer from significant inefficiencies due to adherence to fixed initial priors. Existing approaches predominantly operate within a static hypothesis space, which restricts the discovery of novel phenomena, resulting in computational waste when baseline theories fail. To address this, we propose shifting the focus from searching hypotheses to evolving the underlying scientific principles. We present PiEvo, a principle-evolvable framework that treats scientific discovery as Bayesian optimization over an expanding principle space. By integrating Information-Directed Hypothesis Selection via Gaussian Process and an anomaly-driven augmentation mechanism, PiEvo enables agents to autonomously refine their theoretical worldview. Evaluation across four benchmarks demonstrates that PiEvo (1) achieves an average solution quality of up to 90.81%~93.15%, representing a 29.7%~31.1% improvement over the state-of-the-art, (2) attains an 83.3% speedup in convergence step via significantly reduced sample complexity by optimizing the compact principle space, and (3) maintains robust performance across diverse scientific domains and LLM backbones.
zh_title: 原理可演化科学发现通过不确定性最小化
translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学智能体加速了科学发现，但由于固守固定的初始先验，它们往往效率低下。现有方法主要在静态假设空间内运作，限制了新现象的发现，并在基线理论失败时造成计算浪费。为解决此问题，我们提出将重点从搜索假设转移到演化潜在的科学原理。我们提出了PiEvo，一个原理可演化框架，它将科学发现视为在不断扩展的原理空间上的贝叶斯优化。通过整合信息导向假设选择（通过高斯过程）和异常驱动的增强机制，PiEvo使智能体能够自主地完善其理论世界观。在四个基准测试上的评估表明，PiEvo（1）实现了高达90.81%~93.15%的平均解决方案质量，比现有技术提高了29.7%~31.1%，（2）通过优化紧凑的原理空间显著降低了样本复杂度，从而在收敛步骤上实现了83.3%的加速，以及（3）在不同的科学领域和LLM骨干模型上保持了鲁棒的性能。
tldr: 提出了PiEvo框架，用于基于LLM的科学发现，该框架将重点从静态假设搜索转移到可演化的科学原理，使用贝叶斯优化和异常驱动增强，显著提高了发现质量和收敛速度（最高加速83.3%）。
ai_comments: 本文的核心创新在于将科学发现的搜索空间从传统的“假设空间”提升到了更深层次的“原理空间”。通过引入“原理演化”和“不确定性最小化”（隐式通过贝叶斯优化和信息导向选择实现）的概念，PiEvo有效地解决了LLM智能体在面对复杂或未知现象时，因固守初始知识（固定先验）而导致的效率瓶颈和发现限制。其在收敛速度和发现质量上的显著提升，表明这种动态、自适应的理论框架对于下一代科学发现智能体具有重要价值。
motivation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学智能体受限于固定的初始先验，导致效率低下。现有方法在静态假设空间中操作，限制了新现象的发现，并在基线理论失败时造成计算浪费。
method: 提出PiEvo框架，将科学发现视为在不断扩展的原理空间上的贝叶斯优化。它通过整合信息导向假设选择（通过高斯过程）和异常驱动的增强机制，使智能体能够自主改进其理论世界观。
results: 在四个基准测试中，平均解决方案质量达到90.81%~93.15%，比现有技术提高了29.7%~31.1%。通过优化紧凑的原理空间，收敛步骤加速了83.3%，显著降低了样本复杂度。在不同科学领域和LLM骨干模型上保持鲁棒性能。
conclusion: 该框架（PiEvo）通过将科学发现视为在不断扩展的原理空间上的贝叶斯优化，成功克服了基于LLM的科学智能体中固定先验带来的效率低下和发现限制问题，实现了更高的解决方案质量和收敛速度。

title: CORE: Comprehensive Ontological Relation Evaluation for Large Language Models
authors: Satyam Dwivedi, Sanjukta Ghosh, Shivam Dwivedi, Nishi Kumari, Anil Thakur, Anurag Purushottam, Deepak Alok, Praveen Gatla, Manjuprasad B, Bipasha Patgiri
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on many reasoning benchmarks, yet existing evaluations rarely assess their ability to distinguish between meaningful semantic relations and genuine unrelatedness. We introduce CORE (Comprehensive Ontological Relation Evaluation), a dataset of 225K multiple-choice questions spanning 74 disciplines, together with a general-domain open-source benchmark of 203 rigorously validated questions (Cohen's Kappa = 1.0) covering 24 semantic relation types with equal representation of unrelated pairs. A human baseline from 1,000+ participants achieves 92.6% accuracy (95.1% on unrelated pairs). In contrast, 29 state-of-the-art LLMs achieve 48.25-70.9% overall accuracy, with near-ceiling performance on related pairs (86.5-100%) but severe degradation on unrelated pairs (0-41.35%), despite assigning similar confidence (92-94%). Expected Calibration Error increases 2-4x on unrelated pairs, and a mean semantic collapse rate of 37.6% indicates systematic generation of spurious relations. On the CORE 225K MCQs dataset, accuracy further drops to approximately 2%, highlighting substantial challenges in domain-specific semantic reasoning. We identify unrelatedness reasoning as a critical, under-evaluated frontier for LLM evaluation and safety.
zh_title: CORE：大型语言模型的综合本体关系评估
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在许多推理基准上表现出色，但现有评估很少评估它们区分有意义的语义关系和真正不相关性的能力。我们引入了CORE（Comprehensive Ontological Relation Evaluation，综合本体关系评估），这是一个包含22.5万道多项选择题（MCQs）的数据集，涵盖74个学科，以及一个包含203个经过严格验证（Cohen's Kappa = 1.0）、涵盖24种语义关系类型且不相关对等量表示的通用领域开源基准。由1000多名参与者组成的人类基线取得了92.6%的准确率（不相关对上为95.1%）。相比之下，29个最先进的LLMs的总体准确率在48.25%到70.9%之间，在相关对上表现接近满分（86.5%-100%），但在不相关对上严重退化（0%-41.35%），尽管它们分配了相似的置信度（92%-94%）。不相关对的预期校准误差增加了2-4倍，平均语义崩溃率达37.6%，表明系统性地生成了虚假关系。在CORE 22.5万MCQs数据集上，准确率进一步下降到约2%，突显了领域特定语义推理中的巨大挑战。我们将不相关性推理确定为LLM评估和安全方面一个关键的、被低估的前沿领域。
tldr: 我们引入了CORE，一个新的基准来测试LLM识别“不相关”概念的能力。LLM在不相关对上的表现非常差（0-41.35%的准确率），但置信度很高，表明在区分真正的非关系方面存在严重缺陷，这对安全性至关重要。
ai_comments: 这项创新的重点在于将LLM评估的焦点从识别“关系”转向识别“无关系”（不相关性）。结果引人注目：LLM对不相关对的低质量判断表现出高度自信，这表明存在根本性的校准失败和一种倾向于“语义崩溃”的趋势——即在没有关系时也总能找到联系。这种失败模式对于安全性和可信度至关重要，因为它表明LLM在被问及不存在的关系时，可能会系统性地生成错误信息或虚假联系。
motivation: 现有评估很少评估大型语言模型（LLMs）区分有意义的语义关系和真正不相关性的能力。
method: 引入了CORE（综合本体关系评估），这是一个包含22.5万道多项选择题（MCQs）的跨74个学科的数据集，以及一个包含203个经过严格验证（Kappa=1.0）、涵盖24种语义关系类型且不相关对等量表示的通用领域开源基准。
results: 人类基线取得了92.6%的准确率（不相关对上为95.1%）。29个最先进的LLM总体准确率在48.25%至70.9%之间，在相关对上表现良好（86.5%-100%），但在不相关对上严重退化（0%-41.35%）。尽管置信度相似（92%-94%），不相关对的预期校准误差增加了2-4倍。平均语义崩溃率达37.6%。在22.5万MCQs数据集上，准确率降至约2%。
conclusion: 不相关性推理是LLM评估和安全方面一个关键的、被低估的前沿领域。

title: What Is Wrong with Synthetic Data for Scene Text Recognition? A Strong Synthetic Engine with Diverse Simulations and Self-Evolution
authors: Xingsong Ye, Yongkun Du, JiaXin Zhang, Chen Li, Jing LYU, Zhineng Chen
abstract: Large-scale and categorical-balanced text data is essential for training effective Scene Text Recognition (STR) models, which is hard to achieve when collecting real data. Synthetic data offers a cost-effective and perfectly labeled alternative. However, its performance often lags behind, revealing a significant domain gap between real and current synthetic data. In this work, we systematically analyze mainstream rendering-based synthetic datasets and identify their key limitations: insufficient diversity in corpus, font, and layout, which restricts their realism in complex scenarios. To address these issues, we introduce UnionST, a strong data engine synthesizes text covering a union of challenging samples and better aligns with the complexity observed in the wild. We then construct UnionST-S, a large-scale synthetic dataset with improved simulations in challenging scenarios. Furthermore, we develop a self-evolution learning (SEL) framework for effective real data annotation. Experiments show that models trained on UnionST-S achieve significant improvements over existing synthetic datasets. They even surpass real-data performance in certain scenarios. Moreover, when using SEL, the trained models achieve competitive performance by only seeing 9% of real data labels.
zh_title: 场景文本识别的合成数据有什么问题？一个具有多样化模拟和自进化的强大合成引擎
translation: 大规模且类别平衡的文本数据对于训练有效的场景文本识别（STR）模型至关重要，但这在收集真实数据时很难实现。合成数据提供了一种经济高效且完美标注的替代方案。然而，其性能通常落后，揭示了真实数据与现有合成数据之间存在显著的领域差距。在这项工作中，我们系统地分析了主流的基于渲染的合成数据集，并确定了其关键局限性：语料库、字体和布局的多样性不足，这限制了它们在复杂场景中的真实性。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了UnionST，这是一个强大的数据引擎，可以合成覆盖具有挑战性样本集合的文本，并更好地匹配野外观察到的复杂性。随后，我们构建了UnionST-S，这是一个在大规模合成数据集，在具有挑战性的场景中进行了改进的模拟。此外，我们开发了一个自进化学习（SEL）框架，用于有效的真实数据标注。实验表明，在UnionST-S上训练的模型比现有合成数据集取得了显著的改进。它们甚至在某些场景中超越了真实数据的性能。此外，当使用SEL时，训练出的模型仅看到9%的真实数据标签就达到了有竞争力的性能。
tldr: 现有STR合成数据不够好，我们提出了UnionST引擎和UnionST-S数据集，增加了多样性，显著提升了模型性能，并且用自进化学习框架减少了对真实数据标签的依赖。
ai_comments: 本文的创新在于系统性地指出了当前场景文本识别（STR）合成数据在多样性（语料、字体、布局）上的核心缺陷，并提出了UnionST合成引擎来解决这一领域差距。UnionST-S数据集的构建为STR提供了一个更具挑战性和真实性的训练资源。更重要的是，引入的自进化学习（SEL）框架展示了如何在仅使用极少量的真实数据标签（9%）的情况下获得具有竞争力的模型性能，极大地提高了数据标注效率，为解决STR领域的数据瓶颈提供了重要且实用的解决方案。
motivation: 训练有效的场景文本识别（STR）模型需要大规模且类别平衡的文本数据，这在收集真实数据时难以实现。现有合成数据虽然成本低且标注完美，但性能落后，与真实数据存在显著的领域差距。主要问题在于现有合成数据集在语料库、字体和布局上的多样性不足。
method: 引入了UnionST，这是一个强大的数据引擎，用于合成覆盖具有挑战性样本集合的文本，以更好地匹配野外观察到的复杂性。构建了大规模合成数据集UnionST-S。此外，开发了一个自进化学习（SEL）框架用于有效的真实数据标注。
results: 经UnionST-S训练的模型比现有合成数据集实现了显著改进。在某些场景下甚至超过了真实数据训练的性能。使用SEL时，仅需9%的真实数据标签，训练出的模型即可达到有竞争力的性能。
conclusion: 通过系统分析现有合成数据的局限性并引入UnionST引擎和UnionST-S数据集，作者成功缩小了合成数据与真实数据之间的领域差距，显著提升了场景文本识别模型的性能，并通过自进化学习框架提高了真实数据标注的效率。

title: Evaluating an evidence-guided reinforcement learning framework in aligning light-parameter large language models with decision-making cognition in psychiatric clinical reasoning
authors: Xinxin Lin, Guangxin Dai, Yi Zhong, Xiang Li, Xue Xiao, Yixin Zhang, Zhengdong Wu, Yongbo Zheng, Runchuan Zhu, Ming Zhao, Huizi Yu, Shuo Wu, Jun Zhao, Lingming Hu, Yumei Wang, Ping Yin, Joey W.Y. Chan, Ngan Yin Chan, Sijing Chen, Yun Kwok Wing, Lin Lu, Xin Ma, Lizhou Fan
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) hold transformative potential for medical decision support yet their application in psychiatry remains constrained by hallucinations and superficial reasoning. This limitation is particularly acute in light-parameter LLMs which are essential for privacy-preserving and efficient clinical deployment. Existing training paradigms prioritize linguistic fluency over structured clinical logic and result in a fundamental misalignment with professional diagnostic cognition. Here we introduce ClinMPO, a reinforcement learning framework designed to align the internal reasoning of LLMs with professional psychiatric practice. The framework employs a specialized reward model trained independently on a dataset derived from 4,474 psychiatry journal articles and structured according to evidence-based medicine principles. We evaluated ClinMPO on a unseen subset of the benchmark designed to isolate reasoning capabilities from rote memorization. This test set comprises items where leading large-parameter LLMs consistently fail. We compared the ClinMPO-aligned light LLM performance against a cohort of 300 medical students. The ClinMPO-tuned Qwen3-8B model achieved a diagnostic accuracy of 31.4% and surpassed the human benchmark of 30.8% on these complex cases. These results demonstrate that medical evidence-guided optimization enables light-parameter LLMs to master complex reasoning tasks. Our findings suggest that explicit cognitive alignment offers a scalable pathway to reliable and safe psychiatric decision support.
zh_title: 评估证据引导的强化学习框架在使轻量级大语言模型与精神病学临床推理中的决策认知保持一致性方面的效果
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医疗决策支持方面具有变革潜力，但其在精神病学中的应用仍受到幻觉和肤浅推理的限制。这种限制在轻量级LLMs中尤为突出，而轻量级LLMs对于保护隐私和高效的临床部署至关重要。现有的训练范式优先考虑语言流畅性而非结构化的临床逻辑，导致与专业诊断认知存在根本性的不一致。我们在此介绍ClinMPO，这是一个旨在将LLMs的内部推理与专业精神病学实践保持一致的强化学习框架。该框架采用一个专门的奖励模型，该模型独立于一个包含4,474篇精神病学期刊文章的数据集进行训练，并根据循证医学原则进行结构化。我们对ClinMPO进行了一个未见的基准子集进行评估，该子集旨在将推理能力与死记硬背的能力隔离开来。该测试集包含领先的大参数LLMs始终失败的项目。我们将ClinMPO校准后的轻量级LLM性能与300名医学生群体进行了比较。经过ClinMPO调优的Qwen3-8B模型实现了31.4%的诊断准确率，并在这些复杂案例上超过了30.8%的人类基准。这些结果表明，医学证据引导的优化使轻量级LLMs能够掌握复杂的推理任务。我们的发现表明，明确的认知对齐为可靠且安全的精神病学决策支持提供了一条可扩展的途径。
tldr: 引入ClinMPO，这是一个使用医学证据训练奖励模型的强化学习框架，用于校准轻量级LLM（Qwen3-8B）的精神病学临床推理。该模型在复杂诊断案例上的准确率（31.4%）超过了医学生（30.8%）。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于提出了一个明确的“证据引导”强化学习框架（ClinMPO），以解决轻量级LLM在需要结构化临床逻辑的专业领域（如精神病学）中的固有缺陷。其重要性在于，它提供了一种可扩展且注重隐私的解决方案，通过认知对齐而非简单增大模型参数，显著提升了LLM在复杂诊断推理中的可靠性。超越人类基准（医学生）的性能展示了这种方法在将模型推理与循证医学实践相结合方面的潜力。
motivation: 现有的LLMs（特别是轻量级LLMs）在精神病学中的应用受到幻觉和肤浅推理的限制，因为它们优先考虑语言流畅性而非结构化的临床逻辑，导致与专业诊断认知不一致。需要一种方法来校准LLM的内部推理与专业的精神病学实践。
method: 引入ClinMPO，一个强化学习（RL）框架。该框架使用一个独立的、专门的奖励模型，该模型基于4,474篇精神病学期刊文章数据集，并根据循证医学原则进行结构化训练。使用该框架对轻量级LLM（Qwen3-8B）进行调优。
results: ClinMPO调优后的Qwen3-8B模型在复杂的、领先的大参数LLM也失败的测试集上，诊断准确率达到31.4%，超过了300名医学生的基准（30.8%）。
conclusion: 医学证据引导的优化使轻量级LLMs能够掌握复杂的推理任务。明确的认知对齐为可靠且安全的精神病学决策支持提供了一条可扩展的途径。

title: BrokenBind: Universal Modality Exploration beyond Dataset Boundaries
authors: Zhuo Huang, Runnan Chen, Bo Han, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama, Tongliang Liu
abstract: Multi-modal learning combines various modalities to provide a comprehensive understanding of real-world problems. A common strategy is to directly bind different modalities together in a specific joint embedding space. However, the capability of existing methods is restricted within the modalities presented in the given dataset, thus they are biased when generalizing to unpresented modalities in downstream tasks. As a result, due to such inflexibility, the viability of previous methods is seriously hindered by the cost of acquiring multi-modal datasets. In this paper, we introduce BrokenBind, which focuses on binding modalities that are presented from different datasets. To achieve this, BrokenBind simultaneously leverages multiple datasets containing the modalities of interest and one shared modality. Though the two datasets do not correspond to each other due to distribution mismatch, we can capture their relationship to generate pseudo embeddings to fill in the missing modalities of interest, enabling flexible and generalized multi-modal learning. Under our framework, any two modalities can be bound together, free from the dataset limitation, to achieve universal modality exploration. Further, to reveal the capability of our method, we study intensified scenarios where more than two datasets are needed for modality binding and show the effectiveness of BrokenBind in low-data regimes. Through extensive evaluation, we carefully justify the superiority of BrokenBind compared to well-known multi-modal baseline methods.
zh_title: BrokenBind：超越数据集边界的通用模态探索
translation: 多模态学习结合了各种模态，以提供对现实世界问题的全面理解。一个常见的策略是将不同的模态直接绑定在一个特定的联合嵌入空间中。然而，现有方法的能力受限于给定数据集中存在的模态，因此在泛化到下游任务中未出现的模态时存在偏差。结果，由于这种不灵活性，获取多模态数据集的成本严重阻碍了先前方法的可行性。在本文中，我们引入了BrokenBind，它专注于绑定来自不同数据集的模态。为实现这一目标，BrokenBind同时利用了多个包含目标模态和一种共享模态的数据集。尽管这两个数据集由于分布不匹配而互不对应，但我们可以捕获它们之间的关系以生成伪嵌入，从而填补缺失的目标模态，实现灵活和泛化的多模态学习。在我们的框架下，任意两种模态都可以绑定在一起，摆脱了数据集的限制，实现了通用模态探索。此外，为了揭示我们方法的能力，我们研究了需要两个以上数据集进行模态绑定的复杂场景，并展示了BrokenBind在低数据量环境中的有效性。通过广泛的评估，我们仔细证明了BrokenBind相较于著名的多模态基线方法的优越性。
tldr: 现有的多模态学习受限于数据集边界，泛化性差。本文提出BrokenBind，它能利用多个含有共享模态和目标模态的独立数据集，生成伪嵌入，实现任意模态的灵活绑定和通用探索，即使在低数据量下也表现优越。
ai_comments: BrokenBind的创新点在于突破了传统多模态学习对“配对”数据集的强依赖。通过引入“共享模态”作为桥梁，即使面对分布不匹配的独立数据集，也能进行有效的模态间关联（即“软绑定”）。这极大地提高了多模态模型的灵活性和泛化能力，降低了对昂贵、稀有、完全对齐的多模态数据集的需求，对于推动多模态学习在资源受限环境下的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的多模态学习方法将不同模态直接绑定在特定的联合嵌入空间中，但其能力受限于给定数据集中的模态，导致在泛化到下游任务中未出现的模态时存在偏差，且数据采集成本高昂，严重阻碍了先前方法的可行性。
method: 提出BrokenBind框架，专注于绑定来自不同数据集的模态。该方法同时利用多个包含目标模态和一种共享模态的数据集。尽管这些数据集因分布不匹配而互不对应，但BrokenBind可以捕获它们之间的关系，生成“伪嵌入”来填补缺失的目标模态，从而实现灵活和泛化的多模态学习。该框架还可扩展到需要两个以上数据集的复杂场景。
results: 通过广泛的评估，证明了BrokenBind相对于著名的多模态基线方法具有优越性，并且在低数据量情况下也表现出有效性。
conclusion: BrokenBind通过利用来自不同数据集的模态，实现了不受数据集限制的通用模态探索，解决了现有方法在泛化性和数据成本上的限制。

title: On the Plasticity and Stability for Post-Training Large Language Models
authors: Wenwen Qiang, Ziyin Gu, Jiahuan Zhou, Jie Hu, Jingyao Wang, Changwen Zheng, Hui Xiong
abstract: Training stability remains a critical bottleneck for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), often manifesting as a trade-off between reasoning plasticity and general capability retention. We identify a root cause as the geometric conflict between plasticity and stability gradients, which leads to destructive interference. Crucially, we argue that deterministic projection methods are suboptimal for GRPO as they overlook the intrinsic stochasticity of group-based gradient estimates. To address this, we propose Probabilistic Conflict Resolution (PCR), a Bayesian framework that models gradients as random variables. PCR dynamically arbitrates conflicts via an uncertainty-aware ``soft projection'' mechanism, optimizing the signal-to-noise ratio. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PCR significantly smooths the training trajectory and achieves superior performance in various reasoning tasks.
zh_title: 关于训练后大型语言模型的塑性和稳定性
translation: 训练稳定性仍然是群相对策略优化（GRPO）的关键瓶颈，通常表现为推理塑性与通用能力保留之间的权衡。我们确定了一个根本原因：塑性梯度和稳定性梯度之间的几何冲突导致了破坏性干扰。至关重要的是，我们认为确定性投影方法对于GRPO来说是次优的，因为它们忽略了基于群组的梯度估计的内在随机性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了概率冲突解决（PCR），这是一个将梯度建模为随机变量的贝叶斯框架。PCR通过一个不确定性感知的“软投影”机制动态仲裁冲突，优化信噪比。广泛的实验表明，PCR显著平滑了训练轨迹，并在各种推理任务中实现了优越的性能。
tldr: 训练后LLM的GRPO方法存在塑性与稳定性梯度冲突。本文提出概率冲突解决（PCR），一个基于贝叶斯的“软投影”框架，用于动态解决梯度冲突，从而提高训练稳定性和推理性能。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将训练后LLM优化中的“塑性”与“稳定性”的权衡问题，归结为梯度空间中的几何冲突。通过引入贝叶斯框架和概率冲突解决（PCR）机制，它超越了传统的确定性投影方法，利用梯度估计的内在随机性进行更精细的动态调整。这种将梯度冲突视为随机变量并进行不确定性感知仲裁的思路，对于提高基于策略优化的LLM微调方法的训练稳定性和效率具有重要意义。
motivation: 解决群相对策略优化（GRPO）中训练稳定性差的问题，该问题表现为推理塑性与通用能力保留之间的权衡，根源在于塑性与稳定性梯度之间的几何冲突导致的破坏性干扰。
method: 提出概率冲突解决（PCR），一个贝叶斯框架，将梯度建模为随机变量。PCR通过一个不确定性感知的“软投影”机制动态仲裁冲突，优化信噪比，以解决梯度冲突。
results: PCR显著平滑了训练轨迹，并在各种推理任务中取得了优越的性能。

title: RelayGen: Intra-Generation Model Switching for Efficient Reasoning
authors: Jiwon Song, Yoongon Kim, Jae-Joon Kim
abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating long, multi-step reasoning trajectories, but inference-time scaling incurs substantial deployment cost. A key challenge is that generation difficulty varies within a single output, whereas existing efficiency-oriented approaches either ignore this intra-generation variation or rely on supervised token-level routing with high system complexity. We present \textbf{RelayGen}, a training-free, segment-level runtime model switching framework that exploits difficulty variation in long-form reasoning. Through offline analysis of generation uncertainty using token probability margins, we show that coarse-grained segment-level control is sufficient to capture difficulty transitions within a reasoning trajectory. RelayGen identifies model-specific switch cues that signal transitions to lower-difficulty segments and dynamically delegates their continuation to a smaller model, while preserving high-difficulty reasoning on the large model. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, RelayGen substantially reduces inference latency while preserving most of the accuracy of large models. When combined with speculative decoding, RelayGen achieves up to 2.2$\times$ end-to-end speedup with less than 2\% accuracy degradation, without requiring additional training or learned routing components.
zh_title: RelayGen：生成内模型切换实现高效推理
translation: 大型推理模型（LRM）通过生成长、多步推理轨迹，在复杂推理任务上取得了强大的性能，但推理时期的扩展会带来巨大的部署成本。一个关键挑战是，单个输出内的生成难度各不相同，而现有的面向效率的方法要么忽略了这种生成内的变化，要么依赖于具有高系统复杂度的监督式token级路由。我们提出了 **RelayGen**，一个无需训练的、分段级运行时模型切换框架，它利用了长篇推理中的难度变化。通过使用token概率裕度对生成不确定性进行离线分析，我们表明粗粒度的分段级控制足以捕获推理轨迹中的难度转换。RelayGen识别出模型特定的切换信号，指示转向难度较低的片段，并动态地将其延续委托给较小的模型，同时在大模型上保留高难度推理。在多个推理基准测试中，RelayGen显著降低了推理延迟，同时保留了大型模型的大部分准确性。当与推测解码结合时，RelayGen实现了高达2.2倍的端到端加速，准确性下降不到2%，且无需额外的训练或学习路由组件。
tldr: RelayGen是一个无需训练的、分段式运行时模型切换框架，通过在推理过程中动态切换大小模型来提高大型推理模型的效率，同时保持准确性。
ai_comments: RelayGen的创新点在于其无需训练、基于分段级动态模型切换的策略，有效地利用了生成过程中难度变化，提供了一种实用的效率提升方案。它避免了传统监督式token级路由的复杂性，且与推测解码结合能带来显著的性能提升。
motivation: 大型推理模型在复杂推理任务中表现出色，但生成长、多步推理轨迹的推理成本高昂。现有效率方法忽略了生成内部的难度变化或依赖于高系统复杂度的监督式token级路由。
