Prior studies have explored tokenizer families and vocabulary sizes but typically (i) vary vocabulary without systematically controlling the tokenizer's training corpus, (ii) provide limited intrinsic diagnostics, and (iii) evaluate a narrow slice of downstream tasks. We present the first comprehensive, principled study of Turkish subword tokenization; a "subwords manifest", that jointly varies vocabulary size and tokenizer training corpus size (data and vocabulary coupling), compares multiple tokenizer families under matched parameter budgets (WordPiece, morphology level, and character baselines), and evaluates across semantic (NLI, STS, sentiment analysis, NER), syntactic (POS, dependency parsing), and morphology-sensitive probes. To explain why tokenizers succeed or fail, we introduce a morphology-aware diagnostic toolkit that goes beyond coarse aggregates to boundary-level micro/macro F1, decoupled lemma atomicity vs. surface boundary hits, over/under-segmentation indices, character/word edit distances (CER/WER), continuation rates, and affix-type coverage and token-level atomicity. Our contributions are fourfold: (i) a systematic investigation of the vocabulary-corpus-success triad; (ii) a unified, morphology-aware evaluation framework linking intrinsic diagnostics to extrinsic outcomes; (iii) controlled comparisons identifying when character-level and morphology-level tokenization pay off; and (iv) an open-source release of evaluation code, tokenizer pipelines, and models. As the first work of its kind, this "subwords manifest" delivers actionable guidance for building effective tokenizers in MRLs and establishes a reproducible foundation for future research.
comment: Submitted to Cambridge NLP journal, all rights belong to them

title: Agentic Uncertainty Reveals Agentic Overconfidence
authors: Jean Kaddour, Srijan Patel, Gbètondji Dovonon, Leo Richter, Pasquale Minervini, Matt J. Kusner
abstract: Can AI agents predict whether they will succeed at a task? We study agentic uncertainty by eliciting success probability estimates before, during, and after task execution. All results exhibit agentic overconfidence: some agents that succeed only 22% of the time predict 77% success. Counterintuitively, pre-execution assessment with strictly less information tends to yield better discrimination than standard post-execution review, though differences are not always significant. Adversarial prompting reframing assessment as bug-finding achieves the best calibration.

title: Distributed Knowledge in Simplicial Models
authors: Éric Goubault, Jérémy Ledent, Sergio Rajsbaum
abstract:
The usual semantics of multi-agent epistemic logic is based on Kripke models, defined in terms of binary relations on a set of possible worlds. Recently, there has been a growing interest in using simplicial complexes rather than graphs, as models for multi-agent epistemic logic.
  This approach uses agents' views as the fundamental object instead of worlds. A set of views by different agents about a world forms a simplex, and a set of simplexes defines a simplicial complex, that can serve as a model for multi-agent epistemic logic. This new approach reveals topological information that is implicit in Kripke models, because the binary indistinguishability relations are more clearly seen as n-ary relations in the simplicial complex.
  This paper, written for an economics audience, introduces simplicial models to non-experts and connects distributed computing, epistemic logic and topology. Our focus is on distributed knowledge and its fixed point, common distributed knowledge. These concepts arise when considering the knowledge that a group of agents would acquire, if they could communicate their local knowledge perfectly. While common knowledge has been shown to be related to consensus, we illustrate how distributed knowledge is related to a task weaker to consensus, called majority consensus.
  We describe three models of communication, some well-known (immediate snapshot), and others less studied (related to broadcast and test-and-set). When majority consensus is solvable, we describe the distributed knowledge that is used to solve it. When it is not solvable, we present a logical obstruction, a formula that should always be known according to the task specification, but which the players cannot know.

title: DAWN: Dependency-Aware Fast Inference for Diffusion LLMs
authors: Lizhuo Luo, Zhuoran Shi, Jiajun Luo, Zhi Wang, Shen Ren, Wenya Wang, Tianwei Zhang
abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have shown advantages in text generation, particularly due to their inherent ability for parallel decoding. However, constrained by the quality--speed trade-off, existing inference solutions adopt conservative parallel strategies, leaving substantial efficiency potential underexplored. A core challenge is that parallel decoding assumes each position can be filled independently, but tokens are often semantically coupled. Thus, the correct choice at one position constrains valid choices at others. Without modeling these inter-token dependencies, parallel strategies produce deteriorated outputs. Motivated by this insight, we propose DAWN, a training-free, dependency-aware decoding method for fast dLLM inference. DAWN extracts token dependencies and leverages two key motivations: (1) positions dependent on unmasked certain positions become more reliable, (2) simultaneously unmasking strongly coupled uncertain positions induces errors. Given those findings, DAWN leverages a dependency graph to select more reliable unmasking positions at each iteration, achieving high parallelism with negligible loss in generation quality. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets demonstrate that DAWN speedups the inference by 1.80-8.06x over baselines while preserving the generation quality. Code is released at https://github.com/lizhuo-luo/DAWN.

title: CineScene: Implicit 3D as Effective Scene Representation for Cinematic Video Generation
authors: Kaiyi Huang, Yukun Huang, Yu Li, Jianhong Bai, Xintao Wang, Zinan Lin, Xuefei Ning, Jiwen Yu, Pengfei Wan, Yu Wang, Xihui Liu
abstract: Cinematic video production requires control over scene-subject composition and camera movement, but live-action shooting remains costly due to the need for constructing physical sets. To address this, we introduce the task of cinematic video generation with decoupled scene context: given multiple images of a static environment, the goal is to synthesize high-quality videos featuring dynamic subject while preserving the underlying scene consistency and following a user-specified camera trajectory. We present CineScene, a framework that leverages implicit 3D-aware scene representation for cinematic video generation. Our key innovation is a novel context conditioning mechanism that injects 3D-aware features in an implicit way: By encoding scene images into visual representations through VGGT, CineScene injects spatial priors into a pretrained text-to-video generation model by additional context concatenation, enabling camera-controlled video synthesis with consistent scenes and dynamic subjects. To further enhance the model's robustness, we introduce a simple yet effective random-shuffling strategy for the input scene images during training. To address the lack of training data, we construct a scene-decoupled dataset with Unreal Engine 5, containing paired videos of scenes with and without dynamic subjects, panoramic images representing the underlying static scene, along with their camera trajectories. Experiments show that CineScene achieves state-of-the-art performance in scene-consistent cinematic video generation, handling large camera movements and demonstrating generalization across diverse environments.

title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
authors: Shenyuan Gao, William Liang, Kaiyuan Zheng, Ayaan Malik, Seonghyeon Ye, Sihyun Yu, Wei-Cheng Tseng, Yuzhu Dong, Kaichun Mo, Chen-Hsuan Lin, Qianli Ma, Seungjun Nah, Loic Magne, Jiannan Xiang, Yuqi Xie, Ruijie Zheng, Dantong Niu, You Liang Tan, K.R. Zentner, George Kurian, Suneel Indupuru, Pooya Jannaty, Jinwei Gu, Jun Zhang, Jitendra Malik, Pieter Abbeel, Ming-Yu Liu, Yuke Zhu, Joel Jang, Linxi "Jim" Fan
abstract: Being able to simulate the outcomes of actions in varied environments will revolutionize the development of generalist agents at scale. However, modeling these world dynamics, especially for dexterous robotics tasks, poses significant challenges due to limited data coverage and scarce action labels. As an endeavor towards this end, we introduce DreamDojo, a foundation world model that learns diverse interactions and dexterous controls from 44k hours of egocentric human videos. Our data mixture represents the largest video dataset to date for world model pretraining, spanning a wide range of daily scenarios with diverse objects and skills. To address the scarcity of action labels, we introduce continuous latent actions as unified proxy actions, enhancing interaction knowledge transfer from unlabeled videos. After post-training on small-scale target robot data, DreamDojo demonstrates a strong understanding of physics and precise action controllability. We also devise a distillation pipeline that accelerates DreamDojo to a real-time speed of 10.81 FPS and further improves context consistency. Our work enables several important applications based on generative world models, including live teleoperation, policy evaluation, and model-based planning. Systematic evaluation on multiple challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks verifies the significance of our method for simulating open-world, contact-rich tasks, paving the way for general-purpose robot world models.

title: Improving Credit Card Fraud Detection with an Optimized Explainable Boosting Machine
authors: Reza E. Fazel, Arash Bakhtiary, Siavash A. Bigdeli
abstract: Addressing class imbalance is a central challenge in credit card fraud detection, as it directly impacts predictive reliability in real-world financial systems. To overcome this, the study proposes an enhanced workflow based on the Explainable Boosting Machine (EBM)-a transparent, state-of-the-art implementation of the GA2M algorithm-optimized through systematic hyperparameter tuning, feature selection, and preprocessing refinement. Rather than relying on conventional sampling techniques that may introduce bias or cause information loss, the optimized EBM achieves an effective balance between accuracy and interpretability, enabling precise detection of fraudulent transactions while providing actionable insights into feature importance and interaction effects. Furthermore, the Taguchi method is employed to optimize both the sequence of data scalers and model hyperparameters, ensuring robust, reproducible, and systematically validated performance improvements. Experimental evaluation on benchmark credit card data yields an ROC-AUC of 0.983, surpassing prior EBM baselines (0.975) and outperforming Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Decision Tree models. These results highlight the potential of interpretable machine learning and data-driven optimization for advancing trustworthy fraud analytics in financial systems.

title: Learning a Generative Meta-Model of LLM Activations
authors: Grace Luo, Jiahai Feng, Trevor Darrell, Alec Radford, Jacob Steinhardt
abstract: Existing approaches for analyzing neural network activations, such as PCA and sparse autoencoders, rely on strong structural assumptions. Generative models offer an alternative: they can uncover structure without such assumptions and act as priors that improve intervention fidelity. We explore this direction by training diffusion models on one billion residual stream activations, creating "meta-models" that learn the distribution of a network's internal states. We find that diffusion loss decreases smoothly with compute and reliably predicts downstream utility. In particular, applying the meta-model's learned prior to steering interventions improves fluency, with larger gains as loss decreases. Moreover, the meta-model's neurons increasingly isolate concepts into individual units, with sparse probing scores that scale as loss decreases. These results suggest generative meta-models offer a scalable path toward interpretability without restrictive structural assumptions. Project page: https://generative-latent-prior.github.io.

title: InftyThink+: Effective and Efficient Infinite-Horizon Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
authors: Yuchen Yan, Liang Jiang, Jin Jiang, Shuaicheng Li, Zujie Wen, Zhiqiang Zhang, Jun Zhou, Jian Shao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
abstract: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance by scaling inference-time chain-of-thought, but this paradigm suffers from quadratic cost, context length limits, and degraded reasoning due to lost-in-the-middle effects. Iterative reasoning mitigates these issues by periodically summarizing intermediate thoughts, yet existing methods rely on supervised learning or fixed heuristics and fail to optimize when to summarize, what to preserve, and how to resume reasoning. We propose InftyThink+, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the entire iterative reasoning trajectory, building on model-controlled iteration boundaries and explicit summarization. InftyThink+ adopts a two-stage training scheme with supervised cold-start followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning, enabling the model to learn strategic summarization and continuation decisions. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B show that InftyThink+ improves accuracy by 21% on AIME24 and outperforms conventional long chain-of-thought reinforcement learning by a clear margin, while also generalizing better to out-of-distribution benchmarks. Moreover, InftyThink+ significantly reduces inference latency and accelerates reinforcement learning training, demonstrating improved reasoning efficiency alongside stronger performance.

title: Computing Diffusion Geometry
authors: Iolo Jones, David Lanners
abstract: Calculus and geometry are ubiquitous in the theoretical modelling of scientific phenomena, but have historically been very challenging to apply directly to real data as statistics. Diffusion geometry is a new theory that reformulates classical calculus and geometry in terms of a diffusion process, allowing these theories to generalise beyond manifolds and be computed from data. This work introduces a new computational framework for diffusion geometry that substantially broadens its practical scope and improves its precision, robustness to noise, and computational complexity. We present a range of new computational methods, including all the standard objects from vector calculus and Riemannian geometry, and apply them to solve spatial PDEs and vector field flows, find geodesic (intrinsic) distances, curvature, and several new topological tools like de Rham cohomology, circular coordinates, and Morse theory. These methods are data-driven, scalable, and can exploit highly optimised numerical tools for linear algebra.

title: MedMO: Grounding and Understanding Multimodal Large Language Model for Medical Images
authors: Ankan Deria, Komal Kumar, Adinath Madhavrao Dukre, Eran Segal, Salman Khan, Imran Razzak
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have rapidly advanced, yet their adoption in medicine remains limited by gaps in domain coverage, modality alignment, and grounded reasoning. In this work, we introduce MedMO, a medical foundation model built upon a generalized MLLM architecture and trained exclusively on large-scale, domain-specific data. MedMO follows a multi-stage training recipe: (i) cross-modal pretraining to align heterogeneous visual encoders with a medical language backbone; (ii) instruction tuning on multi-task supervision that spans captioning, VQA, report generation, retrieval, and grounded disease localization with bounding boxes; and (iii) reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards that combine factuality checks with a box-level GIoU reward to strengthen spatial grounding and step-by-step reasoning in complex clinical scenarios. MedMO consistently outperforms strong open-source medical MLLMs across multiple modalities and tasks. On VQA benchmarks, MedMO achieves an average accuracy improvement of +13.7% over the baseline and performs within 1.9% of the SOTA Fleming-VL. For text-based QA, it attains +6.9% over the baseline and +14.5% over Fleming-VL. In medical report generation, MedMO delivers significant gains in both semantic and clinical accuracy. Moreover, it exhibits strong grounding capability, achieving an IoU improvement of +40.4 over the baseline and +37.0% over Fleming-VL, underscoring its robust spatial reasoning and localization performance. Evaluations across radiology, ophthalmology, and pathology-microscopy confirm MedMO's broad cross-modality generalization. We release two versions of MedMO: 4B and 8B. Project is available at https://genmilab.github.io/MedMO-Page

title: COSMOS: Coherent Supergaussian Modeling with Spatial Priors for Sparse-View 3D Splatting
authors: Chaeyoung Jeong, Kwangsu Kim
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently emerged as a promising approach for 3D reconstruction, providing explicit, point-based representations and enabling high-quality real time rendering. However, when trained with sparse input views, 3DGS suffers from overfitting and structural degradation, leading to poor generalization on novel views. This limitation arises from its optimization relying solely on photometric loss without incorporating any 3D structure priors. To address this issue, we propose Coherent supergaussian Modeling with Spatial Priors (COSMOS). Inspired by the concept of superpoints from 3D segmentation, COSMOS introduces 3D structure priors by newly defining supergaussian groupings of Gaussians based on local geometric cues and appearance features. To this end, COSMOS applies inter group global self-attention across supergaussian groups and sparse local attention among individual Gaussians, enabling the integration of global and local spatial information. These structure-aware features are then used for predicting Gaussian attributes, facilitating more consistent 3D reconstructions. Furthermore, by leveraging supergaussian-based grouping, COSMOS enforces an intra-group positional regularization to maintain structural coherence and suppress floaters, thereby enhancing training stability under sparse-view conditions. Our experiments on Blender and DTU show that COSMOS surpasses state-of-the-art methods in sparse-view settings without any external depth supervision.

title: Deep networks learn to parse uniform-depth context-free languages from local statistics
authors: Jack T. Parley, Francesco Cagnetta, Matthieu Wyart
abstract: Understanding how the structure of language can be learned from sentences alone is a central question in both cognitive science and machine learning. Studies of the internal representations of Large Language Models (LLMs) support their ability to parse text when predicting the next word, while representing semantic notions independently of surface form. Yet, which data statistics make these feats possible, and how much data is required, remain largely unknown. Probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs) provide a tractable testbed for studying these questions. However, prior work has focused either on the post-hoc characterization of the parsing-like algorithms used by trained networks; or on the learnability of PCFGs with fixed syntax, where parsing is unnecessary. Here, we (i) introduce a tunable class of PCFGs in which both the degree of ambiguity and the correlation structure across scales can be controlled; (ii) provide a learning mechanism -- an inference algorithm inspired by the structure of deep convolutional networks -- that links learnability and sample complexity to specific language statistics; and (iii) validate our predictions empirically across deep convolutional and transformer-based architectures. Overall, we propose a unifying framework where correlations at different scales lift local ambiguities, enabling the emergence of hierarchical representations of the data.

title: The Preservation Tradeoff: A Thermodynamic Bound in the Diminishing-Returns Regime
authors: Amadeus Brandes
abstract: Thermodynamic systems that preserve information against thermal fluctuations face a tradeoff distinct from transmission (Shannon) or erasure (Landauer). We establish a feasibility condition for this preservation problem within a broad class of systems exhibiting diminishing returns in error suppression. By defining the preservation stiffness S_kappa, a response function analogous to magnetic susceptibility, we derive an optimality condition linking S_kappa to the resource odds. This identity provides a substrate-agnostic diagnostic: deviations reveal thermodynamic inefficiency or operation outside the smooth reliability regime. For systems in the diminishing-returns regime -- a class we argue is typical of physically realistic error-correction -- the optimal maintenance allocation is bounded above by 50%; for the physically significant subclass exhibiting smooth saturation, it is further constrained to a 30-50% band. We derive this regime from two independent physical principles -- Shannon's channel capacity and Landauer's erasure bound -- whose convergence on the same functional form constitutes our central theoretical contribution. We validate this framework against kinetic proofreading data in E. coli and protocol overhead in TCP/IP networks, and specify conditions under which the prediction is falsifiable.

title: Adaptive Resolution and Chroma Subsampling for Energy-Efficient Video Coding
authors: Amritha Premkumar, Christian Herglotz
abstract: Conventional video encoders typically employ a fixed chroma subsampling format, such as YUV420, which may not optimally reflect variations in chroma detail across different types of content. This can lead to suboptimal chroma quality and inefficiencies in bitrate allocation. We propose an Adaptive Resolution-Chroma Subsampling (ARCS) framework that jointly optimizes spatial resolution and chroma subsampling to balance perceptual quality and decoding efficiency. ARCS selects an optimal (resolution, chroma format) pair for each bitrate by maximizing a composite quality-complexity objective, while enforcing monotonicity constraints to ensure smooth transitions between representations. Experimental results using x265 show that, compared to a fixed-format encoding (YUV444), on average, ARCS achieves a 13.48 % bitrate savings and a 62.18 % reduction in decoding time, which we use as a proxy for the decoding energy, to yield the same colorVideoVDP score. The proposed framework introduces chroma adaptivity as a new control dimension for energy-efficient video streaming.
comment: 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS)
zh_title: 适用于节能视频编码的自适应分辨率和色度子采样
translation: 传统的视频编码器通常采用固定的色度子采样格式，例如YUV420，这可能无法最佳地反映不同类型内容中色度细节的变化。这可能导致次优的色度质量和比特率分配效率低下。我们提出了一种自适应分辨率-色度子采样（ARCS）框架，它联合优化空间分辨率和色度子采样，以平衡感知质量和解码效率。ARCS通过最大化一个复合的质量-复杂度目标函数，为每个比特率选择一个最佳的（分辨率，色度格式）对，同时实施单调性约束以确保表示之间的平滑过渡。使用x265进行的实验结果显示，与固定格式编码（YUV444）相比，在达到相同的colorVideoVDP分数时，ARCS平均实现了13.48%的比特率节省和62.18%的解码时间减少，我们将解码时间用作解码能耗的替代指标。所提出的框架引入了色度自适应性作为节能视频流的新控制维度。
tldr: 提出ARCS框架，联合优化视频分辨率和色度子采样，以节省比特率和降低解码能耗。实验显示，与YUV444相比，在相同感知质量下，比特率节省13.48%，解码时间减少62.18%。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于将色度自适应性引入视频编码的控制维度，并将其与空间分辨率联合优化。通过优化（分辨率，色度格式）对，它有效地平衡了感知质量和解码复杂度（能耗），为实现节能视频流提供了一种新的、量化效果显著的方法。其结果表明，在保持用户体验的前提下，能耗和带宽的节省潜力巨大。
motivation: 传统的视频编码器通常采用固定的色度子采样格式（如YUV420），这不能最佳地反映不同内容中色度细节的变化，可能导致次优的色度质量和比特率分配效率低下。
method: 提出了一种自适应分辨率-色度子采样（ARCS）框架，联合优化空间分辨率和色度子采样，以平衡感知质量和解码效率。ARCS通过最大化一个复合的质量-复杂度目标函数，为每个比特率选择一个最佳的（分辨率，色度格式）对，并实施单调性约束以确保表示之间的平滑过渡。
results: 使用x265进行的实验结果显示，与固定格式编码（YUV444）相比，在达到相同的colorVideoVDP分数时，ARCS平均实现了13.48%的比特率节省和62.18%的解码时间减少（用作解码能耗的替代指标）。
conclusion: 所提出的框架引入了色度自适应性作为节能视频流的新控制维度。

title: ALIEN: Analytic Latent Watermarking for Controllable Generation
authors: Liangqi Lei, Keke Gai, Jing Yu, Qi Wu
abstract: Watermarking is a technical alternative to safeguarding intellectual property and reducing misuse. Existing methods focus on optimizing watermarked latent variables to balance watermark robustness and fidelity, as Latent diffusion models (LDMs) are considered a powerful tool for generative tasks. However, reliance on computationally intensive heuristic optimization for iterative signal refinement results in high training overhead and local optima entrapment.To address these issues, we propose an \underline{A}na\underline{l}ytical Watermark\underline{i}ng Framework for Controllabl\underline{e} Generatio\underline{n} (ALIEN). We develop the first analytical derivation of the time-dependent modulation coefficient that guides the diffusion of watermark residuals to achieve controllable watermark embedding pattern.Experimental results show that ALIEN-Q outperforms the state-of-the-art by 33.1\% across 5 quality metrics, and ALIEN-R demonstrates 14.0\% improved robustness against generative variant and stability threats compared to the state-of-the-art across 15 distinct conditions. Code can be available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ALIEN/.
zh_title: ALIEN：可控生成中的解析潜在水印
translation:
水印是保护知识产权和减少滥用的技术替代方案。现有方法侧重于优化带水印的潜在变量，以平衡水印的鲁棒性和保真度，因为潜在扩散模型（LDMs）被认为是生成任务的强大工具。然而，依赖于计算密集型的启发式优化进行迭代信号精炼，会导致高昂的训练开销和局部最优陷阱。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了

（ALIEN）。我们开发了首个时间相关的调制系数的解析推导，该系数指导水印残差的扩散，以实现可控的水印嵌入模式。实验结果表明，ALIEN-Q 在 5 个质量指标上优于现有技术 33.1%，而 ALIEN-R 在 15 个不同条件下，与现有技术相比，在鲁棒性方面提高了 14.0%。代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ALIEN/ 获取。
tldr: ALIEN提出了一种新的水印方法，通过解析推导时间相关的调制系数来控制水印嵌入，解决了现有方法计算开销大和局部最优的问题。实验证明ALIEN在质量和鲁棒性方面优于现有技术。
ai_comments: ALIEN框架在水印技术上实现了重要的理论突破，通过解析推导解决了现有方法在计算效率和优化精度上的瓶颈。其在质量和鲁棒性上的显著提升，为数字内容版权保护和溯源提供了更可靠的解决方案。然而，文章未提及水印的不可见性以及对生成内容多样性的潜在影响，这可能是未来研究可以进一步探索的方向。
motivation: 现有水印方法在潜变量扩散模型（LDMs）中，为了平衡鲁棒性和保真度，依赖于计算密集型启发式优化，导致训练开销大且容易陷入局部最优。ALIEN旨在解决这些问题。
method: ALIEN提出了一种解析方法，通过推导时间相关的调制系数来指导水印残差的扩散，从而实现可控的水印嵌入模式。
results: ALIEN-Q在5个质量指标上比现有技术提高了33.1%。ALIEN-R在15种不同条件下，与现有技术相比，在鲁棒性方面提高了14.0%。
conclusion: ALIEN通过解析方法实现了高效且可控的水印嵌入，在质量和鲁棒性方面均优于现有技术。

title: Algebraic Robustness Verification of Neural Networks
authors: Yulia Alexandr, Hao Duan, Guido Montúfar
abstract: We formulate formal robustness verification of neural networks as an algebraic optimization problem. We leverage the Euclidean Distance (ED) degree, which is the generic number of complex critical points of the distance minimization problem to a classifier's decision boundary, as an architecture-dependent measure of the intrinsic complexity of robustness verification. To make this notion operational, we define the associated ED discriminant, which characterizes input points at which the number of real critical points changes, distinguishing test instances that are easier or harder to verify. We provide an explicit algorithm for computing this discriminant. We further introduce the parameter discriminant of a neural network, identifying parameters where the ED degree drops and the decision boundary exhibits reduced algebraic complexity. We derive closed-form expressions for the ED degree for several classes of neural architectures, as well as formulas for the expected number of real critical points in the infinite-width limit. Finally, we present an exact robustness certification algorithm based on numerical homotopy continuation, establishing a concrete link between metric algebraic geometry and neural network verification.
zh_title: 神经网络的代数鲁棒性验证
translation: 我们将神经网络的正式鲁棒性验证表述为一个代数优化问题。我们利用欧氏距离（ED）度，即最小化到分类器决策边界的距离问题的复杂临界点的通用数量，作为衡量鲁棒性验证固有复杂性的一个依赖于架构的度量。为了使这一概念可操作，我们定义了相关的ED判别式，它表征了实临界点数量发生变化的输入点，区分了验证起来更容易或更困难的测试实例。我们提供了一种计算该判别式的显式算法。我们进一步引入了神经网络的参数判别式，识别出ED度下降且决策边界表现出代数复杂度降低的参数。我们推导出了几种神经网络架构的ED度的闭式表达式，以及无限宽度极限下期望实临界点数的公式。最后，我们提出了一种基于数值同伦延续的精确鲁棒性认证算法，在度量代数几何与神经网络验证之间建立了具体的联系。
tldr: 将神经网络鲁棒性验证转化为代数优化问题，定义了衡量验证难度的ED度及其判别式，推导了特定结构的解析解，并最终提出了一种基于同伦延续的精确验证方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将鲁棒性验证形式化为一个明确的代数优化问题，并引入了欧氏距离（ED）度作为衡量验证复杂度的指标。其重要性在于提供了一种基于代数几何的精确验证方法。局限性可能在于计算ED判别式和同伦延续方法的实际可扩展性。
motivation: 将神经网络的正式鲁棒性验证问题转化为一个代数优化问题，并寻求一种衡量验证固有复杂性和识别易于/难以验证实例的新方法。
method: 将鲁棒性验证表述为代数优化问题；定义欧氏距离（ED）度作为复杂性度量；定义ED判别式来区分易于或难以验证的测试实例；提出计算该判别式的显式算法；引入参数判别式；推导出特定网络结构的ED度闭式表达式及无限宽度极限下的期望实临界点数；最后，基于数值同伦延续提出精确鲁棒性认证算法。
results: 提出了ED度作为架构依赖的鲁棒性验证复杂性度量；定义并提供了计算ED判别式的算法；引入了参数判别式；推导了特定网络结构的ED度闭式表达式和无限宽度极限下的期望实临界点数公式；并提出了基于数值同伦延续的精确鲁棒性认证算法。
conclusion: 基于数值同伦延续，提出了一种精确的鲁棒性认证算法，从而在度量代数几何与神经网络验证之间建立了具体的联系。

title: Optimal rates for density and mode estimation with expand-and-sparsify representations
authors: Kaushik Sinha, Christopher Tosh
abstract: Expand-and-sparsify representations are a class of theoretical models that capture sparse representation phenomena observed in the sensory systems of many animals. At a high level, these representations map an input $x \in \mathbb{R}^d$ to a much higher dimension $m \gg d$ via random linear projections before zeroing out all but the $k \ll m$ largest entries. The result is a $k$-sparse vector in $\{0,1\}^m$. We study the suitability of this representation for two fundamental statistical problems: density estimation and mode estimation. For density estimation, we show that a simple linear function of the expand-and-sparsify representation produces an estimator with minimax-optimal $\ell_{\infty}$ convergence rates. In mode estimation, we provide simple algorithms on top of our density estimator that recover single or multiple modes at optimal rates up to logarithmic factors under mild conditions.

title: STACodec: Semantic Token Assignment for Balancing Acoustic Fidelity and Semantic Information in Audio Codecs
authors: Kaiyuan Zhang, Mohan Shi, Eray Eren, Natarajan Balaji Shankar, Zilai Wang, Abeer Alwan
abstract: Neural audio codecs are widely used for audio compression and can be integrated into token-based language models. Traditional codecs preserve acoustic details well but lack semantic information. Recent hybrid codecs attempt to incorporate semantic information through distillation, but this often degrades reconstruction performance, making it difficult to achieve both. To address this limitation, we introduce STACodec, a unified codec that integrates semantic information from self-supervised learning (SSL) models into the first layer of residual vector quantization (RVQ-1) via semantic token assignment (STA). To further eliminate reliance on SSL-based semantic tokenizers and improve efficiency during inference, we propose a semantic pre-distillation (SPD) module, which predicts semantic tokens directly for assignment to the first RVQ layer during inference. Experimental results show that STACodec outperforms existing hybrid codecs in both audio reconstruction and downstream semantic tasks, demonstrating a better balance between acoustic fidelity and semantic capability.

title: Inheritance Between Feedforward and Convolutional Networks via Model Projection
authors: Nicolas Ewen, Jairo Diaz-Rodriguez, Kelly Ramsay
abstract: Techniques for feedforward networks (FFNs) and convolutional networks (CNNs) are frequently reused across families, but the relationship between the underlying model classes is rarely made explicit. We introduce a unified node-level formalization with tensor-valued activations and show that generalized feedforward networks form a strict subset of generalized convolutional networks. Motivated by the mismatch in per-input parameterization between the two families, we propose model projection, a parameter-efficient transfer learning method for CNNs that freezes pretrained per-input-channel filters and learns a single scalar gate for each (output channel, input channel) contribution. Projection keeps all convolutional layers adaptable to downstream tasks while substantially reducing the number of trained parameters in convolutional layers. We prove that projected nodes take the generalized FFN form, enabling projected CNNs to inherit feedforward techniques that do not rely on homogeneous layer inputs. Experiments across multiple ImageNet-pretrained backbones and several downstream image classification datasets show that model projection is a strong transfer learning baseline under simple training recipes.

title: Warm Starts, Cold States: Exploiting Adiabaticity for Variational Ground-States
authors: Ricard Puig, Berta Casas, Alba Cervera-Lierta, Zoë Holmes, Adrián Pérez-Salinas
abstract: Reliable preparation of many-body ground states is an essential task in quantum computing, with applications spanning areas from chemistry and materials modeling to quantum optimization and benchmarking. A variety of approaches have been proposed to tackle this problem, including variational methods. However, variational training often struggle to navigate complex energy landscapes, frequently encountering suboptimal local minima or suffering from barren plateaus. In this work, we introduce an iterative strategy for ground-state preparation based on a stepwise (discretized) Hamiltonian deformation. By complementing the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) with adiabatic principles, we demonstrate that solving a sequence of intermediate problems facilitates tracking the ground-state manifold toward the target system, even as we scale the system size. We provide a rigorous theoretical foundation for this approach, proving a lower bound on the loss variance that suggests trainability throughout the deformation, provided the system remains away from gap closings. Numerical simulations, including the effects of shot noise, confirm that this path-dependent tracking consistently converges to the target ground state.
zh_title: 温启动，冷态：利用绝热性进行变分基态制备
translation: 可靠地制备多体基态是量子计算中的一项基本任务，其应用涵盖了从化学和材料模拟到量子优化和基准测试等领域。已经提出了各种方法来解决这个问题，包括变分方法。然而，变分训练通常难以驾驭复杂的能量景观，经常遇到次优的局部最小值或遭受退化高原的影响。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种基于分步（离散化）哈密顿量形变的基态制备的迭代策略。通过用绝热原理补充变分量子本征求解器（VQE），我们证明了求解一系列中间问题有助于跟踪基态流形朝向目标系统，即使在我们扩大系统规模时也是如此。我们为这种方法提供了严格的理论基础，证明了损失方差的下界，这表明只要系统远离能隙关闭，在整个形变过程中训练都是可行的。数值模拟，包括散粒噪声的影响，证实了这种路径依赖的跟踪策略能够一致地收敛到目标基态。
tldr: 为了解决VQE在寻找量子基态时遇到的困难（如局部最优和退化高原），我们引入了一种“温启动、冷态”策略：通过分步改变哈密顿量（模拟绝热演化），迭代地求解一系列更简单的问题，从而可靠地跟踪并找到复杂系统的真实基态。
ai_comments: 该方法的核心创新在于将绝热演化原理与变分量子本征求解器（VQE）相结合，通过分步哈密顿量形变来应对复杂能量景观和退化高原问题，理论上证明了在无能隙关闭的情况下训练的可行性。其重要性在于为可靠地制备多体基态提供了一种新的、更鲁棒的策略。限制在于其有效性可能依赖于系统是否能“远离能隙关闭”，这在某些情况下可能难以保证。
motivation: 传统的变分训练方法在应对复杂的能量景观时常常遇到次优的局部最小值或遭受退化高原的困扰，难以可靠地制备多体基态。
method: 提出了一种基于分步（离散化）哈密顿量形变的迭代策略，通过将绝热原理与变分量子本征求解器（VQE）相结合，求解一系列中间问题来跟踪基态流形。该方法还提供了严格的理论基础，证明了损失方差的下界。
results: 数值模拟（包括散粒噪声的影响）证实了这种路径依赖的跟踪策略能够一致地收敛到目标基态。理论上证明了损失方差的下界，表明在系统远离能隙关闭的情况下，整个形变过程中训练都是可行的。
conclusion: 所提出的基于分步哈密顿量形变的迭代策略，通过将VQE与绝热原理相结合，能够有效地跟踪目标系统的基态流形，并可靠地收敛到目标基态，即使在考虑了量子散粒噪声的情况下也是如此。

title: Content-Driven Frame-Level Bit Prediction for Rate Control in Versatile Video Coding
authors: Amritha Premkumar, Prajit T Rajendran, Vignesh V Menon, Christian Herglotz
abstract: Rate control allocates bits efficiently across frames to meet a target bitrate while maintaining quality. Conventional two-pass rate control (2pRC) in Versatile Video Coding (VVC) relies on analytical rate-QP models, which often fail to capture nonlinear spatial-temporal variations, causing quality instability and high complexity due to multiple trial encodes. This paper proposes a content-adaptive framework that predicts frame-level bit consumption using lightweight features from the Video Complexity Analyzer (VCA) and quantization parameters within a Random Forest regression. On ultra-high-definition sequences encoded with VVenC, the model achieves strong correlation with ground truth, yielding R2 values of 0.93, 0.88, and 0.77 for I-, P-, and B-frames, respectively. Integrated into a rate-control loop, it achieves comparable coding efficiency to 2pRC while reducing total encoding time by 33.3%. The results show that VCA-driven bit prediction provides a computationally efficient and accurate alternative to conventional rate-QP models.
comment: 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS)

title: Time-uniform conformal and PAC prediction
authors: Kayla E. Scharfstein, Arun Kumar Kuchibhotla
abstract: Given that machine learning algorithms are increasingly being deployed to aid in high stakes decision-making, uncertainty quantification methods that wrap around these black box models such as conformal prediction have received much attention in recent years. In sequential settings, where data are observed/generated in a streaming fashion, traditional conformal methods do not provide any guarantee without fixing the sample size. More importantly, traditional conformal methods cannot cope with sequentially updated predictions. As such, we develop an extension of the conformal prediction and related probably approximately correct (PAC) prediction frameworks to sequential settings where the number of data points is not fixed in advance. The resulting prediction sets are anytime-valid in that their expected coverage is at the required level at any time chosen by the analyst even if this choice depends on the data. We present theoretical guarantees for our proposed methods and demonstrate their validity and utility on simulated and real datasets.
zh_title: 时间一致性的共形和PAC预测
translation: 鉴于机器学习算法越来越多地被用于辅助高风险决策，围绕这些黑箱模型的不确定性量化方法（例如共形预测）近年来受到了广泛关注。在数据以流式方式观察/生成的序列设置中，传统的共形方法在不固定样本量的情况下无法提供任何保证。更重要的是，传统的共形方法无法应对顺序更新的预测。因此，我们开发了共形预测和相关的可能近似正确（PAC）预测框架的扩展，使其适用于数据点数量未预先固定的序列设置。由此产生的预测集是“随时有效”（anytime-valid）的，这意味着即使分析师的选择依赖于数据，其预期覆盖率在分析师选择的任何时间点都处于要求的水平。我们为所提出的方法提供了理论保证，并在模拟和真实数据集上证明了它们的有效性和实用性。
tldr: 本文将共形预测（Conformal Prediction）和PAC预测扩展到序列设置，以处理流式数据和不固定的样本量，确保预测集在任何时间点都具有有效的覆盖率（随时有效性）。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于解决了传统共形预测在序列或流式数据设置中的核心限制，即需要固定的样本量。通过引入“随时有效性”（anytime-validity）的概念，该方法保证了在数据持续生成和预测不断更新的环境中，不确定性量化仍然是可靠和理论上有效的。这对于需要实时监控和高风险决策的系统（如金融、医疗）具有重要的实际价值，因为它极大地增强了在动态环境中应用机器学习模型的信任度。
motivation: 鉴于机器学习模型越来越多地用于高风险决策，需要更好的不确定性量化方法。传统的共形预测方法在样本量不固定或需要顺序更新预测的序列设置中缺乏理论保证。
method: 开发了共形预测和PAC预测框架的扩展，使其适用于数据以流式方式生成且数据点数量不预先固定的序列设置。所产生的预测集具有“随时有效性”（anytime-valid）。
results: 提出了所提方法的理论保证。结果表明，即使分析师的选择依赖于数据，这些预测集在分析师选择的任何时间点，其预期覆盖率都能达到要求的水平。并在模拟和真实数据集上验证了其有效性和实用性。
conclusion: 本文成功地为序列设置开发了共形和PAC预测的扩展，使其预测集具有随时有效性，解决了传统方法在流式数据中缺乏保证的问题。

title: Chasing Tails: How Do People Respond to Wait Time Distributions?
authors: Evgeny Kagan, Kyle Hyndman, Andrew Davis
abstract: We use a series of pre-registered, incentive-compatible online experiments to investigate how people evaluate and choose among different waiting time distributions. Our main findings are threefold. First, consistent with prior literature, people show an aversion to both longer expected waits and higher variance. Second, and more surprisingly, moment-based utility models fail to capture preferences when distributions have thick-right tails: indeed, decision-makers strongly prefer distributions with long-right tails (where probability mass is more evenly distributed over a larger support set) relative to tails that exhibit a spike near the maximum possible value, even when controlling for mean, variance, and higher moments. Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) utility models commonly used in portfolio theory predict these choices well. Third, when given a choice, decision-makers overwhelmingly seek information about right-tail outcomes. These results have practical implications for service operations: (1) service designs that create a spike in long waiting times (such as priority or dedicated queue designs) may be particularly aversive; (2) when informativeness is the goal, providers should prioritize sharing right-tail probabilities or percentiles; and (3) to increase service uptake, providers can strategically disclose (or withhold) distributional information depending on right-tail shape.
zh_title: 追逐尾部：人们如何应对等待时间分布？
translation: 我们使用一系列预先注册的、激励兼容的在线实验，来调查人们如何评估和选择不同的等待时间分布。我们的主要发现有三点。首先，与现有文献一致，人们对更长的预期等待时间和更高的方差都表现出厌恶。其次，更令人惊讶的是，当分布具有厚右尾时，基于矩的效用模型无法捕捉人们的偏好：事实上，即使控制了均值、方差和更高阶矩，决策者也强烈偏好具有长右尾（概率质量更均匀地分布在更大的支持集上）的分布，而不是在最大可能值附近表现出尖峰的尾部。投资组合理论中常用的条件风险价值（CVaR）效用模型能很好地预测这些选择。第三，当被给予选择权时，决策者绝大多数会寻求关于右尾结果的信息。这些结果对服务运营具有实际意义：（1）在长等待时间中产生尖峰的服务设计（例如优先或专用队列设计）可能特别令人反感；（2）当目标是信息量时，服务提供者应优先共享右尾概率或百分位数；（3）为了增加服务接受度，提供者可以根据右尾形状策略性地披露（或保留）分布信息。
tldr: 人们评估等待时间分布时，不仅厌恶长均值和高方差，而且强烈偏好长右尾（均匀分布）而非尖峰右尾，CVaR模型能很好地解释这一现象。决策者会积极寻求右尾信息。这些发现对服务运营设计（如避免尖峰等待时间）和信息披露有重要指导意义。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于揭示了在等待时间分布评估中，传统的基于均值和方差的矩模型在处理“厚右尾”分布时的局限性。它提出了一个重要的行为洞察：人们对极端等待时间的分布形态（尖峰 vs. 均匀分散）有着精细且强烈的偏好，并证明了条件风险价值（CVaR）模型在预测这些选择上的优越性。这对服务运营管理具有重要的实践意义，因为它指导了服务提供商如何通过调整队列设计（避免尖峰）和信息披露策略来优化客户体验和提高服务接受度。这项工作将行为决策理论与运营管理实际问题紧密结合。
motivation: 调查人们在评估和选择不同等待时间分布时的行为和偏好。
method: 采用一系列预先注册的、激励兼容的在线实验。利用基于矩的效用模型进行检验，并发现条件风险价值（CVaR）效用模型能更好地预测结果。
results: 1. 人们厌恶更长的预期等待时间和更高的方差。2. 基于矩的效用模型在厚右尾分布下失效，决策者强烈偏好长右尾分布（概率质量更均匀），而非最大值附近有尖峰的尾部。3. 投资组合理论中常用的条件风险价值（CVaR）效用模型能很好地预测这些选择。4. 决策者在选择时绝大多数会寻求关于右尾结果的信息。
conclusion: 研究结果对服务运营有实际意义：应避免产生长等待时间尖峰的服务设计（如优先或专用队列）；服务提供者应优先共享右尾概率或百分位数信息；提供者可以根据右尾形状策略性地披露或保留分布信息以增加服务接受度。

title: Zero-shot Multi-Contrast Brain MRI Registration by Intensity Randomizing T1-weighted MRI (LUMIR25)
authors: Hengjie Liu, Yimeng Dou, Di Xu, Xinyi Fu, Dan Ruan, Ke Sheng
abstract: In this paper, we summarize the methods and results of our submission to the LUMIR25 challenge in Learn2Reg 2025, which achieved 1st place overall on the test set. Extended from LUMIR24, this year's task focuses on zero-shot registration under domain shifts (high-field MRI, pathological brains, and various MRI contrasts), while the training data comprise only in-domain T1-weighted brain MRI. We start with a meticulous analysis of LUMIR24 winners to identify the main contributors to good monomodal registration performance. To achieve good generalization with diverse contrasts from a model trained with T1-weighted MRI only, we employ three simple but effective strategies: (i) a multimodal loss based on the modality-independent neighborhood descriptor (MIND), (ii) intensity randomization for appearance augmentation, and (iii) lightweight instance-specific optimization (ISO) on feature encoders at inference time. On the validation set, our approach achieves reasonable T1-T2 registration accuracy while maintaining good deformation regularity.
comment: Submitted to and reviewed by Learn2Reg MICCAI 2025
zh_title: 基于强度随机化T1加权MRI的零样本多对比度脑部MRI配准 (LUMIR25)
translation: 在本文中，我们总结了我们提交给Learn2Reg 2025的LUMIR25挑战赛的方法和结果，该方法在测试集上取得了总排名第一的成绩。LUMIR25任务在LUMIR24的基础上进行了扩展，侧重于在领域偏移（高场MRI、病理脑和各种MRI对比度）下的零样本配准，而训练数据仅包含域内T1加权脑部MRI。我们首先对LUMIR24的获胜者进行了细致的分析，以确定对良好单模态配准性能的主要贡献因素。为了让仅使用T1加权MRI训练的模型对不同对比度实现良好的泛化，我们采用了三种简单但有效的策略：(i) 基于模态独立邻域描述符（MIND）的多模态损失，(ii) 用于外观增强的强度随机化，以及 (iii) 推理时在特征编码器上进行的轻量级实例特定优化（ISO）。在验证集上，我们的方法实现了合理的T1-T2配准精度，同时保持了良好的形变规律性。
tldr: 该论文总结了其在LUMIR25挑战赛中的方法，该方法通过分析LUMIR24的获胜者并结合MIND损失、强度随机化和轻量级ISO策略，实现了仅使用T1加权MRI训练数据对多种对比度MRI进行零样本配准，并获得了第一名。
ai_comments: 该工作的创新点在于其巧妙地结合了多种策略来解决医学图像配准中的核心难题——跨模态和领域泛化问题。通过使用“强度随机化”作为外观增强手段，解决了训练数据（T1-weighted）与目标数据（多对比度）之间的巨大强度差异。结合MIND损失和推理时的轻量级ISO，确保了模型在零样本设置下的鲁棒性和精度。该方法在竞争激烈的挑战赛中获得第一名，证明了其在实际应用中的高效性和有效性。
motivation: 解决在Learn2Reg 2025的LUMIR25挑战中，仅使用域内T1加权脑部MRI训练数据，实现对高场MRI、病理脑和各种MRI对比度等领域偏移下的零样本配准问题。
method: 首先分析LUMIR24获胜者的方法以确定单模态配准的关键因素。然后采用三种策略实现从T1加权MRI训练的模型到多样对比度的良好泛化：(i) 基于模态独立邻域描述符（MIND）的多模态损失，(ii) 用于外观增强的强度随机化，以及 (iii) 推理时在特征编码器上进行的轻量级实例特定优化（ISO）。
results: 在LUMIR25挑战的测试集上获得了总排名第一。在验证集上，该方法实现了合理的T1-T2配准精度，同时保持了良好的形变规律性。

title: Hybrid-Field Joint Channel and Visible Region Estimation for RIS-Assisted Communications
authors: Xiaokun Tuo, Ming-Min Zhao, Xiang Wang, Changsheng You, Min-Jian Zhao
abstract: In reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted millimeter-wave (mmWave) communication systems, the large-scale RIS introduces pronounced geometric effects that lead to the coexistence of far-field and near-field propagation. Furthermore, random blockages induce spatial non-stationarity across the RIS array, causing signals from different scatterers to illuminate only partial regions, referred to as visible regions (VRs). This renders conventional far-field and fully visible array-based channel models inadequate and makes channel estimation particularly challenging. In this paper, we investigate the non-stationary cascaded channel estimation problem in a hybrid-field propagation environment, where the RIS-base station (BS) link operates in the far-field, while the user-RIS link exhibits near-field characteristics with partial visibility. To address the resulting high-dimensional and coupled estimation problem, a reduced-dimensional sparse bilinear representation is developed by exploiting the structural characteristics of the cascaded channel. In particular, a dictionary compression technique is proposed to represent the high-dimensional coupled dictionary using a low-dimensional polar-domain dictionary weighted by a visibility matrix, thereby significantly reducing the problem scale. Based on this representation, a turbo-structured joint Bayesian estimation (TS-JBE) approach is proposed to simultaneously estimate the channel gains, VRs, and off-grid parameters, thereby avoiding error propagation inherent in existing sequential methods. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves the estimation accuracy compared with existing approaches.
zh_title: 混合场下RIS辅助通信的联合信道与可见区域估计
translation: 在可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的毫米波（mmWave）通信系统中，大规模RIS引入了显著的几何效应，导致远场和近场传播共存。此外，随机阻塞在RIS阵列上引起空间非平稳性，导致来自不同散射体的信号仅照亮部分区域，这些区域被称为可见区域（VRs）。这使得传统的基于远场和完全可见阵列的信道模型不足，并使信道估计尤其具有挑战性。在本文中，我们研究了混合场传播环境中的非平稳级联信道估计问题，其中RIS-基站（BS）链路在远场运行，而用户-RIS链路表现出具有部分可见性的近场特性。为了解决由此产生的高维耦合估计问题，我们利用级联信道的结构特征，开发了一种降维稀疏双线性表示。特别是，提出了一种字典压缩技术，通过可见性矩阵加权的低维极坐标域字典来表示高维耦合字典，从而显著缩小了问题规模。基于此表示，提出了一种涡轮结构联合贝叶斯估计（TS-JBE）方法，以同时估计信道增益、可见区域和非网格参数，从而避免了现有顺序方法中固有的误差传播。仿真结果表明，所提出的方法比现有方法显著提高了估计精度。
tldr: 针对大规模RIS辅助通信中的混合场和部分可见性问题，提出了一种基于字典压缩和涡轮结构联合贝叶斯估计（TS-JBE）的方法，以同时准确估计信道和可见区域。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于同时解决了大规模RIS系统中复杂的“混合场”（远场/近场）传播和“空间非平稳性”（部分可见区域）问题，这对于RIS的实际部署至关重要。通过提出字典压缩技术将高维估计问题降维，并设计涡轮结构联合贝贝叶斯估计（TS-JBE）方法来同步估计所有关键参数，有效避免了传统顺序方法中的误差传播，显著提高了信道估计的可行性和准确性。
motivation: 传统的远场和完全可见阵列信道模型不适用于存在大规模RIS、随机阻塞导致的混合场传播和空间非平稳性（部分可见区域）的毫米波通信系统，使得信道估计极具挑战性。本文旨在解决混合场（RIS-BS为远场，用户-RIS为近场且部分可见）环境中的非平稳级联信道估计问题。
method: 利用级联信道的结构特征，开发了一种降维稀疏双线性表示。提出了一种字典压缩技术，通过可见性矩阵加权的低维极坐标域字典来表示高维耦合字典，从而显著缩小问题规模。基于此表示，提出了一种涡轮结构联合贝叶斯估计（TS-JBE）方法，用于同步估计信道增益、可见区域和非网格参数。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方法比现有方法显著提高了估计精度。
conclusion: 所提出的TS-JBE方法通过同步估计信道增益、可见区域和非网格参数，避免了现有顺序方法固有的误差传播，显著提高了混合场下非平稳级联信道的估计精度。

title: AS-Mamba: Asymmetric Self-Guided Mamba Decoupled Iterative Network for Metal Artifact Reduction
authors: Bowen Ning, Zekun Zhou, Xinyi Zhong, Zhongzhen Wang, HongXin Wu, HaiTao Wang, Liu Shi, Qiegen Liu
abstract: Metal artifact significantly degrades Computed Tomography (CT) image quality, impeding accurate clinical diagnosis. However, existing deep learning approaches, such as CNN and Transformer, often fail to explicitly capture the directional geometric features of artifacts, leading to compromised structural restoration. To address these limitations, we propose the Asymmetric Self-Guided Mamba (AS-Mamba) for metal artifact reduction. Specifically, the linear propagation of metal-induced streak artifacts aligns well with the sequential modeling capability of State Space Models (SSMs). Consequently, the Mamba architecture is leveraged to explicitly capture and suppress these directional artifacts. Simultaneously, a frequency domain correction mechanism is incorporated to rectify the global amplitude spectrum, thereby mitigating intensity inhomogeneity caused by beam hardening. Furthermore, to bridge the distribution gap across diverse clinical scenarios, we introduce a self-guided contrastive regularization strategy. Extensive experiments on public andclinical dental CBCT datasets demonstrate that AS-Mamba achieves superior performance in suppressing directional streaks and preserving structural details, validating the effectiveness of integrating physical geometric priors into deep network design.
zh_title: AS-Mamba：用于金属伪影去除的非对称自引导 Mamba 解耦迭代网络
translation: 金属伪影会显著降低计算机断层扫描（CT）图像质量，阻碍准确的临床诊断。然而，现有的深度学习方法，如 CNN 和 Transformer，通常无法明确捕获伪影的定向几何特征，导致结构恢复受损。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了非对称自引导 Mamba（AS-Mamba）用于金属伪影去除。具体来说，金属引起的条纹伪影的线性传播与状态空间模型（SSM）的序列建模能力非常吻合。因此，我们利用 Mamba 架构来明确捕获和抑制这些定向伪影。同时，引入了频域校正机制来校正全局幅度谱，从而减轻束硬化引起的强度不均匀性。此外，为了弥合不同临床场景下的分布差距，我们引入了自引导对比正则化策略。在公共和临床牙科 CBCT 数据集上的大量实验表明，AS-Mamba 在抑制定向条纹和保留结构细节方面取得了卓越的性能，验证了将物理几何先验知识整合到深度网络设计中的有效性。
tldr: 我们提出了 AS-Mamba，它利用 Mamba 架构显式建模和抑制定向金属条纹伪影，并结合了频域校正和自引导正则化，以实现卓越的 CT 伪影去除效果。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将以高效序列建模著称的新型 Mamba 架构应用于金属条纹伪影（线性传播）的特定物理几何特征。与标准的 2D 卷积或基于注意力机制的模型相比，这种将强大的序列模型与物理先验知识（几何和频域校正）相结合的方法对于改进伪影抑制至关重要。此外，引入自引导对比正则化策略有助于模型更好地适应多样化的临床数据分布，提升了其实用性。
motivation: 金属伪影严重降低了计算机断层扫描（CT）图像质量，并阻碍了准确的临床诊断。现有的深度学习方法（如 CNN 和 Transformer）未能明确捕获伪影的定向几何特征，导致结构恢复受损。
method: 提出了 AS-Mamba 网络。它利用 Mamba 架构（SSM）的序列建模能力来显式捕获和抑制与线性传播相符的定向条纹伪影。同时，它结合了频域校正机制来校正全局幅度谱，以减轻束硬化引起的强度不均匀性。此外，该方法还引入了自引导对比正则化策略，以弥合不同临床场景下的分布差距。
results: 在公共和临床牙科 CBCT 数据集上的大量实验表明，AS-Mamba 在抑制定向条纹和保留结构细节方面取得了卓越的性能。
conclusion: 验证了将物理几何先验知识整合到深度网络设计中进行金属伪影去除的有效性。

title: High-Dimensional Limit of Stochastic Gradient Flow via Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
authors: Sota Nishiyama, Masaaki Imaizumi
abstract: Modern machine learning models are typically trained via multi-pass stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with small batch sizes, and understanding their dynamics in high dimensions is of great interest. However, an analytical framework for describing the high-dimensional asymptotic behavior of multi-pass SGD with small batch sizes for nonlinear models is currently missing. In this study, we address this gap by analyzing the high-dimensional dynamics of a stochastic differential equation called a \emph{stochastic gradient flow} (SGF), which approximates multi-pass SGD in this regime. In the limit where the number of data samples $n$ and the dimension $d$ grow proportionally, we derive a closed system of low-dimensional and continuous-time equations and prove that it characterizes the asymptotic distribution of the SGF parameters. Our theory is based on the dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) and is applicable to a wide range of models encompassing generalized linear models and two-layer neural networks. We further show that the resulting DMFT equations recover several existing high-dimensional descriptions of SGD dynamics as special cases, thereby providing a unifying perspective on prior frameworks such as online SGD and high-dimensional linear regression. Our proof builds on the existing DMFT technique for gradient flow and extends it to handle the stochasticity in SGF using tools from stochastic calculus.
zh_title: 随机梯度流的动态平均场理论高维极限
translation: 现代机器学习模型通常通过小批量、多轮次随机梯度下降（SGD）进行训练，理解它们在高维中的动力学行为具有重要意义。然而，目前缺乏一个分析框架来描述非线性模型中小批量、多轮次SGD的高维渐近行为。在本研究中，我们通过分析随机微分方程——随机梯度流（SGF）的高维动力学来弥补这一空白，SGF在该机制下近似于多轮次SGD。在数据样本数 $n$ 和维度 $d$ 成比例增长的极限下，我们推导出了一个封闭的低维、连续时间方程系统，并证明了它刻画了SGF参数的渐近分布。我们的理论基于动态平均场理论（DMFT），适用于包括广义线性模型和两层神经网络在内的多种模型。我们进一步证明，由此产生的DMFT方程作为特例恢复了现有的几种高维SGD动力学描述，从而为在线SGD和高维线性回归等现有框架提供了一个统一的视角。我们的证明建立在现有的针对梯度流的DMFT技术之上，并利用随机微积分工具将其扩展以处理SGF中的随机性。
tldr: 通过动态平均场理论（DMFT），本文推导了随机梯度流（SGF，一种多轮次小批量SGD的近似）在高维极限下的低维、连续时间动力学方程，并证明该方程可以统一描述现有多种高维SGD框架。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新在于将动态平均场理论（DMFT）扩展到处理随机梯度流（SGF）的随机性，从而为描述高维、小批量、多轮次随机梯度下降（SGD）的动力学提供了一个缺失的分析框架。通过推导出低维、连续时间的方程，它极大地简化了复杂的高维动力学分析。其重要性在于提供了一个统一的理论基础，能够将先前分散的在线SGD和高维线性回归等高维描述整合起来，显著推进了对现代机器学习模型训练过程的理论理解。
motivation: 现代机器学习模型通常使用多轮次、小批量随机梯度下降（SGD）进行训练，但目前缺乏一个分析框架来描述非线性模型中，小批量多轮次SGD在高维下的渐近行为。
method: 通过分析随机微分方程——随机梯度流（SGF，它近似于多轮次、小批量SGD）的高维动力学来解决问题。在数据样本数 $n$ 和维度 $d$ 成比例增长的极限下，利用动态平均场理论（DMFT）和随机微积分工具，推导并证明了一个封闭的低维、连续时间方程系统。
results: 导出的低维、连续时间方程系统描述了SGF参数的渐近分布。该理论适用于广义线性模型和两层神经网络等多种模型，并且其DMFT方程可以作为特例恢复现有的多种高维SGD描述（如在线SGD和高维线性回归），提供了一个统一的视角。

title: HyQuRP: Hybrid quantum-classical neural network with rotational and permutational equivariance for 3D point clouds
authors: Semin Park, Chae-Yeun Park
abstract: We introduce HyQuRP, a hybrid quantum-classical neural network equivariant to rotational and permutational symmetries. While existing equivariant quantum machine learning models often rely on ad hoc constructions, HyQuRP is built upon the formal foundations of group representation theory. In the sparse-point regime, HyQuRP consistently outperforms strong classical and quantum baselines across multiple benchmarks. For example, when six subsampled points are used, HyQuRP ($\sim$1.5K parameters) achieves 76.13% accuracy on the 5-class ModelNet benchmark, compared to approximately 71% for PointNet, PointMamba, and PointTransformer with similar parameter counts. These results highlight HyQuRP's exceptional data efficiency and suggest the potential of quantum machine learning models for processing 3D point cloud data.
zh_title: HyQuRP：具有旋转和置换等变性的混合量子-经典神经网络，用于3D点云
translation: 我们引入了HyQuRP，这是一种对旋转和置换对称性等变的混合量子-经典神经网络。虽然现有的等变量子机器学习模型通常依赖于临时（ad hoc）的构建，但HyQuRP建立在群表示论的正式基础之上。在稀疏点体制下，HyQuRP在多个基准测试中持续优于强大的经典和量子基线。例如，当使用六个子采样点时，HyQuRP（约1.5K参数）在5类ModelNet基准测试中实现了76.13%的准确率，相比之下，具有相似参数量的PointNet、PointMamba和PointTransformer约为71%。这些结果突显了HyQuRP卓越的数据效率，并暗示了量子机器学习模型在处理3D点云数据方面的潜力。
keywords: 混合量子-经典神经网络
tldr: HyQuRP是一种等变混合量子-经典网络，基于群表示论。在稀疏3D点云处理中，它以极少参数显著超越经典和量子基线，数据效率高。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将群表示论这一正式基础应用于混合量子-经典网络（HyQuRP），确保了对3D点云的旋转和置换等变性，从而克服了现有等变量子模型构建的临时性。其重要性在于，HyQuRP在稀疏点体制下展示出卓越的数据效率和更高的准确率（参数量相似的情况下，准确率显著高于PointNet等经典模型），这对于数据获取受限的3D点云应用具有重要意义。摘要主要关注稀疏点情况，其在密集点云上的表现未提及。
motivation: 现有的等变量子机器学习模型通常依赖于临时（ad hoc）构建。本文的动机是基于群表示论的正式基础，开发一种对3D点云具有高效率和等变性的混合量子-经典网络。
method: 引入HyQuRP，一种混合量子-经典神经网络。其方法论基础是利用群表示论的正式基础来构建模型，从而实现对旋转和置换的等变性。
results: 在稀疏点体制下，HyQuRP持续优于强大的经典和量子基线。例如，在使用6个子采样点进行5类ModelNet基准测试时，HyQuRP（参数量约1.5K）达到76.13%的准确率，而参数量相似的PointNet、PointMamba和PointTransformer约为71%。
conclusion: HyQuRP展示了卓越的数据效率，并暗示了量子机器学习模型在处理3D点云数据方面的巨大潜力。

title: A Multiplicative Neural Network Architecture: Locality and Regularity of Appriximation
authors: Hee-Sun Choi, Beom-Seok Han
abstract:
We introduce a multiplicative neural network architecture in which multiplicative interactions constitute the fundamental representation, rather than appearing as auxiliary components within an additive model. We establish a universal approximation theorem for this architecture and analyze its approximation properties in terms of locality and regularity in Bessel potential spaces.
  To complement the theoretical results, we conduct numerical experiments on representative targets exhibiting sharp transition layers or pointwise loss of higher-order regularity. The experiments focus on the spatial structure of approximation errors and on regularity-sensitive quantities, in particular the convergence of Zygmund-type seminorms. The results show that the proposed multiplicative architecture yields residual error structures that are more tightly aligned with regions of reduced regularity and exhibits more stable convergence in regularity-sensitive metrics.
  These results demonstrate that adopting a multiplicative representation format has concrete implications for the localization and regularity behavior of neural network approximations, providing a direct connection between architectural design and analytical properties of the approximating functions.
zh_title: 乘性神经网络架构：逼近的局部性和正则性
translation: 我们引入了一种乘性神经网络架构，其中乘性交互作用构成了基本表示，而不是作为加性模型中的辅助组件出现。我们为这种架构建立了通用逼近定理，并从Bessel势空间中的局部性和正则性方面分析了其逼近性质。为了补充理论结果，我们对表现出尖锐过渡层或高阶正则性点式损失的代表性目标进行了数值实验。实验侧重于逼近误差的空间结构以及正则性敏感量，特别是Zygmund型半范数的收敛性。结果表明，所提出的乘性架构产生的残余误差结构与正则性降低的区域更紧密地对齐，并在正则性敏感指标中表现出更稳定的收敛性。这些结果表明，采用乘性表示格式对神经网络逼近的局部化和正则性行为具有具体影响，从而在架构设计和逼近函数的分析特性之间提供了直接联系。
tldr: 本文提出了一种以乘法为核心的神经网络架构；它证明了通用逼近能力，并在误差定位和正则性敏感指标的稳定收敛方面优于传统模型。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将神经网络的基本表示从传统的加性模型转变为乘性交互作用。这一转变具有重要意义，因为它直接影响了神经网络逼近误差的分布方式。结果表明，架构格式的改变（乘性而非加性）可以显著改善误差的局部化，尤其是在处理具有尖锐过渡层或局部正则性损失的目标函数时。这为设计更适合逼近复杂正则性结构函数的神经网络提供了新的理论和实践方向。
motivation: 引入一种以乘性交互作用为基本表示的神经网络架构，而非传统的加性模型，并研究其对神经网络逼近的局部性和正则性行为的具体影响。
method: 建立该架构的通用逼近定理；在Bessel势空间中分析其逼近的局部性和正则性；通过数值实验，重点考察逼近误差的空间结构和正则性敏感量（如Zygmund型半范数的收敛性）。
results: 提出的乘性架构产生的残余误差结构与正则性降低的区域更紧密地对齐；在正则性敏感指标（如Zygmund型半范数）中表现出更稳定的收敛性。
conclusion: 采用乘性表示格式对神经网络逼近的局部化和正则性行为具有具体影响，从而建立了架构设计与逼近函数分析特性之间的直接联系。

title: ARIS-RSMA Enhanced ISAC System: Joint Rate Splitting and Beamforming Design
authors: Xin Jin, Tiejun Lv, Yashuai Cao, Jie Zeng, Mugen Peng
abstract: This letter proposes an active reconfigurable intelligent surface (ARIS) assisted rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) system to overcome the fairness bottleneck in multi-target sensing under obstructed line-of-sight environments. Beamforming at the transceiver and ARIS, along with rate splitting, are optimized to maximize the minimum multi-target echo signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio under multi-user rate and power constraints. The intricate non-convex problem is decoupled into three subproblems and solved iteratively by majorization-minimization (MM) and sequential rank-one constraint relaxation (SROCR) algorithms. Simulations show our scheme outperforms nonorthogonal multiple access, space-division multiple access, and passive RIS baselines, approaching sensing-only upper bounds.
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, accepted by IEEE Wireless Communications Letters
zh_title: ARIS-RSMA 增强型 ISAC 系统：联合速率分裂与波束成形设计
translation: 本文提出了一种有源可重构智能表面（ARIS）辅助的速率分裂多址（RSMA）集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统，以克服视线受阻环境下多目标感知中的公平性瓶颈。对收发器和 ARIS 处的波束成形以及速率分裂进行优化，以在多用户速率和功率约束下，最大化最小多目标回波信噪比（SINR）。这个复杂的非凸问题被解耦为三个子问题，并通过大化小（MM）和序列秩一约束松弛（SROCR）算法迭代求解。仿真结果表明，我们的方案优于非正交多址、空分多址和无源 RIS 基线，接近仅感知系统的性能上限。
tldr: 提出并优化了 ARIS-RSMA 增强的 ISAC 系统，通过联合设计速率分裂和波束成形，最大化多目标感知的最小信噪比，性能显著优于现有技术。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将有源可重构智能表面（ARIS）与速率分裂多址（RSMA）集成到 ISAC 系统中，旨在提高感知公平性。采用联合速率分裂和波束成形设计，并通过先进的迭代优化算法（MM和SROCR）求解复杂的非凸问题，确保了系统在视线受阻环境下的高效运行和公平性。
motivation: 解决在视线受阻环境中多目标感知中的公平性瓶颈问题。
method: 提出 ARIS 辅助的 RSMA ISAC 系统。目标是在多用户速率和功率约束下，最大化最小多目标回波信噪比。采用 MM（大化小）和 SROCR（序列秩一约束松弛）算法，将复杂的非凸问题解耦为三个子问题并迭代求解。
results: 所提方案的性能优于非正交多址（NOMA）、空分多址（SDMA）和无源 RIS 基线，且接近仅感知系统的性能上限。
conclusion: 通过联合优化 ARIS、速率分裂和波束成形，有效解决了视线受阻环境下的感知公平性问题，并显著提升了 ISAC 系统的性能。

title: Single- and Multi-Level Fourier-RQMC Methods for Multivariate Shortfall Risk
authors: Chiheb Ben Hammouda, Truong Ngoc Nguyen
abstract:
Multivariate shortfall risk measures provide a principled framework for quantifying systemic risk and determining capital allocations prior to aggregation in interconnected financial systems. Despite their well established theoretical properties, the numerical estimation of multivariate shortfall risk and the corresponding optimal allocations remains computationally challenging, as existing Monte Carlo based approaches can be numerically expensive due to slow convergence.
  In this work, we develop a new class of single and multilevel numerical algorithms for estimating multivariate shortfall risk and the associated optimal allocations, based on a combination of Fourier inversion techniques and randomized quasi Monte Carlo (RQMC) sampling. Rather than operating in physical space, our approach evaluates the relevant expectations appearing in the risk constraint and its optimization in the frequency domain, where the integrands exhibit enhanced smoothness properties that are well suited for RQMC integration. We establish a rigorous mathematical framework for the resulting Fourier RQMC estimators, including convergence analysis and computational complexity bounds. Beyond the single level method, we introduce a multilevel RQMC scheme that exploits the geometric convergence of the underlying deterministic optimization algorithm to reduce computational cost while preserving accuracy.
  Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Fourier RQMC methods outperform sample average approximation and stochastic optimization benchmarks in terms of accuracy and computational cost across a range of models for the risk factors and loss structures. Consistent with the theoretical analysis, these results demonstrate improved asymptotic convergence and complexity rates relative to the benchmark methods, with additional savings achieved through the proposed multilevel RQMC construction.
zh_title: 单层和多层傅里叶-随机准蒙特卡洛方法用于多元短缺风险
translation: 多元短缺风险度量提供了一个原则性的框架，用于量化系统性风险并在互联金融系统中聚合之前确定资本分配。尽管它们具有公认的理论特性，但多元短缺风险及其相应最优分配的数值估计仍然具有计算挑战性，因为现有的基于蒙特卡洛的方法由于收敛缓慢而可能在数值上非常昂贵。在这项工作中，我们开发了一类新的单层和多层数值算法，用于估计多元短缺风险及其相关的最优分配，该算法基于傅里叶反演技术和随机准蒙特卡洛（RQMC）采样的结合。我们的方法不是在物理空间中操作，而是在频域中评估出现在风险约束及其优化中的相关期望，其中被积函数表现出增强的平滑特性，非常适合RQMC积分。我们为由此产生的傅里叶-RQMC估计器建立了一个严格的数学框架，包括收敛性分析和计算复杂性界限。除了单层方法之外，我们还引入了一个多层RQMC方案，该方案利用底层确定性优化算法的几何收敛性来降低计算成本，同时保持精度。数值实验表明，在各种风险因素和损失结构模型中，所提出的傅里叶-RQMC方法在准确性和计算成本方面优于样本平均近似和随机优化基准。与理论分析一致，这些结果表明相对于基准方法，渐近收敛性和复杂性率有所提高，并且通过所提出的多层RQMC构造实现了额外的节省。
tldr: 开发了基于傅里叶反演和随机准蒙特卡洛（RQMC）的新型单层和多层算法，用于高效估计多元短缺风险及其最优分配，显著优于现有基准方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将多元短缺风险估计从物理空间转移到频域，通过傅里叶反演技术显著增强了被积函数的平滑性。这种平滑性使得随机准蒙特卡洛（RQMC）方法能够发挥其优势，从而在收敛性和计算复杂性方面实现了对传统蒙特卡洛方法的重大改进。此外，引入的多层结构进一步优化了计算效率。这一方法对于金融领域系统性风险量化和资本分配的实际应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 多元短缺风险及其最优分配的数值估计具有挑战性，因为现有的基于蒙特卡洛的方法收敛速度慢，计算成本高。
method: 提出了一类新的单层和多层数值算法，结合了傅里叶反演技术和随机准蒙特卡洛（RQMC）采样。该方法在频域中评估期望，利用了RQMC积分所需的平滑特性。多层方案则利用了底层确定性优化算法的几何收敛性来降低计算成本。
results: 提出的傅里叶-RQMC方法在准确性和计算成本方面优于样本平均近似法和随机优化基准方法。结果表明，相对于基准方法，该方法具有改进的渐近收敛性和复杂性，且多层RQMC结构实现了额外的成本节约。
conclusion: 提出的单层和多层傅里叶-RQMC方法为量化和分配互联金融系统中的多元短缺风险提供了一个计算上更高效、更准确的数值框架。

title: Impact of seed node position on network robustness under localized attacks
authors: Masaki Chujyo, Shu Liu, Fujio Toriumi
abstract: Localized attacks (LAs), where damage propagates from a single seed node to its neighbors, pose significant threats to the robustness of complex networks. Although previous studies have extensively analyzed network vulnerability under such attacks, they typically assume random seed node placement and evaluate average robustness. However, the structural position of the seed node can significantly impact the extent of damage. This study proposes the Localized Attack Vulnerability Index (LAVI), a node-level metric that quantifies the potential impact of a LA initiated at a specific node. LAVI quantifies the cumulative number of severed links during attack progression, capturing how local connectivity and topological position amplify the resulting damage. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world networks demonstrate that LAVI correlates more strongly with network robustness degradation than standard centrality measures, such as degree, closeness, and betweenness. Our findings highlight that classical centrality metrics fail to capture key dynamics of spatially localized failures, while LAVI provides an accurate and generalizable indicator of node vulnerability under such disruptions.
zh_title: 种子节点位置对局部攻击下网络鲁棒性的影响
translation: 局部攻击（LAs）——即损害从单个种子节点传播到其邻居的攻击——对复杂网络的鲁棒性构成了重大威胁。尽管先前的研究已经广泛分析了此类攻击下的网络脆弱性，但它们通常假设种子节点的随机放置并评估平均鲁棒性。然而，种子节点的结构位置可以显著影响损害的程度。本研究提出了局部攻击脆弱性指数（LAVI），这是一个节点级别的指标，用于量化从特定节点发起的局部攻击的潜在影响。LAVI量化了攻击进展过程中被切断链接的累积数量，捕捉了局部连接性和拓扑位置如何放大由此产生的损害。在合成网络和真实网络上的数值实验表明，LAVI与网络鲁棒性下降的相关性比标准中心性度量（如度、接近度和中介性）更强。我们的发现强调，传统的中心性指标未能捕捉空间局部故障的关键动态，而LAVI提供了一个准确且可泛化的指标，用于衡量节点在此类中断下的脆弱性。
tldr: 局部攻击中，种子节点的位置极大地影响网络受损程度。本研究提出了局部攻击脆弱性指数（LAVI），该指标比传统中心性指标能更准确地预测节点在局部攻击下的脆弱性及网络鲁棒性下降情况。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于提出了一个专门针对局部攻击特性的节点脆弱性指标（LAVI），有效地弥补了传统中心性指标在处理空间局部故障时的不足。在网络安全和弹性设计领域，确定最危险的攻击起始点至关重要。LAVI的提出为网络防御策略提供了更精确的指导，使其能够更有效地识别和保护潜在的关键种子节点，从而提高整体网络鲁棒性。其重要性在于将对网络脆弱性的评估从平均/随机层面提升到了结构/定位层面。
motivation: 局部攻击（LAs）对复杂网络的鲁棒性构成重大威胁。以往研究通常假设随机放置种子节点并评估平均鲁棒性，但种子节点的结构位置可以显著影响损害程度。因此，需要一个能更好地量化特定节点发起局部攻击的潜在影响的指标。
method: 提出了“局部攻击脆弱性指数”（LAVI），这是一个节点级别的度量指标。LAVI通过量化攻击传播过程中被切断链接的累积数量来衡量潜在损害，捕捉局部连接性和拓扑位置对损害的放大作用。
results: 在合成网络和真实网络上的数值实验表明，LAVI与网络鲁棒性下降的相关性比传统的中心性度量（如度、接近度和中介性）更强。
conclusion: 传统的中心性指标未能捕捉空间局部故障的关键动态，而LAVI提供了一个准确且可泛化的指标，用于衡量节点在此类中断下的脆弱性。

title: Constructing Koszul filtrations: existence and non-existence for G-quadratic algebras
authors: Emily Berghofer, Lisa Nicklasson, Peder Thompson, Thomas Westerbäck
abstract: Given a standard graded algebra over a field, we consider the relationship between G-quadraticity and the existence of a Koszul filtration. We show that having a quadratic Gröbner basis implies the existence of a Koszul filtration for toric algebras equipped with the degree reverse lexicographic term order and for algebras defined by binomial edge ideals. We also resolve a conjecture of Ene, Herzog, and Hibi by constructing an example where this implication fails. These results are underpinned by algorithms we develop for constructing Koszul filtrations. We also demonstrate the utility of these algorithms on the pinched Veronese algebra.
zh_title: 构建 Koszul 过滤：G-二次代数的存在性与非存在性
translation: 给定一个域上的标准分次代数，我们考虑 G-二次性与 Koszul 过滤存在性之间的关系。我们证明了对于配备度逆字典序项序的环面代数和由二项式边理想定义的代数，拥有二次 Gröbner 基意味着 Koszul 过滤的存在。我们还通过构造一个反例，解决了 Ene, Herzog, 和 Hibi 的一个猜想，证明了这种蕴含关系可能失效。这些结果以我们开发的用于构造 Koszul 过滤的算法为基础。我们还展示了这些算法在收缩 Veronese 代数（pinched Veronese algebra）上的实用性。
tldr: 本文研究了 G-二次性与 Koszul 过滤存在性的关系，证明了对于特定代数，二次 Gröbner 基意味着 Koszul 过滤的存在。同时，通过构造反例，解决了 Ene, Herzog, 和 Hibi 的一个猜想。这些发现基于作者开发的新算法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于系统地研究了 G-二次性这一代数性质与 Koszul 过滤这一同调性质之间的深刻联系。通过提供一系列肯定的结果（针对特定代数，如带度逆字典序的环面代数和二项式边理想代数）和否定的反例（解决了一个重要猜想），作者为该领域提供了更清晰的边界。此外，开发出实用的 Koszul 过滤构造算法，并将其应用于具体的代数（如收缩 Veronese 代数），这表明该工作不仅具有理论价值，还具有计算和应用潜力，对于计算代数几何和同调代数的研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 探究标准分次代数中 G-二次性与 Koszul 过滤存在性之间的关系。
method: 1. 理论上研究 G-二次性与 Koszul 过滤存在性的关系。2. 开发用于构造 Koszul 过滤的算法。3. 应用算法于特定的代数（如收缩 Veronese 代数）并提供证明和反例。
results: 1. 证明了对于配备度逆字典序项序的环面代数和由二项式边理想定义的代数，拥有二次 Gröbner 基意味着 Koszul 过滤的存在。2. 通过构造反例，解决了 Ene, Herzog, 和 Hibi 关于 G-二次性蕴含 Koszul 过滤存在的猜想。3. 演示了所开发算法在收缩 Veronese 代数上的实用性。

title: Quickly excluding an annotated graph
authors: Maximilian Gorsky, Evangelos Protopapas, Sebastian Wiederrecht
abstract:
We provide proofs certifying that the structure theorem for vertex sets of bounded bidimensionality holds with polynomial bounds. The bidimensionality of vertex sets is a common generalisation of both treewidth and the face-cover-number of vertex sets in planar graphs. As such, it plays a crucial role in extensions of Courcelle's Theorem to $H$-minor-free graphs. Recently, bidimensionality and similar parameters have emerged as key for extensions of known parameterized algorithms for problems defined on a terminal set $R$. A prominent example for such a problem is Steiner Tree, which admits efficient algorithms on planar graphs whenever $R$ can be covered with few faces.
  Key to the algorithmic applications of bidimensionality is a structure theorem that explains how a graph $G$ can be decomposed into pieces where the behaviour of $R$ is highly controlled. One may see this structure theorem as a rooted analogue of Robertson and Seymour's celebrated Grid Theorem. Combining recent advances in obtaining polynomial bounds in the Graph Minors framework with new techniques for handling annotated vertex sets, we show that all parameters in the structure theorem above admit polynomial bounds. As an application, we also provide a sketch showing how our techniques imply polynomial bounds for the structure theorem for graphs excluding an apex minor.
translation: 我们提供了证明，证实了有界双维度顶点集的结构定理以多项式界限成立。顶点集的双维度性是树宽和平面图中顶点集面覆盖数的常见推广。因此，它在将Courcelle定理扩展到排除$H$-子式的图方面起着至关重要的作用。最近，双维度性和类似参数已成为将已知参数化算法扩展到定义在终端集$R$上的问题的关键。一个突出的例子是Steiner Tree问题，当$R$可以用少量面覆盖时，该问题在平面图上允许高效算法。双维度性算法应用的关键是一个结构定理，该定理解释了图$G$如何分解成$R$的行为高度受控的片段。人们可以将此结构定理视为Robertson和Seymour著名的网格定理的根植模拟。结合图子式框架中获取多项式界限的最新进展和处理带标注顶点集的新技术，我们证明了上述结构定理中的所有参数都具有多项式界限。作为一个应用，我们还提供了一个草图，展示了我们的技术如何暗示排除尖点子式的图的结构定理也具有多项式界限。
tldr: 证明了有界双维度结构定理的参数具有多项式界限，这是图子式理论和参数化算法的关键进展，改进了结果的实用性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的重要性在于，它将图子式理论中的关键结构定理（有界双维度顶点集结构定理）的界限从可能巨大的非多项式函数改进为多项式界限。在理论计算机科学中，Robertson和Seymour的结构定理通常具有极高的复杂性，使得它们在实践中难以应用。实现多项式界限是理论走向实用化的重要一步，尤其对于基于双维度性的参数化算法（如Steiner Tree）的效率提升具有关键推动作用。该工作结合了图子式框架的最新成果与处理标注集的新技术，是一项重要的技术性突破。
motivation: 证明有界双维度顶点集结构定理的参数具有多项式界限，这对将Courcelle定理扩展到排除$H$-子式的图以及带终端集$R$的参数化算法至关重要。
method: 结合图子式框架中获取多项式界限的最新进展，以及处理带标注顶点集的新技术。
results: 证明了有界双维度顶点集的结构定理以多项式界限成立，且结构定理中的所有参数都具有多项式界限。
conclusion: 成功证明了有界双维度顶点集结构定理的参数具有多项式界限，并将其应用于证明排除尖点子式的图的结构定理也具有多项式界限。

title: Algebraic Reduction to Improve an Optimally Bounded Quantum State Preparation Algorithm
authors: Giacomo Belli, Michele Amoretti
abstract: The preparation of $n$-qubit quantum states is a cross-cutting subroutine for many quantum algorithms, and the effort to reduce its circuit complexity is a significant challenge. In the literature, the quantum state preparation algorithm by Sun et al. is known to be optimally bounded, defining the asymptotically optimal width-depth trade-off bounds with and without ancillary qubits. In this work, a simpler algebraic decomposition is proposed to separate the preparation of the real part of the desired state from the complex one, resulting in a reduction in terms of circuit depth, total gates, and CNOT count when $m$ ancillary qubits are available. The reduction in complexity is due to the use of a single operator $Λ$ for each uniformly controlled gate, instead of the three in the original decomposition. Using the PennyLane library, this new algorithm for state preparation has been implemented and tested in a simulated environment for both dense and sparse quantum states, including those that are random and of physical interest. Furthermore, its performance has been compared with that of Möttönen et al.'s algorithm, which is a de facto standard for preparing quantum states in cases where no ancillary qubits are used, highlighting interesting lines of development.
zh_title: 采用代数约简改进最优有界量子态制备算法
translation: $n$ 量子比特量子态的制备是许多量子算法的交叉子程序，减少其电路复杂度的努力是一个重大挑战。在现有文献中，Sun 等人的量子态制备算法被认为是最优有界的，它定义了在使用和不使用辅助量子比特情况下的渐近最优宽度-深度权衡界限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种更简单的代数分解方法，用于将所需量子态的实部制备与复部制备分离，从而在使用 $m$ 个辅助量子比特时，减少了电路深度、总门数和 CNOT 门数量。复杂度的降低归因于对每个均匀受控门使用了单个运算符 $\Lambda$，而不是原始分解中的三个。使用 PennyLane 库，这种新的量子态制备算法已在模拟环境中实现和测试，适用于密集和稀疏量子态，包括随机态和具有物理兴趣的量子态。此外，它的性能已与 Möttönen 等人的算法（在不使用辅助量子比特的情况下，该算法是量子态制备的事实标准）进行了比较，突出了有趣的发展方向。
tldr: 本文提出了一种简化的代数分解方法，用于改进 Sun 等人提出的最优有界量子态制备算法。该方法通过分离实部和复部，在使用辅助量子比特时，能有效减少电路深度、总门数和 CNOT 门数量。实验结果显示了性能提升，并与标准算法进行了比较。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于为Sun等人的最优有界量子态制备算法提供了一个更简单的代数分解。通过将每个均匀受控门所需的运算符数量从三个减少到一个，该方法在使用辅助量子比特时，显著降低了电路深度、总门数和CNOT门数量。这对于量子计算中的核心子程序——量子态制备——提供了一条更高效的实现路径，具有重要的实际意义。其重要性在于，它在保持算法渐近最优界限的基础上，实现了实际电路复杂度的改进。局限性（根据摘要推断）：该方法的显著优势依赖于辅助量子比特的可用性。
motivation: 量子态制备是许多量子算法中的关键子程序，降低其电路复杂度是一个重大挑战。本文旨在通过代数约简来改进 Sun 等人提出的最优有界算法，以减少其电路复杂度。
method: 提出了一种更简单的代数分解方法，用于将所需量子态的实部制备与复部制备分离。通过对每个均匀受控门使用单个运算符 $\Lambda$（而非原始分解中的三个），实现了复杂度的降低。该新算法使用 PennyLane 库在模拟环境中实现和测试。
results: 在有 $m$ 个辅助量子比特可用时，新方法减少了电路深度、总门数和CNOT门数量。该算法已在模拟环境中实现和测试（包括密集、稀疏、随机和具有物理意义的量子态），并与 Möttönen 等人的算法进行了性能比较，突出了其改进和发展潜力。
conclusion: 抽象地提到了其性能与Möttönen等人的算法相比，突出了有趣的发展方向。没有明确的最终结论，但暗示了新方法的有效性和潜在优势。

title: An attention economy model of co-evolution between content quality and audience selectivity
authors: Masaki Chujyo, Isamu Okada, Hitoshi Yamamoto, Dongwoo Lim, Fujio Toriumi
abstract: Human attention has become a scarce and strategically contested resource in digital environments. Content providers increasingly engage in excessive competition for visibility, often prioritizing attention-grabbing tactics over substantive quality. Despite extensive empirical evidence, however, there is a lack of theoretical models that explain the fundamental dynamics of the attention economy. Here, we develop a minimal mathematical framework to explain how content quality and audience attention coevolve under limited attention capacity. Using an evolutionary game approach, we model strategic feedback between providers, who decide how much effort to invest in production, and consumers, who choose whether to search selectively for high-quality content or to engage passively. Analytical and numerical results reveal three characteristic regimes of content dynamics: collapse, boundary, and coexistence. The transitions between these regimes depend on how effectively audiences can distinguish content quality. When audience discriminability is weak, both selective attention and high-quality production vanish, leading to informational collapse. When discriminability is sufficient and incentives are well aligned, high- and low-quality content dynamically coexist through feedback between audience selectivity and providers' effort. These findings identify two key conditions for sustaining a healthy information ecosystem: adequate discriminability among audiences and sufficient incentives for high-effort creation. The model provides a theoretical foundation for understanding how institutional and platform designs can prevent the degradation of content quality in the attention economy.
zh_title: 内容质量与受众选择性协同演化的注意力经济模型
translation: 在数字环境中，人类注意力已成为一种稀缺且具有战略竞争性的资源。内容提供商日益参与过度竞争以争取曝光度，通常优先考虑吸引注意力的策略而非实质性质量。然而，尽管有大量的经验证据，但仍缺乏解释注意力经济基本动态的理论模型。在此，我们开发了一个最小数学框架，用以解释在有限注意力容量下内容质量和受众注意力如何协同演化。我们使用演化博弈方法，对提供商（决定投入多少生产努力）和消费者（选择是选择性搜索高质量内容还是被动参与）之间的战略反馈进行建模。分析和数值结果揭示了内容动态的三种特征性机制：崩溃、边界和共存。这些机制之间的转变取决于受众区分内容质量的有效性。当受众鉴别力弱时，选择性注意和高质量生产都会消失，导致信息崩溃。当鉴别力足够且激励措施良好时，高低质量内容通过受众选择性与提供商的努力之间的反馈动态共存。这些发现确定了维持健康信息生态系统的两个关键条件：受众具备足够的鉴别能力，以及为高努力创作提供充分的激励。该模型为理解制度和平台设计如何防止注意力经济中的内容质量下降提供了理论基础。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于演化博弈论的最小数学模型，解释了有限注意力下内容质量和受众选择性如何协同演化。结果揭示了三种动态机制（崩溃、边界、共存），并指出维持健康信息生态系统的关键在于受众的鉴别能力和创作者的激励机制。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提供了一个急需的理论框架（演化博弈模型）来解释注意力经济中的核心动态，超越了以往以经验研究为主的局限性。它将内容质量的生产（供给侧）与受众的选择性行为（需求侧）整合在一个协同演化的系统中，而非孤立地看待。模型的实际重要性在于其结论直接指向了平台和制度设计的可操作杠杆——即提高受众的鉴别能力（例如通过更好的工具或教育）和优化激励结构，以防止数字环境中普遍存在的内容质量下降问题。
motivation: 尽管有大量经验证据，但缺乏解释注意力经济基本动态的理论模型。内容提供商过度竞争可见性，往往牺牲实质性质量，因此需要一个数学框架来解释内容质量和受众选择性在有限注意力容量下的协同演化。
method: 采用最小数学框架和演化博弈论方法。模型化了提供商（决定投入多少生产努力）和消费者（选择性搜索高质量内容或被动参与）之间的战略反馈。使用了分析和数值结果进行揭示。
results: 发现了三种特征性的内容动态机制：崩溃、边界和共存。机制间的转换取决于受众区分内容质量的有效性。当受众鉴别力弱时，导致信息崩溃；当鉴别力足够且激励措施良好时，高低质量内容通过受众选择性与提供商努力之间的反馈动态共存。
conclusion: 维持健康信息生态系统的两个关键条件是：受众具备足够的鉴别能力，以及为高努力创作提供充分的激励。该模型为理解制度和平台设计如何防止注意力经济中的内容质量下降提供了理论基础。

title: Revisiting the Sliced Wasserstein Kernel for persistence diagrams: a Figalli-Gigli approach
authors: Marc Janthial, Théo Lacombe
abstract: The Sliced Wasserstein Kernel (SWK) for persistence diagrams was introduced in (Carri{è}re et al. 2017) as a powerful tool to implicitly embed persistence diagrams in a Hilbert space with reasonable distortion. This kernel is built on the intuition that the Figalli-Gigli distance-that is the partial matching distance routinely used to compare persistence diagrams-resembles the Wasserstein distance used in the optimal transport literature, and that the later could be sliced to define a positive definite kernel on the space of persistence diagrams. This efficient construction nonetheless relies on ad-hoc tweaks on the Wasserstein distance to account for the peculiar geometry of the space of persistence diagrams. In this work, we propose to revisit this idea by directly using the Figalli-Gigli distance instead of the Wasserstein one as the building block of our kernel. On the theoretical side, our sliced Figalli-Gigli kernel (SFGK) shares most of the important properties of the SWK of Carri{è}re et al., including distortion results on the induced embedding and its ease of computation, while being more faithful to the natural geometry of persistence diagrams. In particular, it can be directly used to handle infinite persistence diagrams and persistence measures. On the numerical side, we show that the SFGK performs as well as the SWK on benchmark applications.
zh_title: 重新审视用于持久化图的切片 Wasserstein 核：一种 Figalli-Gigli 方法
translation: 用于持久化图的切片 Wasserstein 核（SWK）由 (Carrière et al. 2017) 引入，作为一种强大的工具，能以合理的失真将持久化图隐式嵌入到希尔伯特空间中。该核建立在 Figalli-Gigli 距离（即通常用于比较持久化图的偏匹配距离）类似于最优传输文献中使用的 Wasserstein 距离的直觉之上，并且后者可以被切片以在持久化图空间上定义一个正定核。然而，这种高效的构建依赖于对 Wasserstein 距离进行特设调整，以解释持久化图空间的特殊几何结构。在这项工作中，我们建议重新审视这一想法，通过直接使用 Figalli-Gigli 距离而不是 Wasserstein 距离作为我们核的构建基石。在理论方面，我们的切片 Figalli-Gigli 核（SFGK）共享 Carrière 等人的 SWK 的大多数重要性质，包括诱导嵌入的失真结果及其易于计算性，同时更忠实于持久化图的自然几何结构。特别是，它可以直接用于处理无限持久化图和持久化测度。在数值方面，我们表明 SFGK 在基准应用中的表现与 SWK 一样好。
tldr: 原始的切片 Wasserstein 核（SWK）依赖于对 Wasserstein 距离的特设调整。本文提出了一种新的切片 Figalli-Gigli 核（SFGK），它直接使用更忠实于持久化图几何的 Figalli-Gigli 距离。SFGK 在理论性质上与 SWK 相似，计算简便，并能处理无限持久化图，且在基准测试中性能相当。
ai_comments: 这项工作解决了现有切片 Wasserstein 核（SWK）在处理持久化图几何时需要进行“特设调整”的局限性。通过将构建核的基础距离从 Wasserstein 距离替换为更内在、更忠实于持久化图几何的 Figalli-Gigli 距离，作者提供了一种理论上更优雅且几何上更准确的替代方案。创新点在于直接将 Figalli-Gigli 距离（一种偏匹配距离）与切片核方法结合，从而保持了计算效率（与 SWK 相似）的同时，增强了模型的几何保真度，并扩展了其适用性（例如处理无限图）。
motivation: 现有的切片 Wasserstein 核（SWK）虽然有效，但其构建依赖于对 Wasserstein 距离进行特设调整，以适应持久化图空间的特殊几何结构。作者的动机是提出一种更忠实于持久化图自然几何的新核。
method: 提出切片 Figalli-Gigli 核（SFGK）。该方法直接使用 Figalli-Gigli 距离（持久化图常用的偏匹配距离）作为构建核的基石，而不是像 SWK 那样使用 Wasserstein 距离并进行调整。
results: 1. 理论上，新的切片 Figalli-Gigli 核（SFGK）与 SWK 共享大多数重要性质，包括诱导嵌入的失真结果和易于计算性。2. SFGK 更忠实于持久化图的自然几何结构。3. SFGK 可以直接用于处理无限持久化图和持久化测度。4. 数值实验表明，SFGK 在基准应用中的表现与 SWK 一样好。

title: A Complete Equational Theory for Real-Clifford+CH Quantum Circuits
authors: Alexandre Clément
abstract: We introduce a complete equational theory for the fragment of quantum circuits generated by the real Clifford gates plus the two-qubit controlled-Hadamard gate. That is, we give a simple set of equalities between circuits of this fragment, and prove that any other true equation can be derived from these. This is the first such completeness result for a finitely-generated, universal fragment of quantum circuits, with no parameterized gates and no need for ancillas.
zh_title: 实在Clifford+CH量子电路的完备等式理论
translation: 我们为由实在Clifford门加上双量子比特受控Hadamard门生成的量子电路片段引入了一个完备的等式理论。也就是说，我们给出了该片段电路之间的一组简单等式，并证明了任何其他真实的等式都可以从这些等式中推导出来。这是第一个针对有限生成、通用、无参数门且无需辅助比特的量子电路片段的完备性结果。
tldr: 研究人员为由实在Clifford门和受控Hadamard门构成的所有量子电路找到了一套完整的规则（等式），这是首次针对这种通用、简洁电路的完备性证明。
ai_comments: 这项工作具有重要的理论意义，因为它为特定的量子计算模型提供了一个坚实的代数基础。完备的等式理论允许对量子程序进行形式化验证和优化，无需诉诸复杂的矩阵运算或模拟。尤其值得注意的是，这是第一次针对一个“干净”的（即有限生成、通用、无参数、无辅助比特）量子电路片段实现完备性证明，这标志着在量子程序语义和验证领域取得了关键进展。
motivation: 为由实在Clifford门和双量子比特受控Hadamard门（CH）生成的量子电路片段引入一个完备的等式理论，从而提供一套简洁的基础等式。
method: 提出了一个简单的电路等式集合，并证明了该片段中所有其他真实的等式都可以从这组等式中推导出来（即证明了完备性）。
results: 引入了一个完备的等式理论。该成果是第一个针对有限生成、通用、无参数门且无需辅助比特的量子电路片段的完备性结果。
conclusion: 成功建立了实在Clifford门加上受控Hadamard门（Real-Clifford+CH）量子电路片段的完备等式理论，这是首个针对有限生成、通用、无参数门且无需辅助比特的量子电路片段的完备性结果。

title: Evolving Ranking Functions for Canonical Blow-Ups in Positive Characteristic
authors: Gergely Bérczi
abstract: Resolution of singularities in positive characteristic remains a long-standing open problem in algebraic geometry. In characteristic zero, the problem was solved by Hironaka in 1964, work for which he was awarded the Fields Medal. Modern proofs proceed by constructing suitable ranking functions, that is, invariants shown to strictly decrease along canonical sequences of blow-ups, ensuring termination. In positive characteristic, however, no such general ranking function is known: Frobenius-specific pathologies, such as the kangaroo phenomenon, can cause classical characteristic-zero invariants to plateau or even temporarily increase, presenting a fundamental obstruction to existing approaches. In this paper we report a sequence of experiments using the evolutionary search model AlphaEvolve, designed to discover candidate ranking functions for a toy canonical blow-up process. Our test benchmarks consist of carefully selected hypersurface singularities in dimension $4$ and characteristic $p=3$, with monic purely inseparable leading term, a regime in which naive order-based invariants often fail. After iteratively refining the experimental design, we obtained a discretized five-component lexicographic ranking function satisfying a bounded-delay descent criterion with zero violations across the benchmark. These experiments in turn motivated our main results: the conjectural delayed ranking functions in characteristic $3$ formulated in two conjectures.
zh_title: 正特征下规范爆破的演化排序函数
translation: 正特征下的奇点消解仍然是代数几何中一个长期存在的开放问题。在零特征下，该问题由Hironaka在1964年解决，并因此获得了菲尔兹奖。现代的证明是通过构造合适的排序函数来实现的，这些不变量被证明在规范爆破序列中严格递减，从而确保终止。然而，在正特征下，尚无已知的此类通用排序函数：Frobenius特有的病理现象，例如袋鼠现象，可能导致经典的零特征不变量保持不变甚至暂时增加，这对现有方法构成了根本性障碍。在本文中，我们报告了一系列使用演化搜索模型AlphaEvolve进行的实验，该模型旨在为一个玩具规范爆破过程发现候选排序函数。我们的测试基准包括在维度$4$和特征$p=3$中精心选择的超曲面奇点，这些奇点具有幺模纯非分离首项，这是一个天真的基于阶数的不变量经常失效的区域。经过迭代改进实验设计，我们获得了一个离散化的五分量词典排序函数，该函数在整个基准测试中以零违规满足有界延迟下降准则。这些实验反过来启发了我们的主要成果：在两个推测中阐述的、特征$3$下的推测性延迟排序函数。
