title: Deterministic Retrieval at Scale: Optimal-Space LCP Indexing and 308x Energy Reduction on Modern GPUs
authors: Stanislav Byriukov
abstract: We study deterministic top-k retrieval under Longest Common Prefix (LCP) similarity for N sequences of length L. We prove a tight Omega(N) space lower bound (cell-probe model) and present a trie-based index using O(N*L) space with O(L+k) query time. We contrast this with pairwise materialization (Theta(N^2)), which hits a practical OOM wall at scale, while our indexed approach remains O(N) in memory. We then introduce Thermal-Aware Logic (TAL), which turns prefix structure into range-bounded scans. In hardware measurements, TAL reduces energy per query by 308x (0.0145 J vs 4.46 J) and cuts p95 latency by 329x (0.114 ms vs 37.5 ms) on a 20M-item range-scan benchmark, while sustaining near-peak utilization (~99%) under long runs. The result is a deterministic retrieval primitive with receipts in regimes where approximate methods are unacceptable.
zh_title: 规模化确定性检索：最优空间LCP索引和现代GPU上308倍的能耗降低
translation: 我们研究了N个长度为L的序列在最长公共前缀（LCP）相似性下的确定性top-k检索。我们证明了一个紧密的$\Omega(N)$空间下界（单元探针模型），并提出了一个使用$O(N \cdot L)$空间的基于Trie的索引，其查询时间为$O(L+k)$。我们将其与对偶物化（$\Theta(N^2)$）进行了对比，后者在规模化时会遇到实际的内存溢出（OOM）障碍，而我们的索引方法在内存中保持$O(N)$级别。随后，我们引入了热感知逻辑（Thermal-Aware Logic, TAL），它将前缀结构转化为范围有界扫描。在硬件测量中，在一项2000万项范围扫描基准测试中，TAL将每查询能耗降低了308倍（0.0145 J 对比 4.46 J），并将p95延迟缩短了329倍（0.114 ms 对比 37.5 ms），同时在长时间运行中保持了接近峰值的利用率（约99%）。结果是获得了一个确定性检索原语，适用于近似方法不可接受的场景。
tldr: 针对序列的LCP相似性，我们提出了一个基于Trie的$O(N \cdot L)$空间索引，克服了传统方法$O(N^2)$的空间限制。通过引入热感知逻辑（TAL）和范围扫描，我们在GPU上实现了308倍的能耗降低和329倍的延迟缩短，提供了一个高效的确定性检索原语。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将理论上的最优空间索引设计（通过Trie结构实现$O(N \cdot L)$空间和$O(L+k)$查询时间）与实际的硬件优化（热感知逻辑TAL）相结合。通过将前缀匹配问题转化为范围扫描，该方法极大地提升了现代GPU的能源效率和查询延迟，解决了大规模确定性检索中内存和计算效率的核心挑战。其重要性在于提供了一个在需要高精度（确定性）结果时，能够替代低效或近似方法的实用解决方案。
motivation: 传统的基于对偶物化（pairwise materialization）的检索方法空间复杂度为$\Theta(N^2)$，在大规模应用中会遇到内存溢出（OOM）的实际障碍。此外，该工作旨在提供一个确定性检索原语，以应对近似方法不可接受的应用场景。
method: 首先证明了$\Omega(N)$的紧密空间下界（单元探针模型）。然后提出了一个基于Trie的索引结构，其空间复杂度为$O(N \cdot L)$，查询时间为$O(L+k)$。接着引入了热感知逻辑（Thermal-Aware Logic, TAL），将前缀结构转换为范围有界扫描（range-bounded scans），以优化硬件性能。
results: 理论上，索引空间复杂度为$O(N \cdot L)$，查询时间为$O(L+k)$，内存占用为$O(N)$级别。硬件测量结果显示，在2000万项范围扫描基准测试中，每查询能耗降低了308倍（从4.46 J降至0.0145 J），p95延迟缩短了329倍（从37.5 ms降至0.114 ms），并且在长时间运行中保持了接近峰值的利用率（约99%）。
conclusion: 该方法提供了一个确定性的检索原语，适用于近似方法不可接受的应用场景。

title: The Birthmark Standard: Privacy-Preserving Photo Authentication via Hardware Roots of Trust and Consortium Blockchain
authors: Sam Ryan
abstract: The rapid advancement of generative AI systems has collapsed the credibility landscape for photographic evidence. Modern image generation models produce photorealistic images undermining the evidentiary foundation upon which journalism and public discourse depend. Existing authentication approaches, such as the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA), embed cryptographically signed metadata directly into image files but suffer from two critical failures: technical vulnerability to metadata stripping during social media reprocessing, and structural dependency on corporate-controlled verification infrastructure where commercial incentives may conflict with public interest. We present the Birthmark Standard, an authentication architecture leveraging manufacturing-unique sensor entropy from non-uniformity correction (NUC) maps and PRNU patterns to generate hardware-rooted authentication keys. During capture, cameras create anonymized authentication certificates proving sensor authenticity without exposing device identity via a key table architecture maintaining anonymity sets exceeding 1,000 devices. Authentication records are stored on a consortium blockchain operated by journalism organizations rather than commercial platforms, enabling verification that survives all metadata loss. We formally verify privacy properties using ProVerif, proving observational equivalence for Manufacturer Non-Correlation and Blockchain Observer Non-Identification under Dolev-Yao adversary assumptions. The architecture is validated through prototype implementation using Raspberry Pi 4 hardware, demonstrating the complete cryptographic pipeline. Performance analysis projects camera overhead below 100ms and verification latency below 500ms at scale of one million daily authentications.
comment: 32 pages, 2 figures. Technical specification and security analysis for metadata-independent photo authentication. Prototype implementation with Raspberry Pi 4 hardware
zh_title: 生辰印记标准：通过硬件信任根和联盟区块链实现隐私保护的照片认证
translation: 生成式AI系统的快速发展已经瓦解了摄影证据的可信度。现代图像生成模型产生逼真的图像，破坏了新闻业和公共讨论所依赖的证据基础。现有的认证方法，例如内容来源与真实性联盟（C2PA），将加密签名的元数据直接嵌入图像文件中，但存在两个关键缺陷：在社交媒体重新处理过程中元数据容易被剥离的技术漏洞，以及对企业控制的验证基础设施的结构性依赖，其中商业激励可能与公共利益冲突。我们提出了生辰印记标准，这是一种认证架构，它利用非均匀性校正（NUC）图和PRNU模式中制造独特的传感器熵来生成硬件根植的认证密钥。在捕获过程中，相机通过一个密钥表架构创建匿名认证证书，证明传感器真实性而不暴露设备身份，匿名集超过1,000个设备。认证记录存储在由新闻机构而非商业平台运营的联盟区块链上，从而实现即使所有元数据丢失也能进行验证。我们使用ProVerif正式验证了隐私属性，证明了在Dolev-Yao对手假设下的制造商非关联性和区块链观察者非识别的观测等效性。该架构通过使用Raspberry Pi 4硬件的原型实现进行了验证，演示了完整的加密管道。性能分析预测，在每天一百万次认证的规模下，相机开销低于100毫秒，验证延迟低于500毫秒。
tldr: Birthmark标准提出了一种新的照片认证架构，利用硬件信任根和联盟区块链来解决生成式AI对照片证据可信度的破坏以及现有认证方法（如C2PA）的缺陷，同时确保隐私。
ai_comments: 本文针对生成式AI带来的图像真实性挑战提出了一个创新且及时的解决方案。其核心创新在于结合了硬件信任根、隐私保护的匿名密钥架构和由新闻机构运营的联盟区块链，有效解决了现有元数据认证方案易被篡改和受商业利益影响的问题。形式化验证增加了方案的可靠性。该方法有望在维护数字图像可信度方面发挥重要作用。
motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展严重破坏了照片证据的可信度。现有的认证方法（如C2PA）存在两个关键缺陷：在社交媒体重新处理过程中容易被剥离元数据，以及对企业控制的验证基础设施的结构性依赖，这可能导致商业利益与公共利益冲突。
method: 本文提出了“生辰印记标准”认证架构。该架构利用制造独特的传感器熵（来自非均匀性校正图和PRNU模式）生成硬件根植的认证密钥。在捕获过程中，相机通过一个密钥表架构创建匿名认证证书，证明传感器真实性而不暴露设备身份，匿名集超过1,000个设备。认证记录存储在由新闻机构而非商业平台运营的联盟区块链上。使用ProVerif正式验证了隐私属性，证明了在Dolev-Yao对手假设下的制造商非关联性和区块链观察者非识别的观测等效性。通过使用Raspberry Pi 4硬件的原型实现验证了该架构，演示了完整的加密管道。
results: 通过ProVerif在Dolev-Yao对手假设下正式验证了隐私属性，证明了制造商非关联性和区块链观察者非识别的观测等效性。使用Raspberry Pi 4硬件的原型实现验证了完整的加密管道。性能分析预测，在每天一百万次认证的规模下，相机开销低于100毫秒，验证延迟低于500毫秒。
conclusion: 生辰印记标准提供了一种强大的、隐私保护的照片认证架构，能够抵御所有元数据丢失，并避免企业控制，从而解决生成式AI引发的信任危机。

title: SynthForensics: A Multi-Generator Benchmark for Detecting Synthetic Video Deepfakes
authors: Roberto Leotta, Salvatore Alfio Sambataro, Claudio Vittorio Ragaglia, Mirko Casu, Yuri Petralia, Francesco Guarnera, Luca Guarnera, Sebastiano Battiato
abstract: The landscape of synthetic media has been irrevocably altered by text-to-video (T2V) models, whose outputs are rapidly approaching indistinguishability from reality. Critically, this technology is no longer confined to large-scale labs; the proliferation of efficient, open-source generators is democratizing the ability to create high-fidelity synthetic content on consumer-grade hardware. This makes existing face-centric and manipulation-based benchmarks obsolete. To address this urgent threat, we introduce SynthForensics, to the best of our knowledge the first human-centric benchmark for detecting purely synthetic video deepfakes. The benchmark comprises 6,815 unique videos from five architecturally distinct, state-of-the-art open-source T2V models. Its construction was underpinned by a meticulous two-stage, human-in-the-loop validation to ensure high semantic and visual quality. Each video is provided in four versions (raw, lossless, light, and heavy compression) to enable real-world robustness testing. Experiments demonstrate that state-of-the-art detectors are both fragile and exhibit limited generalization when evaluated on this new domain: we observe a mean performance drop of $29.19\%$ AUC, with some methods performing worse than random chance, and top models losing over 30 points under heavy compression. The paper further investigates the efficacy of training on SynthForensics as a means to mitigate these observed performance gaps, achieving robust generalization to unseen generators ($93.81\%$ AUC), though at the cost of reduced backward compatibility with traditional manipulation-based deepfakes. The complete dataset and all generation metadata, including the specific prompts and inference parameters for every video, will be made publicly available at [link anonymized for review].

title: Large Language Models in Software Documentation and Modeling: A Literature Review and Findings
authors: Lukas Radosky, Ivan Polasek
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence attracts significant attention, especially with the introduction of large language models. Its capabilities are being exploited to solve various software engineering tasks. Thanks to their ability to understand natural language and generate natural language responses, large language models are great for processing various software documentation artifacts. At the same time, large language models excel at understanding structured languages, having the potential for working with software programs and models. We conduct a literature review on the usage of large language models for software engineering tasks related to documentation and modeling. We analyze articles from four major venues in the area, organize them per tasks they solve, and provide an overview of used prompt techniques, metrics, approaches to human-based evaluation, and major datasets.
comment: This is a preprint of a paper that was presented at the IEEE 24th World Symposium on Applied Machine Intelligence and Informatics (SAMI 2026)
zh_title: 大型语言模型在软件文档和建模中的应用：文献综述与发现
translation: 生成式人工智能，特别是大型语言模型的引入，引起了广泛关注。其能力正被用于解决各种软件工程任务。由于大型语言模型具备理解自然语言和生成自然语言响应的能力，它们非常适合处理各种软件文档工件。同时，大型语言模型擅长理解结构化语言，具有处理软件程序和模型的潜力。我们对大型语言模型在与文档和建模相关的软件工程任务中的使用进行了文献综述。我们分析了该领域四个主要场所的文章，根据它们解决的任务进行组织，并概述了所使用的提示技术、指标、基于人工的评估方法和主要数据集。
tldr: 对大型语言模型在软件工程的文档和建模任务中的应用进行文献综述，分析主要论文、使用的提示技术、评估指标和数据集。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于其综述性质，它系统地梳理了新兴的大型语言模型在软件工程特定子领域（文档和建模）的应用现状。其重要性在于为研究人员和从业者提供了一个结构化的知识框架，帮助他们理解当前的研究趋势、主流方法（如提示技术）和评估标准。这对于指导未来的LLM在软件工程领域的应用研究和实践具有重要价值。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）因其理解和生成自然语言的能力，非常适合处理软件文档；同时，它们在理解结构化语言方面的优势使其具备处理软件程序和模型的潜力。因此，有必要对LLMs在这些软件工程任务中的应用进行系统回顾。
method: 进行文献综述，重点关注大型语言模型在软件文档和建模相关软件工程任务中的应用。分析来自该领域四个主要会议的文章，并根据所解决的任务进行组织，概述所使用的提示技术、评估指标、基于人工的评估方法和主要数据集。

title: Transolver-3: Scaling Up Transformer Solvers to Industrial-Scale Geometries
authors: Hang Zhou, Haixu Wu, Haonan Shangguan, Yuezhou Ma, Huikun Weng, Jianmin Wang, Mingsheng Long
abstract: Deep learning has emerged as a transformative tool for the neural surrogate modeling of partial differential equations (PDEs), known as neural PDE solvers. However, scaling these solvers to industrial-scale geometries with over $10^8$ cells remains a fundamental challenge due to the prohibitive memory complexity of processing high-resolution meshes. We present Transolver-3, a new member of the Transolver family as a highly scalable framework designed for high-fidelity physics simulations. To bridge the gap between limited GPU capacity and the resolution requirements of complex engineering tasks, we introduce two key architectural optimizations: faster slice and deslice by exploiting matrix multiplication associative property and geometry slice tiling to partition the computation of physical states. Combined with an amortized training strategy by learning on random subsets of original high-resolution meshes and a physical state caching technique during inference, Transolver-3 enables high-fidelity field prediction on industrial-scale meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Transolver-3 is capable of handling meshes with over 160 million cells, achieving impressive performance across three challenging simulation benchmarks, including aircraft and automotive design tasks.
zh_title: Transolver-3：将Transformer求解器扩展到工业规模几何体
translation: 深度学习已成为偏微分方程（PDE）神经替代建模（称为神经PDE求解器）的变革性工具。然而，由于处理高分辨率网格的内存复杂度过高，将这些求解器扩展到具有超过 $10^8$ 个单元格的工业规模几何体仍然是一个根本性的挑战。我们提出了Transolver-3，作为Transolver家族的新成员，它是一个专为高保真物理模拟设计的高度可扩展框架。为了弥合有限的GPU容量与复杂工程任务分辨率要求之间的差距，我们引入了两个关键的架构优化：通过利用矩阵乘法结合律实现更快的切片（slice）和反切片（deslice），以及几何体切片平铺（geometry slice tiling）来划分物理状态的计算。结合通过在原始高分辨率网格的随机子集上学习的摊销训练策略，以及推理期间的物理状态缓存技术，Transolver-3能够在工业规模网格上实现高保真度的场预测。广泛的实验表明，Transolver-3能够处理超过1.6亿个单元格的网格，并在包括飞机和汽车设计任务在内的三个具有挑战性的模拟基准测试中取得了令人印象深刻的性能。
tldr: Transolver-3是一个高度可扩展的神经PDE求解器，它通过架构优化（如几何切片平铺和矩阵乘法技巧）和训练策略，解决了处理超高分辨率工业网格（超过1.6亿个单元格）的内存挑战，并在高保真物理模拟中表现出色。
ai_comments: Transolver-3的创新之处在于其对现有Transformer求解器在内存效率和可扩展性上的重大改进。通过引入几何切片平铺（geometry slice tiling）和利用矩阵乘法结合律等巧妙的架构优化，它有效地绕过了GPU内存的限制，使得神经PDE求解器首次能够处理传统上只有大型高性能计算集群才能处理的工业级网格（超过1.6亿单元）。这对于将深度学习模型应用于实际工程和复杂物理模拟领域具有重要的推动作用，解决了现有方法在处理高分辨率复杂几何体时的根本性挑战。
motivation: 现有的神经偏微分方程（PDE）求解器难以扩展到具有超过 $10^8$ 个单元格的工业规模几何体，主要原因是处理高分辨率网格所需的内存复杂度过高。
method: 提出了Transolver-3框架。主要方法包括两个架构优化：利用矩阵乘法结合律实现更快的切片（slice）和反切片（deslice），以及几何体切片平铺（geometry slice tiling）来划分物理状态的计算。此外，还采用了摊销训练策略（在原始高分辨率网格的随机子集上学习）和推理期间的物理状态缓存技术。
results: Transolver-3能够处理超过1.6亿个单元格的网格，并在包括飞机和汽车设计任务在内的三个具有挑战性的模拟基准测试中取得了令人印象深刻的性能。
conclusion: Transolver-3通过引入关键的架构优化和训练/推理策略，成功实现了在高保真度物理模拟中对工业规模网格进行场预测的能力。

title: Linear Model Merging Unlocks Simple and Scalable Multimodal Data Mixture Optimization
authors: Davide Berasi, Matteo Farina, Massimiliano Mancini, Elisa Ricci
abstract: Selecting the best data mixture is critical for successful Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) of Multimodal Large Language Models. However, determining the optimal mixture weights across multiple domain-specific datasets remains a significant bottleneck due to the combinatorial search space and the high cost associated with even a single training run. This is the so-called Data Mixture Optimization (DMO) problem. On the other hand, model merging unifies domain-specific experts through parameter interpolation. This strategy is efficient, as it only requires a single training run per domain, yet oftentimes leads to suboptimal models. In this work, we take the best of both worlds, studying model merging as an efficient strategy for estimating the performance of different data mixtures. We train domain-specific multimodal experts and evaluate their weighted parameter-space combinations to estimate the efficacy of corresponding data mixtures. We conduct extensive experiments on 14 multimodal benchmarks, and empirically demonstrate that the merged proxy models exhibit a high rank correlation with models trained on actual data mixtures. This decouples the search for optimal mixtures from the resource-intensive training process, thereby providing a scalable and efficient strategy for navigating the complex landscape of mixture weights. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/BerasiDavide/mLLMs_merging_4_DMO.
zh_title: 线性模型合并实现简单且可扩展的多模态数据混合优化
translation: 选择最佳数据混合对于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的监督微调（SFT）至关重要。然而，由于组合搜索空间巨大以及即使是单次训练运行也成本高昂，确定跨多个特定领域数据集的最佳混合权重仍然是一个重大瓶颈。这就是所谓的数据混合优化（DMO）问题。另一方面，模型合并通过参数插值来统一特定领域的专家模型。这种策略效率很高，因为它只需要为每个领域进行一次训练，但通常会导致次优模型。在这项工作中，我们取两者之长，研究模型合并作为一种有效策略来估计不同数据混合的性能。我们训练特定领域的多模态专家模型，并评估它们在参数空间中的加权组合，以估计相应数据混合的有效性。我们在14个多模态基准上进行了广泛实验，经验证明合并的代理模型与在实际数据混合上训练的模型表现出高度的秩相关性。这使得最佳混合物的搜索与资源密集型训练过程解耦，从而为探索复杂的混合权重空间提供了一种可扩展且高效的策略。代码已公开发布于 https://github.com/BerasiDavide/mLLMs_merging_4_DMO。
tldr: 针对多模态大模型SFT中数据混合优化（DMO）的高成本问题，本文提出使用线性模型合并作为代理，通过合并训练好的专家模型参数来高效预测不同数据混合的性能，实验证明该代理模型与真实训练模型具有高秩相关性，从而实现了DMO搜索与昂贵训练过程的解耦。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将高效的模型合并策略应用于解决资源密集型的数据混合优化（DMO）问题。通过证明合并的代理模型性能与实际训练模型的性能之间存在高度秩相关性，该方法有效地解耦了最优数据混合搜索与昂贵的模型训练过程。这为多模态大语言模型的监督微调提供了一个简单、可扩展且高效的解决方案，是提升MLLM训练效率的重要一步。
motivation: 在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的监督微调（SFT）中，选择最佳数据混合至关重要。然而，由于组合搜索空间巨大以及单次训练成本高昂，确定最佳混合权重（即数据混合优化，DMO问题）是一个重大瓶颈。
method: 结合模型合并和数据混合优化的优点，将模型合并作为一种高效策略来估计不同数据混合的性能。具体方法是：训练特定领域的多模态专家模型，然后评估这些专家模型在参数空间中的加权组合，以估计相应数据混合的有效性。
results: 在14个多模态基准上进行了广泛实验，经验证明合并的代理模型（merged proxy models）与在实际数据混合上训练的模型表现出高度的秩相关性。
conclusion: 这种基于模型合并的策略将寻找最佳数据混合的过程与资源密集型训练过程解耦，从而为探索复杂的混合权重空间提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案。

title: Improving Set Function Approximation with Quasi-Arithmetic Neural Networks
authors: Tomas Tokar, Scott Sanner
abstract: Sets represent a fundamental abstraction across many types of data. To handle the unordered nature of set-structured data, models such as DeepSets and PointNet rely on fixed, non-learnable pooling operations (e.g., sum or max) -- a design choice that can hinder the transferability of learned embeddings and limits model expressivity. More recently, learnable aggregation functions have been proposed as more expressive alternatives. In this work, we advance this line of research by introducing the Neuralized Kolmogorov Mean (NKM) -- a novel, trainable framework for learning a generalized measure of central tendency through an invertible neural function. We further propose quasi-arithmetic neural networks (QUANNs), which incorporate the NKM as a learnable aggregation function. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that, QUANNs are universal approximators for a broad class of common set-function decompositions and, thanks to their invertible neural components, learn more structured latent representations. Empirically, QUANNs outperform state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks, while learning embeddings that transfer effectively even to tasks that do not involve sets.
zh_title: 使用准算术神经网络改进集合函数逼近
translation: 集合代表了许多类型数据的基本抽象。为了处理集合结构数据的无序性，DeepSets和PointNet等模型依赖于固定的、不可学习的池化操作（例如，求和或最大值）——这种设计选择可能会阻碍学习到的嵌入的可迁移性并限制模型的表达能力。最近，可学习的聚合函数被提议作为更具表达力的替代方案。在这项工作中，我们通过引入神经科尔莫哥洛夫平均（Neuralized Kolmogorov Mean, NKM）——一个新颖的、可训练的框架，通过一个可逆的神经函数学习广义的集中趋势度量——来推进这一研究方向。我们进一步提出了准算术神经网络（QUANNs），它将NKM作为可学习的聚合函数。我们提供了理论分析，表明QUANNs是广泛类别的常见集合函数分解的通用逼近器，并且由于其可逆的神经组件，能够学习到更结构化的潜在表示。从经验上看，QUANNs在各种基准测试中优于最先进的基线模型，同时学习到的嵌入甚至可以有效地迁移到不涉及集合的任务。
keywords: 神经科尔莫哥洛夫平均
tldr: 针对DeepSets和PointNet等模型中固定池化操作的局限性，本文提出了可学习的集合聚合函数——神经科尔莫哥洛夫平均（NKM），并将其整合到准算术神经网络（QUANNs）中。QUANNs被证明是集合函数的通用逼近器，并在经验上超越了现有技术，同时学习到具有更好可迁移性的嵌入。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于用可学习的、基于可逆神经函数的聚合机制（NKM）取代了传统的固定池化操作（如求和或最大值），从而提高了集合函数逼近的表达能力。理论上证明了QUANNs的通用逼近特性，同时强调了其在学习结构化和可迁移嵌入方面的实际优势。该方法直接解决了DeepSets/PointNet架构中的核心局限性，对处理无序数据的深度学习领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的处理集合结构数据的模型（如DeepSets和PointNet）依赖于固定的、不可学习的池化操作（如求和或最大值），这会限制模型表达能力并阻碍学习到的嵌入的可迁移性。
method: 引入了神经科尔莫哥洛夫平均（Neuralized Kolmogorov Mean, NKM），这是一个新颖的、可训练的框架，通过一个可逆的神经函数来学习广义的集中趋势度量。进一步提出了准算术神经网络（QUANNs），它将NKM作为可学习的聚合函数。
results: 1. 理论上，QUANNs是广泛类别的常见集合函数分解的通用逼近器。2. 由于其可逆的神经组件，QUANNs学习到更结构化的潜在表示。3. 经验上，QUANNs在各种基准测试中优于最先进的基线模型。4. QUANNs学习到的嵌入具有有效可迁移性，甚至适用于不涉及集合的任务。
conclusion: QUANNs通过引入可学习的聚合函数NKM，成功解决了传统集合模型中固定池化操作的限制，显著提高了集合函数逼近的性能、表达能力和嵌入的可迁移性。

title: Multi-Sensor Scheduling for Remote State Estimation over Wireless MIMO Fading Channels with Semantic Over-the-Air Aggregation
authors: Minjie Tang, Photios A. Stavrou, Marios Kountouris
abstract: In this work, we study multi-sensor scheduling for remote state estimation over wireless multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) fading channels using a novel semantic over-the-air (SemOTA) aggregation approach. We first revisit Kalman filtering with conventional over-the-air (OTA) aggregation and highlight its transmit power limitations. To balance power efficiency and estimation performance, we formulate the scheduling task as a finite-horizon dynamic programming (DP) problem. By analyzing the structure of the optimal Q-function, we show that the resulting scheduling policy exhibits a semantic structure that adapts online to the estimation error covariance and channel variations. To obtain a practical solution, we derive a tractable upper bound on the Q-function via a positive semidefinite (PSD) cone decomposition, which enables an efficient approximate scheduling policy and a low-complexity remote estimation algorithm. Numerical results confirm that the proposed scheme outperforms existing methods in both estimation accuracy and power efficiency.
zh_title: 具有语义空中聚合的无线MIMO衰落信道远程状态估计的多传感器调度
translation: 在这项工作中，我们研究了利用一种新颖的语义空中聚合（SemOTA）方法，在无线多输入多输出（MIMO）衰落信道上进行远程状态估计的多传感器调度问题。我们首先回顾了传统空中聚合（OTA）的卡尔曼滤波，并强调了其发射功率限制。为了平衡功率效率和估计性能，我们将调度任务建模为一个有限范围动态规划（DP）问题。通过分析最优Q函数的结构，我们发现由此产生的调度策略表现出一种语义结构，可以根据估计误差协方差和信道变化进行在线适应。为了获得一个实用的解决方案，我们通过正半定（PSD）锥分解推导出了一个可处理的Q函数上界，这使得高效的近似调度策略和低复杂度的远程估计算法成为可能。数值结果证实，所提出的方案在估计精度和功率效率方面均优于现有方法。
tldr: 研究了一种基于语义空中聚合（SemOTA）的新型多传感器调度方案，用于无线MIMO信道远程状态估计。通过将问题建模为动态规划，并利用PSD锥分解推导出可处理的上界近似，该方案在估计精度和功率效率上均优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于引入了“语义空中聚合”（SemOTA）的概念，将其应用于多传感器调度和远程状态估计，这代表了信息聚合和通信效率方面的一种新范式。通过将调度问题转化为动态规划（DP），并利用数学工具（如PSD锥分解）来解决实际计算复杂性，该研究成功地将理论优化与实际应用中的低复杂度需求相结合，同时解决了传统OTA方法的功率限制，具有重要的实践意义。
motivation: 解决传统空中聚合（OTA）的卡尔曼滤波在远程状态估计中存在的发射功率限制问题。目标是设计一种方案来平衡功率效率和估计性能。
method: 1. 提出了一种新颖的语义空中聚合（SemOTA）方法。2. 将调度任务建模为一个有限范围动态规划（DP）问题，旨在平衡功率效率和估计性能。3. 分析最优Q函数的结构，发现调度策略具有适应估计误差协方差和信道变化的语义结构。4. 通过正半定（PSD）锥分解，推导出一个可处理的Q函数上界，从而得到高效的近似调度策略和低复杂度的远程估计算法。
results: 所提出的方案在估计精度和功率效率方面均优于现有方法。

title: Privileged Information Distillation for Language Models
authors: Emiliano Penaloza, Dheeraj Vattikonda, Nicolas Gontier, Alexandre Lacoste, Laurent Charlin, Massimo Caccia
abstract: Training-time privileged information (PI) can enable language models to succeed on tasks they would otherwise fail, making it a powerful tool for reinforcement learning in hard, long-horizon settings. However, transferring capabilities learned with PI to policies that must act without it at inference time remains a fundamental challenge. We study this problem in the context of distilling frontier models for multi-turn agentic environments, where closed-source systems typically hide their internal reasoning and expose only action trajectories. This breaks standard distillation pipelines, since successful behavior is observable but the reasoning process is not. For this, we introduce π-Distill, a joint teacher-student objective that trains a PI-conditioned teacher and an unconditioned student simultaneously using the same model. Additionally, we also introduce On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), an alternative approach that trains using Reinforcement Learning (RL) with a reverse KL-penalty between the student and the PI-conditioned teacher. We show that both of these algorithms effectively distill frontier agents using action-only PI. Specifically we find that π-Distill and in some cases OPSD, outperform industry standard practices (Supervised finetuning followed by RL) that assume access to full Chain-of-Thought supervision across multiple agentic benchmarks, models, and forms of PI. We complement our results with extensive analysis that characterizes the factors enabling effective learning with PI, focusing primarily on π-Distill and characterizing when OPSD is competitive.

zh_title: 语言模型的特权信息蒸馏
translation: 训练时的特权信息（PI）可以使语言模型在原本会失败的任务上取得成功，使其成为解决困难、长周期设置中强化学习的强大工具。然而，将使用PI学到的能力转移到在推理时必须在没有PI的情况下行动的策略中，仍然是一个根本性的挑战。我们在蒸馏多轮代理环境中的前沿模型这一背景下研究了这个问题，在这些环境中，闭源系统通常隐藏其内部推理过程，只暴露动作轨迹。这打破了标准的蒸馏流程，因为成功的行为是可观察的，但推理过程却不是。为此，我们引入了π-Distill，这是一个联合教师-学生目标，它使用同一模型同时训练一个以PI为条件的教师和一个无条件的学生。此外，我们还引入了On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD），这是一种替代方法，它使用强化学习（RL）进行训练，并在学生和以PI为条件的教师之间施加一个逆向KL惩罚。我们展示了这两种算法都能有效地使用仅包含动作的PI来蒸馏前沿代理。具体来说，我们发现π-Distill，以及在某些情况下OPSD，在多个代理基准、模型和PI形式上，优于假设可以访问完整思维链监督的行业标准实践（监督微调后接RL）。我们通过广泛的分析补充了我们的结果，这些分析描述了使用PI实现有效学习的因素，主要关注π-Distill并描述了OPSD何时具有竞争力。
tldr: 特权信息（PI）训练的语言模型能力强大但难以迁移。本文提出了π-Distill和OPSD两种方法，仅使用可观察的动作就能有效蒸馏这些能力，并优于需要完整思维链（CoT）监督的行业标准方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于解决了从特权信息（PI）条件教师向无条件学生进行知识迁移的根本挑战，特别是在黑箱前沿代理（仅暴露动作，不暴露内部推理）这一困难背景下。π-Distill和OPSD的引入提供了实用的解决方案，令人惊讶地优于需要完整思维链（CoT）监督的行业标准做法。这表明了一种利用有限可观察数据进行高效蒸馏的方式，对于部署强大的专有代理模型具有高度的现实意义。
motivation: 特权信息（PI）是解决困难、长周期强化学习任务的强大工具。然而，将通过PI学习到的能力转移到推理时没有PI的策略中是一个根本挑战，尤其是在前沿模型中，其内部推理过程通常是隐藏的，只暴露动作轨迹。
method: 提出了两种蒸馏算法：1. **π-Distill**：一种联合教师-学生目标，使用同一模型同时训练PI条件教师和无条件学生。2. **On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD)**：一种替代方法，使用强化学习（RL）并在学生与PI条件教师之间施加一个逆向KL惩罚。
results: 两种算法（π-Distill和OPSD）都能有效地使用仅包含动作的特权信息（PI）来蒸馏前沿代理。π-Distill，以及在某些情况下OPSD，在多个基准测试中优于假设可获得完整思维链（CoT）监督的行业标准实践（监督微调后接RL）。

title: Learning Context Matters: Measuring and Diagnosing Personalization Gaps in LLM-Based Instructional Design
authors: Johaun Hatchett, Debshila Basu Mallick, Brittany C. Bradford, Richard G. Baraniuk
abstract: The adoption of generative AI in education has accelerated dramatically in recent years, with Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly integrated into learning environments in the hope of providing personalized support that enhances learner engagement and knowledge retention. However, truly personalized support requires access to meaningful Learning Context (LC) regarding who the learner is, what they are trying to understand, and how they are engaging with the material. In this paper, we present a framework for measuring and diagnosing how the LC influences instructional strategy selection in LLM-based tutoring systems. Using psychometrically grounded synthetic learning contexts and a pedagogically grounded decision space, we compare LLM instructional decisions in context-blind and context-aware conditions and quantify their alignment with the pedagogical judgments of subject matter experts. Our results show that, while providing the LC induces systematic, measurable changes in instructional decisions that move LLM policies closer to the subject matter expert policy, substantial misalignment remains. To diagnose this misalignment, we introduce a relevance-impact analysis that reveals which learner characteristics are attended to, ignored, or spuriously influential in LLM instructional decision-making. This analysis, conducted in collaboration with subject matter experts, demonstrates that LC materially shapes LLM instructional planning but does not reliably induce pedagogically appropriate personalization. Our results enable principled evaluation of context-aware LLM systems and provide a foundation for improving personalization through learner characteristic prioritization, pedagogical model tuning, and LC engineering.
zh_title: 学习情境至关重要：衡量和诊断基于LLM的教学设计中的个性化差距
translation: 近年来，生成式AI在教育中的应用显著加速，大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被整合到学习环境中，以期提供个性化支持，增强学习者参与度和知识保留。然而，真正个性化的支持需要获取关于学习者是谁、他们试图理解什么以及他们如何参与材料的有意义的学习情境（LC）。在本文中，我们提出了一个框架，用于衡量和诊断LC如何影响基于LLM的辅导系统中的教学策略选择。我们使用基于心理测量学的合成学习情境和基于教学法的决策空间，比较了LLM在情境盲和情境感知条件下的教学决策，并量化了它们与主题专家（SME）教学判断的一致性。我们的结果表明，虽然提供LC会引起教学决策中系统性、可衡量的变化，使LLM策略更接近主题专家策略，但仍存在显著的未对齐。为了诊断这种未对齐，我们引入了相关性-影响分析，揭示了LLM教学决策中哪些学习者特征被关注、被忽略或产生了虚假影响。这项与主题专家合作进行的分析表明，LC实质性地塑造了LLM的教学规划，但不能可靠地诱导教学上恰当的个性化。我们的结果有助于对情境感知LLM系统进行原则性评估，并为通过学习者特征优先级排序、教学模型调整和LC工程来改进个性化提供了基础。
tldr: 研究发现，虽然向LLM提供学习情境（LC）可以改善其教学决策，使其更接近专家，但仍存在显著的个性化差距。通过相关性分析，揭示了LLM在个性化决策中哪些学习者特征被关注或被忽略，为未来改进LLM教育系统提供了依据。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个量化和诊断LLM在教学设计中个性化差距的系统性框架，尤其引入了“相关性-影响分析”来精确定位LLM决策中对学习者特征的利用偏差（过度关注、忽略或错误关注）。这对于指导LLM在教育领域的应用具有重要意义，因为它从经验上证明了仅仅提供学习情境（LC）是不够的，还需要对LLM进行教学法调优和情境工程。它为从主观定性评估转向客观定量评估LLM教育系统的有效性提供了坚实的基础。
motivation: 鉴于生成式AI（尤其是LLM）在教育中被广泛采用以提供个性化支持，但真正的个性化支持需要获取有意义的学习情境（LC）。本文的动机是衡量和诊断在基于LLM的辅导系统中，学习情境如何影响教学策略选择。
method: 提出了一个衡量和诊断LC如何影响LLM教学策略选择的框架。使用心理测量学基础的合成学习情境和教学法基础的决策空间，比较了LLM在情境盲和情境感知条件下的教学决策，并量化了它们与主题专家（SME）判断的一致性。此外，引入了相关性-影响分析来诊断未对齐的原因。
results: 提供学习情境（LC）会引起系统性、可衡量的教学决策变化，使LLM策略更接近主题专家策略。然而，仍存在显著的未对齐。相关性-影响分析表明，LC实质上塑造了LLM的教学规划，但不能可靠地诱导教学上恰当的个性化。
conclusion: 结果为情境感知LLM系统的原则性评估提供了基础，并为通过学习者特征优先级排序、教学模型调整和学习情境工程来改进个性化提供了方向。

title: Stochastic hierarchical data-driven optimization: application to plasma-surface kinetics
authors: José Afonso, Vasco Guerra, Pedro Viegas
abstract: This work introduces a stochastic hierarchical optimization framework inspired by Sloppy Model theory for the efficient calibration of physical models. Central to this method is the use of a reduced Hessian approximation, which identifies and targets the stiff parameter subspace using minimal simulation queries. This strategy enables efficient navigation of highly anisotropic landscapes, avoiding the computational burden of exhaustive sampling. To ensure rigorous inference, we integrate this approach with a probabilistic formulation that derives a principled objective loss function directly from observed data. We validate the framework by applying it to the problem of plasma-surface interactions, where accurate modelling is strictly limited by uncertainties in surface reactivity parameters and the computational cost of kinetic simulations. Comparative analysis demonstrates that our method consistently outperforms baseline optimization techniques in sample efficiency. This approach offers a general and scalable tool for optimizing models of complex reaction systems, ranging from plasma chemistry to biochemical networks.
zh_title: 随机分层数据驱动优化：在等离子体-表面动力学中的应用
translation: 这项工作引入了一种受“松弛模型理论”启发的随机分层优化框架，用于物理模型的高效校准。该方法的核心是使用简化的Hessian近似，它通过最小化的模拟查询来识别并针对刚性参数子空间。这一策略能够有效地导航高度各向异性的景观，避免了穷举采样的计算负担。为了确保严格的推理，我们将这种方法与概率公式相结合，直接从观测数据中导出一个原则性的目标损失函数。我们通过将其应用于等离子体-表面相互作用问题来验证该框架，在该问题中，准确建模受到表面反应性参数的不确定性和动力学模拟的计算成本的严格限制。对比分析表明，我们的方法在样本效率方面始终优于基线优化技术。这种方法为优化复杂的反应系统模型提供了一个通用且可扩展的工具，应用范围从等离子体化学到生化网络。
tldr: 本文提出了一种受“松弛模型理论”启发的随机分层优化框架，用于高效校准物理模型。该方法利用简化Hessian近似识别关键参数子空间，显著减少了模拟查询次数，并在等离子体-表面相互作用的应用中，展示出优于基线优化技术的样本效率。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将“松弛模型理论”（Sloppy Model theory）的概念（识别模型中对数据敏感和不敏感的参数）与简化的Hessian近似相结合，创建了一个计算效率极高的优化策略。对于那些参数空间巨大且单次模拟成本高昂的复杂系统（如等离子体化学和生化网络），这种“分层”或“聚焦”的优化方法具有重要的实用价值。通过将计算资源集中在对模型输出影响最大的参数上，它有效地克服了传统优化方法在处理高维、各向异性景观时的主要瓶颈。
motivation: 准确的物理模型校准受到表面反应性参数的不确定性和动力学模拟的高计算成本的严格限制。本文旨在开发一种高效的优化框架来解决这些挑战。
method: 引入了一个受“松弛模型理论”（Sloppy Model theory）启发的随机分层优化框架。核心是使用简化的Hessian近似来识别并针对“刚性参数子空间”，从而使用最少的模拟查询来高效地导航高度各向异性的景观。此外，该方法与概率公式相结合，直接从观测数据中导出原则性的目标损失函数，以确保严格的推理。
results: 对等离子体-表面相互作用问题的应用验证表明，该方法在样本效率方面始终优于基线优化技术。
conclusion: 该方法提供了一种通用且可扩展的工具，用于优化复杂的反应系统模型，应用范围从等离子体化学到生化网络。

title: BioACE: An Automated Framework for Biomedical Answer and Citation Evaluations
authors: Deepak Gupta, Davis Bartels, Dina Demner-Fuhsman
abstract: With the increasing use of large language models (LLMs) for generating answers to biomedical questions, it is crucial to evaluate the quality of the generated answers and the references provided to support the facts in the generated answers. Evaluation of text generated by LLMs remains a challenge for question answering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), summarization, and many other natural language processing tasks in the biomedical domain, due to the requirements of expert assessment to verify consistency with the scientific literature and complex medical terminology. In this work, we propose BioACE, an automated framework for evaluating biomedical answers and citations against the facts stated in the answers. The proposed BioACE framework considers multiple aspects, including completeness, correctness, precision, and recall, in relation to the ground-truth nuggets for answer evaluation. We developed automated approaches to evaluate each of the aforementioned aspects and performed extensive experiments to assess and analyze their correlation with human evaluations. In addition, we considered multiple existing approaches, such as natural language inference (NLI) and pre-trained language models and LLMs, to evaluate the quality of evidence provided to support the generated answers in the form of citations into biomedical literature. With the detailed experiments and analysis, we provide the best approaches for biomedical answer and citation evaluation as a part of BioACE (https://github.com/deepaknlp/BioACE) evaluation package.
zh_title: BioACE：一个用于生物医学答案和引用评估的自动化框架
translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成生物医学问题答案方面的使用日益增加，评估所生成答案的质量以及为支持答案中事实而提供的参考文献至关重要。对于生物医学领域的问答、检索增强生成（RAG）、摘要和许多其他自然语言处理任务而言，评估LLMs生成的文本仍然是一个挑战，因为需要专家评估来验证其与科学文献的一致性以及处理复杂的医学术语。在这项工作中，我们提出了 BioACE，这是一个自动化框架，用于根据答案中陈述的事实来评估生物医学答案和引用的质量。所提出的 BioACE 框架考虑了多个方面，包括完整性、正确性、精确度和召回率，并将其与用于答案评估的“事实基准块”相关联。我们开发了自动化方法来评估上述每个方面，并进行了广泛的实验来评估和分析它们与人工评估的相关性。此外，我们考虑了多种现有方法，例如自然语言推理（NLI）、预训练语言模型和大型语言模型，以评估以生物医学文献引用形式提供的证据质量，从而支持生成的答案。通过详细的实验和分析，我们提供了作为 BioACE 评估包（https://github.com/deepaknlp/BioACE）一部分的生物医学答案和引用评估的最佳方法。
tldr: 提出 BioACE 自动化框架，用于评估大型语言模型生成的生物医学答案的质量及其引用的准确性，并提供与人工评估高度相关的最佳自动化方法。
ai_comments: 创新性：BioACE 的核心创新在于提供了一个统一、多维度的自动化框架来同时评估生物医学问答的答案质量和支持引用的证据质量。它超越了简单的文本匹配，引入了诸如完整性、正确性、精确度和召回率等细致的评估指标，并尝试将这些指标与难以量化的人工专家评估相关联。重要性：在高度敏感和专业化的生物医学领域，确保大型语言模型（LLM）输出的准确性和可信度至关重要。BioACE 为检索增强生成（RAG）和问答系统提供了一个急需的、可扩展的、自动化的验证工具，有助于提高生物医学信息检索系统的可靠性。局限性（未明确提及但可推断）：尽管声称与人工评估相关性良好，但该框架的实际性能可能仍然受限于其所依赖的底层模型（如 NLI 和 LLMs）的偏见和准确性。此外，“事实基准块”（ground-truth nuggets）的构建本身可能需要大量的人工标注和专业知识。
motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在生物医学问答中的应用增加，评估生成答案的质量及其支持事实的引用至关重要。由于需要专家评估、验证科学文献一致性和处理复杂的医学术语，当前评估具有挑战性。
method: 提出了 BioACE 自动化框架。该框架通过评估完整性、正确性、精确度和召回率等多个方面来评估答案，并将其与“事实基准块”（ground-truth nuggets）进行比较。此外，它使用自然语言推理（NLI）、预训练语言模型和大型语言模型等现有方法来评估引用（证据）的质量。
results: 进行了广泛的实验，评估和分析了所提出的自动化方法与人工评估之间的相关性。确定了生物医学答案和引用评估的最佳方法。
conclusion: BioACE 框架提供了一套最佳的自动化方法，用于生物医学答案和引用的评估。

title: Parameterized Algorithms for the Drone Delivery Problem
authors: Simon Bartlmae, Andreas Hene, Joshua Könen, Heiko Röglin
abstract:
Timely delivery and optimal routing remain fundamental challenges in the modern logistics industry. Building on prior work that considers single-package delivery across networks using multiple types of collaborative agents with restricted movement areas (e.g., drones or trucks), we examine the complexity of the problem under structural and operational constraints. Our focus is on minimizing total delivery time by coordinating agents that differ in speed and movement range across a graph. This problem formulation aligns with the recently proposed Drone Delivery Problem with respect to delivery time (DDT), introduced by Erlebach et al. [ISAAC 2022].
  We first resolve an open question posed by Erlebach et al. [ISAAC 2022] by showing that even when the delivery network is a path graph, DDT admits no polynomial-time approximation within any polynomially encodable factor $a(n)$, unless P=NP. Additionally, we identify the intersection graph of the agents, where nodes represent agents and edges indicate an overlap of the movement areas of two agents, as an important structural concept. For path graphs, we show that DDT becomes tractable when parameterized by the treewidth $w$ of the intersection graph, and we present an exact FPT algorithm with running time $f(w)\cdot\text{poly}(n,k)$, for some computable function $f$. For general graphs, we give an FPT algorithm with running time $f(Δ,w)\cdot\text{poly}(n,k)$, where $Δ$ is the maximum degree of the intersection graph. In the special case where the intersection graph is a tree, we provide a simple polynomial-time algorithm.
comment: Full (extended) version of the ISAAC 2025 paper. 35 pages, 9 figures
zh_title: 无人机配送问题的参数化算法
translation: 及时配送和最优路径规划仍然是现代物流业的基本挑战。基于先前考虑使用多种类型具有受限移动区域的协作代理（例如无人机或卡车）在网络中进行单包裹配送的工作，我们研究了在结构和操作约束下该问题的复杂性。我们的重点是通过协调图上速度和移动范围不同的代理来最小化总配送时间。该问题表述与Erlebach等人[ISAAC 2022]最近提出的关于配送时间的无人机配送问题（DDT）一致。我们首先解决了Erlebach等人[ISAAC 2022]提出的一个开放问题，证明了即使当配送网络是路径图时，DDT也不存在任何多项式可编码因子 $a(n)$ 的多项式时间近似算法，除非P=NP。此外，我们确定了代理的交集图（其中节点代表代理，边表示两个代理的移动区域重叠）是一个重要的结构概念。对于路径图，我们展示了以交集图的树宽 $w$ 为参数时，DDT变得可处理，并提出了一个运行时间为 $f(w)\cdot\text{poly}(n,k)$ 的精确FPT算法，其中 $f$ 是某个可计算函数。对于一般图，我们给出了一个运行时间为 $f(\Delta,w)\cdot\text{poly}(n,k)$ 的FPT算法，其中 $\Delta$ 是交集图的最大度。在交集图是树的特殊情况下，我们提供了一个简单的多项式时间算法。
tldr: 本文研究了无人机配送问题（DDT），旨在最小化多异构协作代理（无人机和卡车）的配送总时间。首先证明了即使在路径图上，DDT也难以近似（除非P=NP）。随后，引入了代理的交集图结构，并基于该图的树宽和最大度给出了几种精确的固定参数可解（FPT）算法，从而证明了该问题在结构约束下的可解性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将强不可近似性结果与参数化算法相结合，为DDT问题提供了深刻的复杂性分析。通过引入“交集图”这一结构性概念，作者成功地识别了使问题从计算困难变得可处理的关键拓扑特性（树宽和最大度）。这种方法对于理解和解决涉及多代理协作和受限运动区域的复杂路由问题具有重要意义。
motivation: 及时配送和优化路径是现代物流业的基本挑战。本文旨在通过协调速度和移动范围不同的代理（如无人机和卡车）在图上进行配送，从而最小化总配送时间，解决最近提出的无人机配送问题（DDT）的复杂性。
method: 采用参数化算法设计。引入了代理的“交集图”作为关键结构概念，其中节点代表代理，边表示移动区域重叠。算法设计依赖于交集图的树宽 $w$ 和最大度 $\Delta$ 作为参数。
results: 1. 解决了Erlebach等人的一个开放问题，证明了即使在路径图上，DDT也不存在任何多项式可编码因子的多项式时间近似算法，除非P=NP（强不可近似性）。2. 对于路径图，提出了一个以交集图树宽 $w$ 为参数的精确FPT算法，运行时间为 $f(w)\cdot\text{poly}(n,k)$。3. 对于一般图，提出了一个以交集图的最大度 $\Delta$ 和树宽 $w$ 为参数的FPT算法，运行时间为 $f(\Delta,w)\cdot\text{poly}(n,k)$。4. 当交集图是树时，提供了一个简单的多项式时间算法。

title: Near-Optimal Dynamic Matching via Coarsening with Application to Heart Transplantation
authors: Itai Zilberstein, Ioannis Anagnostides, Zachary W. Sollie, Arman Kilic, Tuomas Sandholm
abstract: Online matching has been a mainstay in domains such as Internet advertising and organ allocation, but practical algorithms often lack strong theoretical guarantees. We take an important step toward addressing this by developing new online matching algorithms based on a coarsening approach. Although coarsening typically implies a loss of granularity, we show that, to the contrary, aggregating offline nodes into capacitated clusters can yield near-optimal theoretical guarantees. We apply our methodology to heart transplant allocation to develop theoretically grounded policies based on structural properties of historical data. In realistic simulations, our policy closely matches the performance of the omniscient benchmark. Our work bridges the gap between data-driven heuristics and pessimistic theoretical lower bounds, and provides rigorous justification for prior clustering-based approaches in organ allocation.
zh_title: 通过粗化实现近最优动态匹配及其在心脏移植中的应用
translation: 在线匹配一直是互联网广告和器官分配等领域的中流砥柱，但实用算法通常缺乏强大的理论保证。我们通过开发基于粗化方法的新型在线匹配算法，向解决这一问题迈出了重要一步。尽管粗化通常意味着粒度的损失，但我们表明，相反，将离线节点聚合成有容量的集群可以产生接近最优的理论保证。我们将我们的方法应用于心脏移植分配，以开发基于历史数据结构属性的理论基础策略。在实际模拟中，我们的策略与全知基准的性能非常接近。我们的工作弥合了数据驱动启发式算法和悲观理论下限之间的差距，并为先前器官分配中基于聚类的方法提供了严格的理由。
tldr: 该研究开发了基于粗化方法的新型在线匹配算法，实现了近最优的理论保证，并在心脏移植模拟中表现出色，弥合了启发式方法与理论之间的差距。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于证明了粗化（通常与细节损失相关）实际上可以在在线匹配中带来更好的理论保证。其在心脏移植中的应用突出了其在生命关键领域中的实际重要性，为以前的启发式方法提供了强有力的理论支持。
motivation: 在线匹配的实用算法通常缺乏强大的理论保证，尤其在器官分配等关键领域。
method: 开发了基于粗化方法的新型在线匹配算法，通过将离线节点聚合成有容量的集群来获得近最优的理论保证。将该方法应用于心脏移植分配，并基于历史数据结构属性开发了理论基础策略。
results: 粗化方法产生了近最优的理论保证。在心脏移植分配的实际模拟中，所提出的策略性能与全知基准非常接近。
conclusion: 该工作弥合了数据驱动启发式算法和悲观理论下限之间的差距，并为先前器官分配中基于聚类的方法提供了严格的理由。

title: Position: Machine Learning for Heart Transplant Allocation Policy Optimization Should Account for Incentives
authors: Ioannis Anagnostides, Itai Zilberstein, Zachary W. Sollie, Arman Kilic, Tuomas Sandholm
abstract: The allocation of scarce donor organs constitutes one of the most consequential algorithmic challenges in healthcare. While the field is rapidly transitioning from rigid, rule-based systems to machine learning and data-driven optimization, we argue that current approaches often overlook a fundamental barrier: incentives. In this position paper, we highlight that organ allocation is not merely a static optimization problem, but rather a complex game involving transplant centers, clinicians, and regulators. Focusing on US adult heart transplant allocation, we identify critical incentive misalignments across the decision-making pipeline, and present data showing that they are having adverse consequences today. Our main position is that the next generation of allocation policies should be incentive aware. We outline a research agenda for the machine learning community, calling for the integration of mechanism design, strategic classification, causal inference, and social choice to ensure robustness, efficiency, and fairness in the face of strategic behavior from the various constituent groups.
zh_title: 位置：将机器学习应用于心脏移植分配政策优化时应考虑激励因素
translation: 稀有供体器官的分配构成了医疗保健中最具影响力的算法挑战之一。虽然该领域正迅速从僵化的、基于规则的系统转向机器学习和数据驱动的优化，但我们认为当前的方法往往忽略了一个根本性的障碍：激励。在这篇立场论文中，我们强调器官分配不仅仅是一个静态优化问题，而是一个涉及移植中心、临床医生和监管机构的复杂博弈。我们聚焦于美国成人心脏移植分配，识别出决策流程中关键的激励失调，并提供数据显示它们目前正在产生不利后果。我们的主要观点是，下一代分配政策应该是激励感知的。我们为机器学习界勾勒了一个研究议程，呼吁整合机制设计、战略分类、因果推断和社会选择，以确保在面对各组成群体战略行为时系统的稳健性、效率和公平性。
tldr: 目前的机器学习器官分配模型忽略了参与者的激励问题，导致负面后果。未来的系统必须整合机制设计等技术，以应对各方的战略行为，确保公平和效率。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于强调了在器官分配优化中应考虑激励机制，这超越了传统的静态优化方法。其重要性在于指出了当前基于机器学习的分配系统可能因忽视激励而产生的负面后果。局限性在于这是一篇立场论文，主要提出观点和研究方向，而非提出一个具体的、已验证的解决方案。
motivation: 器官分配是医疗保健中最重大的算法挑战之一，但当前的基于机器学习和数据驱动的优化方法往往忽略了激励这一基本障碍。器官分配是一个涉及移植中心、临床医生和监管机构的复杂博弈，而非静态优化问题。
method: 通过关注美国成人心脏移植分配，识别决策流程中的关键激励失调，并展示了其负面影响的数据。论文提出了一个研究议程，呼吁整合机制设计、战略分类、因果推断和社会选择。
results: 识别出美国成人心脏移植分配中关键的激励失调，并展示了它们目前正在产生不利后果。
conclusion: 下一代器官分配政策必须是激励感知的（incentive aware）。

title: CVA6-CFI: A First Glance at RISC-V Control-Flow Integrity Extensions
authors: Simone Manoni, Emanuele Parisi, Riccardo Tedeschi, Davide Rossi, Andrea Acquaviva, Andrea Bartolini
abstract: This work presents the first design, integration, and evaluation of the standard RISC-V extensions for Control-Flow Integrity (CFI). The Zicfiss and Zicfilp extensions aim at protecting the execution of a vulnerable program from control-flow hijacking attacks through the implementation of security mechanisms based on shadow stack and landing pad primitives. We introduce two independent and configurable hardware units implementing forward-edge and backward-edge control-flow protection, fully integrated into the open-source CVA6 core. Our design incurs in only 1.0% area overhead when synthesized in 22 nm FDX technology, and up to 15.6% performance overhead based on evaluation with the MiBench automotive benchmark subset. We release the complete implementation as open source.
comment: Accepted as a lecture at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems. Preprint version
zh_title: CVA6-CFI：RISC-V控制流完整性扩展的初步观察
translation: 这项工作首次设计、集成和评估了用于控制流完整性（CFI）的标准RISC-V扩展。Zicfiss和Zicfilp扩展旨在通过基于影子栈和着陆垫原语的安全机制实现，保护易受攻击的程序免受控制流劫持攻击。我们将两个独立且可配置的硬件单元完全集成到开源的CVA6核心中，分别实现前向边和后向边控制流保护。在22纳米FDX技术合成时，我们的设计仅产生1.0%的面积开销，并且基于MiBench汽车基准测试子集的评估，性能开销最高可达15.6%。我们将完整的实现作为开源发布。
tldr: 首次在RISC-V的CVA6核心中集成了用于控制流完整性（CFI）的Zicfiss和Zicfilp硬件扩展，以防御劫持攻击，评估显示开销合理（1.0%面积，最高15.6%性能开销），并已开源。
ai_comments: 这项工作首次设计、集成和评估了RISC-V用于控制流完整性（CFI）的标准扩展（Zicfiss和Zicfilp）。其创新点在于将这些安全机制（基于影子栈和着陆垫原语）完全集成到开源的CVA6核心中，并提供了完整的开源实现。性能和面积开销在22nm技术下是可接受的。
motivation: 对RISC-V控制流完整性（CFI）扩展进行首次设计、集成和评估，以通过影子栈和着陆垫原语实现安全机制，保护程序免受控制流劫持攻击。
method: 设计和集成两个独立的、可配置的硬件单元，分别实现前向边和后向边控制流保护，并将其完全集成到开源的CVA6核心中。
results: 在22nm FDX技术合成时，仅产生1.0%的面积开销；基于MiBench汽车基准测试子集的评估显示，性能开销最高可达15.6%。

title: Artificial Intelligence as Strange Intelligence: Against Linear Models of Intelligence
authors: Kendra Chilson, Eric Schwitzgebel
abstract: We endorse and expand upon Susan Schneider's critique of the linear model of AI progress and introduce two novel concepts: "familiar intelligence" and "strange intelligence". AI intelligence is likely to be strange intelligence, defying familiar patterns of ability and inability, combining superhuman capacities in some domains with subhuman performance in other domains, and even within domains sometimes combining superhuman insight with surprising errors that few humans would make. We develop and defend a nonlinear model of intelligence on which "general intelligence" is not a unified capacity but instead the ability to achieve a broad range of goals in a broad range of environments, in a manner that defies nonarbitrary reduction to a single linear quantity. We conclude with implications for adversarial testing approaches to evaluating AI capacities. If AI is strange intelligence, we should expect that even the most capable systems will sometimes fail in seemingly obvious tasks. On a nonlinear model of AI intelligence, such errors on their own do not demonstrate a system's lack of outstanding general intelligence. Conversely, excellent performance on one type of task, such as an IQ test, cannot warrant assumptions of broad capacities beyond that task domain.
zh_title: 人工智能作为奇异智能：反对智能的线性模型
translation: 我们赞同并扩展了苏珊·施耐德对人工智能进展线性模型的批判，并引入了两个新颖的概念：“熟悉智能”和“奇异智能”。人工智能的智能很可能是奇异智能，它挑战了熟悉的能力和无能模式，将某些领域的超人能力与另一些领域的次人表现相结合，甚至在同一领域内，有时也会将超人洞察力与少数人类才会犯的令人惊讶的错误相结合。我们发展并捍卫了一种非线性智能模型，在这种模型上，“通用智能”不是一种统一的能力，而是在广泛环境中实现广泛目标的能力，其方式拒绝被非任意地简化为单一的线性数量。我们最后总结了这对评估人工智能能力的对抗性测试方法的影响。如果人工智能是奇异智能，我们应该预料到即使是最有能力的系统有时也会在看似明显的任务中失败。在人工智能智能的非线性模型上，仅凭此类错误并不能证明系统缺乏杰出的通用智能。反之，在某一类任务（例如智商测试）上的出色表现，也不能保证其在超出该任务领域之外具有广泛能力。
tldr: 人工智能很可能是“奇异智能”，它在不同领域的能力表现不一致，甚至在同一领域内也会犯奇怪的错误，因此不能用单一的线性模型来衡量。评估AI时不应因简单的失败而否定其通用性，也不应因单一的成功而过度泛化其能力。
ai_comments: 本文的核心创新在于引入了“奇异智能”（Strange Intelligence）的概念，有效地挑战了长期以来将AI发展视为从低到高、渐进且统一的“线性智能”观。这一观点对于理解当前大模型的特点（即“能力孤岛”和“突发性错误”）至关重要。它提供了一个更现实的框架来评估AI的通用性（AGI），强调评估必须是多维度和环境相关的，而非依赖于单一的基准或测试（如IQ测试）。其重要性在于，它为AI的评估和安全研究提供了哲学基础，警示研究人员不要因单一的失败而低估系统的整体能力，也不要因单一的成功而过度泛化其能力。
motivation: 批判并扩展苏珊·施耐德（Susan Schneider）对AI进展线性模型的批判，并引入“熟悉智能”和“奇异智能”的概念来更好地描述AI智能的本质。
method: 扩展了对AI进展线性模型的批判，引入了“熟悉智能”和“奇异智能”两个概念。发展并捍卫了一种非线性智能模型，该模型认为通用智能是实现广泛目标的能力，无法被简化为单一的线性数量。
results: 提出了AI智能很可能是“奇异智能”的论断，其特征是能力和无能的模式不熟悉，表现为在不同领域的能力不一致，甚至在同一领域内结合超人洞察力和令人惊讶的错误。探讨了这一模型对评估AI能力的对抗性测试方法的启示。
conclusion: 如果AI是奇异智能，即使是最强大的系统也可能在看似简单的任务上失败，但这种错误本身并不能证明系统缺乏杰出的通用智能。反之，在单一任务（如智商测试）上的优秀表现，也不能保证其在超出该任务领域之外具有广泛能力。这对于评估AI能力的对抗性测试方法具有重要启示。

title: A uniformly accurate multiscale time integrator for the nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation in the nonrelativistic regime via simplified transmission conditions
authors: Weizhu Bao, Caoyi Liu
abstract: We propose a new and simplified multiscale time integrator Fourier pseudospectral (MTI-FP) method for the nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation (NKGE) with a dimensionless parameter epsilon in (0,1] inversely proportional to the speed of light, and establish its uniform first-order accuracy in time in the nonrelativistic regime, i.e. 0 < epsilon << 1. In this regime, the solution of the NKGE is highly oscillatory in time with O(epsilon^2)-wavelength, which brings significant difficulties in designing uniformly accurate numerical methods. The MTI-FP is based on (i) a multiscale decomposition by frequency of the NKGE in each time interval with simplified transmission conditions, and (ii) an exponential wave integrator for temporal discretization and a Fourier pseudospectral method for spatial discretization. By adapting the energy method and the mathematical induction, we obtain two error bounds in H1-norm at O(h^{m0}+tau^2/epsilon^2) and O(h^{m0}+tau+epsilon^2) with mesh size h, time step tau and m0 an integer dependent on the regularity of the solution, which immediately implies a uniformly accurate error bound O(h^{m0}+tau) with respect to epsilon in (0,1]. In addition, by adopting a linear interpolation of the micro variables with the multiscale decomposition in each time interval, we obtain a uniformly accurate numerical solution for any time t larger than zero. Thus the proposed MTI-FP method has a super resolution property in time in terms of the Shannon sampling theory, i.e. accurate numerical solutions can be obtained even when the time step is much bigger than the O(epsilon^2)-wavelength. Extensive numerical results are reported to confirm our error bounds and demonstrate their super resolution in time. Finally the proposed MTI-FP method is applied to study numerically convergence rates of the NKGE to its different limiting models in the nonrelativistic regime.
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IMA Journal of Numerical Analysis
zh_title: 一种通过简化传输条件实现非相对论状态下非线性Klein-Gordon方程的均匀精确多尺度时间积分器
translation: 我们提出了一种新的简化的多尺度时间积分器傅里叶伪谱（MTI-FP）方法，用于求解非线性Klein-Gordon方程（NKGE），其中包含一个与光速成反比的无量纲参数$\epsilon \in (0,1]$。我们证明了该方法在非相对论状态，即$0 < \epsilon \ll 1$下，在时间上具有均匀的一阶精度。在这种状态下，NKGE的解在时间上以$O(\epsilon^2)$的波长高度振荡，这给设计均匀精确的数值方法带来了巨大的困难。MTI-FP方法基于 (i) 在每个时间间隔内通过简化的传输条件对NKGE进行频率多尺度分解，以及 (ii) 采用指数波积分器进行时间离散化和傅里叶伪谱法进行空间离散化。通过采用能量法和数学归纳法，我们获得了$H^1$范数下的两个误差界：$O(h^{m0}+\tau^2/\epsilon^2)$ 和 $O(h^{m0}+\tau+\epsilon^2)$，其中$h$是网格尺寸，$\tau$是时间步长，$m0$是依赖于解的正则性的整数。这立即意味着关于$\epsilon \in (0,1]$的均匀精确误差界为$O(h^{m0}+\tau)$。此外，通过在每个时间间隔内对微观变量采用线性插值，我们获得了对于任意大于零的时间$t$的均匀精确数值解。因此，根据香农采样理论，所提出的MTI-FP方法在时间上具有超分辨率特性，即即使时间步长远大于$O(\epsilon^2)$波长，也能获得精确的数值解。报告了大量的数值结果以证实我们的误差界并展示其在时间上的超分辨率。最后，将所提出的MTI-FP方法应用于数值研究NKGE在非相对论状态下收敛到其不同极限模型的收敛率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的MTI-FP方法，用于解决非相对论状态下高度振荡的非线性Klein-Gordon方程。该方法通过简化传输条件实现了对参数$\epsilon$的均匀精确性$O(h^{m0}+\tau)$，并具有时间上的“超分辨率”特性，即使时间步长远大于振荡波长也能获得精确解。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于设计了一种新的MTI-FP方法，通过简化传输条件，成功地解决了非相对论状态下非线性Klein-Gordon方程（NKGE）的高度振荡性带来的挑战。其重要性在于实现了独立于小参数$\epsilon$的均匀精确性$O(h^{m0}+\tau)$。特别是，该方法具有时间上的“超分辨率”特性，意味着它能够以远低于香农采样频率的要求进行采样，极大地提高了计算效率，克服了传统方法中时间步长必须受限于$O(\epsilon^2)$波长的限制。
motivation: 在非相对论状态（$0 < \epsilon \ll 1$）下，非线性Klein-Gordon方程（NKGE）的解在时间上具有$O(\epsilon^2)$波长的高度振荡性，这给设计均匀精确的数值方法带来了巨大的困难。
method: 提出了一种新的简化多尺度时间积分器傅里叶伪谱（MTI-FP）方法。该方法基于：(i) 在每个时间间隔内通过简化传输条件对NKGE进行频率多尺度分解；(ii) 采用指数波积分器进行时间离散化；(iii) 采用傅里叶伪谱法进行空间离散化。
results: (1) 获得了$H^1$范数下的两个误差界：$O(h^{m0}+\tau^2/\epsilon^2)$ 和 $O(h^{m0}+\tau+\epsilon^2)$。(2) 这立即意味着关于$\epsilon$的均匀精确误差界为$O(h^{m0}+\tau)$。(3) 通过对微观变量进行线性插值，获得了$t>0$时任意时间的均匀精确数值解。(4) 证明了该方法在时间上具有超分辨率特性，即时间步长可以远大于振荡波长。(5) 数值结果证实了误差界和超分辨率，并将其应用于研究NKGE到其极限模型的收敛率。

title: Applying Ground Robot Fleets in Urban Search: Understanding Professionals' Operational Challenges and Design Opportunities
authors: Puqi Zhou, Charles R. Twardy, Cynthia Lum, Myeong Lee, David J. Porfirio, Michael R. Hieb, Chris Thomas, Xuesu Xiao, Sungsoo Ray Hong
abstract: Urban searches demand rapid, defensible decisions and sustained physical effort under high cognitive and situational load. Incident commanders must plan, coordinate, and document time-critical operations, while field searchers execute evolving tasks in uncertain environments. With recent advances in technology, ground-robot fleets paired with computer-vision-based situational awareness and LLM-powered interfaces offer the potential to ease these operational burdens. However, no dedicated studies have examined how public safety professionals perceive such technologies or envision their integration into existing practices, risking building technically sophisticated yet impractical solutions. To address this gap, we conducted focus-group sessions with eight police officers across five local departments in Virginia. Our findings show that ground robots could reduce professionals' reliance on paper references, mental calculations, and ad-hoc coordination, alleviating cognitive and physical strain in four key challenge areas: (1) partitioning the workforce across multiple search hypotheses, (2) retaining group awareness and situational awareness, (3) building route planning that fits the lost-person profile, and (4) managing cognitive and physical fatigue under uncertainty. We further identify four design opportunities and requirements for future ground-robot fleet integration in public-safety operations: (1) scalable multi-robot planning and control interfaces, (2) agency-specific route optimization, (3) real-time replanning informed by debrief updates, and (4) vision-assisted cueing that preserves operational trust while reducing cognitive workload. We conclude with design implications for deployable, accountable, and human-centered urban-search support systems
zh_title: 城市搜索中的地面机器人车队应用：理解专业人员的操作挑战和设计机遇
translation: 城市搜救需要快速、可靠的决策以及在高认知和情境负荷下持续的体能付出。事故指挥官必须规划、协调和记录时间关键的操作，而现场搜救人员则在不确定的环境中执行不断变化的 任务。随着技术的最新进展，配备计算机视觉态势感知和LLM驱动界面的地面机器人车队有潜力减轻这些操作负担。然而，目前还没有专门的研究考察公共安全专业人员如何看待这些技术或设想它们如何融入现有实践，这可能导致开发出技术上先进但实际上不可行的解决方案。为了解决这一差距，我们对弗吉尼亚州五个地方部门的八名警官进行了焦点小组会议。我们的研究结果表明，地面机器人可以减少专业人员对纸质参考资料、心算和临时协调的依赖，从而在四个关键挑战领域减轻认知和体力负担：（1）将劳动力分配给多个搜索假设，（2）保持团队意识和态势感知，（3）建立符合失踪人员特征的路线规划，以及（4) 在不确定的情况下管理认知和体力疲劳。我们进一步确定了未来在公共安全操作中整合地面机器人车队所需的四个设计机会和要求：（1）可扩展的多机器人规划和控制界面，（2）特定机构的路线优化，（3）受汇报更新信息影响的实时重新规划，以及（4）在减轻认知负荷的同时保持操作信任的视觉辅助提示。最后，我们为可部署、可问责和以人为本的城市搜救支持系统提供了设计启示。
tldr: 本研究通过焦点小组访谈，探讨了地面机器人车队在城市搜救中的应用潜力，并识别了专业人员面临的操作挑战和未来设计机会。
ai_comments: 这项研究具有重要的实践意义，它弥合了技术发展与实际操作需求之间的差距。通过深入了解一线专业人员的挑战和需求，为开发真正有效且易于集成的机器人搜救系统提供了宝贵的见解。然而，研究样本量较小，未来需要更大规模的验证。
motivation: 现有研究缺乏对公共安全专业人员如何看待和整合地面机器人车队技术的关注，可能导致开发出不切实际的解决方案。
method: 通过与来自弗吉尼亚州五个地方部门的八名警官进行焦点小组讨论，收集了他们对地面机器人车队在城市搜救中应用的看法。
results: 研究发现，地面机器人可以减轻专业人员在劳动力分配、态势感知、路线规划和疲劳管理方面的认知和体力负担。同时，也指出了可扩展的多机器人规划与控制界面、特定机构的路线优化、实时重新规划以及视觉辅助提示等设计机会。
conclusion: 为了开发可部署、负责任且以人为本的城市搜救支持系统，需要考虑可扩展的界面、特定机构的优化、实时重新规划和信任的视觉辅助。

title: EntRGi: Entropy Aware Reward Guidance for Diffusion Language Models
authors: Atula Tejaswi, Litu Rout, Constantine Caramanis, Sanjay Shakkottai, Sujay Sanghavi
abstract: Reward guidance has been applied to great success in the test-time adaptation of continuous diffusion models; it updates each denoising step using the gradients from a downstream reward model. We study reward guidance for discrete diffusion language models, where one cannot differentiate through the natural outputs of the model because they are discrete tokens. Existing approaches either replace these discrete tokens with continuous relaxations, or employ techniques like the straight-through estimator. In this work, we show the downsides of both these methods. The former degrades gradient feedback because the reward model has never been trained with continuous inputs. The latter involves incorrect optimization because the gradient evaluated at discrete tokens is used to update continuous logits. Our key innovation is to go beyond this tradeoff by introducing a novel mechanism called EntRGi: Entropy aware Reward Guidance that dynamically regulates the gradients from the reward model. By modulating the continuous relaxation using the model's confidence, our approach substantially improves reward guidance while providing reliable inputs to the reward model. We empirically validate our approach on a 7B-parameter diffusion language model across 3 diverse reward models and 3 multi-skill benchmarks, showing consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods.
zh_title: 面向扩散语言模型的熵感知奖励引导（EntRGi）
translation: 奖励引导（Reward guidance）已在连续扩散模型的测试时适应中取得了巨大的成功；它使用下游奖励模型的梯度来更新每个去噪步骤。我们研究了奖励引导在离散扩散语言模型中的应用，在其中我们无法区分模型的自然输出，因为它们是离散的token。现有方法要么用连续松弛替换这些离散token，要么采用诸如直通估计器（straight-through estimator）之类的技术。在工作中，我们展示了这两种方法的弊端。前者由于奖励模型从未用连续输入进行训练而导致梯度反馈退化。后者涉及不正确的优化，因为在离散token处评估的梯度被用于更新连续的logits。我们的关键创新是通过引入一种名为EntRGi：熵感知奖励引导的新颖机制来超越这种权衡，该机制可以动态调节来自奖励模型的梯度。通过用模型的置信度调节连续松弛，我们的方法在提供可靠的奖励模型输入的同时，大幅提高了奖励引导的性能。我们在一个7B参数的扩散语言模型上，针对3个不同的奖励模型和3个多技能基准测试，实证验证了我们的方法，显示出相对于现有最先进方法的持续改进。
tldr: 针对扩散语言模型中奖励引导的困难（现有方法有梯度退化或优化错误），我们提出了EntRGi，它通过根据模型置信度动态调整奖励梯度来改善引导效果，并在实验中一致性地超越了现有SOTA方法。
ai_comments: EntRGi的创新点在于动态调节奖励模型的梯度，通过结合模型的置信度来调制连续松弛，解决了现有方法中梯度反馈退化或优化不正确的问题。该方法在多个基准测试中展示了优于现有技术的一致性提升，具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有方法在离散扩散语言模型中应用奖励引导时存在缺陷：使用连续松弛会导致奖励模型未在连续输入上训练而退化梯度反馈；使用直通估计器会导致用离散令牌处的梯度更新连续对数，造成优化不正确。
method: 引入了一种名为EntRGi（Entropy aware Reward Guidance）的新颖机制，它通过模型的置信度动态调节奖励模型的梯度，从而调节连续松弛。
results: 在7B参数的扩散语言模型上，使用3个不同的奖励模型和3个多技能基准测试，EntRGi一致性地优于现有最先进的方法。

title: SIDeR: Semantic Identity Decoupling for Unrestricted Face Privacy
authors: Zhuosen Bao, Xia Du, Zheng Lin, Jizhe Zhou, Zihan Fang, Jiening Wu, Yuxin Zhang, Zhe Chen, Chi-man Pun, Wei Ni, Jun Luo
abstract: With the deep integration of facial recognition into online banking, identity verification, and other networked services, achieving effective decoupling of identity information from visual representations during image storage and transmission has become a critical challenge for privacy protection. To address this issue, we propose SIDeR, a Semantic decoupling-driven framework for unrestricted face privacy protection. SIDeR decomposes a facial image into a machine-recognizable identity feature vector and a visually perceptible semantic appearance component. By leveraging semantic-guided recomposition in the latent space of a diffusion model, it generates visually anonymous adversarial faces while maintaining machine-level identity consistency. The framework incorporates momentum-driven unrestricted perturbation optimization and a semantic-visual balancing factor to synthesize multiple visually diverse, highly natural adversarial samples. Furthermore, for authorized access, the protected image can be restored to its original form when the correct password is provided. Extensive experiments on the CelebA-HQ and FFHQ datasets demonstrate that SIDeR achieves a 99% attack success rate in black-box scenarios and outperforms baseline methods by 41.28% in PSNR-based restoration quality.
zh_title: 无限制人脸隐私的语义身份解耦
translation: 随着人脸识别技术在在线银行、身份验证和其他网络服务中的深度融合，在图像存储和传输过程中实现身份信息与视觉表示的有效分离，已成为隐私保护的关键挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SIDeR，一个面向无限制人脸隐私保护的语义解耦驱动框架。SIDeR将人脸图像分解为机器可识别的身份特征向量和视觉上可感知的语义外观组件。利用扩散模型潜在空间中的语义引导重构，它在保持机器级身份一致性的同时，生成视觉上匿名的对抗性人脸。该框架结合了动量驱动的无限制扰动优化和语义-视觉平衡因子，以合成多个视觉上多样化、高度自然化的对抗性样本。此外，对于授权访问，当提供正确的密码时，受保护的图像可以恢复为原始形式。在CelebA-HQ和FFHQ数据集上的广泛实验表明，SIDeR在黑盒场景下实现了99%的攻击成功率，并且在基于PSNR的恢复质量上比基线方法提高了41.28%。
tldr: SIDeR框架通过将人脸图像分解为身份特征和视觉外观，并利用扩散模型的潜在空间进行重构，生成视觉上匿名但身份一致的对抗性人脸。该框架还支持使用密码进行原始图像恢复，并在实验中表现出色。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的人脸隐私保护方法SIDeR，通过语义身份解耦和扩散模型重构，在匿名化视觉信息的同时保留身份可识别性，并支持可控的图像恢复。方法具有创新性，实验结果令人信服，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力。
motivation: 随着人脸识别技术在网络服务中的广泛应用，如何在图像存储和传输过程中实现身份信息与视觉表示的有效分离，以保护隐私，已成为一个关键挑战。
method: SIDeR框架将人脸图像分解为可机器识别的身份特征向量和视觉上可感知的语义外观组件。利用扩散模型的潜在空间进行语义引导的重构，生成视觉上匿名但保持机器级身份一致性的对抗性人脸。该框架结合了动量驱动的无限制扰动优化和语义-视觉平衡因子，以合成多个视觉上多样化且高度自然的对抗性样本。此外，对于授权访问，在提供正确密码时可以恢复原始图像。
results: 在CelebA-HQ和FFHQ数据集上的广泛实验表明，SIDeR在黑盒场景下实现了99%的攻击成功率，并且在基于PSNR的恢复质量上比基线方法提高了41.28%。
conclusion: SIDeR框架成功地实现了身份信息与视觉表示的分离，在保护人脸隐私的同时，保证了身份的可识别性，并在图像恢复质量和对抗性样本生成方面取得了优异的性能。

title: Learning Rate Matters: Vanilla LoRA May Suffice for LLM Fine-tuning
authors: Yu-Ang Lee, Ching-Yun Ko, Pin-Yu Chen, Mi-Yen Yeh
abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is the prevailing approach for efficient large language model (LLM) fine-tuning. Building on this paradigm, recent studies have proposed alternative initialization strategies and architectural modifications, reporting substantial improvements over vanilla LoRA. However, these gains are often demonstrated under fixed or narrowly tuned hyperparameter settings, despite the known sensitivity of neural networks to training configurations. In this work, we systematically re-evaluate four representative LoRA variants alongside vanilla LoRA through extensive hyperparameter searches. Across mathematical and code generation tasks on diverse model scales, we find that different LoRA methods favor distinct learning rate ranges. Crucially, once learning rates are properly tuned, all methods achieve similar peak performance (within 1-2%), with only subtle rank-dependent behaviors. These results suggest that vanilla LoRA remains a competitive baseline and that improvements reported under single training configuration may not reflect consistent methodological advantages. Finally, a second-order analysis attributes the differing optimal learning rate ranges to variations in the largest Hessian eigenvalue, aligning with classical learning theories.
zh_title: 学习率很重要：基础LoRA对于LLM微调可能就足够了
translation: 低秩适应（LoRA）是高效大语言模型（LLM）微调的流行方法。在此范式的基础上，最近的研究提出了替代的初始化策略和架构修改，报告了相对于基础LoRA的显著改进。然而，这些增益通常是在固定或狭窄调优的超参数设置下展示的，尽管已知神经网络对训练配置很敏感。在这项工作中，我们通过广泛的超参数搜索，系统地重新评估了四种具有代表性的LoRA变体以及基础LoRA。在跨越不同模型规模的数学和代码生成任务中，我们发现不同的LoRA方法偏爱不同的学习率范围。至关重要的是，一旦学习率得到适当调优，所有方法都能达到相似的峰值性能（在1-2%以内），仅表现出微妙的秩依赖行为。这些结果表明，基础LoRA仍然是一个有竞争力的基线，并且在单一训练配置下报告的改进可能没有反映出一致的方法论优势。最后，二阶分析将不同的最优学习率范围归因于最大Hessian特征值的变化，这与经典学习理论一致。
tldr: 别相信那些声称改进了LoRA的方法，因为它们的优势可能只是因为恰好选对了学习率。当你把Vanilla LoRA的学习率也调到最优时，它和其他花哨的变体表现一样好。学习率调优才是关键。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于系统性地重新评估了不同的LoRA变体，并强调了学习率调优的重要性，挑战了先前研究中声称的改进效果。其重要性在于确认了基础的Vanilla LoRA在充分调优后依然是一个强大的基线。限制在于评估主要集中在数学和代码生成任务上。
motivation: 最近的研究提出了替代的LoRA初始化策略和架构修改，并声称取得了显著改进，但这些改进通常是在固定或狭窄调优的超参数设置下展示的，而LoRA已知对训练配置敏感。因此，需要系统地重新评估这些变体。
method: 通过对四种代表性的LoRA变体和Vanilla LoRA进行广泛的超参数搜索，并在数学和代码生成任务上评估了不同模型规模下的性能。此外，还进行了二阶分析，将最优学习率范围的差异归因于最大Hessian特征值的变化。
results: 研究发现不同的LoRA方法偏爱不同的学习率范围。一旦学习率得到适当调优，所有方法都实现了相似的峰值性能（在1-2%以内），只有轻微的秩依赖行为。二阶分析将最优学习率范围的差异归因于最大Hessian特征值的变化。
conclusion: 一旦学习率得到适当调优，所有不同的LoRA方法都能达到相似的峰值性能（1-2%的差异内），这表明Vanilla LoRA仍然是一个有竞争力的基线，并且先前报告的改进可能没有反映出一致的方法论优势。

title: System-Level Isolation for Mixed-Criticality RISC-V SoCs: A "World" Reality Check
authors: Luis Cunha, Jose Martins, Manuel Rodriguez, Tiago Gomes, Sandro Pinto, Uwe Moslehner, Kai Dieffenbach, Glenn Farrall, Kajetan Nuernberger, Thomas Roecker
abstract: As RISC-V adoption accelerates, domains such as automotive, the Internet of Things (IoT), and industrial control are attracting growing attention. These domains are subject to stringent Size, Weight, Power, and Cost (SWaP-C) constraints, which have driven a shift toward heterogeneous Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) integrating general-purpose CPUs, tightly coupled accelerators, and diverse I/O devices with different integrity levels. While such integration improves cost efficiency and performance, it introduces a fundamental safety and security challenge: enforcing system-level isolation in mixed-criticality environments. Although RISC-V International has proposed several hardware isolation primitives, including RISC-V Worlds, IOPMP, and SmMTT, their interoperability, scalability, and suitability for real-time systems remain insufficiently understood. In this paper, we present a comparative analysis of these primitives from the perspective of practical heterogeneous SoC designs. We implement an IOPMP, a World-based checker, and a modified RISC-V World checker that addresses key limitations of the baseline specification, and evaluate their trade-offs in terms of security guarantees and power-performance-area (PPA). Our results show that the World-based checker introduces a fixed, configuration-independent access latency, achieving lower worst-case delay than the evaluated alternatives while scaling predictably with system size. At the macro level, we estimate that the proposed modifications reduce SoC area by up to approximately 5% compared to a baseline design. All artifacts will be released as open source, and we expect these findings to directly contribute to the evolution and ratification of RISC-V specifications, as well as to the design of future RISC-V SoCs.

title: Enhanced QKNorm normalization for neural transformers with the Lp norm
authors: Ezequiel Lopez-Rubio, Javier Montes-Perez, Esteban Jose Palomo
abstract: The normalization of query and key vectors is an essential part of the Transformer architecture. It ensures that learning is stable regardless of the scale of these vectors. Some normalization approaches are available. In this preliminary work, a generalization of the QKNorm normalization scheme is proposed. The approach is based on the Lp norm, allowing non-Euclidean norms to be employed. Experimental results demonstrate the suitability of the method for a simple problem.

title: CoWork-X: Experience-Optimized Co-Evolution for Multi-Agent Collaboration System
authors: Zexin Lin, Jiachen Yu, Haoyang Zhang, Yuzhao Li, Zhonghang Li, Yujiu Yang, Junjie Wang, Xiaoqiang Ji
abstract: Large language models are enabling language-conditioned agents in interactive environments, but highly cooperative tasks often impose two simultaneous constraints: sub-second real-time coordination and sustained multi-episode adaptation under a strict online token budget. Existing approaches either rely on frequent in-episode reasoning that induces latency and timing jitter, or deliver post-episode improvements through unstructured text that is difficult to compile into reliable low-cost execution. We propose CoWork-X, an active co-evolution framework that casts peer collaboration as a closed-loop optimization problem across episodes, inspired by fast--slow memory separation. CoWork-X instantiates a Skill-Agent that executes via HTN (hierarchical task network)-based skill retrieval from a structured, interpretable, and compositional skill library, and a post-episode Co-Optimizer that performs patch-style skill consolidation with explicit budget constraints and drift regularization. Experiments in challenging Overcooked-AI-like realtime collaboration benchmarks demonstrate that CoWork-X achieves stable, cumulative performance gains while steadily reducing online latency and token usage.

title: Signal or 'Noise': Human Reactions to Robot Errors in the Wild
authors: Maia Stiber, Sameer Khan, Russell Taylor, Chien-Ming Huang
abstract: In the real world, robots frequently make errors, yet little is known about people's social responses to errors outside of lab settings. Prior work has shown that social signals are reliable and useful for error management in constrained interactions, but it is unclear if this holds in the real world - especially with a non-social robot in repeated and group interactions with successive or propagated errors. To explore this, we built a coffee robot and conducted a public field deployment ($N = 49$). We found that participants consistently expressed varied social signals in response to errors and other stimuli, particularly during group interactions. Our findings suggest that social signals in the wild are rich (with participants volunteering information about the interaction), but "noisy." We discuss lessons, benefits, and challenges for using social signals in real-world HRI.

title: Private PoEtry: Private In-Context Learning via Product of Experts
authors: Rob Romijnders, Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani, Jonathan Petit, Max Welling, Christos Louizos, Yuki M. Asano
abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to new tasks with only a small set of examples at inference time, thereby avoiding task-specific fine-tuning. However, in-context examples may contain privacy-sensitive information that should not be revealed through model outputs. Existing differential privacy (DP) approaches to ICL are either computationally expensive or rely on heuristics with limited effectiveness, including context oversampling, synthetic data generation, or unnecessary thresholding. We reformulate private ICL through the lens of a Product-of-Experts model. This gives a theoretically grounded framework, and the algorithm can be trivially parallelized. We evaluate our method across five datasets in text classification, math, and vision-language. We find that our method improves accuracy by more than 30 percentage points on average compared to prior DP-ICL methods, while maintaining strong privacy guarantees.

title: Acoustic scattering by fractal inhomogeneities via geometry-conforming Galerkin methods for the Lippmann-Schwinger equation
authors: Joshua Bannister, David P. Hewett, Andrew Gibbs
abstract: We propose and analyse a numerical method for time-harmonic acoustic scattering in $\mathbb{R}^n$, $n=2,3$, by a class of inhomogeneities (penetrable scatterers) with fractal boundary. Our method is based on a Galerkin discretisation of the Lippmann-Schwinger volume integral equation, using a discontinuous piecewise-polynomial approximation space on a geometry-conforming mesh comprising elements which themselves have fractal boundary. We first provide a semi-discrete well-posedness and error analysis for both the $h$- and $p$-versions of our method for completely arbitrary inhomogeneities (without any regularity assumption on the boundary of the inhomogeneity or of the mesh elements). We prove convergence estimates for the integral equation solution and superconvergence estimates for linear functionals such as scattered field and far-field pattern evaluations, and elucidate how the regularity of the inhomogeneity boundary and the regularity of the refractive index affect the rates of convergence predicted. We then specialise to the case where the inhomogeneity is an ``$n$-attractor'', i.e.\ the fractal attractor of an iterated function system satisfying the open set condition with non-empty interior, showing how in this case the self-similarity of the inhomogeneity can be used to generate geometry-conforming meshes. For the $h$-version with piecewise constant approximation we also present singular quadrature rules, supported by a fully discrete error analysis, permitting practical implementation of our method. We present numerical results for two-dimensional examples, which validate our theoretical results and show that our method is significantly more accurate than a comparable method involving replacement of the fractal inhomogeneity by a smoother prefractal approximation.

title: From Fragmentation to Integration: Exploring the Design Space of AI Agents for Human-as-the-Unit Privacy Management
authors: Eryue Xu, Tianshi Li
abstract: Managing one's digital footprint is overwhelming, as it spans multiple platforms and involves countless context-dependent decisions. Recent advances in agentic AI offer ways forward by enabling holistic, contextual privacy-enhancing solutions. Building on this potential, we adopted a ''human-as-the-unit'' perspective and investigated users' cross-context privacy challenges through 12 semi-structured interviews. Results reveal that people rely on ad hoc manual strategies while lacking comprehensive privacy controls, highlighting nine privacy-management challenges across applications, temporal contexts, and relationships. To explore solutions, we generated nine AI agent concepts and evaluated them via a speed-dating survey with 116 US participants. The three highest-ranked concepts were all post-sharing management tools with half or full agent autonomy, with users expressing greater trust in AI accuracy than in their own efforts. Our findings highlight a promising design space where users see AI agents bridging the fragments in privacy management, particularly through automated, comprehensive post-sharing remediation of users' digital footprints.

title: DeepRead: Document Structure-Aware Reasoning to Enhance Agentic Search
authors: Zhanli Li, Huiwen Tian, Lvzhou Luo, Yixuan Cao, Ping Luo
abstract: With the rapid progress of tool-using and agentic large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is evolving from one-shot, passive retrieval into multi-turn, decision-driven evidence acquisition. Despite strong results in open-domain settings, existing agentic search frameworks commonly treat long documents as flat collections of chunks, underutilizing document-native priors such as hierarchical organization and sequential discourse structure. We introduce DeepRead, a structure-aware, multi-turn document reasoning agent that explicitly operationalizes these priors for long-document question answering. DeepRead leverages LLM-based OCR model to convert PDFs into structured Markdown that preserves headings and paragraph boundaries. It then indexes documents at the paragraph level and assigns each paragraph a coordinate-style metadata key encoding its section identity and in-section order. Building on this representation, DeepRead equips the LLM with two complementary tools: a Retrieve tool that localizes relevant paragraphs while exposing their structural coordinates (with lightweight scanning context), and a ReadSection tool that enables contiguous, order-preserving reading within a specified section and paragraph range. Our experiments demonstrate that DeepRead achieves significant improvements over Search-o1-style agentic search in document question answering. The synergistic effect between retrieval and reading tools is also validated. Our fine-grained behavioral analysis reveals a reading and reasoning paradigm resembling human-like ``locate then read'' behavior.
comment: This work is currently in progress

title: Untwisting RoPE: Frequency Control for Shared Attention in DiTs
authors: Aryan Mikaeili, Or Patashnik, Andrea Tagliasacchi, Daniel Cohen-Or, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri
abstract: Positional encodings are essential to transformer-based generative models, yet their behavior in multimodal and attention-sharing settings is not fully understood. In this work, we present a principled analysis of Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE), showing that RoPE naturally decomposes into frequency components with distinct positional sensitivities. We demonstrate that this frequency structure explains why shared-attention mechanisms, where a target image is generated while attending to tokens from a reference image, can lead to reference copying, in which the model reproduces content from the reference instead of extracting only its stylistic cues. Our analysis reveals that the high-frequency components of RoPE dominate the attention computation, forcing queries to attend mainly to spatially aligned reference tokens and thereby inducing this unintended copying behavior. Building on these insights, we introduce a method for selectively modulating RoPE frequency bands so that attention reflects semantic similarity rather than strict positional alignment. Applied to modern transformer-based diffusion architectures, where all tokens share attention, this modulation restores stable and meaningful shared attention. As a result, it enables effective control over the degree of style transfer versus content copying, yielding a proper style-aligned generation process in which stylistic attributes are transferred without duplicating reference content.

title: A Simple Reduction Scheme for Constrained Contextual Bandits with Adversarial Contexts via Regression
authors: Dhruv Sarkar, Abhishek Sinha
abstract: We study constrained contextual bandits (CCB) with adversarially chosen contexts, where each action yields a random reward and incurs a random cost. We adopt the standard realizability assumption: conditioned on the observed context, rewards and costs are drawn independently from fixed distributions whose expectations belong to known function classes. We consider the continuing setting, in which the algorithm operates over the entire horizon even after the budget is exhausted. In this setting, the objective is to simultaneously control regret and cumulative constraint violation. Building on the seminal SquareCB framework of Foster et al. (2018), we propose a simple and modular algorithmic scheme that leverages online regression oracles to reduce the constrained problem to a standard unconstrained contextual bandit problem with adaptively defined surrogate reward functions. In contrast to most prior work on CCB, which focuses on stochastic contexts, our reduction yields improved guarantees for the more general adversarial context setting, together with a compact and transparent analysis.

title: COFFEE: A Carbon-Modeling and Optimization Framework for HZO-based FeFET eNVMs
authors: Hongbang Wu, Xuesi Chen, Shubham Jadhav, Amit Lal, Lillian Pentecost, Udit Gupta
abstract: Information and communication technologies account for a growing portion of global environmental impacts. While emerging technologies, such as emerging non-volatile memories (eNVM), offer a promising solution to energy efficient computing, their end-to-end footprint is not well understood. Understanding the environmental impact of hardware systems over their life cycle is the first step to realizing sustainable computing. This work conducts a detailed study of one example eNVM device: hafnium-zirconium-oxide (HZO)-based ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs). We present COFFEE, the first carbon modeling framework for HZO-based FeFET eNVMs across life cycle, from hardware manufacturing (embodied carbon) to use (operational carbon). COFFEE builds on data gathered from a real semiconductor fab and device fabrication recipes to estimate embodied carbon, and architecture level eNVM design space exploration tools to quantify use-phase performance and energy. Our evaluation shows that, at 2 MB capacity, the embodied carbon per unit area overhead of HZO-FeFETs can be up to 11% higher than the CMOS baseline, while the embodied carbon per MB remains consistently about 4.3x lower than SRAM across different memory capacity. A further case study applies COFFEE to an edge ML accelerator, showing that replacing the SRAM-based weight buffer with HZO-based FeFET eNVMs reduces embodied carbon by 42.3% and operational carbon by up to 70%.

title: A novel scalable high performance diffusion solver for multiscale cell simulations
authors: Jose-Luis Estragues-Muñoz, Carlos Alvarez, Arnau Montagud, Daniel Jimenez-Gonzalez, Alfonso Valencia
abstract: Agent-based cellular models simulate tissue evolution by capturing the behavior of individual cells, their interactions with neighboring cells, and their responses to the surrounding microenvironment. An important challenge in the field is scaling cellular resolution models to real-scale tumor simulations, which is critical for the development of digital twin models of diseases and requires the use of High-Performance Computing (HPC) since every time step involves trillions of operations. We hereby present a scalable HPC solution for the molecular diffusion modeling using an efficient implementation of state-of-the-art Finite Volume Method (FVM) frameworks. The paper systematically evaluates a novel scalable Biological Finite Volume Method (BioFVM) library and presents an extensive performance analysis of the available solutions. Results shows that our HPC proposal reach almost 200x speedup and up to 36% reduction in memory usage over the current state-of-the-art solutions, paving the way to efficiently compute the next generation of biological problems.

title: Laws of Learning Dynamics and the Core of Learners
authors: Inkee Jung, Siu Cheong Lau
abstract: We formulate the fundamental laws governing learning dynamics, namely the conservation law and the decrease of total entropy. Within this framework, we introduce an entropy-based lifelong ensemble learning method. We evaluate its effectiveness by constructing an immunization mechanism to defend against transfer-based adversarial attacks on the CIFAR-10 dataset. Compared with a naive ensemble formed by simply averaging models specialized on clean and adversarial samples, the resulting logifold achieves higher accuracy in most test cases, with particularly large gains under strong perturbations.

title: Do Vision-Language Models Respect Contextual Integrity in Location Disclosure?
authors: Ruixin Yang, Ethan Mendes, Arthur Wang, James Hays, Sauvik Das, Wei Xu, Alan Ritter
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in image geolocation, a capability further sharpened by frontier multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs). This poses a significant privacy risk, as these widely accessible models can be exploited to infer sensitive locations from casually shared photos, often at street-level precision, potentially surpassing the level of detail the sharer consented or intended to disclose. While recent work has proposed applying a blanket restriction on geolocation disclosure to combat this risk, these measures fail to distinguish valid geolocation uses from malicious behavior. Instead, VLMs should maintain contextual integrity by reasoning about elements within an image to determine the appropriate level of information disclosure, balancing privacy and utility. To evaluate how well models respect contextual integrity, we introduce VLM-GEOPRIVACY, a benchmark that challenges VLMs to interpret latent social norms and contextual cues in real-world images and determine the appropriate level of location disclosure. Our evaluation of 14 leading VLMs shows that, despite their ability to precisely geolocate images, the models are poorly aligned with human privacy expectations. They often over-disclose in sensitive contexts and are vulnerable to prompt-based attacks. Our results call for new design principles in multimodal systems to incorporate context-conditioned privacy reasoning.

title: AudioSAE: Towards Understanding of Audio-Processing Models with Sparse AutoEncoders
authors: Georgii Aparin, Tasnima Sadekova, Alexey Rukhovich, Assel Yermekova, Laida Kushnareva, Vadim Popov, Kristian Kuznetsov, Irina Piontkovskaya
abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are powerful tools for interpreting neural representations, yet their use in audio remains underexplored. We train SAEs across all encoder layers of Whisper and HuBERT, provide an extensive evaluation of their stability, interpretability, and show their practical utility. Over 50% of the features remain consistent across random seeds, and reconstruction quality is preserved. SAE features capture general acoustic and semantic information as well as specific events, including environmental noises and paralinguistic sounds (e.g. laughter, whispering) and disentangle them effectively, requiring removal of only 19-27% of features to erase a concept. Feature steering reduces Whisper's false speech detections by 70% with negligible WER increase, demonstrating real-world applicability. Finally, we find SAE features correlated with human EEG activity during speech perception, indicating alignment with human neural processing. The code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/audiosae/audiosae_demo.

title: Laplacian Representations for Decision-Time Planning
authors: Dikshant Shehmar, Matthew Schlegel, Matthew E. Taylor, Marlos C. Machado
abstract: Planning with a learned model remains a key challenge in model-based reinforcement learning (RL). In decision-time planning, state representations are critical as they must support local cost computation while preserving long-horizon structure.
