To establish a judge-independent reference, we introduce a consensus-deviation metric that eliminates circularity by comparing each judge's score to the mean of all other judges, yielding a theoretically grounded measure of self-evaluation and cross-model deviation. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity: GPT-5.1 and Claude 4.5 Sonnet show negative self-evaluation bias (-0.33, -0.31), while Gemini-2.5 Pro and Grok 4 display positive bias (+0.77, +0.71), with bias attenuating by 25.8 percent under anonymization. Evaluation by 26 payment-industry experts shows LLM judges assign scores averaging +0.46 points above human consensus, and that the negative bias of GPT-5.1 and Claude 4.5 Sonnet reflects closer alignment with human judgment. Ground-truth validation using payment-network data shows four models exhibit statistically significant alignment (Spearman rho = 0.56 to 0.77), confirming that the framework captures genuine quality. Overall, the framework provides a replicable basis for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge systems in payment-risk workflows and highlights the need for bias-aware protocols in operational financial settings.

title: Scalable Generation and Validation of Isomorphic Physics Problems with GenAI
authors: Naiming Liu, Leo Murch, Spencer Moore, Tong Wan, Shashank Sonkar, Richard Baraniuk, Zhongzhou Chen
abstract: Traditional synchronous STEM assessments face growing challenges including accessibility barriers, security concerns from resource-sharing platforms, and limited comparability across institutions. We present a framework for generating and evaluating large-scale isomorphic physics problem banks using Generative AI to enable asynchronous, multi-attempt assessments. Isomorphic problems test identical concepts through varied surface features and contexts, providing richer variation than conventional parameterized questions while maintaining consistent difficulty. Our generation framework employs prompt chaining and tool use to achieve precise control over structural variations (numeric values, spatial relations) alongside diverse contextual variations. For pre-deployment validation, we evaluate generated items using 17 open-source language models (LMs) (0.6B-32B) and compare against actual student performance (N>200) across three midterm exams. Results show that 73% of deployed banks achieve statistically homogeneous difficulty, and LMs pattern correlate strongly with student performance (Pearson's $ρ$ up to 0.594). Additionally, LMs successfully identify problematic variants, such as ambiguous problem texts. Model scale also proves critical for effective validation, where extremely small (<4B) and large (>14B) models exhibit floor and ceiling effects respectively, making mid-sized models optimal for detecting difficulty outliers.

title: Unbiased Single-Queried Gradient for Combinatorial Objective
authors: Thanawat Sornwanee
abstract: In a probabilistic reformulation of a combinatorial problem, we often face an optimization over a hypercube, which corresponds to the Bernoulli probability parameter for each binary variable in the primal problem. The combinatorial nature suggests that an exact gradient computation requires multiple queries. We propose a stochastic gradient that is unbiased and requires only a single query of the combinatorial function. This method encompasses a well-established REINFORCE (through an importance sampling), as well as including a class of new stochastic gradients.

title: SocialVeil: Probing Social Intelligence of Language Agents under Communication Barriers
authors: Keyang Xuan, Pengda Wang, Chongrui Ye, Haofei Yu, Tal August, Jiaxuan You
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated in interactive environments to test their social intelligence. However, existing benchmarks often assume idealized communication between agents, limiting our ability to diagnose whether LLMs can maintain and repair interactions in more realistic, imperfect settings. To close this gap, we present \textsc{SocialVeil}, a social learning environment that can simulate social interaction under cognitive-difference-induced communication barriers. Grounded in a systematic literature review of communication challenges in human interaction, \textsc{SocialVeil} introduces three representative types of such disruption, \emph{semantic vagueness}, \emph{sociocultural mismatch}, and \emph{emotional interference}. We also introduce two barrier-aware evaluation metrics, \emph{unresolved confusion} and \emph{mutual understanding}, to evaluate interaction quality under impaired communication. Experiments across 720 scenarios and four frontier LLMs show that barriers consistently impair performance, with mutual understanding reduced by over 45\% on average, and confusion elevated by nearly 50\%. Human evaluations validate the fidelity of these simulated barriers (ICC$\approx$0.78, Pearson r$\approx$0.80). We further demonstrate that adaptation strategies (Repair Instruction and Interactive learning) only have a modest effect far from barrier-free performance. This work takes a step toward bringing social interaction environments closer to real-world communication, opening opportunities for exploring the social intelligence of LLM agents.

title: GPU-to-Grid: Voltage Regulation via GPU Utilization Control
authors: Zhirui Liang, Jae-Won Chung, Mosharaf Chowdhury, Jiasi Chen, Vladimir Dvorkin
abstract: While the rapid expansion of data centers poses challenges for power grids, it also offers new opportunities as potentially flexible loads. Existing power system research often abstracts data centers as aggregate resources, while computer system research primarily focuses on optimizing GPU energy efficiency and largely ignores the grid impacts of optimized GPU power consumption. To bridge this gap, we develop a GPU-to-Grid framework that couples device-level GPU control with power system objectives. We study distribution-level voltage regulation enabled by flexibility in LLM inference, using batch size as a control knob that trades off the voltage impacts of GPU power consumption against inference latency and token throughput. We first formulate this problem as an optimization problem and then realize it as an online feedback optimization controller that leverages measurements from both the power grid and GPU systems. Our key insight is that reducing GPU power consumption alleviates violations of lower voltage limits, while increasing GPU power mitigates violations near upper voltage limits in distribution systems; this runs counter to the common belief that minimizing GPU power consumption is always beneficial to power grids.

title: Trojan Attacks on Neural Network Controllers for Robotic Systems
authors: Farbod Younesi, Walter Lucia, Amr Youssef
abstract: Neural network controllers are increasingly deployed in robotic systems for tasks such as trajectory tracking and pose stabilization. However, their reliance on potentially untrusted training pipelines or supply chains introduces significant security vulnerabilities. This paper investigates backdoor (Trojan) attacks against neural controllers, using a differential-drive mobile robot platform as a case study. In particular, assuming that the robot's tracking controller is implemented as a neural network, we design a lightweight, parallel Trojan network that can be embedded within the controller. This malicious module remains dormant during normal operation but, upon detecting a highly specific trigger condition defined by the robot's pose and goal parameters, compromises the primary controller's wheel velocity commands, resulting in undesired and potentially unsafe robot behaviours. We provide a proof-of-concept implementation of the proposed Trojan network, which is validated through simulation under two different attack scenarios. The results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed attack and demonstrate that neural network-based robotic control systems are subject to potentially critical security threats.
comment: Paper submitted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Control Technology and Applications (CCTA)

title: TestMigrationsInPy: A Dataset of Test Migrations from Unittest to Pytest
authors: Altino Alves, Andre Hora
abstract: Unittest and pytest are the most popular testing frameworks in Python. Overall, pytest provides some advantages, including simpler assertion, reuse of fixtures, and interoperability. Due to such benefits, multiple projects in the Python ecosystem have migrated from unittest to pytest. To facilitate the migration, pytest can also run unittest tests, thus, the migration can happen gradually over time. However, the migration can be time-consuming and take a long time to conclude. In this context, projects would benefit from automated solutions to support the migration process. In this paper, we propose TestMigrationsInPy, a dataset of test migrations from unittest to pytest. TestMigrationsInPy contains 923 real-world migrations performed by developers. Future research proposing novel solutions to migrate frameworks in Python can rely on TestMigrationsInPy as a ground truth. Moreover, as TestMigrationsInPy includes information about the migration type (e.g., changes in assertions or fixtures), our dataset enables novel solutions to be verified effectively, for instance, from simpler assertion migrations to more complex fixture migrations. TestMigrationsInPy is publicly available at: https://github.com/altinoalvesjunior/TestMigrationsInPy.

title: Exceptional Behaviors: How Frequently Are They Tested?
authors: Andre Hora, Gordon Fraser
abstract: Exceptions allow developers to handle error cases expected to occur infrequently. Ideally, good test suites should test both normal and exceptional behaviors to catch more bugs and avoid regressions. While current research analyzes exceptions that propagate to tests, it does not explore other exceptions that do not reach the tests. In this paper, we provide an empirical study to explore how frequently exceptional behaviors are tested in real-world systems. We consider both exceptions that propagate to tests and the ones that do not reach the tests. For this purpose, we run an instrumented version of test suites, monitor their execution, and collect information about the exceptions raised at runtime. We analyze the test suites of 25 Python systems, covering 5,372 executed methods, 17.9M calls, and 1.4M raised exceptions. We find that 21.4% of the executed methods do raise exceptions at runtime. In methods that raise exceptions, on the median, 1 in 10 calls exercise exceptional behaviors. Close to 80% of the methods that raise exceptions do so infrequently, but about 20% raise exceptions more frequently. Finally, we provide implications for researchers and practitioners. We suggest developing novel tools to support exercising exceptional behaviors and refactoring expensive try/except blocks. We also call attention to the fact that exception-raising behaviors are not necessarily "abnormal" or rare.

title: Certifiable Boolean Reasoning Is Universal
authors: Wenhao Li, Anastasis Kratsios, Hrad Ghoukasian, Dennis Zvigelsky
abstract:
The proliferation of agentic systems has thrust the reasoning capabilities of AI into the forefront of contemporary machine learning. While it is known that there \emph{exist} neural networks which can reason through any Boolean task $f:\{0,1\}^B\to\{0,1\}$, in the sense that they emulate Boolean circuits with fan-in $2$ and fan-out $1$ gates, trained models have been repeatedly demonstrated to fall short of these theoretical ideals. This raises the question: \textit{Can one exhibit a deep learning model which \textbf{certifiably} always reasons and can \textbf{universally} reason through any Boolean task?} Moreover, such a model should ideally require few parameters to solve simple Boolean tasks.
  We answer this question affirmatively by exhibiting a deep learning architecture which parameterizes distributions over Boolean circuits with the guarantee that, for every parameter configuration, a sample is almost surely a valid Boolean circuit (and hence admits an intrinsic circuit-level certificate). We then prove a universality theorem: for any Boolean $f:\{0,1\}^B\to\{0,1\}$, there exists a parameter configuration under which the sampled circuit computes $f$ with arbitrarily high probability. When $f$ is an $\mathcal{O}(\log B)$-junta, the required number of parameters scales linearly with the input dimension $B$.
  Empirically, on a controlled truth-table completion benchmark aligned with our setting, the proposed architecture trains reliably and achieves high exact-match accuracy while preserving the predicted structure: every internal unit is Boolean-valued on $\{0,1\}^B$. Matched MLP baselines reach comparable accuracy, but only about $10\%$ of hidden units admit a Boolean representation; i.e.\ are two-valued over the Boolean cube.

title: Scalable Fixed-Point Framework for High-Dimensional Hamilton-Jacobi Equations
authors: Yesom Park, Stanley Osher
abstract: We propose a novel, mesh-free, and gradient-free fixed-point approach for computing viscosity solutions of high-dimensional Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) equations. By leveraging the Hopf-Lax formula, our approach iteratively solves the associated variational problem via a Picard iteration, enabling efficient evaluation of both the solution and its corresponding control without relying on grids, characteristics, or differentiation. We demonstrate the practical efficacy and scalability of the approach through numerical experiments in up to 100 dimensions, including control problems and non-smooth solutions. Our results show that the proposed scheme achieves high accuracy, is highly efficient, and exhibits computational times that are largely independent of dimensionality, highlighting its suitability for high-dimensional problems.

title: CLEAR-HPV: Interpretable Concept Discovery for HPV-Associated Morphology in Whole-Slide Histology
authors: Weiyi Qin, Yingci Liu-Swetz, Shiwei Tan, Hao Wang
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) status is a critical determinant of prognosis and treatment response in head and neck and cervical cancers. Although attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) achieves strong slide-level prediction for HPV-related whole-slide histopathology, it provides limited morphologic interpretability. To address this limitation, we introduce Concept-Level Explainable Attention-guided Representation for HPV (CLEAR-HPV), a framework that restructures the MIL latent space using attention to enable concept discovery without requiring concept labels during training. Operating in an attention-weighted latent space, CLEAR-HPV automatically discovers keratinizing, basaloid, and stromal morphologic concepts, generates spatial concept maps, and represents each slide using a compact concept-fraction vector. CLEAR-HPV's concept-fraction vectors preserve the predictive information of the original MIL embeddings while reducing the high-dimensional feature space (e.g., 1536 dimensions) to only 10 interpretable concepts. CLEAR-HPV generalizes consistently across TCGA-HNSCC, TCGA-CESC, and CPTAC-HNSCC, providing compact, concept-level interpretability through a general, backbone-agnostic framework for attention-based MIL models of whole-slide histopathology.

title: Varifocal Displays Reduce the Impact of the Vergence-Accommodation Conflict on 3D Pointing Performance in Augmented Reality Systems
authors: Xiaodan Hu, Monica Perusquía-Hernández, Mayra Donaji Barrera Machuca, Anil Ufuk Batmaz, Yan Zhang, Wolfgang Stuerzlinger, Kiyoshi Kiyokawa
abstract: This paper investigates whether a custom varifocal display can improve 3D pointing performance in augmented reality (AR), where the vergence-accommodation conflict (VAC) is known to impair interaction. Varifocal displays have been hypothesized to alleviate the VAC by dynamically matching the focal distance to the user's gaze-defined target depth. Following prior work, we conducted a within-subject study with 24 participants performing an ISO 9241-411 pointing task under varifocal and fixed-focal viewing. Overall, varifocal viewing yielded significantly higher performance than the fixed-focal baseline across key interaction metrics, although the magnitude and even the direction of the benefit varied across individuals. In particular, participants' responses exhibited a baseline-dependent pattern, with smaller improvements (or occasional degradation) observed for those with better baseline performance. Our findings suggest that varifocal technology can improve AR pointing performance relative to fixed-focal viewing, while highlighting substantial individual differences that should be considered in design and evaluation.

title: Reporting and Reviewing LLM-Integrated Systems in HCI: Challenges and Considerations
authors: Karla Felix Navarro, Eugene Syriani, Ian Arawjo
abstract: What should HCI scholars consider when reporting and reviewing papers that involve LLM-integrated systems? We interview 18 authors of LLM-integrated system papers on their authoring and reviewing experiences. We find that norms of trust-building between authors and reviewers appear to be eroded by the uncertainty of LLM behavior and hyperbolic rhetoric surrounding AI. Authors perceive that reviewers apply uniquely skeptical and inconsistent standards towards papers that report LLM-integrated systems, and mitigate mistrust by adding technical evaluations, justifying usage, and de-emphasizing LLM presence. Authors' views challenge blanket directives to report all prompts and use open models, arguing that prompt reporting is context-dependent and justifying proprietary model usage despite ethical concerns. Finally, some tensions in peer review appear to stem from clashes between the norms and values of HCI and ML/NLP communities, particularly around what constitutes a contribution and an appropriate level of technical rigor. Based on our findings and additional feedback from six expert HCI researchers, we present a set of guidelines and considerations for authors, reviewers, and HCI communities around reporting and reviewing papers that involve LLM-integrated systems.
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. For proposed reporting guidelines, see https://ianarawjo.github.io/Guidelines-for-Reporting-LLM-Integrated-Systems-in-HCI/

title: Rethinking Rubric Generation for Improving LLM Judge and Reward Modeling for Open-ended Tasks
authors: William F. Shen, Xinchi Qiu, Chenxi Whitehouse, Lisa Alazraki, Shashwat Goel, Francesco Barbieri, Timon Willi, Akhil Mathur, Ilias Leontiadis
abstract: Recently, rubrics have been used to guide LLM judges in capturing subjective, nuanced, multi-dimensional human preferences, and have been extended from evaluation to reward signals for reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT). However, rubric generation remains hard to control: rubrics often lack coverage, conflate dimensions, misalign preference direction, and contain redundant or highly correlated criteria, degrading judge accuracy and producing suboptimal rewards during RFT. We propose RRD, a principled framework for rubric refinement built on a recursive decompose-filter cycle. RRD decomposes coarse rubrics into fine-grained, discriminative criteria, expanding coverage while sharpening separation between responses. A complementary filtering mechanism removes misaligned and redundant rubrics, and a correlation-aware weighting scheme prevents over-representing highly correlated criteria, yielding rubric sets that are informative, comprehensive, and non-redundant. Empirically, RRD delivers large, consistent gains across both evaluation and training: it improves preference-judgment accuracy on JudgeBench and PPE for both GPT-4o and Llama3.1-405B judges, achieving top performance in all settings with up to +17.7 points on JudgeBench. When used as the reward source for RFT on WildChat, it yields substantially stronger and more stable learning signals, boosting reward by up to 160% (Qwen3-4B) and 60% (Llama3.1-8B) versus 10-20% for prior rubric baselines, with gains that transfer to HealthBench-Hard and BiGGen Bench. Overall, RRD establishes recursive rubric refinement as a scalable and interpretable foundation for LLM judging and reward modeling in open-ended domains.

title: Towards Advancing Research with Workflows: A perspective from the Workflows Community Summit -- Amsterdam, 2025
authors: Irene Bonati, Silvina Caino-Lores, Tainã Coleman, Sagar Dolas, Sandro Fiore, Venkatesh Kannan, Marco Verdicchio, Sean R. Wilkinson, Rafael Ferreira da Silva
abstract: Scientific workflows have become essential for orchestrating complex computational processes across distributed resources, managing large datasets, and ensuring reproducibility in modern research. The Workflows Community Summit 2025, held in Amsterdam on June 6th, 2025, convened international experts to examine emerging challenges and opportunities in this domain. Participants identified key barriers to workflow adoption, including tensions between system generality and domain-specific utility, concerns over long-term sustainability of workflow systems and services, insufficient recognition for those who develop and maintain reproducible workflows, and gaps in standardization, funding, training, and cross-disciplinary collaboration. To address these challenges, the summit proposed action lines spanning technology, policy, and community dimensions: shifting evaluation metrics from raw computational performance toward measuring genuine scientific impact; formalizing workflow patterns and community-driven benchmarks to improve transparency, reproducibility, and usability; cultivating a cohesive international workflows community that engages funding bodies and research stakeholders; and investing in human capital through dedicated workflow engineering roles, career pathways, and integration of workflow concepts into educational curricula and long-term training initiatives. This document presents the summit's findings, beginning with an overview of the current computing ecosystem and the rationale for workflow-centric approaches, followed by a discussion of identified challenges and recommended action lines for advancing scientific discovery through workflows.

title: CAST-CKT: Chaos-Aware Spatio-Temporal and Cross-City Knowledge Transfer for Traffic Flow Prediction
authors: Abdul Joseph Fofanah, Lian Wen, David Chen, Alpha Alimamy Kamara, Zhongyi Zhang
abstract: Traffic prediction in data-scarce, cross-city settings is challenging due to complex nonlinear dynamics and domain shifts. Existing methods often fail to capture traffic's inherent chaotic nature for effective few-shot learning. We propose CAST-CKT, a novel Chaos-Aware Spatio-Temporal and Cross-City Knowledge Transfer framework. It employs an efficient chaotic analyser to quantify traffic predictability regimes, driving several key innovations: chaos-aware attention for regime-adaptive temporal modelling; adaptive topology learning for dynamic spatial dependencies; and chaotic consistency-based cross-city alignment for knowledge transfer. The framework also provides horizon-specific predictions with uncertainty quantification. Theoretical analysis shows improved generalisation bounds. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks in cross-city few-shot settings show CAST-CKT outperforms state-of-the-art methods by significant margins in MAE and RMSE, while offering interpretable regime analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/afofanah/CAST-CKT.

title: ARGaze: Autoregressive Transformers for Online Egocentric Gaze Estimation
authors: Jia Li, Wenjie Zhao, Shijian Deng, Bolin Lai, Yuheng Wu, RUijia Chen, Jon E. Froehlich, Yuhang Zhao, Yapeng Tian
abstract: Online egocentric gaze estimation predicts where a camera wearer is looking from first-person video using only past and current frames, a task essential for augmented reality and assistive technologies. Unlike third-person gaze estimation, this setting lacks explicit head or eye signals, requiring models to infer current visual attention from sparse, indirect cues such as hand-object interactions and salient scene content. We observe that gaze exhibits strong temporal continuity during goal-directed activities: knowing where a person looked recently provides a powerful prior for predicting where they look next. Inspired by vision-conditioned autoregressive decoding in vision-language models, we propose ARGaze, which reformulates gaze estimation as sequential prediction: at each timestep, a transformer decoder predicts current gaze by conditioning on (i) current visual features and (ii) a fixed-length Gaze Context Window of recent gaze target estimates. This design enforces causality and enables bounded-resource streaming inference. We achieve state-of-the-art performance across multiple egocentric benchmarks under online evaluation, with extensive ablations validating that autoregressive modeling with bounded gaze history is critical for robust prediction. We will release our source code and pre-trained models.

title: SemPipes -- Optimizable Semantic Data Operators for Tabular Machine Learning Pipelines
authors: Olga Ovcharenko, Matthias Boehm, Sebastian Schelter
abstract: Real-world machine learning on tabular data relies on complex data preparation pipelines for prediction, data integration, augmentation, and debugging. Designing these pipelines requires substantial domain expertise and engineering effort, motivating the question of how large language models (LLMs) can support tabular ML through code synthesis. We introduce SemPipes, a novel declarative programming model that integrates LLM-powered semantic data operators into tabular ML pipelines. Semantic operators specify data transformations in natural language while delegating execution to a runtime system. During training, SemPipes synthesizes custom operator implementations based on data characteristics, operator instructions, and pipeline context. This design enables the automatic optimization of data operations in a pipeline via LLM-based code synthesis guided by evolutionary search. We evaluate SemPipes across diverse tabular ML tasks and show that semantic operators substantially improve end-to-end predictive performance for both expert-designed and agent-generated pipelines, while reducing pipeline complexity. We implement SemPipes in Python and release it at https://github.com/deem-data/sempipes/tree/v1.
zh_title: SemPipes——用于表格机器学习管道的可优化语义数据运算符
translation: 现实世界中基于表格数据的机器学习依赖于复杂的数据准备管道来进行预测、数据集成、增强和调试。设计这些管道需要大量的领域专业知识和工程工作，这促使人们思考大型语言模型（LLMs）如何通过代码合成来支持表格机器学习的需求。我们介绍了 SemPipes，这是一种新颖的声明式编程模型，它将 LLM 驱动的语义数据运算符集成到表格 ML 管道中。语义运算符以自然语言指定数据转换，同时将执行委托给运行时系统。在训练期间，SemPipes 根据数据特征、运算符指令和管道上下文合成自定义运算符实现。这种设计可以通过由演化搜索指导的基于 LLM 的代码合成，实现管道中数据操作的自动优化。我们在各种表格 ML 任务上评估了 SemPipes，结果表明语义运算符显著提高了专家设计和代理生成的管道的端到端预测性能，同时降低了管道的复杂性。我们使用 Python 实现了 SemPipes 并发布在 [链接]。
tldr: 引入了 SemPipes，这是一个声明式编程模型，它使用 LLM 合成代码和演化搜索来自动优化表格机器学习管道中的语义数据操作。结果显示它显著提高了预测性能并降低了管道复杂性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM）的能力与传统的机器学习数据管道相结合，提出了一种可自动优化的新范式。通过使用自然语言定义语义操作符，它大大降低了设计复杂数据准备管道所需的专业知识门槛。更重要的是，它利用 LLM 进行代码合成并结合演化搜索进行优化，实现了数据操作的自动化调优，解决了传统管道中手动优化耗时且困难的问题。这对于提高表格数据 ML 任务的效率和性能具有重要意义。
motivation: 现实世界的表格机器学习数据准备管道设计复杂，需要大量的领域专业知识和工程工作。这激发了研究如何利用大型语言模型（LLMs）通过代码合成来支持表格机器学习的需求。
method: 引入了 SemPipes，这是一种新颖的声明式编程模型，它将 LLM 驱动的语义数据运算符集成到表格 ML 管道中。语义运算符使用自然语言指定数据转换，并将执行委托给运行时系统。在训练期间，SemPipes 根据数据特征、运算符指令和管道上下文合成自定义运算符实现。通过基于 LLM 的代码合成和演化搜索，实现了管道数据操作的自动优化。
results: 语义运算符显著提高了专家设计和代理生成的管道的端到端预测性能，同时降低了管道的复杂性。

title: Adaptive Exploration for Latent-State Bandits
authors: Jikai Jin, Kenneth Hung, Sanath Kumar Krishnamurthy, Baoyi Shi, Congshan Zhang
abstract: The multi-armed bandit problem is a core framework for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, but classical algorithms often fail in environments with hidden, time-varying states that confound reward estimation and optimal action selection. We address key challenges arising from unobserved confounders, such as biased reward estimates and limited state information, by introducing a family of state-model-free bandit algorithms that leverage lagged contextual features and coordinated probing strategies. These implicitly track latent states and disambiguate state-dependent reward patterns. Our methods and their adaptive variants can learn optimal policies without explicit state modeling, combining computational efficiency with robust adaptation to non-stationary rewards. Empirical results across diverse settings demonstrate superior performance over classical approaches, and we provide practical recommendations for algorithm selection in real-world applications.
zh_title: 隐状态多臂赌博机的自适应探索
translation: 多臂赌博机问题是具有不确定性的序列决策的核心框架，但经典算法在存在隐藏的、时变的状态（这些状态会混淆奖励估计和最优动作选择）的环境中往往会失效。我们通过引入一系列无状态模型的赌博机算法，解决了未观测到的混杂因素带来的关键挑战，例如有偏的奖励估计和有限的状态信息。这些算法利用滞后的上下文特征和协调的探测策略，隐式地跟踪潜在状态并消除状态依赖性奖励模式的歧义。我们的方法及其自适应变体无需显式状态建模即可学习最优策略，同时结合了计算效率和对非平稳奖励的鲁棒适应性。跨越不同设置的实证结果表明，其性能优于经典方法，并且我们为现实世界应用中的算法选择提供了实用建议。
tldr: 针对具有隐藏时变状态的多臂赌博机问题，我们开发了一系列无需显式状态建模的自适应算法，通过利用滞后特征和探测策略，在复杂和非平稳环境中表现优异。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于为隐状态多臂赌博机问题提供了一套“无状态模型”的解决方案。通过避免显式地建模复杂的隐藏状态，而是利用滞后的上下文特征和协调的探测策略来隐式地跟踪状态，该方法显著提高了算法的实用性和计算效率。这对于处理具有未观测到的、时变混杂因素的现实世界序列决策问题具有重要意义。
motivation: 经典多臂赌博机算法在存在隐藏的、时变的（未观测到的混杂因素）状态的环境中表现不佳，这些状态会混淆奖励估计和最优动作选择。
method: 引入了一系列无状态模型的多臂赌博机算法。这些方法利用滞后的上下文特征和协调的探测策略，隐式地跟踪潜在状态并消除状态依赖性奖励模式的歧义。
results: 这些方法及其自适应变体无需显式状态建模即可学习最优策略，并结合了计算效率和对非平稳奖励的鲁棒适应性。在各种设置下的实证结果表明，其性能优于经典方法。
conclusion: 提出了一种无状态模型的自适应算法家族，能够有效解决隐状态多臂赌博机问题，并为实际应用中的算法选择提供了实用建议。

title: Decoupled Orthogonal Dynamics: Regularization for Deep Network Optimizers
authors: Hao Chen, Jinghui Yuan, Hanmin Zhang
abstract: Is the standard weight decay in AdamW truly optimal? Although AdamW decouples weight decay from adaptive gradient scaling, a fundamental conflict remains: the Radial Tug-of-War. In deep learning, gradients tend to increase parameter norms to expand effective capacity while steering directions to learn features, whereas weight decay indiscriminately suppresses norm growth. This push--pull interaction induces radial oscillations, injecting noise into Adam's second-moment estimates and potentially degrading delicate tangential feature learning. We argue that magnitude and direction play distinct roles and should be decoupled in optimizer dynamics. We propose Orthogonal Dynamics Decoupling and instantiate it as AdamO: an SGD-style update handles the one-dimensional norm control, while Adam's adaptive preconditioning is confined to the tangential subspace. AdamO further incorporates curvature-adaptive radial step sizing and architecture-aware rules and projections for scale-invariant layers and low-dimensional parameters. Experiments on vision and language tasks show that AdamO improves generalization and stability over AdamW without introducing additional complex constraints.
zh_title: 解耦正交动力学：深度网络优化器的正则化
translation: AdamW中的标准权重衰减真的是最优的吗？尽管AdamW将权重衰减与自适应梯度缩放解耦，但一个根本性的冲突仍然存在：径向拉锯战（Radial Tug-of-War）。在深度学习中，梯度倾向于增加参数范数以扩展有效容量，同时引导方向以学习特征，而权重衰减则不加区分地抑制范数增长。这种推拉交互作用会引起径向振荡，向Adam的二阶矩估计中注入噪声，并可能损害精细的切向特征学习。我们认为幅度（magnitude）和方向（direction）起着不同的作用，应该在优化器动力学中解耦。我们提出了正交动力学解耦（Orthogonal Dynamics Decoupling），并将其实现为AdamO：一个SGD风格的更新处理一维范数控制，而Adam的自适应预处理则被限制在切向子空间。AdamO进一步结合了曲率自适应径向步长调整以及针对尺度不变层和低维参数的结构感知规则和投影。在视觉和语言任务上的实验表明，AdamO比AdamW提高了泛化性和稳定性，且未引入额外的复杂约束。
tldr: 现有的AdamW因径向拉锯战导致噪声。本文提出AdamO，通过将参数范数控制（径向）和特征学习（切向）的优化动力学解耦，从而提高深度网络的泛化性和稳定性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于识别并解决了AdamW中权重衰减与梯度更新之间的“径向拉锯战”这一核心冲突。通过提出正交动力学解耦（AdamO），将优化步骤的幅度和方向作用彻底分离，解决了传统正则化方法引入的噪声和振荡问题。这种基于几何动力学的优化器设计思路，为提高深度学习模型的稳定性和泛化能力提供了一个优雅且有效的新方向。
motivation: 现有的AdamW中的标准权重衰减并非最优，因为它引入了“径向拉锯战”冲突，导致径向振荡，并向Adam的二阶矩估计中注入噪声，从而可能损害精细的切向特征学习。
method: 提出“正交动力学解耦”（Orthogonal Dynamics Decoupling），并将其实现为AdamO。该方法使用SGD风格的更新处理一维范数控制，同时将Adam的自适应预处理限制在切向子空间中。AdamO还结合了曲率自适应径向步长调整以及针对尺度不变层和低维参数的结构感知规则。
results: 在视觉和语言任务上的实验表明，AdamO比AdamW提高了泛化性和稳定性，且未引入额外的复杂约束。
conclusion: 通过将优化动力学中的幅度和方向作用解耦，AdamO成功解决了AdamW中的径向冲突问题，从而在视觉和语言任务上实现了更好的泛化性和稳定性。

title: HugRAG: Hierarchical Causal Knowledge Graph Design for RAG
authors: Nengbo Wang, Tuo Liang, Vikash Singh, Chaoda Song, Van Yang, Yu Yin, Jing Ma, Jagdip Singh, Vipin Chaudhary
abstract: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) has enhanced large language models by enabling access to external knowledge, with graph-based RAG emerging as a powerful paradigm for structured retrieval and reasoning. However, existing graph-based methods often over-rely on surface-level node matching and lack explicit causal modeling, leading to unfaithful or spurious answers. Prior attempts to incorporate causality are typically limited to local or single-document contexts and also suffer from information isolation that arises from modular graph structures, which hinders scalability and cross-module causal reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose HugRAG, a framework that rethinks knowledge organization for graph-based RAG through causal gating across hierarchical modules. HugRAG explicitly models causal relationships to suppress spurious correlations while enabling scalable reasoning over large-scale knowledge graphs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HugRAG consistently outperforms competitive graph-based RAG baselines across multiple datasets and evaluation metrics. Our work establishes a principled foundation for structured, scalable, and causally grounded RAG systems.
zh_title: HugRAG：用于RAG的层次化因果知识图谱设计
translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过允许访问外部知识，增强了大型语言模型，其中基于图的RAG作为结构化检索和推理的强大范式正在兴起。然而，现有的图基方法通常过度依赖表面级的节点匹配，缺乏明确的因果建模，从而导致不忠实或虚假的答案。先前尝试纳入因果关系的方法通常局限于局部或单文档上下文，并且遭受模块化图结构引起的信息隔离，这阻碍了可扩展性和跨模块因果推理。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HugRAG，这是一个通过跨层次模块的因果门控来重新思考图基RAG知识组织的框架。HugRAG明确地建模因果关系，以抑制虚假关联，同时实现对大规模知识图谱的可扩展推理。广泛的实验证明，HugRAG在多个数据集和评估指标上持续优于竞争性的图基RAG基线。我们的工作为结构化、可扩展和基于因果关系的RAG系统建立了原则性基础。
tldr: 提出HugRAG框架，通过在层次模块中使用因果门控，解决现有图基RAG方法过度依赖表面匹配和缺乏明确因果建模的问题，从而实现结构化、可扩展和因果驱动的RAG系统，并在实验中表现优越。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将“层次化”（hierarchical）结构与“因果门控”（causal gating）机制相结合，用于改进图基RAG的知识组织和检索过程。通过明确建模因果关系来抑制虚假相关性，是解决RAG系统生成不忠实答案的关键一步。该方法旨在解决现有图基RAG在可扩展性和跨模块推理方面的限制，使其能够应用于大规模知识图谱，这对于推动RAG技术在复杂推理任务中的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的图基RAG方法过度依赖表面节点匹配，缺乏明确的因果建模，导致答案不可信或虚假。此外，先前尝试纳入因果关系的方法通常局限于局部或单文档上下文，并存在模块化图结构导致的信息隔离问题，阻碍了可扩展性和跨模块因果推理。
method: 提出HugRAG框架，通过跨层次模块的因果门控（causal gating）重新思考图基RAG的知识组织方式。HugRAG明确建模因果关系，以抑制虚假关联，同时实现对大规模知识图谱的可扩展推理。
results: 广泛的实验证明，HugRAG在多个数据集和评估指标上持续优于竞争性的图基RAG基线。
conclusion: 这项工作为结构化、可扩展和基于因果关系的RAG系统奠定了原则性基础。

title: TIDE: Temporal Incremental Draft Engine for Self-Improving LLM Inference
authors: Jiyoung Park, Hankyu Jang, Changseok Song, Wookeun Jung
abstract: Speculative decoding can substantially accelerate LLM inference, but realizing its benefits in practice is challenging due to evolving workloads and system-level constraints. We present TIDE (Temporal Incremental Draft Engine), a serving-engine-native framework that integrates online draft adaptation directly into high-performance LLM inference systems. TIDE reuses target model hidden states generated during inference as training signals, enabling zero-overhead draft adaptation without reloading the target model, and employs adaptive runtime control to activate speculation and training only when beneficial. TIDE exploits heterogeneous clusters by mapping decoupled inference and training to appropriate GPU classes. Across diverse real-world workloads, TIDE achieves up to 1.15x throughput improvement over static speculative decoding while reducing draft training time by 1.67x compared to approaches that recompute training signals.
zh_title: TIDE：用于自我改进LLM推理的时间增量草稿引擎
translation: 推测解码可以显著加速LLM推理，但由于工作负载不断变化和系统级限制，在实践中实现其益处具有挑战性。我们提出了TIDE（Temporal Incremental Draft Engine），这是一个服务引擎原生的框架，将在线草稿模型自适应直接集成到高性能LLM推理系统中。TIDE重用推理过程中生成的目标模型隐藏状态作为训练信号，实现了零开销的草稿模型自适应，无需重新加载目标模型，并采用自适应运行时控制，仅在有益时才激活推测和训练。TIDE通过将解耦的推理和训练映射到合适的GPU类别来利用异构集群。在各种实际工作负载中，TIDE比静态推测解码的吞吐量提高了1.15倍，同时与重新计算训练信号的方法相比，草稿训练时间减少了1.67倍。
tldr: TIDE是一个服务引擎原生的框架，通过在推理过程中重用目标模型隐藏状态作为训练信号，实现了零开销的草稿模型自适应，并利用自适应运行时控制和异构集群，将LLM推理吞吐量比静态推测解码提高了1.15倍。
ai_comments: TIDE的关键创新在于将“训练”信号的收集与“推理”过程耦合，通过重用目标模型隐藏状态，消除了传统在线适应方法的额外开销（零开销自适应）。这种集成方法使其成为一个高度实用的、服务引擎原生的解决方案。利用异构集群和自适应控制进一步增强了其实用性和效率。其重要性在于，它提供了一种在动态生产环境中维持推测解码效率的机制，解决了静态草稿模型在面对不断变化的工作负载时的性能衰减问题。
motivation: 推测解码（Speculative decoding）可以显著加速LLM推理，但在实践中，由于工作负载不断变化和系统级限制，实现其益处具有挑战性。
method: 提出了TIDE（Temporal Incremental Draft Engine），一个服务引擎原生的框架。它通过以下方式实现：1) 重用推理过程中生成的目标模型隐藏状态作为训练信号，实现零开销的草稿模型自适应，无需重新加载目标模型。2) 采用自适应运行时控制，仅在有益时才激活推测和训练。3) 利用异构集群，将解耦的推理和训练映射到合适的GPU类别。
results: 在各种实际工作负载下，TIDE比静态推测解码的吞吐量提高了1.15倍。与重新计算训练信号的方法相比，草稿训练时间减少了1.67倍。

title: Fairness Under Group-Conditional Prior Probability Shift: Invariance, Drift, and Target-Aware Post-Processing
authors: Amir Asiaee, Kaveh Aryan
abstract: Machine learning systems are often trained and evaluated for fairness on historical data, yet deployed in environments where conditions have shifted. A particularly common form of shift occurs when the prevalence of positive outcomes changes differently across demographic groups--for example, when disease rates rise faster in one population than another, or when economic conditions affect loan default rates unequally. We study group-conditional prior probability shift (GPPS), where the label prevalence $P(Y=1\mid A=a)$ may change between training and deployment while the feature-generation process $P(X\mid Y,A)$ remains stable. Our analysis yields three main contributions. First, we prove a fundamental dichotomy: fairness criteria based on error rates (equalized odds) are structurally invariant under GPPS, while acceptance-rate criteria (demographic parity) can drift--and we prove this drift is unavoidable for non-trivial classifiers (shift-robust impossibility). Second, we show that target-domain risk and fairness metrics are identifiable without target labels: the invariance of ROC quantities under GPPS enables consistent estimation from source labels and unlabeled target data alone, with finite-sample guarantees. Third, we propose TAP-GPPS, a label-free post-processing algorithm that estimates prevalences from unlabeled data, corrects posteriors, and selects thresholds to satisfy demographic parity in the target domain. Experiments validate our theoretical predictions and demonstrate that TAP-GPPS achieves target fairness with minimal utility loss.
zh_title: 组条件先验概率漂移下的公平性：不变性、漂移和目标感知后处理
translation: 机器学习系统通常在历史数据上进行公平性训练和评估，但却部署在条件已发生变化的实际环境中。一种特别常见的变化形式是，积极结果的发生率在不同人口群体中发生差异性变化——例如，疾病发病率在一个群体中比另一个群体上升得更快，或者经济条件对贷款违约率造成了不平等的影响。我们研究了组条件先验概率漂移（GPPS），即训练和部署之间标签发生率 $P(Y=1\mid A=a)$ 可能会发生变化，而特征生成过程 $P(X\mid Y,A)$ 保持稳定。我们的分析产生了三个主要贡献。首先，我们证明了一个基本二分法：基于错误率的公平性标准（平等机会）在GPPS下具有结构不变性，而基于接受率的标准（人口均等性）可能会发生漂移——我们证明了对于非平凡分类器而言，这种漂移是不可避免的（漂移鲁棒性不可能）。其次，我们展示了目标域风险和公平性指标在没有目标标签的情况下是可识别的：ROC量在GPPS下的不变性使得仅使用源标签和未标记的目标数据即可进行一致估计，并具有有限样本保证。第三，我们提出了TAP-GPPS，这是一种无需标签的后处理算法，它从未标记数据中估计先验概率，校正后验概率，并选择阈值以满足目标域的人口均等性。实验验证了我们的理论预测，并证明了TAP-GPPS实现了目标公平性，同时最小化了效用损失。
tldr: 当部署环境中不同群体的积极结果发生率发生变化（GPPS）时，基于错误率的公平性标准保持不变，但基于接受率的标准会漂移。论文证明了目标域指标的可识别性，并提出了TAP-GPPS算法，这是一种无需目标标签的后处理方法，用于估计漂移并恢复目标域的公平性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于清晰地界定了在组条件先验概率漂移（GPPS）下，不同类型的公平性准则（基于错误率 vs. 基于接受率）的结构性差异，这是一个重要的理论贡献。证明目标域指标的可识别性，使得在缺乏目标标签的实际部署场景中进行公平性评估和校正成为可能。TAP-GPPS算法提供了一个实用的、无需标签的解决方案，将域适应技术与公平性目标相结合，具有重要的实践价值。
motivation: 机器学习系统在部署时，环境条件经常发生变化，特别是积极结果的发生率在不同人口群体中发生差异性变化（组条件先验概率漂移，GPPS），这种漂移严重影响了模型的公平性。
method: 研究组条件先验概率漂移（GPPS）模型，其中 $P(Y=1\mid A=a)$ 变化而 $P(X\mid Y,A)$ 稳定。证明了公平性标准的不变性和漂移的二分法。证明了目标域指标在无标签下的可识别性。提出了TAP-GPPS（目标感知后处理）算法，该算法使用未标记数据估计先验概率，校正后验概率，并选择阈值以满足目标域的人口均等性。
results: 证明了基于错误率的公平性标准（如平等机会）在GPPS下是结构不变的，而基于接受率的标准（如人口均等性）会发生不可避免的漂移。展示了目标风险和公平性指标仅使用源标签和未标记的目标数据即可识别。实验验证了TAP-GPPS算法实现了目标公平性，同时最小化了效用损失。
conclusion: 论文揭示了在组条件先验概率漂移下，不同公平性标准的结构性差异（不变性与漂移），并提出了一种无需目标标签的后处理算法TAP-GPPS，以在部署环境中有效地恢复公平性。

title: Cross-talk based multi-task learning for fault classification of physically coupled machine system
authors: Wonjun Yi, Rismaya Kumar Mishra, Yong-Hwa Park
abstract: Machine systems inherently generate signals in which fault conditions and various physical variables are physically coupled. Although many existing fault classification studies rely solely on direct fault labels, the aforementioned signals naturally embed additional information shaped by other physically coupled information. Herein, we leverage this coupling through a multi-task learning (MTL) framework that jointly learns fault conditions and the related physical variables. Among MTL architectures, crosstalk structures have distinct advantages because they allow for controlled information exchange between tasks through the cross-talk layer while preventing negative transfer, in contrast to shared trunk architectures that often mix incompatible features. We build on our previously introduced residual neural dimension reductor model, and extend its application to two benchmarks where physical coupling is prominent. The first benchmark is a drone fault dataset, in which machine type and maneuvering direction significantly alter the frequency components of measured signals even under the same nominal condition. By learning fault classification together with these physical attributes, the cross-talk architecture can better classify faults. The second benchmark dataset is the motor compound fault dataset. In this system, each fault component, inner race fault, outer race fault, misalignment, and unbalance is coupled to the other. For motor compound fault, we also test classification performance when we use single-channel data or multi-channel data as input to the classifier. Across both benchmarks, our residual neural dimension reductor, consistently outperformed single-task models, multi-class models that merge all label combinations, and shared trunk multi-task models.
comment: Submitted to 32th International Congress on Sound and Vibration (ICSV32)
zh_title: 基于交叉对话的多任务学习用于物理耦合机械系统的故障分类
translation: 机械系统固有地会产生信号，其中故障条件和各种物理变量是物理耦合的。尽管许多现有故障分类研究仅依赖于直接的故障标签，但上述信号自然地嵌入了由其他物理耦合信息塑造的附加信息。在本文中，我们通过一个多任务学习（MTL）框架来利用这种耦合，该框架联合学习故障条件和相关的物理变量。在MTL架构中，交叉对话结构具有独特的优势，因为它允许通过交叉对话层在任务之间进行受控的信息交换，同时防止负迁移，这与通常混合不兼容特征的共享主干架构形成对比。我们基于先前引入的残差神经降维器模型，并将其应用扩展到两个物理耦合突出的基准测试中。第一个基准是无人机故障数据集，其中机器类型和操纵方向甚至在相同的标称条件下也会显著改变测量信号的频率分量。通过将故障分类与这些物理属性一起学习，交叉对话架构可以更好地分类故障。第二个基准数据集是电机复合故障数据集。在该系统中，每个故障分量（内圈故障、外圈故障、不对中和不平衡）都与其他故障分量耦合。对于电机复合故障，我们还测试了使用单通道数据或多通道数据作为分类器输入时的分类性能。在这两个基准测试中，我们的残差神经降维器始终优于单任务模型、合并所有标签组合的多类别模型以及共享主干的多任务模型。
tldr: 针对机械系统中的物理耦合问题，本文使用基于交叉对话的多任务学习（MTL）框架，联合训练故障和物理变量，有效利用耦合信息，显著提高了故障分类的准确性，优于多种传统和共享MTL模型。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将“交叉对话”（Cross-talk）结构引入多任务学习（MTL）框架中，用于处理物理耦合机械系统的故障诊断问题。通过允许受控的信息交换同时防止负迁移，该方法巧妙地利用了与故障耦合的物理变量（如机器类型、运行状态）作为辅助信息，解决了传统单任务模型在面对复杂耦合信号时性能受限的问题。这对于提升实际工业场景中复杂机械系统的诊断鲁棒性和准确性具有重要意义。
motivation: 机械系统信号中，故障条件和各种物理变量是物理耦合的。现有故障分类研究多依赖直接故障标签，但信号中天然嵌入了其他物理耦合信息，可以利用这些信息提升分类性能。
method: 提出一个多任务学习（MTL）框架，联合学习故障条件和相关的物理变量。该框架采用交叉对话（cross-talk）结构，通过交叉对话层控制任务间信息交换，防止负迁移。该方法基于先前引入的残差神经降维器模型并对其进行扩展应用。
results: 在无人机和电机复合故障两个基准测试中，该残差神经降维器模型始终优于单任务模型、合并所有标签组合的多类别模型以及共享主干的多任务模型。在无人机故障分类中，交叉对话架构能更好地分类故障。
conclusion: 基于交叉对话的多任务学习框架，通过联合学习故障条件和物理变量，能够有效利用物理耦合信息，显著提升物理耦合机械系统中的故障分类性能。

title: GreekMMLU: A Native-Sourced Multitask Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models in Greek
authors: Yang Zhang, Mersin Konomi, Christos Xypolopoulos, Konstantinos Divriotis, Konstantinos Skianis, Giannis Nikolentzos, Giorgos Stamou, Guokan Shang, Michalis Vazirgiannis
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly trained on multilingual corpora that include Greek, yet reliable evaluation benchmarks for Greek-particularly those based on authentic, native-sourced content-remain limited. Existing datasets are often machine-translated from English, failing to capture Greek linguistic and cultural characteristics. We introduce GreekMMLU, a native-sourced benchmark for massive multitask language understanding in Greek, comprising 21,805 multiple-choice questions across 45 subject areas, organized under a newly defined subject taxonomy and annotated with educational difficulty levels spanning primary to professional examinations. All questions are sourced or authored in Greek from academic, professional, and governmental exams. We publicly release 16,857 samples and reserve 4,948 samples for a private leaderboard to enable robust and contamination-resistant evaluation. Evaluations of over 80 open- and closed-source LLMs reveal substantial performance gaps between frontier and open-weight models, as well as between Greek-adapted models and general multilingual ones. Finally, we provide a systematic analysis of factors influencing performance-including model scale, adaptation, and prompting-and derive insights for improving LLM capabilities in Greek.
zh_title: GreekMMLU：一个用于评估希腊语语言模型的本土多任务基准测试
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常使用包含希腊语的多语言语料库进行训练，但可靠的希腊语评估基准仍然有限，特别是那些基于真实的、本土来源内容的基准。现有数据集通常是从英语进行机器翻译的，未能捕捉希腊语的语言和文化特征。我们引入了GreekMMLU，这是一个用于希腊语大规模多任务语言理解的本土来源基准，包含45个学科领域的21,805个多项选择题，这些问题根据新定义的学科分类进行组织，并标注了从小学到专业考试的教育难度级别。所有问题均源自或创作于希腊语的学术、专业和政府考试。我们公开发布了16,857个样本，并保留了4,948个样本用于私有排行榜，以实现鲁棒且抗污染的评估。对80多个开源和闭源LLM的评估揭示了前沿模型与开源模型之间、以及希腊语适应模型与通用多语言模型之间存在显著的性能差距。最后，我们对影响性能的因素（包括模型规模、适应性和提示）进行了系统分析，并为提高希腊语LLM的能力提供了见解。
tldr: 引入了GreekMMLU，这是一个包含21,805个本土来源多项选择题的希腊语多任务基准，用于评估LLM。评估结果显示，顶级模型与开源模型之间、以及专门适应模型与通用模型之间存在显著性能差距。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新性在于其“本土来源”（Native-Sourced）的特性，直接解决了现有希腊语评估基准依赖机器翻译而导致的语言和文化特征缺失问题。通过从学术、专业和政府考试中收集高质量、多难度级别的数据，GreekMMLU提供了一个比现有基准更具挑战性和真实性的评估环境。其重要性在于，它为希腊语LLM的开发和公平比较提供了一个急需的、抗污染的黄金标准，并揭示了顶级模型在特定低资源语言（或至少是评估资源不足的语言）上的实际能力差距。
motivation: 现有的希腊语评估基准有限，缺乏基于真实的、本土来源的内容。现有数据集通常是机器翻译的，未能捕捉希腊语的语言和文化特征，因此需要一个全新的、本土来源的基准。
method: 引入了GreekMMLU基准，包含45个学科领域的21,805个本土来源多项选择题。这些问题源自希腊语的学术、专业和政府考试，并根据新的分类法和教育难度级别（从小学到专业考试）进行标注。数据集分为16,857个公开发布样本和4,948个保留用于私有排行榜的样本，以确保评估的鲁棒性和抗污染性。
results: 对80多个开源和闭源LLM的评估显示：1) 顶尖模型与开源模型之间存在巨大的性能差距。2) 希腊语适应模型与通用多语言模型之间也存在显著差距。此外，还系统分析了影响性能的因素，包括模型规模、适应性（adaptation）和提示工程（prompting）。
conclusion: 通过系统分析模型规模、适应性和提示等因素，为提高希腊语LLM的能力提供了见解。该基准揭示了当前模型在希腊语理解方面存在的显著性能差距。

title: CoSA: Compressed Sensing-Based Adaptation of Large Language Models
authors: Songtao Wei, Yi Li, Bohan Zhang, Zhichun Guo, Ying Huang, Yuede Ji, Miao Yin, Guanpeng Li, Bingzhe Li
abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has emerged as a practical paradigm for adapting large language models (LLMs) without updating all parameters. Most existing approaches, such as LoRA and PiSSA, rely on low-rank decompositions of weight updates. However, the low-rank assumption may restrict expressivity, particularly in task-specific adaptation scenarios where singular values are distributed relatively uniformly. To address this limitation, we propose CoSA (Compressed Sensing-Based Adaptation), a new PEFT method extended from compressed sensing theory. Instead of constraining weight updates to a low-rank subspace, CoSA expresses them through fixed random projection matrices and a compact learnable core. We provide a formal theoretical analysis of CoSA as a synthesis process, proving that weight updates can be compactly encoded into a low-dimensional space and mapped back through random projections. Extensive experimental results show that CoSA provides a principled perspective for efficient and expressive multi-scale model adaptation. Specifically, we evaluate CoSA on 10 diverse tasks, including natural language understanding and generation, employing 5 models of different scales from RoBERTa, Llama, and Qwen families. Across these settings, CoSA consistently matches or outperforms state-of-the-art PEFT methods.
zh_title: CoSA：基于压缩感知的语言模型自适应方法
translation: 参数高效微调（PEFT）已成为一种实用的范式，用于在不更新所有参数的情况下自适应大型语言模型（LLMs）。大多数现有方法，如LoRA和PiSSA，依赖于权重更新的低秩分解。然而，低秩假设可能会限制表达能力，特别是在奇异值分布相对均匀的任务特定自适应场景中。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了CoSA（基于压缩感知的自适应），一种从压缩感知理论扩展而来的新型PEFT方法。CoSA没有将权重更新限制在低秩子空间，而是通过固定的随机投影矩阵和一个紧凑的可学习核心来表达它们。我们提供了CoSA作为合成过程的正式理论分析，证明权重更新可以被紧凑地编码到一个低维空间，并通过随机投影映射回来。广泛的实验结果表明，CoSA为高效和富有表现力的多尺度模型自适应提供了一个有原则的视角。具体来说，我们在10个不同的任务上评估了CoSA，包括自然语言理解和生成，并采用了来自RoBERTa、Llama和Qwen系列的5个不同规模的模型。在这些设置中，CoSA持续匹配或优于最先进的PEFT方法。
tldr: CoSA是一种新的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，它使用压缩感知理论，通过固定随机投影矩阵和紧凑可学习核心来避免低秩假设的限制，并在多种任务和模型上超越了现有的SOTA PEFT方法。
ai_comments: CoSA的创新点在于将压缩感知（Compressed Sensing）这一信号处理领域的强大理论引入到大型语言模型（LLM）的参数高效微调（PEFT）领域，提供了一种替代传统的低秩分解（如LoRA）的方法。这一方法通过避免低秩假设，允许模型在权重更新的维度上拥有更高的表达自由度，尤其适用于那些权重奇异值分布均匀、低秩假设不成立的复杂任务。理论分析的提供增加了方法的严谨性。其在广泛任务和模型上的SOTA表现证明了该方法在实践中的重要性和有效性。
motivation: 现有的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法（如LoRA和PiSSA）依赖于低秩分解，但在奇异值分布相对均匀的任务特定自适应场景中，低秩假设可能会限制模型的表达能力。
method: 提出CoSA（基于压缩感知的自适应），一种源于压缩感知理论的新型PEFT方法。它不将权重更新限制在低秩子空间，而是通过固定的随机投影矩阵和一个紧凑的可学习核心来表达权重更新。该方法被形式化为一种合成过程，并提供了正式的理论分析。
results: CoSA在一系列实验中（包括10个不同的任务，如自然语言理解和生成，以及RoBERTa、Llama和Qwen系列中的5个不同规模的模型）持续匹配或优于最先进的PEFT方法。
conclusion: CoSA为高效且富有表现力的多尺度模型自适应提供了一个有原则的视角，并在实验中证明了其优越性。

title: RAG without Forgetting: Continual Query-Infused Key Memory
authors: Yuntong Hu, Sha Li, Naren Ramakrishnan, Liang Zhao
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems commonly improve robustness via query-time adaptations such as query expansion and iterative retrieval. While effective, these approaches are inherently stateless: adaptations are recomputed for each query and discarded thereafter, precluding cumulative learning and repeatedly incurring inference-time cost. Index-side approaches like key expansion introduce persistence but rely on offline preprocessing or heuristic updates that are weakly aligned with downstream task utility, leading to semantic drift and noise accumulation. We propose Evolving Retrieval Memory (ERM), a training-free framework that transforms transient query-time gains into persistent retrieval improvements. ERM updates the retrieval index through correctness-gated feedback, selectively attributes atomic expansion signals to the document keys they benefit, and progressively evolves keys via stable, norm-bounded updates. We show that query and key expansion are theoretically equivalent under standard similarity functions and prove convergence of ERM's selective updates, amortizing optimal query expansion into a stable index with zero inference-time overhead. Experiments on BEIR and BRIGHT across 13 domains demonstrate consistent gains in retrieval and generation, particularly on reasoning-intensive tasks, at native retrieval speed.
zh_title: RAG（检索增强生成）不遗忘：持续的查询注入式关键记忆
translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常通过查询时适应（如查询扩展和迭代检索）来提高鲁棒性。尽管有效，但这些方法本质上是无状态的：适应性计算针对每个查询重新进行，并在之后被丢弃，这阻碍了累积学习并反复产生推理时间成本。像键扩展这样的索引侧方法引入了持久性，但依赖于离线预处理或启发式更新，这些更新与下游任务效用对齐较弱，导致语义漂移和噪声积累。我们提出了演化检索记忆（ERM），这是一个免训练的框架，它将瞬态的查询时增益转化为持久的检索改进。ERM通过正确性门控反馈来更新检索索引，选择性地将原子扩展信号归因于它们所受益的文档键，并通过稳定、范数约束的更新逐步演化这些键。我们证明了在标准相似性函数下，查询和键扩展在理论上是等价的，并证明了ERM选择性更新的收敛性，从而将最优查询扩展摊销到一个稳定的索引中，实现了零推理时间开销。在BEIR和BRIGHT跨13个领域的实验表明，检索和生成方面持续获得提升，特别是在推理密集型任务上，且保持了原生的检索速度。
tldr: 提出ERM框架，通过正确性门控反馈，将瞬态的查询增强信号稳定、选择性地持续更新到检索索引（文档键）中，实现RAG的持续学习和性能提升，且推理时零开销。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将RAG的动态适应性从瞬时、高成本的查询侧转移到了持续、低成本的索引侧。通过引入“正确性门控反馈”和“选择性归因”机制，ERM有效地解决了传统键扩展中普遍存在的语义漂移和噪声积累问题，实现了RAG系统的持续学习能力（“不遗忘”）。其理论证明（查询/键等价性及收敛性）和实际效果（零推理开销下的性能提升）使其成为改进RAG鲁棒性和效率的重要一步。
motivation: 现有RAG的查询时适应方法（如查询扩展）是无状态的，无法实现累积学习并重复产生推理成本。现有的索引侧方法（如键扩展）更新方式不佳，导致语义漂移和噪声积累。
method: 提出“演化检索记忆”（ERM）框架。该框架是免训练的，通过“正确性门控反馈”更新检索索引，选择性地将原子扩展信号归因于受益的文档键，并通过稳定、范数约束的更新逐步演化这些键。理论上证明了查询和键扩展的等价性以及ERM选择性更新的收敛性。
results: 在BEIR和BRIGHT的13个领域上，检索和生成性能持续提升，尤其在推理密集型任务上效果显著，且保持了原生的检索速度（推理时零开销）。
conclusion: ERM成功地将最优查询扩展摊销到一个稳定的索引中，实现了RAG的持续学习和性能提升，且不增加推理时间开销。

title: The Necessity of a Holistic Safety Evaluation Framework for AI-Based Automation Features
authors: Alireza Abbaspour, Shabin Mahadevan, Kilian Zwirglmaier, Jeff Stafford
abstract: The intersection of Safety of Intended Functionality (SOTIF) and Functional Safety (FuSa) analysis of driving automation features has traditionally excluded Quality Management (QM) components from rigorous safety impact evaluations. While QM components are not typically classified as safety-relevant, recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI) integration reveal that such components can contribute to SOTIF-related hazardous risks. Compliance with emerging AI safety standards, such as ISO/PAS 8800, necessitates re-evaluating safety considerations for these components. This paper examines the necessity of conducting holistic safety analysis and risk assessment on AI components, emphasizing their potential to introduce hazards with the capacity to violate risk acceptance criteria when deployed in safety-critical driving systems, particularly in perception algorithms. Using case studies, we demonstrate how deficiencies in AI-driven perception systems can emerge even in QM-classified components, leading to unintended functional behaviors with critical safety implications. By bridging theoretical analysis with practical examples, this paper argues for the adoption of comprehensive FuSa, SOTIF, and AI standards-driven methodologies to identify and mitigate risks in AI components. The findings demonstrate the importance of revising existing safety frameworks to address the evolving challenges posed by AI, ensuring comprehensive safety assurance across all component classifications spanning multiple safety standards.
zh_title: 基于AI的自动化功能的整体安全评估框架的必要性
translation: 自动驾驶功能中的预期功能安全（SOTIF）与功能安全（FuSa）分析的交叉点传统上将质量管理（QM）组件排除在严格的安全影响评估之外。虽然QM组件通常不被归类为安全相关组件，但人工智能（AI）集成的最新发展表明，此类组件可能导致SOTIF相关的危险风险。遵守新兴的AI安全标准，例如ISO/PAS 8800，要求重新评估这些组件的安全考量。本文考察了对AI组件进行整体安全分析和风险评估的必要性，强调了它们在部署到安全关键驾驶系统（尤其是感知算法中）时，可能引入具有违反风险接受标准能力的危险。通过案例研究，我们证明了即使在QM分类的组件中，AI驱动的感知系统也可能出现缺陷，从而导致具有关键安全隐患的非预期功能行为。通过将理论分析与实际示例相结合，本文主张采用综合性的功能安全（FuSa）、预期功能安全（SOTIF）和AI标准驱动的方法论来识别和减轻AI组件中的风险。研究结果表明，修订现有安全框架以应对AI带来的不断变化的挑战，确保跨越多个安全标准的所有组件分类的全面安全保障的重要性。
tldr: 传统的安全评估忽略了AI系统中可能引入危险的质量管理（QM）组件。本文主张必须建立一个整合功能安全（FuSa）、预期功能安全（SOTIF）和新兴AI标准的整体安全评估框架，以全面识别和减轻AI自动化功能中的风险。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于指出了当前汽车安全标准（如SOTIF和FuSa）中的一个关键缺陷：在AI集成的情况下，传统上被归类为质量管理（QM）的组件也可能引入严重的、SOTIF相关的安全风险。其重要性在于，它倡导采用一个统一的、跨标准的（整合FuSa、SOTIF和ISO/PAS 8800等AI标准）整体方法论，来评估AI驱动的复杂系统（特别是感知算法）的安全。这种从组件分类到基于风险的整体评估的转变对于自动驾驶行业至关重要。
motivation: 传统的自动驾驶功能安全分析（SOTIF和FuSa）排除了质量管理（QM）组件的严格安全评估，但AI的集成表明QM组件可能导致SOTIF相关的危险风险。新兴AI安全标准（如ISO/PAS 8800）要求重新评估这些组件的安全考量。
method: 检验对AI组件进行整体安全分析和风险评估的必要性。通过案例研究，证明AI驱动的感知系统（即使是QM分类的组件）中的缺陷如何导致具有关键安全隐患的意外功能行为。提倡采用结合功能安全（FuSa）、预期功能安全（SOTIF）和AI标准的综合方法论。
results: 案例研究证明，即使是质量管理（QM）分类的组件，也可能在AI驱动的感知系统中出现缺陷，引发具有严重安全影响的非预期功能行为。研究结果表明，必须修订现有安全框架，以应对AI带来的挑战，确保跨越多个安全标准的所有组件分类的全面安全保障。
conclusion: 必须采用一个涵盖功能安全（FuSa）、预期功能安全（SOTIF）和新兴AI标准的整体安全评估框架，以识别和减轻AI组件（尤其是在感知算法中）带来的风险，确保安全关键驾驶系统的全面安全。

title: PLATO Hand: Shaping Contact Behavior with Fingernails for Precise Manipulation
authors: Dong Ho Kang, Aaron Kim, Mingyo Seo, Kazuto Yokoyama, Tetsuya Narita, Luis Sentis
abstract: We present the PLATO Hand, a dexterous robotic hand with a hybrid fingertip that embeds a rigid fingernail within a compliant pulp. This design shapes contact behavior to enable diverse interaction modes across a range of object geometries. We develop a strain-energy-based bending-indentation model to guide the fingertip design and to explain how guided contact preserves local indentation while suppressing global bending. Experimental results show that the proposed robotic hand design demonstrates improved pinching stability, enhanced force observability, and successful execution of edge-sensitive manipulation tasks, including paper singulation, card picking, and orange peeling. Together, these results show that coupling structured contact geometry with a force-motion transparent mechanism provides a principled, physically embodied approach to precise manipulation.
zh_title: PLATO 手：利用指甲塑造接触行为以实现精确操作
translation: 我们提出了 PLATO 手，这是一种灵巧的机械手，其混合指尖在柔性指腹内嵌入了刚性指甲。这种设计塑造了接触行为，以实现跨一系列物体几何形状的多样化交互模式。我们开发了一种基于应变能的弯曲-压痕模型来指导指尖设计，并解释了引导接触如何保持局部压痕同时抑制整体弯曲。实验结果表明，所提出的机械手设计展示了改进的捏取稳定性、增强的力可观测性，并成功执行了对边缘敏感的操作任务，包括分纸、捡卡片和剥橙皮。总而言之，这些结果表明，将结构化的接触几何形状与力-运动透明机制相结合，为精确操作提供了一种有原则、物理实现的方法。
tldr: PLATO 手是一种新型灵巧机械手，其混合指尖（柔性指腹内嵌刚性指甲）能塑造接触行为。该设计提高了捏取稳定性和力可观测性，成功实现了精确操作任务（如剥橙皮、分纸）。
ai_comments: 创新点在于仿生学——将刚性元素（指甲）集成到柔性结构（指腹）中，以控制接触力的柔顺性和局部化，这对于边缘敏感型操作至关重要。通过提供结构化的接触几何形状，该设计超越了简单的柔性抓手。使用物理模型（弯曲-压痕模型）来指导物理设计是一个重要的优势。
motivation: 通过塑造接触行为，实现对各种物体几何形状的精确操作。
method: 提出并设计了PLATO 手，其灵巧指尖采用混合结构（柔性指腹内嵌刚性指甲）。开发了基于应变能的弯曲-压痕模型来指导指尖设计，并解释了引导接触如何保持局部压痕同时抑制整体弯曲。
results: 实验结果表明，该机械手设计提高了捏取稳定性、增强了力可观测性，并成功执行了对边缘敏感的操作任务，包括分纸、捡卡片和剥橙皮。
conclusion: 将结构化的接触几何形状与力-运动透明机制相结合，为精确操作提供了一种有原则、物理实现的方法。

title: AirGlove: Exploring Egocentric 3D Hand Tracking and Appearance Generalization for Sensing Gloves
authors: Wenhui Cui, Ziyi Kou, Chuan Qin, Ergys Ristani, Li Guan
abstract: Sensing gloves have become important tools for teleoperation and robotic policy learning as they are able to provide rich signals like speed, acceleration and tactile feedback. A common approach to track gloved hands is to directly use the sensor signals (e.g., angular velocity, gravity orientation) to estimate 3D hand poses. However, sensor-based tracking can be restrictive in practice as the accuracy is often impacted by sensor signal and calibration quality. Recent advances in vision-based approaches have achieved strong performance on human hands via large-scale pre-training, but their performance on gloved hands with distinct visual appearances remains underexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of vision-based hand tracking models on gloved hands under both zero-shot and fine-tuning setups. Our analysis shows that existing bare-hand models suffer from substantial performance degradation on sensing gloves due to large appearance gap between bare-hand and glove designs. We therefore propose AirGlove, which leverages existing gloves to generalize the learned glove representations towards new gloves with limited data. Experiments with multiple sensing gloves show that AirGlove effectively generalizes the hand pose models to new glove designs and achieves a significant performance boost over the compared schemes.
zh_title: AirGlove：探索用于传感手套的以自我为中心的 3D 手部跟踪和外观泛化
translation: 传感手套已成为远程操作和机器人策略学习的重要工具，因为它们能够提供速度、加速度和触觉反馈等丰富的信号。跟踪戴手套的手的一个常见方法是直接使用传感器信号（例如角速度、重力方向）来估计 3D 手部姿势。然而，基于传感器的跟踪在实践中可能具有局限性，因为其准确性通常受到传感器信号和校准质量的影响。最近基于视觉方法的进展通过大规模预训练在人手上取得了强大的性能，但它们在具有独特视觉外观的传感手套上的性能仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们首次在零样本和微调设置下，对基于视觉的手部跟踪模型在戴手套的手上进行了系统的评估。我们的分析表明，由于裸手和手套设计之间巨大的外观差异，现有的裸手模型在传感手套上遭受了严重的性能下降。因此，我们提出了 AirGlove，它利用现有手套将学习到的手套表示泛化到数据有限的新手套。使用多个传感手套进行的实验表明，AirGlove 有效地将手部姿势模型泛化到新的手套设计，并比对比方案实现了显著的性能提升。
tldr: 现有基于视觉的手部跟踪模型在传感手套上性能不佳。本文提出了 AirGlove，通过学习手套表示来泛化到新的手套设计，显著提高了 3D 手部跟踪的准确性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于首次系统地评估了现有基于视觉的裸手跟踪模型在传感手套上的性能退化问题，并明确了外观泛化是关键瓶颈。AirGlove 提出的利用现有手套表示进行泛化的方法，对于提高依赖传感手套的远程操作和机器人学习的实用性和准确性具有重要意义。它有效地弥合了真实应用中裸手模型与特殊外观手套之间的性能差距。
motivation: 传感手套在远程操作和机器人策略学习中是重要工具。传统的基于传感器的跟踪方法受信号和校准质量影响，准确性受限。现有的基于视觉的裸手跟踪模型由于裸手和手套设计之间巨大的外观差异，在传感手套上的性能尚未得到充分探索且表现不佳。
method: 首先，对现有基于视觉的裸手跟踪模型在传感手套上进行了首次系统的零样本和微调设置下的评估。然后，提出了 AirGlove，它利用现有手套来泛化学习到的手套表示，使其适用于数据有限的新手套设计。
results: 现有裸手模型在传感手套上遭受了严重的性能下降。AirGlove 有效地将手部姿势模型泛化到新的手套设计，并比对比方案实现了显著的性能提升。
conclusion: AirGlove 能够有效地将手部姿势模型泛化到新的手套设计，并显著提高了性能，解决了视觉跟踪模型在传感手套外观泛化方面的挑战。

title: LOBSTgER-enhance: an underwater image enhancement pipeline
authors: Andreas Mentzelopoulos, Keith Ellenbogen
abstract:
Underwater photography presents significant inherent challenges including reduced contrast, spatial blur, and wavelength-dependent color distortions. These effects can obscure the vibrancy of marine life and awareness photographers in particular are often challenged with heavy post-processing pipelines to correct for these distortions.
  We develop an image-to-image pipeline that learns to reverse underwater degradations by introducing a synthetic corruption pipeline and learning to reverse its effects with diffusion-based generation. Training and evaluation are performed on a small high-quality dataset of awareness photography images by Keith Ellenbogen. The proposed methodology achieves high perceptual consistency and strong generalization in synthesizing 512x768 images using a model of ~11M parameters after training from scratch on ~2.5k images.
comment: 12 pages, 30 figures, work done as part of LOBSTgER
zh_title: LOBSTgER-enhance：一个水下图像增强流程
translation: 水下摄影存在固有的重大挑战，包括对比度降低、空间模糊和依赖于波长的颜色失真。这些影响会掩盖海洋生物的活力，特别是意识摄影师经常面临繁重的后期处理流程来校正这些失真。我们开发了一个图像到图像的流程，通过引入一个合成损坏流程并学习使用基于扩散的生成模型来逆转其影响，从而学习逆转水下退化。训练和评估是在Keith Ellenbogen拍摄的小型高质量意识摄影图像数据集上进行的。所提出的方法在使用约11M参数的模型，在约2.5k张图像上从头开始训练后，在合成512x768图像时实现了高感知一致性和强大的泛化能力。
tldr: 我们开发了一个名为LOBSTgER-enhance的基于扩散的图像到图像流程，用于高效地逆转水下照片中的对比度降低、模糊和颜色失真。该模型参数量小（约11M），在小数据集上训练后显示出良好的感知一致性和泛化能力。
ai_comments: 创新点在于结合了合成损坏流程和基于扩散的生成模型来解决水下图像增强问题。重要性在于其高效性（模型参数量小，约11M）以及在仅使用约2.5k张高质量图像小数据集进行训练后，仍能实现高感知一致性和强大的泛化能力，这对于简化专业摄影师的后期处理流程具有实际意义。
motivation: 水下摄影存在固有的挑战，包括对比度降低、空间模糊和依赖于波长的颜色失真。这些问题模糊了海洋生物的活力，且意识摄影师通常需要繁重的后期处理流程来校正这些失真，因此需要一个更高效的增强方案。
method: 开发了一个图像到图像的流程，该流程通过引入一个合成损坏流水线，并利用基于扩散的生成模型来学习逆转这些合成损坏的影响，从而实现水下图像退化的逆转。模型参数量约为11M，在Keith Ellenbogen拍摄的约2.5k张高质量意识摄影图像数据集上从头开始训练和评估。
results: 所提出的方法在合成512x768图像时实现了高感知一致性和强大的泛化能力。
conclusion: 成功开发了一个高效、小参数量的（约11M）基于扩散的图像到图像流程，能够有效地逆转水下退化，并在合成512x768图像时展现出高感知一致性和强大的泛化能力。

title: SHaSaM: Submodular Hard Sample Mining for Fair Facial Attribute Recognition
authors: Anay Majee, Rishabh Iyer
abstract: Deep neural networks often inherit social and demographic biases from annotated data during model training, leading to unfair predictions, especially in the presence of sensitive attributes like race, age, gender etc. Existing methods fall prey to the inherent data imbalance between attribute groups and inadvertently emphasize on sensitive attributes, worsening unfairness and performance. To surmount these challenges, we propose SHaSaM (Submodular Hard Sample Mining), a novel combinatorial approach that models fairness-driven representation learning as a submodular hard-sample mining problem. Our two-stage approach comprises of SHaSaM-MINE, which introduces a submodular subset selection strategy to mine hard positives and negatives - effectively mitigating data imbalance, and SHaSaM-LEARN, which introduces a family of combinatorial loss functions based on Submodular Conditional Mutual Information to maximize the decision boundary between target classes while minimizing the influence of sensitive attributes. This unified formulation restricts the model from learning features tied to sensitive attributes, significantly enhancing fairness without sacrificing performance. Experiments on CelebA and UTKFace demonstrate that SHaSaM achieves state-of-the-art results, with up to 2.7 points improvement in model fairness (Equalized Odds) and a 3.5% gain in Accuracy, within fewer epochs as compared to existing methods.
zh_title: SHaSaM：用于公平面部属性识别的子模硬样本挖掘
translation: 深度神经网络在模型训练中经常从标注数据中继承社会和人口偏见，导致预测不公平，尤其是在存在种族、年龄、性别等敏感属性的情况下。现有方法容易受到属性组之间固有的数据不平衡的影响，并无意中强调了敏感属性，从而加剧了不公平性和性能下降。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了SHaSaM（子模硬样本挖掘），这是一种新颖的组合方法，将公平驱动的表示学习建模为子模硬样本挖掘问题。我们的两阶段方法包括SHaSaM-MINE，它引入了一种子模子集选择策略来挖掘硬正样本和硬负样本，从而有效地减轻数据不平衡；以及SHaSaM-LEARN，它引入了一系列基于子模条件互信息的组合损失函数，旨在最大化目标类别之间的决策边界，同时最小化敏感属性的影响。这种统一的公式限制了模型学习与敏感属性绑定的特征，在不牺牲性能的情况下显著增强了公平性。在CelebA和UTKFace上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，SHaSaM实现了最先进的结果，模型公平性（Equalized Odds）提高了2.7点，准确率提高了3.5%，且所需的训练周期更少。
tldr: 提出SHaSaM，一种基于子模硬样本挖掘的两阶段方法，用于解决面部属性识别中的公平性问题。它通过子模选择挖掘硬样本并使用基于子模条件互信息的损失函数，有效减轻数据偏差，同时提高公平性（Equalized Odds提高2.7点）和准确率（提高3.5%）。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将公平性驱动的表示学习明确地框架为一个“子模硬样本挖掘”问题。通过引入两阶段的SHaSaM-MINE和SHaSaM-LEARN，作者提供了一个统一的、基于组合优化的解决方案来解决数据不平衡和敏感属性依赖性。使用子模函数（如SCMI）来同时优化目标边界和最小化敏感属性影响是其核心技术优势。该方法在公平性指标（Equalized Odds）和标准准确率上均取得了显著提升，证明了其在解决现实世界模型偏差方面的有效性和重要性。
motivation: 解决深度神经网络在模型训练中从标注数据继承社会和人口偏见，导致预测不公平的问题，尤其是在存在种族、年龄、性别等敏感属性的情况下。现有方法因数据不平衡和对敏感属性的过度强调而加剧了不公平性。
method: 提出SHaSaM（子模硬样本挖掘）方法，将公平驱动的表示学习建模为子模硬样本挖掘问题。该方法分两阶段：1. SHaSaM-MINE：采用子模子集选择策略挖掘硬正样本和硬负样本，以减轻数据不平衡。2. SHaSaM-LEARN：引入基于子模条件互信息（SCMI）的组合损失函数，最大化目标类别间的决策边界，同时最小化敏感属性的影响。
results: 在CelebA和UTKFace数据集上的实验表明，SHaSaM达到了最先进的结果，模型公平性（Equalized Odds）提高了2.7点，准确率提高了3.5%，且所需的训练周期少于现有方法。
conclusion: 提出的统一公式能够限制模型学习与敏感属性相关的特征，在不牺牲性能的情况下显著提高了公平性。

title: EBPO: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage for Stabilizing Group-Relative Policy Optimization
authors: Kevin Han, Yuhang Zhou, Mingze Gao, Gedi Zhou, Serena Li, Abhishek Kumar, Xiangjun Fan, Weiwei Li, Lizhu Zhang
abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has proven effective for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, dominant approaches like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) face critical stability challenges: they suffer from high estimator variance under computational constraints (small group sizes) and vanishing gradient signals in saturated failure regimes where all responses yield identical zero rewards. To address this, we propose Empirical Bayes Policy Optimization (EBPO), a novel framework that regularizes local group-based baselines by borrowing strength from the policy's accumulated global statistics. Instead of estimating baselines in isolation, EBPO employs a shrinkage estimator that dynamically balances local group statistics with a global prior updated via Welford's online algorithm. Theoretically, we demonstrate that EBPO guarantees strictly lower Mean Squared Error (MSE), bounded entropy decay, and non-vanishing penalty signals in failure scenarios compared to GRPO. Empirically, EBPO consistently outperforms GRPO and other established baselines across diverse benchmarks, including AIME and OlympiadBench. Notably, EBPO exhibits superior training stability, achieving high-performance gains even with small group sizes, and benefits significantly from difficulty-stratified curriculum learning.
zh_title: EBPO：用于稳定组相对策略优化的经验贝叶斯收缩
translation: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 已被证明可有效增强大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的推理能力。然而，主流方法如组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 面临着关键的稳定性挑战：它们在计算受限（小分组规模）下遭受高估计器方差，并且在所有响应都产生相同零奖励的饱和失败状态下梯度信号消失。为解决此问题，我们提出了经验贝叶斯策略优化 (EBPO)，这是一个新颖的框架，它通过借鉴策略累积的全局统计量来正则化局部分组基线。EBPO没有孤立地估计基线，而是采用收缩估计器，动态平衡局部组统计量和通过Welford在线算法更新的全局先验。在理论上，我们证明了与GRPO相比，EBPO保证了严格更低的均方误差 (MSE)，有界的熵衰减，以及在失败场景中非消失的惩罚信号。在经验上，EBPO在包括AIME和OlympiadBench在内的各种基准测试中持续优于GRPO和其他既定基线。值得注意的是，EBPO表现出卓越的训练稳定性，即使在小分组规模下也能实现高性能增益，并显著受益于难度分层的课程学习。
tldr: 针对组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 在小规模分组和奖励饱和时的不稳定问题，本文提出了经验贝叶斯策略优化 (EBPO)。EBPO利用经验贝叶斯收缩，动态平衡局部组统计量和全局先验，显著提高了训练稳定性，并在多个基准测试中优于GRPO。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将经验贝叶斯收缩方法引入策略优化中，以解决组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 在资源受限（小分组）时的高方差问题和在失败状态下的梯度消失问题。这种方法通过动态结合局部和全局统计量来稳定基线估计，显著提高了训练的鲁棒性和效率。理论上提供了MSE降低和熵衰减有界的保证，增强了方法的可靠性。这对于推动RLVR在实际LLM推理增强中的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 增强大型语言模型推理能力的RLVR方法中，主流的组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 存在稳定性挑战，具体表现为：在计算受限（小分组规模）时估计器方差高；在所有响应奖励相同（零奖励）的饱和失败状态下梯度信号消失。
method: 提出经验贝叶斯策略优化 (EBPO) 框架。EBPO通过引入收缩估计器，利用策略累积的全局统计量对局部基于组的基线进行正则化。该方法动态平衡了局部组统计量和通过Welford在线算法更新的全局先验。
results: 理论上，EBPO保证了比GRPO更低的均方误差 (MSE)，有界熵衰减，并在失败场景中具有非消失惩罚信号。经验上，EBPO在AIME和OlympiadBench等基准测试中持续优于GRPO和其他基线，即使在小分组规模下也表现出卓越的训练稳定性，并显著受益于难度分层的课程学习。
conclusion: EBPO通过经验贝叶斯收缩有效解决了GRPO的稳定性问题，显著提高了性能，尤其在小分组规模下表现出优越的训练稳定性，是增强LLMs推理能力的有效新框架。

title: Position: Capability Control Should be a Separate Goal From Alignment
authors: Shoaib Ahmed Siddiqui, Eleni Triantafillou, David Krueger, Adrian Weller
abstract: Foundation models are trained on broad data distributions, yielding generalist capabilities that enable many downstream applications but also expand the space of potential misuse and failures. This position paper argues that capability control -- imposing restrictions on permissible model behavior -- should be treated as a distinct goal from alignment. While alignment is often context and preference-driven, capability control aims to impose hard operational limits on permissible behaviors, including under adversarial elicitation. We organize capability control mechanisms across the model lifecycle into three layers: (i) data-based control of the training distribution, (ii) learning-based control via weight- or representation-level interventions, and (iii) system-based control via post-deployment guardrails over inputs, outputs, and actions. Because each layer has characteristic failure modes when used in isolation, we advocate for a defense-in-depth approach that composes complementary controls across the full stack. We further outline key open challenges in achieving such control, including the dual-use nature of knowledge and compositional generalization.
zh_title: 观点：能力控制应是一个独立于对齐的目标
translation: 基础模型是在广泛的数据分布上训练的，产生了通用能力，这使得许多下游应用成为可能，但也扩大了潜在滥用和失败的空间。本文的观点是，能力控制——对允许的模型行为施加限制——应被视为一个独立于对齐的目标。对齐通常是上下文和偏好驱动的，而能力控制旨在对允许的行为施加硬性操作限制，包括在对抗性诱导下。我们将模型生命周期中的能力控制机制组织为三个层面：(i) 基于数据的训练分布控制，(ii) 通过权重或表示层干预的基于学习的控制，以及 (iii) 通过对输入、输出和动作的部署后防护栏的基于系统的控制。由于每一层单独使用时都有其特有的失效模式，我们提倡采用深度防御方法，结合全栈互补控制措施。我们进一步概述了实现此类控制的关键开放挑战，包括知识的双重用途性质和组合泛化。
tldr: 本文提出一个观点：基础模型的“能力控制”（设定硬性操作限制）应作为独立于“对齐”（基于偏好和上下文）的目标。文章提出了一个三层深度防御方法来实现全栈能力控制，并讨论了现有挑战。
ai_comments: 这篇观点论文的重要性在于明确区分了AI安全领域的两个关键概念：能力控制和对齐，并指出能力控制需要更严格、更具操作性的硬性限制，尤其是在面对对抗性诱导时。文章提出的三层控制框架（数据、学习、系统）和深度防御策略为实现基础模型的安全部署提供了一个清晰且结构化的路线图，强调了多层防御的必要性，具有重要的指导意义。创新点在于将控制机制系统化地分解到模型生命周期的不同阶段。
motivation: 基础模型具有通用能力，但同时也扩大了潜在滥用和失败的空间。作者认为，为了有效管理这些风险，必须将旨在施加硬性操作限制的能力控制，视为一个独立于基于上下文和偏好的对齐目标。
method: 将能力控制机制组织为跨模型生命周期的三层：(i) 基于数据的训练分布控制；(ii) 基于学习的权重或表示层干预；(iii) 基于系统的部署后输入、输出和行动防护栏。倡导采用深度防御方法，结合全栈互补控制措施来应对单层控制的固有失效模式。
conclusion: 能力控制应作为一个独立目标，旨在对基础模型的行为施加硬性操作限制。实现这种控制需要采用跨越数据、学习和系统三个层面的深度防御方法，以应对知识双重用途和组合泛化等关键开放挑战。

title: ShapePuri: Shape Guided and Appearance Generalized Adversarial Purification
authors: Zhe Li, Bernhard Kainz
abstract: Deep neural networks demonstrate impressive performance in visual recognition, but they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that is imperceptible to the human. Although existing defense strategies such as adversarial training and purification have achieved progress, diffusion-based purification often involves high computational costs and information loss. To address these challenges, we introduce Shape Guided Purification (ShapePuri), a novel defense framework enhances robustness by aligning model representations with stable structural invariants. ShapePuri integrates two components: a Shape Encoding Module (SEM) that provides dense geometric guidance through Signed Distance Functions (SDF), and a Global Appearance Debiasing (GAD) module that mitigates appearance bias via stochastic transformations. In our experiments, ShapePuri achieves $84.06\%$ clean accuracy and $81.64\%$ robust accuracy under the AutoAttack protocol, representing the first defense framework to surpass the $80\%$ threshold on this benchmark. Our approach provides a scalable and efficient adversarial defense that preserves prediction stability during inference without requiring auxiliary modules or additional computational cost.
zh_title: ShapePuri：形状引导和外观泛化的对抗性净化
translation: 深度神经网络在视觉识别方面表现出令人印象深刻的性能，但它们仍然容易受到人类难以察觉的对抗性攻击。尽管现有的防御策略如对抗性训练和净化已经取得了进展，但基于扩散的净化通常涉及高计算成本和信息损失。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了形状引导净化（ShapePuri），一种新颖的防御框架，通过将模型表示与稳定的结构不变量对齐来增强鲁棒性。ShapePuri集成了两个组件：一个提供通过符号距离函数（SDF）的密集几何指导的形状编码模块（SEM），以及一个通过随机变换减轻外观偏差的全局外观去偏（GAD）模块。在我们的实验中，ShapePuri在AutoAttack协议下实现了$84.06\%$的干净准确率和$81.64\%$的鲁棒准确率，代表了第一个在该基准测试中超过$80\%$阈值的防御框架。我们的方法提供了一种可扩展且高效的对抗性防御，在推理过程中保持预测稳定性，而无需辅助模块或额外的计算成本。
tldr: ShapePuri是一种新的、高效的对抗防御方法，它使用形状信息（SDF）和外观去偏（GAD）来净化对抗样本，在AutoAttack测试中取得了超过80%的鲁棒准确率，并且不增加推理时的计算负担。
ai_comments: ShapePuri的创新点在于结合了形状信息（SDF）和外观去偏（GAD）来提高防御效果，同时声称在保持高准确率的同时实现了高效性，这是其重要性所在。其局限性可能在于对SDF提取的依赖性以及是否能泛化到更复杂的攻击场景。
motivation: 现有的基于扩散的净化方法计算成本高且信息损失大，为了解决这些挑战，需要一种新的防御框架来提高鲁棒性，同时保持效率。
method: ShapePuri是一个新的防御框架，集成了形状编码模块（SEM）和全局外观去偏（GAD）模块。SEM通过符号距离函数（SDF）提供密集的几何指导，而GAD模块通过随机变换来减轻外观偏差。
results: 在AutoAttack协议下，ShapePuri实现了$84.06\%$的干净准确率和$81.64\%$的鲁棒准确率，是第一个在该基准测试中超过$80\%$阈值的防御框架。
conclusion: ShapePuri提供了一种可扩展且高效的对抗性防御方法，在推理过程中保持预测稳定性，而无需额外的辅助模块或计算成本。

title: Among Us: Measuring and Mitigating Malicious Contributions in Model Collaboration Systems
authors: Ziyuan Yang, Wenxuan Ding, Shangbin Feng, Yulia Tsvetkov
abstract: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used in collaboration: multiple LMs trained by different parties collaborate through routing systems, multi-agent debate, model merging, and more. Critical safety risks remain in this decentralized paradigm: what if some of the models in multi-LLM systems are compromised or malicious? We first quantify the impact of malicious models by engineering four categories of malicious LMs, plug them into four types of popular model collaboration systems, and evaluate the compromised system across 10 datasets. We find that malicious models have a severe impact on the multi-LLM systems, especially for reasoning and safety domains where performance is lowered by 7.12% and 7.94% on average. We then propose mitigation strategies to alleviate the impact of malicious components, by employing external supervisors that oversee model collaboration to disable/mask them out to reduce their influence. On average, these strategies recover 95.31% of the initial performance, while making model collaboration systems fully resistant to malicious models remains an open research question.
zh_title: “在我们之中”：衡量和减轻模型协作系统中的恶意贡献
translation: 语言模型（LMs）越来越多地用于协作：由不同方训练的多个LMs通过路由系统、多智能体辩论、模型合并等方式进行协作。这种去中心化范式中存在关键的安全风险：如果多LLM系统中的某些模型被破坏或恶意怎么办？我们首先通过工程化四类恶意LMs来量化恶意模型的影响，将它们插入四种流行的模型协作系统中，并在10个数据集上评估受损系统。我们发现恶意模型对多LLM系统有严重影响，尤其是在推理和安全领域，平均性能分别下降了7.12%和7.94%。然后，我们提出了缓解策略来减轻恶意组件的影响，通过采用外部监督器来监督模型协作，以禁用/屏蔽它们，从而减少其影响。平均而言，这些策略恢复了95.31%的初始性能，但使模型协作系统完全抵抗恶意模型仍然是一个开放的研究问题。
tldr: 恶意模型严重损害了多语言模型协作系统的性能（推理和安全领域下降近8%），但通过添加外部监督器可以恢复95%的性能，不过完全免疫仍是难题。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于系统地量化了模型协作系统中恶意贡献的实际影响，并提出了初步的缓解策略。重要性在于它指出了去中心化模型协作范式中一个关键的安全漏洞。局限性在于，虽然缓解策略有效，但实现完全抵抗仍是一个开放性问题。
motivation: 语言模型越来越多地以去中心化的方式进行协作，但如果某些模型被破坏或恶意，就会产生关键的安全风险。需要量化这种恶意行为的影响并提出缓解措施。
method: 工程化四类恶意语言模型，将它们插入四种流行的模型协作系统中，并在10个数据集上评估受损系统的性能。然后，提出使用外部监督器来禁用/屏蔽恶意组件的缓解策略。
results: 恶意模型对多LLM系统有严重影响，尤其是在推理和安全领域，平均性能分别下降了7.12%和7.94%。缓解策略平均恢复了95.31%的初始性能。
conclusion: 所提出的缓解策略平均恢复了初始性能的95.31%，但使模型协作系统完全抵抗恶意模型仍然是一个开放的研究问题。

title: Prediction Laundering: The Illusion of Neutrality, Transparency, and Governance in Polymarket
authors: Yasaman Rohanifar, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed, Sharifa Sultana
abstract: The growing reliance on prediction markets as epistemic infrastructures has positioned platforms like Polymarket as providers of objective, real-time probabilistic truth, yet the signals they produce often obscure uncertainty, strategic manipulation, and capital asymmetries, encouraging misplaced epistemic trust. This paper presents a qualitative sociotechnical audit of Polymarket (N = 27), combining digital ethnography, interpretive walkthroughs, and semi-structured interviews to examine how probabilistic authority is produced and contested. We introduce the concept of Prediction Laundering, drawing on MacFarlanes framework of knowledge transmission, to describe how subjective, high-uncertainty bets, strategic hedges, and capital-heavy whale activity are stripped of their original noise through algorithmic aggregation. We trace a four-stage laundering lifecycle: Structural Sanitization, where a centralized ontology scripts the bet-able future; Probabilistic Flattening, which collapses heterogeneous motives into a single signal; Architectural Masking, which conceals capital-driven influence behind apparent consensus; and Epistemic Hardening, which erases governance disputes to produce an objective historical fact. We show that this process induces epistemic vertigo and accountability gaps by offloading truth-resolution to off-platform communities such as Discord. Challenging narratives of frictionless collective intelligence, we demonstrate Epistemic Stratification, in which technical elites audit underlying mechanisms while the broader public consumes a sanitized, capital-weighted signal, and we conclude by advocating Friction-Positive Design that surfaces the social and financial frictions inherent in synthetic truth production.
zh_title: 预测洗钱：Polymarket中中立性、透明度和治理的幻觉
translation: 日益依赖预测市场作为认识论基础设施，已将Polymarket等平台定位为客观、实时的概率真理提供者，但它们产生的信号往往掩盖了不确定性、战略操纵和资本不对称性，助长了错误的认识论信任。本文对Polymarket（N=27）进行了定性社会技术审计，结合了数字民族志、解释性走查和半结构化访谈，以检验概率权威是如何被产生和争夺的。我们引入了“预测洗钱”的概念，借鉴了MacFarlane的知识传递框架，用以描述主观的、高不确定性的投注、战略对冲和资本雄厚的鲸鱼活动如何通过算法聚合被剥离了其原始噪音。我们追踪了一个四阶段的洗钱生命周期：结构净化，其中一个中心化的本体论脚本化了可投注的未来；概率扁平化，它将异构的动机压缩成单一信号；架构掩蔽，它将资本驱动的影响力隐藏在表面的共识之后；以及认识论硬化，它抹去了治理争议，产生了一个客观的历史事实。我们表明，这一过程通过将真理的解决推给平台外的社区（如Discord）而诱发了认识论眩晕和问责缺口。挑战了“无摩擦集体智能”的叙事，我们展示了“认识论分层”：技术精英审计底层机制，而广大公众则消费着经过净化、按资本加权的信号，我们最后主张采用“正摩擦设计”，以凸显合成真理生产中固有的社会和金融摩擦。
tldr: Polymarket等预测市场通过“预测洗钱”的四个技术和结构步骤（结构净化、概率扁平化、架构掩蔽、认识论硬化）将主观、有偏见的投注转化为看似客观的概率信号，掩盖了资本不对称和操纵，制造了虚假的确定性，并使问责制外流到平台外社区。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了“预测洗钱”（Prediction Laundering）这一新颖的概念，深入揭示了预测市场（以Polymarket为例）如何通过技术和结构机制掩盖不确定性、资本不对称和操纵行为，从而制造出虚假的客观性。其重要性在于对日益依赖的“知识基础设施”提出了深刻的批判。局限性在于研究主要基于定性分析，且样本量（N=27）相对较小。
motivation: 日益依赖预测市场作为认识论基础设施，但它们产生的信号往往掩盖了不确定性、战略操纵和资本不对称性，从而助长了错误的认识论信任。
method: 结合数字民族志、解释性走查和半结构化访谈的定性社会技术审计（N=27）。
results: 证明了“预测洗钱”的四个阶段：结构净化、概率扁平化、架构掩蔽和认识论硬化，这些阶段共同作用，消除了原始噪音，产生了一个客观的历史事实。同时揭示了“认识论分层”现象，即技术精英审计底层机制，而公众消费着经过净化、按资本加权的信号。
conclusion: 该过程会诱发“认识论眩晕”和问责缺口，因为真理的解决被转移到了平台外的社区（如Discord）。论文最后主张采用“正摩擦设计”（Friction-Positive Design），以凸显合成真理生产中固有的社会和金融摩擦。

title: The Single-Multi Evolution Loop for Self-Improving Model Collaboration Systems
authors: Shangbin Feng, Kishan Panaganti, Yulia Tsvetkov, Wenhao Yu
abstract: Model collaboration -- systems where multiple language models (LMs) collaborate -- combines the strengths of diverse models with cost in loading multiple LMs. We improve efficiency while preserving the strengths of collaboration by distilling collaborative patterns into a single model, where the model is trained on the outputs of the model collaboration system. At inference time, only the distilled model is employed: it imitates the collaboration while only incurring the cost of a single model. Furthermore, we propose the single-multi evolution loop: multiple LMs collaborate, each distills from the collaborative outputs, and these post-distillation improved LMs collaborate again, forming a collective evolution ecosystem where models evolve and self-improve by interacting with an environment of other models. Extensive experiments with 7 collaboration strategies and 15 tasks (QA, reasoning, factuality, etc.) demonstrate that: 1) individual models improve by 8.0% on average, absorbing the strengths of collaboration while reducing the cost to a single model; 2) the collaboration also benefits from the stronger and more synergistic LMs after distillation, improving over initial systems without evolution by 14.9% on average. Analysis reveals that the single-multi evolution loop outperforms various existing evolutionary AI methods, is compatible with diverse model/collaboration/distillation settings, and helps solve problems where the initial model/system struggles to.
zh_title: 用于自改进模型协作系统的单一-多重进化循环
translation: 模型协作——多个语言模型（LMs）协作的系统——结合了不同模型的优势和加载多个LM的成本。我们通过将协作模式蒸馏到一个单独的模型中来提高效率，同时保留协作的优势，该模型在模型协作系统的输出上进行训练。在推理时，只使用蒸馏后的模型：它模仿协作，但只产生单个模型的成本。此外，我们提出了单一-多重进化循环：多个LM协作，每个LM从协作输出中蒸馏，然后这些蒸馏后的LM再次协作，形成一个集体进化生态系统，模型通过与其他模型的交互进行进化和自我改进。在7种协作策略和15个任务（QA、推理、事实性等）上的广泛实验表明：1）单个模型平均提高8.0%，吸收了协作的优势，同时成本降低到单个模型；2）蒸馏后的模型更强，协同作用更好，与没有进化的初始系统相比，协作平均提高了14.9%。分析显示，单一-多重进化循环优于现有的各种进化人工智能方法，兼容各种模型/协作/蒸馏设置，并有助于解决初始模型/系统难以解决的问题。
tldr: 通过将协作模式蒸馏到单个模型中来提高模型协作系统的效率，并提出了一个单一-多多重进化循环，使模型能够通过与其他模型的交互进行自我改进，实验证明了该方法的有效性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的“单一-多重进化循环”方法，有效地解决了模型协作系统的效率和性能问题。通过蒸馏技术，将复杂协作的优势融入单一模型，显著降低了推理成本。进化循环的设计使得模型能够持续自我改进，形成了一个动态的协作生态系统。实验结果令人信服，证明了该方法的有效性和广泛适用性。未来可进一步探索不同蒸馏技术和进化策略对系统性能的影响。
motivation: 提高模型协作系统的效率，同时保留其优势，并使模型能够自我改进。
method: 将模型协作的输出蒸馏到一个单独的模型中进行训练，并提出了一种单一-多重进化循环，其中多个语言模型进行协作，每个模型从协作输出中进行蒸馏，然后这些蒸馏后的模型再次协作，形成一个集体进化生态系统。
results: 1. 单个模型平均提高8.0%，吸收了协作的优势，同时成本降低到单个模型。 2. 蒸馏后的模型更强，协同作用更好，与没有进化的初始系统相比，协作平均提高了14.9%。
conclusion: 单一-多重进化循环优于现有的进化人工智能方法，兼容各种模型/协作/蒸馏设置，并有助于解决初始模型/系统难以解决的问题。

title: Data-Centric Interpretability for LLM-based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: John Yan, Michael Yu, Yuqi Sun, Alexander Duffy, Tyler Marques, Matthew Lyle Olson
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained in complex Reinforcement Learning, multi-agent environments, making it difficult to understand how behavior changes over training. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have recently shown to be useful for data-centric interpretability. In this work, we analyze large-scale reinforcement learning training runs from the sophisticated environment of Full-Press Diplomacy by applying pretrained SAEs, alongside LLM-summarizer methods.
