translation: 高质量内核对于可扩展AI系统至关重要，而使大型语言模型（LLM）生成此类代码将推动AI发展。然而，为此任务训练LLM需要足够的数据、一个健壮的环境，并且训练过程通常容易受到奖励欺骗和惰性优化的影响。在这些情况下，模型可能会利用训练奖励的漏洞，优先考虑表面正确性而非有意义的加速。在本文中，我们系统地研究了用于内核生成的强化学习（RL）。我们首先设计了KernelGYM，这是一个健壮的分布式GPU环境，支持奖励欺骗检查、多轮交互数据收集和长期RL训练。基于KernelGYM，我们研究了有效的多轮RL方法，并识别出GRPO中由自包含导致的偏差策略梯度问题。为解决此问题，我们提出了**Turn-level Reinforce-Leave-One-Out (TRLOO)**，为多轮RL提供无偏优势估计。为了缓解惰性优化，我们纳入了不匹配校正以稳定训练，并引入了**Profiling-based Rewards (PR)**和**Profiling-based Rejection Sampling (PRS)**来克服该问题。训练出的模型**Dr.Kernel-14B**在Kernelbench上达到了与Claude-4.5-Sonnet相当的性能。最后，我们研究了Dr.Kernel-14B的顺序测试时扩展。在KernelBench Level-2子集上，31.6%的生成内核实现了至少1.2倍于Torch参考的速度提升，超过了Claude-4.5-Sonnet (26.7%)和GPT-5 (28.6%)。当从所有轮次中选择最佳候选时，这一1.2倍加速率进一步增加到47.8%。所有资源，包括环境、训练代码、模型和数据集，均包含在https://www.github.com/hkust-nlp/KernelGYM。
tldr: 针对LLM生成Triton内核时强化学习训练中的奖励欺骗和惰性优化问题，我们设计了健壮的环境KernelGYM和新的RL算法（TRLOO、PR、PRS）。我们训练的Dr.Kernel-14B模型在生成高加速比内核方面超越了Claude-4.5-Sonnet和GPT-5。
ai_comments: 本文解决了将强化学习应用于内核代码生成时的关键实际挑战，特别是奖励欺骗和惰性优化问题。其创新点在于：1) 设计了**KernelGYM**这一健壮的分布式GPU环境，支持多轮交互和奖励欺骗检查。2) 提出了**TRLOO**算法来纠正多轮RL中的策略梯度偏差。3) 引入了基于分析的奖励和采样机制（PR/PRS）来确保模型追求有意义的性能提升。在内核加速率上超越顶尖专有模型（如GPT-5和Claude-4.5-Sonnet），证明了其方法在专业领域中的有效性和重要性。
motivation: 高质量内核对于可扩展AI系统至关重要。使用LLM生成内核代码面临挑战，包括数据不足、环境不健壮、奖励欺骗（reward hacking）和惰性优化（lazy optimization），导致模型可能追求表面正确性而非有意义的加速。
method: 系统研究了用于内核生成的强化学习（RL）。首先设计了**KernelGYM**，一个支持奖励欺骗检查、多轮交互数据收集和长期RL训练的分布式GPU环境。其次，针对GRPO中自包含导致的偏差策略梯度问题，提出了**Turn-level Reinforce-Leave-One-Out (TRLOO)**以提供无偏优势估计。最后，通过整合不匹配校正以及引入**Profiling-based Rewards (PR)**和**Profiling-based Rejection Sampling (PRS)**来缓解惰性优化问题。
results: 训练出的模型**Dr.Kernel-14B**在Kernelbench上达到了与Claude-4.5-Sonnet相当的性能。在KernelBench Level-2子集上，Dr.Kernel-14B生成的内核中有31.6%实现了至少1.2倍于Torch参考的速度提升，超过了Claude-4.5-Sonnet (26.7%)和GPT-5 (28.6%)。通过从所有轮次中选择最佳候选，这一1.2倍加速率进一步提高到47.8%。
conclusion: 该研究系统地解决了强化学习在内核生成中的挑战，通过提出的环境和算法（TRLOO、PR、PRS）成功训练出高性能模型Dr.Kernel-14B，在加速率上超越了顶尖LLM，证明了所提方法的有效性。

title: DFPO: Scaling Value Modeling via Distributional Flow towards Robust and Generalizable LLM Post-Training
authors: Dingwei Zhu, Zhiheng Xi, Shihan Dou, Jiahan Li, Chenhao Huang, Junjie Ye, Sixian Li, Mingxu Chai, Yuhui Wang, Yajie Yang, Ming Zhang, Jiazheng Zhang, Shichun Liu, Caishuang Huang, Yunke Zhang, Yuran Wang, Tao Gui, Xipeng Qiu, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
abstract: Training reinforcement learning (RL) systems in real-world environments remains challenging due to noisy supervision and poor out-of-domain (OOD) generalization, especially in LLM post-training. Recent distributional RL methods improve robustness by modeling values with multiple quantile points, but they still learn each quantile independently as a scalar. This results in rough-grained value representations that lack fine-grained conditioning on state information, struggling under complex and OOD conditions. We propose DFPO (Distributional Value Flow Policy Optimization with Conditional Risk and Consistency Control), a robust distributional RL framework that models values as continuous flows across time steps. By scaling value modeling through learning of a value flow field instead of isolated quantile predictions, DFPO captures richer state information for more accurate advantage estimation. To stabilize training under noisy feedback, DFPO further integrates conditional risk control and consistency constraints along value flow trajectories. Experiments on dialogue, math reasoning, and scientific tasks show that DFPO outperforms PPO, FlowRL, and other robust baselines under noisy supervision, achieving improved training stability and generalization.
zh_title: DFPO：通过分布流扩展价值建模，实现稳健且可泛化的LLM后训练
translation: 在现实世界环境中训练强化学习（RL）系统仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在LLM后训练中，存在监督信号嘈杂和域外（OOD）泛化能力差的问题。最近的分布RL方法通过使用多个分位数点建模价值来提高鲁棒性，但它们仍将每个分位数点作为标量独立学习。这导致价值表示粒度粗糙，缺乏对状态信息的细粒度调节，难以应对复杂和OOD条件。我们提出了DFPO（带有条件风险和一致性控制的分布价值流策略优化），这是一个稳健的分布RL框架，它将价值建模为跨时间步的连续流。通过学习一个价值流场而非孤立的分位数预测来扩展价值建模，DFPO捕获了更丰富的状态信息，以实现更精确的优势估计。为了在嘈杂反馈下稳定训练，DFPO进一步集成了条件风险控制和沿价值流轨迹的一致性约束。在对话、数学推理和科学任务上的实验表明，在嘈杂的监督下，DFPO优于PPO、FlowRL和其他稳健基线，实现了更高的训练稳定性和泛化能力。
tldr: DFPO是一种新的分布强化学习框架，通过将价值建模为连续的“价值流场”，而非独立的量化点，显著提高了LLM后训练在噪声和域外条件下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
ai_comments: 本文的核心创新在于将分布强化学习中的价值建模从离散的标量分位数扩展到连续的“价值流场”。这种方法能捕获更细粒度的状态信息，解决现有方法在复杂和OOD条件下价值表示粗糙的限制。对于需要处理高噪声和强调泛化能力的LLM后训练场景而言，DFPO提供了一个重要的、更具鲁棒性的策略优化方案，具有很高的实际应用价值。
motivation: 现实世界中的强化学习系统（尤其是在LLM后训练中）面临监督信号嘈杂和域外（OOD）泛化能力差的挑战。现有的分布强化学习方法使用独立的标量分位数点来建模价值，导致价值表示粗糙，缺乏对状态信息的细粒度调节，难以应对复杂和OOD条件。
method: 提出DFPO（带有条件风险和一致性控制的分布价值流策略优化）框架。方法通过学习一个跨时间步的连续“价值流场”来扩展价值建模，而非孤立的分位数预测，从而捕获更丰富的状态信息以实现更精确的优势估计。此外，DFPO还集成了条件风险控制和沿价值流轨迹的一致性约束，以稳定训练。
results: 在对话、数学推理和科学任务上的实验表明，在嘈杂的监督下，DFPO优于PPO、FlowRL和其他稳健基线，实现了更高的训练稳定性和泛化能力。
conclusion: DFPO通过引入价值流建模和控制机制，成功解决了LLM后训练中价值建模粗糙、泛化能力差的问题，显著提高了训练的稳定性和在嘈杂监督下的泛化能力。

title: Metric Hedonic Games on the Line
authors: Merlin de la Haye, Pascal Lenzner, Farehe Soheil, Marcus Wunderlich
abstract:
Hedonic games are fundamental models for investigating the formation of coalitions among a set of strategic agents, where every agent has a certain utility for every possible coalition of agents it can be part of. To avoid the intractability of defining exponentially many utilities for all possible coalitions, many variants with succinct representations of the agents' utility functions have been devised and analyzed, e.g., modified fractional hedonic games by Monaco et al. [JAAMAS 2020]. We extend this by studying a novel succinct variant that is related to modified fractional hedonic games. In our model, each agent has a fixed type-value and an agent's cost for some given coalition is based on the differences between its value and those of the other members of its coalition. This allows to model natural situations like athletes forming training groups with similar performance levels or voters that partition themselves along a political spectrum.
  In particular, we investigate natural variants where an agent's cost is defined by distance thresholds, or by the maximum or average value difference to the other agents in its coalition. For these settings, we study the existence of stable coalition structures, their properties, and their quality in terms of the price of anarchy and the price of stability. Further, we investigate the impact of limiting the maximum number of coalitions. Despite the simple setting with metric distances on a line, we uncover a rich landscape of models, partially with counter-intuitive behavior. Also, our focus on both swap stability and jump stability allows us to study the influence of fixing the number and the size of the coalitions. Overall, we find that stable coalition structures always exist but that their properties and quality can vary widely.
translation: 享乐博弈是研究战略智能体集合之间结盟形成的基础模型，其中每个智能体对其可能加入的每个联盟都具有一定的效用。为了避免为所有可能的联盟定义指数级数量的效用的难度，人们设计并分析了许多具有简洁表示的智能体效用函数变体，例如 Monac 等人 [JAAMAS 2020] 提出的修正分数享乐博弈。我们通过研究一种与修正分数享乐博弈相关的新型简洁变体来扩展这一领域。在我们的模型中，每个智能体都有一个固定的类型值，智能体对于给定联盟的成本基于其自身值与其联盟中其他成员的值之间的差异。这使得可以对自然情境进行建模，例如运动员组成具有相似表现水平的训练小组，或选民沿着政治光谱进行划分。具体而言，我们研究了智能体成本由距离阈值、或由联盟中与其他智能体的最大或平均价值差异定义的自然变体。对于这些设置，我们研究了稳定联盟结构的存在性、它们的性质以及它们的质量（以无政府代价和稳定代价衡量）。此外，我们还研究了限制最大联盟数量的影响。尽管设置简单，具有线上的度量距离，但我们揭示了一个丰富的模型图景，其中部分行为是反直觉的。此外，我们对交换稳定性和跳跃稳定性的关注使我们能够研究固定联盟数量和大小的影响。总的来说，我们发现稳定的联盟结构总是存在的，但它们的性质和质量可以广泛变化。
tldr: 本文提出并研究了一种新型的线性度量享乐博弈，其中特工的结盟成本基于其类型值在线性上的度量差异。研究了不同成本定义下的稳定联盟结构的存在性、性质和质量（PoA/PoS），发现稳定结构总是存在，但其性质和质量变化很大，且存在反直觉行为。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“线性度量享乐博弈”这一新的简洁模型，成功地将度量距离的概念引入到享乐博弈的效用函数中，从而能够简洁地表示复杂的偏好结构，并模拟现实世界中基于相似性的分组情境（如政治光谱、绩效水平）。通过在线性环境中研究不同的成本函数（阈值、最大值、平均值），作者揭示了即使在最简单的几何设置中，享乐博弈也可能展现出丰富的、甚至反直觉的动态行为。同时，对无政府代价（PoA）和稳定代价（PoS）的分析，以及对两种稳定性概念（交换稳定性和跳跃稳定性）的对比研究，为理解这类博弈的效率和鲁棒性提供了全面的视角。
motivation: 享乐博弈是研究战略智能体结盟形成的基础模型。由于定义所有可能联盟的效用函数过于复杂，需要设计具有简洁表示的变体。本文旨在通过研究一种与修正分数享乐博弈相关的新型简洁变体来扩展现有工作，该模型允许建模自然情境，如性能相似的运动员组建训练小组或沿政治光谱划分的选民。
method: 研究了特工成本由距离阈值、或联盟内与其他特工的最大或平均价值差异定义的自然变体。分析了稳定联盟结构的存在性、性质以及质量（以无政府代价 Price of Anarchy 和稳定代价 Price of Stability 衡量）。此外，还研究了限制最大联盟数量的影响，并关注了交换稳定性（swap stability）和跳跃稳定性（jump stability）。
results: 尽管设置简单，但揭示了丰富的模型图景，部分行为是反直觉的。稳定联盟结构总是存在，但它们的性质和质量差异很大。
conclusion: 稳定联盟结构总是存在，但其性质和质量变化广泛。通过关注交换稳定性和跳跃稳定性，研究了固定联盟数量和大小的影响。

title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Waste-Container Lifting Using Large-Scale Cranes with Underactuated Tools
authors: Qi Li, Karsten Berns
abstract: This paper studies the container lifting phase of a waste-container recycling task in urban environments, performed by a hydraulic loader crane equipped with an underactuated discharge unit, and proposes a residual reinforcement learning (RRL) approach that combines a nominal Cartesian controller with a learned residual policy. All experiments are conducted in simulation, where the task is characterized by tight geometric tolerances between the discharge-unit hooks and the container rings relative to the overall crane scale, making precise trajectory tracking and swing suppression essential. The nominal controller uses admittance control for trajectory tracking and pendulum-aware swing damping, followed by damped least-squares inverse kinematics with a nullspace posture term to generate joint velocity commands. A PPO-trained residual policy in Isaac Lab compensates for unmodeled dynamics and parameter variations, improving precision and robustness without requiring end-to-end learning from scratch. We further employ randomized episode initialization and domain randomization over payload properties, actuator gains, and passive joint parameters to enhance generalization. Simulation results demonstrate improved tracking accuracy, reduced oscillations, and higher lifting success rates compared to the nominal controller alone.
zh_title: 基于欠驱动工具的大型起重机用于废物容器吊装的残差强化学习
translation: 本文研究了城市环境中废物容器回收任务中的容器吊装阶段，该任务由配备欠驱动卸载单元的液压装载机起重机执行。本文提出了一种残差强化学习（RRL）方法，将名义笛卡尔控制器与学习到的残差策略相结合。所有实验均在模拟中进行，该任务的特点是相对于起重机的整体规模而言，卸载单元的挂钩与容器环之间的几何公差非常紧密，因此精确的轨迹跟踪和抑制摆动至关重要。名义控制器使用导纳控制进行轨迹跟踪和摆动感知阻尼，然后通过阻尼最小二乘逆运动学和零空间姿态项来生成关节速度命令。在Isaac Lab中训练的PPO残差策略补偿了未建模的动力学和参数变化，在不需要从头开始进行端到端学习的情况下提高了精度和鲁棒性。我们进一步采用随机化的情节初始化和针对有效载荷特性、执行器增益和被动关节参数的域随机化来增强泛化能力。模拟结果表明，与单独的名义控制器相比，该方法提高了跟踪精度，减少了振荡，并获得了更高的吊装成功率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种残差强化学习（RRL）方法，将名义笛卡尔控制器与学习到的残差策略结合，用于模拟环境中大型液压装载机起重机吊装废物容器的任务，显著提高了精度和成功率。
ai_comments: 创新点在于采用了残差强化学习（RRL）范式，有效地结合了传统的控制知识（名义控制器）和数据驱动的RL（残差策略）。这避免了纯粹端到端RL训练的复杂性和数据需求，同时提高了系统对未建模动态和参数变化的鲁棒性。对于处理具有严格几何限制和大规模动态的现实世界重型机械自动化任务，这是一个重要且实用的方法。
motivation: 解决城市环境中废物容器回收任务中，大型液压装载机起重机吊装阶段的精确控制挑战。由于几何公差紧密且起重机规模大，精确的轨迹跟踪和抑制摆动至关重要。
method: 提出残差强化学习（RRL）方法，结合名义笛卡尔控制器和学习到的残差策略。名义控制器使用导纳控制进行轨迹跟踪和摆动阻尼，并通过阻尼最小二乘逆运动学生成关节速度指令。残差策略是使用PPO在Isaac Lab中训练的，用于补偿未建模的动力学和参数变化。使用随机化初始化和针对载荷、执行器增益和被动关节参数的域随机化来增强泛化能力。
results: 模拟结果表明，与单独的名义控制器相比，RRL方法提高了跟踪精度，减少了振荡，并获得了更高的吊装成功率。
conclusion: RRL方法通过结合传统控制器（名义笛卡尔控制器）和学习到的残差策略，在不依赖从头开始的端到端学习的情况下，成功提高了大型起重机废物容器吊装任务的精度和鲁棒性。

title: ContextBench: A Benchmark for Context Retrieval in Coding Agents
authors: Han Li, Letian Zhu, Bohan Zhang, Rili Feng, Jiaming Wang, Yue Pan, Earl T. Barr, Sarro Federica, Zhaoyang Chu, He Ye
abstract: LLM-based coding agents have shown strong performance on automated issue resolution benchmarks, yet existing evaluations largely focus on final task success, providing limited insight into how agents retrieve and use code context during problem solving. We introduce ContextBench, a process-oriented evaluation of context retrieval in coding agents. ContextBench consists of 1,136 issue-resolution tasks from 66 repositories across eight programming languages, each augmented with human-annotated gold contexts. We further implement an automated evaluation framework that tracks agent trajectories and measures context recall, precision, and efficiency throughout issue resolution. Using ContextBench, we evaluate four frontier LLMs and five coding agents. Our results show that sophisticated agent scaffolding yields only marginal gains in context retrieval ("The Bitter Lesson" of coding agents), LLMs consistently favor recall over precision, and substantial gaps exist between explored and utilized context. ContextBench augments existing end-to-end benchmarks with intermediate gold-context metrics that unbox the issue-resolution process. These contexts offer valuable intermediate signals for guiding LLM reasoning in software tasks. Data and code are available at: https://cioutn.github.io/context-bench/.
zh_title: ContextBench：一个用于编码智能体中上下文检索的基准
translation: 基于LLM的编码智能体在自动化问题解决基准上表现出强大的性能，然而现有的评估主要关注最终任务的成功，对智能体在解决问题过程中如何检索和使用代码上下文提供的见解有限。我们引入了ContextBench，这是一个针对编码智能体中上下文检索的面向过程评估。ContextBench包含来自66个代码仓库（涵盖八种编程语言）的1136个问题解决任务，每个任务都通过人工标注的黄金上下文进行了增强。我们进一步实现了一个自动化评估框架，用于跟踪智能体轨迹并测量其在问题解决过程中的上下文召回率、精确度和效率。使用ContextBench，我们评估了四种前沿LLM和五个编码智能体。我们的结果显示，复杂的智能体脚手架对上下文检索的提升仅有微小的收益（即“编码智能体的苦涩教训”），LLMs持续偏爱召回率而非精确度，并且已探索和已利用的上下文之间存在实质性差距。ContextBench通过中间的黄金上下文指标增强了现有的端到端基准，揭示了问题解决过程。这些上下文为指导LLM在软件任务中的推理提供了宝贵的中间信号。数据和代码可在：https://cioutn.github.io/context-bench/获取。
tldr: 引入ContextBench，这是一个针对LLM编码智能体的上下文检索过程评估基准。它包含1136个带有黄金上下文的人工标注任务，并使用自动化框架测量召回率、精确度和效率。结果显示，复杂的智能体脚手架对上下文检索的提升微乎其微，且LLMs偏爱召回而非精确度。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将对编码智能体的评估从传统的“端到端成功率”转向对关键中间步骤“上下文检索”的“面向过程”评估。这对于理解LLM在复杂软件任务中的推理机制至关重要，因为准确高效地检索上下文是生成正确修复方案的基础。ContextBench通过提供人工标注的黄金上下文和过程性指标（如召回率和精确度），为未来的智能体设计和LLM微调提供了更精细、更有指导意义的信号，有助于克服智能体在实际应用中表现出的“苦涩教训”。
motivation: 现有的评估主要关注最终任务的成功率，未能提供关于LLM编码智能体在解决问题过程中如何检索和使用代码上下文的深入见解。
method: 引入ContextBench，这是一个面向过程的上下文检索评估基准，包含来自66个代码仓库（8种编程语言）的1136个带有“人工标注黄金上下文”的问题解决任务。同时实施了一个自动化评估框架，用于跟踪智能体轨迹并测量其在问题解决过程中的上下文召回率、精确度和效率。
results: 复杂的智能体脚手架（scaffolding）对上下文检索的提升效果微乎其微（即“编码智能体的苦涩教训”）。大型语言模型（LLMs）持续偏爱召回率而非精确度。已探索的上下文与实际利用的上下文之间存在巨大差距。
conclusion: ContextBench通过中间的黄金上下文指标增强了现有的端到端基准，揭示了问题解决过程。这些上下文为指导LLM在软件任务中的推理提供了宝贵的中间信号。

title: When Elo Lies: Hidden Biases in Codeforces-Based Evaluation of Large Language Models
authors: Shenyu Zheng, Ximing Dong, Xiaoshuang Liu, Gustavo Oliva, Chong Chun Yong, Dayi Lin, Boyuan Chen, Shaowei Wang, Ahmed E. Hassan
abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve breakthroughs in complex reasoning, Codeforces-based Elo ratings have emerged as a prominent metric for evaluating competitive programming capabilities. However, these ratings are often reported without critical experimental details, leading to significant discrepancies illustrated by recent reports where the score of the same model version fluctuated by nearly 500 points. This paper presents a systematic empirical study on the hidden factors biasing Elo evaluations: (1) the temporal ordering of submissions, (2) contest difficulty selection, and (3) run to run stochastic variability of LLMs. Utilizing a controlled benchmark of 37 recent Codeforces contests and 13,691 generated test cases, we demonstrate that Elo scores are highly sensitive to these parameters. Our findings reveal that varying submission orders can shift scores by 394 points, while contest selection can cause differences of up to 1,122 points for the same model. Run to run performance exhibits substantial instability, with a maximum difference of 349 points in mean scores observed when evaluating identical contests. We conclude that direct Elo comparisons are unreliable and potentially misleading without strict standardization and transparent reporting of experimental settings.
zh_title: 当Elo说谎时：基于Codeforces的大型语言模型评估中的隐藏偏差
translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在复杂推理方面取得突破，基于Codeforces的Elo评分已成为评估竞技编程能力的重要指标。然而，这些评分报告往往缺乏关键的实验细节，导致了显著的差异，最近的报告显示同一模型版本的得分波动了近500分。本文对导致Elo评估偏差的隐藏因素进行了系统的实证研究：（1）提交的时间顺序，（2）竞赛难度选择，以及（3）LLM运行间的随机可变性。我们利用包含37个最新Codeforces竞赛和13,691个生成的测试用例的受控基准，证明了Elo分数对这些参数高度敏感。我们的发现揭示，不同的提交顺序可以使分数移动394分，而竞赛选择可以导致同一模型高达1,122分的差异。运行间的性能表现出显著的不稳定性，在评估相同竞赛时观察到平均分数最大差异为349分。我们总结认为，在缺乏严格标准化和透明实验设置报告的情况下，直接的Elo比较是不可靠且具有潜在误导性的。
tldr: LLM的Codeforces Elo评分极不可靠，受提交顺序、竞赛难度和模型随机性等因素的严重影响。在缺乏严格标准化报告的情况下，直接的Elo比较具有误导性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于系统性地量化了LLM评估中经常被忽视的实验偏差，特别是在流行的Codeforces/Elo框架内。其重要性在于强调了一个广泛使用的指标（Elo）对非模型因素（如数据顺序和随机性）高度敏感，这挑战了许多现有LLM排行榜的有效性，并强调了在竞技编程基准测试中对标准化报告的迫切需求。
motivation: 尽管LLM在复杂推理方面取得突破，但基于Codeforces的Elo评分作为评估竞技编程能力的重要指标却存在巨大波动（同一模型版本分数波动近500分），且缺乏关键实验细节报告。本文旨在系统性地研究导致Elo评估偏差的隐藏因素。
method: 采用系统的实证研究方法，控制基准包括37个最近的Codeforces竞赛和13,691个生成的测试用例。研究了三个隐藏的偏差因素：（1）提交的时间顺序，（2）竞赛难度选择，（3）LLM运行间的随机可变性。
results: Elo分数对这些参数高度敏感。提交顺序变化可导致394分的差异；竞赛选择可导致高达1,122分的差异；运行间的不稳定性在相同竞赛评估中显示出平均分数最大349分的差异。
conclusion: 缺乏严格的标准化和透明的实验设置报告，直接的Elo比较是不可靠且具有误导性的。

title: Parity, Sensitivity, and Transformers
authors: Alexander Kozachinskiy, Tomasz Steifer, Przemysław Wałȩga
abstract:
The transformer architecture is almost a decade old. Despite that, we still have a limited understanding of what this architecture can or cannot compute. For instance, can a 1-layer transformer solve PARITY -- or more generally -- which kinds of transformers can do it? Known constructions for PARITY have at least 2 layers and employ impractical features: either a length-dependent positional encoding, or hardmax, or layernorm without the regularization parameter, or they are not implementable with causal masking.
  We give a new construction of a transformer for PARITY with softmax, length-independent and polynomially bounded positional encoding, no layernorm, working both with and without causal masking. We also give the first lower bound for transformers solving PARITY -- by showing that it cannot be done with only one layer and one head.
translation: Transformer架构已经存在了近十年。尽管如此，我们对于这种架构能够或不能计算什么仍然知之甚少。例如，一个单层Transformer能否解决PARITY（奇偶校验）问题——或者更普遍地说——哪种Transformer可以做到？已知的PARITY构造至少有2层，并采用了不切实际的特征：要么是依赖长度的位置编码，要么是hardmax，要么是缺少正则化参数的LayerNorm，要么是无法用因果掩码实现。我们给出了一种解决PARITY问题的新型Transformer构造，它使用softmax，长度无关且多项式有界的位置编码，不使用LayerNorm，并且在有无因果掩码的情况下均可工作。我们还给出了解决PARITY问题的Transformer的第一个下限——通过证明它不能仅用一层和一个注意力头来完成。
tldr: 研究Transformer架构的计算能力，特别是解决PARITY（奇偶校验）问题的能力。提出了一个更实用的PARITY Transformer新结构，并给出了第一个下限证明：单层单头Transformer无法解决PARITY问题。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于，它不仅提供了一个更实用、更简洁的Transformer构造来解决PARITY问题（这是一个重要的基准计算任务），而且首次为该任务提供了正式的计算复杂性下限（单层单头限制）。这对于理解Transformer的最小必需组件和计算能力边界至关重要，有助于指导未来更高效和理论基础更强的架构设计。
motivation: 尽管Transformer架构已存在近十年，但我们对其计算能力（能计算什么、不能计算什么）的理解仍然有限。已知的解决PARITY问题的结构至少需要2层，且采用了不切实际的特征（如依赖长度的位置编码、hardmax、特定LayerNorm或与因果掩码不兼容）。
method: 1. 提出了一种解决PARITY问题的新型Transformer结构，该结构使用softmax，长度无关且多项式有界的位置编码，不使用LayerNorm，并且在有无因果掩码的情况下均可工作。2. 提供了解决PARITY问题的Transformer的第一个下限证明。
results: 成功构建了一种更实用的PARITY Transformer结构。首次证明了仅使用一层和一个注意力头的Transformer无法解决PARITY问题。

title: Stop Rewarding Hallucinated Steps: Faithfulness-Aware Step-Level Reinforcement Learning for Small Reasoning Models
authors: Shuo Nie, Hexuan Deng, Chao Wang, Ruiyu Fang, Xuebo Liu, Shuangyong Song, Yu Li, Min Zhang, Xuelong Li
abstract: As large language models become smaller and more efficient, small reasoning models (SRMs) are crucial for enabling chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in resource-constrained settings. However, they are prone to faithfulness hallucinations, especially in intermediate reasoning steps. Existing mitigation methods based on online reinforcement learning rely on outcome-based rewards or coarse-grained CoT evaluation, which can inadvertently reinforce unfaithful reasoning when the final answer is correct. To address these limitations, we propose Faithfulness-Aware Step-Level Reinforcement Learning (FaithRL), introducing step-level supervision via explicit faithfulness rewards from a process reward model, together with an implicit truncated resampling strategy that generates contrastive signals from faithful prefixes. Experiments across multiple SRMs and Open-Book QA benchmarks demonstrate that FaithRL consistently reduces hallucinations in both the CoT and final answers, leading to more faithful and reliable reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/Easy195/FaithRL.
zh_title: 停止奖励幻觉步骤：面向小型推理模型的忠实性感知步骤级强化学习
translation: 随着大型语言模型变得更小、更高效，小型推理模型（SRMs）对于在资源受限环境下实现思维链（CoT）推理至关重要。然而，它们容易产生忠实性幻觉，尤其是在中间推理步骤中。现有的基于在线强化学习的缓解方法依赖于基于结果的奖励或粗粒度的CoT评估，这可能会在最终答案正确时无意中强化不忠实的推理。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了忠实性感知步骤级强化学习（FaithRL），通过一个过程奖励模型引入显式的忠实性奖励，并结合隐式的截断重采样策略，从忠实的步骤前缀中生成对比信号，从而引入步骤级监督。在多个SRMs和Open-Book QA基准测试上的实验表明，FaithRL始终能减少CoT和最终答案中的幻觉，从而带来更忠实可靠的推理。代码可在https://github.com/Easy195/FaithRL获取。
tldr: 针对小型推理模型（SRMs）在CoT推理中易产生幻觉的问题，本文提出了FaithRL，一种使用过程奖励模型提供步骤级忠实性奖励和截断重采样策略的强化学习方法，以减少推理链和最终答案中的幻觉。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将强化学习的奖励机制从传统的“结果导向”提升到“过程导向”，通过步骤级的忠实性奖励来直接惩罚中间推理步骤中的幻觉。这对于资源受限的小型模型（SRMs）尤为重要，因为它们比大型模型更不稳定，更容易在复杂的推理链中犯错。FaithRL提出的过程奖励模型和截断重采样策略，提供了一种精细化的监督信号，解决了现有RL方法中奖励稀疏和信号不精确的问题，是提高小型模型推理可靠性的关键一步。
motivation: 小型推理模型（SRMs）在资源受限环境下进行思维链（CoT）推理至关重要，但它们容易产生忠实性幻觉，尤其是在中间推理步骤中。现有的在线强化学习方法依赖于基于结果的奖励或粗粒度的CoT评估，可能在最终答案正确时无意中强化了不忠实的推理。
method: 提出了一种名为“忠实性感知步骤级强化学习”（FaithRL）的方法。该方法通过以下方式引入步骤级监督：1) 使用一个过程奖励模型提供显式的忠实性奖励；2) 采用隐式的截断重采样策略，从忠实的步骤前缀中生成对比信号。
results: 在多个SRMs和Open-Book QA基准测试上的实验表明，FaithRL始终能减少思维链（CoT）和最终答案中的幻觉，从而实现更忠实可靠的推理。

title: Regularized Calibration with Successive Rounding for Post-Training Quantization
authors: Seohyeon Cha, Huancheng Chen, Dongjun Kim, Haoran Zhang, Kevin Chan, Gustavo de Veciana, Haris Vikalo
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deliver robust performance across diverse applications, yet their deployment often faces challenges due to the memory and latency costs of storing and accessing billions of parameters. Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient inference by mapping pretrained weights to low-bit formats without retraining, but its effectiveness depends critically on both the quantization objective and the rounding procedure used to obtain low-bit weight representations. In this work, we show that interpolating between symmetric and asymmetric calibration acts as a form of regularization that preserves the standard quadratic structure used in PTQ while providing robustness to activation mismatch. Building on this perspective, we derive a simple successive rounding procedure that naturally incorporates asymmetric calibration, as well as a bounded-search extension that allows for an explicit trade-off between quantization quality and the compute cost. Experiments across multiple LLM families, quantization bit-widths, and benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed bounded search based on a regularized asymmetric calibration objective consistently improves perplexity and accuracy over PTQ baselines, while incurring only modest and controllable additional computational cost.
zh_title: 使用逐次舍入的正则化校准用于训练后量化
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在各种应用中展现出强大的性能，但由于存储和访问数十亿参数所需的内存和延迟成本，它们的部署经常面临挑战。训练后量化（PTQ）通过将预训练权重映射到低位格式而无需重新训练，实现了高效推理，但其有效性关键取决于量化目标和用于获取低位权重表示的舍入过程。在这项工作中，我们展示了在对称和非对称校准之间进行插值，可以作为一种正则化形式，它保留了PTQ中使用的标准二次结构，同时提供了对激活不匹配的鲁棒性。基于这一视角，我们推导出了一个简单的逐次舍入过程，该过程自然地融入了非对称校准，以及一个允许在量化质量和计算成本之间进行明确权衡的有界搜索扩展。跨多个LLM家族、量化位宽和基准测试的实验表明，所提出的基于正则化非对称校准目标的有界搜索方法，相比PTQ基线，持续改进了困惑度和准确性，同时只产生了适度且可控的额外计算成本。
tldr: 针对LLM的训练后量化，本文提出了一种正则化非对称校准目标和基于有界搜索的逐次舍入方法，显著提高了量化精度（困惑度和准确性），且计算成本增加可控。
ai_comments: 这项工作解决了PTQ中量化精度和计算效率的关键权衡问题，特别适用于对内存和延迟敏感的LLM部署。通过将校准（对称/非对称）视为正则化形式，它提供了一个理论基础来改进现有的PTQ优化目标。提出的“逐次舍入”和“有界搜索”机制，为在保证精度的同时控制量化过程的额外计算开销提供了实用且灵活的工程解决方案。其创新点在于将正则化校准与受控的搜索策略相结合，以实现更鲁棒和高性能的低位量化。
motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的部署面临内存和延迟成本高昂的挑战。训练后量化（PTQ）是提高效率的有效手段，但其性能严重依赖于量化目标和舍入过程。
method: 1. 提出通过在对称和非对称校准之间插值来实现正则化，以保持PTQ的标准二次结构并增强对激活不匹配的鲁棒性。2. 基于此，推导出一个简单的逐次舍入过程，该过程自然地融入了非对称校准。3. 进一步引入一个有界搜索扩展，以明确权衡量化质量和计算成本。
results: 在多个LLM家族、量化位宽和基准测试中，所提出的基于正则化非对称校准目标的有界搜索方法，相比PTQ基线，持续改进了困惑度和准确性，同时只产生了适度且可控的额外计算成本。

title: Improved SDP-Based Algorithm for Coloring 3-Colorable Graphs
authors: Nikhil Bansal, Neng Huang, Euiwoong Lee
abstract:
We present a polynomial-time algorithm that colors any 3-colorable $n$-vertex graph using $O(n^{0.19539})$ colors, improving upon the previous best bound of $\widetilde{O}(n^{0.19747})$ by Kawarabayashi, Thorup, and Yoneda [STOC 2024]. Our result constitutes the first progress in nearly two decades on SDP-based approaches to this problem.
  The earlier SDP-based algorithms of Arora, Chlamtáč, and Charikar [STOC 2006] and Chlamtáč [FOCS 2007] rely on extracting a large independent set from a suitably "random-looking" second-level neighborhood, under the assumption that the KMS algorithm [Karger, Motwani, and Sudan, JACM 1998] fails to find one globally. We extend their analysis to third-level neighborhoods. We then come up with a new vector $5/2$-coloring, which allows us to extract a large independent set from some third-level neighborhood. The new vector coloring construction may be of independent interest.
zh_title: 改进的基于SDP的3-可着色图着色算法
translation: 我们提出了一种多项式时间算法，它使用$O(n^{0.19539})$种颜色对任意3-可着色$n$顶点图进行着色，改进了Kawarabayashi, Thorup, and Yoneda [STOC 2024]提出的先前最佳界限$\widetilde{O}(n^{0.19747})$。我们的结果构成了近二十年来基于SDP方法解决该问题的首次进展。早期的基于SDP的算法，由Arora, Chlamtáč, and Charikar [STOC 2006]和Chlamtáč [FOCS 2007]提出，依赖于在一个适当“随机”的二级邻域中提取一个大的独立集，前提是KMS算法 [Karger, Motwani, and Sudan, JACM 1998] 未能在全局找到独立集。我们将他们的分析扩展到三级邻域。然后，我们提出了一种新的向量$5/2$-着色，这使我们能够从某个三级邻域中提取一个大的独立集。这种新的向量着色构造本身可能具有独立的价值。
tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的基于SDP的算法，将3-可着色图的着色数从$\widetilde{O}(n^{0.19747})$提升至$O(n^{0.19539})$，通过将现有分析扩展到三级邻域并引入新的向量着色方法实现。
ai_comments: 本文的主要创新在于打破了基于SDP的3-可着色图着色算法领域长达近二十年的停滞，并成功改进了颜色界限。技术上的创新点在于将现有算法的分析框架推广到了三级邻域，以及提出了一种新颖的向量$5/2$-着色构造，后者可能对其他相关研究具有独立的参考价值。
motivation: 改进3-可着色图着色问题的现有最佳界限，并推进近二十年来停滞不前的基于SDP的方法的研究进展。
method: 提出了一种多项式时间算法，该算法基于SDP方法。具体步骤包括：将早期SDP算法（依赖于从二级邻域提取独立集）的分析扩展到三级邻域；构造一种新的向量$5/2$-着色（可能具有独立价值）；利用新的向量着色从某个三级邻域中提取一个大的独立集。
results: 提出了一种多项式时间算法，可以将任意3-可着色$n$顶点图用$O(n^{0.19539})$种颜色着色。这改进了Kawarabayashi, Thorup, and Yoneda在STOC 2024上提出的$\widetilde{O}(n^{0.19747})$的先前最佳界限。
conclusion: 成功地在近二十年后首次改进了基于SDP的3-可着色图着色算法的界限，证明了该方法在扩展到三级邻域和使用新的向量着色构造后仍具有潜力。

title: Codified Finite-state Machines for Role-playing
authors: Letian Peng, Yupeng Hou, Kun Zhou, Jingbo Shang
abstract: Modeling latent character states is crucial for consistent and engaging role-playing (RP) with large language models (LLMs). Yet, existing prompting-based approaches mainly capture surface actions, often failing to track the latent states that drive interaction. We revisit finite-state machines (FSMs), long used in game design to model state transitions. While effective in small, well-specified state spaces, traditional hand-crafted, rule-based FSMs struggle to adapt to the open-ended semantic space of RP. To address this, we introduce Codified Finite-State Machines (CFSMs), a framework that automatically codifies textual character profiles into FSMs using LLM-based coding. CFSMs extract key states and transitions directly from the profile, producing interpretable structures that enforce character consistency. To further capture uncertainty and variability, we extend CFSMs into Codified Probabilistic Finite-State Machines (CPFSMs), where transitions are modeled as probability distributions over states. Through both synthetic evaluations and real-world RP scenarios in established artifacts, we demonstrate that CFSM and CPFSM outperform generally applied baselines, verifying effectiveness not only in structured tasks but also in open-ended stochastic state exploration.
zh_title: 用于角色扮演的编码有限状态机
translation: 对潜在角色状态的建模对于使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行一致且引人入胜的角色扮演（RP）至关重要。然而，现有的基于提示的方法主要捕获表面行为，往往未能跟踪驱动交互的潜在状态。我们重新审视了在游戏设计中长期用于模拟状态转换的有限状态机（FSM）。虽然传统的手工、基于规则的FSM在小型、明确定义的状态空间中很有效，但它们难以适应RP的开放式语义空间。为解决此问题，我们引入了编码有限状态机（CFSM），一个利用基于LLM的编码自动将文本角色资料编码成FSM的框架。CFSM直接从资料中提取关键状态和转换，生成可解释的结构以保证角色一致性。为进一步捕捉不确定性和可变性，我们将CFSM扩展为编码概率有限状态机（CPFSM），其中转换被建模为状态上的概率分布。通过合成评估和在既定人工制品中的真实世界RP场景，我们证明了CFSM和CPFSM优于普遍应用的基线方法，验证了它们不仅在结构化任务中，而且在开放式随机状态探索中也有效。
tldr: 为解决LLM角色扮演中状态跟踪不一致的问题，我们提出了CFSM和CPFSM，它们使用LLM自动将角色描述转化为状态机模型，并在测试中表现优于基线方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将传统的有限状态机（FSM）的概念与大型语言模型（LLM）的文本编码能力相结合，自动从角色描述中提取状态和转换，解决了传统FSM在开放式角色扮演中难以适应语义空间的问题。其重要性在于提高了LLM在角色扮演中对潜在角色状态的一致性跟踪能力。限制是其性能可能依赖于LLM的编码质量。
motivation: 在角色扮演（RP）中，对潜在角色状态进行建模对于保持一致性和参与度至关重要，但现有的基于提示的方法主要捕获表面行为，往往无法跟踪驱动交互的潜在状态。传统的基于规则的手工FSM难以适应RP的开放式语义空间。
method: 引入了“编码有限状态机”（CFSM）框架，该框架使用基于LLM的编码自动地将文本角色资料编码成FSM，直接从资料中提取关键状态和转换。此外，还扩展为“编码概率有限状态机”（CPFSM），将转换建模为状态上的概率分布。
results: CFSM和CPFSM在合成评估和真实世界的RP场景中，性能优于一般应用的基线方法。
conclusion: 研究证明了CFSM和CPFSM在合成评估和真实角色扮演场景中优于一般性基线方法，验证了它们不仅在结构化任务中，而且在开放式随机状态探索中也有效。

title: Verification of the Implicit World Model in a Generative Model via Adversarial Sequences
authors: András Balogh, Márk Jelasity
abstract: Generative sequence models are typically trained on sample sequences from natural or formal languages. It is a crucial question whether -- or to what extent -- sample-based training is able to capture the true structure of these languages, often referred to as the ``world model''. Theoretical results indicate that we can hope for soundness at best, that is, generating valid sequences, but not necessarily all of them. However, it is still important to have practical tools that are able to verify whether a given sequence model is sound. In this study, we focus on chess, as it is a domain that provides enough complexity while having a simple rule-based world model. We propose adversarial sequence generation for verifying the soundness of the sequence model. Our adversaries generate valid sequences so as to force the sequence model to generate an invalid next move prediction. Apart from the falsification of soundness, this method is also suitable for a more fine-grained analysis of the failure modes and the effects of different choices during training. To demonstrate this, we propose a number of methods for adversarial sequence generation and evaluate the approach on a large set of chess models. We train models on random as well as high-quality chess games, using several training recipes. We find that none of the models are sound, but some training techniques and dataset choices are able to improve soundness remarkably. We also investigate the potential application of board state probes in both our training and attack methods. Our findings indicate that the extracted board states have no causal role in next token prediction in most of the models.
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. Code, datasets, and models are available at https://github.com/szegedai/world-model-verification
zh_title: 通过对抗序列验证生成模型中的隐式世界模型
translation: 生成序列模型通常在自然语言或形式语言的样本序列上进行训练。基于样本的训练能否（以及在多大程度上）捕获这些语言的真实结构（通常称为“世界模型”）是一个关键问题。理论结果表明，我们最多只能期望模型的“完备性”，即能够生成有效的序列，但不一定能生成所有序列。然而，拥有能够验证给定序列模型是否完备的实用工具仍然很重要。在本研究中，我们专注于国际象棋，因为它既提供了足够的复杂性，又拥有简单的基于规则的世界模型。我们提出使用对抗序列生成来验证序列模型的完备性。我们的对抗序列生成器生成有效的序列，旨在迫使序列模型生成无效的下一步预测。除了证伪完备性之外，该方法还适用于对故障模式和训练过程中不同选择的影响进行更细致的分析。为了证明这一点，我们提出了多种对抗序列生成方法，并在一大批国际象棋模型上评估了该方法。我们使用多种训练配方，在随机和高质量的国际象棋棋局上训练了模型。我们发现所有模型都不完备，但某些训练技术和数据集选择能够显著提高完备性。我们还研究了棋盘状态探针在我们训练和攻击方法中的潜在应用。我们的研究结果表明，在大多数模型中，提取的棋盘状态在下一个标记预测中没有因果作用。
tldr: 我们使用对抗序列（有效的国际象棋走法）来测试生成序列模型是否正确学习了潜在规则（“世界模型”）。我们发现所有测试的模型都是不完备的（无法保证只生成有效的下一步预测），但特定的训练技术可以显著提高完备性。我们还发现，提取的棋盘状态在大多数模型的下一个标记预测中没有因果作用。
ai_comments: 创新点：本文提出了一种新颖且实用的对抗序列生成技术，专门用于根据已知的、基于规则的世界模型（国际象棋规则）来“验证”生成模型的完备性，将重点从简单的生成质量转移到规则遵守上。重要性：它通过实证证实了序列模型的理论局限性——即使在规则简单且已知的领域，模型也难以实现完美的完备性，突出了基于样本的学习与规则内化之间的根本差距。局限性：关于棋盘状态探针缺乏因果作用的发现表明，当前的序列模型可能严重依赖表面序列模式，而不是深入编码实现真正规则掌握所需的潜在状态表示，这是一个重要的架构/学习限制。
motivation: 确定基于样本的训练能否在多大程度上捕捉到语言的真实结构（即“世界模型”）是一个关键问题。需要实用的工具来验证给定的序列模型是否“完备”（能够生成有效的序列）。
method: 以国际象棋为研究领域，提出“对抗序列生成”方法来验证模型的完备性。对抗序列生成器生成有效的序列，迫使序列模型预测出无效的下一步走法。评估了在不同训练配方（随机对高质量棋局）下训练的大量国际象棋模型，并研究了棋盘状态探针的应用。
results: 发现所有模型均不完备。但某些训练技术和数据集选择能够显著提高完备性。研究结果表明，在大多数模型中，提取的棋盘状态在下一个标记预测中没有因果作用。
conclusion: 尽管在序列上训练的生成模型无法达到完全的完备性，但所提出的对抗性验证方法能够有效地证伪完备性并进行细致的故障分析。特定的训练选择可以提高完备性，但研究表明，在大多数模型中，提取的棋盘状态与下一个标记预测的因果关系不大。

title: Chunky Post-Training: Data Driven Failures of Generalization
authors: Seoirse Murray, Allison Qi, Timothy Qian, John Schulman, Collin Burns, Sara Price
abstract: LLM post-training involves many diverse datasets, each targeting a specific behavior. But these datasets encode incidental patterns alongside intended ones: correlations between formatting and content, narrow phrasings across diverse problems, and implicit associations arising from the discrete data curation process. These patterns are often invisible to developers yet salient to models, producing behaviors that surprise their creators, such as rejecting true facts presented in a particular question format. We call this chunky post-training: the model learns spurious correlations as a result of distinct chunks of post-training data. We introduce SURF, a black-box pipeline which surfaces these unintended behaviors at run time, and TURF, a tool that traces these failures back to specific post-training data. Applying these tools to frontier models (Claude 4.5, GPT-5.1, Grok 4.1, Gemini 3) and open models (Tülu 3), we show that chunky post-training produces miscalibrated behaviors, which often result from imbalanced or underspecified chunks of post-training data.
zh_title: 块状后训练：数据驱动的泛化失败
translation: LLM 的后训练涉及许多不同的数据集，每个数据集都针对特定的行为。但这些数据集在编码预期模式的同时，也编码了偶然的模式：格式与内容的关联、跨越不同问题的狭窄措辞，以及由离散的数据策展过程产生的隐式关联。这些模式通常对开发者来说是不可见的，但对模型来说却非常显著，从而产生了令其创造者感到惊讶的行为，例如拒绝以特定问题形式呈现的真实事实。我们称之为块状后训练：模型由于不同的后训练数据“块”而学习到虚假的相关性。我们引入了 SURF，一个在运行时揭示这些意外行为的黑盒管道，以及 TURF，一个将这些失败追溯到特定后训练数据的工具。我们将这些工具应用于前沿模型（Claude 4.5、GPT-5.1、Grok 4.1、Gemini 3）和开源模型（Tülu 3），我们表明块状后训练产生了失校准的行为，这些行为通常源于不平衡或未充分说明的后训练数据块。
tldr: LLM 在后训练中会从数据块中学到“坏”的虚假相关性（块状后训练），导致模型行为奇怪。作者开发了 SURF 和 TURF 工具来发现和追溯这些在 Claude 4.5、GPT-5.1 等模型中存在的、源于数据不平衡的错误。
ai_comments: 这项工作创新地提出了“块状后训练”（chunky post-training）的概念，揭示了大型语言模型（LLM）在后训练阶段学习到数据中存在的虚假相关性，而不是仅学习到目标行为。SURF和TURF工具的引入为黑盒模型的可解释性分析提供了一种实用的运行时和追溯方法，具有重要的实际意义。限制在于，分析是基于“黑盒”管道进行的，可能无法揭示模型内部的根本原因。
motivation: LLM 的后训练数据集会编码出与预期行为无关的偶然模式（如格式与内容的关联、狭窄的措辞等），这些模式导致模型出现出乎意料的行为，例如拒绝特定格式下的事实陈述。
method: 引入了 SURF（一个在运行时揭示这些意外行为的黑盒管道）和 TURF（一个将这些失败追溯到特定后训练数据的工具）。
results: 应用 SURF 和 TURF 到前沿模型（Claude 4.5, GPT-5.1, Grok 4.1, Gemini 3）和开源模型（Tülu 3）后，展示了块状后训练会产生失校准的行为。
conclusion: Chunky post-training 会导致模型出现失校准的行为，这些行为通常源于后训练数据中不平衡或未充分说明的“块”（chunks）。

title: CLIP-Map: Structured Matrix Mapping for Parameter-Efficient CLIP Compression
authors: Kangjie Zhang, Wenxuan Huang, Xin Zhou, Boxiang Zhou, Dejia Song, Yuan Xie, Baochang Zhang, Lizhuang Ma, Nemo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Shaohui Lin
abstract: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has achieved widely applications in various computer vision tasks, e.g., text-to-image generation, Image-Text retrieval and Image captioning. However, CLIP suffers from high memory and computation cost, which prohibits its usage to the resource-limited application scenarios. Existing CLIP compression methods typically reduce the size of pre-trained CLIP weights by selecting their subset as weight inheritance for further retraining via mask optimization or important weight measurement. However, these select-based weight inheritance often compromises the feature presentation ability, especially on the extreme compression. In this paper, we propose a novel mapping-based CLIP compression framework, CLIP-Map. It leverages learnable matrices to map and combine pretrained weights by Full-Mapping with Kronecker Factorization, aiming to preserve as much information from the original weights as possible. To mitigate the optimization challenges introduced by the learnable mapping, we propose Diagonal Inheritance Initialization to reduce the distribution shifting problem for efficient and effective mapping learning. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CLIP-Map outperforms select-based frameworks across various compression ratios, with particularly significant gains observed under high compression settings.
zh_title: CLIP-Map：用于参数高效CLIP压缩的结构化矩阵映射
translation: 对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）在文本到图像生成、图文检索和图像描述等各种计算机视觉任务中取得了广泛应用。然而，CLIP存在高内存和计算成本，这限制了它在资源受限应用场景中的使用。现有的CLIP压缩方法通常通过选择预训练权重的子集作为权重继承，再通过掩码优化或重要权重测量进行进一步训练来减小模型大小。然而，这些基于选择的权重继承通常会损害特征表示能力，尤其是在极端压缩的情况下。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于映射的CLIP压缩框架——CLIP-Map。它利用可学习矩阵，通过结合Kronecker分解的全映射来映射和组合预训练权重，旨在尽可能多地保留原始权重信息。为了缓解可学习映射引入的优化挑战，我们提出了对角继承初始化（Diagonal Inheritance Initialization），以减少分布偏移问题，从而实现高效且有效的映射学习。广泛的实验结果表明，所提出的CLIP-Map在各种压缩率下均优于基于选择的框架，尤其是在高压缩设置下观察到显著的性能提升。
tldr: CLIP模型太大了，现有压缩方法在高压缩时效果差。我们提出了CLIP-Map，用可学习的矩阵映射（带Kronecker分解）来替代权重选择，并用对角继承初始化来稳定训练，结果表明它在极端压缩下效果更好。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地提出了基于可学习矩阵映射的压缩框架（CLIP-Map），特别是结合了Kronecker分解的全映射策略，旨在更有效地保留原始权重信息，而不是简单地选择子集。对优化挑战提出的对角继承初始化也是一个亮点。
motivation: CLIP在各种视觉任务中应用广泛，但其高昂的内存和计算成本限制了其在资源受限场景中的应用。现有方法（基于选择子集）在高压缩率下会损害特征表示能力。
method: 提出了一种新颖的基于映射的CLIP压缩框架CLIP-Map，它利用可学习矩阵通过全映射（结合Kronecker分解）来映射和组合预训练权重。为解决优化挑战，提出了对角继承初始化（Diagonal Inheritance Initialization）以减少分布偏移。
results: 实验结果表明，所提出的CLIP-Map在各种压缩率下均优于基于选择的框架，特别是在高压缩设置下取得了显著的性能提升。
conclusion: 所提出的CLIP-Map在各种压缩率下都优于基于选择的框架，尤其是在高压缩设置下表现出显著的性能提升。

title: Quantum Reinforcement Learning with Transformers for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
authors: Eva Andrés
abstract: This paper addresses the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) by comparing classical and quantum Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches. An Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C) agent is implemented in classical, full quantum, and hybrid variants, integrating transformer architectures to capture the relationships between vehicles, clients, and the depot through self- and cross-attention mechanisms. The experiments focus on multi-vehicle scenarios with capacity constraints, considering 20 clients and 4 vehicles, and are conducted over ten independent runs. Performance is assessed using routing distance, route compactness, and route overlap. The results show that all three approaches are capable of learning effective routing policies. However, quantum-enhanced models outperform the classical baseline and produce more robust route organization, with the hybrid architecture achieving the best overall performance across distance, compactness, and route overlap. In addition to quantitative improvements, qualitative visualizations reveal that quantum-based models generate more structured and coherent routing solutions. These findings highlight the potential of hybrid quantum-classical reinforcement learning models for addressing complex combinatorial optimization problems such as the CVRP.
zh_title: 基于Transformer的量子强化学习在带容量限制的车辆路径问题中的应用
translation: 本文通过比较经典和量子强化学习（RL）方法来解决带容量限制的车辆路径问题（CVRP）。我们实施了一个优势演员-评论家（A2C）智能体，在经典、全量子和混合变体中集成了Transformer架构，通过自注意力和交叉注意力机制来捕获车辆、客户和仓库之间的关系。实验重点关注具有容量限制的多车场景，考虑20个客户和4辆车，并在十次独立运行中进行。性能通过路由距离、路线紧凑性和路线重叠度进行评估。结果表明，所有三种方法都能够学习到有效的路径策略。然而，量子增强模型优于经典基线并产生更稳健的路线组织，其中混合架构在距离、紧凑性和路线重叠度方面取得了最佳的总体性能。除了定量改进之外，定性可视化显示基于量子模型生成的路由解决方案更具结构性和连贯性。这些发现凸显了混合量子-经典强化学习模型在解决如CVRP等复杂组合优化问题中的潜力。
tldr: 研究人员使用带有Transformer的经典、全量子和混合A2C智能体来解决CVRP，发现混合量子增强学习在路由距离和结构方面表现最佳，证明了其在复杂优化问题中的优越性。
ai_comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于将Transformer架构集成到量子和经典强化学习框架中，以解决CVRP问题，特别是混合模型在所有评估指标上均优于经典基线，表明了量子增强学习在组合优化中的潜力。限制在于实验规模较小（20个客户，4辆车）。
motivation: 旨在通过比较经典和量子强化学习方法来解决带容量限制的车辆路径问题（CVRP）。
method: 实施了基于A2C的智能体，并在经典、全量子和混合变体中集成了Transformer架构，利用自注意力和交叉注意力机制来捕捉车辆、客户和仓库之间的关系。实验在20个客户和4辆车的场景下进行。
results: 所有三种方法（经典、全量子、混合）都能学习到有效的路径策略。量子增强模型优于经典基线并产生更稳健的路线组织，其中混合架构在距离、紧凑性和路线重叠度方面取得了最佳的总体性能。定性分析也显示量子模型生成的解决方案更具结构性。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，量子增强模型（特别是混合架构）在解决CVRP等复杂组合优化问题方面具有潜力，它们不仅在路由距离、紧凑性和重叠度方面优于经典基线，而且在定性上也能产生更具结构性和连贯性的解决方案。

title: From Bench to Flight: Translating Drone Impact Tests into Operational Safety Limits
authors: Aziz Mohamed Mili, Louis Catar, Paul Gérard, Ilyass Tabiai, David St-Onge
abstract: Indoor micro-aerial vehicles (MAVs) are increasingly used for tasks that require close proximity to people, yet practitioners lack practical methods to tune motion limits based on measured impact risk. We present an end-to-end, open toolchain that converts benchtop impact tests into deployable safety governors for drones. First, we describe a compact and replicable impact rig and protocol for capturing force-time profiles across drone classes and contact surfaces. Second, we provide data-driven models that map pre-impact speed to impulse and contact duration, enabling direct computation of speed bounds for a target force limit. Third, we release scripts and a ROS2 node that enforce these bounds online and log compliance, with support for facility-specific policies. We validate the workflow on multiple commercial off-the-shelf quadrotors and representative indoor assets, demonstrating that the derived governors preserve task throughput while meeting force constraints specified by safety stakeholders. Our contribution is a practical bridge from measured impacts to runtime limits, with shareable datasets, code, and a repeatable process that teams can adopt to certify indoor MAV operations near humans.
zh_title: 从台架到飞行：将无人机冲击测试转化为运行安全限制
translation: 室内微型飞行器（MAV）越来越多地用于需要与人近距离接触的任务，但实践者缺乏根据测量的冲击风险来调整运动限制的实用方法。我们提出了一个端到端的、开源的工具链，将台架冲击测试转换为可部署的无人机安全控制器。首先，我们描述了一个紧凑且可复制的冲击台和协议，用于捕获跨无人机类别和接触表面的力-时间曲线。其次，我们提供了数据驱动模型，将撞击前速度映射到冲量和接触持续时间，从而可以直接计算目标力限制下的速度边界。第三，我们发布了脚本和ROS2节点，用于在线强制执行这些边界并记录合规性，并支持特定设施的策略。我们在多个商用现货四旋翼和代表性室内资产上验证了该工作流程，证明了推导出的控制器在满足安全利益相关者指定的力约束的同时，保持了任务吞吐量。我们的贡献是从实测冲击到运行时限制的实用桥梁，包含可共享的数据集、代码和一个可重复的过程，团队可以采用此流程来认证室内MAV在人附近的运行安全。
tldr: 研究开发了一个完整的系统，通过在实验室测试无人机撞击力，自动计算出安全的飞行速度限制，并将这些限制部署到无人机上，以确保近人操作的安全。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提供了一个从实验室冲击测试到实际飞行安全限制的完整、可复用的工具链，解决了室内微型飞行器（MAV）在近人操作中缺乏实用安全限值设定方法的痛点。其重要性在于为室内MAV的认证和安全部署提供了可量化的、基于物理冲击的依据。局限性在于其验证仅限于商业现货（COTS）四旋翼和代表性的室内资产，更复杂的飞行器或环境下的适用性有待进一步验证。
motivation: 室内微型飞行器（MAV）越来越多地用于需要与人近距离接触的任务，但实践者缺乏根据测量的冲击风险来调整运动限制的实用方法。
method: 首先，描述了一个紧凑且可复制的冲击台和协议，用于捕获跨无人机类别和接触表面的力-时间曲线。其次，提供了数据驱动模型，将撞击前速度映射到冲量和接触持续时间，从而可以直接计算目标力限制下的速度边界。最后，发布了脚本和ROS2节点，用于在线强制执行这些边界并记录合规性。
results: 我们在一系列商用现货四旋翼和代表性室内资产上验证了该工作流程，证明了推导出的安全控制器在满足安全利益相关者指定的力约束的同时，保持了任务吞吐量。
conclusion: 我们提供了一个从实测冲击到运行时限制的实用桥梁，包括可共享的数据集、代码和一个可重复的过程，团队可以采用此流程来认证室内MAV在人附近的运行安全。

title: Adaptive Hashing: Faster Hash Functions with Fewer Collisions
authors: Gábor Melis
abstract: Hash tables are ubiquitous, and the choice of hash function, which maps a key to a bucket, is key to their performance. We argue that the predominant approach of fixing the hash function for the lifetime of the hash table is suboptimal and propose adapting it to the current set of keys. In the prevailing view, good hash functions spread the keys ``randomly'' and are fast to evaluate. General-purpose ones (e.g. Murmur) are designed to do both while remaining agnostic to the distribution of the keys, which limits their bucketing ability and wastes computation. When these shortcomings are recognized, one may specify a hash function more tailored to some assumed key distribution, but doing so almost always introduces an unbounded risk in case this assumption does not bear out in practice. At the other, fully key-aware end of the spectrum, Perfect Hashing algorithms can discover hash functions to bucket a given set of keys optimally, but they are costly to run and require the keys to be known and fixed ahead of time. Our main conceptual contribution is that adapting the hash table's hash function to the keys online is necessary for the best performance, as adaptivity allows for better bucketing of keys \emph{and} faster hash functions. We instantiate the idea of online adaptation with minimal overhead and no change to the hash table API. The experiments show that the adaptive approach marries the common-case performance of weak hash functions with the robustness of general-purpose ones.

title: KV-CoRE: Benchmarking Data-Dependent Low-Rank Compressibility of KV-Caches in LLMs
authors: Jian Chen, Zhuoran Wang, Jiayu Qin, Ming Li, Meng Wang, Changyou Chen, Yin Chen, Qizhen Weng, Yirui Liu
abstract: Large language models rely on kv-caches to avoid redundant computation during autoregressive decoding, but as context length grows, reading and writing the cache can quickly saturate GPU memory bandwidth. Recent work has explored KV-cache compression, yet most approaches neglect the data-dependent nature of kv-caches and their variation across layers. We introduce KV-CoRE KV-cache Compressibility by Rank Evaluation), an SVD-based method for quantifying the data-dependent low-rank compressibility of kv-caches. KV-CoRE computes the optimal low-rank approximation under the Frobenius norm and, being gradient-free and incremental, enables efficient dataset-level, layer-wise evaluation. Using this method, we analyze multiple models and datasets spanning five English domains and sixteen languages, uncovering systematic patterns that link compressibility to model architecture, training data, and language coverage. As part of this analysis, we employ the Normalized Effective Rank as a metric of compressibility and show that it correlates strongly with performance degradation under compression. Our study establishes a principled evaluation framework and the first large-scale benchmark of kv-cache compressibility in LLMs, offering insights for dynamic, data-aware compression and data-centric model development.
zh_title: KV-CoRE：基准测试LLM中KV缓存的数据依赖性低秩可压缩性
translation: 大型语言模型依赖kv-caches来避免在自回归解码过程中进行冗余计算，但随着上下文长度的增长，缓存的读写会迅速使GPU内存带宽饱和。最近的工作探索了KV缓存压缩，但大多数方法忽略了kv-caches的数据依赖性及其在层之间的变化。我们引入了KV-CoRE（按秩评估的KV缓存可压缩性），一种基于SVD的方法，用于量化kv-caches的数据依赖性低秩可压缩性。KV-CoRE计算Frobenius范数下的最优低秩近似，并且由于其无梯度和增量特性，可以进行高效的数据集级别、逐层评估。利用该方法，我们分析了跨越五个英语领域和十六种语言的多个模型和数据集，揭示了将可压缩性与模型架构、训练数据和语言覆盖相关联的系统性模式。作为分析的一部分，我们采用标准化有效秩作为可压缩性的指标，并表明它与压缩下的性能下降有很强的相关性。我们的研究建立了一个原则性的评估框架和首个LLM中kv-cache可压缩性的大规模基准，为动态、数据感知的压缩和以数据为中心的模型开发提供了见解。
tldr: 这项工作提出了KV-CoRE，一个评估KV缓存数据依赖性低秩可压缩性的新框架，发现缓存的可压缩性与其模型和数据特性相关，并建立了一个大规模基准，指导未来的内存优化压缩策略。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个专门用于量化KV缓存数据依赖性低秩可压缩性的评估框架KV-CoRE，并进行了大规模基准测试。其重要性在于揭示了可压缩性与模型架构、训练数据和语言覆盖之间的系统性联系，并证明了有效秩与压缩性能下降之间的强相关性，为未来的数据感知压缩提供了理论基础。局限性在于仅基于SVD和Frobenius范数进行评估，可能未完全涵盖所有可能的压缩形式。
motivation: 随着上下文长度的增长，读取和写入KV缓存会迅速饱和GPU内存带宽，而现有压缩方法大多忽略了kv-caches的数据依赖性及其在不同层之间的变化。
method: 引入了KV-CoRE（KV-cache Compressibility by Rank Evaluation），一种基于SVD的方法，用于量化kv-caches的数据依赖性低秩可压缩性，它计算Frobenius范数下的最优低秩近似，并且是无梯度和增量的。使用标准化有效秩（Normalized Effective Rank）作为可压缩性指标。
results: KV-CoRE能够高效地进行数据集级别和层级的评估。分析揭示了可压缩性与模型架构、训练数据和语言覆盖之间的系统性模式。标准化有效秩与压缩下的性能下降有很强的相关性。
conclusion: 该研究建立了一个原则性的评估框架和首个大规模LLM中kv-cache可压缩性的基准测试，为动态、数据感知的压缩和以数据为中心的模型开发提供了见解。

title: Task-Adaptive Physical Reservoir Computing via Tunable Molecular Communication Dynamics
authors: Saad Yousuf, Kaan Burak Ikiz, Murat Kuscu
abstract: Physical Reservoir Computing (PRC) offers an efficient paradigm for processing temporal data, yet most physical implementations are static, limiting their performance to a narrow range of tasks. In this work, we demonstrate in silico that a canonical Molecular Communication (MC) channel can function as a highly versatile and task-adaptive PRC whose computational properties are reconfigurable. Using a dual-simulation approach -- a computationally efficient deterministic mean-field model and a high-fidelity particle-based stochastic model (Smoldyn) -- we show that tuning the channel's underlying biophysical parameters, such as ligand-receptor kinetics and diffusion dynamics, allows the reservoir to be optimized for distinct classes of computation. We employ Bayesian optimization to efficiently navigate this high-dimensional parameter space, identifying discrete operational regimes. Our results reveal a clear trade-off: parameter sets rich in channel memory excel at chaotic time-series forecasting tasks (e.g., Mackey Glass), while regimes that promote strong receptor nonlinearity are superior for nonlinear data transformation. We further demonstrate that post-processing methods improve the performance of the stochastic reservoir by mitigating intrinsic molecular noise. These findings establish the MC channel not merely as a computational substrate, but as a design blueprint for tunable, bioinspired computing systems, providing a clear optimization framework for future wetware AI implementations.
zh_title: 任务自适应物理水库计算通过可调分子通信动力学
translation: 物理水库计算（PRC）为处理时间数据提供了一种高效的范例，但大多数物理实现是静态的，将其性能限制在狭窄的任务范围内。在本工作中，我们通过计算机模拟证明，一个典型的分子通信（MC）通道可以作为一个高度通用且任务自适应的PRC，其计算特性是可重构的。我们使用双模拟方法——计算效率高的确定性平均场模型和高保真度的基于粒子的随机模型（Smoldyn）——表明通过调整通道的底层生物物理参数，如配体-受体动力学和扩散动力学，可以优化水库以适应不同的计算类别。我们采用贝叶斯优化来有效地导航这个高维参数空间，识别离散的操作模式。我们的结果揭示了一个明显的权衡：具有丰富通道记忆的参数集在混沌时间序列预测任务（例如，Mackey Glass）中表现出色，而促进强受体非线性的模式则在非线性数据转换方面表现更优。我们进一步证明，后处理方法通过减轻固有的分子噪声来提高随机水库的性能。这些发现确立了MC通道不仅仅是一个计算基板，而且是可调谐的、受生物启发的计算系统的设计蓝图，为未来的湿件人工智能（AI）实现提供了清晰的优化框架。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种新颖的物理水库计算（PRC）方法，利用分子通信（MC）通道作为可重构的计算基板。通过调整MC通道的生物物理参数（如配体-受体动力学和扩散动力学），可以优化PRC以适应不同的计算任务。研究结果表明，具有长记忆的参数集适用于混沌时间序列预测，而具有强非线性的参数集则适用于非线性数据转换。此外，后处理方法可以减轻随机模型中的分子噪声。这项工作为设计可调谐的、受生物启发的计算系统提供了框架。
ai_comments: 这项研究在物理水库计算领域取得了重要进展，通过利用分子通信通道的可调性，实现了任务自适应的计算。研究方法新颖，结合了确定性模型和随机模型，并通过贝叶斯优化有效探索了参数空间。结果清晰地展示了不同参数设置下的计算特性权衡，为设计更强大的生物启发式计算系统提供了有价值的见解。然而，研究仅限于计算机模拟，未来的工作可以关注实际的湿件实现，并进一步探索该方法的扩展性与其他计算范式的结合。
motivation: 现有的物理水库计算（PRC）实现通常是静态的，性能受限于狭窄的任务范围。本研究旨在开发一种能够适应不同任务的PRC，以克服这一局限性。
method: 采用双模拟方法，结合确定性平均场模型和基于粒子的随机模型（Smoldyn），来模拟分子通信（MC）通道作为PRC。利用贝叶斯优化来调整通道的生物物理参数（如配体-受体动力学和扩散动力学），以优化计算性能。研究了不同参数设置下的内存和非线性特性，并评估了后处理方法对随机模型性能的影响。
results: 通过调整MC通道的生物物理参数，可以实现PRC的任务自适应性。结果表明，具有长记忆的参数集在混沌时间序列预测任务（如Mackey Glass）上表现优异，而具有强非线性的参数集则更适合非线性数据转换任务。后处理方法可以有效减轻随机模型中的分子噪声，提高其性能。
conclusion: 分子通信通道可以作为一种高度通用且任务自适应的物理水库计算（PRC）系统，其计算特性可以通过调整生物物理参数进行重构。这项工作为设计可调谐的、受生物启发的计算系统提供了一个明确的优化框架，为未来的湿件人工智能（AI）实现奠定了基础。

title: Even Faster Geosocial Reachability Queries
authors: Rick van der Heijden, Nikolay Yakovets, Thekla Hamm
abstract: Geosocial reachability queries (\textsc{RangeReach}) determine whether a given vertex in a geosocial network can reach any spatial vertex within a query region. The state-of-the-art 3DReach method answers such queries by encoding graph reachability through interval labelling and indexing spatial vertices in a 3D R-tree. We present 2DReach, a simpler approach that avoids interval labelling entirely. Like 3DReach, 2DReach collapses strongly connected components (SCCs) into a DAG, but instead of computing interval labels, it directly stores a 2D R-tree per component over all reachable spatial vertices. A query then reduces to a single 2D R-tree lookup. We further propose compressed variants that reduce storage by excluding spatial sinks and sharing R-trees between components with identical reachable sets. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that 2DReach achieves faster index construction than 3DReach, with the compressed variant yielding the smallest index size among all methods. 2DReach delivers competitive or superior query performance with more stable response times across varying query parameters.
zh_title: 更快的地理社交可达性查询
translation: 地理社交可达性查询（\textsc{RangeReach}）旨在确定给定地理社交网络中的一个顶点是否可以到达查询区域内的任何空间顶点。最先进的 3DReach 方法通过区间标记编码图可达性，并在 3D R-tree 中索引空间顶点来回答此类查询。我们提出了 2DReach，一种更简单的方法，完全避免了区间标记。与 3DReach 一样，2DReach 将强连通分量（SCC）折叠成一个有向无环图（DAG），但它不是计算区间标签，而是直接在所有可达的空间顶点上为每个分量存储一个 2D R-tree。查询因此简化为一次 2D R-tree 查找。我们进一步提出了压缩变体，通过排除空间汇点和共享具有相同可达集合的 R-tree 来减少存储。在四个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，2DReach 的索引构建速度快于 3DReach，其压缩变体在所有方法中产生了最小的索引大小。2DReach 在查询性能上具有竞争力或更优越，并且跨不同查询参数的响应时间更稳定。
tldr: 研究人员开发了 2DReach，一种更简单的地理社交网络可达性查询方法，它用 2D R-tree 替代了 3DReach 的复杂区间标记。2DReach 实现了更快的索引构建、更小的索引大小和更稳定的查询性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种更简洁的方法 2DReach 来解决地理社交网络的可达性查询问题，它完全避免了 3DReach 中使用的区间标记（interval labelling），转而直接在每个强连通分量（SCC）上使用 2D R-tree 索引可达的顶点，这简化了结构并提升了性能和稳定性。其主要贡献是简化了现有最先进方法的复杂性，同时在构建时间和空间效率上取得了优势。
motivation: 现有的最先进方法 3DReach 使用区间标记和 3D R-tree 来回答地理社交网络的可达性查询（RangeReach），该研究旨在提出一种更简单的方法来解决此问题。
method: 2DReach 方法首先将图折叠为有向无环图（DAG），为每个强连通分量（SCC）直接在所有可达的空间顶点上存储一个 2D R-tree，而不是使用区间标记。查询简化为一次 2D R-tree 查找。还提出了压缩变体，通过排除空间汇点和共享具有相同可达集合的 R-tree 来减少存储。
results: 实验结果表明，2DReach 的索引构建速度快于 3DReach，其压缩变体在所有方法中具有最小的索引大小。2DReach 在查询性能上具有竞争力或更优越，并且跨不同查询参数的响应时间更稳定。
conclusion: 2DReach 及其压缩变体在索引构建速度、索引大小以及查询性能（包括响应时间的稳定性）方面，与最先进的 3DReach 方法相比具有竞争力或更优越的性能。

title: Compound Deception in Elite Peer Review: A Failure Mode Taxonomy of 100 Fabricated Citations at NeurIPS 2025
authors: Samar Ansari
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in academic writing workflows, yet they frequently hallucinate by generating citations to sources that do not exist. This study analyzes 100 AI-generated hallucinated citations that appeared in papers accepted by the 2025 Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), one of the world's most prestigious AI conferences. Despite review by 3-5 expert researchers per paper, these fabricated citations evaded detection, appearing in 53 published papers (approx. 1% of all accepted papers). We develop a five-category taxonomy that classifies hallucinations by their failure mode: Total Fabrication (66%), Partial Attribute Corruption (27%), Identifier Hijacking (4%), Placeholder Hallucination (2%), and Semantic Hallucination (1%). Our analysis reveals a critical finding: every hallucination (100%) exhibited compound failure modes. The distribution of secondary characteristics was dominated by Semantic Hallucination (63%) and Identifier Hijacking (29%), which often appeared alongside Total Fabrication to create a veneer of plausibility and false verifiability. These compound structures exploit multiple verification heuristics simultaneously, explaining why peer review fails to detect them. The distribution exhibits a bimodal pattern: 92% of contaminated papers contain 1-2 hallucinations (minimal AI use) while 8% contain 4-13 hallucinations (heavy reliance). These findings demonstrate that current peer review processes do not include effective citation verification and that the problem extends beyond NeurIPS to other major conferences, government reports, and professional consulting. We propose mandatory automated citation verification at submission as an implementable solution to prevent fabricated citations from becoming normalized in scientific literature.
zh_title: 精英同行评审中的复合欺骗：2025年神经信息处理系统大会100篇伪造引文的失效模式分类法
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于学术写作工作流程，但它们经常会产生幻觉，生成不存在的来源的引文。本研究分析了2025年神经信息处理系统大会（NeurIPS），这是世界上最负盛名的AI会议之一，所接受的论文中出现的100个AI生成的虚假引文。尽管每篇论文都经过3-5名专家研究人员的评审，但这些伪造的引文逃脱了检测，出现在53篇已发表的论文中（约占所有被接受论文的1%）。我们开发了一种五类分类法，将幻觉按其失效模式进行分类：完全伪造（66%）、部分属性损坏（27%）、标识符劫持（4%）、占位符幻觉（2%）和语义幻觉（1%）。我们的分析揭示了一个关键发现：所有幻觉（100%）都表现出复合失效模式。次要特征的分布以语义幻觉（63%）和标识符劫持（29%）为主，它们常常与完全伪造一起出现，以制造虚假的合理性和可验证性。这些复合结构同时利用了多种验证启发式方法，解释了为什么同行评审未能检测到它们。分布呈现双峰模式：92%的受污染论文包含1-2个幻觉（最少使用AI），而8%的论文包含4-13个幻觉（严重依赖AI）。这些发现表明，当前的同行评审流程不包括有效的引文验证，而且这个问题不仅限于NeurIPS，还延伸到其他主要会议、政府报告和专业咨询。我们提出在提交时强制进行自动引文验证，作为防止伪造引文在科学文献中常态化的可实施解决方案。
tldr: LLM生成的虚假引文（包括不存在的来源）在NeurIPS 2025的同行评审中被发现，尽管有专家评审，但仍有53篇论文被接受。研究人员开发了一种分类法，将这些幻觉分为五种类型，并发现所有幻觉都具有复合失效模式，常常结合了语义幻觉和标识符劫持，以增强可信度。研究还指出，大多数受影响的论文包含少量幻觉，但也有一些论文严重依赖AI。结论是，当前的同行评审缺乏有效的引文验证，并且这个问题存在于多个学术和政府领域。建议在提交时强制进行自动引文验证，以防止虚假引文的常态化。
ai_comments: 这项研究揭示了AI生成虚假引文在顶级学术会议同行评审中逃脱检测的严峻现实，并提出了一个有价值的分类法来理解这些失效模式。然而，该研究的局限性在于仅分析了NeurIPS会议的数据，虽然作者声称问题存在于其他领域，但缺乏更广泛的数据支持。此外，提出的解决方案（强制自动引文验证）虽然可行，但其实施细节和潜在的误报/漏报问题需要进一步探讨。该研究对于提高学术诚信和改进同行评审流程具有重要意义。
motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）在学术写作中日益普及，它们经常会生成不存在的引文（幻觉）。本研究旨在分析在顶级AI会议NeurIPS 2025上被接受的论文中出现的100个AI生成的虚假引文，以了解其失效模式和同行评审未能检测到的原因。
method: 本研究分析了NeurIPS 2025上接受的100个AI生成的虚假引文。研究人员开发了一种将幻觉按失效模式分类的五类分类法：完全伪造、部分属性损坏、标识符劫持、占位符幻觉和语义幻觉。他们分析了这些幻觉的复合失效模式和次要特征的分布，以及受影响论文中虚假引文的数量分布。
results: 在NeurIPS 2025上接受的100个AI生成的虚假引文中，有66%属于完全伪造，27%属于部分属性损坏，4%属于标识符劫持，2%属于占位符幻觉，1%属于语义幻觉。所有（100%）幻觉都表现出复合失效模式，其中语义幻觉（63%）和标识符劫持（29%）是最常见的次要特征。92%的受影响论文包含1-2个幻觉，而8%的论文包含4-13个幻觉。
conclusion: 当前的同行评审流程缺乏有效的引文验证机制，导致AI生成的虚假引文能够逃脱检测。这个问题不仅限于NeurIPS，还存在于其他主要会议、政府报告和专业咨询中。为了防止虚假引文在科学文献中常态化，建议在提交时强制实施自动引文验证。

title: Approximation of Log-Partition Function in Policy Mirror Descent Induces Implicit Regularization for LLM Post-Training
authors: Zhenghao Xu, Qin Lu, Changlong Yu, Tuo Zhao
abstract: Policy mirror descent (PMD) provides a principled framework for reinforcement learning (RL) by iteratively solving KL-regularized policy improvement subproblems. While this approach has been adopted in training advanced LLMs such as Kimi K1.5/K2, the ideal closed-form PMD updates require reliable partition function estimation, a significant challenge when working with limited rollouts in the vast action spaces of LLMs. We investigate a practical algorithm, termed PMD-mean, that approximates the log-partition term with the mean reward under the sampling policy and performs regression in log-policy space. Specifically, we characterize the population solution of PMD-mean and demonstrate that it implicitly optimizes mirror descent subproblems with an adaptive mixed KL--$χ^2$ regularizer. This additional $χ^2$ regularization constrains large probability changes, producing more conservative updates when expected rewards are low and enhancing robustness against finite-sample estimation errors. Experiments on math reasoning tasks show that PMD-mean achieves superior performance with improved stability and time efficiency. These findings deepen our understanding of PMD-mean and illuminate pathways toward principled improvements in RL algorithms for LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/horizon-rl/OpenKimi.

title: Dimensionality Reduction on Riemannian Manifolds in Data Analysis
authors: Alaa El Ichi, Khalide Jbilou
abstract: In this work, we investigate Riemannian geometry based dimensionality reduction methods that respect the underlying manifold structure of the data. In particular, we focus on Principal Geodesic Analysis (PGA) as a nonlinear generalization of PCA for manifold valued data, and extend discriminant analysis through Riemannian adaptations of other known dimensionality reduction methods. These approaches exploit geodesic distances, tangent space representations, and intrinsic statistical measures to achieve more faithful low dimensional embeddings. We also discuss related manifold learning techniques and highlight their theoretical foundations and practical advantages. Experimental results on representative datasets demonstrate that Riemannian methods provide improved representation quality and classification performance compared to their Euclidean counterparts, especially for data constrained to curved spaces such as hyperspheres and symmetric positive definite manifolds. This study underscores the importance of geometry aware dimensionality reduction in modern machine learning and data science applications.

title: Tuning Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detectors Without Given OOD Data
authors: Sudeepta Mondal, Xinyi Mary Xie, Ruxiao Duan, Alex Wong, Ganesh Sundaramoorthi
abstract: Existing out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors are often tuned by a separate dataset deemed OOD with respect to the training distribution of a neural network (NN). OOD detectors process the activations of NN layers and score the output, where parameters of the detectors are determined by fitting to an in-distribution (training) set and the aforementioned dataset chosen adhocly. At detector training time, this adhoc dataset may not be available or difficult to obtain, and even when it's available, it may not be representative of actual OOD data, which is often ''unknown unknowns." Current benchmarks may specify some left-out set from test OOD sets. We show that there can be significant variance in performance of detectors based on the adhoc dataset chosen in current literature, and thus even if such a dataset can be collected, the performance of the detector may be highly dependent on the choice. In this paper, we introduce and formalize the often neglected problem of tuning OOD detectors without a given ``OOD'' dataset. To this end, we present strong baselines as an attempt to approach this problem. Furthermore, we propose a new generic approach to OOD detector tuning that does not require any extra data other than those used to train the NN. We show that our approach improves over baseline methods consistently across higher-parameter OOD detector families, while being comparable across lower-parameter families.

title: Polyglots or Multitudes? Multilingual LLM Answers to Value-laden Multiple-Choice Questions
authors: Léo Labat, Etienne Ollion, François Yvon
abstract: Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) are often used to assess knowledge, reasoning abilities, and even values encoded in large language models (LLMs). While the effect of multilingualism has been studied on LLM factual recall, this paper seeks to investigate the less explored question of language-induced variation in value-laden MCQ responses. Are multilingual LLMs consistent in their responses across languages, i.e. behave like theoretical polyglots, or do they answer value-laden MCQs depending on the language of the question, like a multitude of monolingual models expressing different values through a single model? We release a new corpus, the Multilingual European Value Survey (MEVS), which, unlike prior work relying on machine translation or ad hoc prompts, solely comprises human-translated survey questions aligned in 8 European languages. We administer a subset of those questions to over thirty multilingual LLMs of various sizes, manufacturers and alignment-fine-tuning status under comprehensive, controlled prompt variations including answer order, symbol type, and tail character. Our results show that while larger, instruction-tuned models display higher overall consistency, the robustness of their responses varies greatly across questions, with certain MCQs eliciting total agreement within and across models while others leave LLM answers split. Language-specific behavior seems to arise in all consistent, instruction-fine-tuned models, but only on certain questions, warranting a further study of the selective effect of preference fine-tuning.
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures (8 pages of references and appendices)
zh_title: 多语者还是众多？多语言大型语言模型对价值判断多项选择题的回答
translation: 多项选择题（MCQs）常被用来评估大型语言模型（LLMs）的知识、推理能力甚至所编码的价值观。虽然多语言性对LLM事实回忆的影响已被研究，但本文旨在探究较少被探索的语言诱导的价值判断MCQ响应变化问题。多语言LLM在不同语言中的响应是否一致，即表现得像理论上的“多语者”，还是会像“众多”的单一语言模型一样，根据问题的语言回答价值判断MCQ，表达不同的价值观？我们发布了一个新的语料库，欧洲多语言价值调查（MEVS），与以往依赖机器翻译或临时提示的工作不同，它仅包含与8种欧洲语言对齐的人工翻译的调查问题。我们在全面的、受控的提示变化下（包括答案顺序、符号类型和尾随字符），向三十多个不同规模、制造商和对齐微调状态的多语言LLM施加了部分这些问题。我们的结果显示，虽然较大的、经过指令微调的模型显示出更高的总体一致性，但其响应的鲁棒性在不同问题间差异很大，一些MCQ在模型内部和模型间引起完全一致，而其他问题则使LLM答案出现分歧。语言特定的行为似乎存在于所有一致的、经过指令微调的模型中，但仅在某些问题上，这值得对偏好微调的选择性影响进行进一步研究。
tldr: 研究人员测试了多语言LLM对价值判断多项选择题的回答是否随语言变化，发布了新的人工翻译语料库MEVS。发现大型模型更一致，但在某些问题上仍有语言差异，表明存在选择性的语言影响。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于发布了专门针对价值判断多项选择题（MCQ）的、完全由人工翻译的欧洲多语言价值调查（MEVS）语料库，这克服了先前研究中依赖机器翻译或临时提示的局限性。研究结果揭示了多语言LLM在处理价值问题时存在语言依赖性，即使是大型、经过指令微调的模型也存在响应不一致的情况，这为理解模型在不同语言环境中如何编码和表达价值观提供了重要见解。局限性在于仅关注了8种欧洲语言。
motivation: 研究多语言LLM在回答价值判断多项选择题（MCQ）时，其响应是否在不同语言间保持一致（如理论上的“多语者”），还是会像“众多”的单一语言模型一样，根据问题的语言表现出不同的价值观。这是对LLM多语言性在事实召回之外的应用（价值判断）的探索。
method: 发布了新的人工翻译、对齐的欧洲8种语言的价值调查语料库（MEVS）；对超过30个不同规模、制造商和对齐微调状态的多语言LLM进行了测试；采用了包括答案顺序、符号类型和尾随字符在内的全面、受控的提示变化。
results: 较大的、经过指令微调的模型显示出更高的总体一致性，但其响应的鲁棒性因问题而异，一些MCQ在模型内部和模型之间引起完全一致，而另一些则导致LLM答案出现分歧。语言特定的行为在所有一致的、经过指令微调的模型中出现，但仅在特定问题上。
conclusion: 语言特定的行为似乎存在于所有一致的、经过指令微调的模型中，但仅在某些特定的问题上出现，这提示需要进一步研究偏好微调的选择性影响。

title: Multi-Scale Global-Instance Prompt Tuning for Continual Test-time Adaptation in Medical Image Segmentation
authors: Lingrui Li, Yanfeng Zhou, Nan Pu, Xin Chen, Zhun Zhong
abstract: Distribution shift is a common challenge in medical images obtained from different clinical centers, significantly hindering the deployment of pre-trained semantic segmentation models in real-world applications across multiple domains. Continual Test-Time Adaptation(CTTA) has emerged as a promising approach to address cross-domain shifts during continually evolving target domains. Most existing CTTA methods rely on incrementally updating model parameters, which inevitably suffer from error accumulation and catastrophic forgetting, especially in long-term adaptation. Recent prompt-tuning-based works have shown potential to mitigate the two issues above by updating only visual prompts. While these approaches have demonstrated promising performance, several limitations remain:1)lacking multi-scale prompt diversity, 2)inadequate incorporation of instance-specific knowledge, and 3)risk of privacy leakage. To overcome these limitations, we propose Multi-scale Global-Instance Prompt Tuning(MGIPT), to enhance scale diversity of prompts and capture both global- and instance-level knowledge for robust CTTA. Specifically, MGIPT consists of an Adaptive-scale Instance Prompt(AIP) and a Multi-scale Global-level Prompt(MGP). AIP dynamically learns lightweight and instance-specific prompts to mitigate error accumulation with adaptive optimal-scale selection mechanism. MGP captures domain-level knowledge across different scales to ensure robust adaptation with anti-forgetting capabilities. These complementary components are combined through a weighted ensemble approach, enabling effective dual-level adaptation that integrates both global and local information. Extensive experiments on medical image segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that our MGIPT outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving robust adaptation across continually changing target domains.

title: Self-Improving Multilingual Long Reasoning via Translation-Reasoning Integrated Training
authors: Junxiao Liu, Zhijun Wang, Yixiao Li, Zhejian Lai, Liqian Huang, Xin Huang, Xue Han, Junlan Feng, Shujian Huang
abstract: Long reasoning models often struggle in multilingual settings: they tend to reason in English for non-English questions; when constrained to reasoning in the question language, accuracies drop substantially. The struggle is caused by the limited abilities for both multilingual question understanding and multilingual reasoning. To address both problems, we propose TRIT (Translation-Reasoning Integrated Training), a self-improving framework that integrates the training of translation into multilingual reasoning. Without external feedback or additional multilingual data, our method jointly enhances multilingual question understanding and response generation. On MMATH, our method outperforms multiple baselines by an average of 7 percentage points, improving both answer correctness and language consistency. Further analysis reveals that integrating translation training improves cross-lingual question alignment by over 10 percentage points and enhances translation quality for both mathematical questions and general-domain text, with gains up to 8.4 COMET points on FLORES-200.

title: "Detective Work We Shouldn't Have to Do": Practitioner Challenges in Regulatory-Aligned Data Quality in Machine Learning Systems
authors: Yichun Wang, Kristina Irion, Paul Groth, Hazar Harmouch
abstract: Ensuring data quality in machine learning (ML) systems has become increasingly complex as regulatory requirements expand. In the European Union (EU), frameworks such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) articulate data quality requirements that closely parallel technical concerns in ML practice, while also extending to legal obligations related to accountability, risk management, and human rights protection. This paper presents a qualitative interview study with EU-based data practitioners working on ML systems in regulated contexts. Through semi-structured interviews, we investigate how practitioners interpret regulatory-aligned data quality, the challenges they encounter, and the supports they identify as necessary. Our findings reveal persistent gaps between legal principles and engineering workflows, fragmentation across data pipelines, limitations of existing tools, unclear responsibility boundaries between technical and legal teams, and a tendency toward reactive, audit-driven quality practices. We also identify practitioners' needs for compliance-aware tooling, clearer governance structures, and cultural shifts toward proactive data governance.

title: $f$-GRPO and Beyond: Divergence-Based Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for General LLM Alignment
authors: Rajdeep Haldar, Lantao Mei, Guang Lin, Yue Xing, Qifan Song
abstract: Recent research shows that Preference Alignment (PA) objectives act as divergence estimators between aligned (chosen) and unaligned (rejected) response distributions. In this work, we extend this divergence-based perspective to general alignment settings, such as reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where only environmental rewards are available. Within this unified framework, we propose $f$-Group Relative Policy Optimization ($f$-GRPO), a class of on-policy reinforcement learning, and $f$-Hybrid Alignment Loss ($f$-HAL), a hybrid on/off policy objectives, for general LLM alignment based on variational representation of $f$-divergences. We provide theoretical guarantees that these classes of objectives improve the average reward after alignment. Empirically, we validate our framework on both RLVR (Math Reasoning) and PA tasks (Safety Alignment), demonstrating superior performance and flexibility compared to current methods.

title: AgenticTagger: Structured Item Representation for Recommendation with LLM Agents
authors: Zhouhang Xie, Bo Peng, Zhankui He, Ziqi Chen, Alice Han, Isabella Ye, Benjamin Coleman, Noveen Sachdeva, Fernando Pereira, Julian McAuley, Wang-Cheng Kang, Derek Zhiyuan Cheng, Beidou Wang, Randolph Brown
abstract: High-quality representations are a core requirement for effective recommendation. In this work, we study the problem of LLM-based descriptor generation, i.e., keyphrase-like natural language item representation generation frameworks with minimal constraints on downstream applications. We propose AgenticTagger, a framework that queries LLMs for representing items with sequences of text descriptors. However, open-ended generation provides little control over the generation space, leading to high cardinality, low-performance descriptors that renders downstream modeling challenging. To this end, AgenticTagger features two core stages: (1) a vocabulary building stage where a set of hierarchical, low-cardinality, and high-quality descriptors is identified, and (2) a vocabulary assignment stage where LLMs assign in-vocabulary descriptors to items. To effectively and efficiently ground vocabulary in the item corpus of interest, we design a multi-agent reflection mechanism where an architect LLM iteratively refines the vocabulary guided by parallelized feedback from annotator LLMs that validates the vocabulary against item data. Experiments on public and private data show AgenticTagger brings consistent improvements across diverse recommendation scenarios, including generative and term-based retrieval, ranking, and controllability-oriented, critique-based recommendation.

title: Orthogonal Model Merging
authors: Sihan Yang, Kexuan Shi, Weiyang Liu
abstract: Merging finetuned Large Language Models (LLMs) has become increasingly important for integrating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing model merging methods rely on linear arithmetic in Euclidean space, which often destroys the intrinsic geometric properties of pretrained weights, such as hyperspherical energy. To address this, we propose Orthogonal Model Merging (OrthoMerge), a method that performs merging operations on the Riemannian manifold formed by the orthogonal group to preserve the geometric structure of the model's weights. By mapping task-specific orthogonal matrices learned by Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) to the Lie algebra, OrthoMerge enables a principled yet efficient integration that takes into account both the direction and intensity of adaptations. In addition to directly leveraging orthogonal matrices obtained by OFT, we further extend this approach to general models finetuned with non-OFT methods (i.e., low-rank finetuning, full finetuning) via an Orthogonal-Residual Decoupling strategy. This technique extracts the orthogonal components of expert models by solving the orthogonal Procrustes problem, which are then merged on the manifold of the orthogonal group, while the remaining linear residuals are processed through standard additive merging. Extensive empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of OrthoMerge in mitigating catastrophic forgetting and maintaining model performance across diverse tasks.
comment: Technical report (18 pages, 9 figures, project page: https://spherelab.ai/OrthoMerge/)

title: Location-Aware Dispersion on Anonymous Graphs
authors: Himani, Supantha Pandit, Gokarna Sharma
abstract:
The well-studied DISPERSION problem is a fundamental coordination problem in distributed robotics, where a set of mobile robots must relocate so that each occupies a distinct node of a network. DISPERSION assumes that a robot can settle at any node as long as no other robot settles on that node. In this work, we introduce LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION, a novel generalization of DISPERSION that incorporates location awareness: Let $G = (V, E)$ be an anonymous, connected, undirected graph with $n = |V|$ nodes, each labeled with a color $\sf{col}(v) \in C = \{c_1, \dots, c_t\}, t\leq n$. A set $R = \{r_1, \dots, r_k\}$ of $k \leq n$ mobile robots is given, where each robot $r_i$ has an associated color $\mathsf{col}(r_i) \in C$. Initially placed arbitrarily on the graph, the goal is to relocate the robots so that each occupies a distinct node of the same color. When $|C|=1$, LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION reduces to DISPERSION. There is a solution to DISPERSION in graphs with any $k\leq n$ without knowing $k,n$.
  Like DISPERSION, the goal is to solve LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION minimizing both time and memory requirement at each agent. We develop several deterministic algorithms with guaranteed bounds on both time and memory requirement. We also give an impossibility and a lower bound for any deterministic algorithm for LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION. To the best of our knowledge, the presented results collectively establish the algorithmic feasibility of LOCATION-AWARE DISPERSION in anonymous networks and also highlight the challenges on getting an efficient solution compared to the solutions for DISPERSION.

title: Breaking Symmetry Bottlenecks in GNN Readouts
authors: Mouad Talhi, Arne Wolf, Anthea Monod
abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used for learning on structured data, yet their ability to distinguish non-isomorphic graphs is fundamentally limited. These limitations are usually attributed to message passing; in this work we show that an independent bottleneck arises at the readout stage. Using finite-dimensional representation theory, we prove that all linear permutation-invariant readouts, including sum and mean pooling, factor through the Reynolds (group-averaging) operator and therefore project node embeddings onto the fixed subspace of the permutation action, erasing all non-trivial symmetry-aware components regardless of encoder expressivity. This yields both a new expressivity barrier and an interpretable characterization of what global pooling preserves or destroys. To overcome this collapse, we introduce projector-based invariant readouts that decompose node representations into symmetry-aware channels and summarize them with nonlinear invariant statistics, preserving permutation invariance while retaining information provably invisible to averaging. Empirically, swapping only the readout enables fixed encoders to separate WL-hard graph pairs and improves performance across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating that readout design is a decisive and under-appreciated factor in GNN expressivity.

title: Better Source, Better Flow: Learning Condition-Dependent Source Distribution for Flow Matching
authors: Junwan Kim, Jiho Park, Seonghu Jeon, Seungryong Kim
abstract: Flow matching has recently emerged as a promising alternative to diffusion-based generative models, particularly for text-to-image generation. Despite its flexibility in allowing arbitrary source distributions, most existing approaches rely on a standard Gaussian distribution, a choice inherited from diffusion models, and rarely consider the source distribution itself as an optimization target in such settings. In this work, we show that principled design of the source distribution is not only feasible but also beneficial at the scale of modern text-to-image systems. Specifically, we propose learning a condition-dependent source distribution under flow matching objective that better exploit rich conditioning signals. We identify key failure modes that arise when directly incorporating conditioning into the source, including distributional collapse and instability, and show that appropriate variance regularization and directional alignment between source and target are critical for stable and effective learning. We further analyze how the choice of target representation space impacts flow matching with structured sources, revealing regimes in which such designs are most effective. Extensive experiments across multiple text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate consistent and robust improvements, including up to a 3x faster convergence in FID, highlighting the practical benefits of a principled source distribution design for conditional flow matching.

title: Spectral Analysis of Block Diagonally Preconditioned Multiple Saddle-Point Matrices with Inexact Schur Complements
authors: Marco Pilotto, Luca Bergamaschi, Angeles Martinez
abstract: We derive eigenvalue bounds for symmetric block-tridiagonal multiple saddle-point systems preconditioned with block-diagonal Schur complement matrices. This analysis applies to an arbitrary number of blocks and accounts for the case where the Schur complements are approximated, generalizing the findings in [Bergamaschi et al., Linear Algebra and its Applications, 2026]. Numerical experiments are carried out to validate the proposed estimates.

title: Competitive Analysis of Online Facility Assignment Algorithms on Discrete Grid Graphs: Performance Bounds and Remediation Strategies
authors: Lamya Alif, Raian Tasnim Saoda, Sumaiya Afrin, Md. Rawha Siddiqi Riad, Md. Tanzeem Rahat, Md Manzurul Hasan
abstract: We study the \emph{Online Facility Assignment} (OFA) problem on a discrete $r\times c$ grid graph under the standard model of Ahmed, Rahman, and Kobourov: a fixed set of facilities is given, each with limited capacity, and an online sequence of unit-demand requests must be irrevocably assigned upon arrival to an available facility, incurring Manhattan ($L_1$) distance cost. We investigate how the discrete geometry of grids interacts with capacity depletion by analyzing two natural baselines and one capacity-aware heuristic. First, we give explicit adversarial sequences on grid instances showing that purely local rules can be forced into large competitive ratios: (i) a capacity-sensitive weighted-Voronoi heuristic (\textsc{CS-Voronoi}) can suffer cascading \emph{region-collapse} effects when nearby capacity is exhausted; and (ii) nearest-available \textsc{Greedy} (with randomized tie-breaking) can be driven into repeated long reassignments via an \emph{oscillation} construction. These results formalize geometric failure modes that are specific to discrete $L_1$ metrics with hard capacities. Motivated by these lower bounds, we then discuss a semi-online extension in which the algorithm may delay assignment for up to $τ$ time steps and solve each batch optimally via a min-cost flow computation. We present this batching framework as a remediation strategy and delineate the parameters that govern its performance, while leaving sharp competitive guarantees for this semi-online variant as an open direction.

title: Discrete diffusion samplers and bridges: Off-policy algorithms and applications in latent spaces
authors: Arran Carter, Sanghyeok Choi, Kirill Tamogashev, Víctor Elvira, Nikolay Malkin
abstract: Sampling from a distribution $p(x) \propto e^{-\mathcal{E}(x)}$ known up to a normalising constant is an important and challenging problem in statistics. Recent years have seen the rise of a new family of amortised sampling algorithms, commonly referred to as diffusion samplers, that enable fast and efficient sampling from an unnormalised density. Such algorithms have been widely studied for continuous-space sampling tasks; however, their application to problems in discrete space remains largely unexplored. Although some progress has been made in this area, discrete diffusion samplers do not take full advantage of ideas commonly used for continuous-space sampling. In this paper, we propose to bridge this gap by introducing off-policy training techniques for discrete diffusion samplers. We show that these techniques improve the performance of discrete samplers on both established and new synthetic benchmarks. Next, we generalise discrete diffusion samplers to the task of bridging between two arbitrary distributions, introducing data-to-energy Schrödinger bridge training for the discrete domain for the first time.
