ScholarMate enables researchers to dynamically arrange and interact with text snippets on a non-linear canvas, leveraging AI for theme suggestions, multi-level summarization, and evidence-based theme naming, while ensuring transparency through traceability to source documents. Initial pilot studies indicated that users value this mixed-initiative approach, finding the balance between AI suggestions and direct manipulation crucial for maintaining interpretability and trust. We further demonstrate the system's capability through a case study analyzing 24 papers. By balancing automation with human control, ScholarMate enhances efficiency and supports interpretability, offering a valuable approach for productive human-AI collaboration in demanding sensemaking tasks common in knowledge work.
zh_title: ScholarMate：一种用于定性知识工作和信息理解的混合主动工具
translation: 从大量文档集合中综合知识是定性研究和知识工作的关键但日益复杂的方面。虽然AI提供了自动化的潜力，但将其有效集成到以人为中心的理解流程中仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了ScholarMate，这是一个交互式系统，旨在通过统一AI辅助和人为监督来增强定性分析。ScholarMate使研究人员能够在非线性画布上动态排列文本片段并与之交互，利用AI进行主题建议、多级摘要和基于证据的主题命名，同时通过可追溯到源文档来确保透明度。初步的试点研究表明，用户重视这种混合主动的方法，发现AI建议和直接操作之间的平衡对于保持可解释性和信任至关重要。我们通过一个分析24篇论文的案例研究进一步展示了系统的能力。通过平衡自动化与人为控制，ScholarMate提高了效率并支持了可解释性，为知识工作中要求苛刻的理解任务中的高效人机协作提供了一种有价值的方法。
tldr: ScholarMate是一个混合主动的工具，它结合了AI辅助（主题建议、总结）和人类控制，帮助研究人员对大量文档进行定性分析和知识理解，同时确保可解释性和信任。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“混合主动”的方法，明确地平衡了AI的自动化能力（如主题建议和摘要）与人类对定性分析的直接控制（如在非线性画布上的操作）。这种设计通过确保所有AI建议都可追溯到原始文档，有效解决了定性研究中AI“黑箱”问题，增强了用户对结果的信任和可解释性。对于处理大量文本数据且高度依赖人工理解的知识工作领域而言，这是一个重要且实用的工具。
motivation: 从大量文档集合中综合知识是定性研究和知识工作的关键但日益复杂的方面。将AI有效集成到以人为中心的理解流程中仍然具有挑战性。
method: 提出了ScholarMate，一个交互式系统，通过统一AI辅助和人为监督来增强定性分析。它允许研究人员在非线性画布上动态排列文本片段，并利用AI进行主题建议、多级摘要和基于证据的主题命名。系统通过可追溯到源文档来确保透明度。
results: 初步的试点研究表明，用户重视这种混合主动的方法，发现AI建议和直接操作之间的平衡对于保持可解释性和信任至关重要。通过分析24篇论文的案例研究展示了系统的能力。
conclusion: 通过平衡自动化与人为控制，ScholarMate提高了效率并支持了可解释性，为知识工作中要求苛刻的理解任务中的高效人机协作提供了一种有价值的方法。

title: SynPAT: A System for Generating Synthetic Physical Theories with Data
authors: Jonathan Lenchner, Karan Srivastava, Joao Goncalves, Mark Squillante, Lior Horesh
abstract: Machine-assisted methods for discovering physical laws from background theory and data have recently emerged, promising to advance our understanding of the physical world. However, training and benchmarking these systems remains challenging: real physical theories are limited in number. To address this need, we introduce SynPAT, a system for generating synthetic physical theories with accompanying data. SynPAT produces: (i) a consistent set of axioms forming a synthetic theory, (ii) a symbolic consequence of these axioms representing the discovery target, and (iii) noisy data approximating this consequence. Crucially, to mirror historically incorrect theories (e.g., Newtonian mechanics before Special Relativity), SynPAT can also generate theories whose axioms do not strictly entail, and in fact conflict with, the observed consequence, requiring a correction to the assumed axioms to bridge the gap. We detail SynPAT's methodology and benchmark several open-source symbolic regression systems on our generated theories and data.
zh_title: SynPAT：一个生成带数据的合成物理理论的系统
translation: 近年来，出现了机器辅助从背景理论和数据中发现物理定律的方法，有望推动我们对物理世界的理解。然而，训练和基准测试这些系统仍然具有挑战性：真实的物理理论数量有限。为了解决这一需求，我们引入了SynPAT，这是一个用于生成带数据的合成物理理论的系统。SynPAT生成：(i) 一套形成合成理论的一致公理集；(ii) 代表发现目标的这些公理的符号推论；(iii) 逼近该推论的带噪声数据。至关重要的是，为了模拟历史上不正确的理论（例如，狭义相对论之前的牛顿力学），SynPAT还可以生成公理并非严格推导出、甚至与观测推论相冲突的理论，这就需要对假定的公理进行修正才能弥补差距。我们详细介绍了SynPAT的方法论，并使用我们生成的理论和数据对几个开源的符号回归系统进行了基准测试。
tldr: SynPAT是一个系统，用于生成人工物理理论及其相关数据，以解决训练和测试机器发现物理定律系统时真实理论数量有限的问题。它还能生成与观测数据存在冲突的理论，用于模拟历史上的理论修正过程。
ai_comments: SynPAT的创新性在于它提供了一个可扩展的、结构化的合成数据集生成器，专门针对物理定律发现任务。其重要性在于它解决了该领域核心的“数据稀缺”问题，为机器辅助科学发现系统的训练、鲁棒性测试和基准比较提供了一个标准化的平台。尤其值得称赞的是，它能够模拟历史上的“错误”理论，这使得系统不仅能学习从公理到结果的推导，还能学习理论修正和科学演进的过程，极大地提高了测试的复杂性和现实意义。
motivation: 机器辅助发现物理定律的方法在训练和基准测试上面临挑战，因为真实的物理理论数量有限。
method: 提出了SynPAT系统，该系统生成：(i) 一致的公理集合（合成理论）；(ii) 这些公理的符号推论（发现目标）；(iii) 逼近该推论的带噪声数据。关键是，SynPAT还能生成公理与观测结果不严格一致甚至冲突的理论（模拟历史上的错误理论），以要求修正公理。
results: 详细介绍了SynPAT的方法论，并使用生成的理论和数据对几个开源的符号回归系统进行了基准测试。

title: Relational Graph Transformer
authors: Vijay Prakash Dwivedi, Sri Jaladi, Yangyi Shen, Federico López, Charilaos I. Kanatsoulis, Rishi Puri, Matthias Fey, Jure Leskovec
abstract: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) is a promising approach for building state-of-the-art predictive models on multi-table relational data by representing it as a heterogeneous temporal graph. However, commonly used Graph Neural Network models suffer from fundamental limitations in capturing complex structural patterns and long-range dependencies that are inherent in relational data. While Graph Transformers have emerged as powerful alternatives to GNNs on general graphs, applying them to relational entity graphs presents unique challenges: (i) Traditional positional encodings fail to generalize to massive, heterogeneous graphs; (ii) existing architectures cannot model the temporal dynamics and schema constraints of relational data; (iii) existing tokenization schemes lose critical structural information. Here we introduce the Relational Graph Transformer (RelGT), the first graph transformer architecture designed specifically for relational tables. RelGT employs a novel multi-element tokenization strategy that decomposes each node into five components (features, type, hop distance, time, and local structure), enabling efficient encoding of heterogeneity, temporality, and topology without expensive precomputation. Our architecture combines local attention over sampled subgraphs with global attention to learnable centroids, incorporating both local and database-wide representations. Across 21 tasks from the RelBench benchmark, RelGT consistently matches or outperforms GNN baselines by up to 18%, establishing Graph Transformers as a powerful architecture for Relational Deep Learning.
translation: 关系深度学习（RDL）是一种很有前途的方法，通过将多表关系数据表示为异构时序图，来构建最先进的预测模型。然而，常用的图神经网络模型在捕获关系数据中固有的复杂结构模式和长程依赖方面存在根本性的局限。虽然图Transformer已成为通用图上GNN的强大替代方案，但将其应用于关系实体图面临独特的挑战：(i) 传统的位置编码无法推广到大规模、异构的图；(ii) 现有架构无法建模关系数据的时间动态和模式约束；(iii) 现有分词方案会丢失关键的结构信息。为此，我们引入了关系图Transformer（RelGT），这是第一个专门为关系表设计的图Transformer架构。RelGT采用新颖的多元素分词策略，将每个节点分解为五个组件（特征、类型、跳距、时间和局部结构），从而无需昂贵的预计算即可高效编码异构性、时序性和拓扑结构。我们的架构结合了对采样子图的局部注意力以及对可学习质心的全局注意力，整合了局部和数据库范围的表示。在RelBench基准测试的21项任务中，RelGT始终与GNN基线持平或表现更优，性能提升高达18%，从而确立了图Transformer作为关系深度学习的强大架构。
tldr: RelGT是首个用于关系深度学习（RDL）的图Transformer。它通过五元素分词和混合局部/全局注意力来解决异构性、时序性和结构复杂性问题，在关系基准测试中性能显著优于GNN。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于设计了首个专门针对关系深度学习（RDL）独特挑战的图Transformer架构。核心创新是其“多元素分词策略”（包含五个组件，即特征、类型、跳距、时间和局部结构），有效地将特征、模式、拓扑结构和时间动态信息集成到注意力机制中，从而克服了标准位置编码在大规模异构图中的局限性。其重要性在于，它将图Transformer确立为RDL领域的一种强大架构，在关系基准测试中显著超越了传统的GNN，为处理多表关系数据提供了新的SOTA（State-of-the-Art）方法。
motivation: 关系深度学习（RDL）很有前景，但常用的图神经网络（GNN）在捕获关系数据中固有的复杂结构模式和长程依赖方面存在局限性。将图Transformer应用于关系实体图面临三大挑战：传统位置编码不适用于大规模异构图；现有架构无法建模关系数据的时间动态和模式约束；现有分词方案会丢失关键结构信息。
method: 引入了关系图Transformer (RelGT)，这是首个专为关系表设计的图Transformer架构。它采用新颖的多元素分词策略，将每个节点分解为五个组件（特征、类型、跳距、时间和局部结构），从而高效编码异构性、时序性和拓扑结构。其架构结合了对采样子图的局部注意力以及对可学习质心的全局注意力，以整合局部和数据库范围的表示。
results: 在RelBench基准测试的21项任务中，RelGT始终与GNN基线持平或表现更优，性能提升高达18%，从而确立了图Transformer作为关系深度学习的强大架构。
conclusion: RelGT将图Transformer确立为关系深度学习的一种强大架构。

title: LEANCODE: Understanding Models Better for Code Simplification of Pre-trained Large Language Models
authors: Yan Wang, Ling Ding, Tien N Nguyen, Shaohua Wang, Yanan Zheng
abstract: Large Language Models for code often entail significant computational complexity, which grows significantly with the length of the input code sequence. We propose LeanCode for code simplification to reduce training and prediction time, leveraging code contexts in utilizing attention scores to represent the tokens' importance. We advocate for the selective removal of tokens based on the average context-aware attention scores rather than average scores across all inputs. LeanCode uses the attention scores of `CLS' tokens within the encoder for classification tasks, such as code search. It also employs the encoder-decoder attention scores to determine token significance for sequence-to-sequence tasks like code summarization. Our evaluation shows LeanCode's superiority over the SOTAs DietCode and Slimcode, with improvements of 60% and 16% for code search, and 29% and 27% for code summarization, respectively.
comment: ACL 2025 Main. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/akai-sh/LeanCode
zh_title: LEANCODE：更好地理解模型以简化预训练大型语言模型的代码
translation: 用于代码的大型语言模型通常涉及显著的计算复杂性，且随着输入代码序列长度的增加而显著增长。我们提出了LeanCode用于代码简化，以减少训练和预测时间，它利用代码上下文中的注意力分数来表示token的重要性。我们主张基于平均上下文感知注意力分数而不是所有输入上的平均分数来选择性地删除token。LeanCode在分类任务（如代码搜索）中使用编码器内`CLS` token的注意力分数。它还采用编码器-解码器注意力分数来确定序列到序列任务（如代码摘要）中token的重要性。我们的评估表明，LeanCode优于现有技术DietCode和Slimcode，在代码搜索方面分别提高了60%和16%，在代码摘要方面分别提高了29%和27%。
tldr: LeanCode通过利用注意力分数选择性地删除不重要的token，从而简化代码，以减少代码大型语言模型的计算复杂性，并在代码搜索和代码摘要任务上优于现有技术。
ai_comments: LeanCode的创新之处在于其利用上下文感知注意力分数进行选择性token删除的策略，这比简单地基于平均分数更精细。它针对不同类型的任务（分类与序列到序列）使用不同的注意力分数机制，显示了其方法的灵活性和任务适应性。该方法对于优化代码LLM的效率具有重要意义，尤其是在处理长代码序列时。
motivation: 大型语言模型处理代码时通常涉及显著的计算复杂性，且随着输入代码序列长度的增加而显著增长，因此需要一种代码简化方法来减少训练和预测时间。
method: LeanCode利用代码上下文中的注意力分数来表示token的重要性，并基于平均上下文感知注意力分数选择性地删除token。对于代码搜索等分类任务，它使用编码器中`CLS` token的注意力分数；对于代码摘要等序列到序列任务，它使用编码器-解码器注意力分数来确定token的重要性。
results: LeanCode在代码搜索方面比DietCode和Slimcode分别提高了60%和16%，在代码摘要方面分别提高了29%和27%。
conclusion: LeanCode在代码搜索和代码摘要任务上表现优于现有技术DietCode和Slimcode。

title: Bench-NPIN: Benchmarking Non-prehensile Interactive Navigation
authors: Ninghan Zhong, Steven Caro, Avraiem Iskandar, Megnath Ramesh, Stephen L. Smith
abstract: Mobile robots are increasingly deployed in unstructured environments where obstacles and objects are movable. Navigation in such environments is known as interactive navigation, where task completion requires not only avoiding obstacles but also strategic interactions with movable objects. Non-prehensile interactive navigation focuses on non-grasping interaction strategies, such as pushing, rather than relying on prehensile manipulation. Despite a growing body of research in this field, most solutions are evaluated using case-specific setups, limiting reproducibility and cross-comparison. In this paper, we present Bench-NPIN, the first comprehensive benchmark for non-prehensile interactive navigation. Bench-NPIN includes multiple components: 1) a comprehensive range of simulated environments for non-prehensile interactive navigation tasks, including navigating a maze with movable obstacles, autonomous ship navigation in icy waters, box delivery, and area clearing, each with varying levels of complexity; 2) a set of evaluation metrics that capture unique aspects of interactive navigation, such as efficiency, interaction effort, and partial task completion; and 3) demonstrations using Bench-NPIN to evaluate example implementations of established baselines across environments. Bench-NPIN is an open-source Python library with a modular design. The code, documentation, and trained models can be found at https://github.com/IvanIZ/BenchNPIN.
comment: This paper has been withdrawn by the authors. This paper has been superseded by arXiv:2512.11736
zh_title: Bench-NPIN：非抓取式交互导航的基准测试
translation: 移动机器人的部署越来越多地出现在障碍物和物体均可移动的非结构化环境中。在这种环境中的导航被称为交互式导航，任务完成不仅需要避开障碍物，还需要与可移动物体进行战略性互动。非抓取式交互导航侧重于非抓取式的交互策略，例如推，而不是依赖抓取式操作。尽管该领域的研究日益增多，但大多数解决方案都是使用特定案例的设置进行评估，这限制了复现性和交叉比较。在本文中，我们提出了Bench-NPIN，这是第一个针对非抓取式交互导航的综合基准测试。Bench-NPIN包含多个组件：1）一系列用于非抓取式交互导航任务的综合模拟环境，包括穿越带有可移动障碍物的迷宫、冰水中的自主船舶导航、箱子递送和区域清理，每个环境具有不同的复杂程度；2）一套捕捉交互式导航独特方面的评估指标，例如效率、交互努力和部分任务完成度；3）使用Bench-NPIN来评估现有基线在不同环境中的示例实现的演示。Bench-NPIN是一个具有模块化设计的开源Python库。代码、文档和训练模型可在https://github.com/IvanIZ/BenchNPIN找到。
tldr: 提出了Bench-NPIN，这是首个针对非抓取式交互导航（如推动物体）的综合基准测试，它提供了一系列模拟环境、专门的评估指标，并用于评估现有基线，以提高该领域研究的复现性和可比性。
ai_comments: Bench-NPIN的创新性在于它解决了移动机器人交互式导航领域长期存在的评估标准化问题。通过提供统一的模拟环境、多样的任务和专门的指标（如交互努力和部分任务完成度），它极大地促进了非抓取式交互导航算法的公平比较和快速迭代。其重要性在于，非抓取式交互（如推动）在许多现实世界的机器人应用中比抓取更实用或更高效，建立一个强大的、开源的基准对于推动该子领域的发展至关重要。
motivation: 移动机器人在非结构化环境中需要进行交互式导航（与可移动物体进行战略性互动）。现有的非抓取式交互导航（NPIN）解决方案通常使用特定案例的设置进行评估，这限制了研究的复现性和跨系统比较。
method: 提出了Bench-NPIN，这是第一个综合性的非抓取式交互导航基准测试，它是一个开源Python库，具有模块化设计。该基准包含三个主要组件：1) 一系列用于非抓取式交互导航任务的综合模拟环境（如带可移动障碍的迷宫、冰水中的自主船舶导航、箱子递送和区域清理）；2) 一套捕捉交互式导航独特方面的评估指标（如效率、交互努力和部分任务完成度）；3) 用于评估现有基线在不同环境中的示例实现的演示。
results: 演示了使用Bench-NPIN来评估现有基线在不同环境中的实现。

title: The equivalent condition for GRL codes to be MDS, AMDS or self-dual
authors: Zhonghao Liang, Yongkang Wan, Qunying Liao
abstract: It's well known that MDS, AMDS or self dual codes have good algebraic properties, and are applied in communication systems, data storage, quantum codes, and so on. In this paper, we focus on a class of generalized Roth-Lempel linear codes which are not not equivalent to linear codes in [21],[22] and give an equivalent condition for them or their dual to be non RS MDS, AMDS or non RS self-dual and some corresponding examples.

title: Trefftz Discontinuous Galerkin methods for scattering by periodic structures
authors: Armando Maria Monforte, Andrea Moiola
abstract: We propose a Trefftz discontinuous Galerkin (TDG) method for the approximation of plane wave scattering by periodic diffraction gratings, modelled by the two-dimensional Helmholtz equation. The periodic obstacle may include penetrable and impenetrable regions. The TDG method requires the approximation of the Dirichlet-to-Neumann (DtN) operator on the periodic cell faces, and relies on plane wave discrete spaces. For polygonal meshes, all linear-system entries can be computed analytically. Using a Rellich identity, we prove a new explicit stability estimate for the Helmholtz solution, which is robust in the small material jump limit.

title: Rethinking Multi-Modal Learning from Gradient Uncertainty
authors: Peizheng Guo, Jingyao Wang, Wenwen Qiang, Jiahuan Zhou, Changwen Zheng, Gang Hua
abstract: Multi-Modal Learning (MML) integrates information from diverse modalities to improve predictive accuracy. While existing optimization strategies have made significant strides by mitigating gradient direction conflicts, we revisit MML from a gradient-based perspective to explore further improvements. Empirically, we observe an interesting phenomenon: performance fluctuations can persist in both conflict and non-conflict settings. Based on this, we argue that: beyond gradient direction, the intrinsic reliability of gradients acts as a decisive factor in optimization, necessitating the explicit modeling of gradient uncertainty. Guided by this insight, we propose Bayesian-Oriented Gradient Calibration for MML (BOGC-MML). Our approach explicitly models gradients as probability distributions to capture uncertainty, interpreting their precision as evidence within the framework of subjective logic and evidence theory. By subsequently aggregating these signals using a reduced Dempster's combination rule, BOGC-MML adaptively weights gradients based on their reliability to generate a calibrated update. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed method.

title: Robust Answers, Fragile Logic: Probing the Decoupling Hypothesis in LLM Reasoning
authors: Enyi Jiang, Changming Xu, Nischay Singh, Tian Qiu, Gagandeep Singh
abstract: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become a cornerstone for complex reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), the faithfulness of the generated reasoning remains an open question. We investigate the Decoupling Hypothesis: that correct answers often mask fragile, post-hoc rationalizations that are not causally tied to the model's prediction. To systematically verify this, we introduce MATCHA, a novel Answer-Conditioned Probing framework. Unlike standard evaluations that focus on final output accuracy, MATCHA isolates the reasoning phase by conditioning generation on the model's predicted answer, allowing us to stress-test the stability of the rationale itself. Our experiments reveal a critical vulnerability: under imperceptible input perturbations, LLMs frequently maintain the correct answer while generating inconsistent or nonsensical reasoning - effectively being ``Right for the Wrong Reasons''. Using LLM judges to quantify this robustness gap, we find that multi-step and commonsense tasks are significantly more susceptible to this decoupling than logical tasks. Furthermore, we demonstrate that adversarial examples generated by MATCHA transfer non-trivially to black-box models. Our findings expose the illusion of CoT robustness and underscore the need for future architectures that enforce genuine answer-reasoning consistency rather than mere surface-level accuracy.
zh_title: 稳健的答案，脆弱的逻辑：探究大型语言模型推理中的去耦假设
translation: 尽管思维链（CoT）提示已成为大型语言模型（LLMs）复杂推理的基石，但生成推理的忠实度仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们研究了解耦假设：正确的答案常常掩盖了脆弱的、事后编造的、与模型的预测没有因果关系的合理化。为了系统地验证这一点，我们引入了MATCHA，一个新颖的答案条件探针框架。与关注最终输出准确性的标准评估不同，MATCHA通过以模型的预测答案为条件来隔离推理阶段，从而允许我们对推理本身的稳定性进行压力测试。我们的实验揭示了一个关键的漏洞：在几乎察觉不到的输入扰动下，LLM经常保持正确的答案，同时生成不一致或无意义的推理——有效地“为错误的原因而正确”。使用LLM判官量化这种鲁棒性差距，我们发现多步和常识性任务比逻辑任务更容易受到这种解耦的影响。此外，我们证明了由MATCHA生成的对抗样本可以非平凡地迁移到黑盒模型。我们的发现暴露了CoT鲁棒性的假象，并强调了未来需要强制执行真正答案-推理一致性而非仅仅表面准确性的架构。
tldr: LLM的思维链推理（CoT）常常是“为错误的原因而得出正确答案”：即使输入只有微小变化，模型也能保持答案正确，但其推理过程变得荒谬。新工具MATCHA揭示了这种脆弱性，表明我们不能完全相信CoT的解释，尤其是在复杂任务中。
ai_comments: 这项工作创新性地提出了MATCHA框架来检验大型语言模型（LLM）推理中的“去耦假设”，即正确答案可能掩盖了脆弱的、事后编造的推理过程。实验结果揭示了CoT推理在面对微小输入扰动时缺乏鲁棒性，尤其在多步和常识性任务中表现明显，这指出了当前LLM“为错误的原因而得出正确答案”的普遍问题，对未来模型设计具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 研究旨在探究思维链（CoT）提示生成的推理过程的忠实度，特别是验证“解耦假设”——即正确答案是否常常掩盖了与模型预测没有因果关系的、脆弱的事后合理化。
method: 提出了一种名为MATCHA（Answer-Conditioned Probing framework）的新颖框架，该框架通过以模型预测的答案为条件来隔离推理阶段，从而对推理的稳定性进行压力测试。
results: 实验表明，在几乎察觉不到的输入扰动下，LLM经常保持正确的答案但生成不一致或无意义的推理（即“为错误的原因而正确”）。使用LLM判官量化发现，多步和常识性任务比逻辑任务更容易出现这种去耦现象。此外，MATCHA生成的对抗样本可以非平凡地迁移到黑盒模型。
conclusion: 研究结果揭示了思维链（CoT）鲁棒性的假象，并强调了未来架构需要强制执行真正的答案-推理一致性，而非仅仅关注表面准确性。

title: CATS: Enhancing Multivariate Time Series Forecasting by Constructing Auxiliary Time Series as Exogenous Variables
authors: Jiecheng Lu, Xu Han, Yan Sun, Shihao Yang
abstract: For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF), recent deep learning applications show that univariate models frequently outperform multivariate ones. To address the difficiency in multivariate models, we introduce a method to Construct Auxiliary Time Series (CATS) that functions like a 2D temporal-contextual attention mechanism, which generates Auxiliary Time Series (ATS) from Original Time Series (OTS) to effectively represent and incorporate inter-series relationships for forecasting. Key principles of ATS - continuity, sparsity, and variability - are identified and implemented through different modules. Even with a basic 2-layer MLP as core predictor, CATS achieves state-of-the-art, significantly reducing complexity and parameters compared to previous multivariate models, marking it an efficient and transferable MTSF solution.

title: ARM: Refining Multivariate Forecasting with Adaptive Temporal-Contextual Learning
authors: Jiecheng Lu, Xu Han, Shihao Yang
abstract: Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) is important for various domains but is confronted by challenges in handling the complex temporal-contextual relationships. As multivariate input models underperforming some recent univariate counterparts, we posit that the issue lies in the inefficiency of existing multivariate LTSF Transformers to model series-wise relationships: the characteristic differences between series are often captured incorrectly. To address this, we introduce ARM: a multivariate temporal-contextual adaptive learning method, which is an enhanced architecture specifically designed for multivariate LTSF modelling. ARM employs Adaptive Univariate Effect Learning (AUEL), Random Dropping (RD) training strategy, and Multi-kernel Local Smoothing (MKLS), to better handle individual series temporal patterns and correctly learn inter-series dependencies. ARM demonstrates superior performance on multiple benchmarks without significantly increasing computational costs compared to vanilla Transformer, thereby advancing the state-of-the-art in LTSF. ARM is also generally applicable to other LTSF architecture beyond vanilla Transformer.

title: Dynamic Resource Allocation with Karma: An Experimental Study
authors: Ezzat Elokda, Saverio Bolognani, Florian Dörfler, Heinrich H. Nax
abstract: A system of non-tradable credits that flow between individuals like karma, hence proposed under that name, is a mechanism for repeated resource allocation that comes with attractive efficiency and fairness properties, in theory. In this study, we test karma in an online experiment in which human subjects repeatedly compete for a resource with time-varying and stochastic individual preferences or urgency to acquire the resource. We confirm that karma has significant and sustained welfare benefits even in a population with no prior training. We identify mechanism usage in contexts with sporadic high urgency, more so than with frequent moderate urgency, and implemented as a simple (binary) karma bidding scheme as particularly effective for welfare improvements: relatively larger aggregate efficiency gains are realized that are (almost) Pareto superior. These findings provide guidance for further testing and for future implementation plans of such mechanisms in the real world.
zh_title: 带有Karma的动态资源分配：一项实验研究
translation: 一种在个人之间像业力（karma）一样流动的非交易信用体系，因此以该名称提出，是一种重复性资源分配机制，理论上具有吸引人的效率和公平特性。在本研究中，我们在一个在线实验中测试了Karma，实验对象是人类受试者，他们需要反复竞争一种资源，该资源的个体偏好或紧急性是时变且随机的。我们证实，即使在没有事先训练的人群中，Karma也具有显著且持续的福利效益。我们发现，机制使用在偶发的、高紧急性的情境下更为频繁，并且以简单的（二元的）Karma竞价方案实施时对福利改善特别有效：实现的相对较大的总体效率提升是（几乎）帕累托最优的。这些发现为未来对该机制的进一步测试和在现实世界中实施此类机制的计划提供了指导。
tldr: Karma系统是一种理论上很棒的资源分配机制，首次在在线实验中进行了测试，结果显示它在处理具有随机高需求的人群时表现出色，即便参与者未经训练也能带来显著的福利提升和接近完美的效率改进。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次在在线实验中测试了Karma系统在动态资源分配中的实际效果，尤其是在存在随机变化的个体偏好或紧急性的情境下。其重要性在于证实了Karma机制在没有预先训练的情况下也能带来显著且持续的福利提升。局限性可能在于实验环境与真实世界应用的复杂性之间存在差距。
motivation: Karma系统作为一种非交易信用机制，理论上具有吸引人的效率和公平性特性，本研究旨在通过实验检验其在重复资源分配中的实际效果。
method: 在一项在线实验中测试了Karma系统，实验对象是人类受试者，他们需要反复竞争一种资源，该资源的个体偏好或紧急性是时变且随机的。该研究还比较了不同Karma竞价方案（如简单的二元Karma竞价方案）的效果。
results: 证实Karma在没有事先训练的人群中具有显著且持续的福利效益。研究发现，在偶发的、高紧急性的情境下，机制使用更为频繁，并且实施为简单的（二元的）Karma竞价方案对福利改善特别有效，实现了相对较大的、几乎是帕累托最优的总体效率提升。
conclusion: 这些发现为未来对该机制的进一步测试和在现实世界中实施此类机制的计划提供了指导。

title: Interpretability by Design for Efficient Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
authors: Qiyue Xia, Tianwei Wang, J. Michael Herrmann
abstract: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) aims at optimising several, often conflicting goals to improve the flexibility and reliability of RL in practical tasks. This is typically achieved by finding a set of diverse, non-dominated policies that form a Pareto front in the performance space. We introduce LLE-MORL, an approach that achieves interpretability by design by utilising a training scheme based on the local relationship between the parameter space and the performance space. By exploiting a locally linear map between these spaces, our method provides an interpretation of policy parameters in terms of the objectives, and this structured representation enables an efficient search within contiguous solution domains, allowing for the rapid generation of high-quality solutions without extensive retraining. Experiments across diverse continuous control domains demonstrate that LLE-MORL consistently achieves higher Pareto front quality and efficiency than state-of-the-art approaches.

title: Learning and Communication Towards Unanimous Consent
authors: Yingkai Li, Boli Xu
abstract: A principal and an agent can launch a project under unanimous consent. Their individual payoffs from the project depend on an underlying state, and the agent privately knows his own preference. The principal can conduct a test to learn about the state and then communicate with the agent, but has limited commitment, as she may misreport her findings. We show that limited commitment makes binary tests optimal. Moreover, when players' preferences are positively aligned, the optimal test is a threshold test. When their preferences are negatively aligned, the optimal test is either an interval test or a tail test, depending on the agent's relative risk attitude. Additionally, the principal can benefit from screening the agent through a menu of tests, which admits a simple structure regardless of the complexity of the agent's type space.

title: Evaluating S-Band Interference: Impact of Satellite Systems on Terrestrial Networks
authors: Lingrui Zhang, Zheng Li, Sheng Yang
abstract: The co-existence of terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) is essential for achieving global coverage in sixth-generation cellular networks. Due to increasing spectrum demand, there is discussion in the world level to share some frequencies used in terrestrial Networks (TNs) with NTNs, resulting in co-channel interference and performance degradation. This paper analyzes the interference caused by satellite networks on TN in the S-band. We examined the transmission mechanisms of satellite signals and conducted simulations to evaluate interference intensity across varying slant ranges. Our findings indicate that the angle between the user equipment direction and the sub-satellite point direction from the beam center significantly impacts the interference level.
comment: This submission is withdrawn because it duplicates arXiv:2501.05462, which should be considered the authoritative version

title: Geometry and Dress groups with non-symmetric cost functions
authors: Lukas Silvester Barth, Parvaneh Joharinad, Jürgen Jost, Walter Wenzel
abstract: A metric relation by definition is symmetric. Since many data sets are non-symmetric, in this paper we develop a systematic theory of non-symmetric cost functions. Betweenness relations play an important role. We also introduce the notion of a Dress group in the non-symmetric setting and indicate a notion of curvature.

title: Phase-Only Positioning in Distributed MIMO Under Phase Impairments: AP Selection Using Deep Learning
authors: Fatih Ayten, Musa Furkan Keskin, Akshay Jain, Mehmet C. Ilter, Ossi Kaltiokallio, Jukka Talvitie, Elena Simona Lohan, Mikko Valkama
abstract: Carrier phase positioning (CPP) can enable cm-level accuracy in next-generation wireless systems, while recent literature shows that accuracy remains high using phase-only measurements in distributed MIMO (D-MIMO). However, the impact of phase synchronization errors on such systems remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we first show that the proposed hyperbola intersection method achieves highly accurate positioning even in the presence of phase synchronization errors, when trained on appropriate data reflecting such impairments. We then introduce a deep learning (DL)-based D-MIMO antenna point (AP) selection framework that ensures high-precision localization under phase synchronization errors. Simulation results show that the proposed framework improves positioning accuracy compared to prior-art methods, while reducing inference complexity by approximately 19.7%.
zh_title: 分布式MIMO中存在相位损伤时的纯相位定位：使用深度学习的AP选择
translation: 载波相位定位（CPP）可以在下一代无线系统中实现厘米级的精度，而最近的文献表明，在分布式MIMO（D-MIMO）中使用纯相位测量仍能保持高精度。然而，相位同步错误对此类系统的影响仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这一差距，我们首先展示了所提出的双曲线交叉方法，即使在存在相位同步错误的情况下，如果使用反映此类损伤的适当数据进行训练，也能实现高精度定位。然后，我们引入了一个基于深度学习（DL）的D-MIMO天线点（AP）选择框架，以确保在相位同步错误下实现高精度定位。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架与现有技术方法相比，提高了定位精度，同时将推理复杂度降低了约19.7%。
tldr: 针对分布式MIMO中相位同步错误影响下的纯相位定位问题，本文提出了一种基于深度学习的AP选择框架，结合改进的双曲线交叉方法，在保持高定位精度的同时，降低了计算复杂度。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将深度学习应用于D-MIMO纯相位定位中的AP选择，以主动应对现实中难以避免的相位同步错误问题。通过结合改进的定位算法（双曲线交叉法）和DL驱动的选择机制，该方法有效地解决了纯相位测量在实际部署中的主要挑战，即对相位误差的敏感性。同时，其在提高精度的同时显著降低了复杂度（19.7%），这对于下一代无线系统（如6G）中对实时性和资源效率有严格要求的厘米级定位应用具有重要的实际价值。
motivation: 尽管现有研究表明分布式MIMO（D-MIMO）中的纯相位测量可以实现高精度定位，但相位同步错误（相位损伤）对这类系统的影响尚未得到充分探索，这是本文研究的动机。
method: 1. 提出了一种改进的“双曲线交叉方法”（hyperbola intersection method），该方法使用反映相位损伤的适当数据进行训练，以在存在相位同步错误时实现高精度定位。2. 引入了一个基于深度学习（DL）的D-MIMO天线点（AP）选择框架，以确保在相位同步错误下实现高精度定位。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提出的框架与现有技术方法相比，提高了定位精度，同时将推理复杂度降低了约19.7%。

title: A physics-based data-driven model for CO$_2$ gas diffusion electrodes to drive automated laboratories
authors: Ivan Grega, Félix Therrien, Abhishek Soni, Karry Ocean, Kevan Dettelbach, Ribwar Ahmadi, Mehrdad Mokhtari, Curtis P. Berlinguette, Yoshua Bengio
abstract: The electrochemical reduction of atmospheric CO$_2$ into high-energy molecules with renewable energy is a promising avenue for energy storage that can take advantage of existing infrastructure especially in areas where sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels do not exist. Automated laboratories are currently being developed and used to optimize the composition and operating conditions of gas diffusion electrodes (GDEs), the device in which this reaction takes place. Improving the efficiency of GDEs is crucial for this technology to become viable. Here we present a modeling framework to efficiently explore the high-dimensional parameter space of GDE designs in an active learning context. At the core of the framework is an uncertainty-aware physics model calibrated with experimental data. The model has the flexibility to capture various input parameter spaces and any carbon products which can be modeled with Tafel kinetics. It is interpretable, and a Gaussian process layer can capture deviations of real data from the function space of the physical model itself. We deploy the model in a simulated active learning setup with real electrochemical data gathered by the AdaCarbon automated laboratory and show that it can be used to efficiently traverse the multi-dimensional parameter space.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Published as a conference paper in ICLR2025 AI4Mat workshop

title: Diffusion-aided Extreme Video Compression with Lightweight Semantics Guidance
authors: Maojun Zhang, Haotian Wu, Richeng Jin, Deniz Gunduz, Krystian Mikolajczyk
abstract: Modern video codecs and learning-based approaches struggle for semantic reconstruction at extremely low bit-rates due to reliance on low-level spatiotemporal redundancies. Generative models, especially diffusion models, offer a new paradigm for video compression by leveraging high-level semantic understanding and powerful visual synthesis. This paper propose a video compression framework that integrates generative priors to drastically reduce bit-rate while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. Specifically, our method compresses high-level semantic representations of the video, then uses a conditional diffusion model to reconstruct frames from these semantics. To further improve compression, we characterize motion information with global camera trajectories and foreground segmentation: background motion is compactly represented by camera pose parameters while foreground dynamics by sparse segmentation masks. This allows for significantly boosts compression efficiency, enabling descent video reconstruction at extremely low bit-rates.
zh_title: 扩散模型辅助的极限视频压缩与轻量级语义指导
translation: 现代视频编解码器和基于学习的方法由于依赖低级时空冗余，在极低比特率下难以进行语义重建。生成模型，尤其是扩散模型，通过利用高级语义理解和强大的视觉合成能力，为视频压缩提供了一种新范式。本文提出了一种视频压缩框架，该框架集成了生成先验，以在大幅降低比特率的同时保持重建保真度。具体来说，我们的方法压缩视频的高级语义表示，然后使用条件扩散模型从这些语义中重建帧。为了进一步提高压缩效率，我们使用全局相机轨迹和前景分割来表征运动信息：背景运动由相机姿态参数紧凑地表示，而前景动态由稀疏分割掩码表示。这极大地提高了压缩效率，使得在极低比特率下也能实现良好的视频重建。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的视频压缩框架，通过压缩高级语义表示和利用轻量级运动（全局相机轨迹和前景分割）指导条件扩散模型，实现了在极低比特率下的高效视频重建。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将扩散模型的强大生成能力与视频压缩任务相结合，尤其是在处理极限低比特率场景中现有方法（传统编解码器或基于学习的方法）的语义重建缺陷。通过将视频信息分解为可压缩的高级语义（用于重建）和轻量级运动信息（用于指导），该方法有效地分离了内容表示和细节合成，是视频压缩领域的一个重要范式转变。其局限性可能在于扩散模型的计算成本和训练复杂性，以及语义表示的提取和量化精度对最终重建质量的影响。
motivation: 现有的视频编码器和基于学习的方法在极低比特率下难以进行语义重建，因为它们依赖于低级时空冗余。需要利用生成模型（尤其是扩散模型）的高级语义理解和强大的视觉合成能力来克服这一挑战。
method: 提出一个集成了生成先验的视频压缩框架。具体方法是：首先压缩视频的高级语义表示，然后使用条件扩散模型从这些语义中重建帧。为进一步提高压缩效率，使用全局相机轨迹紧凑地表示背景运动，并通过稀疏分割掩码表示前景动态。
results: 显著提升了压缩效率，能够在极低比特率下实现可接受的视频重建。

title: Personalized White Matter Bundle Segmentation for Early Childhood
authors: Elyssa M. McMaster, Michael E. Kim, Nancy R. Newlin, Gaurav Rudravaram, Adam M. Saunders, Aravind R. Krishnan, Jongyeon Yoon, Ji S. Kim, Bryce L. Geeraert, Meaghan V. Perdue, Catherine Lebel, Daniel Moyer, Kurt G. Schilling, Laurie E. Cutting, Bennett A. Landman
abstract: White matter segmentation methods from diffusion magnetic resonance imaging range from streamline clustering-based approaches to bundle mask delineation, but none have proposed a pediatric-specific approach. We hypothesize that a deep learning model with a similar approach to TractSeg will improve similarity between an algorithm-generated mask and an expert-labeled ground truth. Given a cohort of 56 manually labelled white matter bundles, we take inspiration from TractSeg's 2D UNet architecture, and we modify inputs to match bundle definitions as determined by pediatric experts, evaluation to use k fold cross validation, the loss function to masked Dice loss. We evaluate Dice score, volume overlap, and volume overreach of 16 major regions of interest compared to the expert labeled dataset. To test whether our approach offers statistically significant improvements over TractSeg, we compare Dice voxels, volume overlap, and adjacency voxels with a Wilcoxon signed rank test followed by false discovery rate correction. We find statistical significance across all bundles for all metrics with one exception in volume overlap. After we run TractSeg and our model, we combine their output masks into a 60 label atlas to evaluate if TractSeg and our model combined can generate a robust, individualized atlas, and observe smoothed, continuous masks in cases that TractSeg did not produce an anatomically plausible output. With the improvement of white matter pathway segmentation masks, we can further understand neurodevelopment on a population level scale, and we can produce reliable estimates of individualized anatomy in pediatric white matter diseases and disorders.
zh_title: 早期儿童个性化白质束分割
translation: 扩散磁共振成像的白质分割方法从基于流线聚类的方法到束掩膜描绘不等，但没有一种提出儿科特异性方法。我们假设一种采用与TractSeg类似方法的深度学习模型将改善算法生成的掩膜与专家标记的地面真值之间的相似性。鉴于一个包含56个手动标记白质束的队列，我们从TractSeg的2D UNet架构中获得灵感，并修改输入以匹配儿科专家确定的束定义，评估使用k折交叉验证，损失函数为掩膜Dice损失。我们评估了16个主要感兴趣区域的Dice分数、体积重叠和体积超限，并与专家标记数据集进行比较。为了测试我们的方法是否比TractSeg提供统计学上的显著改进，我们使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验，然后进行错误发现率校正，比较了Dice体素、体积重叠和邻接体素。我们发现除了一个体积重叠指标外，所有束的所有指标都具有统计学意义。在我们运行TractSeg和我们的模型后，我们将它们的输出掩膜组合成一个60标签图谱，以评估TractSeg和我们的模型结合是否能生成一个鲁棒的、个性化的图谱，并观察到在TractSeg没有产生解剖学上合理输出的情况下，掩膜是平滑、连续的。随着白质通路分割掩膜的改进，我们可以在人群层面进一步理解神经发育，并为儿童白质疾病和障碍提供可靠的个体化解剖结构估计。
tldr: 提出并验证了一种基于深度学习的儿童特异性白质束分割方法，相较于TractSeg有显著改进，能生成更可靠的个体化图谱。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次提出了针对儿科的白质束分割深度学习方法，填补了现有方法在儿童特异性方面的空白。通过对TractSeg模型的改进和优化，并在大量手动标记数据上进行验证，证明了其优越性。这对于儿童神经发育研究和儿科疾病诊断具有重要意义。未来的工作可以探索更大规模的数据集和更复杂的网络结构以进一步提高精度和泛化能力。
motivation: 现有的白质分割方法缺乏儿童特异性方法。作者假设一种采用与TractSeg类似方法的深度学习模型可以改善算法生成的掩膜与专家标记的地面真值之间的相似性，尤其是在儿童数据上。
method: 本研究基于TractSeg的2D UNet架构，修改输入以匹配儿科专家确定的束定义，使用56个手动标记的白质束作为训练队列。评估采用k折交叉验证，损失函数为掩膜Dice损失。通过Dice分数、体积重叠和体积超限来评估16个主要感兴趣区域。通过Wilcoxon符号秩检验和FDR校正与TractSeg进行统计学比较，并结合TractSeg和新模型的输出掩膜生成60标签图谱。
results: 除了一个体积重叠指标外，所有白质束在所有指标上都具有统计学意义上的显著改进。结合TractSeg和新模型的输出掩膜，在TractSeg未能产生解剖学上合理输出的情况下，产生了平滑、连续的掩膜。
conclusion: 改进的白质通路分割掩膜有助于在人群层面理解神经发育，并为儿童白质疾病和障碍提供可靠的个体化解剖结构估计。

title: Exterior sound field estimation based on physics-constrained kernel
authors: Juliano G. C. Ribeiro, Ryo Matsuda, Jorge Trevino
abstract: Exterior sound field interpolation is a challenging problem that often requires specific array configurations and prior knowledge on the source conditions. We propose an interpolation method based on Gaussian processes using a point source reproducing kernel with a trainable inner product formulation made to fit exterior sound fields. While this estimation does not have a closed formula, it allows for the definition of a flexible estimator that is not restricted by microphone distribution and attenuates higher harmonic orders automatically with parameters directly optimized from the recordings, meaning an arbitrary distribution of microphones can be used. The proposed kernel estimator is compared in simulated experiments to the conventional method using spherical wave functions and an established physics-informed machine learning model, achieving lower interpolation error by approximately 2 dB on average within the analyzed frequencies of 100 Hz and 2.5 kHz and reconstructing the ground truth sound field more consistently within the target region.
comment: This paper has been accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026
zh_title: 基于物理约束核的外场声场估计
translation: 外部声场插值是一个具有挑战性的问题，通常需要特定的阵列配置和对声源条件的先验知识。我们提出了一种基于高斯过程的插值方法，使用具有可训练内积公式的点源再现核来拟合外部声场。虽然这种估计没有闭式解，但它允许定义一个灵活的估计器，不受麦克风分布的限制，并自动衰减高阶谐波，其参数直接从记录中优化，这意味着可以使用任意分布的麦克风。所提出的核估计器与使用球波函数的传统方法和已建立的物理信息机器学习模型在模拟实验中进行了比较，在100 Hz至2.5 kHz的分析频率范围内平均降低了约2 dB的插值误差，并在目标区域内更一致地重建了真实声场。
tldr: 提出了一种新的基于高斯过程和物理约束核的声场插值方法，它不需要特定的麦克风阵列布局，并且在与传统方法和物理信息机器学习模型相比时，表现出更低的插值误差。
ai_comments: 该方法的主要创新在于使用可训练的内积公式化的点源再现核（point source reproducing kernel）来进行高斯过程插值，这使得估计器具有灵活性，不受麦克风阵列配置的限制，并能自动衰减高阶谐波。其重要性在于解决了传统方法对阵列配置和声源先验知识的依赖性。限制方面，方法没有闭式解。
motivation: 外部声场插值是一个具有挑战性的问题，通常需要特定的阵列配置和对声源条件的先验知识。
method: 提出了一种基于高斯过程的插值方法，使用具有可训练内积公式的点源再现核来拟合外部声场。该方法通过优化记录参数来自动衰减高阶谐波。
results: 与使用球波函数的传统方法和已建立的物理信息机器学习模型相比，所提出的核估计器在100 Hz至2.5 kHz的分析频率范围内平均降低了约2 dB的插值误差，并在目标区域内更一致地重建了真实声场。

title: A Migration-Assisted Deep Learning Scheme for Imaging Defects Inside Cylindrical Structures via GPR: A Case Study for Tree Trunks
authors: Jiwei Qian, Yee Hui Lee, Kaixuan Cheng, Qiqi Dai, Arda Yalcinkaya, Mohamed Lokman Mohd Yusof, James Wang, Abdulkadir C. Yucel
abstract: Ground-penetrating radar (GPR) has emerged as a prominent tool for imaging internal defects in cylindrical structures, such as columns, utility poles, and tree trunks. However, accurately reconstructing both the shape and permittivity of the defects inside cylindrical structures remains challenging due to complex wave scattering phenomena and the limited accuracy of the existing signal processing and deep learning techniques. To address these issues, this study proposes a migration-assisted deep learning scheme for reconstructing the shape and permittivity of defects within cylindrical structures. The proposed scheme involves three stages of GPR data processing. First, a dual-permittivity estimation network extracts the permittivity values of the defect and the cylindrical structure, the latter of which is estimated with the help of a novel structural similarity index measure-based autofocusing technique. Second, a modified Kirchhoff migration incorporating the extracted permittivity of the cylindrical structure maps the signals reflected from the defect to the imaging domain. Third, a shape reconstruction network processes the migrated image to recover the precise shape of the defect. The image of the interior defect is finally obtained by combining the reconstructed shape and extracted permittivity of the defect. The proposed scheme is validated using both synthetic and experimental data from a laboratory trunk model and real tree trunk samples. Comparative results show superior performance over existing deep learning methods, while generalization tests on live trees confirm its feasibility for in-field deployment. The underlying principle can further be applied to other circumferential GPR imaging scenarios. The code and database are available at: https://github.com/jwqian54/Migration-Assisted-DL.

title: Beamformed Fingerprint-Based Transformer Network for Trajectory Estimation and Path Determination in Outdoor mmWave MIMO Systems
authors: Mohammad Shamsesalehi, Mahmoud Ahmadian Attari, Mohammad Amin Maleki Sadr, Benoit Champagne
abstract: Radio transmissions in millimeter wave (mmWave) bands have gained significant interest for applications demanding precise device localization and trajectory estimation. This paper explores novel neural network (NN) architectures suitable for trajectory estimation and path determination in a mmWave multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) outdoor system based on localization data from beamformed fingerprint (BFF). The NN architecture captures sequences of BFF signals from different users, and through the application of learning mechanisms, subsequently estimate their trajectories. In turn, this information is employed to find the shortest path to the target, thereby enabling more efficient navigation. Specifically, we propose a two-stage procedure for trajectory estimation and optimal path finding. In the first stage, a transformer network (TN) based on attention mechanisms is developed to predict trajectories of wireless devices using BFF sequences captured in a mmWave MIMO outdoor system. In the second stage, a novel algorithm based on Informed Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (iRRT*) is employed to determine the optimal path to target locations using trajectory estimates derived in the first stage. The effectiveness of the proposed schemes is validated through numerical experiments, using a comprehensive dataset of radio measurements, generated using ray tracing simulations to model outdoor propagation at 28 GHz. We show that our proposed TN-based trajectory estimator outperforms other methods from the recent literature and can successfully generalize to new trajectories outside the training set. Furthermore, our proposed iRRT* algorithm is able to consistently provide the shortest path to the target.

title: Physics-Aware Tensor Reconstruction for Radio Maps in Pixel-Based Fluid Antenna Systems
authors: Mu Jia, Hao Sun, Junting Chen, Pooi-Yuen Kam
abstract: The deployment of pixel-based antennas and fluid antenna systems (FAS) is hindered by prohibitive channel state information (CSI) acquisition overhead. While radio maps enable proactive mode selection, reconstructing high-fidelity maps from sparse measurements is challenging. Existing physics-agnostic or data-driven methods often fail to recover fine-grained shadowing details under extreme sparsity. We propose a Physics-Regularized Low-Rank Tensor Completion (PR-LRTC) framework for radio map reconstruction. By modeling the signal field as a three-way tensor, we integrate environmental low-rankness with deterministic antenna physics. Specifically, we leverage Effective Aerial Degrees-of-Freedom (EADoF) theory to derive a differential gain topology map as a physical prior for regularization. The resulting optimization problem is solved via an efficient Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm. Simulations show that PR-LRTC achieves a 4 dB gain over baselines at a 10% sampling ratio. It effectively preserves sharp shadowing edges, providing a robust, physics-compliant solution for low-overhead beam management.

title: Depth estimation of a monoharmonic source using a vertical linear array at fixed distance
authors: Yangjin Xu, Wei Gao, Xiaolei Li, Qinghang Zeng
abstract: Estimating the depth of a monoharmonic sound source at a fixed range using a vertical linear array (VLA) is challenging in the absence of seabed environmental parameters, and relevant research remains scarce. The orthogonality constrained modal search based depth estimation (OCMS-D) method is proposed in this paper, which enables the estimation of the depth of a monoharmonic source at a fixed range using a VLA under unknown seabed parameters. Using the sparsity of propagating normal modes and the orthogonality of mode depth functions, OCMS-D estimates the normal mode parameters under a fixed source-array distance at first. The estimated normal mode parameters are then used to estimate the source depth. To ensure the precision of the source depth estimation, the method utilizes information on both the amplitude distribution and the sign (positive/negative) patterns of the estimated mode depth functions at the inferred source depth. Numerical simulations evaluate the performance of OCMS-D under different conditions. The effectiveness of OCMS-D is also verified by the Yellow Sea experiment and the SWellEx-96 experiment. In the Yellow Sea experiment, the depth estimation absolute errors by OCMS-D with a 4-second time window are less than 2.4 m. And the depth estimation absolute errors in the SWellEx-96 experiment with a 10-second time window are less than 5.4 m for the shallow source and less than 10.8 m for the deep source.

title: Joint Optimization of Latency and Accuracy for Split Federated Learning in User-Centric Cell-Free MIMO Networks
authors: Zitong Wang, Cheng Zhang, Wen Wang, Shuigen Yang, Haiming Wang, Yongming Huang
abstract: This paper proposes a user-centric split federated learning (UCSFL) framework for user-centric cell-free multiple-input multiple-output (CF-MIMO) networks to support split federated learning (SFL). In the proposed UCSFL framework, users deploy split sub-models locally, while complete models are maintained and updated at access point (AP)-side distributed processing units (DPUs), followed by a two-level aggregation procedure across DPUs and the central processing unit (CPU). Under standard machine learning (ML) assumptions, we provide a theoretical convergence analysis for UCSFL, which reveals that the AP-cluster size is a key factor influencing model training accuracy. Motivated by this result, we introduce a new performance metric, termed the latency-to-accuracy ratio, defined as the ratio of a user's per-iteration training latency to the weighted size of its AP cluster. Based on this metric, we formulate a joint optimization problem to minimize the maximum latency-to-accuracy ratio by jointly optimizing uplink power control, downlink beamforming, model splitting, and AP clustering. The resulting problem is decomposed into two sub-problems operating on different time scales, for which dedicated algorithms are developed to handle the short-term and long-term optimizations, respectively. Simulation results verify the convergence of the proposed algorithms and demonstrate that UCSFL effectively reduces the latency-to-accuracy ratio of the VGG16 model compared with baseline schemes. Moreover, the proposed framework adaptively adjusts splitting and clustering strategies in response to varying communication and computation resources. An MNIST-based handwritten digit classification example further shows that UCSFL significantly accelerates the convergence of the VGG16 model.

title: Physics-Inspired Target Shape Detection and Reconstruction in mmWave Communication Systems
authors: Ziqing Xing, Zhaoyang Zhang, Xin Tong, Zhaohui Yang, Chongwen Huang
abstract: The integration of sensing and communication (ISAC) is an essential function of future wireless systems. Due to its large available bandwidth, millimeter-wave (mmWave) ISAC systems are able to achieve high sensing accuracy. In this paper, we consider the multiple base-station (BS) collaborative sensing problem in a multi-input multi-output (MIMO) orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) mmWave communication system. Our aim is to sense a remote target shape with the collected signals which consist of both the reflection and scattering signals. We first characterize the mmWave's scattering and reflection effects based on the Lambertian scattering model. Then we apply the periodogram technique to obtain rough scattering point detection, and further incorporate the subspace method to achieve more precise scattering and reflection point detection. Based on these, a reconstruction algorithm based on Hough Transform and principal component analysis (PCA) is designed for a single convex polygon target scenario. To improve the accuracy and completeness of the reconstruction results, we propose a method to further fuse the scattering and reflection points. Extensive simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

title: Zero-Shot TTS With Enhanced Audio Prompts: Bsc Submission For The 2026 Wildspoof Challenge TTS Track
authors: Jose Giraldo, Alex Peiró-Lilja, Rodolfo Zevallos, Cristina España-Bonet
abstract: We evaluate two non-autoregressive architectures, StyleTTS2 and F5-TTS, to address the spontaneous nature of in-the-wild speech. Our models utilize flexible duration modeling to improve prosodic naturalness. To handle acoustic noise, we implement a multi-stage enhancement pipeline using the Sidon model, which significantly outperforms standard Demucs in signal quality. Experimental results show that finetuning enhanced audios yields superior robustness, achieving up to 4.21 UTMOS and 3.47 DNSMOS. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of reference prompt quality and length on zero-shot synthesis performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach for realistic speech generation.

title: IDSOR: Intensity- and Distance-Aware Statistical Outlier Removal for Weather-Robust LiDAR Point Clouds
authors: Chenyang Yan, Mats Bengtsson
abstract: LiDAR point clouds captured in rain or snow are often corrupted by weather-induced returns, which can degrade perception and safety-critical scene understanding. This paper proposes Intensity- and Distance-Aware Statistical Outlier Removal (IDSOR), a range-adaptive filtering method that jointly exploits intensity cues and neighborhood sparsity. By incorporating an empirical, range-dependent distribution of weather returns into the threshold design, IDSOR suppresses weather-induced points while preserving fine structural details without cumbersome manual parameter tuning. We also propose a variant that uses a previously proposed method to estimate the weather return distribution from data, and integrates it into IDSOR. Experiments on simulation-augmented level-crossing measurements and on the Winter Adverse Driving dataset (WADS) demonstrate that IDSOR achieves a favorable precision-recall trade-off, maintaining both precision and recall above 90% on WADS.

title: Sound Field Estimation Using Optimal Transport Barycenters in the Presence of Phase Errors
authors: Yuyang Liu, Johan Karlsson, Filip Elvander
abstract: This study introduces a novel approach for estimating plane-wave coefficients in sound field reconstruction, specifically addressing challenges posed by error-in-variable phase perturbations. Such systematic errors typically arise from sensor mis-calibration, including uncertainties in sensor positions and response characteristics, leading to measurement-induced phase shifts in plane wave coefficients. Traditional methods often result in biased estimates or non-convex solutions. To overcome these issues, we propose an optimal transport (OT) framework. This framework operates on a set of lifted non-negative measures that correspond to observation-dependent shifted coefficients relative to the unperturbed ones. By applying OT, the supports of the measures are transported toward an optimal average in the phase space, effectively morphing them into an indistinguishable state. This optimal average, known as barycenter, is linked to the estimated plane-wave coefficients using the same lifting rule. The framework addresses the ill-posed nature of the problem, due to the large number of plane waves, by adding a constant to the ground cost, ensuring the sparsity of the transport matrix. Convex consistency of the solution is maintained. Simulation results confirm that our proposed method provides more accurate coefficient estimations compared to baseline approaches in scenarios with both additive noise and phase perturbations.

title: Self-Portrait of the Focusing Process in Speckle: III. Tailoring Complex Spatio-Temporal Focusing Laws To Overcome Reverberations in Reflection Imaging
authors: Elsa Giraudat, Flavien Bureau, William Lambert, Mathias Fink, Alexandre Aubry
abstract: This is the third article in a series of three dealing with the exploitation of speckle for imaging purposes. In complex media, a fundamental limit is the multiple scattering phenomenon that completely blurs the imaging process in depth. Matrix imaging can provide a relevant framework for solving this problem. As it proved to be an adequate tool for probing reverberations in speckle [E. Giraudat et al., Part I], we will show how it can be used to tailor complex spatio-temporal focusing laws to monitor the interference between the multiply-reflected paths and the ballistic component of the wave-field. To do so, we extend the distortion matrix concept to the frequency domain. An iterative phase reversal process operated from the space-time Fourier space is then used to compensate for reverberations and optimize both the axial and transverse resolution of the confocal image. Here, we first present an experimental proof-of-concept consisting in imaging a tissue-mimicking phantom through a reverberating plate before outlining the potential and the limits of this strategy for transcranial ultrasound and beyond.

title: Physics-Informed Diffusion Models for Vehicle Speed Trajectory Generation
authors: Vadim Sokolov, Farnaz Behnia, Dominik Karbowski
abstract: Synthetic vehicle speed trajectory generation is essential for evaluating vehicle control algorithms and connected vehicle technologies. Traditional Markov chain approaches suffer from discretization artifacts and limited expressiveness. This paper proposes a physics-informed diffusion framework for conditional micro-trip synthesis, combining a dual-channel speed-acceleration representation with soft physics constraints that resolve optimization conflicts inherent to hard-constraint formulations. We compare a 1D U-Net architecture against a transformer-based Conditional Score-based Diffusion Imputation (CSDI) model using 6,367 GPS-derived micro-trips. CSDI achieves superior distribution matching (Wasserstein distance 0.30 for speed, 0.026 for acceleration), strong indistinguishability from real data (discriminative score 0.49), and validated utility for downstream energy assessment tasks. The methodology enables scalable generation of realistic driving profiles for intelligent transportation systems (ITS) applications without costly field data collection.
zh_title: 面向车辆速度轨迹生成的物理信息扩散模型
translation: 合成车辆速度轨迹对于评估车辆控制算法和联网车辆技术至关重要。传统的马尔可夫链方法存在离散化伪影和表达能力有限的缺点。本文提出了一种用于条件微观行程合成的物理信息扩散框架，它结合了双通道的速度-加速度表示和软物理约束，解决了硬约束公式固有的优化冲突。我们将1D U-Net架构与基于Transformer的条件分数扩散插补（CSDI）模型进行了比较，使用了6,367个GPS衍生的微观行程。CSDI在分布匹配上实现了更优的结果（速度的Wasserstein距离为0.30，加速度为0.026），与真实数据具有很强的不可区分性（判别得分0.49），并验证了其在下游能源评估任务中的效用。该方法能够为智能交通系统（ITS）应用可扩展地生成真实的驾驶特征，而无需昂贵的现场数据收集。
tldr: 提出了一种物理信息扩散模型（CSDI）用于生成车辆速度轨迹，它使用软物理约束，在匹配真实驾驶数据分布方面优于传统方法，可用于ITS应用。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将物理信息融入扩散模型，以解决传统方法在车辆轨迹生成中存在的局限性。使用软物理约束而非硬约束是一个关键的改进，它解决了优化冲突问题。结果表明CSDI模型在分布匹配和数据真实性方面优于U-Net。该方法对智能交通系统（ITS）的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 合成车辆速度轨迹对于评估车辆控制算法和联网车辆技术至关重要，而传统的马尔可夫链方法存在离散化伪影和表达能力有限的缺点。
method: 提出了一种结合双通道速度-加速度表示和软物理约束的物理信息扩散框架，用于条件微观行程合成。将1D U-Net架构与基于Transformer的条件分数扩散插补（CSDI）模型进行比较。
results: CSDI模型在分布匹配上表现更优（速度的Wasserstein距离为0.30，加速度为0.026），与真实数据的不可区分性强（判别得分0.49），并验证了其在下游能源评估任务中的效用。
conclusion: 该方法能够实现对真实驾驶特征的可扩展生成，从而避免了昂贵的现场数据收集，可用于智能交通系统（ITS）应用。

title: Self-Portrait of the Focusing Process in Speckle: II. Gouy Phase Shift for Defocus Correction and Pixel Depth Reassignment
authors: Flavien Bureau, Emma Brenner, Naiara Korta Martiartu, Elsa Giraudat, Arthur Le Ber, William Lambert, Louis Carmier, Aymeric Guibal, Mathias Fink, Alexandre Aubry
abstract: This is the second article in a series of three dealing with the exploitation of speckle for aberration correction and reverberation compensation in reflection imaging. When probing heterogeneous media with waves, we have to cope with multi-scale fluctuations of the wave velocity. On the one hand, short-scale heterogeneities induce back-scattered echoes whose random interference generate a speckle pattern on the beamformed image. On the other hand, large-scale fluctuations of the wave-velocity can distort the focused wave-fronts, resulting in aberrations on the same image. In this paper, we show how the self-portrait of the wave evolves as a function of the speed-of-sound model. Strikingly, a Gouy phase shift is observed when the speed-of-sound model is optimal. This particularly sensitive feature enables: (i) an optimization of the speed-of-sound model for each pixel of the image; (ii) a local and fine compensation of defocus across the field-of-view, thereby compensating for most aberrations in the image. Experiment in a tissue-mimicking phantom and numerical simulations are first presented to validate our method. It is then applied to in-vivo liver data of a difficult-to-image patient. The speed-of-sound optimization allows an axial compensation of aberrations and a depth-reassignment of each singly-scattered echo to the actual position of the associated scatterer. As distance measurement is often critical for diagnosis, such a wave speed optimization can be crucial for ultrasound but also for any other imaging methods based on the principle of echo-location.
zh_title: 散斑聚焦过程的自画像：II. 用于散焦校正和像素深度重分配的古依相移
translation: 这是处理反射成像中利用散斑进行像差校正和混响补偿的三个系列文章中的第二篇。当用波探测异质介质时，我们必须应对波速的多尺度波动。一方面，短尺度异质性诱导的后向散射回波的随机干涉会在波束形成图像上产生散斑图样。另一方面，大尺度的波速波动会扭曲聚焦波前，导致同一图像上出现像差。在本文中，我们展示了波的自画像如何随声速模型演变。引人注目的是，当声速模型最优时，观察到了古依相移。这种特别敏感的特征使得：（i）可以对图像的每个像素进行声速模型优化；（ii）在整个视场内进行局部和精细的散焦补偿，从而补偿图像中的大多数像差。首先介绍了在组织模拟体模中的实验和数值模拟来验证我们的方法。然后将其应用于难以成像患者的活体肝脏数据。声速优化允许对像差进行轴向补偿，并将每个单次散射回波深度重新分配到相关散射体的实际位置。由于距离测量通常对诊断至关重要，因此这种波速优化对于超声以及任何其他基于回波定位原理的成像方法都至关重要。
tldr: 利用散斑成像中出现的古依相移，可以精确优化局部声速模型，从而补偿像差和散焦，并准确地重新分配像素深度，这对于超声和回波定位方法至关重要。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将古依相移（Gouy Phase Shift）这一物理现象引入到成像系统的校正中。古依相移通常与波束聚焦的几何特性相关，其在最优声速模型下被观测到，为局部声速优化提供了一个极其敏感且内在的指标。这使得该方法能够实现像素级别的散焦补偿和精确的轴向深度重分配，解决了传统成像方法中由于介质非均匀性导致的像差和距离测量不准确的关键问题。对于依赖精确距离测量的诊断工具（如超声）而言，这是一个重要的进步。
motivation: 解决反射成像中，波在异质介质中传播时，大尺度波速波动导致的波前畸变和像差问题。本文旨在利用散斑效应进行像差校正和混响补偿。
method: 监测波的“自画像”如何随声速模型变化。发现当声速模型最优时，会出现敏感的古依相移（Gouy Phase Shift）。利用这一特征，对图像的每个像素进行声速模型优化，实现局部、精细的散焦补偿，从而校正大多数像差。
results: 通过组织模拟体模实验和数值模拟验证了方法。应用于难以成像患者的活体肝脏数据，实现了像差的轴向补偿，并将每个单次散射回波的深度重新分配到相关散射体的实际位置。
conclusion: 这种基于古依相移的波速优化方法对于超声以及任何其他基于回波定位原理的成像方法至关重要，因为精确的距离测量对临床诊断至关重要。

title: Predictive Synthesis under Sporadic Participation: Evidence from Inflation Density Surveys
authors: Matthew C. Johnson, Matteo Luciani, Minzhengxiong Zhang, Kenichiro McAlinn
abstract: Central banks rely on density forecasts from professional surveys to assess inflation risks and communicate uncertainty. A central challenge in using these surveys is irregular participation: forecasters enter and exit, skip rounds, and reappear after long gaps. In the European Central Bank's Survey of Professional Forecasters, turnover and missingness vary substantially over time, causing the set of submitted predictions to change from quarter to quarter. Standard aggregation rules -- such as equal-weight pooling, renormalization after dropping missing forecasters, or ad hoc imputation -- can generate artificial jumps in combined predictions driven by panel composition rather than economic information, complicating real-time interpretation and obscuring forecaster performance. We develop coherent Bayesian updating rules for forecast combination under sporadic participation that maintain a well-defined latent predictive state for each forecaster even when their forecast is unobserved. Rather than relying on renormalization or imputation, the combined predictive distribution is updated through the implied conditional structure of the panel. This approach isolates genuine performance differences from mechanical participation effects and yields interpretable dynamics in forecaster influence. In the ECB survey, it improves predictive accuracy relative to equal-weight benchmarks and delivers smoother and better-calibrated inflation density forecasts, particularly during periods of high turnover.
zh_title: 预测性综合在零星参与下的应用：来自通胀密度调查的证据
translation: 中央银行依赖专业调查的密度预测来评估通胀风险和沟通不确定性。使用这些调查的一个核心挑战是参与的不规律性：预测者进出、跳过轮次，并在长时间间隔后重新出现。在欧洲中央银行的专业预测者调查中，人员流动和缺失情况随时间显著变化，导致提交的预测集合每季度都在变化。标准的聚合规则——例如等权重合并、在剔除缺失预测者后进行重整化，或临时的插补——可能会产生由面板构成而非经济信息驱动的组合预测的人为跳跃，从而干扰实时解读并掩盖预测者的绩效。我们开发了在零星参与下进行预测组合的连贯贝叶斯更新规则，即使在预测者缺席的情况下也能为每个预测者维护一个明确的潜在预测状态。该方法不依赖于重整化或插补，而是通过面板的隐含条件结构来更新组合预测分布。这种方法将真实的绩效差异与机械的参与效应分离开来，并产生可解释的预测者影响动态。在欧洲央行调查中，与等权重基准相比，它提高了预测准确性，并提供了更平滑、更准确的通胀密度预测，尤其是在高人员流动时期。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的贝叶斯更新规则，用于处理专业预测调查中预测者不规律参与的问题，以提高通胀预测的准确性和可解释性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决预测市场中一个长期存在的问题，即预测者参与的不规律性。通过使用贝叶斯更新规则，该方法能够更准确地捕捉经济动态，并区分真实的预测能力和由数据缺失引起的技术性偏差。其在欧洲央行调查中的应用结果令人鼓舞，表明该方法具有重要的实践意义。
motivation: 现有预测综合方法在处理预测者不规律参与（如进出、跳过轮次）时，可能会产生人为的跳跃，干扰对经济信息的解读和预测者绩效的评估。
method: 开发了连贯的贝叶斯更新规则，即使在预测者缺席的情况下也能维护其潜在的预测状态，并通过面板的隐含条件结构更新组合预测分布，而不是依赖重整化或插补。
results: 该方法在欧洲央行专业预测者调查中，相对于等权重基准提高了预测准确性，并在高流动性时期提供了更平滑、更准确的通胀密度预测。
conclusion: 提出的贝叶斯更新规则能够有效处理预测者零星参与的问题，分离真实的绩效差异和机械的参与效应，从而提供更可靠、更具可解释性的通胀预测。

title: Active Simulation-Based Inference for Scalable Car-Following Model Calibration
authors: Menglin Kong, Chengyuan Zhang, Lijun Sun
abstract: Credible microscopic traffic simulation requires car-following models that capture both the average response and the substantial variability observed across drivers and situations. However, most data-driven calibrations remain deterministic, producing a single best-fit parameter vector and offering limited guidance for uncertainty-aware prediction, risk-sensitive evaluation, and population-level simulation. Bayesian calibration addresses this gap by inferring a posterior distribution over parameters, but per-trajectory sampling methods such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) are computationally infeasible for modern large-scale naturalistic driving datasets. This paper proposes an active simulation-based inference framework for scalable car-following model calibration. The approach combines (i) a residual-augmented car-following simulator with two alternatives for the residual process and (ii) an amortized conditional density estimator that maps an observed leader--follower trajectory directly to a driver-specific posterior over model parameters with a single forward pass at test time. To reduce simulation cost during training, we introduce a joint active design strategy that selects informative parameter proposals together with representative driving contexts, focusing simulations where the current inference model is most uncertain while maintaining realism. Experiments on the HighD dataset show improved predictive accuracy and closer agreement between simulated and observed trajectory distributions relative to Bayesian calibration baselines, with convergence and ablation studies supporting the robustness of the proposed design choices. The framework enables scalable, uncertainty-aware driver population modeling for traffic flow simulation and risk-sensitive transportation analysis.
zh_title: 可扩展车辆跟随模型校准的主动模拟驱动推断框架
translation: 可信的微观交通仿真需要捕获跨驾驶员和情境的平均响应和显著可变性的跟车模型。然而，大多数数据驱动的校准仍然是确定性的，产生单一的最佳拟合参数向量，对不确定性感知的预测、风险敏感评估和群体级仿真提供的指导有限。贝叶斯校准通过对参数推断后验分布来解决这一差距，但像马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）这样的每轨迹采样方法对于现代大规模自然驾驶数据集来说计算上是不可行的。本文提出了一种用于可扩展车辆跟随模型校准的主动模拟驱动推断框架。该方法结合了（i）一个带有残差过程两种替代方案的残差增强车辆跟随模拟器和（ii）一个平均条件密度估计器，该估计器在测试时仅通过一次前向传播即可将观测到的领导者-跟随者轨迹直接映射到特定驾驶员的模型参数后验分布。为了在训练期间减少模拟成本，我们引入了一种联合主动设计策略，该策略与代表性驾驶情境一起选择信息丰富的参数提议，将模拟集中在当前推断模型最不确定的地方，同时保持真实性。在HighD数据集上的实验表明，与贝叶斯校准基线相比，预测准确性有所提高，并且模拟与观测到的轨迹分布之间的一致性更高，收敛性和消融研究支持了所提出设计选择的鲁棒性。该框架使得交通流仿真和风险敏感交通分析的可扩展、可感知不确定性的驾驶员群体建模成为可能。
tldr: 为了解决大规模交通数据下贝叶斯校准计算量过大的问题，本文设计了一个主动推断框架，它使用一个能快速输出后验分布的条件密度估计器，并通过主动选择最具信息量的模拟场景来降低训练成本，最终实现了更准确且可扩展的车辆跟随模型校准。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个结合残差增强模拟器和条件密度估计器的*主动*推断框架，解决了传统贝叶斯校准方法在大规模自然驾驶数据上计算不可行的问题。其主动设计策略有效地平衡了模拟成本和信息量，是其核心贡献之一。其重要性在于为大规模交通流仿真和风险敏感分析提供了可扩展、可感知不确定性的驾驶员群体建模能力。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但计算效率的提升是其主要优势。
motivation: 现有的数据驱动的车辆跟随模型校准大多是确定性的，对不确定性感知的预测、风险敏感评估和群体级仿真指导有限。贝叶斯校准虽然能推断参数的后验分布，但基于轨迹的MCMC方法对于大规模自然驾驶数据集计算上不可行。
method: 该方法结合了（i）一个残差增强的车辆跟随模拟器（带有两种残差过程替代方案）和（ii）一个平均条件密度估计器，该估计器将观察到的领导者-跟随者轨迹直接映射到特定驾驶员的模型参数后验分布。训练期间，引入联合主动设计策略来选择信息量大的参数提议和具有代表性的驾驶情境，以降低模拟成本。
results: 实验结果表明，与贝叶斯校准基线相比，该方法在HighD数据集上实现了更高的预测准确性和更接近观测轨迹分布的模拟结果。收敛性和消融研究支持了所提出设计选择的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该框架实现了可扩展的、可感知不确定性的驾驶员群体建模，可用于交通流仿真和风险敏感的交通分析。

title: Penalized Likelihood Parameter Estimation for Differential Equation Models: A Computational Tutorial
authors: Matthew J Simpson, James S Bennett, Alexander Johnston, Ruth E Baker
abstract: Parameter estimation connects mathematical models to real-world data and decision making across many scientific and industrial applications. Standard approaches such as maximum likelihood estimation and Markov chain Monte Carlo estimate parameters by repeatedly solving the model, which often requires numerical solutions of differential equation models. In contrast, generalized profiling (also called parameter cascading) focuses directly on the governing differential equation(s), linking the model and data through a penalized likelihood that explicitly measures both the data fit and model fit. Despite several advantages, generalized profiling is relatively rarely used in practice. This tutorial-style article outlines a set of self-directed computational exercises that facilitate skills development in applying generalized profiling to a range of ordinary differential equation models. All calculations can be repeated using reproducible open-source Jupyter notebooks that are available on GitHub.
zh_title: 带惩罚的似然参数估计在微分方程模型中的应用：一个计算教程
translation: 参数估计是将数学模型与现实世界的数据和决策联系起来，应用于许多科学和工业领域。最大似然估计和马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛等标准方法通过反复求解模型来估计参数，这通常需要对微分方程模型进行数值求解。相比之下，广义剖析（也称为参数级联）直接关注控制微分方程，通过惩罚似然将模型和数据联系起来，该似然显式地衡量数据拟合和模型拟合。尽管有几个优点，广义剖析在实践中很少使用。本教程风格的文章概述了一套自导的计算练习，以促进将广义剖析应用于一系列常微分方程模型的技能发展。所有计算都可以使用GitHub上提供的可复现的开源Jupyter Notebooks进行重复。
tldr: 本教程介绍了广义剖析方法，这是一种直接作用于微分方程的参数估计技术，通过惩罚似然来同时衡量数据拟合和模型拟合，并提供可重复的计算练习。
ai_comments: 该教程通过提供可复现的计算练习，有效地解决了广义剖析方法在实际应用中较少使用的问题，具有重要的实践意义。
motivation: 尽管广义剖析方法在参数估计中具有优势，但在实践中应用较少，因此需要本教程来促进其应用。
method: 通过一系列自导的计算练习，使用可复现的开源Jupyter Notebooks，教授如何将广义剖析方法应用于常微分方程模型。
results: 本教程通过计算练习，旨在帮助用户掌握广义剖析方法在常微分方程模型中的应用技能。
conclusion: 本教程提供了一种有效的方式来学习和应用广义剖析方法，以解决微分方程模型的参数估计问题。

title: Sensitivity analysis for contamination in egocentric-network randomized trials with interference
authors: Bar Weinstein, Daniel Nevo
abstract: Egocentric-Network Randomized Trials (ENRTs) are increasingly used to estimate causal effects under interference when measuring complete sociocentric network data is infeasible. ENRTs rely on egocentric network sampling, where a set of egos is first sampled, and each ego recruits a subset of its neighbors as alters. Treatments are then randomized across egos. While the observed ego-networks are disjoint by design, the underlying population network may contain edges connecting them, leading to contamination. Under a design-based framework, we show that the Horvitz-Thompson estimators of direct and indirect effects are biased whenever contamination is present. To address this, we derive bias-corrected estimators and propose a novel sensitivity analysis framework based on sensitivity parameters representing the probability or expected number of missing edges. This framework is implemented via both grid sensitivity analysis and probabilistic bias analysis, providing researchers with a flexible tool to assess the robustness of the causal estimators to contamination. We apply our methodology to the HIV Prevention Trials Network 037 study, finding that ignoring contamination may lead to underestimation of indirect effects and overestimation of direct effects.

title: A Bayesian approach to differential prevalence analysis with applications in microbiome studies
authors: Juho Pelto, Kari Auranen, Janne V. Kujala, Leo Lahti
abstract: Recent evidence suggests that analyzing the presence/absence of taxonomic features can offer a compelling alternative to differential abundance analysis in microbiome studies. However, standard approaches face challenges with boundary cases and multiple testing. To address these challenges, we developed DiPPER (Differential Prevalence via Probabilistic Estimation in R), a method based on Bayesian hierarchical modeling. We benchmarked our method against existing differential prevalence and abundance methods using data from 67 publicly available human gut microbiome studies. We observed considerable variation in performance across methods, with DiPPER outperforming alternatives by combining high sensitivity with effective error control. DiPPER also demonstrated superior replication of findings across independent studies. Furthermore, DiPPER provides differential prevalence estimates and uncertainty intervals that are inherently adjusted for multiple testing.

title: Piecewise Deterministic Markov Processes for Bayesian Inference of PDE Coefficients
authors: Leon Riccius, Iuri B.C.M. Rocha, Joris Bierkens, Hanne Kekkonen, Frans P. van der Meer
abstract: We develop a general framework for piecewise deterministic Markov process (PDMP) samplers that enables efficient Bayesian inference in non-linear inverse problems with expensive likelihoods. The key ingredient is a surrogate-assisted thinning scheme in which a surrogate model provides a proposal event rate and a robust correction mechanism enforces an upper bound on the true rate by dynamically adjusting an additive offset whenever violations are detected. This construction is agnostic to the choice of surrogate and PDMP, and we demonstrate it for the Zig-Zag sampler and the Bouncy particle sampler with constant, Laplace, and Gaussian process (GP) surrogates, including gradient-informed and adaptively refined GP variants. As a representative application, we consider Bayesian inference of a spatially varying Young's modulus in a one-dimensional linear elasticity problem. Across dimensions, PDMP samplers equipped with GP-based surrogates achieve substantially higher accuracy and effective sample size per forward model evaluation than Random Walk Metropolis algorithm and the No-U-Turn sampler. The Bouncy particle sampler exhibits the most favorable overall efficiency and scaling, illustrating the potential of the proposed PDMP framework beyond this particular setting.

title: On the Skew Stickiness Ratio
authors: Masaaki Fukasawa
abstract: The skew stickiness ratio is a statistic that captures the joint dynamics of an asset price and its volatility. We derive a representation formula for this quantity using the Itô-Wentzell and Clark-Ocone formulae, and we apply it to analyze its asymptotics under Bergomi-type stochastic volatility models.

title: Optimal Accelerated Life Testing Sampling Plan Design with Piecewise Linear Function based Modeling of Lifetime Characteristics
authors: Sandip Barui, Shovan Chowdhury
abstract: Researchers have widely used accelerated life tests to determine an optimal inspection plan for lot acceptance. All such plans are proposed by assuming a known relationship between the lifetime characteristic(s) and the accelerating stress factor(s) under a parametric framework of the product lifetime distribution. As the true relationship is rarely known in practical scenarios, the assumption itself may produce biased estimates that may lead to an inefficient sampling plan. To this endeavor, an optimal accelerating life test plan is designed under a Type-I censoring scheme with a generalized link structure similar to a spline regression, to capture the nonlinear relationship between the lifetime characteristics and the stress levels. Product lifetime is assumed to follow Weibull distribution with non-identical scale and shape parameters linked with the stress factor through a piecewise linear function. The elements of the Fisher information matrix are computed in detail to formulate the acceptability criterion for the conforming lots. The decision variables of the sampling plan including sample size, stress factors, and others are determined using a constrained aggregated cost minimization approach and variance minimization approach. A simulated case study demonstrates that the nonlinear link-based piecewise linear approximation model outperforms the linear link-based model.
zh_title: 基于分段线性函数寿命特性建模的最优加速寿命试验抽样方案设计
translation: 研究人员广泛使用加速寿命试验来确定批量验收的最优检查方案。所有这些方案都是通过在参数化产品寿命分布框架下，假设寿命特征与加速应力因子之间存在已知关系而提出的。由于在实际情况下真实关系很少被知晓，这种假设本身可能会产生有偏估计，从而导致低效的抽样方案。为此，本研究在 Type-I 审查方案下设计了一个最优加速寿命试验方案，采用了类似于样条回归的广义链接结构，以捕获寿命特征与应力水平之间的非线性关系。产品寿命假设服从威布尔分布，其具有不相同的尺度和形状参数，这些参数通过分段线性函数与应力因子联系起来。详细计算了费希尔信息矩阵的元素，以制定合格批次的验收准则。使用约束的聚合成本最小化方法和方差最小化方法来确定抽样方案的决策变量，包括样本量、应力因子等。模拟案例研究表明，基于非线性链接的分段线性近似模型优于基于线性链接的模型。
tldr: 为了克服传统加速寿命试验（ALT）中对寿命-应力关系假设的限制，本文提出了一种基于分段线性函数的广义链接结构模型，用于设计最优的 Type-I 审查抽样方案，并通过成本和方差最小化确定参数，模拟结果显示该非线性模型优于线性模型。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于采用广义链接结构（类似于样条回归）来捕获寿命特征与加速应力水平之间非线性关系，并基于分段线性函数构建寿命模型，这克服了传统方法中假设真实关系已知的局限性。其重要性在于设计了更稳健的最优加速寿命试验（ALT）抽样方案。局限性是模型基于威布尔分布假设。
motivation: 传统的加速寿命试验（ALT）抽样方案都假设寿命特征与加速应力因子之间存在已知的参数关系，但在实际中真实关系很少为人所知，这种假设可能导致估计有偏，进而产生低效的抽样方案。
method: 在 Type-I 审查方案下，设计了最优加速寿命试验方案，采用类似于样条回归的广义链接结构来捕获寿命特征与应力水平之间的非线性关系。产品寿命假设服从威布尔分布，其尺度和形状参数通过分段线性函数与应力因子相关联。使用约束的聚合成本最小化方法和方差最小化方法确定抽样方案的决策变量（包括样本量和应力因子）。
results: 模拟案例研究表明，非线性链接的分段线性近似模型优于线性链接模型。
conclusion: 基于非线性链接的分段线性近似模型在模拟案例研究中表现优于线性链接模型。

title: Using Individualized Treatment Effects to Assess Treatment Effect Heterogeneity
authors: Konstantinos Sechidis, Cong Zhang, Sophie Sun, Yao Chen, Asher Spector, Björn Bornkamp
abstract: Assessing treatment effect heterogeneity (TEH) in clinical trials is crucial, as it provides insights into the variability of treatment responses among patients, influencing important decisions related to drug development. Furthermore, it can lead to personalized medicine by tailoring treatments to individual patient characteristics. This paper introduces novel methodologies for assessing treatment effects using the individual treatment effect as a basis. To estimate this effect, we use a Double Robust (DR) learner to infer a pseudo-outcome that reflects the causal contrast. This pseudo-outcome is then used to perform three objectives: (1) a global test for heterogeneity, (2) ranking covariates based on their influence on effect modification, and (3) providing estimates of the individualized treatment effect. We compare our DR-learner with various alternatives and competing methods in a simulation study, and also use it to assess heterogeneity in a pooled analysis of five Phase III trials in psoriatic arthritis. By integrating these methods with the recently proposed WATCH workflow (Workflow to Assess Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in Drug Development for Clinical Trial Sponsors), we provide a robust framework for analyzing TEH, offering insights that enable more informed decision-making in this challenging area.

title: Jointly Exchangeable Collective Risk Models: Interaction, Structure, and Limit Theorems
authors: Daniel Gaigall, Stefan Weber
abstract: We introduce a framework for systemic risk modeling in insurance portfolios using jointly exchangeable arrays, extending classical collective risk models to account for interactions. Joint exchangeability is a more general probabilistic symmetric than de Finetti's exchangeability, characterized by the Aldous-Hoover-Kallenberg representation. We establish central limit theorems that asymptotically capture total portfolio losses, providing a theoretical foundation for approximations in large portfolios and over long time horizons. These approximations are validated through simulation-based numerical experiments. Additionally, we analyze the impact of dependence on portfolio loss distributions, with a particular focus on tail behavior.

title: Comparing methods to assess treatment effect heterogeneity in general parametric regression models
authors: Yao Chen, Sophie Sun, Konstantinos Sechidis, Cong Zhang, Torsten Hothorn, Björn Bornkamp
abstract: This paper reviews and compares methods to assess treatment effect heterogeneity in the context of parametric regression models. These methods include the standard likelihood ratio tests, bootstrap likelihood ratio tests, and Goeman's global test motivated by testing whether the random effect variance is zero. We place particular emphasis on tests based on the score-residual of the treatment effect and explore different variants of tests in this class. All approaches are compared in a simulation study, and the approach based on residual scores is illustrated in a clinical trial with time-to-event outcome comparing treatment versus placebo. Our findings demonstrate that score-residual based methods provide practical, flexible and reliable tools for exploring treatment effect heterogeneity and treatment effect modifiers, and can provide useful guidance for decision making around treatment effect heterogeneity.

title: An Optimal Transport approach to arbitrage correction: application to Volatility Stress-Tests
authors: Marius Chevallier, Stefano De Marco, Pierre-Emmanuel Lévy-dit-Vehel
abstract: We present a method based on optimal transport to remove arbitrage opportunities within a finite set of option prices. The method is notably intended for regulatory stress-tests, which require applying significant local distortions to implied volatility surfaces, thereby introducing arbitrage. The resulting stressed option prices being associated with signed marginal measures, we formulate the process of removing arbitrage as a projection onto the subset of martingale measures with respect to a Wasserstein metric in the space of signed measures, to which we then apply an entropic regularization technique. For the regularized problem, we derive a strong duality formula, show convergence results as the regularization parameter approaches zero, and formulate a multi-constrained Sinkhorn algorithm, where each iteration involves, at worst, finding the root of an explicit scalar function. The convergence of this algorithm is also established. We compare our method with the existing approach of [Cohen, Reisinger and Wang, Appl.\ Math.\ Fin.\ 2020] across various scenarios and test cases.

title: WebAccessVL: Making an Accessible Web via Violation-Conditioned VLM
authors: Amber Yijia Zheng, Jae Joong Lee, Bedrich Benes, Raymond A. Yeh
abstract: We present a vision-language model (VLM) that automatically edits website HTML to address Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2 (WCAG2) violations. We formulate this as a supervised image-conditioned program synthesis task, where the model learns to correct HTML given the HTML and its rendering. We collected WebAccessVL, a new dataset with manually corrected accessibility violations, establishing paired training data. We then propose a violation-conditioned VLM that additionally conditions on the WCAG2 violation count to guide the correction process. Experiments demonstrate that our method effectively reduces the average number of violations from 5.34 to 0.44 per website, outperforming commercial LLM APIs (Gemini, GPT-5). A perceptual study confirms that our edited websites maintain the original visual appearance and content.
zh_title: WebAccessVL：通过违规条件VLM创建可访问的网页
translation: 我们提出了一个视觉语言模型（VLM），它能自动编辑网站HTML以解决Web内容可访问性指南2（WCAG2）违规问题。我们将此任务表述为一个监督图像条件程序合成任务，其中模型根据HTML及其渲染图学习修正HTML。我们收集了WebAccessVL，这是一个包含手动修正的可访问性违规的新数据集，建立了配对训练数据。随后，我们提出了一个违规条件VLM，它额外以WCAG2违规计数为条件来指导修正过程。实验证明，我们的方法有效地将每个网站的平均违规次数从5.34次减少到0.44次，性能优于商业LLM API（Gemini, GPT-5）。一项感知研究证实，我们编辑后的网站保持了原始的视觉外观和内容。
tldr: 提出WebAccessVL，一个使用“违规条件VLM”自动编辑HTML来修复网页可访问性违规的模型，效果显著优于商业大模型，并将平均违规次数从5.34降至0.44。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将可访问性修正任务转化为“违规条件”下的图像条件程序合成，并提出了专门的WebAccessVL数据集和违规条件VLM。其重要性在于解决了WCAG2合规性的自动化难题，这对提升网络无障碍环境具有巨大的实际价值。实验结果显示出该专业模型的卓越性能，特别是优于通用商业大语言模型（如Gemini和GPT-5），证明了其方法的有效性和专业化优势。
motivation: 自动编辑网站HTML以解决Web内容可访问性指南2 (WCAG2) 违规问题，从而创建可访问的网页。
method: 将问题表述为监督图像条件程序合成任务。收集了新的WebAccessVL数据集（包含手动修正的无障碍违规），用于配对训练。提出了一个“违规条件VLM”（Violation-Conditioned VLM），该模型额外以WCAG2违规计数为条件来指导修正过程。
results: 实验证明，该方法将每个网站的平均违规次数从5.34次有效减少到0.44次，优于商业LLM API（Gemini, GPT-5）。感知研究证实编辑后的网站保持了原始的视觉外观和内容。
conclusion: 成功开发了一种高效的违规条件视觉语言模型WebAccessVL，能够自动且准确地修正网站的WCAG2违规，显著提高了网页的可访问性，同时保持了视觉一致性。

title: HybridQuestion: Human-AI Collaboration for Identifying High-Impact Research Questions
authors: Keyu Zhao, Fengli Xu, Yong Li, Tie-Yan Liu
abstract: The "AI Scientist" paradigm is transforming scientific research by automating key stages of the research process, from idea generation to scholarly writing. This shift is expected to accelerate discovery and expand the scope of scientific inquiry. However, a key question remains unclear: can AI scientists identify meaningful research questions?
