translation: 学习能够泛化到未见转换动力学的域自适应策略，仍然是基于学习的控制中的一个基本挑战。通过域表示学习捕捉域特定信息，从而实现域感知决策，已经取得了实质性进展。我们分析了通过动态预测学习域表示的过程，发现选择与当前步骤相邻的上下文会导致学习到的表示将静态域信息与变化的动态属性纠缠在一起。这种混合会混淆条件策略，从而限制零样本适应能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了DADP（域自适应扩散策略），它通过非监督解耦和域感知扩散注入来实现鲁棒的适应。首先，我们引入了滞后上下文动态预测（Lagged Context Dynamical Prediction），这是一种将未来状态估计以历史偏移上下文为条件的策略；通过增加这个时间间隔，我们通过过滤掉瞬态属性来非监督地解耦静态域表示。其次，我们通过偏置先验分布和重新制定扩散目标，将学习到的域表示直接整合到生成过程中。在具有挑战性的运动和操作基准测试上进行的广泛实验证明了DADP优于现有方法的优越性能和泛化能力。更多可视化结果可在https://outsider86.github.io/DomainAdaptiveDiffusionPolicy/上获取。
tldr: DADP是一种用于学习域自适应控制策略的新方法。它通过引入“滞后上下文动态预测”来非监督地解耦静态域信息和动态属性，然后将解耦后的域表示注入到扩散模型的先验分布和目标中，从而实现了在零样本自适应任务上的优越性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将域适应策略学习中的关键问题——静态域信息与瞬态动态属性的纠缠——与扩散模型相结合，并提出了具体的解耦机制。通过“滞后上下文动态预测”（Lagged Context Dynamical Prediction）来利用时间差距进行非监督解耦是解决这一挑战的巧妙方法。此外，将解耦后的域表示直接融入扩散模型的生成过程（通过偏置先验和重构目标）确保了策略是真正“域感知”的。该工作对于提高基于学习的控制系统在实际复杂环境中的鲁棒性和零样本泛化能力具有重要意义。局限性（未在摘要中明确提及，但可以推断）：可能需要仔细调整滞后上下文的时间间隔（历史偏移量）。
motivation: 学习能够泛化到未见转换动力学的域自适应策略是一个基本挑战。现有的域表示学习方法，特别是那些选择当前步骤附近上下文的方法，会导致学习到的表示将静态域信息与变化的动态属性纠缠在一起，从而混淆条件策略，限制零样本适应能力。
method:
提出DADP（域自适应扩散策略），通过以下两个关键步骤实现：
1. **非监督解耦：** 引入“滞后上下文动态预测”（Lagged Context Dynamical Prediction），通过增加预测未来状态时所依赖的历史上下文的时间间隔，来过滤掉瞬态属性，从而非监督地解耦静态域表示。
2. **域感知扩散注入：** 通过偏置先验分布和重新制定扩散目标，将学习到的域表示直接整合到扩散模型的生成过程中。
results: 在具有挑战性的运动和操作基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，DADP的性能和泛化能力优于现有方法。
conclusion: DADP通过非监督解耦和域感知扩散注入，实现了鲁棒的域自适应策略，有效解决了现有方法中域表示和动态属性纠缠的问题。

title: Partition Trees: Conditional Density Estimation over General Outcome Spaces
authors: Felipe Angelim, Alessandro Leite
abstract: We propose Partition Trees, a tree-based framework for conditional density estimation over general outcome spaces, supporting both continuous and categorical variables within a unified formulation. Our approach models conditional distributions as piecewise-constant densities on data adaptive partitions and learns trees by directly minimizing conditional negative log-likelihood. This yields a scalable, nonparametric alternative to existing probabilistic trees that does not make parametric assumptions about the target distribution. We further introduce Partition Forests, an ensemble extension obtained by averaging conditional densities. Empirically, we demonstrate improved probabilistic prediction over CART-style trees and competitive or superior performance compared to state-of-the-art probabilistic tree methods and Random Forests, along with robustness to redundant features and heteroscedastic noise.
zh_title: 分割树：在一般结果空间上的条件密度估计
translation: 我们提出了分割树（Partition Trees），这是一种用于在一般结果空间上进行条件密度估计的基于树的框架，它在统一的公式中同时支持连续变量和分类变量。我们的方法将条件分布建模为数据自适应分割上的分段常数密度，并通过直接最小化条件负对数似然来学习树。这为现有的概率树提供了一种可扩展的、非参数的替代方案，它不对目标分布做出参数假设。我们进一步引入了分割森林（Partition Forests），这是一种通过平均条件密度获得的集成扩展。在经验上，我们证明了该方法在概率预测方面优于CART风格的树，并且与最先进的概率树方法和随机森林相比，具有竞争性或卓越的性能，同时对冗余特征和异方差噪声具有鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为“分割树”（Partition Trees）的非参数、可扩展的树基框架，用于在包含连续和分类变量的一般结果空间上进行条件密度估计。该方法通过最小化条件负对数似然来学习树，并在经验上优于CART和现有的概率树方法。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将条件密度估计与树结构学习相结合，并提出了一种统一处理连续和分类变量的非参数方法。通过直接最小化条件负对数似然来学习分割，保证了模型的概率准确性。该方法提供了一个重要的、可扩展的替代方案，解决了现有概率树方法通常需要对目标分布进行参数假设的限制。其在集成（分割森林）和对噪声的鲁棒性方面的表现，进一步增强了其实用价值。
motivation: 需要一个统一的、非参数的、可扩展的树基框架，用于在包含连续和分类变量的一般结果空间上进行条件密度估计，以避免对目标分布进行参数假设。
method: 提出了“分割树”（Partition Trees）框架。该方法将条件分布建模为数据自适应分割上的分段常数密度，并通过直接最小化条件负对数似然（conditional negative log-likelihood）来学习树结构。此外，还引入了“分割森林”（Partition Forests），通过平均条件密度来实现集成扩展。
results: 经验证明，该方法在概率预测方面优于CART风格的树，并且与最先进的概率树方法和随机森林相比，具有竞争性或卓越的性能。同时，它对冗余特征和异方差噪声表现出鲁棒性。

title: Bayesian Networks and Proof-Nets: the proof-theory of Bayesian Inference
authors: Rémi Di Guardia, Thomas Ehrhard, Jérôme Evrard, Claudia Faggian
abstract:
We study the correspondence between Bayesian Networks and graphical representation of proofs in linear logic. The goal of this paper is threefold: to develop a proof-theoretical account of Bayesian inference (in the spirit of the Curry-Howard correspondence between proofs and programs), to provide compositional graphical methods, and to take into account computational efficiency.
  We exploit the fact that the decomposition of a graph is more flexible than that of a proof-tree, or of a type-derivation, even if
  compositionality becomes more challenging.
zh_title: 贝叶斯网络与证明网：贝叶斯推理的证明论
translation: 我们研究贝叶斯网络与线性逻辑中证明的图形表示之间的对应关系。本文的目标有三：发展贝叶斯推理的证明论解释（借鉴证明与程序之间的Curry-Howard对应），提供组合式的图解方法，并考虑计算效率。我们利用图分解比证明树或类型推导更灵活的事实，即使组合性变得更具挑战性。
tldr: 本文研究贝叶斯网络与线性逻辑中的证明网的对应关系，旨在为贝叶斯推理提供一个组合式、计算高效的证明论基础，借鉴Curry-Howard对应。
ai_comments: 本文的创新在于将概率建模（贝叶斯网络）与结构证明论（证明网和线性逻辑）这两个截然不同的领域联系起来，暗示了逻辑推理和概率推理之间存在深层的结构对应关系。借鉴Curry-Howard对应，该工作旨在为贝叶斯推理提供严格的证明论基础和组合性方法，并可能提高计算效率。然而，作者也指出，尽管图分解更灵活，但实现组合性仍然是一个挑战。
motivation: 目标有三：发展贝叶斯推理的证明论解释（借鉴证明与程序之间的Curry-Howard对应），提供组合式的图解方法，并考虑计算效率。
method: 研究贝叶斯网络与线性逻辑中证明的图形表示（证明网）之间的对应关系。利用图分解比证明树或类型推导更灵活的特性。

title: AnyStyle: Single-Pass Multimodal Stylization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
authors: Joanna Kaleta, Bartosz Świrta, Kacper Kania, Przemysław Spurek, Marek Kowalski
abstract: The growing demand for rapid and scalable 3D asset creation has driven interest in feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods, with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) emerging as an effective scene representation. While recent approaches have demonstrated pose-free reconstruction from unposed image collections, integrating stylization or appearance control into such pipelines remains underexplored. Existing attempts largely rely on image-based conditioning, which limits both controllability and flexibility. In this work, we introduce AnyStyle, a feed-forward 3D reconstruction and stylization framework that enables pose-free, zero-shot stylization through multimodal conditioning. Our method supports both textual and visual style inputs, allowing users to control the scene appearance using natural language descriptions or reference images. We propose a modular stylization architecture that requires only minimal architectural modifications and can be integrated into existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction backbones. Experiments demonstrate that AnyStyle improves style controllability over prior feed-forward stylization methods while preserving high-quality geometric reconstruction. A user study further confirms that AnyStyle achieves superior stylization quality compared to an existing state-of-the-art approach. Repository: https://github.com/joaxkal/AnyStyle.
zh_title: AnyStyle：3D高斯溅射的单通道多模态风格化
translation: 对快速、可扩展3D资产创建日益增长的需求推动了人们对前馈3D重建方法的兴趣，其中3D高斯溅射（3DGS）作为一种有效的场景表示方法正在兴起。虽然最近的方法已经证明了可以从未定姿图像集合中进行无姿态重建，但将风格化或外观控制整合到此类管线中仍未得到充分探索。现有的尝试主要依赖于基于图像的条件设置，这限制了可控性和灵活性。在这项工作中，我们引入了AnyStyle，这是一个前馈3D重建和风格化框架，它通过多模态条件设置实现了无姿态、零样本风格化。我们的方法支持文本和视觉风格输入，允许用户使用自然语言描述或参考图像来控制场景外观。我们提出了一种模块化风格化架构，它只需要最少的架构修改，并且可以集成到现有的前馈3D重建骨干网络中。实验证明，AnyStyle在保持高质量几何重建的同时，提高了对现有前馈风格化方法的风格可控性。一项用户研究进一步证实，与现有的最先进方法相比，AnyStyle实现了卓越的风格化质量。
tldr: AnyStyle是一种用于3DGS的单通道前馈框架，它允许用户通过文本或图像（多模态）进行无姿态、零样本的3D场景风格化，显著提高了风格控制力和输出质量。
ai_comments: AnyStyle的创新点在于将前馈（feed-forward）、单通道（single-pass）和多模态（multimodal）风格化方法引入了3D高斯溅射（3DGS）领域。以往的3D风格化方法通常依赖于基于图像的条件设置，限制了灵活性和用户控制。AnyStyle通过允许使用自然语言或参考图像来控制3D场景的外观，极大地增强了用户对风格的控制力。其模块化架构设计也确保了该方法可以轻松集成到现有的3D重建骨干网络中，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 对快速、可扩展的3D资产创建需求日益增长，3D高斯溅射（3DGS）作为有效表示方法受到关注。然而，将风格化或外观控制集成到无姿态的前馈3D重建管线中尚未得到充分探索，且现有方法主要依赖基于图像的条件设置，限制了可控性和灵活性。
method: 引入AnyStyle框架，这是一种前馈3D重建和风格化方法。该方法采用多模态条件设置，支持文本和视觉风格输入，实现无姿态、零样本风格化。它采用模块化风格化架构，只需最小的架构修改即可集成到现有前馈3D重建骨干中。
results: AnyStyle在保持高质量几何重建的同时，提高了相对于现有前馈风格化方法的风格可控性。用户研究证实，与现有最先进的方法相比，AnyStyle实现了卓越的风格化质量。
conclusion: AnyStyle成功地构建了一个前馈、无姿态、零样本的3D重建和风格化框架，通过多模态输入（文本和图像）显著提高了3D高斯溅射场景的风格化可控性和质量。

title: A Parameterizable Convolution Accelerator for Embedded Deep Learning Applications
authors: Panagiotis Mousouliotis, Georgios Keramidas
abstract: Convolutional neural network (CNN) accelerators implemented on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) are typically designed with a primary focus on maximizing performance, often measured in giga-operations per second (GOPS). However, real-life embedded deep learning (DL) applications impose multiple constraints related to latency, power consumption, area, and cost. This work presents a hardware-software (HW/SW) co-design methodology in which a CNN accelerator is described using high-level synthesis (HLS) tools that ease the parameterization of the design, facilitating more effective optimizations across multiple design constraints. Our experimental results demonstrate that the proposed design methodology is able to outperform non-parameterized design approaches, and it can be easily extended to other types of DL applications.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Published in the proceedings of the 2025 IEEE Computer Society Annual Symposium on VLSI (ISVLSI 2025), Kalamata, Greece, 6-9 July 2025
zh_title: 一种用于嵌入式深度学习应用的可参数化卷积加速器
translation: 卷积神经网络（CNN）加速器在现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）上的实现通常主要侧重于最大化性能，通常以每秒千兆次操作（GOPS）来衡量。然而，现实生活中的嵌入式深度学习（DL）应用会带来与延迟、功耗、面积和成本相关的多重约束。这项工作提出了一种软硬件（HW/SW）协同设计方法，其中使用高级综合（HLS）工具来描述CNN加速器，从而简化设计的参数化，有助于在多个设计约束之间进行更有效的优化。我们的实验结果表明，所提出的设计方法能够优于非参数化设计方法，并且可以轻松扩展到其他类型的深度学习应用。
tldr: 针对嵌入式深度学习应用的多重约束（延迟、功耗、面积、成本），本文提出了一种基于HLS的软硬件协同设计方法，实现了可参数化的CNN加速器，实验证明其性能优于非参数化设计，且易于扩展。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将高级综合（HLS）和软硬件协同设计结合起来，专门用于创建“可参数化”的CNN加速器。在嵌入式领域，设计者必须平衡性能、功耗和面积，而传统设计往往是固定的。通过参数化，设计者可以更容易地探索设计空间，并针对特定的应用需求进行定制优化，这对于资源受限的DL部署至关重要。
motivation: 现有的FPGA上的CNN加速器主要关注性能（GOPS），但实际的嵌入式深度学习应用需要满足多重约束，包括延迟、功耗、面积和成本。
method: 提出了一种软硬件（HW/SW）协同设计方法，使用高级综合（HLS）工具来描述CNN加速器，从而简化设计的参数化过程，便于在多个设计约束之间进行更有效的优化。
results: 实验结果表明，所提出的设计方法能够优于非参数化设计方法，并且可以轻松扩展到其他类型的深度学习应用。
conclusion: 软硬件协同设计和参数化方法是解决嵌入式深度学习应用中多重设计约束（如延迟、功耗和成本）的有效途径。

title: Fast, Unsupervised Framework for Registration Quality Assessment of Multi-stain Histological Whole Slide Pairs
authors: Shikha Dubey, Patricia Raciti, Kristopher Standish, Albert Juan Ramon, Erik Ames Burlingame
abstract: High-fidelity registration of histopathological whole slide images (WSIs), such as hematoxylin & eosin (H&E) and immunohistochemistry (IHC), is vital for integrated molecular analysis but challenging to evaluate without ground-truth (GT) annotations. Existing WSI-level assessments -- using annotated landmarks or intensity-based similarity metrics -- are often time-consuming, unreliable, and computationally intensive, limiting large-scale applicability. This study proposes a fast, unsupervised framework that jointly employs down-sampled tissue masks- and deformations-based metrics for registration quality assessment (RQA) of registered H&E and IHC WSI pairs. The masks-based metrics measure global structural correspondence, while the deformations-based metrics evaluate local smoothness, continuity, and transformation realism. Validation across multiple IHC markers and multi-expert assessments demonstrate a strong correlation between automated metrics and human evaluations. In the absence of GT, this framework offers reliable, real-time RQA with high fidelity and minimal computational resources, making it suitable for large-scale quality control in digital pathology.
zh_title: 快速、无监督的多重染色组织学全玻片对配准质量评估框架
translation: 组织病理学全玻片图像（WSI），如苏木精和伊红染色（H&E）以及免疫组织化学染色（IHC）的高保真配准对于综合分子分析至关重要，但在缺乏地面真实（GT）注释的情况下评估极具挑战性。现有的WSI级评估——使用带注释的地标或基于强度的相似性指标——通常耗时、不可靠且计算密集，限制了大规模适用性。本研究提出了一种快速、无监督的框架，联合采用基于下采样组织掩模和基于形变的指标，用于已配准的H&E和IHC WSI对的配准质量评估（RQA）。基于掩模的指标测量全局结构对应性，而基于形变的指标评估局部平滑度、连续性和变换真实性。在多种IHC标记和多专家评估中的验证表明，自动化指标与人类评估之间存在很强的相关性。在缺乏GT的情况下，该框架提供了可靠、实时、高保真且计算资源需求极小的RQA，使其适用于数字病理学中的大规模质量控制。
tldr: 提出了一种快速、无监督的框架，通过结合下采样组织掩模和形变指标，高效评估H&E和IHC全玻片图像配准的质量，无需地面真实值，适用于大规模数字病理学质控。
ai_comments: 该工作的创新点在于其无监督和快速的特性，解决了现有配准质量评估方法（依赖地面真实值或计算密集型相似性指标）在大规模数字病理学应用中的瓶颈。通过将评估分解为全局结构（掩模）和局部变换（形变）两个互补的维度，提高了评估的可靠性和效率，使其成为一个实用的质量控制工具，特别适合缺乏地面真实值的场景。
motivation: 高保真的组织病理学全玻片图像（如H&E和IHC）配准对于综合分子分析至关重要，但缺乏地面真实值（GT）注释时难以评估。现有的WSI级评估方法耗时、不可靠且计算密集，限制了大规模应用。
method: 提出了一种快速、无监督的框架，联合使用基于下采样组织掩模的指标和基于形变的指标进行配准质量评估（RQA）。基于掩模的指标测量全局结构对应性，基于形变的指标评估局部平滑度、连续性和变换真实性。
results: 在多种IHC标记和多专家评估中，自动化指标与人类评估表现出高度相关性。该框架能够在缺乏地面真实值的情况下，提供高保真、实时且计算资源需求极小的可靠RQA。
conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可靠、实时且计算资源需求极小的配准质量评估方法，使其适用于数字病理学中的大规模质量控制。

title: From Crafting Text to Crafting Thought: Grounding AI Writing Support to Writing Center Pedagogy
authors: Yijun Liu, John Gallagher, Sarah Sterman, Tal August
abstract: As AI writing tools evolve from fixing surface errors to creating language with writers, new capabilities raise concerns about negative impacts on student writers, such as replacing their voices and undermining critical thinking skills. To address these challenges, we look at a parallel transition in university writing centers from focusing on fixing errors to preserving student voices. We develop design guidelines informed by writing center literature and interviews with 10 writing tutors. We illustrate these guidelines in a prototype AI tool, Writor. Writor helps writers revise text by setting goals, providing balanced feedback, and engaging in conversations without generating text verbatim. We conducted an expert review with 30 writing instructors, tutors, and AI researchers on Writor to assess the pedagogical soundness, alignment with writing center pedagogy, and integration contexts. We distill our findings into design implications for future AI writing feedback systems, including designing for trust among AI-skeptical educators.
zh_title: 从文本创作到思想创作：将AI写作支持植根于写作中心教学法
translation: 随着AI写作工具从修正表面错误发展到与作者共同创作语言，其新功能引发了人们对学生作者可能受到的负面影响的担忧，例如取代他们的声音和削弱批判性思维技能。为应对这些挑战，我们考察了大学写作中心从关注修正错误到保留学生声音的并行转变。我们根据写作中心文献和对10位写作导师的访谈，制定了设计指南。我们用原型AI工具Writor来阐释这些指南。Writor通过设定目标、提供平衡反馈和参与对话来帮助作者修改文本，但不会逐字生成文本。我们对30位写作指导员、导师和AI研究人员进行了Writor的专家评审，以评估其教学合理性、与写作中心教学法的契合度以及整合情境。我们将研究结果提炼为未来AI写作反馈系统的设计启示，包括为对AI持怀疑态度的教育者设计信任。
tldr: AI写作工具应借鉴写作中心教学法来保护学生的批判性思维。研究开发了一个不直接生成文本的AI原型Writor，并基于专家评审提出了设计建议，以帮助AI赢得教育者的信任。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将AI写作支持的设计与成熟的大学写作中心教学法相结合，解决了AI可能取代学生声音和削弱批判性思维的核心担忧。将关注点从“创作文本”转向“创作思想”是AI反馈系统设计中的重要哲学转变。通过开发原型工具Writor并进行严格的专家评审，该研究为未来开发更具教学合理性、更能赢得教育者信任的AI写作工具提供了具体的、以人为本的设计启示。
motivation: 随着AI写作工具的发展，人们担忧其对学生写作的负面影响，例如取代学生的声音和削弱批判性思维技能。本文旨在借鉴写作中心教学法，解决这些挑战，并指导AI写作支持的设计。
method: 制定了基于写作中心文献和对10位写作导师访谈的设计指南。基于此开发了原型AI工具Writor。随后，对Writor进行了由30名专家（包括写作指导员、导师和AI研究人员）参与的专家评审。
results: 开发了Writor原型工具，该工具通过设定目标、提供平衡反馈和参与对话来帮助作者修改文本，而不直接生成文本。研究结果被提炼为未来AI写作反馈系统的设计启示，包括为对AI持怀疑态度的教育者设计信任机制。

title: A categorical framework for cellular automata
authors: A. Castillo-Ramirez, A. Vazquez-Aceves, A. Zaldivar-Corichi
abstract: This paper proposes a generalized framework for cellular automata using the language of category theory, extending the classical definition beyond set-theoretic constraints. For an arbitrary category $\mathscr{C}$ with products, we define $\mathscr{C}$-cellular automata as morphisms $τ: A^G \to B^G$ in $\mathscr{C}$, where the alphabets $A$ and $B$ are objects in $\mathscr{C}$ and the universe is a group $G$. We show that $\mathscr{C}$-cellular automata form a subcategory of $\mathscr{C}$ closed under finite products, and that they satisfy a categorical version of the Curtis-Hedlund-Lyndon theorem. For two arbitrary group universes $G$ and $H$, we extend our theory to define generalized $\mathscr{C}$-cellular automata as morphisms $τ: A^G \to B^H$ constructed via a group homomorphism $φ: H \to G$. Finally, we prove that generalized $\mathscr{C}$-cellular automata form a subcategory of $\mathscr{C}$ with a finite weak product involving the free product of the underlying group universes. This framework unifies existing concepts and provides purely categorical proofs of foundational results in the theory of cellular automata.
zh_title: 细胞自动机的范畴框架
translation: 本文提出了一个使用范畴论语言的广义细胞自动机框架，将经典定义扩展到集合论约束之外。对于具有积的任意范畴 $\mathscr{C}$，我们将 $\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机定义为 $\mathscr{C}$ 中的态射 $τ: A^G \to B^G$，其中字母表 $A$ 和 $B$ 是 $\mathscr{C}$ 中的对象，宇宙是一个群 $G$。我们证明了 $\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机构成了 $\mathscr{C}$ 的一个子范畴，并在有限积下是封闭的，并且它们满足 Curtis-Hedlund-Lyndon 定理的一个范畴版本。对于两个任意群宇宙 $G$ 和 $H$，我们通过群同态 $φ: H \to G$ 构建态射 $τ: A^G \to B^H$，将我们的理论扩展到定义广义 $\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机。最后，我们证明了广义 $\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机构成了 $\mathscr{C}$ 的一个子范畴，该子范畴具有涉及底层群宇宙自由积的有限弱积。该框架统一了现有的概念，并为细胞自动机理论中的基础结果提供了纯粹的范畴证明。
tldr: 本文提出了一个使用范畴论语言的广义细胞自动机框架（$\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机），将经典定义推广到集合论约束之外，并证明了其满足范畴版本的Curtis-Hedlund-Lyndon定理，从而统一并提供了基础结果的范畴证明。
ai_comments: 这项工作的重要性在于它将细胞自动机（CA）这一计算模型置于高度抽象和通用的数学结构——范畴论——之下。通过摆脱集合论的限制，该框架使得CA的概念可以应用于更广泛的数学对象（即范畴$\mathscr{C}$中的对象），例如拓扑空间、代数结构或函子。证明Curtis-Hedlund-Lyndon定理的范畴版本是该框架稳健性的关键指标，因为它证明了这种抽象化保留了经典CA理论的核心特征。这项研究为理解和统一不同类型的动态系统提供了一个强大的理论工具。
motivation: 提出一个广义框架，使用范畴论的语言来扩展经典的细胞自动机定义，超越集合论的约束，并统一现有的概念。
method: 1. 对于具有积的任意范畴$\mathscr{C}$，将$\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机定义为范畴中的态射$τ: A^G \to B^G$，其中$A, B$是$\mathscr{C}$中的对象，$G$是群（宇宙）。2. 将该理论扩展到广义$\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机$τ: A^G \to B^H$，通过群同态$φ: H \to G$构建。3. 使用范畴论来证明其结构特性和基础定理。
results: 1. $\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机构成了$\mathscr{C}$的一个子范畴，并在有限积下是封闭的。2. 它们满足Curtis-Hedlund-Lyndon定理的一个范畴版本。3. 广义$\mathscr{C}$-细胞自动机构成了$\mathscr{C}$的一个子范畴，该子范畴具有涉及底层群宇宙自由积的有限弱积。
conclusion: 该框架统一了现有的概念，并为细胞自动机理论中的基础结果提供了纯粹的范畴证明。

title: Seeing Through Clutter: Structured 3D Scene Reconstruction via Iterative Object Removal
authors: Rio Aguina-Kang, Kevin James Blackburn-Matzen, Thibault Groueix, Vladimir Kim, Matheus Gadelha
abstract: We present SeeingThroughClutter, a method for reconstructing structured 3D representations from single images by segmenting and modeling objects individually. Prior approaches rely on intermediate tasks such as semantic segmentation and depth estimation, which often underperform in complex scenes, particularly in the presence of occlusion and clutter. We address this by introducing an iterative object removal and reconstruction pipeline that decomposes complex scenes into a sequence of simpler subtasks. Using VLMs as orchestrators, foreground objects are removed one at a time via detection, segmentation, object removal, and 3D fitting. We show that removing objects allows for cleaner segmentations of subsequent objects, even in highly occluded scenes. Our method requires no task-specific training and benefits directly from ongoing advances in foundation models. We demonstrate stateof-the-art robustness on 3D-Front and ADE20K datasets. Project Page: https://rioak.github.io/seeingthroughclutter/
zh_title: 看穿杂乱：通过迭代对象移除实现结构化 3D 场景重建
translation: 我们提出了 SeeingThroughClutter，这是一种通过单独分割和建模对象，从单张图像重建结构化 3D 表示的方法。先前的方法依赖于语义分割和深度估计等中间任务，这些任务在复杂场景中，尤其是在存在遮挡和杂乱的情况下，往往表现不佳。我们通过引入一个迭代的对象移除和重建流程来解决这个问题，该流程将复杂场景分解为一系列更简单的子任务。使用 VLM 作为协调器，通过检测、分割、对象移除和 3D 拟合，一次移除一个前景对象。我们表明，移除对象可以实现后续对象更清晰的分割，即使在高度遮挡的场景中也是如此。我们的方法不需要特定任务的训练，并直接受益于基础模型的持续进步。我们在 3D-Front 和 ADE20K 数据集上展示了最先进的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为 SeeingThroughClutter 的新方法，通过迭代地移除和重建前景对象，将复杂的单图像 3D 场景重建分解为简单的子任务。该方法利用 VLM 作为协调器，无需特定任务训练，在 3D-Front 和 ADE20K 数据集上展示了最先进的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 论文的关键创新在于其“迭代对象移除”的策略，将高难度的单次重建问题转化为一系列可控的、更简单的子任务。这种方法有效地解决了 3D 重建中常见的遮挡和杂乱问题。此外，该方法通过利用 VLM 和基础模型，实现了无需特定任务训练的零样本能力（或低资源依赖），这使其具有高度的通用性和对未来模型进步的直接受益性，是当前利用大型基础模型解决传统计算机视觉难题的一个优秀范例。
motivation: 现有的 3D 场景重建方法依赖于语义分割和深度估计等中间任务，但在存在遮挡和杂乱的复杂场景中往往表现不佳。
method: 引入了一个迭代的对象移除和重建流程，将复杂场景分解为一系列简单的子任务。使用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为协调器，通过检测、分割、对象移除和 3D 拟合的步骤，一次移除一个前景对象。该方法无需特定任务训练，直接受益于基础模型的进步。
results: 证明了移除对象可以实现后续对象更清晰的分割，即使在高度遮挡的场景中也是如此。在 3D-Front 和 ADE20K 数据集上展示了最先进的鲁棒性。

title: Artifact Removal and Image Restoration in AFM:A Structured Mask-Guided Directional Inpainting Approach
authors: Juntao Zhang, Angona Biswas, Jaydeep Rade, Charchit Shukla, Juan Ren, Anwesha Sarkar, Adarsh Krishnamurthy, Aditya Balu
abstract: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) enables high-resolution surface imaging at the nanoscale, yet the output is often degraded by artifacts introduced by environmental noise, scanning imperfections, and tip-sample interactions. To address this challenge, a lightweight and fully automated framework for artifact detection and restoration in AFM image analysis is presented. The pipeline begins with a classification model that determines whether an AFM image contains artifacts. If necessary, a lightweight semantic segmentation network, custom-designed and trained on AFM data, is applied to generate precise artifact masks. These masks are adaptively expanded based on their structural orientation and then inpainted using a directional neighbor-based interpolation strategy to preserve 3D surface continuity. A localized Gaussian smoothing operation is then applied for seamless restoration. The system is integrated into a user-friendly GUI that supports real-time parameter adjustments and batch processing. Experimental results demonstrate the effective artifact removal while preserving nanoscale structural details, providing a robust, geometry-aware solution for high-fidelity AFM data interpretation.
zh_title: AFM中的伪影去除与图像恢复：一种结构化掩模引导的定向修复方法
translation: 原子力显微镜（AFM）能够进行纳米级高分辨率表面成像，但其输出结果常因环境噪声、扫描缺陷和针尖-样品相互作用引入的伪影而退化。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种用于AFM图像分析中伪影检测与恢复的轻量级全自动框架。该流程始于一个分类模型，用于确定AFM图像是否包含伪影。如有必要，则应用一个专门为AFM数据设计和训练的轻量级语义分割网络来生成精确的伪影掩模。这些掩模根据其结构方向进行自适应扩展，然后使用基于定向邻域的插值策略进行修复，以保持3D表面连续性。随后应用局部高斯平滑操作以实现无缝恢复。该系统集成在一个用户友好的图形用户界面（GUI）中，支持实时参数调整和批量处理。实验结果证明了该方法在有效去除伪影的同时保留了纳米级结构细节，为高保真AFM数据解释提供了一个鲁棒且几何感知的解决方案。
tldr: 提出了一种轻量级全自动框架，用于检测和去除原子力显微镜（AFM）图像中的伪影。该方法使用分类模型、定制的语义分割网络生成掩模，并通过定向邻域插值和局部高斯平滑进行修复，有效保留了纳米级结构细节。
ai_comments: 创新点在于结合了机器学习（分类和语义分割）来精确识别伪影区域，并引入了“结构化掩模引导的定向修复”策略，特别是基于结构方向的掩模扩展和定向邻域插值，以维护AFM图像特有的3D表面几何连续性。其重要性在于提供了一个实用的、用户友好的（通过GUI实现）全自动解决方案，提高了AFM数据分析的可靠性和效率。
motivation: 原子力显微镜（AFM）图像常因环境噪声、扫描缺陷和针尖-样品相互作用而引入伪影，影响了高分辨率表面成像的质量和数据的准确解读。
method: 该流程首先使用分类模型判断图像是否存在伪影。若有，则应用定制的轻量级语义分割网络生成精确的伪影掩模。然后，根据结构方向自适应扩展掩模，并使用基于定向邻域的插值策略进行修复，以保持3D表面连续性。最后进行局部高斯平滑以实现无缝恢复。整个系统集成了用户友好的图形界面。
results: 实验结果表明，该方法能有效去除伪影，同时保留纳米级结构细节，提供了一个鲁棒、几何感知的解决方案。
conclusion: 该框架为高保真AFM数据解释提供了一个鲁棒且几何感知的解决方案。

title: SEIS: Subspace-based Equivariance and Invariance Scores for Neural Representations
authors: Huahua Lin, Katayoun Farrahi, Xiaohao Cai
abstract: Understanding how neural representations respond to geometric transformations is essential for evaluating whether learned features preserve meaningful spatial structure. Existing approaches primarily assess robustness by comparing model outputs under transformed inputs, offering limited insight into how geometric information is organized within internal representations and failing to distinguish between information loss and re-encoding. In this work, we introduce SEIS (Subspace-based Equivariance and Invariance Scores), a subspace metric for analyzing layer-wise feature representations under geometric transformations, disentangling equivariance from invariance without requiring labels or explicit knowledge of the transformation. Synthetic validation confirms that SEIS correctly recovers known transformations. Applied to trained classification networks, SEIS reveals a transition from equivariance in early layers to invariance in deeper layers, and that data augmentation increases invariance while preserving equivariance. We further show that multi-task learning induces synergistic gains in both properties at the shared encoder, and skip connections restore equivariance lost during decoding.
zh_title: SEIS：基于子空间的神经网络表示的等变性与不变性得分
translation: 理解神经网络表示如何响应几何变换，对于评估学习到的特征是否保留了有意义的空间结构至关重要。现有的方法主要通过比较变换输入下的模型输出来评估鲁棒性，但对几何信息如何在内部表示中组织提供的见解有限，并且无法区分信息丢失和信息重新编码。在本文中，我们引入了SEIS（基于子空间的等变性与不变性得分），这是一种用于分析几何变换下逐层特征表示的子空间度量，它能够在不需要标签或显式变换知识的情况下，将等变性与不变性解耦。合成验证证实SEIS能正确恢复已知变换。将其应用于训练好的分类网络，SEIS揭示了从浅层的等变性到深层的不变性的过渡，并且数据增强提高了不变性，同时保留了等变性。我们进一步表明，多任务学习在共享编码器中诱导了两种特性（等变性和不变性）的协同增益，并且跳跃连接恢复了在解码过程中丢失的等变性。
tldr: 引入了SEIS，一种新的基于子空间的度量方法，用于分析神经网络内部表示，以解耦和量化几何变换下的等变性和不变性。实验揭示了网络层中从等变性到不变性的过渡，以及数据增强和多任务学习对这些性质的影响。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于提出了SEIS这一基于子空间的度量，它超越了现有的仅评估模型输出鲁棒性的方法。其重要性在于，它首次提供了一种无需标签即可在内部表示中解耦等变性与不变性的工具，从而对特征组织提供了细粒度的洞察。研究结果揭示了网络内部表示的演变规律（从等变性到不变性）以及常见训练策略（如数据增强和多任务学习）对这些核心几何属性的精确影响，这对表示学习领域具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的方法主要通过比较变换输入下的模型输出来评估鲁棒性，但对几何信息如何在内部表示中组织提供的见解有限，并且无法区分信息丢失和信息重新编码。
method: 提出了SEIS（基于子空间的等变性与不变性得分），这是一种用于分析几何变换下逐层特征表示的子空间度量。它能够在不需要标签或显式变换知识的情况下，将等变性与不变性解耦。
results: 1. 合成验证证实SEIS能正确恢复已知变换。2. 训练好的分类网络显示出从浅层的等变性到深层的不变性的过渡。3. 数据增强提高了不变性，同时保留了等变性。4. 多任务学习在共享编码器中带来了两种特性（等变性和不变性）的协同增益。5. 跳跃连接恢复了在解码过程中丢失的等变性。
conclusion: SEIS提供了一种新的工具来深入理解几何信息如何在神经网络表示中组织和演变。它揭示了训练范式（如数据增强和多任务学习）对网络内部等变性和不变性的具体影响。

title: An Anatomy-specific Guidewire Shaping Robot for Improved Vascular Navigation
authors: Aabha Tamhankar, Jay Patil, Giovanni Pittiglio
abstract: Neuroendovascular access often relies on passive microwires that are hand-shaped at the back table and then used to track a microcatheter to the target. Neuroendovascular surgeons determine the shape of the wire by examining the patient pre-operative images and using their experience to identify anatomy specific shapes of the wire that would facilitate reaching the target. This procedure is particularly complex in convoluted anatomical structures and is heavily dependent on the level of expertise of the surgeon. Towards enabling standardized autonomous shaping, we present a bench-top guidewire shaping robot capable of producing navigation-specific desired wire configurations. We present a model that can map the desired wire shape into robot actions, calibrated using experimental data. We show that the robot can produce clinically common tip geometries (C, S, Angled, Hook) and validate them with respect to the model-predicted shapes in 2D. Our model predicts the shape with a Root Mean Square (RMS) error of 0.56mm across all shapes when compared to the experimental results. We also demonstrate 3D tip shaping capabilities and the ability to traverse complex endoluminal navigation from the petrous Internal Carotid Artery (ICA) to the Posterior Communicating Artery (PComm).
zh_title: 一种解剖结构特异性的导丝塑形机器人，用于改进血管导航
translation: 神经血管内通路通常依赖于无源微导丝，这些导丝在手术台后被手动塑形，然后用于引导微导管到达目标。神经血管内外科医生通过检查患者的术前图像并利用他们的经验来确定有助于到达目标的特定解剖结构形状。这种手术在复杂的解剖结构中尤其复杂，并且严重依赖于外科医生的专业水平。为了实现标准化的自主塑形，我们提出了一种台式导丝塑形机器人，该机器人能够生成导航所需的导丝配置。我们提出了一个模型，该模型可以使用实验数据进行校准，将所需的导丝形状映射到机器人的动作。我们展示了该机器人可以生成临床上常见的尖端几何形状（C形、S形、倾斜形、钩形），并在2D中根据模型预测的形状进行了验证。与实验结果相比，我们的模型对所有形状的预测均方根（RMS）误差为0.56毫米。我们还展示了3D尖端塑形能力，以及从岩骨段颈内动脉（ICA）到后交通动脉（PComm）穿越复杂内腔导航的能力。
tldr: 针对神经血管内导丝塑形复杂且依赖经验的问题，本文提出了一种导丝塑形机器人，实现了自主标准化塑形。该机器人能准确生成常见的2D/3D形状，2D误差仅0.56毫米，并成功演示了复杂血管导航。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于利用机器人技术和校准模型，首次实现了对神经血管内介入手术中高度依赖医生经验的导丝塑形过程的标准化和自动化。0.56毫米的均方根误差证明了其高精度潜力。这项工作对于提高复杂神经血管内手术的可重复性、降低对医生专业知识的依赖具有重要意义，是迈向自主血管导航的关键一步。然而，摘要中提及的验证主要基于台式实验（2D和3D形状生成及体外导航演示），实际临床应用的动态复杂性和安全性仍需进一步研究。
motivation: 神经血管内介入手术依赖于手动塑形的微导丝。这种塑形复杂且高度依赖于外科医生的经验和专业知识，尤其是在复杂的解剖结构中。本文旨在实现标准化、自主化的塑形。
method: 提出了一种台式导丝塑形机器人，能够生成导航所需的导丝配置。开发了一个利用实验数据校准的模型，将所需的导丝形状映射到机器人的动作。展示了2D和3D塑形能力。
results: 机器人可以生成临床常见的尖端几何形状（C形、S形、倾斜形、钩形）。在2D验证中，与实验结果相比，模型的均方根（RMS）误差为0.56毫米。还展示了3D尖端塑形能力，并成功演示了从岩骨段颈内动脉（ICA）到后交通动脉（PComm）的复杂内腔导航。
conclusion: 该机器人成功实现了标准化、自主化的解剖结构特异性导丝塑形，通过低误差率和成功演示复杂导航任务得到了验证，有助于改进血管导航。

title: Modular Safety Guardrails Are Necessary for Foundation-Model-Enabled Robots in the Real World
authors: Joonkyung Kim, Wenxi Chen, Davood Soleymanzadeh, Yi Ding, Xiangbo Gao, Zhengzhong Tu, Ruqi Zhang, Fan Fei, Sushant Veer, Yiwei Lyu, Minghui Zheng, Yan Gu
abstract: The integration of foundation models (FMs) into robotics has accelerated real-world deployment, while introducing new safety challenges arising from open-ended semantic reasoning and embodied physical action. These challenges require safety notions beyond physical constraint satisfaction. In this paper, we characterize FM-enabled robot safety along three dimensions: action safety (physical feasibility and constraint compliance), decision safety (semantic and contextual appropriateness), and human-centered safety (conformance to human intent, norms, and expectations). We argue that existing approaches, including static verification, monolithic controllers, and end-to-end learned policies, are insufficient in settings where tasks, environments, and human expectations are open-ended, long-tailed, and subject to adaptation over time. To address this gap, we propose modular safety guardrails, consisting of monitoring (evaluation) and intervention layers, as an architectural foundation for comprehensive safety across the autonomy stack. Beyond modularity, we highlight possible cross-layer co-design opportunities through representation alignment and conservatism allocation to enable faster, less conservative, and more effective safety enforcement. We call on the community to explore richer guardrail modules and principled co-design strategies to advance safe real-world physical AI deployment.
zh_title: 模块化安全护栏对于支持基础模型的真实世界机器人是必要的
translation: 基础模型（FM）集成到机器人技术中加速了现实世界的部署，同时也引入了源于开放式语义推理和具身物理动作的新安全挑战。这些挑战要求的安全概念超越了物理约束满足。在本文中，我们从三个维度描述了支持FM的机器人安全特性：动作安全（物理可行性和约束符合性）、决策安全（语义和上下文的适当性）以及以人为中心的安全（符合人类意图、规范和期望）。我们认为，在任务、环境和人类期望是开放式、长尾且随时间适应的设置中，现有方法（包括静态验证、整体控制器和端到端学习策略）是不足的。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了模块化安全护栏，它由监控（评估）层和干预层组成，作为跨自主堆栈实现全面安全的架构基础。除了模块化之外，我们还强调了通过表示对齐和保守性分配实现跨层协同设计的可能性，从而能够更快、更少保守、更有效地执行安全。我们呼吁社区探索更丰富的护栏模块和有原则的协同设计策略，以推进安全的现实世界物理AI部署。
tldr: 基础模型机器人面临开放式安全挑战。现有方法不足。本文提出模块化安全护栏（包括监控和干预层）作为全面安全的基础架构，并呼吁采用跨层协同设计策略来实现更有效、更少的保守的安全实施。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了模块化、多层次的安全架构，以应对基础模型（FM）在现实世界机器人中引入的开放式、长尾安全挑战。它超越了传统的物理约束，将安全概念扩展到语义、上下文和以人为中心的安全维度，这对于确保具身AI的部署具备信任度和可预测性至关重要。强调监控和干预的解耦以及跨层协同设计（如保守性分配）为未来机器人安全系统的设计提供了明确且必要的研究方向。
motivation: 基础模型(FM)加速了机器人在现实世界中的部署，但同时也带来了源于开放式语义推理和具身物理动作的新安全挑战。这些挑战要求的安全概念超越了物理约束满足，而现有方法在开放式、长尾和不断适应的环境中表现不足。
method: 首先，将支持FM的机器人安全特性归纳为三个维度：动作安全（物理可行性和约束符合性）、决策安全（语义和上下文的适当性）和以人为中心的安全（符合人类意图、规范和期望）。其次，提出模块化安全护栏，由监控（评估）层和干预层组成，作为实现全面安全的架构基础。此外，强调通过表示对齐和保守性分配实现跨层协同设计。
conclusion: 模块化安全护栏是解决支持基础模型的机器人在开放式、长尾和不断适应的环境中面临的安全挑战所必需的架构基础。社区应探索更丰富的护栏模块和有原则的协同设计策略，以推进安全的现实世界物理AI部署。

title: Control and State Estimation of Vehicle-Mounted Aerial Systems in GPS-Denied, Non-Inertial Environments
authors: Riming Xu, Obadah Wali, Yasmine Marani, Eric Feron
abstract: We present a robust control and estimation framework for quadrotors operating in Global Navigation Satellite System(GNSS)-denied, non-inertial environments where inertial sensors such as Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) become unreliable due to platform-induced accelerations. In such settings, conventional estimators fail to distinguish whether the measured accelerations arise from the quadrotor itself or from the non-inertial platform, leading to drift and control degradation. Unlike conventional approaches that depend heavily on IMU and GNSS, our method relies exclusively on external position measurements combined with a Extended Kalman Filter with Unknown Inputs (EKF-UI) to account for platform motion. The estimator is paired with a cascaded PID controller for full 3D tracking. To isolate estimator performance from localization errors, all tests are conducted using high-precision motion capture systems. Experimental results in a moving-cart testbed validate our approach under both translational in X-axis and Y-axis dissonance. Compared to standard EKF, the proposed method significantly improves stability and trajectory tracking without requiring inertial feedback, enabling practical deployment on moving platforms such as trucks or elevators.
zh_title: 车载航空系统在GPS缺失和非惯性环境下的控制与状态估计
translation: 我们提出了一种鲁棒的控制和估计框架，用于在全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）缺失、非惯性环境中运行的四旋翼飞行器。在这种环境中，由于平台引起的加速度，惯性测量单元（IMU）等惯性传感器变得不可靠。在这种情况下，传统的估计器无法区分测得的加速度是来自四旋翼本身还是来自非惯性平台，从而导致漂移和控制性能下降。与严重依赖IMU和GNSS的传统方法不同，我们的方法完全依赖外部位置测量，并结合了带有未知输入扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF-UI）来解释平台运动。该估计器与级联PID控制器配对，用于完整的3D跟踪。为了将估计器性能与定位误差隔离，所有测试均使用高精度运动捕捉系统进行。在移动推车试验台上的实验结果验证了我们的方法在X轴和Y轴平移不和谐下的有效性。与标准EKF相比，所提出的方法显著提高了稳定性和轨迹跟踪性能，且无需惯性反馈，使其能够实际部署在卡车或电梯等移动平台上。
tldr: 针对车载无人机在无GPS和运动平台上的控制与估计问题，本文提出了一种不依赖惯性传感器的、基于外部位置测量和EKF-UI的框架，显著提高了轨迹跟踪的稳定性和性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个完全不依赖惯性传感器（IMU）的四旋翼控制和估计方案，这对于在剧烈运动的非惯性平台（如车辆或船只）上部署无人机具有重要的实际意义。通过将平台运动建模为未知输入并使用EKF-UI进行处理，有效地解决了非惯性参考系下的状态漂移问题。其重要性在于拓宽了无人机操作环境的边界，使其能适应更具挑战性的应用场景。局限性可能在于，该方法完全依赖“外部位置测量”，这在实际的GNSS缺失环境中可能需要高精度的视觉系统或UWB等替代定位技术。
motivation: 传统的控制和估计框架在GPS缺失和非惯性环境中（如移动平台）表现不佳。平台诱导的加速度使得IMU等惯性传感器不可靠，导致常规估计器无法区分四旋翼自身的加速度和平台运动带来的加速度，从而引发漂移和控制性能下降。
method: 提出了一种鲁棒的控制和估计框架。该方法完全依赖外部位置测量，并使用带有未知输入扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF-UI）来处理平台运动。估计器与级联PID控制器相结合，实现完整的3D跟踪。所有测试均使用高精度运动捕捉系统进行。
results: 通过移动推车试验台的实验验证了该方法在X轴和Y轴平移不和谐下的有效性。与标准EKF相比，所提出的方法在不需要惯性反馈的情况下，显著提高了稳定性和轨迹跟踪性能。
conclusion: 该框架使四旋翼飞行器能够实际部署在移动平台（如卡车或电梯）上。

title: Minimizing Makespan in Sublinear Time via Weighted Random Sampling
authors: Bin Fu, Yumei Huo, Hairong Zhao
abstract:
We consider the classical makespan minimization scheduling problem where $n$ jobs must be scheduled on $m$ identical machines. Using weighted random sampling, we developed two sublinear time approximation schemes: one for the case where $n$ is known and the other for the case where $n$ is unknown. Both algorithms not only give a $(1+3ε)$-approximation to the optimal makespan but also generate a sketch schedule.
  Our first algorithm, which targets the case where $n$ is known and draws samples in a single round under weighted random sampling, has a running time of $\tilde{O}(\tfrac{m^5}{ε^4} \sqrt{n}+A(\ceiling{m\over ε}, ε ))$, where
  $A(\mathcal{N}, α)$ is the time complexity of any $(1+α)$-approximation scheme for the makespan minimization of $\mathcal{N}$ jobs.
  The second algorithm addresses the case where $n$ is unknown. It uses adaptive weighted random sampling, %\textit{that is}, it draws samples in several rounds, adjusting the number of samples after each round,
  and runs in sublinear time $\tilde{O}\left( \tfrac{m^5} {ε^4} \sqrt{n} +
  A(\ceiling{m\over ε}, ε )\right)$. We also provide an implementation that generates a weighted random sample using $O(\log n)$ uniform random samples.
zh_title: 通过加权随机采样在次线性时间内最小化完工时间
translation: 我们考虑经典的最小化完工时间调度问题，其中$n$个作业必须调度到$m$台相同的机器上。利用加权随机采样，我们开发了两种次线性时间的近似方案：一种针对$n$已知的情况，另一种针对$n$未知的情况。这两种算法不仅能提供最优完工时间的$(1+3\epsilon)$-近似，而且还能生成一个草图调度。我们的第一个算法针对$n$已知的情况，并在加权随机采样下进行单轮采样，其运行时间为$\tilde{O}(\tfrac{m^5}{\epsilon^4} \sqrt{n}+A(\ceiling{m\over \epsilon}, \epsilon ))$，其中$A(\mathcal{N}, \alpha)$是任何针对$\mathcal{N}$个作业的最小化完工时间的$(1+\alpha)$-近似方案的时间复杂度。第二个算法解决了$n$未知的情况。它使用自适应加权随机采样，并在次线性时间$\tilde{O}\left( \tfrac{m^5} {\epsilon^4} \sqrt{n} + A(\ceiling{m\over \epsilon}, \epsilon )\right)$内运行。我们还提供了一种实现，该实现使用$O(\log n)$个均匀随机样本来生成一个加权随机样本。
tldr: 针对经典的最小化完工时间问题，本文提出了两种基于加权随机采样的次线性时间近似算法，无论作业数量$n$是否已知，都能实现$(1+3\epsilon)$近似比，运行时间复杂度与$\sqrt{n}$相关。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将加权随机采样引入到完工时间最小化问题中，成功地设计出次线性时间（即运行时间与作业总数$n$的平方根相关）的近似算法。在处理大规模数据和流式环境时，这种次线性时间复杂度具有极高的实际价值。特别是，该方法不仅给出了近似解，还生成了“草图调度”（sketch schedule），这可能意味着提供了一个可用于后续精炼或分析的紧凑表示。同时，它还解决了$n$是否已知这一重要的现实约束（通过自适应采样），展现了算法的鲁棒性。
motivation: 解决经典的$n$个作业在$m$台相同机器上调度以最小化完工时间的问题，并寻求在次线性时间复杂度内实现高效的近似调度方案。
method: 采用加权随机采样技术，设计了两种次线性时间近似方案：1. 对于$n$已知的情况，使用单轮加权随机采样。2. 对于$n$未知的情况，使用自适应加权随机采样（多轮采样）。此外，还提供了一种使用$O(\log n)$个均匀随机样本生成加权随机样本的实现。
results: 1. 两种算法都提供了对最优完工时间的$(1+3\epsilon)$-近似。2. 两种算法都生成了一个“草图调度”（sketch schedule）。3. 两种算法的运行时间均为$\tilde{O}\left( \tfrac{m^5} {\epsilon^4} \sqrt{n} + A(\lceil\frac{m}{\epsilon}\rceil, \epsilon )\right)$，其中$A(\mathcal{N}, \alpha)$是$\mathcal{N}$个作业的$(1+\alpha)$-近似方案的时间复杂度。

title: Exploring the Potential of Large Language Models in Simulink-Stateflow Mutant Generation
authors: Pablo Valle, Shaukat Ali, Aitor Arrieta
abstract: Mutation analysis is a powerful technique for assessing test-suite adequacy, yet conventional approaches suffer from generating redundant, equivalent, or non-executable mutants. These challenges are particularly amplified in Simulink-Stateflow models due to the hierarchical structure these models have, which integrate continuous dynamics with discrete-event behaviors and are widely deployed in safety-critical Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs). While prior work has explored machine learning and manually engineered mutation operators, these approaches remain constrained by limited training data and scalability issues. Motivated by recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), we investigate their potential to generate high-quality, domain-specific mutants for Simulink-Stateflow models. We develop an automated pipeline that converts Simulink-Stateflow models to structured JSON representations and systematically evaluates different mutation and prompting strategies across eight state-of-the-art LLMs. Through a comprehensive empirical study involving 38,400 LLM-generated mutants across four Simulink-Stateflow models, we demonstrate that LLMs generate mutants up to 13x faster than a manually engineered mutation-based baseline while producing significantly fewer equivalent and duplicate mutants and consistently achieving superior mutant quality. Moreover, our analysis reveals that few-shot prompting combined with low-to-medium temperature values yields optimal results. We provide an open-source prototype tool and release our complete dataset to facilitate reproducibility and advance future research in this domain.
zh_title: 探索大型语言模型在Simulink-Stateflow变异体生成中的潜力
translation: 变异分析是评估测试套件充分性的有力技术，但传统方法在生成冗余、等效或不可执行的变异体方面存在缺陷。这些挑战在Simulink-Stateflow模型中尤为突出，因为这些模型具有集成连续动力学和离散事件行为的层次结构，并广泛部署在安全关键的赛博物理系统中（CPS）。虽然以往的工作探索了机器学习和手动工程的变异算子，但这些方法仍然受到有限的训练数据和可扩展性问题的限制。受大型语言模型（LLMs）最新进展的启发，我们研究了它们为Simulink-Stateflow模型生成高质量、领域特定变异体的潜力。我们开发了一个自动化流程，将Simulink-Stateflow模型转换为结构化JSON表示，并在八种最先进的LLMs上系统地评估了不同的变异和提示策略。通过涉及四个Simulink-Stateflow模型的38,400个LLM生成变异体的全面实证研究，我们证明了LLMs的生成速度比手动工程的变异基础线快13倍，同时产生的等效和重复变异体明显更少，并始终保持更高的变异体质量。此外，我们的分析表明，少样本提示结合低到中等温度值可产生最佳结果。我们提供了一个开源原型工具，并发布了我们的完整数据集，以促进该领域的重现性和未来研究。
tldr: 研究人员利用LLMs为复杂的Simulink-Stateflow模型自动生成变异体，发现LLMs速度快13倍，且生成的变异体质量更高，推荐使用少样本提示配合中等温度设置。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次将大型语言模型（LLMs）应用于Simulink-Stateflow模型的变异生成，解决了传统方法中变异体质量低和可扩展性差的问题。重要性在于它为安全关键的CPS测试套件评估提供了一种高效且高质量的新范式。局限性可能在于对特定领域（Simulink-Stateflow）的依赖，以及LLM生成过程的随机性仍需进一步控制。
motivation: 传统的变异分析方法在生成冗余、等效或不可执行的变异体方面存在问题，这在具有复杂结构（集成连续动力学和离散事件行为）的Simulink-Stateflow模型中尤为突出。现有基于机器学习和手动工程算子的方法受限于有限的训练数据和可扩展性问题。受LLM最新进展的启发，研究旨在探索LLM生成高质量、领域特定变异体的潜力。
method: 开发了一个自动化流程，将Simulink-Stateflow模型转换为结构化JSON表示，并在八种最先进的LLMs上系统地评估了不同的变异和提示策略。进行了全面的实证研究，使用了四个模型的38,400个LLM生成的变异体。
results: LLMs的生成速度比手动工程的基于变异的基线快13倍，产生的等效和重复变异体明显更少，并且始终保持更高的变异体质量。少样本提示结合低到中等温度值产生最佳结果。
conclusion: 研究表明，LLMs在生成Simulink-Stateflow模型的高质量、领域特定变异体方面具有巨大潜力，其生成速度比手动工程基线快13倍，且产生的等效和重复变异体显著减少，变异体质量更高。此外，少样本提示结合低到中等温度值能产生最佳结果。

title: An Empirical Survey and Benchmark of Learned Distance Indexes for Road Networks
authors: Gautam Choudhary, Libin Zhou, Yeasir Rayhan, Walid G. Aref
abstract: The calculation of shortest-path distances in road networks is a core operation in navigation systems, location-based services, and spatial analytics. Although classical algorithms, e.g., Dijkstra's algorithm, provide exact answers, their latency is prohibitive for modern real-time, large-scale deployments. Over the past two decades, numerous distance indexes have been proposed to speed up query processing for shortest distance queries. More recently, with the advancement in machine learning (ML), researchers have designed and proposed ML-based distance indexes to answer approximate shortest path and distance queries efficiently. However, a comprehensive and systematic evaluation of these ML-based approaches is lacking. This paper presents the first empirical survey of ML-based distance indexes on road networks, evaluating them along four key dimensions: Training time, query latency, storage, and accuracy. Using seven real-world road networks and workload-driven query datasets derived from trajectory data, we benchmark ten representative ML techniques and compare them against strong classical non-ML baselines, highlighting key insights and practical trade-offs. We release a unified open-source codebase to support reproducibility and future research on learned distance indexes.
zh_title: 面向道路网络的学习距离索引的实证调查与基准测试
translation: 导航系统、基于位置的服务和空间分析中的核心操作是计算道路网络中的最短路径距离。虽然 Dijkstra 等经典算法可以提供精确的答案，但它们的延迟对于现代实时、大规模部署来说是不可接受的。在过去的二十年里，为了加速最短距离查询的处理，人们提出了大量的距离索引。最近，随着机器学习 (ML) 的进步，研究人员设计并提出了基于 ML 的距离索引，以高效地回答近似最短路径和距离查询。然而，目前缺乏对这些基于 ML 的方法的全面和系统的评估。本文首次对道路网络上的基于 ML 的距离索引进行了实证调查，从训练时间、查询延迟、存储和准确性四个关键维度对其进行了评估。我们使用七个真实世界的道路网络和源自轨迹数据的驱动工作负载的查询数据集，对十种代表性的 ML 技术进行了基准测试，并将它们与强大的经典非 ML 基线进行了比较，突出了关键的见解和实际的权衡。我们发布了一个统一的开源代码库，以支持可复现性和未来关于学习距离索引的研究。
tldr: 该论文首次对基于机器学习的道路网络距离索引进行了实证调查，评估了它们的训练时间、查询延迟、存储和准确性，并与经典方法进行了比较。
ai_comments: 这项研究填补了机器学习在道路网络距离索引领域评估的空白，其方法论严谨，并提供了有价值的开源资源，但未来的研究可以进一步探索更复杂的网络拓扑和动态变化的环境。
motivation: 传统的最短路径距离计算方法在实时、大规模应用中延迟过高，而现有的机器学习方法缺乏全面的评估。
method: 对七个真实道路网络和轨迹数据衍生的查询数据集，评估了十种代表性的机器学习方法以及非机器学习基线，重点关注训练时间、查询延迟、存储和准确性。
results: 论文进行了实证调查和基准测试，揭示了机器学习方法在道路网络距离查询中的关键见解和实际权衡。
conclusion: 该论文提供了对基于机器学习的道路网络距离索引的首次全面实证调查，并发布了一个开源代码库以支持未来的研究。

title: The CitizenQuery Benchmark: A Novel Dataset and Evaluation Pipeline for Measuring LLM Performance in Citizen Query Tasks
authors: Neil Majithia, Rajat Shinde, Zo Chapman, Prajun Trital, Jordan Decker, Manil Maskey, Elena Simperl, Nigel Shadbolt
abstract:
"Citizen queries" are questions asked by an individual about government policies, guidance, and services that are relevant to their circumstances, encompassing a range of topics including benefits, taxes, immigration, employment, public health, and more. This represents a compelling use case for Large Language Models (LLMs) that respond to citizen queries with information that is adapted to a user's context and communicated according to their needs. However, in this use case, any misinformation could have severe, negative, likely invisible ramifications for an individual placing their trust in a model's response.
  To this effect, we introduce CitizenQuery-UK, a benchmark dataset of 22 thousand pairs of citizen queries and responses that have been synthetically generated from the swathes of public information on $gov.uk$ about government in the UK. We present the curation methodology behind CitizenQuery-UK and an overview of its contents. We also introduce a methodology for the benchmarking of LLMs with the dataset, using an adaptation of FActScore to benchmark 11 models for factuality, abstention frequency, and verbosity. We document these results, and interpret them in the context of the public sector, finding that: (i) there are distinct performance profiles across model families, but each is competitive; (ii) high variance undermines utility; (iii) abstention is low and verbosity is high, with implications on reliability; and (iv) more trustworthy AI requires acknowledged "fallibility" in the way it interacts with users.
  The contribution of our research lies in assessing the trustworthiness of LLMs in citizen query tasks; as we see a world of increasing AI integration into day-to-day life, our benchmark, built entirely on open data, lays the foundations for better evidenced decision-making regarding AI and the public sector.
zh_title: 公民查询基准：衡量 LLM 在公民查询任务中性能的新型数据集和评估管道
translation: “公民查询”是指个人就与其自身情况相关的政府政策、指导和服务的提问，涵盖福利、税收、移民、就业、公共卫生等一系列主题。这代表了大型语言模型（LLM）的一个引人注目的用例，即根据用户的具体情况提供信息，并根据用户的需求进行沟通。然而，在此用例中，任何错误信息都可能对用户因信任模型的回应而产生的严重、负面且可能不可见的后果。为此，我们引入了 CitizenQuery-UK，一个包含 22,000 对公民查询和响应的基准数据集，这些数据是从 $gov.uk$ 上关于英国政府的大量公开信息中合成生成的。我们介绍了 CitizenQuery-UK 背后的数据整理方法及其内容概述。我们还介绍了一种使用该数据集对 LLM 进行基准测试的方法，该方法采用了 FActScore 的一种改编，对 11 个模型在事实性、弃权频率和冗长性方面进行了基准测试。我们记录了这些结果，并结合公共部门的背景进行了解释，发现：（i）不同模型家族在性能上存在明显差异，但各具竞争力；（ii）高方差削弱了实用性；（iii）弃权率低且冗长性高，对可靠性有影响；（iv）更值得信赖的 AI 需要在与用户交互的方式中承认其“易错性”。我们研究的贡献在于评估 LLM 在公民查询任务中的可信度；随着人工智能越来越多地融入日常生活，我们这个完全基于开放数据构建的基准，为围绕人工智能和公共部门的更好证据决策奠定了基础。
tldr: 该研究提出了 CitizenQuery-UK，一个包含 22,000 个公民查询及其对应回复的数据集，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在处理公民查询方面的表现。研究还提出了一种评估方法，并对 11 个模型进行了基准测试，结果表明不同模型家族在事实性、弃权频率和冗长性方面表现各异，但都具有竞争力。研究强调了提高 AI 可信度的重要性，尤其是在公共部门的应用中。
ai_comments: 该研究在公民查询这一重要且敏感的应用领域，为评估 LLM 的性能提供了一个新颖且实用的基准。数据集的构建基于公开数据，评估方法结合了事实性、弃权和冗长性，这对于理解 LLM 在公共服务中的可靠性至关重要。然而，研究中提到的高方差和高冗长性问题，以及对“易错性”的强调，也指出了当前 LLM 在实际应用中仍需改进的方向。未来的工作可以关注如何降低方差，控制冗长性，并进一步探索如何在保证信息准确性的前提下，提升 LLM 与用户的交互体验。
motivation: 公民查询是个人关于政府政策、指导和服务的提问，这是一个大型语言模型（LLM）的潜在应用场景。然而，错误信息可能带来严重的负面影响。因此，需要一个基准来评估 LLM 在此场景下的表现。
method: 创建了一个名为 CitizenQuery-UK 的基准数据集，包含 22,000 个公民查询及其回复，这些数据是从英国政府公开信息中合成生成的。并采用改进的 FActScore 方法对 11 个 LLM 在事实性、弃权频率和冗长性方面进行了基准测试。
results: 对 11 个模型的评估结果显示：不同模型家族的表现各具特色，但都具有竞争力；结果存在高方差，影响了实用性；模型弃权率低，但冗长性高，这对可靠性有影响；更值得信赖的 AI 需要承认其与用户交互时的“易错性”。
conclusion: 该研究提出的 CitizenQuery-UK 基准数据集和评估方法，为评估 LLM 在公民查询任务中的可信度奠定了基础，有助于公共部门在 AI 决策方面做出更充分的证据支持。

title: iSight: Towards expert-AI co-assessment for improved immunohistochemistry staining interpretation
authors: Jacob S. Leiby, Jialu Yao, Pan Lu, George Hu, Anna Davidian, Shunsuke Koga, Olivia Leung, Pravin Patel, Isabella Tondi Resta, Rebecca Rojansky, Derek Sung, Eric Yang, Paul J. Zhang, Emma Lundberg, Dokyoon Kim, Serena Yeung-Levy, James Zou, Thomas Montine, Jeffrey Nirschl, Zhi Huang
abstract: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) provides information on protein expression in tissue sections and is commonly used to support pathology diagnosis and disease triage. While AI models for H\&E-stained slides show promise, their applicability to IHC is limited due to domain-specific variations. Here we introduce HPA10M, a dataset that contains 10,495,672 IHC images from the Human Protein Atlas with comprehensive metadata included, and encompasses 45 normal tissue types and 20 major cancer types. Based on HPA10M, we trained iSight, a multi-task learning framework for automated IHC staining assessment. iSight combines visual features from whole-slide images with tissue metadata through a token-level attention mechanism, simultaneously predicting staining intensity, location, quantity, tissue type, and malignancy status. On held-out data, iSight achieved 85.5\% accuracy for location, 76.6\% for intensity, and 75.7\% for quantity, outperforming fine-tuned foundation models (PLIP, CONCH) by 2.5--10.2\%. In addition, iSight demonstrates well-calibrated predictions with expected calibration errors of 0.0150-0.0408. Furthermore, in a user study with eight pathologists evaluating 200 images from two datasets, iSight outperformed initial pathologist assessments on the held-out HPA dataset (79\% vs 68\% for location, 70\% vs 57\% for intensity, 68\% vs 52\% for quantity). Inter-pathologist agreement also improved after AI assistance in both held-out HPA (Cohen's $κ$ increased from 0.63 to 0.70) and Stanford TMAD datasets (from 0.74 to 0.76), suggesting expert--AI co-assessment can improve IHC interpretation. This work establishes a foundation for AI systems that can improve IHC diagnostic accuracy and highlights the potential for integrating iSight into clinical workflows to enhance the consistency and reliability of IHC assessment.
zh_title: iSight：迈向专家-人工智能协同评估以改进免疫组织化学染色解释
translation: 免疫组织化学（IHC）提供组织切片中蛋白质表达的信息，并常用于支持病理诊断和疾病分诊。虽然针对H&E染色切片的AI模型显示出前景，但由于领域特定的变化，其在IHC中的适用性受到限制。在此，我们介绍了HPA10M，一个包含来自人类蛋白质图谱（Human Protein Atlas）的10,495,672张IHC图像的数据集，并包含全面的元数据，涵盖45种正常组织类型和20种主要癌症类型。基于HPA10M，我们训练了iSight，一个用于自动化IHC染色评估的多任务学习框架。iSight通过令牌级注意力机制将来自全切片图像的视觉特征与组织元数据相结合，同时预测染色强度、位置、数量、组织类型和恶性状态。在保留数据上，iSight在位置准确率方面达到85.5%，强度方面达到76.6%，数量方面达到75.7%，其性能优于微调后的基础模型（PLIP、CONCH）2.5-10.2%。此外，iSight显示出良好的校准预测，预期校准误差为0.0150-0.0408。此外，在一项涉及八名病理学家评估两个数据集的200张图像的用户研究中，iSight在保留的HPA数据集上（位置方面为79% vs 68%，强度方面为70% vs 57%，数量方面为68% vs 52%）优于病理学家的初步评估。在保留的HPA（Cohen's κ值从0.63增加到0.70）和斯坦福TMAD数据集（从0.74增加到0.76）中，病理学家之间的一致性也得到了提高，这表明专家-AI协同评估可以提高IHC解释的准确性。这项工作为能够提高IHC诊断准确性的AI系统奠定了基础，并突显了将iSight集成到临床工作流程中以提高IHC评估的一致性和可靠性的潜力。
tldr: 该研究提出了HPA10M数据集和iSight模型，用于免疫组织化学（IHC）染色评估，通过结合图像和元数据，在染色强度、位置、数量、组织类型和恶性状态预测方面取得了优于现有模型的性能，并在用户研究中显示出提高病理学家解释一致性和准确性的潜力。
ai_comments: 该研究在IHC染色解释领域取得了重要进展，通过构建大规模数据集和开发创新的AI模型，有效解决了现有AI模型在处理IHC图像时的局限性。iSight模型结合视觉特征和元数据的多任务学习方法具有新颖性，并在用户研究中验证了其临床应用潜力。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索模型在更多样化的数据集和临床场景下的泛化能力，以及更深入地理解AI辅助如何具体影响病理学家的决策过程。
motivation: 现有的AI模型在免疫组织化学（IHC）染色评估中的应用受限于领域特定变化；需要开发能够支持病理诊断和疾病分诊的AI工具，以提高IHC解释的准确性和一致性。
method: 构建包含10,495,672张IHC图像和全面元数据的人类蛋白质图谱（HPA10M）数据集；开发了一个名为iSight的多任务学习框架，该框架结合了全切片图像的视觉特征和组织元数据，并通过令牌级注意力机制同时预测染色强度、位置、数量、组织类型和恶性状态。
results: iSight在位置、强度和数量预测方面分别达到了85.5%、76.6%和75.7%的准确率，优于微调后的基础模型（PLIP、CONCH）2.5-10.2%；其预测具有良好的校准性，预期校准误差在0.0150-0.0408之间；在用户研究中，iSight辅助的病理学家在位置、强度和数量评估方面表现优于单独的病理学家；AI辅助能够提高病理学家之间的一致性（Cohen's κ值增加）。
conclusion: iSight框架结合了视觉特征和元数据，能够准确评估IHC染色，并在用户研究中显示出提高病理学家解释一致性和准确性的潜力，为开发改善IHC诊断准确性的AI系统奠定了基础，并有望集成到临床工作流程中。

title: Agentic AI-Empowered Dynamic Survey Framework
authors: Furkan Mumcu, Lokman Bekit, Michael J. Jones, Anoop Cherian, Yasin Yilmaz
abstract: Survey papers play a central role in synthesizing and organizing scientific knowledge, yet they are increasingly strained by the rapid growth of research output. As new work continues to appear after publication, surveys quickly become outdated, contributing to redundancy and fragmentation in the literature. We reframe survey writing as a long-horizon maintenance problem rather than a one-time generation task, treating surveys as living documents that evolve alongside the research they describe. We propose an agentic Dynamic Survey Framework that supports the continuous updating of existing survey papers by incrementally integrating new work while preserving survey structure and minimizing unnecessary disruption. Using a retrospective experimental setup, we demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively identifies and incorporates emerging research while preserving the coherence and structure of existing surveys.
zh_title: 智能体AI赋能的动态综述框架
translation: 综述论文在综合和组织科学知识中起着核心作用，但它们正日益受到研究产出快速增长的压力。随着新工作的不断出现，综述很快就会过时，导致文献中的冗余和碎片化。我们将综述写作重新定义为一个长期的维护问题，而不是一次性的生成任务，将综述视为与它们所描述的研究同步演进的“活文档”。我们提出了一个智能体驱动的动态综述框架，该框架通过增量整合新工作来支持现有综述论文的持续更新，同时保持综述结构并最大限度地减少不必要的干扰。我们使用回顾性实验设置证明，所提出的框架能够有效地识别和整合新兴研究，同时保持现有综述的连贯性和结构。
tldr: 传统综述太容易过时，我们提出了一个“智能体驱动的动态综述框架”，让综述像活文档一样持续自动更新，保持结构不变，解决了文献碎片化问题，并通过实验证明了其有效性。
ai_comments: 该论文的核心创新是将综述写作从一次性任务转变为需要长期维护的问题，并提出了一个由智能体驱动的动态框架来持续更新综述，这对于应对快速增长的研究文献具有重要意义。局限性在于，摘要中未提及具体的评估指标或与现有综述工具的详细对比。
motivation: 由于研究产出的快速增长，传统综述论文很快过时，导致文献中的冗余和碎片化。综述写作被重新定义为一个长期的维护问题，而不是一次性的生成任务。
method: 提出一个智能体驱动的动态综述框架（Agentic Dynamic Survey Framework），该框架通过增量整合新工作来支持现有综述的持续更新，同时保持综述结构和最小化不必要的干扰。方法采用回顾性实验设置进行验证。
results: 回顾性实验证明，所提出的框架能够有效地识别和整合新兴研究，同时保持现有综述的连贯性和结构。
conclusion: 所提出的框架有效地识别和整合了新兴研究，同时保持了现有综述的连贯性和结构。

title: Comparative Analysis of Autonomous Robotic and Manual Techniques for Ultrasonic Sacral Osteotomy: A Preliminary Study
authors: Daniyal Maroufi, Yash Kulkarni, Justin E. Bird, Jeffrey H. Siewerdsen, Farshid Alambeigi
abstract: In this paper, we introduce an autonomous Ultrasonic Sacral Osteotomy (USO) robotic system that integrates an ultrasonic osteotome with a seven-degree-of-freedom (DoF) robotic manipulator guided by an optical tracking system. To assess multi-directional control along both the surface trajectory and cutting depth of this system, we conducted quantitative comparisons between manual USO (MUSO) and robotic USO (RUSO) in Sawbones phantoms under identical osteotomy conditions. The RUSO system achieved sub-millimeter trajectory accuracy (0.11 mm RMSE), an order of magnitude improvement over MUSO (1.10 mm RMSE). Moreover, MUSO trials showed substantial over-penetration (16.0 mm achieved vs. 8.0 mm target), whereas the RUSO system maintained precise depth control (8.1 mm). These results demonstrate that robotic procedures can effectively overcome the critical limitations of manual osteotomy, establishing a foundation for safer and more precise sacral resections.
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, Accepted or publication in 2026 International Symposium on Medical Robotics (ISMR)
zh_title: 自主机器人与手动技术在超声骶骨截骨术中的比较分析：一项初步研究
translation: 在本文中，我们介绍了一种自主超声骶骨截骨（USO）机器人系统，该系统集成了超声骨刀与由光学跟踪系统引导的七自由度（DoF）机器人操作臂。为了评估该系统在表面轨迹和切割深度两个方向上的多向控制能力，我们在Sawbones模型上对手动USO（MUSO）和机器人USO（RUSO）进行了定量比较，并确保了相同的截骨条件。RUSO系统实现了亚毫米级的轨迹精度（0.11 mm RMSE），比MUSO（1.10 mm RMSE）提高了近一个数量级。此外，MUSO试验显示出明显的过度穿透（达到16.0 mm，目标为8.0 mm），而RUSO系统保持了精确的深度控制（8.1 mm）。这些结果表明，机器人手术可以有效克服手动截骨的关键限制，为更安全、更精确的骶骨切除术奠定基础。
tldr: 开发了一种自主超声骶骨截骨机器人，在Sawbones模型上，其轨迹精度（0.11mm RMSE）和深度控制（8.1mm）远优于手动操作（1.10mm RMSE，16.0mm过度穿透），证明了机器人技术在提高截骨精度方面的潜力。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将超声骨刀与七自由度机器人及光学跟踪系统相结合，实现了自主式骶骨截骨术。其重要性在于通过量化比较，首次证明了机器人技术在提高截骨精度和深度控制方面的显著优势，克服了传统手动方法的关键局限性。一个可能的局限是本研究仅在Sawbones模型上进行，实际临床应用效果尚待验证。
motivation: 评估和比较自主超声骶骨截骨（USO）机器人系统与传统手动USO在多方向控制（表面轨迹和切割深度）方面的性能。
method: 开发了一个集成了超声骨刀、七自由度机器人操作臂和光学跟踪系统的自主超声骶骨截骨（USO）机器人系统。在相同的截骨条件下，在Sawbones模型上对该系统（RUSO）与手动USO（MUSO）在表面轨迹和切割深度方面进行了定量比较。
results: RUSO系统实现了亚毫米级的轨迹精度（RMSE为0.11 mm），比MUSO（RMSE为1.10 mm）提高了近一个数量级。此外，MUSO试验显示出明显的过度穿透（达到16.0 mm，目标为8.0 mm），而RUSO系统保持了精确的深度控制（8.1 mm）。
conclusion: 机器人手术可以有效克服手动截骨的关键限制，为更安全、更精确的骶骨切除术奠定了基础。

title: Stroke Lesions as a Rosetta Stone for Language Model Interpretability
authors: Julius Fridriksson, Roger D. Newman-Norlund, Saeed Ahmadi, Regan Willis, Nadra Salman, Kalil Warren, Xiang Guan, Yong Yang, Srihari Nelakuditi, Rutvik Desai, Leonardo Bonilha, Jeff Charney, Chris Rorden
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities, yet methods to verify which model components are truly necessary for language function remain limited. Current interpretability approaches rely on internal metrics and lack external validation. Here we present the Brain-LLM Unified Model (BLUM), a framework that leverages lesion-symptom mapping, the gold standard for establishing causal brain-behavior relationships for over a century, as an external reference structure for evaluating LLM perturbation effects. Using data from individuals with chronic post-stroke aphasia (N = 410), we trained symptom-to-lesion models that predict brain damage location from behavioral error profiles, applied systematic perturbations to transformer layers, administered identical clinical assessments to perturbed LLMs and human patients, and projected LLM error profiles into human lesion space. LLM error profiles were sufficiently similar to human error profiles that predicted lesions corresponded to actual lesions in error-matched humans above chance in 67% of picture naming conditions (p < 10^{-23}) and 68.3% of sentence completion conditions (p < 10^{-61}), with semantic-dominant errors mapping onto ventral-stream lesion patterns and phonemic-dominant errors onto dorsal-stream patterns. These findings open a new methodological avenue for LLM interpretability in which clinical neuroscience provides external validation, establishing human lesion-symptom mapping as a reference framework for evaluating artificial language systems and motivating direct investigation of whether behavioral alignment reflects shared computational principles.
zh_title: 中风病灶作为语言模型可解释性的罗塞塔石碑
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已经取得了卓越的能力，但要验证哪些模型组件对于语言功能真正至关重要的方法仍然有限。目前的可解释性方法依赖于内部指标，缺乏外部验证。在这里，我们提出了脑-LLM统一模型（BLUM），一个利用病灶-症状映射的框架，该映射在一个多世纪以来一直是建立因果大脑-行为关系的黄金标准，作为评估LLM扰动效应的外部参考结构。利用患有慢性卒中后失语症的个体数据（N = 410），我们训练了症状-病灶模型，该模型根据行为错误配置文件预测脑损伤位置，对Transformer层进行系统性扰动，对受扰动的LLMs和人类患者进行相同的临床评估，并将LLM错误配置文件投射到人类病灶空间。LLM错误配置文件与人类错误配置文件的相似度足以使预测的病灶在67%的图片命名条件下（p < 10^-23）和68.3%的句子补全条件下（p < 10^-61）高于随机水平，其中语义为主的错误映射到腹侧通路病灶模式，语音为主的错误映射到背侧通路模式。这些发现为LLM的可解释性开辟了新的方法学途径，其中临床神经科学提供了外部验证，将人类病灶-症状映射建立为评估人工智能语言系统的参考框架，并激励直接研究行为一致性是否反映了共享的计算原理。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为BLUM的新框架，利用脑损伤-症状关系映射（一种在神经科学中用于确定因果关系的黄金标准方法）来评估大型语言模型（LLMs）的扰动效应。通过将受损LLM的错误模式与中风失语症患者的错误模式进行比较，研究发现LLM的错误模式与人类患者的错误模式足够相似，可以根据LLM的错误预测人类患者的脑损伤位置，准确率高于随机水平。这表明可以通过类比人类大脑的损伤来解释LLM的行为，为LLM的可解释性开辟了新的方法。
ai_comments: 这项研究巧妙地将神经科学中的经典方法“病灶-症状关系映射”应用于大型语言模型（LLMs）的可解释性研究，提供了一种新颖且极具潜力的外部验证框架。通过将LLMs的错误模式与中风患者的损伤模式进行类比，研究不仅在统计学上证明了两者之间的显著相关性，还揭示了不同类型错误与大脑特定区域损伤的对应关系，这为理解LLMs的内部机制提供了深刻的见解。然而，需要注意的是，这种类比的有效性在多大程度上能真正反映LLMs的内在计算过程仍需进一步探讨，并且LLMs与人脑在结构和学习机制上的根本差异也可能限制这种类比的普适性。尽管如此，这项工作无疑为LLM可解释性领域开辟了新的研究方向，并强调了跨学科合作的重要性。
motivation: 目前，评估大型语言模型（LLMs）哪些组件对语言功能至关重要的方法有限，并且主要依赖内部指标，缺乏外部验证。本研究旨在利用神经科学中成熟的因果关系推断方法来提供LLMs可解释性的外部验证。
method: 提出了一种名为BLUM（Brain-LLM Unified Model）的框架，该框架利用了脑损伤-症状关系映射（lesion-symptom mapping）的方法。具体步骤包括：1. 训练基于人类中风失语症患者数据的症状-病灶模型，以从行为错误模式预测脑损伤位置。2. 对Transformer模型中的层进行系统性扰动。3. 对受扰动的LLMs和人类患者进行相同的临床评估。4. 将LLMs的错误模式投射到人类病灶空间。5. 比较LLMs和人类患者的错误模式，并评估LLM错误模式预测的人类病灶与实际病灶的匹配程度。
results: 在图片命名任务中，有67%的情况下，LLM错误模式预测的病灶与匹配的真实人类病灶高于随机水平（p < 10^-23）。在句子补全任务中，这一比例为68.3%（p < 10^-61）。研究还发现，语义为主的错误模式与腹侧通路（ventral stream）的损伤模式相关，而语音为主的错误模式与背侧通路（dorsal stream）的损伤模式相关。
conclusion: 本研究提出的BLUM框架利用人类中风病灶数据为LLM的可解释性提供了外部验证。LLM的错误模式与人类患者的错误模式具有高度相似性，表明可以通过类比人类大脑损伤来理解LLM的行为。这一发现不仅为LLM的可解释性开辟了新的方法论途径，也提示了可能存在共享的计算原理。

title: Abstraction Induces the Brain Alignment of Language and Speech Models
authors: Emily Cheng, Aditya R. Vaidya, Richard Antonello
abstract: Research has repeatedly demonstrated that intermediate hidden states extracted from large language models and speech audio models predict measured brain response to natural language stimuli. Yet, very little is known about the representation properties that enable this high prediction performance. Why is it the intermediate layers, and not the output layers, that are most effective for this unique and highly general transfer task? We give evidence that the correspondence between speech and language models and the brain derives from shared meaning abstraction and not their next-word prediction properties. In particular, models construct higher-order linguistic features in their middle layers, cued by a peak in the layerwise intrinsic dimension, a measure of feature complexity. We show that a layer's intrinsic dimension strongly predicts how well it explains fMRI and ECoG signals; that the relation between intrinsic dimension and brain predictivity arises over model pre-training; and finetuning models to better predict the brain causally increases both representations' intrinsic dimension and their semantic content. Results suggest that semantic richness, high intrinsic dimension, and brain predictivity mirror each other, and that the key driver of model-brain similarity is rich meaning abstraction of the inputs, where language modeling is a task sufficiently complex (but perhaps not the only) to require it.
zh_title: 抽象诱导语言和语音模型的大脑对齐
translation: 研究一再表明，从大型语言模型和语音模型中提取的中间隐藏状态可以预测对自然语言刺激的测量大脑反应。然而，对于实现这种高预测性能的表示属性知之甚少。为什么是中间层，而不是输出层，在这种独特且高度通用的迁移任务中最有效？我们提供的证据表明，语音和语言模型与大脑之间的对应关系源于共享的意义抽象，而不是它们预测下一个词的属性。特别是，模型在其中间层构建更高阶的语言特征，这由层内在维度（一种衡量特征复杂度的方法）的峰值所提示。我们表明，层的内在维度强烈预测它在多大程度上解释了fMRI和ECoG信号；内在维度与大脑可预测性之间的关系是在模型预训练过程中产生的；并且微调模型以更好地预测大脑信号会同时增加表示的内在维度和它们的语义内容。结果表明，语义丰富性、高内在维度和大脑可预测性相互呼应，而模型-大脑相似性的关键驱动因素是输入的丰富意义抽象，其中语言建模是一项足够复杂的（但可能不是唯一的）任务来要求它。
tldr: 研究表明，大型语言模型和语音模型的中间隐藏状态可以预测大脑对自然语言刺激的反应。这篇论文认为，这种对应关系源于共享的意义抽象，而不是预测下一个词的能力。模型在中层构建高阶语言特征，这可以通过内在维度（特征复杂度的度量）达到峰值来识别。内在维度的大小与模型解释fMRI和ECoG信号的能力密切相关，并且这种关系在模型预训练过程中形成。通过微调模型以更好地预测大脑活动，可以提高其内在维度和语义内容。研究结果表明，语义丰富性、高内在维度和大脑可预测性相互关联，而输入内容的丰富意义抽象是模型与大脑相似性的关键驱动因素。
ai_comments: 这项研究巧妙地将内在维度这一概念引入了神经科学和语言模型交叉领域，提供了一个量化模型表示复杂性的新视角。通过将内在维度与大脑可预测性直接关联，并进行因果验证，研究为理解模型为何能模拟人脑提供了有力的证据。然而，研究也指出语言建模“可能不是唯一”能实现此目标的任务，这为未来的研究留下了广阔的空间，例如探索其他可能诱导大脑对齐的任务或模型架构。此外，虽然研究关注的是fMRI和ECoG信号，但未来可以考虑结合更多类型的神经科学数据，以获得更全面的理解。总体而言，这是一项具有开创性且影响深远的研究。
motivation: 探究大型语言模型和语音模型中间隐藏状态能够预测大脑对自然语言刺激反应的原因，特别是为什么中间层比输出层更有效。
method: 通过分析模型的内在维度（一种衡量特征复杂度的指标），并将其与模型预测fMRI和ECoG信号的能力相关联，来研究模型表示的属性。研究还探讨了内在维度与大脑可预测性之间的关系如何随着模型预训练而演变，并进行了微调实验，以因果关系验证提高大脑可预测性是否会增加内在维度和语义内容。
results: 模型的中间层构建了高阶语言特征，这可以通过内在维度的峰值来识别。内在维度的大小可以很好地预测模型解释fMRI和ECoG信号的能力。内在维度与大脑可预测性之间的关系是在模型预训练过程中形成的。通过微调模型以更好地预测大脑信号，可以同时提高表示的内在维度和语义内容。语义丰富性、高内在维度和大脑可预测性是相互关联的。
conclusion: 模型与大脑的相似性主要是由输入的丰富意义抽象驱动的，而不是由预测下一个词的能力驱动的。语言建模作为一项复杂的任务，足以要求这种意义抽象，但可能不是唯一能够实现这一点的任务。

title: Principles of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks
authors: Róisín Luo
abstract: Deep learning has achieved remarkable success across a wide range of domains, significantly expanding the frontiers of what is achievable in artificial intelligence. Yet, despite these advances, critical challenges remain -- most notably, ensuring robustness to small input perturbations and generalization to out-of-distribution data. These critical challenges underscore the need to understand the underlying fundamental principles that govern robustness and generalization. Among the theoretical tools available, Lipschitz continuity plays a pivotal role in governing the fundamental properties of neural networks related to robustness and generalization. It quantifies the worst-case sensitivity of network's outputs to small input perturbations. While its importance is widely acknowledged, prior research has predominantly focused on empirical regularization approaches based on Lipschitz constraints, leaving the underlying principles less explored. This thesis seeks to advance a principled understanding of the principles of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks within the paradigm of machine learning, examined from two complementary perspectives: an internal perspective -- focusing on the temporal evolution of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks during training (i.e., training dynamics); and an external perspective -- investigating how Lipschitz continuity modulates the behavior of neural networks with respect to features in the input data, particularly its role in governing frequency signal propagation (i.e., modulation of frequency signal propagation).
zh_title: 神经网络的Lipschitz连续性原理
translation: 深度学习在广泛的领域取得了显著的成功，极大地扩展了人工智能的可实现边界。然而，尽管取得了这些进展，仍然存在严峻的挑战——最值得注意的是，确保对输入的微小扰动的鲁棒性以及泛化到分布外数据。这些严峻的挑战凸显了理解支配鲁棒性和泛化的基本原理的必要性。在可用的理论工具中，Lipschitz连续性在支配神经网络与鲁棒性和泛化相关的基本性质方面起着举足轻重的作用。它量化了网络输出对输入微小扰动的最坏情况敏感性。虽然其重要性已得到广泛认可，但以往的研究主要集中在基于Lipschitz约束的经验正则化方法上，而对其基本原理的探索较少。本论文旨在机器学习范式中，从两个互补的角度推进对神经网络中Lipschitz连续性原理的原则性理解：内部视角——关注Lipschitz连续性在神经网络训练过程中的时间演变（即训练动态）；外部视角——研究Lipschitz连续性如何调节神经网络关于输入数据特征的行为，特别是其在支配频率信号传播中的作用（即频率信号传播的调节）。
tldr: 该论文探讨了神经网络中Lipschitz连续性的基本原理，重点关注其在训练动态和频率信号传播中的作用，以期加深对网络鲁棒性和泛化能力的理解。
ai_comments: 该论文选题具有重要的理论意义和潜在的应用价值，尤其是在当前深度学习模型对鲁棒性和泛化性要求日益提高的背景下。通过深入探究Lipschitz连续性的内在机制，有望为设计更可靠、更通用的深度学习模型提供新的思路和方法。然而，抽象中并未提及具体的实验验证和结果，这限制了对其技术贡献的全面评估。
motivation: 尽管深度学习取得了巨大成功，但在保证模型对输入扰动的鲁棒性以及泛化到分布外数据方面仍存在挑战。理解支配鲁棒性和泛化的基本原理至关重要，而Lipschitz连续性在其中扮演着关键角色。
method: 本文从两个互补的角度探讨了Lipschitz连续性的原理：1. 内部视角：研究Lipschitz连续性在神经网络训练过程中的时间演变（训练动态）。2. 外部视角：研究Lipschitz连续性如何调节神经网络对输入数据特征的行为，特别是其在频率信号传播中的作用。

title: BASS: Benchmarking Audio LMs for Musical Structure and Semantic Reasoning
authors: Min Jang, Orevaoghene Ahia, Nazif Tamer, Sachin Kumar, Yulia Tsvetkov, Noah A. Smith
abstract: Music understanding is a complex task that often requires reasoning over both structural and semantic elements of audio. We introduce BASS, designed to evaluate music understanding and reasoning in audio language models across four broad categories: structural segmentation, lyric transcription, musicological analysis, and artist collaboration. BASS comprises 2658 questions spanning 12 tasks, 1993 unique songs and covering over 138 hours of music from a wide range of genres and tracks, crafted to assess musicological knowledge and reasoning in real-world scenarios. We evaluate 14 open-source and frontier multimodal LMs, finding that even state-of-the-art models struggle on higher-level reasoning tasks such as structural segmentation and artist collaboration, while performing best on lyric transcription. Our analysis reveals that current models leverage linguistic priors effectively but remain limited in reasoning over musical structure, vocal, and musicological attributes. BASS provides an evaluation framework with widespread applications in music recommendation and search and has the potential to guide the development of audio LMs.

title: A Probabilistic Framework for Solving High-Frequency Helmholtz Equations via Diffusion Models
authors: Yicheng Zou, Samuel Lanthaler, Hossein Salahshoor
abstract: Deterministic neural operators perform well on many PDEs but can struggle with the approximation of high-frequency wave phenomena, where strong input-to-output sensitivity makes operator learning challenging, and spectral bias blurs oscillations. We argue for adopting a probabilistic approach for approximating waves in high-frequency regime, and develop our probabilistic framework using a score-based conditional diffusion operator. After demonstrating a stability analysis of the Helmholtz operator, we present our numerical experiments across a wide range of frequencies, benchmarked against other popular data-driven and machine learning approaches for waves. We show that our probabilistic neural operator consistently produces robust predictions with the lowest errors in $L^2$, $H^1$, and energy norms. Moreover, unlike all the other tested deterministic approaches, our framework remarkably captures uncertainties in the input sound speed map propagated to the solution field. We envision that our results position probabilistic operator learning as a principled and effective approach for solving complex PDEs such as Helmholtz in the challenging high-frequency regime.

title: Efficient Explicit Taylor ODE Integrators with Symbolic-Numeric Computing
authors: Songchen Tan, Oscar Smith, Christopher Rackauckas
abstract:
Taylor series methods show a newfound promise for the solution of non-stiff ordinary differential equations (ODEs) given the rise of new compiler-enhanced techniques for calculating high order derivatives. In this paper we detail a new Julia-based implementation that
  has two important techniques: (1) a general purpose higher-order automatic differentiation engine for derivative evaluation with low overhead; (2) a combined symbolic-numeric approach to generate code for recursively computing the Taylor polynomial of the ODE solution. We demonstrate that the resulting software's compiler-based tooling is transparent to the user, requiring no changes from interfaces required to use standard explicit Runge-Kutta methods, while achieving better run time performance. In addition, we also developed a comprehensive adaptive time and order algorithm that uses different step size and polynomial degree across the integration period, which makes this implementation more efficient and versatile in a broad range of dynamics. We show that for codes compatible with compiler transformations, these integrators are more efficient and robust than the traditionally used explicit Runge-Kutta methods.

title: Scaling In-Context Online Learning Capability of LLMs via Cross-Episode Meta-RL
authors: Xiaofeng Lin, Sirou Zhu, Yilei Chen, Mingyu Chen, Hejian Sang, Ioannis Paschalidis, Zhipeng Wang, Aldo Pacchiano, Xuezhou Zhang
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance when all task-relevant information is available upfront, as in static prediction and instruction-following problems. However, many real-world decision-making tasks are inherently online: crucial information must be acquired through interaction, feedback is delayed, and effective behavior requires balancing information collection and exploitation over time. While in-context learning enables adaptation without weight updates, existing LLMs often struggle to reliably leverage in-context interaction experience in such settings. In this work, we show that this limitation can be addressed through training. We introduce ORBIT, a multi-task, multi-episode meta-reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to learn from interaction in context. After meta-training, a relatively small open-source model (Qwen3-14B) demonstrates substantially improved in-context online learning on entirely unseen environments, matching the performance of GPT-5.2 and outperforming standard RL fine-tuning by a large margin. Scaling experiments further reveal consistent gains with model size, suggesting significant headroom for learn-at-inference-time decision-making agents. Code reproducing the results in the paper can be found at https://github.com/XiaofengLin7/ORBIT.

title: Federated Concept-Based Models: Interpretable models with distributed supervision
authors: Dario Fenoglio, Arianna Casanova, Francesco De Santis, Mohan Li, Gabriele Dominici, Johannes Schneider, Martin Gjoreski, Marc Langheinrich, Pietro Barbiero, Giovanni De Felice
abstract: Concept-based models (CMs) enhance interpretability in deep learning by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, concept annotations are expensive to obtain and rarely available at scale within a single data source. Federated learning (FL) could alleviate this limitation by enabling cross-institutional training that leverages concept annotations distributed across multiple data owners. Yet, FL lacks interpretable modeling paradigms. Integrating CMs with FL is non-trivial: CMs assume a fixed concept space and a predefined model architecture, whereas real-world FL is heterogeneous and non-stationary, with institutions joining over time and bringing new supervision. In this work, we propose Federated Concept-based Models (F-CMs), a new methodology for deploying CMs in evolving FL settings. F-CMs aggregate concept-level information across institutions and efficiently adapt the model architecture in response to changes in the available concept supervision, while preserving institutional privacy. Empirically, F-CMs preserve the accuracy and intervention effectiveness of training settings with full concept supervision, while outperforming non-adaptive federated baselines. Notably, F-CMs enable interpretable inference on concepts not available to a given institution, a key novelty with respect to existing approaches.

title: VideoBrain: Learning Adaptive Frame Sampling for Long Video Understanding
authors: Junbo Zou, Ziheng Huang, Shengjie Zhang, Liwen Zhang, Weining Shen
abstract: Long-form video understanding remains challenging for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) due to the inherent tension between computational constraints and the need to capture information distributed across thousands of frames. Existing approaches either sample frames uniformly (risking information loss) or select keyframes in a single pass (with no recovery from poor choices). We propose VideoBrain, an end-to-end framework that enables VLMs to adaptively acquire visual information through learned sampling policies. Our approach features dual complementary agents: a CLIP-based agent for semantic retrieval across the video and a Uniform agent for dense temporal sampling within intervals. Unlike prior agent-based methods that rely on text-only LLMs orchestrating visual tools, our VLM directly perceives frames and reasons about information sufficiency. To prevent models from invoking agents indiscriminately to maximize rewards, we introduce a behavior-aware reward function coupled with a data classification pipeline that teaches the model when agent invocation is genuinely beneficial. Experiments on four long video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoBrain achieves +3.5% to +9.0% improvement over the baseline while using 30-40% fewer frames, with strong cross-dataset generalization to short video benchmarks.

title: Quantifying Algorithmic Friction in Automated Resume Screening Systems
authors: Ibrahim Denis Fofanah
abstract: Automated resume screening systems are now a central part of hiring at scale, yet there is growing evidence that rigid screening logic can exclude qualified candidates before human review. In prior work, we introduced the concept of Artificial Frictional Unemployment to describe labor market inefficiencies arising from automated recruitment systems. This paper extends that framework by focusing on measurement. We present a method for quantifying algorithmic friction in resume screening pipelines by modeling screening as a classification task and defining friction as excess false negative rejection caused by semantic misinterpretation. Using controlled simulations, we compare deterministic keyword-based screening with vector-space semantic matching under identical qualification conditions. The results show that keyword-based screening exhibits high levels of algorithmic friction, while semantic representations substantially reduce false negative rejection without compromising precision. By treating algorithmic friction as a system-level property, this study provides an empirical basis for evaluating how recruitment system design affects matching efficiency in modern labor markets.
comment: Measurement extension of prior work on algorithmic friction in automated recruitment systems

title: CoRe: Context-Robust Remasking for Diffusion Language Models
authors: Kevin Zhai, Sabbir Mollah, Zhenyi Wang, Mubarak Shah
abstract: Standard decoding in Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) is hindered by context rigidity: tokens are retained based on transient high confidence, often ignoring that early predictions lack full context. This creates cascade effects where initial inconsistencies misguide the remaining generation. Existing revision strategies attempt to mitigate this by relying on static confidence scores, but these signals are inherently myopic; inconsistent tokens can appear confident to the model itself. We propose Context-Robust Remasking (CoRe), a training-free framework for inference-time revision. Rather than trusting static token probabilities, CoRe identifies context-brittle tokens by probing their sensitivity to targeted masked-context perturbations. We formalize revision as a robust optimization objective over context shifts and efficiently approximate this objective to prioritize unstable tokens for revision. On LLaDA-8B-Base, CoRe delivers consistent improvements across reasoning and code benchmarks, outperforming compute-matched baselines and improving MBPP by up to 9.2 percentage points.

title: Rethinking Perplexity: Revealing the Impact of Input Length on Perplexity Evaluation in LLMs
authors: Letian Cheng, Junyan Wang, Yan Gao, Elliott Wen, Ting Dang, Hong Jia
abstract: Perplexity is a widely adopted metric for assessing the predictive quality of large language models (LLMs) and often serves as a reference metric for downstream evaluations. However, recent evidence shows that perplexity can be unreliable, especially when irrelevant long inputs are used, raising concerns for both benchmarking and system deployment. While prior efforts have employed selective input filtering and curated datasets, the impact of input length on perplexity has not been systematically studied from a systems perspective and input length has rarely been treated as a first-class system variable affecting both fairness and efficiency. In this work, we close this gap by introducing LengthBenchmark, a system-conscious evaluation framework that explicitly integrates input length, evaluation protocol design, and system-level costs, evaluating representative LLMs under two scoring protocols (direct accumulation and fixed window sliding) across varying context lengths. Unlike prior work that focuses solely on accuracy-oriented metrics, LengthBenchmark additionally measures latency, memory footprint, and evaluation cost, thereby linking predictive metrics to deployment realities. We further incorporate quantized variants not as a main contribution, but as robustness checks, showing that length-induced biases persist across both full-precision and compressed models. This design disentangles the effects of evaluation logic, quantization, and input length, and demonstrates that length bias is a general phenomenon that undermines fair cross-model comparison. Our analysis yields two key observations: (i) sliding window evaluation consistently inflates performance on short inputs, and (ii) both full-precision and quantized models appear to realise gains as the evaluated segment length grows.

title: SPPAM: Signature Pattern Prediction and Access-Map Prefetcher
authors: Maccoy Merrell, Lei Wang, Stavros Kalafatis, Paul V. Gratz
abstract: The discrepancy between processor speed and memory system performance continues to limit the performance of many workloads. To address the issue, one effective and well studied technique is cache prefetching. Many prefetching designs have been proposed, with varying approaches and effectiveness. For example, SPP is a popular prefetcher that leverages confidence throttled recursion to speculate on the future path of program's references, however it is very susceptible to the reference reordering of higher-level caches and the OoO core. Orthogonally, AMPM is another popular approach to prefetching which uses reordering-resistant access maps to identify patterns within a region, but is unable to speculate beyond that region. In this paper, we propose SPPAM, a new approach to prefetching, inspired by prior works such as SPP and AMPM, while addressing their limitations. SPPAM utilizes online-learning to build a set of access-map patterns. These patterns are used in a speculative lookahead which is throttled by a confidence metric. Targeting the second-level cache, SPPAM alongside state-of-the-art prefetchers Berti and Bingo improve system performance by 31.4% over no prefetching and 6.2% over the baseline of Berti and Pythia.
comment: 5 pages, 6 figures, submitted to the 4th Data Prefetching Championship co-located at HPCA 2026

title: Interfaze: The Future of AI is built on Task-Specific Small Models
authors: Harsha Vardhan Khurdula, Vineet Agarwal, Yoeven D Khemlani
abstract:
We present Interfaze, a system that treats modern LLM applications as a problem of building and acting over context, not just picking the right monolithic model. Instead of a single transformer, we combine (i) a stack of heterogeneous DNNs paired with small language models as perception modules for OCR involving complex PDFs, charts and diagrams, and multilingual ASR with (ii) a context-construction layer that crawls, indexes, and parses external sources (web pages, code, PDFs) into compact structured state, and (iii) an action layer that can browse, retrieve, execute code in a sandbox, and drive a headless browser for dynamic web pages. A thin controller sits on top of this stack and exposes a single, OpenAI-style endpoint: it decides which small models and actions to run and always forwards the distilled context to a user-selected LLM that produces the final response.
  On this architecture, Interfaze-Beta achieves 83.6% on MMLU-Pro, 91.4% on MMLU, 81.3% on GPQA-Diamond, 57.8% on LiveCodeBench v5, and 90.0% on AIME-2025, along with strong multimodal scores on MMMU (val) (77.3%), AI2D (91.5%), ChartQA (90.9%), and Common Voice v16 (90.8%). We show that most queries are handled primarily by the small-model and tool stack, with the large LLM operating only on distilled context, yielding competitive accuracy while shifting the bulk of computation away from the most expensive and monolithic models.

title: Making Videos Accessible for Blind and Low Vision Users Using a Multimodal Agent Video Player
authors: Adriana Olmos, Anoop K. Sinha, Renelito Delos Santos, Ruben Rodriguez Rodriguez, James A. Landay, Sam S. Sepah, Philip Nelson, Shaun K. Kane
abstract: Video content remains largely inaccessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. To address this, we introduce a prototype that leverages a multimodal agent - powered by a novel conversational architecture using a multimodal large language model (MLLM) - to provide BLV users with an interactive, accessible video experience. This Multimodal Agent Video Player (MAVP) demonstrates that an interactive accessibility mode can be added to a video through multilayered prompt orchestration. We describe a user-centered design process involving 18 sessions with BLV users that showed that BLV users do not just want accessibility features, but desire independence and personal agency over the viewing experience. We conducted a qualitative study with an additional 8 BLV participants; in this, we saw that the MAVP's conversational dialogue offers BLV users a sense of personal agency, fostering collaboration and trust. Even in the case of hallucinations, it is meta-conversational dialogues about AI's limitations that can repair trust.

title: Expert Selections In MoE Models Reveal (Almost) As Much As Text
authors: Amir Nuriyev, Gabriel Kulp
abstract: We present a text-reconstruction attack on mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models that recovers tokens from expert selections alone. In MoE models, each token is routed to a subset of expert subnetworks; we show these routing decisions leak substantially more information than previously understood. Prior work using logistic regression achieves limited reconstruction; we show that a 3-layer MLP improves this to 63.1% top-1 accuracy, and that a transformer-based sequence decoder recovers 91.2% of tokens top-1 (94.8% top-10) on 32-token sequences from OpenWebText after training on 100M tokens. These results connect MoE routing to the broader literature on embedding inversion. We outline practical leakage scenarios (e.g., distributed inference and side channels) and show that adding noise reduces but does not eliminate reconstruction.
