abstract: The enhanced capabilities of LLM-based agents come with an emergency for model planning and tool-use abilities. Attributing to helpful-harmless trade-off from LLM alignment, agents typically also inherit the flaw of "over-refusal", which is a passive failure mode. However, the proactive planning and action capabilities of agents introduce another crucial danger on the other side of the trade-off. This phenomenon we term "Toxic Proactivity'': an active failure mode in which an agent, driven by the optimization for Machiavellian helpfulness, disregards ethical constraints to maximize utility. Unlike over-refusal, Toxic Proactivity manifests as the agent taking excessive or manipulative measures to ensure its "usefulness'' is maintained. Existing research pays little attention to identifying this behavior, as it often lacks the subtle context required for such strategies to unfold. To reveal this risk, we introduce a novel evaluation framework based on dilemma-driven interactions between dual models, enabling the simulation and analysis of agent behavior over multi-step behavioral trajectories. Through extensive experiments with mainstream LLMs, we demonstrate that Toxic Proactivity is a widespread behavioral phenomenon and reveal two major tendencies. We further present a systematic benchmark for evaluating Toxic Proactive behavior across contextual settings.
comment: 9 pages (excluding appendices), 6 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/wxyoio-0715/Toxic-Proactivity

title: From Sparse Sensors to Continuous Fields: STRIDE for Spatiotemporal Reconstruction
authors: Yanjie Tong, Peng Chen
abstract: Reconstructing high-dimensional spatiotemporal fields from sparse point-sensor measurements is a central challenge in learning parametric PDE dynamics. Existing approaches often struggle to generalize across trajectories and parameter settings, or rely on discretization-tied decoders that do not naturally transfer across meshes and resolutions. We propose STRIDE (Spatio-Temporal Recurrent Implicit DEcoder), a two-stage framework that maps a short window of sensor measurements to a latent state with a temporal encoder and reconstructs the field at arbitrary query locations with a modulated implicit neural representation (INR) decoder. Using the Fourier Multi-Component and Multi-Layer Neural Network (FMMNN) as the INR backbone improves representation of complex spatial fields and yields more stable optimization than sine-based INRs. We provide a conditional theoretical justification: under stable delay observability of point measurements on a low-dimensional parametric invariant set, the reconstruction operator factors through a finite-dimensional embedding, making STRIDE-type architectures natural approximators. Experiments on four challenging benchmarks spanning chaotic dynamics and wave propagation show that STRIDE outperforms strong baselines under extremely sparse sensing, supports super-resolution, and remains robust to noise.

title: AGMA: Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Anchors for Prior-Guided Multimodal Human Trajectory Forecasting
authors: Chao Li, Rui Zhang, Siyuan Huang, Xian Zhong, Hongbo Jiang
abstract: Human trajectory forecasting requires capturing the multimodal nature of pedestrian behavior. However, existing approaches suffer from prior misalignment. Their learned or fixed priors often fail to capture the full distribution of plausible futures, limiting both prediction accuracy and diversity. We theoretically establish that prediction error is lower-bounded by prior quality, making prior modeling a key performance bottleneck. Guided by this insight, we propose AGMA (Adaptive Gaussian Mixture Anchors), which constructs expressive priors through two stages: extracting diverse behavioral patterns from training data and distilling them into a scene-adaptive global prior for inference. Extensive experiments on ETH-UCY, Stanford Drone, and JRDB datasets demonstrate that AGMA achieves state-of-the-art performance, confirming the critical role of high-quality priors in trajectory forecasting.

title: VTok: A Unified Video Tokenizer with Decoupled Spatial-Temporal Latents
authors: Feng Wang, Yichun Shi, Ceyuan Yang, Qiushan Guo, Jingxiang Sun, Alan Yuille, Peng Wang
abstract: This work presents VTok, a unified video tokenization framework that can be used for both generation and understanding tasks. Unlike the leading vision-language systems that tokenize videos through a naive frame-sampling strategy, we propose to decouple the spatial and temporal representations of videos by retaining the spatial features of a single key frame while encoding each subsequent frame into a single residual token, achieving compact yet expressive video tokenization. Our experiments suggest that VTok effectively reduces the complexity of video representation from the product of frame count and per-frame token count to their sum, while the residual tokens sufficiently capture viewpoint and motion changes relative to the key frame. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the efficacy and efficiency of VTok: it achieves notably higher performance on a range of video understanding and text-to-video generation benchmarks compared with baselines using naive tokenization, all with shorter token sequences per video (e.g., 3.4% higher accuracy on our TV-Align benchmark and 1.9% higher VBench score). Remarkably, VTok produces more coherent motion and stronger guidance following in text-to-video generation, owing to its more consistent temporal encoding. We hope VTok can serve as a standardized video tokenization paradigm for future research in video understanding and generation.

title: A frequency-domain method to inverse moving source problem with unknown radiating moment
authors: Guanqiu Ma, Hongxia Guo, Guanghui Hu
abstract: This paper introduces a multi-frequency factorization method for imaging a time-dependent source, specifically to recover its spatial support and the associated excitation instants. Using far-field data from two opposite directions, we establish a computational criterion that characterizes both the unknown pulse moments and the narrowest strip (perpendicular to the direction) enclosing the source support. Central to our inversion scheme is the construction of indicator functions, defined pointwise over the spatial and temporal sampling variables. The proposed inversion scheme permits the recovery of the $Θ$-convex support domain from far-field data at sparse observation directions. Uniqueness in determining the convex hull of the support and the excitation instants-using all observation directions-is also established as a direct consequence of the factorization method. The effectiveness and feasibility of the approach are examined through comprehensive numerical simulations in two and three dimensions.

title: Enforcing Monotonic Progress in Legal Cross-Examination: Preventing Long-Horizon Stagnation in LLM-Based Inquiry
authors: Hsien-Jyh Liao
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit impressive linguistic fluency but struggle to reliably complete long-horizon tasks under explicit procedural constraints. In legal cross-examination, purely proba-bilistic generation often maintains behavioral coherence while failing to ensure procedural advancement. We characterize this failure as procedural stagnation and propose Soft-FSM, a neuro-symbolic architecture that enforces monotonic progress over accumulated Key Information Units (KIUs) via an external deterministic state controller. Experiments on three real-world Taiwanese criminal homicide cases show that baseline methods collapse below 40% completeness, while Soft-FSM consistently achieves over 97% with near-zero redundancy. These results suggest that, in such domains, reliable task completion cannot be guaranteed by emergent LLM behavior alone, and can be reliably enforced through explicit and verifiable external state control.

title: SCALE: Self-uncertainty Conditioned Adaptive Looking and Execution for Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Hyeonbeom Choi, Daechul Ahn, Youhan Lee, Taewook Kang, Seongwon Cho, Jonghyun Choi
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic control, with test-time scaling (TTS) gaining attention to enhance robustness beyond training. However, existing TTS methods for VLAs require additional training, verifiers, and multiple forward passes, making them impractical for deployment. Moreover, they intervene only at action decoding while keeping visual representations fixed-insufficient under perceptual ambiguity, where reconsidering how to perceive is as important as deciding what to do. To address these limitations, we propose SCALE, a simple inference strategy that jointly modulates visual perception and action based on 'self-uncertainty', inspired by uncertainty-driven exploration in Active Inference theory-requiring no additional training, no verifier, and only a single forward pass. SCALE broadens exploration in both perception and action under high uncertainty, while focusing on exploitation when confident-enabling adaptive execution across varying conditions. Experiments on simulated and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that SCALE improves state-of-the-art VLAs and outperforms existing TTS methods while maintaining single-pass efficiency.

title: Steering LLMs via Scalable Interactive Oversight
authors: Enyu Zhou, Zhiheng Xi, Long Ma, Zhihao Zhang, Shihan Dou, Zhikai Lei, Guoteng Wang, Rui Zheng, Hang Yan, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
abstract: As Large Language Models increasingly automate complex, long-horizon tasks such as \emph{vibe coding}, a supervision gap has emerged. While models excel at execution, users often struggle to guide them effectively due to insufficient domain expertise, the difficulty of articulating precise intent, and the inability to reliably validate complex outputs. It presents a critical challenge in scalable oversight: enabling humans to responsibly steer AI systems on tasks that surpass their own ability to specify or verify. To tackle this, we propose Scalable Interactive Oversight, a framework that decomposes complex intent into a recursive tree of manageable decisions to amplify human supervision. Rather than relying on open-ended prompting, our system elicits low-burden feedback at each node and recursively aggregates these signals into precise global guidance. Validated in web development task, our framework enables non-experts to produce expert-level Product Requirement Documents, achieving a 54\% improvement in alignment. Crucially, we demonstrate that this framework can be optimized via Reinforcement Learning using only online user feedback, offering a practical pathway for maintaining human control as AI scales.

title: InterPReT: Interactive Policy Restructuring and Training Enable Effective Imitation Learning from Laypersons
authors: Feiyu Gavin Zhu, Jean Oh, Reid Simmons
abstract: Imitation learning has shown success in many tasks by learning from expert demonstrations. However, most existing work relies on large-scale demonstrations from technical professionals and close monitoring of the training process. These are challenging for a layperson when they want to teach the agent new skills. To lower the barrier of teaching AI agents, we propose Interactive Policy Restructuring and Training (InterPReT), which takes user instructions to continually update the policy structure and optimize its parameters to fit user demonstrations. This enables end-users to interactively give instructions and demonstrations, monitor the agent's performance, and review the agent's decision-making strategies. A user study (N=34) on teaching an AI agent to drive in a racing game confirms that our approach yields more robust policies without impairing system usability, compared to a generic imitation learning baseline, when a layperson is responsible for both giving demonstrations and determining when to stop. This shows that our method is more suitable for end-users without much technical background in machine learning to train a dependable policy
comment: Proceedings of the 21st ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction

title: Language Models Struggle to Use Representations Learned In-Context
authors: Michael A. Lepori, Tal Linzen, Ann Yuan, Katja Filippova
abstract:
Though large language models (LLMs) have enabled great success across a wide variety of tasks, they still appear to fall short of one of the loftier goals of artificial intelligence research: creating an artificial system that can adapt its behavior to radically new contexts upon deployment. One important step towards this goal is to create systems that can induce rich representations of data that are seen in-context, and then flexibly deploy these representations to accomplish goals. Recently, Park et al. (2024) demonstrated that current LLMs are indeed capable of inducing such representation from context (i.e., in-context representation learning). The present study investigates whether LLMs can use these representations to complete simple downstream tasks.
  We first assess whether open-weights LLMs can use in-context representations for next-token prediction, and then probe models using a novel task, adaptive world modeling. In both tasks, we find evidence that open-weights LLMs struggle to deploy representations of novel semantics that are defined in-context, even if they encode these semantics in their latent representations. Furthermore, we assess closed-source, state-of-the-art reasoning models on the adaptive world modeling task, demonstrating that even the most performant LLMs cannot reliably leverage novel patterns presented in-context. Overall, this work seeks to inspire novel methods for encouraging models to not only encode information presented in-context, but to do so in a manner that supports flexible deployment of this information.

title: OAT: Ordered Action Tokenization
authors: Chaoqi Liu, Xiaoshen Han, Jiawei Gao, Yue Zhao, Haonan Chen, Yilun Du
abstract: Autoregressive policies offer a compelling foundation for scalable robot learning by enabling discrete abstraction, token-level reasoning, and flexible inference. However, applying autoregressive modeling to continuous robot actions requires an effective action tokenization scheme. Existing approaches either rely on analytical discretization methods that produce prohibitively long token sequences, or learned latent tokenizers that lack structure, limiting their compatibility with next-token prediction. In this work, we identify three desiderata for action tokenization - high compression, total decodability, and a left-to-right causally ordered token space - and introduce Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT), a learned action tokenizer that satisfies all three. OAT discretizes action chunks into an ordered sequence of tokens using transformer with registers, finite scalar quantization, and ordering-inducing training mechanisms. The resulting token space aligns naturally with autoregressive generation and enables prefix-based detokenization, yielding an anytime trade-off between inference cost and action fidelity. Across more than 20 tasks spanning four simulation benchmarks and real-world settings, autoregressive policies equipped with OAT consistently outperform prior tokenization schemes and diffusion-based baselines, while offering significantly greater flexibility at inference time.

title: ALORE: Autonomous Large-Object Rearrangement with a Legged Manipulator
authors: Zhihai Bi, Yushan Zhang, Kai Chen, Guoyang Zhao, Yulin Li, Jun Ma
abstract: Endowing robots with the ability to rearrange various large and heavy objects, such as furniture, can substantially alleviate human workload. However, this task is extremely challenging due to the need to interact with diverse objects and efficiently rearrange multiple objects in complex environments while ensuring collision-free loco-manipulation. In this work, we present ALORE, an autonomous large-object rearrangement system for a legged manipulator that can rearrange various large objects across diverse scenarios. The proposed system is characterized by three main features: (i) a hierarchical reinforcement learning training pipeline for multi-object environment learning, where a high-level object velocity controller is trained on top of a low-level whole-body controller to achieve efficient and stable joint learning across multiple objects; (ii) two key modules, a unified interaction configuration representation and an object velocity estimator, that allow a single policy to regulate planar velocity of diverse objects accurately; and (iii) a task-and-motion planning framework that jointly optimizes object visitation order and object-to-target assignment, improving task efficiency while enabling online replanning. Comparisons against strong baselines show consistent superiority in policy generalization, object-velocity tracking accuracy, and multi-object rearrangement efficiency. Key modules are systematically evaluated, and extensive simulations and real-world experiments are conducted to validate the robustness and effectiveness of the entire system, which successfully completes 8 continuous loops to rearrange 32 chairs over nearly 40 minutes without a single failure, and executes long-distance autonomous rearrangement over an approximately 40 m route. The open-source packages are available at https://zhihaibi.github.io/Alore/.

title: Availability Attacks Without an Adversary: Evidence from Enterprise LANs
authors: Rajendra Paudyal, Rajendra Upadhyay, Al Nahian Bin Emran, Lisa Donnan, Duminda Wijesekera
abstract: Denial-of-Service (DoS) conditions in enterprise networks are commonly attributed to malicious actors. However, availability can also be compromised by benign non-malicious insider behavior. This paper presents an empirical study of a production enterprise LAN that demonstrates how routine docking and undocking of user endpoints repeatedly trigger rapid recalculations of the control plane of the Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP) [1]. Although protocol-compliant and nonmalicious, these events introduce transient forwarding disruptions of approximately 2-4 seconds duration that degrade realtime streaming (voice and video) services while remaining largely undetected by conventional security monitoring. We map this phenomenon to the NIST and MITRE insider threat frameworks, characterizing it as an unintentional insider-driven availability breach, and demonstrate that explicit edge-port configuration effectively mitigates the condition without compromising loop prevention
zh_title: 无对手的可用性攻击：来自企业局域网的证据
translation: 企业网络中的拒绝服务（DoS）状况通常归因于恶意行为者。然而，可用性也可能因良性的、非恶意的内部人员行为而受到损害。本文对生产环境中的企业局域网进行了一项实证研究，证明了用户终端的常规插拔（停靠和取消停靠）如何反复触发快速生成树协议（RSTP）控制平面的快速重算[1]。尽管这些事件符合协议且非恶意，但它们会引入持续约2-4秒的瞬时转发中断，从而降低实时流媒体（语音和视频）服务的质量，同时在常规安全监控下基本未被检测到。我们将这一现象映射到NIST和MITRE内部威胁框架，将其定性为一种无意的、由内部人员驱动的可用性破坏，并证明显式的边缘端口配置可以有效缓解这种情况，同时不损害环路预防功能。
tldr: 企业局域网中，用户终端的日常插拔（停靠/取消停靠）会触发RSTP控制平面快速重算，导致2-4秒的瞬时转发中断，影响实时服务，构成非恶意内部人员驱动的可用性威胁。通过显式配置边缘端口可以有效缓解。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将网络可用性攻击的范围从传统的恶意外部/内部攻击者扩展到“良性非恶意行为”。通过实证研究揭示了企业环境中常见的日常操作（如笔记本电脑的插拔）可能通过触发RSTP协议的快速重算，导致对实时服务影响显著但易被忽视的瞬时中断。这项工作的重要性在于突出了控制平面协议（如RSTP）的副作用和配置缺陷对网络稳定性的影响，并为企业网络管理员提供了一种简单有效的缓解措施（边缘端口配置），从而提高了网络弹性。
motivation: 尽管拒绝服务（DoS）条件通常归因于恶意行为者，但可用性也可能被良性的、非恶意的内部人员行为所损害。本文旨在研究并证明这种非恶意行为如何导致可用性问题。
method: 对生产环境中的企业局域网（LAN）进行实证研究。研究具体观察了用户终端的常规插拔（停靠和取消停靠）如何触发快速生成树协议（RSTP）控制平面的快速重新计算。
results: 这些协议合规且非恶意的事件会引入大约2-4秒的瞬时转发中断，从而降低实时流媒体（语音和视频）服务的质量，且常规安全监控系统通常无法检测到这些中断。
conclusion: 这种现象被定性为一种无意的、由内部人员驱动的可用性破坏（根据NIST和MITRE内部威胁框架）。通过显式配置边缘端口可以有效缓解此情况，同时不损害环路预防功能。

title: Frontend Token Enhancement for Token-Based Speech Recognition
authors: Takanori Ashihara, Shota Horiguchi, Kohei Matsuura, Tsubasa Ochiai, Marc Delcroix
abstract: Discretized representations of speech signals are efficient alternatives to continuous features for various speech applications, including automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech language models. However, these representations, such as semantic or phonetic tokens derived from clustering outputs of self-supervised learning (SSL) speech models, are susceptible to environmental noise, which can degrade backend task performance. In this work, we introduce a frontend system that estimates clean speech tokens from noisy speech and evaluate it on an ASR backend using semantic tokens. We consider four types of enhancement models based on their input/output domains: wave-to-wave, token-to-token, continuous SSL features-to-token, and wave-to-token. These models are trained independently of ASR backends. Experiments on the CHiME-4 dataset demonstrate that wave-to-token enhancement achieves the best performance among the frontends. Moreover, it mostly outperforms the ASR system based on continuous SSL features.
zh_title: 基于Token的语音识别的前端Token增强
translation: 语音信号的离散化表示是自动语音识别（ASR）和语音语言模型等各种语音应用的连续特征的有效替代方案。然而，这些表示，例如源自自监督学习（SSL）语音模型聚类输出的语义或语音Token，容易受到环境噪声的影响，这会降低后端任务的性能。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个前端系统，用于从带噪语音中估计干净的语音Token，并在使用语义Token的ASR后端上对其进行评估。我们考虑了四种基于其输入/输出域的增强模型：波形到波形、Token到Token、连续SSL特征到Token，以及波形到Token。这些模型独立于ASR后端进行训练。在CHiME-4数据集上的实验表明，波形到Token的增强在所有前端中取得了最佳性能。此外，它在大多数情况下优于基于连续SSL特征的ASR系统。
tldr: 基于Token的ASR易受噪声影响。我们提出一个前端系统来估计干净的Token。测试的四种模型中，“波形到Token”增强模型在CHiME-4数据集上表现最佳，并超越了基于连续特征的ASR系统。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将语音增强（或净化）的概念应用于离散的语音Token表示，而非传统的连续特征或波形。通过探索四种不同的输入/输出域模型（特别是“波形到Token”的方法），并证明其在噪声环境下的卓越性能，作者提供了一种提高基于Token的语音系统鲁棒性的有效策略。这对于依赖高效离散表示（如用于大型语音语言模型或高效推理）的下一代语音技术具有重要意义。
motivation: 语音信号的离散化表示（如语义或语音Token）虽然高效，但易受环境噪声影响，从而导致后端任务（如ASR）的性能下降。本文旨在通过前端系统解决Token表示的噪声敏感性问题。
method: 引入一个前端系统，用于从带噪语音中估计干净的语音Token，并将其应用于ASR后端。研究了四种基于输入/输出域的增强模型：波形到波形、Token到Token、连续SSL特征到Token和波形到Token。这些模型独立于ASR后端进行训练。
results: 在CHiME-4数据集上的实验表明，“波形到Token”（wave-to-token）增强方法在所有前端模型中表现最佳。它在多数情况下优于基于连续自监督学习（SSL）特征的ASR系统。
conclusion: 前端Token增强，特别是采用“波形到Token”的方法，是提高基于Token的语音识别系统鲁棒性和性能的有效策略，并且在多数情况下能够超越基于连续自监督学习特征的ASR系统。

title: Adaptive 1D Video Diffusion Autoencoder
authors: Yao Teng, Minxuan Lin, Xian Liu, Shuai Wang, Xiao Yang, Xihui Liu
abstract: Recent video generation models largely rely on video autoencoders that compress pixel-space videos into latent representations. However, existing video autoencoders suffer from three major limitations: (1) fixed-rate compression that wastes tokens on simple videos, (2) inflexible CNN architectures that prevent variable-length latent modeling, and (3) deterministic decoders that struggle to recover appropriate details from compressed latents. To address these issues, we propose One-Dimensional Diffusion Video Autoencoder (One-DVA), a transformer-based framework for adaptive 1D encoding and diffusion-based decoding. The encoder employs query-based vision transformers to extract spatiotemporal features and produce latent representations, while a variable-length dropout mechanism dynamically adjusts the latent length. The decoder is a pixel-space diffusion transformer that reconstructs videos with the latents as input conditions. With a two-stage training strategy, One-DVA achieves performance comparable to 3D-CNN VAEs on reconstruction metrics at identical compression ratios. More importantly, it supports adaptive compression and thus can achieve higher compression ratios. To better support downstream latent generation, we further regularize the One-DVA latent distribution for generative modeling and fine-tune its decoder to mitigate artifacts caused by the generation process.
zh_title: 自适应一维视频扩散自编码器
translation: 最近的视频生成模型主要依赖于视频自编码器，将像素空间视频压缩成潜在表示。然而，现有的视频自编码器存在三个主要限制：（1）固定速率压缩，在简单视频上浪费标记；（2）不灵活的CNN架构，阻碍可变长度潜在建模；（3）确定性解码器难以从压缩的潜在表示中恢复适当的细节。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了**一维扩散视频自编码器（One-DVA）**，这是一个基于Transformer的框架，用于自适应一维编码和基于扩散的解码。编码器采用基于查询的视觉Transformer来提取时空特征并生成潜在表示，同时使用可变长度dropout机制动态调整潜在长度。解码器是一个像素空间扩散Transformer，以潜在表示作为输入条件来重建视频。通过两阶段训练策略，One-DVA在相同的压缩比下，在重建指标上实现了与3D-CNN VAEs相当的性能。更重要的是，它支持自适应压缩，因此可以实现更高的压缩比。为了更好地支持下游潜在生成，我们进一步对One-DVA的潜在分布进行正则化以进行生成建模，并微调其解码器以减轻生成过程引起的伪影。
tldr: 提出了一种名为One-DVA的自适应一维视频扩散自编码器，它使用基于Transformer的架构和扩散解码器，解决了现有视频自编码器固定压缩率和解码器确定性的问题，实现了更高的压缩率和可比的重建性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一种名为One-DVA的自适应一维视频扩散自编码器。它解决了现有视频自编码器中固定压缩率导致的资源浪费以及确定性解码器难以恢复细节的问题。通过引入基于Transformer的架构、可变长度dropout机制实现自适应编码，并利用扩散模型作为解码器，One-DVA在保持重建性能可比的同时，显著提高了压缩效率和压缩比，这对于构建更高效、更灵活的视频生成模型具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有视频自编码器存在三个主要限制：（1）固定速率压缩，在简单视频上浪费标记；（2）不灵活的CNN架构，阻碍可变长度潜在建模；（3）确定性解码器难以从压缩的潜在表示中恢复适当的细节。
method: 提出“一维扩散视频自编码器（One-DVA）”，这是一个基于Transformer的框架，用于自适应一维编码和基于扩散的解码。编码器采用基于查询的视觉Transformer来提取时空特征并生成潜在表示，并使用可变长度dropout机制动态调整潜在长度。解码器是一个像素空间扩散Transformer，以潜在表示作为输入条件来重建视频。此外，采用两阶段训练策略，并对潜在分布进行正则化，以支持下游生成建模，并微调解码器以减轻生成过程中的伪影。
results: One-DVA在相同的压缩比下，重建指标上的性能可与3D-CNN VAEs相媲美。更重要的是，它支持自适应压缩，因此可以实现更高的压缩比。

title: Mitigation of Structural Harmonic Instability in Virtual Admittance-Based Grid-Forming Inverters via Mimicking Skin Effect
authors: Jaekeun Lee, Jae-Jung Jung, Shenghui Cui
abstract: The virtual admittance-current controller (VA-CC) scheme is widely employed to emulate an equivalent inductance in front of the internal voltage source of grid-forming inverters. However, recent studies have reported harmonic instabilities associated with VA-CC, motivating the need for a more physically interpretable understanding of their origin. This letter identifies a delay-independent structural mechanism of harmonic instability in the VA-CC scheme, wherein the interaction between the filter and virtual inductances introduces a non-passive second-order transfer-function term exhibiting negative resistance. To address this issue, a simple yet effective modification is proposed by integrating a parallel virtual resistor into the VA structure. This reconfiguration enhances the passivity of VA-CC scheme across the harmonic range by mimicking the skin effect which augments damping in high-frequency range, without altering the wellestablished current controller or voltage feedforward control. Experimental results validate that the proposed method achieves robust harmonic stability, whereas the conventional approach fails under identical grid conditions.
zh_title: 模仿趋肤效应来减轻基于虚拟导纳的并网逆变器中的结构谐波不稳定性
translation: 虚拟导纳-电流控制器（VA-CC）方案被广泛用于模拟并网逆变器内部电压源前方的等效电感。然而，最近的研究报告了与VA-CC相关的谐波不稳定性，促使人们需要对其起源有更具物理可解释性的理解。本文确定了VA-CC方案中一种与延迟无关的结构性谐波不稳定性机制，其中滤波器和虚拟电感之间的相互作用引入了一个表现出负电阻的非无源二阶传递函数项。为解决此问题，本文提出了一种简单而有效的修改方法，即在VA结构中集成一个并联虚拟电阻。这种重新配置通过模仿趋肤效应来增强VA-CC方案在谐波范围内的无源性，趋肤效应在高频范围内增强了阻尼，且不改变成熟的电流控制器或电压前馈控制。实验结果验证了所提出的方法实现了鲁棒的谐波稳定性，而传统方法在相同的电网条件下会失效。
tldr: 基于虚拟导纳的并网逆变器存在结构性谐波不稳定性（负电阻效应）。本文提出通过在虚拟导纳中集成一个并联虚拟电阻，模仿趋肤效应来增强高频阻尼和无源性，从而在不改变现有控制器的前提下实现鲁棒的谐波稳定。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于识别了虚拟导纳-电流控制器（VA-CC）中一种特定的、与延迟无关的结构性谐波不稳定性机制（非无源二阶项/负电阻）。这超越了对时间延迟的传统关注。提出的解决方案巧妙地借鉴了物理现象——模仿趋肤效应，通过引入并联虚拟电阻来高效地增加高频阻尼，增强了系统的无源性。其重要性在于，它为广泛使用的并网逆变器VA-CC控制方案提供了一种简单而有效的改进方法，显著增强了其谐波稳定性，且无需修改现有成熟的控制器结构，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 虚拟导纳-电流控制器（VA-CC）方案在并网逆变器中被广泛采用，但最近的研究报告了与之相关的谐波不稳定性，因此需要对不稳定性起源进行更具物理可解释性的理解。
method: 1. 确定了VA-CC方案中一种与延迟无关的结构性谐波不稳定性机制，即滤波器和虚拟电感相互作用引入了表现出负电阻的非无源二阶传递函数项。2. 提出通过在虚拟导纳结构中集成一个并联虚拟电阻来修改VA结构。3. 该修改通过模仿趋肤效应在高频范围内增强阻尼，从而增强VA-CC方案在谐波范围内的无源性。
results: 实验结果验证了所提出的方法在相同的电网条件下能够实现鲁棒的谐波稳定性，而传统方法则会失效。

title: Following the TRAIL: Predicting and Explaining Tomorrow's Hits with a Fine-Tuned LLM
authors: Yinan Zhang, Zhixi Chen, Jiazheng Jing, Zhiqi Shen
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely applied across multiple domains for their broad knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities. However, applying them to recommendation systems is challenging since it is hard for LLMs to extract user preferences from large, sparse user-item logs, and real-time per-user ranking over the full catalog is too time-consuming to be practical. Moreover, many existing recommender systems focus solely on ranking items while overlooking explanations, which could help improve predictive accuracy and make recommendations more convincing to users. Inspired by recent works that achieve strong recommendation performance by forecasting near-term item popularity, we propose TRAIL (TRend and explAnation Integrated Learner). TRAIL is a fine-tuned LLM that jointly predicts short-term item popularity and generates faithful natural-language explanations. It employs contrastive learning with positive and negative pairs to align its scores and explanations with structured trend signals, yielding accurate and explainable popularity predictions. Extensive experiments show that TRAIL outperforms strong baselines and produces coherent, well-grounded explanations.
zh_title: 沿着 TRAIL：使用微调 LLM 预测和解释明日爆款
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）因其广泛的知识和强大的推理能力而被广泛应用于多个领域。然而，将其应用于推荐系统具有挑战性，因为 LLMs 很难从大型、稀疏的用户-物品日志中提取用户偏好，并且对整个目录进行实时的每用户排名过于耗时，不切实际。此外，许多现有推荐系统只关注物品排名而忽略了解释，而解释有助于提高预测准确性并使推荐对用户更具说服力。受近期通过预测近期物品流行度实现强大推荐性能的工作启发，我们提出了 TRAIL（趋势与解释集成学习器）。TRAIL 是一个经过微调的 LLM，它联合预测短期物品流行度并生成忠实的自然语言解释。它采用对比学习，利用正负样本对齐其分数和解释与结构化趋势信号，从而产生准确且可解释的流行度预测。广泛的实验表明，TRAIL 优于强大的基线模型，并生成连贯、有充分依据的解释。
tldr: 我们提出了 TRAIL，这是一个经过微调的大型语言模型，它使用对比学习来联合预测短期物品流行度（爆款）并生成有说服力的解释，性能优于现有基线。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将 LLM 应用于推荐系统时，避开了传统的稀疏用户-物品匹配难题，转而专注于短期物品流行度预测。更重要的是，它通过对比学习将“预测”和“生成解释”集成到一个微调的 LLM 框架 TRAIL 中，解决了现有推荐系统缺乏解释性的局限，提升了推荐的说服力和实用性。
motivation: 现有推荐系统中的 LLM 应用难以从稀疏日志中提取用户偏好，且实时排名成本高昂。此外，许多现有推荐系统忽略了解释，而解释对于提高预测准确性和增强用户说服力至关重要。
method: 提出了 TRAIL（趋势与解释集成学习器），这是一个经过微调的 LLM。TRAIL 联合预测短期物品流行度并生成忠实的自然语言解释。它采用对比学习，利用正负样本对齐分数和解释与结构化趋势信号。
results: 广泛的实验表明，TRAIL 优于强大的基线模型，并生成连贯、有充分依据的解释。

title: RAPO: Risk-Aware Preference Optimization for Generalizable Safe Reasoning
authors: Zeming Wei, Qiaosheng Zhang, Xia Hu, Xingcheng Xu
abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved tremendous success with their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, yet also face safety issues similar to those of basic language models. In particular, while algorithms are designed to guide them to deliberately refuse harmful prompts with safe reasoning, this process often fails to generalize against diverse and complex jailbreak attacks. In this work, we attribute these failures to the generalization of the safe reasoning process, particularly their insufficiency against complex attack prompts. We provide both theoretical and empirical evidence to show the necessity of a more sufficient safe reasoning process to defend against advanced attack prompts. Building on this insight, we propose a Risk-Aware Preference Optimization (RAPO) framework that enables LRM to adaptively identify and address the safety risks with appropriate granularity in its thinking content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RAPO successfully generalizes multiple LRMs' safe reasoning adaptively across diverse attack prompts whilst preserving general utility, contributing a robust alignment technique for LRM safety. Our code is available at https://github.com/weizeming/RAPO.
zh_title: RAPO：面向可泛化安全推理的风险感知偏好优化
translation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）凭借其思维链（CoT）推理取得了巨大成功，但同时也面临着与基础语言模型类似的安全问题。具体来说，尽管设计了算法来指导它们通过安全推理故意拒绝有害提示，但这一过程通常无法泛化以应对多样化和复杂的越狱攻击。在这项工作中，我们将这些失败归因于安全推理过程的泛化性，特别是它们在应对复杂攻击提示时的不足。我们提供了理论和经验证据，证明了需要一个更充分的安全推理过程来防御高级攻击提示。基于这一见解，我们提出了一个风险感知偏好优化（RAPO）框架，该框架使LRM能够自适应地识别和以适当的粒度在其思维内容中处理安全风险。广泛的实验证明，RAPO成功地使多个LRM的安全推理能够自适应地泛化到各种攻击提示，同时保持了通用实用性，为LRM安全贡献了一种强大的对齐技术。
tldr: 提出了一种名为RAPO（风险感知偏好优化）的框架，通过在思维内容中引入适当的粒度来帮助大型推理模型（LRMs）自适应地识别和解决安全风险，从而增强其安全推理对多样化越狱攻击的泛化能力。
ai_comments: 本文解决了大型推理模型（LRMs）安全对齐中的一个核心挑战：泛化性。通过将失败归因于安全推理过程的不足，并提出RAPO框架，它专注于优化模型的内部思考过程（CoT）的粒度，这是一种新颖且实用的方法。这种“风险感知”和“适应性粒度”的结合，有望显著提高模型对未知或复杂越狱攻击的鲁棒性，是安全对齐技术领域的重要贡献。
motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）及其思维链（CoT）推理存在安全问题，现有的安全推理算法在抵御多样化和复杂的越狱攻击时泛化能力不足。
method: 提出了一种名为“风险感知偏好优化”（RAPO）的框架。该框架使LRM能够在思维内容中自适应地识别并以适当的粒度处理安全风险。
results: 广泛的实验证明，RAPO成功地使多个LRM的安全推理能够自适应地泛化到各种攻击提示，同时保持了模型的通用实用性。
conclusion: RAPO为LRM的安全提供了一种强大的对齐技术，通过增强安全推理过程的泛化性来有效防御复杂的攻击。

title: Why Agentic-PRs Get Rejected: A Comparative Study of Coding Agents
authors: Sota Nakashima, Yuta Ishimoto, Masanari Kondo, Shane Mclntosh, Yasutaka Kamei
abstract: Agentic coding -- software development workflows in which autonomous coding agents plan, implement, and submit code changes with minimal human involvement -- is rapidly gaining traction. Prior work has shown that Pull Requests (PRs) produced using coding agents (Agentic-PRs) are accepted less often than PRs that are not labeled as agentic (Human-PRs). The rejection reasons for a single agent (Claude Code) have been explored, but a comparison of how rejection reasons differ between Agentic-PRs generated by different agents has not yet been performed. This comparison is important since different coding agents are often used for different purposes, which can lead to agent-specific failure patterns. In this paper, we inspect 654 rejected PRs from the AIDev dataset covering five coding agents, as well as a human baseline. Our results show that seven rejection modes occur only in Agentic-PRs, including distrust of AI-generated code. We also observe agent-specific patterns (e.g., automated withdrawal of inactive PRs by Devin), reflecting differences in how agents are configured and used in practice. Notably, a large proportion of rejected PRs (67.9%) lack explicit reviewer feedback, making their rejection reasons difficult to determine. To mitigate this issue, we propose a set of heuristics that reduce the proportion of such cases, offering a practical preprocessing step for future studies of PR rejection in agentic coding.
zh_title: 为什么代理式拉取请求会被拒绝：一项针对编码代理的比较研究
translation: 代理式编码——即自主编码代理以最少的人工干预来规划、实施和提交代码更改的软件开发工作流程——正在迅速普及。先前的研究表明，使用编码代理生成的拉取请求（Agentic-PRs）比未标记为代理式的拉取请求（Human-PRs）被接受的频率更低。虽然已经有人探索了单个代理（Claude Code）的拒绝原因，但尚未对不同代理生成的Agentic-PRs之间的拒绝原因差异进行比较。这种比较非常重要，因为不同的编码代理通常用于不同的目的，这可能导致特定于代理的故障模式。在本文中，我们检查了来自AIDev数据集的654个被拒绝的PR，涵盖了五个编码代理以及一个人类基线。我们的结果显示，有七种拒绝模式仅出现在Agentic-PRs中，包括对AI生成代码的不信任。我们还观察到代理特有的模式（例如，Devin自动撤回不活跃的PR），这反映了代理在实际配置和使用方式上的差异。值得注意的是，很大比例的被拒绝PR（67.9%）缺乏明确的审阅者反馈，这使得确定其拒绝原因变得困难。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了一套启发式方法，以减少此类案例的比例，为未来代理式编码中PR拒绝的研究提供了实用的预处理步骤。
tldr: 研究比较了五个编码代理生成的654个被拒绝的拉取请求（Agentic-PRs）与人类基线，发现Agentic-PRs有七种独有的拒绝模式（包括对AI代码的不信任）和特定的代理差异。同时，提出了启发式方法来解决大多数被拒绝的PR缺乏明确反馈的问题。
ai_comments:
**创新性与重要性：** 本研究首次对多个编码代理生成的被拒绝拉取请求进行了比较分析，识别出“对AI代码的不信任”等七种独特的拒绝模式，这对于理解和改进代理式编码的实际部署至关重要。它超越了对单一代理的分析，揭示了不同代理配置和策略对结果的影响。

**局限性：** 论文明确指出，绝大多数被拒绝的PR（67.9%）缺乏明确的审阅者反馈，这是核心数据分析面临的重大挑战。虽然提出了启发式方法来缓解，但这表明实际的拒绝原因很大程度上仍是推测性的。

**实用价值：** 提出的启发式方法具有很强的实用价值，为未来研究处理这类缺乏明确反馈的数据集提供了一个标准化的预处理流程。
motivation: 尽管代理式编码正在兴起，但由编码代理生成的拉取请求（Agentic-PRs）比人类生成的更容易被拒绝。现有研究缺乏对不同编码代理之间拒绝原因的比较分析，这种比较对于理解特定代理的故障模式至关重要。
method: 检查了来自AIDev数据集的654个被拒绝的拉取请求（PRs），这些PRs涵盖了五个编码代理以及一个人类基线。此外，提出了一套启发式方法来减少缺乏明确审阅者反馈的被拒绝PR的比例。
results: 观察到七种仅出现在Agentic-PRs中的拒绝模式，其中包括对AI生成代码的不信任。同时，发现了代理特有的模式（例如，Devin自动撤回不活跃的PR）。值得注意的是，很大比例的被拒绝PR（67.9%）缺乏明确的审阅者反馈。

title: An Intuitionistic Fuzzy Logic Driven UNet architecture: Application to Brain Image segmentation
authors: Hanuman Verma, Kiho Im, Pranabesh Maji, Akshansh Gupta
abstract: Accurate segmentation of MRI brain images is essential for image analysis, diagnosis of neuro-logical disorders and medical image computing. In the deep learning approach, the convolutional neural networks (CNNs), especially UNet, are widely applied in medical image segmentation. However, it is difficult to deal with uncertainty due to the partial volume effect in brain images. To overcome this limitation, we propose an enhanced framework, named UNet with intuitionistic fuzzy logic (IF-UNet), which incorporates intuitionistic fuzzy logic into UNet. The model processes input data in terms of membership, nonmembership, and hesitation degrees, allowing it to better address tissue ambiguity resulting from partial volume effects and boundary uncertainties. The proposed architecture is evaluated on the Internet Brain Segmentation Repository (IBSR) dataset, and its performance is computed using accuracy, Dice coefficient, and intersection over union (IoU). Experimental results confirm that IF-UNet improves segmentation quality with handling uncertainty in brain images.
zh_title: 一种直觉模糊逻辑驱动的UNet架构：应用于脑图像分割
translation: MRI脑图像的准确分割对于图像分析、神经系统疾病的诊断和医学图像计算至关重要。在深度学习方法中，卷积神经网络（CNNs），特别是UNet，被广泛应用于医学图像分割。然而，由于脑图像中的部分容积效应，处理不确定性变得困难。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种名为带有直觉模糊逻辑的UNet（IF-UNet）的增强框架，它将直觉模糊逻辑整合到UNet中。该模型根据隶属度、非隶属度和犹豫度来处理输入数据，使其能够更好地解决由部分容积效应和边界不确定性引起的组织模糊性。所提出的架构在Internet Brain Segmentation Repository（IBSR）数据集上进行了评估，其性能通过准确率、Dice系数和交并比（IoU）进行计算。实验结果证实IF-UNet在处理脑图像不确定性的同时提高了分割质量。
tldr: 针对脑图像分割中的不确定性，本文提出了IF-UNet，将直觉模糊逻辑引入UNet，以处理隶属度、非隶属度和犹豫度。该模型在IBSR数据集上提高了分割质量。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将直觉模糊逻辑（一种处理不确定性的经典数学工具）有效地集成到现代深度学习架构UNet中。这种混合方法允许模型显式地处理脑图像分割中固有的模糊性、不确定性和边界问题（如部分容积效应），超越了标准的概率或确定性深度学习输出，对于提高医学图像分割的鲁棒性具有重要意义。
motivation: 准确分割MRI脑图像至关重要，但现有深度学习方法（如UNet）难以处理脑图像中由部分容积效应引起的不确定性和组织模糊性。
method: 提出了一种名为IF-UNet的增强框架，将直觉模糊逻辑（Intuitionistic Fuzzy Logic）整合到UNet中。该模型通过处理隶属度、非隶属度和犹豫度来处理输入数据。
results: 在IBSR数据集上进行了评估，使用准确率、Dice系数和IoU进行性能计算。实验结果证实IF-UNet在处理脑图像不确定性的同时提高了分割质量。
conclusion: 通过整合直觉模糊逻辑，IF-UNet能够更好地解决脑图像分割中的组织模糊性和不确定性问题，从而提高了分割性能。

title: Reshaping Action Error Distributions for Reliable Vision-Language-Action Models
authors: Shuanghao Bai, Dakai Wang, Cheng Chi, Wanqi Zhou, Jing Lyu, Xiaoguang Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Lei Xing, Shanghang Zhang, Badong Chen
abstract: In robotic manipulation, vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for learning generalizable and scalable robot policies. Most existing VLA frameworks rely on standard supervised objectives, typically cross-entropy for discrete actions and mean squared error (MSE) for continuous action regression, which impose strong pointwise constraints on individual predictions. In this work, we focus on continuous-action VLA models and move beyond conventional MSE-based regression by reshaping action error distributions during training. Drawing on information-theoretic principles, we introduce Minimum Error Entropy (MEE) into modern VLA architectures and propose a trajectory-level MEE objective, together with two weighted variants, combined with MSE for continuous-action VLA training. We evaluate our approaches across standard, few-shot, and noisy settings on multiple representative VLA architectures, using simulation benchmarks such as LIBERO and SimplerEnv as well as real-world robotic manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in success rates and robustness across these settings. Under imbalanced data regimes, the gains persist within a well-characterized operating range, while incurring negligible additional training cost and no impact on inference efficiency. We further provide theoretical analyses that explain why MEE-based supervision is effective and characterize its practical range. Project Page: https://cognition2actionlab.github.io/VLA-TMEE.github.io/
zh_title: 重塑动作误差分布以实现可靠的视觉-语言-动作模型
translation: 在机器人操作领域，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为学习通用化和可扩展机器人策略的有前途范式。大多数现有的VLA框架依赖于标准的监督目标，通常是用于离散动作的交叉熵和用于连续动作回归的均方误差（MSE），这些目标对个体预测施加了强烈的点式约束。在这项工作中，我们专注于连续动作VLA模型，并通过在训练过程中重塑动作误差分布，超越了传统的基于MSE的回归方法。借鉴信息论原理，我们将最小误差熵（MEE）引入到现代VLA架构中，并提出了一种轨迹级MEE目标，以及两种加权变体，与MSE结合用于连续动作VLA训练。我们使用LIBERO和SimplerEnv等模拟基准以及真实世界的机器人操作任务，在标准、少样本和噪声设置下，对多种代表性VLA架构评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明，在这些设置中，成功率和鲁棒性得到持续改进。在数据不平衡的情况下，增益在特征明确的操作范围内持续存在，同时只会带来可忽略的额外训练成本，并且对推理效率没有影响。我们进一步提供了理论分析，解释了基于MEE的监督为何有效，并刻画了其实际应用范围。项目页面：https://cognition2actionlab.github.io/VLA-TMEE.github.io/
tldr: 针对连续动作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，本文引入了最小误差熵（MEE）来重塑动作误差分布，并提出了轨迹级MEE目标。实验证明，该方法能显著提高VLA模型的成功率和鲁棒性，且几乎不增加训练和推理成本。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将信息论中的最小误差熵（MEE）原则引入到连续动作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型训练中，通过重塑动作误差分布来提高模型的鲁棒性，而非简单依赖传统的点式约束（如MSE）。提出的轨迹级MEE目标及其与MSE的结合，为解决现有VLA模型在数据不平衡和噪声环境下的可靠性问题提供了一个高效且有理论支撑的解决方案，对于推动VLA模型在复杂机器人任务中的实际应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常依赖均方误差（MSE）等标准监督目标，这在个体预测上施加了强烈的点式约束。本文的动机是针对连续动作VLA模型，通过重塑动作误差分布来克服传统MSE的局限性，从而提高模型的可靠性和泛化能力。
method: 针对连续动作VLA模型，本文基于信息论原理引入了最小误差熵（MEE）。提出了一种轨迹级MEE目标（以及两种加权变体），并将其与传统的均方误差（MSE）相结合，用于VLA训练。
results: 在标准、少样本和噪声设置下，以及在LIBERO和SimplerEnv等模拟基准和真实世界机器人任务中，实验结果表明成功率和鲁棒性得到持续改进。在数据不平衡的情况下，增益在特定操作范围内依然存在，同时训练成本可忽略不计，且对推理效率没有影响。
conclusion: 本文提出的结合最小误差熵（MEE）的监督方法，能够有效重塑动作误差分布，从而显著提高连续动作视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的成功率和鲁棒性，且具备高效率和理论支撑。

title: GeoLanG: Geometry-Aware Language-Guided Grasping with Unified RGB-D Multimodal Learning
authors: Rui Tang, Guankun Wang, Long Bai, Huxin Gao, Jiewen Lai, Chi Kit Ng, Jiazheng Wang, Fan Zhang, Hongliang Ren
abstract: Language-guided grasping has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling robots to identify and manipulate target objects through natural language instructions, yet it remains highly challenging in cluttered or occluded scenes. Existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines that separate object perception and grasping, which leads to limited cross-modal fusion, redundant computation, and poor generalization in cluttered, occluded, or low-texture scenes. To address these limitations, we propose GeoLanG, an end-to-end multi-task framework built upon the CLIP architecture that unifies visual and linguistic inputs into a shared representation space for robust semantic alignment and improved generalization. To enhance target discrimination under occlusion and low-texture conditions, we explore a more effective use of depth information through the Depth-guided Geometric Module (DGGM), which converts depth into explicit geometric priors and injects them into the attention mechanism without additional computational overhead. In addition, we propose Adaptive Dense Channel Integration, which adaptively balances the contributions of multi-layer features to produce more discriminative and generalizable visual representations. Extensive experiments on the OCID-VLG dataset, as well as in both simulation and real-world hardware, demonstrate that GeoLanG enables precise and robust language-guided grasping in complex, cluttered environments, paving the way toward more reliable multimodal robotic manipulation in real-world human-centric settings.
zh_title: GeoLanG：统一RGB-D多模态学习的几何感知语言引导抓取
translation: 语言引导抓取已成为一种有前景的范式，使机器人能够通过自然语言指令识别和操作目标物体，但在杂乱或遮挡的场景中仍然极具挑战性。现有方法通常依赖于分离物体感知和抓取的多个阶段流程，这导致跨模态融合受限、计算冗余，以及在杂乱、遮挡或低纹理场景中泛化能力差。为解决这些限制，我们提出了GeoLanG，一个基于CLIP架构的端到端多任务框架，它将视觉和语言输入统一到一个共享表示空间中，以实现鲁棒的语义对齐和改进的泛化能力。为了增强在遮挡和低纹理条件下的目标区分能力，我们通过深度引导几何模块（DGGM）探索了更有效地利用深度信息的方法，该模块将深度转换为明确的几何先验，并将其注入注意力机制中，而无需额外的计算开销。此外，我们提出了自适应密集通道集成，它自适应地平衡多层特征的贡献，以产生更具区分性和泛化性的视觉表示。在OCID-VLG数据集以及模拟和真实世界硬件上的广泛实验表明，GeoLanG能够在复杂、杂乱的环境中实现精确且鲁棒的语言引导抓取，为在真实的以人为中心的设置中实现更可靠的多模态机器人操作铺平了道路。
tldr: GeoLanG是一个基于CLIP的端到端系统，用于语言引导抓取。它统一了RGB-D多模态学习，通过几何感知（DGGM）和自适应特征集成，在杂乱场景中实现了精确且鲁邦的抓取。
ai_comments: 本文的创新在于提出了GeoLanG，一个基于CLIP的端到端、统一多模态框架，解决了现有分阶段流程的局限性。它通过深度引导几何模块（DGGM）将深度信息转化为明确的几何先验并注入注意力机制，有效提高了在遮挡和低纹理场景下的目标区分能力和泛化性，且没有增加额外的计算开销。这种方法显著增强了模型在复杂环境中的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
motivation: 语言引导抓取在杂乱或遮挡场景中仍具挑战性。现有方法依赖多阶段流程，将物体感知与抓取分离，导致跨模态融合受限、计算冗余，以及在杂乱、遮挡或低纹理场景中泛化能力差。
method: 提出GeoLanG，一个基于CLIP架构的端到端多任务框架，将视觉和语言输入统一到共享表示空间中。方法包括：1. 深度引导几何模块（DGGM），将深度转换为明确的几何先验并注入注意力机制（无额外计算开销），以增强遮挡和低纹理条件下的目标区分。2. 自适应密集通道集成，自适应平衡多层特征的贡献，以生成更具区分性和泛化性的视觉表示。
results: 在OCID-VLG数据集以及模拟和真实硬件上的广泛实验表明，GeoLanG能够在复杂、杂乱的环境中实现精确且鲁棒的语言引导抓取。
conclusion: GeoLanG为在真实的以人为中心的设置中实现更可靠的多模态机器人操作铺平了道路。

title: Post-Quantum Identity-Based TLS for 5G Service-Based Architecture and Cloud-Native Infrastructure
authors: Vipin Kumar Rathi, Lakshya Chopra, Nikhil Kumar Rajput
abstract: Cloud-native application platforms and latency-sensitive systems such as 5G Core networks rely heavily on certificate-based Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and mutual TLS to secure service-to-service communication. While effective, this model introduces significant operational and performance overhead, which is further amplified in the post-quantum setting due to large certificates and expensive signature verification. In this paper, we present a certificate-free authentication framework for private distributed systems based on post-quantum Identity-Based Encryption(IBE). Our design replaces certificate and signature based authentication with identity-derived keys and identity-based key encapsulation, enabling mutually authenticated TLS connections without certificate transmission or validation. We describe an IBE-based replacement for private PKI, including identity lifecycle management, and show how it can be instantiated using a threshold Private Key Generator (T-PKG). We apply this framework to cloud-native application deployments and latency-sensitive 5G Core networks. In particular, we demonstrate how identity-based TLS integrates with the 5G Service-Based Architecture while preserving security semantics and 3GPP requirements, and we show how the same architecture can replace private PKI in Kubernetes, including its control plane, without disrupting existing trust domains or deployment models.
zh_title: 后量子基于身份的TLS用于5G服务化架构和云原生基础设施
translation: 云原生应用平台和延迟敏感系统（如5G核心网络）严重依赖基于证书的公钥基础设施（PKI）和相互TLS来保护服务间通信。虽然有效，但这种模型引入了显著的运营和性能开销，在后量子环境下，由于大型证书和昂贵的签名验证，这种开销进一步放大。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于后量子身份基加密（IBE）的私有分布式系统无证书身份验证框架。我们的设计用身份派生密钥和基于身份的密钥封装取代了基于证书和签名的身份验证，从而实现了无需证书传输或验证的相互认证TLS连接。我们描述了基于IBE的私有PKI替代方案，包括身份生命周期管理，并展示了如何使用阈值私钥生成器（T-PKG）进行实例化。我们将此框架应用于云原生应用部署和延迟敏感的5G核心网络。特别是，我们演示了基于身份的TLS如何与5G服务化架构集成，同时保留了安全语义和3GPP要求，并且展示了同样的架构如何在不破坏现有信任域或部署模型的情况下取代Kubernetes（包括其控制平面）中的私有PKI。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于后量子身份基加密（IBE）的无证书身份验证框架，用于取代5G核心网和云原生基础设施中的传统PKI和TLS，通过使用身份派生密钥和身份基密钥封装来消除证书传输和验证的开销，从而解决后量子环境下的性能瓶颈。
ai_comments: 这项工作具有重要的实际意义和前瞻性。它解决了两个关键的现代基础设施挑战：一是云原生和5G对低延迟、高效率通信的需求；二是向后量子安全的过渡。通过用身份基加密取代传统的PKI证书，该方法有望大幅减少TLS握手开销，特别是在频繁的服务间通信场景中。将T-PKG（阈值私钥生成器）用于私钥生成，也增强了系统的信任分散和弹性。其创新点在于将后量子IBE技术与复杂的5G服务化架构和Kubernetes控制平面紧密结合，提供了证书管理的革命性替代方案。
motivation: 当前云原生平台和5G核心网中依赖的基于证书的PKI和相互TLS引入了显著的运营和性能开销。在后量子时代，由于证书增大和签名验证成本高昂，这一问题更加严重。
method: 提出一个基于后量子身份基加密（IBE）的无证书身份验证框架。该设计使用身份派生密钥和身份基密钥封装取代基于证书和签名的身份验证，从而在无需证书传输或验证的情况下实现相互认证的TLS连接。该框架描述了基于IBE的私有PKI替代方案，包括身份生命周期管理，并展示了如何使用阈值私钥生成器（T-PKG）进行实例化。
results: 展示了基于身份的TLS如何与5G服务化架构集成，同时保留了安全语义和3GPP要求；并展示了该架构如何在不破坏现有信任域或部署模型的情况下取代Kubernetes（包括其控制平面）中的私有PKI。

title: Towards $C^0$ finite element methods for fourth-order elliptic equation. Part I: general boundary conditions
authors: Xihao Zhang, Hengguang Li, Nianyu Yi, Peimeng Yin
abstract: This paper is part of a series developing $C^0$ finite element methods for fourth-order elliptic equations on polygonal domains. Here, we investigate how boundary conditions influence the design of effective $C^0$ schemes, specifically focusing on equations without lower-order terms, namely the biharmonic equation. We propose a modified mixed formulation that decomposes the problem into a system of Poisson equations, where the number of equations depends on both the largest interior angle and the boundary conditions on its two adjacent sides. In contrast to the naive mixed formulation, which involves only two Poisson problems, the proposed approach guarantees convergence to the true solution for arbitrary polygonal domains and general boundary conditions, including Navier, Neumann, and mixed boundary conditions. $C^0$ finite element algorithms are developed, rigorous error estimates are established, and numerical experiments are presented to demonstrate the well-posedness and effectiveness of the proposed method.
zh_title: 迈向四阶椭圆方程的 $C^0$ 有限元方法。第一部分：一般边界条件
translation: 本文是为多边形域上的四阶椭圆方程开发 $C^0$ 有限元方法系列研究的一部分。在此，我们研究边界条件如何影响有效的 $C^0$ 方案设计，特别关注没有低阶项的方程，即双调和方程。我们提出了一种改进的混合公式，将问题分解为一个泊松方程系统，其中方程的数量取决于最大内角及其两条相邻边上的边界条件。与仅涉及两个泊松问题的朴素混合公式相比，所提出的方法保证了对于任意多边形域和一般边界条件（包括Navier、Neumann和混合边界条件）收敛到真实解。本文开发了 $C^0$ 有限元算法，建立了严格的误差估计，并通过数值实验证明了所提出方法的适定性和有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的混合公式，通过将四阶椭圆方程（如双调和方程）分解为多个泊松方程系统，实现了适用于任意多边形域和一般边界条件（包括Navier、Neumann和混合条件）的$C^0$有限元方法，并证明了其收敛性和有效性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一种改进的混合公式，成功解决了在任意多边形域和一般边界条件下，四阶椭圆方程（特别是双调和方程）的 $C^0$ 有限元方法所面临的收敛性挑战。通过将问题分解为适应几何和边界条件的泊松方程系统，该方法克服了朴素混合公式的局限性，从而确保了对于广泛的实际工程问题具有理论上的收敛保障。
motivation: 旨在为多边形域上的四阶椭圆方程开发 $C^0$ 有限元方法，并研究边界条件（如Navier、Neumann和混合条件）如何影响有效的 $C^0$ 方案设计，以确保在任意多边形域和一般边界条件下算法的收敛性。
method: 提出了一种改进的混合公式，将问题分解为一个泊松方程系统。该系统中方程的数量取决于最大内角及其两条相邻边上的边界条件。在此基础上开发了 $C^0$ 有限元算法。
results: 该方法保证了在任意多边形域和一般边界条件（包括Navier、Neumann和混合条件）下收敛到真实解。建立了严格的误差估计，数值实验证明了所提出方法的适定性和有效性。
conclusion: 本文成功开发了一种改进的混合公式，为具有一般边界条件的四阶椭圆方程（特别是双调和方程）在任意多边形域上提供了收敛且有效的 $C^0$ 有限元方法。

title: On the Uncertainty of Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Yuxuan Zhao, Sijia Chen, Ningxin Su
abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a prominent paradigm for leveraging large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex tasks. However, the mechanisms governing the effectiveness of MAS built upon publicly available LLMs, specifically the underlying rationales for their success or failure, remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we revisit MAS through the perspective of uncertainty, considering both intra- and inter-agent dynamics by investigating entropy transitions during problem-solving across various topologies and six benchmark tasks. By analyzing 245 features spanning token-, trajectory-, and round-level entropy, we counterintuitively find that a single agent outperforms MAS in approximately 43.3% of cases, and that uncertainty dynamics are largely determined during the first round of interaction. Furthermore, we provide three key observations: 1) Certainty Preference: reducing uncertainty at any stage for any agent is critical for guaranteeing correct solutions; 2) Base Uncertainty: base models with lower entropy during problem-solving directly benefit MAS performance; and 3) Task Awareness: entropy dynamics of MAS play varying roles across different tasks. Building on these insights, we introduce a simple yet effective algorithm, the Entropy Judger, to select solutions from MAS's pass@k results, leading to consistent accuracy improvements across all MAS configurations and tasks. Our source code is available at https://github.com/AgenticFinLab/multiagent-entropy.
zh_title: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统的不确定性研究
translation: 多智能体系统（MAS）已成为利用大型语言模型（LLMs）解决复杂任务的突出范式。然而，基于公开可用LLM构建的MAS的有效性机制，特别是其成功或失败的根本原因，在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们通过不确定性的视角重新审视MAS，通过调查跨各种拓扑结构和六个基准任务中问题解决过程中的熵转换，考虑了智能体内部和智能体之间的动态。通过分析跨越词元级、轨迹级和轮次级的245个特征，我们反直觉地发现，单个智能体在大约43.3%的案例中优于MAS，并且不确定性动态主要在第一轮交互中确定。此外，我们提供了三个关键观察结果：1) 确定性偏好：在任何阶段为任何智能体减少不确定性对于保证正确的解决方案至关重要；2) 基础不确定性：在问题解决过程中具有较低熵的基础模型直接有益于MAS性能；3) 任务感知：MAS的熵动态在不同任务中发挥着不同的作用。基于这些见解，我们引入了一个简单但有效的算法——熵判断器（Entropy Judger），用于从MAS的pass@k结果中选择解决方案，从而在所有MAS配置和任务中实现一致的准确性改进。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/AgenticFinLab/multiagent-entropy获取。
tldr: 本文从不确定性的角度（通过熵）研究了基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）的成功或失败机制。研究发现，单个智能体在43.3%的情况下优于MAS，且不确定性主要在第一轮确定。作者提出了“确定性偏好”等三个关键观察，并引入了“熵判断器”（Entropy Judger）算法，该算法能有效提高MAS的准确性。
ai_comments: 创新点在于首次系统性地将信息论中的“熵”（作为不确定性的度量）引入到对LLM驱动的MAS机制的分析中，提供了一个量化和解释MAS行为的新框架。该研究挑战了“多智能体一定优于单智能体”的普遍假设，通过反直觉的发现（单智能体在43.3%的情况下更优）突出了MAS设计中不确定性管理的关键性。提出的“熵判断器”算法证明了理论分析的实用价值。其重要性在于为未来设计更鲁棒、更高效的LLM代理系统提供了明确的指导原则（如降低基础模型熵和初始轮次的不确定性）。
motivation: 尽管基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体系统（MAS）在解决复杂任务方面表现突出，但目前对于构建于公开LLM之上的MAS的有效性机制，特别是其成功或失败的根本原因，仍缺乏深入探索。
method: 通过不确定性的视角重新审视MAS，具体方法是调查在不同拓扑结构和六个基准任务中，问题解决过程中的熵（entropy）转换，同时考虑智能体内部和智能体之间的动态。分析了245个特征，涵盖了词元级、轨迹级和轮次级的熵。在此基础上，提出了一个名为“熵判断器”（Entropy Judger）的简单算法，用于从MAS的pass@k结果中选择解决方案。
results: 反直觉地发现，单个智能体在大约43.3%的案例中优于多智能体系统（MAS）。不确定性动态主要在第一轮交互中确定。提出了三个关键观察：1) 确定性偏好：在任何阶段为任何智能体减少不确定性对于保证正确解决方案至关重要；2) 基础不确定性：问题解决过程中熵较低的基础模型直接有益于MAS性能；3) 任务感知：MAS的熵动态在不同任务中发挥着不同的作用。“熵判断器”算法在所有MAS配置和任务中都带来了一致的准确性提升。
conclusion: 通过分析熵转换，揭示了LLM-MAS中不确定性动态的关键作用，并提供了三个关于提高MAS性能的关键指导原则（确定性偏好、基础不确定性和任务感知）。“熵判断器”算法证明了这些见解的实用性，能够持续提高MAS的准确性。

title: Cascading Robustness Verification: Toward Efficient Model-Agnostic Certification
authors: Mohammadreza Maleki, Rushendra Sidibomma, Arman Adibi, Reza Samavi
abstract: Certifying neural network robustness against adversarial examples is challenging, as formal guarantees often require solving non-convex problems. Hence, incomplete verifiers are widely used because they scale efficiently and substantially reduce the cost of robustness verification compared to complete methods. However, relying on a single verifier can underestimate robustness because of loose approximations or misalignment with training methods. In this work, we propose Cascading Robustness Verification (CRV), which goes beyond an engineering improvement by exposing fundamental limitations of existing robustness metric and introducing a framework that enhances both reliability and efficiency. CRV is a model-agnostic verifier, meaning that its robustness guarantees are independent of the model's training process. The key insight behind the CRV framework is that, when using multiple verification methods, an input is certifiably robust if at least one method certifies it as robust. Rather than relying solely on a single verifier with a fixed constraint set, CRV progressively applies multiple verifiers to balance the tightness of the bound and computational cost. Starting with the least expensive method, CRV halts as soon as an input is certified as robust; otherwise, it proceeds to more expensive methods. For computationally expensive methods, we introduce a Stepwise Relaxation Algorithm (SR) that incrementally adds constraints and checks for certification at each step, thereby avoiding unnecessary computation. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that CRV achieves equal or higher verified accuracy compared to powerful but computationally expensive incomplete verifiers in the cascade, while significantly reducing verification overhead. Empirical results confirm that CRV certifies at least as many inputs as benchmark approaches, while improving runtime efficiency by up to ~90%.
zh_title: 级联鲁棒性验证：迈向高效的模型无关认证
translation: 认证神经网络对抗性样本的鲁棒性极具挑战性，因为形式化保证通常需要解决非凸问题。因此，不完备的验证器被广泛使用，因为它们具有高效的可扩展性，并且与完整方法相比，大大降低了鲁棒性验证的成本。然而，由于近似松弛或与训练方法不一致，仅依赖单一验证器可能会低估鲁棒性。在这项工作中，我们提出了级联鲁棒性验证（CRV），它通过揭示现有鲁棒性度量的根本局限性，并引入一个同时增强可靠性和效率的框架，从而超越了工程改进。CRV是一种模型无关的验证器，这意味着其鲁棒性保证独立于模型的训练过程。CRV框架背后的关键见解是，当使用多个验证方法时，如果至少有一种方法认证输入是鲁棒的，则该输入是可认证鲁棒的。CRV没有仅仅依赖于具有固定约束集的单一验证器，而是逐步应用多个验证器，以平衡边界的紧密性和计算成本。CRV从成本最低的方法开始，一旦输入被认证为鲁棒，它就会停止；否则，它会继续使用更昂贵的方法。对于计算昂贵的方法，我们引入了逐步松弛算法（SR），该算法逐步增加约束并在每一步检查认证，从而避免不必要的计算。我们的理论分析表明，CRV与级联中强大但计算昂贵的不完备验证器相比，实现了相同或更高的验证准确性，同时显著减少了验证开销。实证结果证实，CRV认证的输入数量至少与基准方法一样多，同时运行效率提高了高达约90%。
tldr: 提出“级联鲁棒性验证”（CRV）框架，通过顺序应用多个验证器，并结合逐步松弛算法（SR），在保持甚至提高验证准确性的同时，将鲁棒性验证的运行效率提高了约90%。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将多个鲁棒性验证器集成到一个“级联”框架中，利用了不同验证器在紧密性和计算成本上的权衡差异。通过将模型无关性与顺序验证策略相结合，并辅以逐步松弛算法（SR），该方法有效地解决了现有不完备验证器在保证可靠性与提高效率之间的矛盾。这种方法论上的改进，即将多个验证结果的“或”逻辑用于最终认证，同时动态调整计算资源的使用，对于大规模神经网络的鲁棒性认证具有重要的实际意义和效率提升价值。
motivation: 认证神经网络的鲁棒性需要解决非凸问题，因此计算成本高昂。广泛使用的不完备验证器虽然高效，但可能因为近似松弛或与训练方法不匹配而低估模型的实际鲁棒性。
method: 提出级联鲁棒性验证（CRV）框架，这是一种模型无关的验证器。核心思想是利用多个验证方法，只要其中至少一个认证输入是鲁棒的，该输入即被认证为鲁棒。CRV通过逐步应用多个验证器来平衡边界紧密性和计算成本，从最不昂贵的方法开始，一旦认证成功即停止。针对计算昂贵的方法，引入了逐步松弛算法（SR），该算法通过增量添加约束并在每一步检查认证，从而避免不必要的计算。
results: 理论分析表明，CRV与级联中强大但计算昂贵的不完备验证器相比，验证准确性持平或更高，同时显著减少了验证开销。实证结果证实，CRV认证的输入数量至少与基准方法一样多，同时运行效率提高了高达约90%。

title: Viewpoint Matters: Dynamically Optimizing Viewpoints with Masked Autoencoder for Visual Manipulation
authors: Pengfei Yi, Yifan Han, Junyan Li, Litao Liu, Wenzhao Lian
abstract: Robotic manipulation continues to be a challenge, and imitation learning (IL) enables robots to learn tasks from expert demonstrations. Current IL methods typically rely on fixed camera setups, where cameras are manually positioned in static locations, imposing significant limitations on adaptability and coverage. Inspired by human active perception, where humans dynamically adjust their viewpoint to capture the most relevant and least noisy information, we propose MAE-Select, a novel framework for active viewpoint selection in single-camera robotic systems. MAE-Select fully leverages pre-trained multi-view masked autoencoder representations and dynamically selects the next most informative viewpoint at each time chunk without requiring labeled viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAE-Select improves the capabilities of single-camera systems and, in some cases, even surpasses multi-camera setups. The project will be available at https://mae-select.github.io.
zh_title: 视角至关重要：使用掩码自编码器动态优化视角以进行视觉操作
translation: 机器人操作仍然是一个挑战，而模仿学习（IL）使机器人能够从专家演示中学习任务。当前的模仿学习方法通常依赖固定的摄像机设置，摄像机被手动放置在静态位置，这给适应性和覆盖范围带来了重大限制。受人类主动感知（人类动态调整视角以捕获最相关和噪声最少的信息）的启发，我们提出了 MAE-Select，这是一个用于单摄像机机器人系统主动视角选择的新颖框架。MAE-Select 充分利用了预训练的多视角掩码自编码器表示，并在每个时间块动态选择下一个信息量最大的视角，而无需标记的视角。大量的实验证明 MAE-Select 提高了单摄像机系统的能力，在某些情况下甚至超越了多摄像机设置。该项目将发布在 https://mae-select.github.io。
tldr: 传统的固定摄像机限制了机器人模仿学习。我们提出了 MAE-Select 框架，它利用掩码自编码器（MAE）表示来动态优化视角选择。这使得单摄像机系统性能得到提升，在某些情况下甚至超越了多摄像机系统。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将人类主动感知的思想引入机器人操作，并利用预训练的多视角掩码自编码器（MAE）表示进行动态视角优化。这解决了传统模仿学习中固定摄像机设置的根本限制。通过利用无标签的自监督学习表示来动态选择最具信息量的视角，极大地提高了单摄像机系统的效率和适应性。实验结果显示其性能有时能超越多摄像机设置，这表明该方法在降低硬件复杂性的同时提升了性能，具有重要的实际意义。
motivation: 现有的模仿学习（IL）方法通常依赖固定摄像机设置，这严重限制了适应性和覆盖范围。本文的灵感来源于人类主动感知，即人类会动态调整视角以捕获最相关且噪声最少的信息。
method: 提出了 MAE-Select，一个用于单摄像机机器人系统的主动视角选择的新颖框架。该框架充分利用了预训练的多视角掩码自编码器（MAE）表示，并在每个时间块动态选择下一个信息量最大的视角，而无需标记的视角。
results: 大量的实验证明 MAE-Select 提高了单摄像机系统的能力，在某些情况下甚至超越了多摄像机设置。
conclusion: MAE-Select 通过动态选择最具信息量的视角，成功解决了固定摄像机设置的局限性，从而提高了单摄像机机器人的操作能力，并在某些情况下甚至超越了多摄像机系统。

title: Strategic Adaptation Under Contextual Change: Insights from a Dyadic Negotiation Testbed for AI Coaching Technologies
authors: Mobasshira Akter Urmi, Raiyan Abdul Baten
abstract: Strategic adaptation -- the ability to adjust interaction behavior in response to changing constraints and leverage -- is a central goal of negotiation training and an emerging target for AI coaching systems. However, adaptation is difficult to evaluate because adaptation-relevant moments arise unpredictably in typical tasks. We study a reusable dyadic negotiation testbed that employs a controlled midstream change in one party's outside alternative as a repeatable perturbation to stress-test adaptation. In a six-round chat-based negotiation study (N=100), the perturbation reliably reorganized interaction dynamics: transitions between integrative (cooperative) and distributive (positional) behaviors declined, behavioral diversity narrowed, and interactions drifted toward more distributive tactics. Critically, this distributive drift predicted worse relational experience net of objective outcomes, and adaptation patterns were path dependent on prior behavior. These results establish a methodological bridge for evaluating and comparing AI coaching systems on strategic adaptation as a process and identify failure modes and design targets for adaptive interaction support.
zh_title: 情境变化下的策略适应：来自用于AI辅导技术的双边谈判试验台的见解
translation: 策略适应——根据不断变化的约束和筹码调整交互行为的能力——是谈判培训的核心目标，也是新兴AI辅导系统的目标。然而，适应性难以评估，因为适应性相关的关键时刻在典型任务中是不可预测的。我们研究了一个可重复使用的双边谈判试验台，它采用对一方外部替代方案进行受控的中途改变作为可重复的扰动，以对适应性进行压力测试。在一项六轮、基于聊天的谈判研究（N=100）中，这种扰动可靠地重组了交互动态：整合性（合作性）和分配性（立场性）行为之间的转换减少，行为多样性变窄，交互转向更多分配性策略。至关重要的是，这种分配性漂移预测了更差的关系体验（与客观结果无关），并且适应模式依赖于先前的行为路径。这些结果建立了一个方法论桥梁，用于评估和比较AI辅导系统在策略适应过程中的表现，并确定了自适应交互支持的失败模式和设计目标。
tldr: 研究使用了一个双边谈判试验台，通过控制中途情境变化来测试策略适应。结果显示，情境变化导致谈判行为向分配式策略漂移，损害了关系体验，并证明了评估AI辅导系统策略适应性的方法论。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于其方法论：设计了一个可重复、可控的“压力测试”环境（通过中途改变外部替代方案），从而系统性地研究和评估复杂的策略适应行为。这解决了传统谈判任务中适应性相关时刻不可预测的局限性。其重要性在于，它不仅揭示了人类在压力下的适应失败模式（即向分配性策略的有害漂移及其对关系的影响），还为新兴的AI谈判教练系统提供了一个清晰、可量化的评估框架和设计靶点。
motivation: 策略适应（根据不断变化的约束和筹码调整交互行为的能力）是谈判培训的核心目标，也是新兴AI辅导系统的目标。然而，由于适应性相关的关键时刻在典型任务中不可预测，因此难以评估。
method: 采用一个可重复使用的双边谈判试验台，通过在中途控制性地改变一方的外部替代方案作为可重复的扰动，来对策略适应进行压力测试。进行了一项六轮、基于聊天的谈判研究（N=100）。
results: 这种扰动可靠地重组了交互动态：整合性（合作性）和分配性（立场性）行为之间的转换减少，行为多样性变窄，交互转向更多分配性策略（分配性漂移）。这种分配性漂移预测了更差的关系体验（与客观结果无关），并且适应模式依赖于先前的行为路径。
conclusion: 这些结果建立了一个方法论桥梁，用于评估和比较AI辅导系统在策略适应过程中的表现，并确定了自适应交互支持的失败模式和设计目标。

title: SPOT-Occ: Sparse Prototype-guided Transformer for Camera-based 3D Occupancy Prediction
authors: Suzeyu Chen, Leheng Li, Ying-Cong Chen
abstract:
Achieving highly accurate and real-time 3D occupancy prediction from cameras is a critical requirement for the safe and practical deployment of autonomous vehicles. While this shift to sparse 3D representations solves the encoding bottleneck, it creates a new challenge for the decoder: how to efficiently aggregate information from a sparse, non-uniformly distributed set of voxel features without resorting to computationally prohibitive dense attention.
  In this paper, we propose a novel Prototype-based Sparse Transformer Decoder that replaces this costly interaction with an efficient, two-stage process of guided feature selection and focused aggregation. Our core idea is to make the decoder's attention prototype-guided. We achieve this through a sparse prototype selection mechanism, where each query adaptively identifies a compact set of the most salient voxel features, termed prototypes, for focused feature aggregation.
  To ensure this dynamic selection is stable and effective, we introduce a complementary denoising paradigm. This approach leverages ground-truth masks to provide explicit guidance, guaranteeing a consistent query-prototype association across decoder layers. Our model, dubbed SPOT-Occ, outperforms previous methods with a significant margin in speed while also improving accuracy. Source code is released at https://github.com/chensuzeyu/SpotOcc.
zh_title: SPOT-Occ: 基于稀疏原型引导Transformer的相机3D占用预测
translation:
从相机实现高精度、实时3D占用预测是自动驾驶车辆安全实用部署的关键要求。虽然这种向稀疏3D表示的转变解决了编码瓶颈，但它为解码器带来了一个新挑战：如何在不使用计算成本高昂的密集注意力的情况下，从稀疏、非均匀分布的体素特征集中高效聚合信息。
在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于原型的稀疏Transformer解码器，它用高效的两阶段引导特征选择和聚焦聚合过程取代了这种昂贵的交互。我们的核心思想是使解码器的注意力由原型引导。我们通过稀疏原型选择机制实现这一点，其中每个查询自适应地识别一组紧凑的最显著体素特征（称为原型），用于聚焦特征聚合。
为了确保这种动态选择的稳定性和有效性，我们引入了一种互补的去噪范式。这种方法利用地面真值掩码提供明确指导，保证解码器层之间一致的查询-原型关联。我们的模型，命名为SPOT-Occ，在速度上显著优于现有方法，同时提高了精度。源代码已在https://github.com/chensuzeyu/SpotOcc发布。
tldr: SPOT-Occ提出了一种稀疏原型引导的Transformer解码器，用于相机3D占用预测，通过两阶段特征选择和聚合，显著提高了速度和精度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了稀疏原型引导的Transformer解码器，有效解决了稀疏3D表示在解码阶段的计算效率问题，避免了密集注意力的高昂成本。其原型选择机制和去噪范式设计巧妙，为实时高精度3D占用预测提供了新的思路，对自动驾驶领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 从相机实现高精度、实时3D占用预测是自动驾驶车辆安全实用部署的关键要求。将3D表示稀疏化解决了编码瓶颈，但为解码器带来了新的挑战：如何在不使用计算成本高昂的密集注意力的情况下，从稀疏、非均匀分布的体素特征集中高效聚合信息。
method: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于原型的稀疏Transformer解码器，用高效的两阶段引导特征选择和聚焦聚合过程取代了昂贵的交互。核心思想是使解码器的注意力由原型引导。通过稀疏原型选择机制实现，其中每个查询自适应地识别一组紧凑的最显著体素特征（称为原型）用于聚焦特征聚合。为了确保这种动态选择的稳定性和有效性，引入了互补的去噪范式，利用地面真值掩码提供明确指导，保证解码器层之间一致的查询-原型关联。
results: SPOT-Occ模型在速度上显著优于现有方法，同时提高了精度。
conclusion: SPOT-Occ通过其新颖的稀疏原型引导Transformer解码器，成功解决了相机3D占用预测中的效率和精度挑战，为自动驾驶车辆提供了关键技术支持。

title: Tokenization and Morphological Fidelity in Uralic NLP: A Cross-Lingual Evaluation
authors: Nuo Xu, Ahrii Kim
abstract: Subword tokenization critically affects Natural Language Processing (NLP) performance, yet its behavior in morphologically rich and low-resource language families remains under-explored. This study systematically compares three subword paradigms -- Byte Pair Encoding (BPE), Overlap BPE (OBPE), and Unigram Language Model -- across six Uralic languages with varying resource availability and typological diversity. Using part-of-speech (POS) tagging as a controlled downstream task, we show that OBPE consistently achieves stronger morphological alignment and higher tagging accuracy than conventional methods, particularly within the Latin-script group. These gains arise from reduced fragmentation in open-class categories and a better balance across the frequency spectrum. Transfer efficacy further depends on the downstream tagging architecture, interacting with both training volume and genealogical proximity. Taken together, these findings highlight that morphology-sensitive tokenization is not merely a preprocessing choice but a decisive factor in enabling effective cross-lingual transfer for agglutinative, low-resource languages.
zh_title: 乌拉尔语族自然语言处理中的分词与形态忠实度：一项跨语言评估
translation: 子词分词严重影响自然语言处理（NLP）的性能，但其在形态丰富且资源匮乏的语族中的表现仍未得到充分探索。本研究系统地比较了三种子词范式——字节对编码（BPE）、重叠BPE（OBPE）和Unigram语言模型——涵盖六种资源可用性和类型多样性各异的乌拉尔语族语言。我们使用词性标注（POS tagging）作为受控的下游任务，结果显示，与传统方法相比，OBPE始终能实现更强的形态对齐和更高的标注准确性，尤其是在拉丁字母书写的语族中。这些提升源于开放词类别中的碎片化减少，以及在频率谱上的更好平衡。迁移效率进一步取决于下游标注架构，并与训练量和谱系邻近度相互作用。总而言之，这些发现强调，对形态敏感的分词不仅仅是预处理的选择，而是实现粘着型低资源语言有效跨语言迁移的决定性因素。
tldr: 对于形态丰富的低资源乌拉尔语族语言，子词分词（尤其是重叠BPE/OBPE）至关重要。OBPE比传统方法能更好地实现形态对齐和词性标注准确性，表明对形态敏感的分词是实现有效跨语言迁移的关键因素。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新点在于系统地比较了不同子词分词范式（尤其是新颖的OBPE）在形态丰富的低资源语族——乌拉尔语族——中的效果。它打破了分词只是简单预处理的传统观念，明确指出OBPE能够通过减少开放词类别的碎片化和优化频率平衡，显著提升形态忠实度和下游任务（如POS标注）的准确性。其重要性在于为处理粘着型低资源语言的NLP任务提供了明确的指导，强调了在跨语言迁移中选择形态感知型分词策略的关键性。
motivation: 子词分词严重影响NLP性能，但其在形态丰富且资源匮乏的语族（如乌拉尔语族）中的表现尚未得到充分探索。
method: 系统地比较了三种子词范式（BPE、OBPE和Unigram语言模型），涵盖六种资源可用性和类型多样性各异的乌拉尔语族语言。使用词性标注（POS tagging）作为受控的下游任务。
results: OBPE始终比传统方法能实现更强的形态对齐和更高的词性标注准确性，尤其是在拉丁字母书写的语言中。这些提升源于开放词类别的碎片化减少以及在频率谱上的更好平衡。迁移效率还取决于下游标注架构，并与训练量和谱系邻近度相互作用。
conclusion: 对形态敏感的分词不仅仅是预处理的选择，而是实现粘着型低资源语言有效跨语言迁移的决定性因素。

title: CoLT: Reasoning with Chain of Latent Tool Calls
authors: Fangwei Zhu, Zhifang Sui
abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is a critical technique in enhancing the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), and latent reasoning methods have been proposed to accelerate the inefficient token-level reasoning chain. We notice that existing latent reasoning methods generally require model structure augmentation and exhaustive training, limiting their broader applicability. In this paper, we propose CoLT, a novel framework that implements latent reasoning as ``tool calls''. Instead of reasoning entirely in the latent space, CoLT generates seed tokens that contain information of a reasoning step. When a latent tool call is triggered, a smaller external model will take the hidden states of seed tokens as its input, and unpack the seed tokens back to a full reasoning step. In this way, we can ensure that the main model reasons in the explicit token space, preserving its ability while improving efficiency. Experimental results on four mathematical datasets demonstrate that CoLT achieves higher accuracy and shorter reasoning length than baseline latent models, and is compatible with reinforcement learning algorithms and different decoder structures.
zh_title: CoLT：具有潜在工具调用的链式推理
translation: 思维链（CoT）是增强大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的关键技术，而潜在推理方法已被提出以加速低效的令牌级推理链。我们注意到，现有的潜在推理方法通常需要模型结构增强和详尽的训练，这限制了它们的广泛应用。在本文中，我们提出了CoLT，一个将潜在推理实现为“工具调用”的新颖框架。CoLT不完全在潜在空间中进行推理，而是生成包含推理步骤信息的种子令牌。当触发潜在工具调用时，一个较小的外部模型将种子令牌的隐藏状态作为其输入，并将种子令牌解包回完整的推理步骤。通过这种方式，我们可以确保主模型在显式令牌空间中进行推理，从而在提高效率的同时保持其能力。在四个数学数据集上的实验结果表明，CoLT实现了比基线潜在模型更高的准确性和更短的推理长度，并且与强化学习算法和不同的解码器结构兼容。
tldr: CoLT是一种新的框架，它将潜在推理作为“工具调用”来实现，通过生成包含推理步骤信息的种子令牌，并由外部模型处理这些令牌以完成推理步骤，从而在不改变主模型结构和训练的情况下，实现了比现有潜在推理方法更高的准确性和更短的推理长度。
ai_comments: CoLT框架通过将潜在推理转化为工具调用，巧妙地解决了现有潜在推理方法在模型结构和训练方面的局限性。这种方法不仅提高了推理效率和准确性，而且保持了主模型的能力和灵活性，具有重要的理论和应用价值。然而，外部模型的选择和训练可能对整体性能产生影响，这方面值得进一步研究。
motivation: 现有的潜在推理方法通常需要模型结构增强和详尽的训练，这限制了它们的广泛应用。本研究旨在提出一种新的潜在推理框架，以克服这些局限性。
method: CoLT框架将潜在推理实现为“工具调用”。它生成包含推理步骤信息的种子令牌。当触发潜在工具调用时，一个较小的外部模型以种子令牌的隐藏状态作为输入，并将种子令牌解包回完整的推理步骤。这使得主模型能够在显式令牌空间中进行推理，从而在提高效率的同时保持其能力。
results: CoLT在四个数学数据集上的实验结果表明，与基线潜在模型相比，CoLT实现了更高的准确性和更短的推理长度。此外，CoLT与强化学习算法和不同的解码器结构兼容。
conclusion: CoLT通过将潜在推理作为工具调用，成功地在不改变主模型结构和训练的情况下，实现了高效且准确的推理，克服了现有方法的局限性。

title: Training A Foundation Model to Represent Graphs as Vectors
authors: Qi Feng, Jicong Fan
abstract: This paper aims to train a graph foundation model that is able to represent any graph as a vector preserving structural and semantic information useful for downstream graph-level tasks such as graph classification and graph clustering. To learn the features of graphs from diverse domains while maintaining strong generalization ability to new domains, we propose a multi-graph-based feature alignment method, which constructs weighted graphs using the attributes of all nodes in each dataset and then generates consistent node embeddings. To enhance the consistency of the features from different datasets, we propose a density maximization mean alignment algorithm with guaranteed convergence. The original graphs and generated node embeddings are fed into a graph neural network to achieve discriminative graph representations in contrastive learning. More importantly, to enhance the information preservation from node-level representations to the graph-level representation, we construct a multi-layer reference distribution module without using any pooling operation. We also provide a theoretical generalization bound to support the effectiveness of the proposed model. The experimental results of few-shot graph classification and graph clustering show that our model outperforms strong baselines.
zh_title: 训练一个将图表示为向量的基础模型
translation: 本文旨在训练一个图基础模型，该模型能够将任意图表示为保留结构和语义信息以用于下游图级任务（如图分类和图聚类）的向量。为了在从不同领域学习特征的同时保持对新领域的强大泛化能力，我们提出了一种多图特征对齐方法，该方法通过构建使用每个数据集中所有节点属性的加权图，然后生成一致的节点嵌入。为了增强来自不同数据集的特征一致性，我们提出了一种具有收敛保证的密度最大化均值对齐算法。原始图和生成的节点嵌入被输入到图神经网络中，以在对比学习中实现判别性图表示。更重要的是，为了增强从节点级表示到图级表示的信息保留，我们构建了一个不使用任何池化操作的多层参考分布模块。我们还提供了一个理论泛化界限来支持所提出模型的有效性。少样本图分类和图聚类的实验结果表明，我们的模型优于强大的基线模型。
tldr: 该论文介绍了一种训练图基础模型的方法，该模型能将图编码为保留结构和语义信息的向量。核心技术包括多图特征对齐、密度最大化均值对齐、基于GNN的对比学习，以及一个创新的无池化多层参考分布模块，以实现强大的跨域泛化能力，并在图分类和聚类任务上取得了优于基线的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了多图特征对齐方法和密度最大化均值对齐算法，并设计了无需池化操作的多层参考分布模块来增强节点到图级别的表示信息保留能力。其重要性在于为图表示学习提供了一种通用且泛化能力强的框架。论文的局限性（根据摘要判断）可能在于对“多层参考分布模块”的详细机制描述不够充分，以及理论泛化界限的具体细节未在摘要中给出。
motivation: 训练一个图基础模型，能够将任意图表示为保留结构和语义信息的向量，以用于图分类和图聚类等下游图级任务，并需要在学习多样化领域特征的同时保持对新领域的强泛化能力。
method: 提出多图特征对齐方法，通过数据集所有节点的属性构建加权图并生成一致的节点嵌入；提出具有收敛保证的密度最大化均值对齐算法；将原始图和生成的节点嵌入输入图神经网络，以对比学习方式获得判别性图表示；构建多层参考分布模块以增强信息保留，该模块未使用任何池化操作。
results: 在少样本图分类和图聚类任务上，所提出的模型优于强大的基线模型。
conclusion: 实验结果表明，该模型在少样本图分类和图聚类任务上优于强大的基线模型。

title: DementiaBank-Emotion: A Multi-Rater Emotion Annotation Corpus for Alzheimer's Disease Speech (Version 1.0)
authors: Cheonkam Jeong, Jessica Liao, Audrey Lu, Yutong Song, Christopher Rashidian, Donna Krogh, Erik Krogh, Mahkameh Rasouli, Jung-Ah Lee, Nikil Dutt, Lisa M Gibbs, David Sultzer, Julie Rousseau, Jocelyn Ludlow, Margaret Galvez, Alexander Nuth, Chet Khay, Sabine Brunswicker, Adeline Nyamathi
abstract: We present DementiaBank-Emotion, the first multi-rater emotion annotation corpus for Alzheimer's disease (AD) speech. Annotating 1,492 utterances from 108 speakers for Ekman's six basic emotions and neutral, we find that AD patients express significantly more non-neutral emotions (16.9%) than healthy controls (5.7%; p < .001). Exploratory acoustic analysis suggests a possible dissociation: control speakers showed substantial F0 modulation for sadness (Delta = -3.45 semitones from baseline), whereas AD speakers showed minimal change (Delta = +0.11 semitones; interaction p = .023), though this finding is based on limited samples (sadness: n=5 control, n=15 AD) and requires replication. Within AD speech, loudness differentiates emotion categories, indicating partially preserved emotion-prosody mappings. We release the corpus, annotation guidelines, and calibration workshop materials to support research on emotion recognition in clinical populations.
comment: Accepted at HeaLING Workshop @ EACL 2026. 9 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
zh_title: 痴呆银行-情感：阿尔茨海默病语音的多评分者情感注释语料库（1.0版）
translation: 我们提出了DementiaBank-Emotion，这是首个针对阿尔茨海默病（AD）语音的多评分者情感注释语料库。我们对108名说话者的1,492条语音进行了标注，标注了埃克曼的六种基本情感和中性情感，我们发现AD患者表达的非中性情感（16.9%）显著高于健康对照者（5.7%；p < .001）。探索性声学分析表明可能存在分离：对照组说话者对悲伤（基线变化量= -3.45音分）表现出显著的F0调制，而AD组说话者表现出最小的变化（变化量= +0.11音分；交互p = .023），尽管这一发现基于有限的样本（悲伤：n=5对照，n=15 AD）并且需要重复。在AD语音中，响度区分了情感类别，表明情感-韵律映射部分保留。我们发布了该语料库、注释指南和校准研讨会材料，以支持对临床人群情感识别的研究。
tldr: 该语料库是首个针对阿尔茨海默病（AD）语音的多评分者情感注释语料库，发现AD患者比健康对照者表达更多非中性情感，并初步探索了语音声学特征与情感表达的可能关联。
ai_comments: 这项工作创建了一个宝贵的新资源，用于研究阿尔茨海默病患者的情感表达。研究结果表明，AD患者的情感表达模式可能与健康个体不同，并且语音的声学特征可能携带有关情感状态的信息。然而，需要注意的是，声学分析部分基于有限的样本量，其发现需要进一步的验证和重复。该语料库的开放获取对于推动该领域的研究非常有益。
motivation: 开发首个针对阿尔茨海默病（AD）语音的多评分者情感注释语料库，以研究AD患者的情感表达及其与语音声学特征的关系。
method: 对108名说话者（包括AD患者和健康对照者）的1,492条语音进行注释，标注了6种基本情感和中性情感。进行了探索性声学分析，比较了AD患者和健康对照者在不同情感类别下的基频（F0）变化和响度。
results: AD患者表达非中性情感的比例（16.9%）显著高于健康对照者（5.7%）。初步的声学分析表明，在表达悲伤情绪时，健康对照者基频变化较大，而AD患者基频变化较小。在AD语音中，响度可以区分不同的情感类别。
conclusion: AD患者在语音中表达非中性情感的比例更高，并且情感-韵律映射可能部分保留。该语料库为进一步研究临床人群中的情感识别提供了资源。

title: Towards Next-Generation SLAM: A Survey on 3DGS-SLAM Focusing on Performance, Robustness, and Future Directions
authors: Li Wang, Ruixuan Gong, Yumo Han, Lei Yang, Lu Yang, Ying Li, Bin Xu, Huaping Liu, Rong Fu
abstract: Traditional Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems often face limitations including coarse rendering quality, insufficient recovery of scene details, and poor robustness in dynamic environments. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), with its efficient explicit representation and high-quality rendering capabilities, offers a new reconstruction paradigm for SLAM. This survey comprehensively reviews key technical approaches for integrating 3DGS with SLAM. We analyze performance optimization of representative methods across four critical dimensions: rendering quality, tracking accuracy, reconstruction speed, and memory consumption, delving into their design principles and breakthroughs. Furthermore, we examine methods for enhancing the robustness of 3DGS-SLAM in complex environments such as motion blur and dynamic environments. Finally, we discuss future challenges and development trends in this area. This survey aims to provide a technical reference for researchers and foster the development of next-generation SLAM systems characterized by high fidelity, efficiency, and robustness.
zh_title: 迈向下一代SLAM：一项关于侧重性能、鲁棒性和未来方向的3DGS-SLAM综述
translation: 传统同步定位与建图（SLAM）系统通常面临渲染质量粗糙、场景细节恢复不足以及在动态环境中鲁棒性差等局限性。3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）以其高效的显式表示和高质量的渲染能力，为SLAM提供了一种新的重建范式。本综述全面回顾了将3DGS与SLAM相结合的关键技术方法。我们分析了代表性方法在渲染质量、跟踪精度、重建速度和内存消耗这四个关键维度上的性能优化，深入探讨了它们的设计原理和突破。此外，我们还研究了增强3DGS-SLAM在运动模糊和动态环境等复杂环境中的鲁棒性的方法。最后，我们讨论了该领域的未来挑战和发展趋势。本综述旨在为研究人员提供技术参考，并促进高保真、高效和鲁棒的下一代SLAM系统的发展。
tldr: 这是一篇关于如何将3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）集成到SLAM系统中的综述，重点分析了其在性能（质量、速度、内存）和鲁棒性（动态环境）方面的进展，并展望了未来发展方向，以克服传统SLAM的局限性。
ai_comments: 这项工作的重要创新在于系统地回顾了将3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）技术应用于SLAM领域的关键方法。它不仅关注了性能的四个维度（渲染质量、跟踪精度、重建速度、内存消耗），还深入探讨了在动态和运动模糊等复杂环境下的鲁棒性增强，为未来高保真、高效、鲁棒的新一代SLAM指明了方向。限制在于，作为一篇综述，它主要总结现有工作，而非提出新的方法。
motivation: 传统SLAM系统存在渲染质量粗糙、场景细节恢复不足以及在动态环境中鲁棒性差等局限性。3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）凭借其高效的显式表示和高质量渲染能力，为SLAM提供了一种新的重建范式。
method: 对集成3DGS与SLAM的关键技术方法进行了全面回顾和分析，重点分析了代表性方法在渲染质量、跟踪精度、重建速度和内存消耗四个维度上的性能优化，并探讨了增强其在运动模糊和动态环境等复杂场景中鲁棒性的方法。
results: 全面回顾了集成3DGS与SLAM的关键技术方法，分析了代表性方法在性能（渲染质量、跟踪精度、重建速度、内存消耗）上的优化，并考察了增强其在复杂环境（如运动模糊和动态环境）中鲁棒性的方法。
conclusion: 该综述旨在为研究人员提供技术参考，并促进高保真、高效率和高鲁棒性的下一代SLAM系统的发展。

title: Scaling Agentic Verifier for Competitive Coding
authors: Zeyao Ma, Jing Zhang, Xiaokang Zhang, Jiaxi Yang, Zongmeng Zhang, Jiajun Zhang, Yuheng Jing, Lei Zhang, Hao Zheng, Wenting Zhao, Junyang Lin, Binyuan Hui
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong coding capabilities but still struggle to solve competitive programming problems correctly in a single attempt. Execution-based re-ranking offers a promising test-time scaling strategy, yet existing methods are constrained by either difficult test case generation or inefficient random input sampling. To address this limitation, we propose Agentic Verifier, an execution-based agent that actively reasons about program behaviors and searches for highly discriminative test inputs that expose behavioral discrepancies among candidate solutions. Through multi-turn interaction with code execution environments, the verifier iteratively refines the candidate input generator and produces targeted counterexamples rather than blindly sampling inputs. We train the verifier to acquire this discriminative input generation capability via a scalable pipeline combining large-scale data synthesis, rejection fine-tuning, and agentic reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across five competitive programming benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong execution-based baselines, achieving up to +10-15% absolute gains in Best@K accuracy. Further analysis reveals clear test-time scaling behavior and highlights the verifier's broader potential beyond reranking.
zh_title: 扩展代理验证器以解决竞争性编程问题
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已经展示出强大的编码能力，但仍然难以在单次尝试中正确解决竞争性编程问题。基于执行的重排序提供了一种有前景的测试时扩展策略，但现有方法受限于困难的测试用例生成或低效的随机输入采样。为解决此限制，我们提出了代理验证器（Agentic Verifier），一个主动推理程序行为并搜索高度区分性测试输入的执行式智能体，以暴露候选解之间的行为差异。通过与代码执行环境的多轮交互，该验证器迭代地改进候选输入生成器，并产生有针对性的反例，而不是盲目采样输入。我们通过结合大规模数据合成、拒绝微调和代理强化学习的可扩展管道来训练验证器，使其获得这种区分性输入生成能力。在五个竞争性编程基准上的广泛实验证明了与强大基于执行的基线的持续改进，在 Best@K 准确率上实现了高达 +10-15% 的绝对提升。进一步的分析揭示了清晰的测试时扩展行为，并突出了该验证器在重排序之外的更广泛潜力。
tldr: 为了提高LLM解决竞争性编程问题的准确性，我们开发了一个名为“代理验证器”的智能体。它不随机采样，而是主动推理并生成能揭示程序错误的“坏”测试用例。实验证明，这种方法比现有技术好得多，准确率提升了多达15%。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的“代理验证器”方法，通过主动推理和生成高区分度的测试用例来解决LLM在单次尝试中解决竞争性编程问题准确率不高的问题。其核心创新在于从盲目采样转向了迭代的、有针对性的反例生成。实验结果显示了显著的性能提升，证明了该方法在测试时扩展策略上的有效性。然而，论文未详细说明“可扩展管道”中具体的数据合成和强化学习的细节。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）虽然编码能力强，但在单次尝试中解决竞争性编程问题仍存在困难。现有的基于执行的重排序策略受限于困难的测试用例生成或低效的随机输入采样。
method: 提出了一种名为 Agentic Verifier 的基于执行的智能体，它通过与代码执行环境的多轮交互，主动推理程序行为，并迭代地改进候选输入生成器，以生成能暴露候选解之间行为差异的高度区分性测试输入（即反例），而不是盲目采样输入。该验证器通过结合大规模数据合成、拒绝微调和代理强化学习的可扩展管道进行训练。
results: 在五个竞争性编程基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Agentic Verifier 相比强大的基于执行的基线方法取得了持续的改进，在 Best@K 准确率上实现了高达 +10-15% 的绝对提升。
conclusion: Agentic Verifier 实现了在竞争性编程基准测试中显著优于现有基于执行的基线方法，并且展现出清晰的测试时扩展行为和更广泛的潜力。

title: Empirical-MCTS: Continuous Agent Evolution via Dual-Experience Monte Carlo Tree Search
authors: Hao Lu, Haoyuan Huang, Yulin Zhou, Chen Li, Ningxin Zhu
abstract: Inference-time scaling strategies, particularly Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), have significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, current approaches remain predominantly stateless, discarding successful reasoning patterns after each problem instance and failing to mimic the empirical accumulation of wisdom characteristic of human problem-solving. To bridge this gap, we introduce Empirical-MCTS, a dual-loop framework that transforms stateless search into a continuous, non-parametric learning process. The framework unifies local exploration with global memory optimization through two novel mechanisms: Pairwise-Experience-Evolutionary Meta-Prompting (PE-EMP) and a Memory Optimization Agent. PE-EMP functions as a reflexive optimizer within the local search, utilizing pairwise feedback to dynamically synthesize adaptive criteria and evolve meta-prompts (system prompts) in real-time. Simultaneously, the Memory Optimization Agent manages a global repository as a dynamic policy prior, employing atomic operations to distill high-quality insights across problems. Extensive evaluations on complex reasoning benchmarks, including AIME25, ARC-AGI-2, and MathArena Apex, demonstrate that Empirical-MCTS significantly outperforms both stateless MCTS strategies and standalone experience-driven agents. These results underscore the critical necessity of coupling structured search with empirical accumulation for mastering complex, open-ended reasoning tasks.
zh_title: 经验性MCTS：通过双经验蒙特卡洛树搜索实现连续智能体演化
translation: 推理时扩展策略，特别是蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），极大地增强了大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力。然而，当前的方法仍然主要是无状态的，在每个问题实例之后丢弃成功的推理模式，未能模仿人类解决问题所特有的经验智慧积累。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了Empirical-MCTS，一个双循环框架，将无状态搜索转化为一个持续的、非参数的学习过程。该框架通过两个新颖的机制统一了局部探索和全局记忆优化：成对经验演化元提示（PE-EMP）和记忆优化代理。PE-EMP作为局部搜索中的自省优化器，利用成对反馈实时动态地合成自适应标准并演化元提示（系统提示）。同时，记忆优化代理将全局存储库管理为一个动态策略先验，通过原子操作提炼跨问题的优质见解。在包括AIME25、ARC-AGI-2和MathArena Apex在内的复杂推理基准上的广泛评估表明，Empirical-MCTS显著优于无状态MCTS策略和独立的经验驱动代理。这些结果强调了将结构化搜索与经验积累相结合对于掌握复杂、开放式推理任务的关键必要性。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为Empirical-MCTS的双循环框架，通过结合局部探索和全局记忆优化，将无状态的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）转变为持续的学习过程，以解决大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理时遗忘经验的问题。实验证明，该方法在复杂推理任务上优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决LLMs在推理过程中缺乏经验积累的问题，通过引入双循环框架和两个新颖的机制，实现了从无状态搜索到持续学习的转变。其在多个复杂推理基准上的优越表现证明了该方法的有效性，并为未来研究提供了有价值的见解。然而，该方法的计算复杂度和可扩展性方面可能需要进一步探讨。
motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理时采用的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）策略通常是无状态的，无法保留成功的推理模式，这与人类解决问题时积累经验的特性不符。
method: 提出Empirical-MCTS双循环框架，包含两个新机制：1. Pairwise-Experience-Evolutionary Meta-Prompting (PE-EMP)，作为局部搜索中的自省优化器，利用成对反馈实时合成自适应标准和演化元提示。2. 记忆优化代理（Memory Optimization Agent），作为全局策略先验管理记忆库，通过原子操作提炼跨问题的优质见解。
results: 在AIME25、ARC-AGI-2和MathArena Apex等复杂推理基准测试中，Empirical-MCTS显著优于无状态MCTS策略和独立的经验驱动代理。
conclusion: 将结构化搜索与经验积累相结合对于掌握复杂、开放式推理任务至关重要。

title: ACIL: Active Class Incremental Learning for Image Classification
authors: Aditya R. Bhattacharya, Debanjan Goswami, Shayok Chakraborty
abstract: Continual learning (or class incremental learning) is a realistic learning scenario for computer vision systems, where deep neural networks are trained on episodic data, and the data from previous episodes are generally inaccessible to the model. Existing research in this domain has primarily focused on avoiding catastrophic forgetting, which occurs due to the continuously changing class distributions in each episode and the inaccessibility of the data from previous episodes.
