We introduce and study vertex splitting as a graph modification operation for transforming graphs into interval graphs. Given a graph $G$ and an integer $k$, we consider the problem of deciding whether $G$ can be transformed into an interval graph using at most $k$ vertex splits. We prove that this problem is NP-hard, even when the input is restricted to subcubic planar bipartite graphs. We further observe that vertex splitting differs fundamentally from vertex and edge deletions as graph modification operations when the objective is to obtain a chordal graph, even for graphs with maximum independent set size at most two. On the positive side, we give a polynomial-time algorithm for transforming, via a minimum number of vertex splits, a given graph into a disjoint union of paths, and that splitting triangle free graphs into unit interval graphs is also solvable in polynomial time.
zh_title: 论将顶点分裂成区间图的复杂性
translation: 顶点分裂是一种图修改操作，其中一个顶点被多个顶点替换，使得它们邻域的并集等于原始顶点的邻域。我们引入并研究顶点分裂作为一种图修改操作，用于将图转换为区间图。给定一个图 $G$ 和一个整数 $k$，我们考虑确定 $G$ 是否可以使用最多 $k$ 次顶点分裂操作转换为区间图的问题。我们证明了这个问题是 NP-难的，即使输入被限制为亚立方平面二分图。我们进一步观察到，即使对于最大独立集大小最多为二的图，当目标是获得弦图时，顶点分裂作为图修改操作与顶点和边删除有着根本的不同。从积极方面来看，我们给出了一个多项式时间算法，用于通过最少次数的顶点分裂将给定图转化为不相交路径的并集，并且将无三角形图分裂为单位区间图的问题也是多项式时间可解的。
tldr: 研究了将图通过最多 $k$ 次顶点分裂操作转化为区间图的决策问题。证明了该问题是 NP-难的，即使输入受限于亚立方平面二分图。但也提供了将图转化为不相交路径并集和将无三角形图转化为单位区间图的两种多项式时间算法。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将“顶点分裂”这一图修改操作应用于生成“区间图”的目标，并深入分析了其计算复杂性。它不仅通过 NP-难证明划定了该问题的难度边界（即使在受限图类上），而且通过提供多项式时间算法展示了在特定目标（如路径并集和单位区间图）下的可解性。这种复杂性分析的二元性（难点和易解点）是该研究的重要贡献。此外，文章还突出了顶点分裂与更常见的图修改操作（如删除）在图结构转换中的根本差异，这对于理解不同图修改操作的特性具有重要意义。
motivation: 引入并研究顶点分裂作为一种图修改操作，目的是将图转换为区间图。具体来说，是确定给定图 $G$ 是否可以使用最多 $k$ 次顶点分裂操作转换为区间图。
method: 核心方法是图修改操作中的“顶点分裂”，即用多个顶点替换一个顶点，使得新顶点的邻域集合的并集等于原顶点的邻域。研究了将图通过最多 $k$ 次顶点分裂转化为区间图的决策问题的计算复杂性（包括 NP-难证明和多项式时间算法设计）。
results:
1.  将图通过最多 $k$ 次顶点分裂转化为区间图的问题是 NP-难的，即使输入被限制为亚立方平面二分图。
2.  当目标是获得弦图时，顶点分裂与顶点删除和边删除这两种图修改操作有根本的不同。
3.  存在一个多项式时间算法，用于通过最少次数的顶点分裂将给定图转化为不相交路径的并集。
4.  将无三角形图分裂为单位区间图的问题也是多项式时间可解的。

title: Discussing Your Needs in VR: A Novel Approach through Persona-based Stakeholder Role-Playing
authors: Yi Wang, Zhengxin Zhang, Xiao Liu, Chetan Arora, John Grundy, Thuong Hoang
abstract: In this study, we propose a novel approach that supports requirements discussions in virtual environments by automatically generating personas from real-time speech-to-text data. In our pilot experiment, 18 participants (14 from universities and 4 from IT companies) used the generated personas to discuss accessibility requirements within the virtual environment. Participants reported a relatively high level of satisfaction with the social presence and usability of the VR system. We also found that requirements discussions based on personas have a lower workload. Finally, we outline the main directions for future work.
zh_title: 在VR中讨论您的需求：一种基于角色的利益相关者角色扮演的新方法
translation: 在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，通过从实时语音转文本数据中自动生成角色（personas），来支持在虚拟环境中进行需求讨论。在我们的初步实验中，18名参与者（14名来自大学，4名来自IT公司）使用生成的角色在虚拟环境中讨论了无障碍性需求。参与者报告称对VR系统的社交临场感和可用性有相对较高的满意度。我们还发现，基于角色的需求讨论具有较低的工作量。最后，我们概述了未来工作的主要方向。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种在VR中自动生成角色（基于实时语音转文本）并进行需求讨论的新方法。初步实验表明，参与者对系统的社交临场感和可用性满意度较高，且工作量较低。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将需求工程中的“角色扮演”概念与前沿的实时语音转文本技术和VR环境结合起来。通过自动化地生成角色，它解决了传统角色扮演中设置和维护成本高的问题，同时利用VR提供了高社交临场感的沉浸式讨论环境。其重要性在于为远程或分布式团队进行复杂需求分析提供了一个高效、低工作量的工具，特别适用于讨论无障碍性等需要多视角理解的议题。
motivation: 支持在虚拟环境中进行需求讨论，并提出一种新颖的、基于角色扮演的方法来改进这一过程。
method: 提出一种通过实时语音转文本数据自动生成角色的方法，并在虚拟环境中利用这些生成的角色进行需求讨论。通过一项包含18名参与者（14名来自大学，4名来自IT公司）的初步实验，讨论了无障碍性需求。
results: 参与者对VR系统的社交临场感和可用性报告了相对较高的满意度。基于角色的需求讨论被发现具有较低的工作量。
conclusion: 摘要中未提及（仅提及将概述未来的工作方向）。

title: Radar-Inertial Odometry For Computationally Constrained Aerial Navigation
authors: Jan Michalczyk
abstract: Recently, the progress in the radar sensing technology consisting in the miniaturization of the packages and increase in measuring precision has drawn the interest of the robotics research community. Indeed, a crucial task enabling autonomy in robotics is to precisely determine the pose of the robot in space. To fulfill this task sensor fusion algorithms are often used, in which data from one or several exteroceptive sensors like, for example, LiDAR, camera, laser ranging sensor or GNSS are fused together with the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements to obtain an estimate of the navigation states of the robot. Nonetheless, owing to their particular sensing principles, some exteroceptive sensors are often incapacitated in extreme environmental conditions, like extreme illumination or presence of fine particles in the environment like smoke or fog. Radars are largely immune to aforementioned factors thanks to the characteristics of electromagnetic waves they use. In this thesis, we present Radar-Inertial Odometry (RIO) algorithms to fuse the information from IMU and radar in order to estimate the navigation states of a (Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle) UAV capable of running on a portable resource-constrained embedded computer in real-time and making use of inexpensive, consumer-grade sensors. We present novel RIO approaches relying on the multi-state tightly-coupled Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) and Factor Graphs (FG) fusing instantaneous velocities of and distances to 3D points delivered by a lightweight, low-cost, off-the-shelf Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar with IMU readings. We also show a novel way to exploit advances in deep learning to retrieve 3D point correspondences in sparse and noisy radar point clouds.
zh_title: 适用于计算受限的空中导航的雷达-惯性里程计
translation: 近年来，雷达传感技术的进步，包括封装的小型化和测量精度的提高，引起了机器人研究界的兴趣。事实上，实现机器人自主性的一个关键任务是精确确定机器人在空间中的姿态。为了完成这项任务，通常使用传感器融合算法，其中将来自一个或多个外部传感器（例如LiDAR、摄像头、激光测距传感器或GNSS）的数据与惯性测量单元（IMU）的测量数据融合，以获得机器人导航状态的估计。然而，由于其特殊的传感原理，一些外部传感器在极端环境条件（例如极端光照或环境中存在烟雾或雾气等细小颗粒）下往往会失效。得益于其使用的电磁波特性，雷达在很大程度上不受上述因素的影响。在本论文中，我们提出了雷达-惯性里程计（RIO）算法，用于融合IMU和雷达的信息，以估计无人机（UAV）的导航状态，该算法能够在便携式资源受限的嵌入式计算机上实时运行，并使用廉价的消费级传感器。我们提出了新颖的RIO方法，它们依赖于多状态紧耦合扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）和因子图（FG），将轻量级、低成本、现成的调频连续波（FMCW）雷达提供的瞬时速度和3D点距离与IMU读数进行融合。我们还展示了一种利用深度学习的最新进展来检索稀疏和嘈杂雷达点云中3D点对应关系的新方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于计算受限无人机导航的雷达-惯性里程计（RIO）系统。该系统利用低成本FMCW雷达和IMU数据，通过紧耦合EKF和因子图框架进行融合，并结合深度学习解决点云对应问题，实现了恶劣环境下的实时定位。
ai_comments: 本文的创新性在于将新兴的、抗环境干扰的FMCW雷达与IMU数据进行紧密融合，解决了传统视觉/激光传感器在恶劣环境下的局限性。其重要性体现在为计算资源受限的无人机提供了一种实时、鲁棒的导航解决方案，使用了低成本的消费级传感器，具有很高的实用价值。方法上，同时探索了基于EKF和因子图两种主流滤波框架，并创新性地引入深度学习来处理雷达点云稀疏和噪声问题，这对于提高雷达里程计的精度至关重要。
motivation: 机器人自主导航需要精确的姿态确定。传统的外感受传感器（如LiDAR、摄像头）在极端环境条件（如极端光照、烟雾、雾气）下容易失效。雷达不受这些因素影响，且当前的雷达技术已实现小型化和高精度。目标是为计算资源受限的便携式嵌入式计算机上的无人机提供实时、鲁棒的导航解决方案。
method: 提出了基于多状态紧耦合扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）和因子图（FG）的新型雷达-惯性里程计（RIO）算法。该算法将轻量级、低成本的FMCW雷达提供的3D点瞬时速度和距离信息与IMU读数进行融合。此外，还利用深度学习来检索稀疏和嘈杂雷达点云中的3D点对应关系。

title: RIGA-Fold: A General Framework for Protein Inverse Folding via Recurrent Interaction and Geometric Awareness
authors: Sisi Yuan, Jiehuang Chen, Junchuang Cai, Dong Xu, Xueliang Li, Zexuan Zhu, Junkai Ji
abstract: Protein inverse folding, the task of predicting amino acid sequences for desired structures, is pivotal for de novo protein design. However, existing GNN-based methods typically suffer from restricted receptive fields that miss long-range dependencies and a "single-pass" inference paradigm that leads to error accumulation. To address these bottlenecks, we propose RIGA-Fold, a framework that synergizes Recurrent Interaction with Geometric Awareness. At the micro-level, we introduce a Geometric Attention Update (GAU) module where edge features explicitly serve as attention keys, ensuring strictly SE(3)-invariant local encoding. At the macro-level, we design an attention-based Global Context Bridge that acts as a soft gating mechanism to dynamically inject global topological information. Furthermore, to bridge the gap between structural and sequence modalities, we introduce an enhanced variant, RIGA-Fold*, which integrates trainable geometric features with frozen evolutionary priors from ESM-2 and ESM-IF via a dual-stream architecture. Finally, a biologically inspired ``predict-recycle-refine'' strategy is implemented to iteratively denoise sequence distributions. Extensive experiments on CATH 4.2, TS50, and TS500 benchmarks demonstrate that our geometric framework is highly competitive, while RIGA-Fold* significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both sequence recovery and structural consistency.
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Includes appendix. Preprint under review
zh_title: RIGA-Fold：通过循环交互和几何感知实现的蛋白质逆折叠通用框架
translation: 蛋白质逆折叠是预测所需结构对应氨基酸序列的任务，对于从头设计蛋白质至关重要。然而，现有的基于GNN的方法通常受限于感受野，无法捕获长程依赖，并且“单次通过”的推理范式会导致误差累积。为解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了RIGA-Fold框架，它将循环交互与几何感知相结合。在微观层面，我们引入了几何注意力更新（GAU）模块，其中边特征明确地作为注意力键，确保了严格的SE(3)不变局部编码。在宏观层面，我们设计了一个基于注意力的全局上下文桥，作为一个软门控机制来动态注入全局拓扑信息。此外，为了弥合结构和序列模态之间的鸿沟，我们引入了一个增强变体RIGA-Fold*，它通过双流架构将可训练的几何特征与来自ESM-2和ESM-IF的冻结演化先验相结合。最后，实施了一种受生物学启发的“预测-循环-精炼”策略，以迭代地对序列分布进行去噪。在CATH 4.2、TS50和TS500基准测试中进行的广泛实验证明，我们的几何框架具有高度竞争力，而RIGA-Fold*在序列恢复和结构一致性方面显著优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: 现有的蛋白质逆折叠模型受限于感受野小和误差累积。RIGA-Fold通过循环交互和几何感知（GAU、全局上下文桥）解决了这些问题，并引入了“预测-循环-精炼”策略迭代去噪，显著优于现有基线。
ai_comments: 本文的创新在于明确针对现有蛋白质逆折叠模型中长程依赖缺失和误差累积两大核心痛点，并提出了RIGA-Fold框架。该框架结合了循环交互和几何感知，通过GAU模块实现了严格的SE(3)不变性，并通过全局上下文桥动态地融入了全局信息。尤其是增强变体RIGA-Fold*，巧妙地将可训练的几何特征与来自ESM模型（如ESM-2/ESM-IF）的冻结演化先验相结合，这代表了将大型语言模型知识融入结构设计任务的有效范例。迭代的“预测-循环-精炼”策略进一步提升了序列分布的去噪和精炼能力，是其实现SOTA性能的关键因素之一。
motivation: 解决现有基于GNN的蛋白质逆折叠方法存在的两大瓶颈：1. 受限的感受野导致无法捕捉长程依赖；2. “单次通过”的推理范式导致误差累积。
method: 提出了RIGA-Fold框架，结合了循环交互和几何感知。微观层面引入了几何注意力更新（GAU）模块，利用边特征作为注意力键，确保严格的SE(3)不变性。宏观层面设计了基于注意力的全局上下文桥，动态注入全局拓扑信息。增强变体RIGA-Fold*采用双流架构，将可训练的几何特征与来自ESM-2和ESM-IF的冻结演化先验相结合。最后，采用受生物学启发的“预测-循环-精炼”策略来迭代地对序列分布进行去噪。
results: 在CATH 4.2、TS50和TS500基准测试中，RIGA-Fold的几何框架表现出高度竞争力。RIGA-Fold*在序列恢复和结构一致性方面显著优于最先进的基线方法。
conclusion: RIGA-Fold通过结合循环交互和几何感知，成功解决了现有蛋白质逆折叠模型的局限性，特别增强变体RIGA-Fold*在序列恢复和结构一致性上显著优于现有最先进的基线方法。

title: WideSeek-R1: Exploring Width Scaling for Broad Information Seeking via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Zelai Xu, Zhexuan Xu, Ruize Zhang, Chunyang Zhu, Shi Yu, Weilin Liu, Quanlu Zhang, Wenbo Ding, Chao Yu, Yu Wang
abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have largely focused on depth scaling, where a single agent solves long-horizon problems with multi-turn reasoning and tool use. However, as tasks grow broader, the key bottleneck shifts from individual competence to organizational capability. In this work, we explore a complementary dimension of width scaling with multi-agent systems to address broad information seeking. Existing multi-agent systems often rely on hand-crafted workflows and turn-taking interactions that fail to parallelize work effectively. To bridge this gap, we propose WideSeek-R1, a lead-agent-subagent framework trained via multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to synergize scalable orchestration and parallel execution. By utilizing a shared LLM with isolated contexts and specialized tools, WideSeek-R1 jointly optimizes the lead agent and parallel subagents on a curated dataset of 20k broad information-seeking tasks. Extensive experiments show that WideSeek-R1-4B achieves an item F1 score of 40.0% on the WideSearch benchmark, which is comparable to the performance of single-agent DeepSeek-R1-671B. Furthermore, WideSeek-R1-4B exhibits consistent performance gains as the number of parallel subagents increases, highlighting the effectiveness of width scaling.
zh_title: WideSeek-R1：通过多智能体强化学习探索广泛信息搜索的宽度扩展
translation: 近期大型语言模型（LLMs）的进展主要集中在深度扩展上，即单个智能体通过多轮推理和工具使用来解决长时程问题。然而，随着任务变得更广泛，关键瓶颈从个体能力转向了组织能力。在这项工作中，我们探索了多智能体系统的宽度扩展这一互补维度，以解决广泛信息搜索问题。现有的多智能体系统通常依赖手工设计的工作流和轮流交互，无法有效实现工作并行化。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了WideSeek-R1，这是一个通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练的“主导智能体-子智能体”框架，旨在协同可扩展的编排和并行执行。通过利用共享的LLM、隔离的上下文和专业工具，WideSeek-R1在包含2万个广泛信息搜索任务的精选数据集上，联合优化了主导智能体和并行子智能体。广泛的实验表明，WideSeek-R1-4B在WideSearch基准测试上取得了40.0%的item F1分数，这与单智能体DeepSeek-R1-671B的性能相当。此外，WideSeek-R1-4B随着并行子智能体数量的增加展现出持续的性能增益，突显了宽度扩展的有效性。
tldr: 针对广泛信息搜索任务，本文提出了WideSeek-R1，一个基于多智能体强化学习的“主导-子智能体”框架，实现了宽度扩展和并行执行。4B模型在WideSearch基准上取得了与671B单智能体模型相当的性能，并证明了宽度扩展的有效性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于明确提出了与主流的“深度扩展”（单智能体长链推理）互补的“宽度扩展”概念，并成功地将其应用于信息搜索任务。通过引入MARL来训练主导-子智能体框架，解决了传统多智能体系统手工编排效率低下的问题，显著提高了任务的并行处理能力和组织效率。这对于未来处理需要多方面信息协同的复杂、广泛任务具有重要指导意义，尤其是在资源受限的情况下，宽度扩展可能比单纯增加模型深度更具成本效益。
motivation: 现有大型语言模型（LLMs）主要关注深度扩展（单个智能体的多轮推理）。然而，对于广泛任务，瓶颈在于组织能力而非个体能力。此外，现有多智能体系统依赖手动工作流和轮流交互，缺乏有效的并行化。
method: 提出了WideSeek-R1框架，这是一个通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）训练的“主导智能体-子智能体”结构。该框架利用共享LLM、隔离上下文和专业工具，共同优化主导智能体和并行子智能体，以实现可扩展的编排和并行执行。
results: WideSeek-R1-4B在WideSearch基准测试上取得了40.0%的item F1分数，与单智能体DeepSeek-R1-671B的性能相当。此外，随着并行子智能体数量的增加，WideSeek-R1-4B的性能持续提高。
conclusion: 宽度扩展对于广泛信息搜索任务是有效的，通过增加并行子智能体的数量可以获得持续的性能提升。

title: Towards Structured, State-Aware, and Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Software Engineering Agents
authors: Tse-Hsun, Chen
abstract:
Software Engineering (SE) agents have shown promising abilities in supporting various SE tasks. Current SE agents remain fundamentally reactive, making decisions mainly based on conversation history and the most recent response. However, this reactive design provides no explicit structure or persistent state within the agent's memory, making long-horizon reasoning challenging. As a result, SE agents struggle to maintain a coherent understanding across reasoning steps, adapt their hypotheses as new evidence emerges, or incorporate execution feedback into the mental reasoning model of the system state.
  In this position paper, we argue that, to further advance SE agents, we need to move beyond reactive behavior toward a structured, state-aware, and execution-grounded reasoning. We outline how explicit structure, persistent and evolving state, and the integration of execution-grounded feedback can help SE agents perform more coherent and reliable reasoning in long-horizon tasks. We also provide an initial roadmap for developing next-generation SE agents that can more effectively perform real-world tasks.
zh_title: 迈向软件工程智能体的结构化、状态感知和执行验证的推理
translation:
软件工程（SE）智能体在支持各种软件工程任务方面已显示出可喜的能力。然而，当前的SE智能体仍然是根本上的被动式，主要基于对话历史和最近的响应来做出决策。这种被动式设计在智能体的记忆中没有提供明确的结构或持久的状态，使得长程推理变得困难。因此，SE智能体难以在推理步骤中保持连贯的理解，难以在新证据出现时调整假设，或将执行反馈纳入系统状态的心理推理模型中。
在这篇立场论文中，我们论证了，为了进一步推进SE智能体，我们需要超越被动行为，转向结构化、状态感知和执行验证的推理。我们概述了明确的结构、持久且不断演变的状态以及执行验证反馈的整合，如何帮助SE智能体在长程任务中执行更连贯、更可靠的推理。我们还为开发能够更有效地执行实际任务的下一代SE智能体提供了一个初步的路线图。
tldr: 现有的软件工程（SE）智能体过于被动，缺乏结构和持久状态，难以进行长程推理。本文提出转向结构化、状态感知和执行验证的推理，并提供了一个开发下一代更可靠SE智能体的路线图。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出将软件工程智能体的范式从被动系统（如标准的LLM聊天界面）转向具有持久内部状态和明确结构的系统。对“执行验证反馈”的关注至关重要，它暗示了一种闭环系统，即现实世界任务的结果可以直接完善智能体的内部推理模型。这种方法解决了当前AI智能体的一个根本限制——难以处理需要持续记忆和适应的复杂、多步骤、真实世界任务。由于这是一篇立场论文，它提出了一个方向而非提供具体的实验结果，这对于寻求即时实证证据的读者来说可能是一个限制。
motivation: 当前的软件工程智能体本质上是被动的，主要基于对话历史和最新响应做出决策。这种被动设计缺乏明确的结构和持久状态，使得长程推理具有挑战性，导致智能体难以保持连贯的理解、适应新证据或将执行反馈纳入系统状态的心理推理模型中。
method: 本文是一篇立场论文，提出需要超越被动行为，转向结构化、状态感知和执行验证的推理。论文概述了明确的结构、持久且不断演变的状态以及执行验证反馈的整合，如何帮助软件工程智能体在长程任务中执行更连贯、更可靠的推理。
conclusion: 为了进一步发展软件工程智能体，需要超越被动行为，转向结构化、状态感知和执行验证的推理，从而在长程任务中执行更连贯、更可靠的推理。本文还为开发能够更有效地执行实际任务的下一代软件工程智能体提供了一个初步的路线图。

title: MTS-JEPA: Multi-Resolution Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Time-Series Anomaly Prediction
authors: Yanan He, Yunshi Wen, Xin Wang, Tengfei Ma
abstract: Multivariate time series underpin modern critical infrastructure, making the prediction of anomalies a vital necessity for proactive risk mitigation. While Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer a promising framework for modeling the latent evolution of these systems, their application is hindered by representation collapse and an inability to capture precursor signals across varying temporal scales. To address these limitations, we propose MTS-JEPA, a specialized architecture that integrates a multi-resolution predictive objective with a soft codebook bottleneck. This design explicitly decouples transient shocks from long-term trends, and utilizes the codebook to capture discrete regime transitions. Notably, we find this constraint also acts as an intrinsic regularizer to ensure optimization stability. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks confirm that our approach effectively prevents degenerate solutions and achieves state-of-the-art performance under the early-warning protocol.
zh_title: MTS-JEPA：用于时间序列异常预测的多分辨率联合嵌入预测架构
translation: 多元时间序列是现代关键基础设施的基础，因此异常预测对于主动风险缓解至关重要。虽然联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）为建模这些系统的潜在演变提供了一个有前景的框架，但其应用受到表示崩溃以及无法捕获不同时间尺度上前兆信号的限制。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了MTS-JEPA，这是一种专门的架构，它将多分辨率预测目标与软码本瓶颈相结合。这种设计明确地将瞬时冲击与长期趋势解耦，并利用码本捕获离散的机制转换。值得注意的是，我们发现这种约束也充当了确保优化稳定性的内在正则化器。对标准基准的实证评估证实，我们的方法有效地防止了退化解，并在早期预警协议下实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: 针对多元时间序列异常预测中JEPA的表示崩溃和多尺度信号捕获不足问题，本文提出了MTS-JEPA，它结合了多分辨率预测目标和软码本瓶颈，有效解耦了瞬时冲击和长期趋势，实现了最先进的早期预警性能。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将JEPA框架应用于时间序列异常预测，并针对该领域的特有挑战（即多尺度信号和表示崩溃）进行了专门的结构改进。通过引入多分辨率目标和软码本瓶颈，MTS-JEPA有效地解决了时间序列中短期噪声和长期趋势的混合问题，并提供了一个内在的正则化机制来稳定训练。在关键基础设施的风险缓解背景下，实现最先进的“早期预警”性能具有重要的实际应用价值。
motivation: 预测多元时间序列中的异常对于主动风险缓解至关重要。现有的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在应用时面临表示崩溃（representation collapse）以及无法捕获不同时间尺度上的前兆信号的限制。
method: 提出MTS-JEPA架构，它集成了多分辨率预测目标（multi-resolution predictive objective）和软码本瓶颈（soft codebook bottleneck）。该设计明确地将瞬时冲击与长期趋势解耦，并利用码本捕获离散的机制转换。同时，码本约束还充当了确保优化稳定性的内在正则化器。
results: 经验评估证实，MTS-JEPA有效地防止了退化解（degenerate solutions），并在标准基准测试的早期预警协议下实现了最先进的性能（state-of-the-art performance）。

title: Relational Scene Graphs for Object Grounding of Natural Language Commands
authors: Julia Kuhn, Francesco Verdoja, Tsvetomila Mihaylova, Ville Kyrki
abstract: Robots are finding wider adoption in human environments, increasing the need for natural human-robot interaction. However, understanding a natural language command requires the robot to infer the intended task and how to decompose it into executable actions, and to ground those actions in the robot's knowledge of the environment, including relevant objects, agents, and locations. This challenge can be addressed by combining the capabilities of Large language models (LLMs) to understand natural language with 3D scene graphs (3DSGs) for grounding inferred actions in a semantic representation of the environment. However, many 3DSGs lack explicit spatial relations between objects, even though humans often rely on these relations to describe an environment. This paper investigates whether incorporating open- or closed-vocabulary spatial relations into 3DSGs can improve the ability of LLMs to interpret natural language commands. To address this, we propose an LLM-based pipeline for target object grounding from open-vocabulary language commands and a vision language model (VLM)-based pipeline to add open-vocabulary spatial edges to 3DSGs from images captured while mapping. Finally, two LLMs are evaluated in a study assessing their performance on the downstream task of target object grounding. Our study demonstrates that explicit spatial relations improve the ability of LLMs to ground objects. Moreover, open-vocabulary relation generation with VLMs proves feasible from robot-captured images, but their advantage over closed-vocabulary relations is found to be limited.
zh_title: 用于自然语言命令中对象定位的关系场景图
translation: 机器人正在人类环境中得到更广泛的应用，这增加了对自然人机交互的需求。然而，理解自然语言命令要求机器人推断预期的任务，将其分解为可执行的动作，并将这些动作与机器人对环境的知识（包括相关对象、代理和位置）进行关联（接地）。这一挑战可以通过结合大型语言模型（LLMs）理解自然语言的能力与3D场景图（3DSGs）将推断出的动作接地到环境的语义表示中的能力来解决。然而，许多3DSGs缺乏对象之间明确的空间关系，尽管人类经常依赖这些关系来描述环境。本文研究将开放词汇或封闭词汇空间关系整合到3DSGs中，是否可以提高LLMs解释自然语言命令的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个基于LLM的管线，用于从开放词汇语言命令中进行目标对象接地，以及一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的管线，用于从测绘时捕获的图像中向3DSGs添加开放词汇空间边缘。最后，通过一项评估两种LLM在目标对象接地这一下游任务中性能的研究进行评估。我们的研究表明，明确的空间关系提高了LLMs对对象接地的能力。此外，事实证明，使用VLM从机器人捕获的图像中生成开放词汇关系是可行的，但发现它们相对于封闭词汇关系的优势有限。
tldr: 为了让机器人在自然语言命令中准确找到目标对象，本研究通过VLM为3D场景图（3DSGs）添加了显式的空间关系。结果显示，这些关系能显著提高LLM的对象定位能力，但开放词汇关系相比传统封闭词汇关系的优势并不大。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个结合大型语言模型（LLM）和增强型3D场景图（3DSG）的框架，用于解决机器人环境中的对象接地问题。其核心在于通过视觉语言模型（VLM）从机器人视角捕获的图像中提取并整合开放词汇或封闭词汇的空间关系到场景图中，从而弥补了现有3DSG缺乏明确空间关系的不足。这对于提升机器人理解依赖于空间关系的复杂自然语言指令的能力至关重要。然而，研究结果也指出了一个潜在的局限性：尽管开放词汇关系生成是可行的，但其相对于封闭词汇关系的优势有限，这可能意味着在实际应用中，开放词汇关系的鲁棒性或精度仍需进一步提高。
motivation: 为了实现更自然的机器人-人类交互，机器人需要理解自然语言命令并将其与环境中的对象、代理和位置进行关联（接地）。现有的3D场景图（3DSGs）通常缺乏明确的对象间空间关系，而人类在描述环境时经常依赖这些关系，因此需要研究如何将空间关系整合到3DSGs中以提高LLM的解释能力。
method: 本文提出了一个基于LLM的管线，用于从开放词汇语言命令中进行目标对象接地。同时，提出了一个基于VLM的管线，用于从机器人测绘时捕获的图像中向3DSGs添加开放词汇空间边缘（关系）。最后，评估了两种LLM在目标对象接地这一下游任务中的性能。
results: 研究表明，明确的空间关系提高了LLM对对象接地的能力。此外，使用VLM从机器人捕获的图像中生成开放词汇关系是可行的，但其相对于封闭词汇关系的优势有限。
conclusion: 明确的空间关系（无论是开放词汇还是封闭词汇）能够显著提高LLM在自然语言命令中进行目标对象接地的能力。尽管使用VLM从机器人图像中生成开放词汇关系是可行的，但其相对于封闭词汇关系的优势并不显著。

title: From Vision to Assistance: Gaze and Vision-Enabled Adaptive Control for a Back-Support Exoskeleton
authors: Alessandro Leanza, Paolo Franceschi, Blerina Spahiu, Loris Roveda
abstract: Back-support exoskeletons have been proposed to mitigate spinal loading in industrial handling, yet their effectiveness critically depends on timely and context-aware assistance. Most existing approaches rely either on load-estimation techniques (e.g., EMG, IMU) or on vision systems that do not directly inform control. In this work, we present a vision-gated control framework for an active lumbar occupational exoskeleton that leverages egocentric vision with wearable gaze tracking. The proposed system integrates real-time grasp detection from a first-person YOLO-based perception system, a finite-state machine (FSM) for task progression, and a variable admittance controller to adapt torque delivery to both posture and object state. A user study with 15 participants performing stooping load lifting trials under three conditions (no exoskeleton, exoskeleton without vision, exoskeleton with vision) shows that vision-gated assistance significantly reduces perceived physical demand and improves fluency, trust, and comfort. Quantitative analysis reveals earlier and stronger assistance when vision is enabled, while questionnaire results confirm user preference for the vision-gated mode. These findings highlight the potential of egocentric vision to enhance the responsiveness, ergonomics, safety, and acceptance of back-support exoskeletons.
zh_title: 从视觉到辅助：用于背部支撑外骨骼的凝视与视觉增强自适应控制
translation: 背部支撑外骨骼已被提出用于减轻工业搬运中的脊柱负荷，但其有效性关键取决于及时和上下文感知的辅助。大多数现有方法要么依赖于负荷估计技术（例如EMG、IMU），要么依赖于不能直接指导控制的视觉系统。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于主动腰部职业外骨骼的视觉门控控制框架，该框架利用了带有可穿戴凝视追踪的以自我为中心的视觉。所提出的系统集成了来自基于YOLO的第一人称感知系统的实时抓取检测、用于任务进程的有限状态机（FSM）以及一个可变导纳控制器，用于根据姿势和物体状态调整扭矩输出。一项有15名参与者进行的弯腰举重试验（在三种条件下：无外骨骼、无视觉的外骨骼、有视觉的外骨骼）的用户研究表明，视觉门控辅助显著降低了感知到的体力需求，并提高了流畅性、信任度和舒适度。定量分析显示，启用视觉后，辅助更早、更强，而问卷结果证实了用户对视觉门控模式的偏好。这些发现突显了以自我为中心的视觉在增强背部支撑外骨骼的响应性、人体工程学、安全性及接受度方面的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于第一人称视觉和凝视追踪的门控控制框架，用于背部支撑外骨骼。该系统通过YOLO检测和有限状态机实现上下文感知辅助。用户研究表明，这种视觉门控辅助显著降低了体力需求，提高了用户体验（流畅性、信任度、舒适度）。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将以自我为中心的视觉（结合YOLO检测）和可穿戴凝视追踪直接整合到外骨骼的控制回路中，实现了上下文感知的“视觉门控”辅助。这解决了传统基于负荷估计方法（如EMG）响应慢或现有视觉系统无法直接控制的问题。研究结果明确证明了这种方法在提高用户体验和外骨骼接受度方面的巨大潜力，为下一代智能、响应式外骨骼设计提供了重要方向。
motivation: 现有背部支撑外骨骼的有效性取决于及时和上下文感知的辅助，但大多数现有方法依赖于负荷估计技术（如EMG、IMU）或无法直接指导控制的视觉系统。
method: 提出了一种用于主动腰部职业外骨骼的视觉门控控制框架，该框架利用了带有可穿戴凝视追踪的以自我为中心的视觉。系统集成了基于YOLO的第一人称感知系统的实时抓取检测、用于任务进程的有限状态机（FSM）以及一个可变导纳控制器，用于根据姿势和物体状态调整扭矩输出。
results: 包含视觉的辅助模式相比无外骨骼和无视觉模式，显著降低了感知到的体力需求，并提高了流畅性、信任度和舒适度。定量分析显示，启用视觉后，辅助更早、更强。问卷结果证实了用户对视觉门控模式的偏好。
conclusion: 以自我为中心的视觉具有增强背部支撑外骨骼的响应性、人体工程学、安全性及接受度的潜力。

title: Abstract Framework for All-Path Reachability Analysis
authors: Misaki Kojima, Naoki Nishida
abstract: An all-path reachability (APR, for short) predicate is a pair of a source set and a target set, which are subsets of an object set. APR predicates have been defined for abstract reduction systems (ARSs, for short) and then extended to logically constrained term rewrite systems (LCTRSs, for short) as pairs of constrained terms that represent sets of terms modeling configurations, states, etc. An APR predicate is said to be partially (or demonically) valid w.r.t. a rewrite system if every finite maximal reduction sequence of the system starting from any element in the source set includes an element in the target set. Partial validity of APR predicates w.r.t. ARSs is defined by means of two inference rules, which can be considered a proof system to construct (possibly infinite) derivation trees for partial validity. On the other hand, a proof system for LCTRSs consists of four inference rules, and thus there is a gap between the inference rules for partial validity w.r.t. ARSs and LCTRSs. In this paper, we revisit the framework for APR analysis and adapt it to verification of not only safety but also liveness properties. To this end, we first reformulate an abstract framework for partial validity w.r.t. ARSs so that there is a one-to-one correspondence between the inference rules for ARSs and LCTRSs. Secondly, we show how to apply APR analysis to safety verification. Thirdly, to apply APR analysis to liveness verification, we introduce a novel stronger validity of APR predicates, called total validity, which requires not only finite but also infinite execution paths to reach target sets. Finally, for a partially valid APR predicate with a cyclic-proof tree, we show a necessary and sufficient condition for the tree to ensure total validity, showing how to apply APR analysis to liveness verification.
comment: 21 pages, full version of a submission to FSCD 2026
zh_title: 抽象框架用于全路径可达性分析
translation: 全路径可达性（APR）谓词是一对源集和目标集，它们是对象集的子集。APR谓词最初为抽象规约系统（ARSs）定义，随后扩展到逻辑约束项重写系统（LCTRSs），作为表示配置、状态等项集合的约束项对。如果从源集中任何元素开始的系统的每个有限最大规约序列都包含目标集中的一个元素，则称APR谓词对于重写系统是部分（或恶魔式）有效的。关于ARSs的部分有效性APR谓词是通过两条推理规则定义的，这两条规则可以被视为构建部分有效性（可能无限的）推导树的证明系统。另一方面，LCTRSs的证明系统包含四条推理规则，因此ARSs和LCTRSs的部分有效性推理规则之间存在差异。在本文中，我们重新审视了APR分析的框架，并使其不仅适用于安全性验证，还适用于活性属性的验证。为此，我们首先重新构建了关于ARSs的部分有效性的抽象框架，使得ARSs和LCTRSs的推理规则之间存在一一对应的关系。其次，我们展示了如何将APR分析应用于安全性验证。第三，为了将APR分析应用于活性验证，我们引入了一种新的更强的APR谓词有效性，称为完全有效性，它要求不仅有限执行路径，而且无限执行路径也能到达目标集。最后，对于具有循环证明树的部分有效APR谓词，我们展示了确保完全有效性的充要条件，从而展示了如何将APR分析应用于活性验证。
tldr: 本文统一了抽象规约系统（ARSs）和逻辑约束项重写系统（LCTRSs）的全路径可达性（APR）部分有效性的证明系统。同时，引入了“完全有效性”，将APR分析扩展到活性（liveness）验证，以及安全性（safety）验证。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将两种不同的形式化系统（ARSs和LCTRSs）在可达性分析的抽象框架下进行了统一。关键在于，“完全有效性”的引入（将可达性扩展到无限路径）是使APR分析适用于活性属性验证的必要概念步骤，从而显著拓宽了该框架的实用性，使其超越了传统的安全性检查。
motivation: 抽象规约系统（ARSs）和逻辑约束项重写系统（LCTRSs）的全路径可达性（APR）部分有效性的推理规则存在差异（分别为两条和四条）。本文旨在重新审视该框架，并使其适用于安全性和活性属性的验证。
method: 1. 重新构建ARSs的部分有效性抽象框架，以实现与LCTRSs推理规则的一一对应。2. 展示如何应用于安全性验证。3. 引入一种新的更强的有效性，称为“完全有效性”，用于活性验证。4. 提出了具有循环证明树的部分有效APR谓词确保完全有效性的充要条件。
results: 1. 建立了ARSs和LCTRSs部分有效性推理规则之间一一对应的抽象框架。2. 展示了APR分析在安全性验证中的应用。3. 引入了“完全有效性”这一新的概念。4. 提出了确保完全有效性的充要条件，从而将APR分析应用于活性验证。
conclusion: 通过重新构建APR分析框架，本文统一了ARSs和LCTRSs的证明系统，并通过引入完全有效性，成功将APR分析的适用范围扩展到了活性属性的验证。

title: SAFE: Stable Alignment Finetuning with Entropy-Aware Predictive Control for RLHF
authors: Dipan Maity
abstract: Optimization (PPO) has been positioned by recent literature as the canonical method for the RL part of RLHF. PPO performs well empirically but has a heuristic motivation and handles the KL-divergence constraint used in LM-RLHF in an ad-hoc manner and suffers form reward oscillations, entropy collapse, value function drift, and sudden policy divergence that require frequent restarts and extensive hyperparameter tuning. In this paper, we develop a new pure on policy actor-critic RL method for the LM-RLHF setting. We present SAFE (Stable Alignment Finetuning with Entropy-aware control),a novel RLHF algorithm that combines a Double Soft-Min Critic for pessimistic value estimation with a new multi-layer stabilization framework combining entropy-gated KL regulation, and PID-controlled adaptive thresholds. Unlike standard PPO's symmetric KL penalties, SAFE distinguishes high-entropy exploration from low-entropy mode collapse and adjusts penalties dynamically based on reward velocity. Experiments on a 3B parameter model show SAFE achieves +5.15\% training-average reward than PPO (0.725 vs 0.689), negligible reward crashes, and superior KL control than ppo . Our method adds minimal computational overhead and provides an interpretable, crash-resistant RLHF framework that maintains aggressive learning speed while ensuring stable long-horizon optimization suitable for production deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/ryyzn9/SAFE
zh_title: SAFE：用于RLHF的熵感知预测控制的稳定对齐微调
translation: 优化（PPO）已被最新文献定位为RLHF的RL部分的规范方法。PPO在经验上表现良好，但其动机是启发式的，并且以临时的方式处理LM-RLHF中使用的KL散度约束，并遭受奖励振荡、熵崩溃、价值函数漂移和突然的策略发散，这需要频繁的重启和大量的超参数调整。在本文中，我们为LM-RLHF场景开发了一种新的纯在线演员-评论家RL方法。我们提出了SAFE（Stable Alignment Finetuning with Entropy-aware control），一种新颖的RLHF算法，它结合了用于悲观价值估计的双软最小评论家，以及一个新的多层稳定化框架，该框架结合了熵门控的KL调节和PID控制的自适应阈值。与标准PPO的对称KL惩罚不同，SAFE区分高熵探索和低熵模式崩溃，并根据奖励速度动态调整惩罚。在3B参数模型上的实验表明，SAFE的训练平均奖励比PPO高出+5.15%（0.725 vs 0.689），奖励崩溃极少，并且具有比ppo更优越的KL控制能力。我们的方法增加了最小的计算开销，并提供了一个可解释的、抗崩溃的RLHF框架，该框架在保持积极学习速度的同时，确保了适合生产部署的稳定长期优化。代码可在https://github.com/ryyzn9/SAFE获取。
tldr: SAFE算法通过引入双软最小评论家和基于熵的动态KL调节（PID控制），解决了PPO在RLHF中常见的奖励振荡和策略发散问题，实现了更稳定、奖励更高的模型对齐微调，且计算开销小。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种新的基于熵的预测控制方法来稳定强化学习中的人类反馈（RLHF）过程，解决了PPO固有的不稳定性和超参数敏感性问题。其重要性在于提供了一个更稳定、可解释且适用于生产环境的对齐微调框架。局限性是仅在3B模型上进行了实验验证。
motivation: 现有的RLHF方法（如PPO）虽然经验上表现良好，但其动机是启发式的，对KL散度约束的处理是临时的，并且容易出现奖励振荡、熵崩溃、价值函数漂移和突然的策略发散等问题，这需要频繁的重启和大量的超参数调整。
method: SAFE（Stable Alignment Finetuning with Entropy-aware control）是一种新的纯在线演员-评论家RL方法，它结合了用于悲观价值估计的双软最小（Double Soft-Min）评论家，以及一个多层稳定化框架，该框架结合了熵门控的KL调节和PID控制的自适应阈值。它根据奖励速度动态调整KL惩罚，以区分高熵探索和低熵模式崩溃。
results: 在3B参数模型上的实验表明，SAFE的训练平均奖励比PPO高出+5.15%（0.725 vs 0.689），奖励崩溃极少，并且实现了比PPO更优越的KL控制。该方法增加了最小的计算开销。
conclusion: SAFE提供了一个可解释、抗崩溃的RLHF框架，它在保持积极学习速度的同时，确保了适合生产部署的长期稳定优化。

title: Outcome Accuracy is Not Enough: Aligning the Reasoning Process of Reward Models
authors: Binghai Wang, Yantao Liu, Yuxuan Liu, Tianyi Tang, Shenzhi Wang, Chang Gao, Chujie Zheng, Yichang Zhang, Le Yu, Shixuan Liu, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Bowen Yu, Fei Huang, Junyang Lin
abstract: Generative Reward Models (GenRMs) and LLM-as-a-Judge exhibit deceptive alignment by producing correct judgments for incorrect reasons, as they are trained and evaluated to prioritize Outcome Accuracy, which undermines their ability to generalize during RLHF. We introduce Rationale Consistency, a fine-grained metric that quantifies the alignment between the model's reasoning process and human judgment. Our evaluation of frontier models reveals that rationale consistency effectively discriminates among state-of-the-art models and detects deceptive alignment, while outcome accuracy falls short in both respects. To mitigate this gap, we introduce a hybrid signal that combines rationale consistency with outcome accuracy for GenRM training. Our training method achieves state-of-the-art performance on RM-Bench (87.1%) and JudgeBench (82%), surpassing outcome-only baselines by an average of 5%. Using RM during RLHF, our method effectively improves performance as demonstrated on Arena Hard v2, notably yielding a 7% improvement in creative writing tasks. Further analysis confirms that our method escapes the deceptive alignment trap, effectively reversing the decline in rationale consistency observed in outcome-only training.
zh_title: 结果准确性是不够的：对齐奖励模型的推理过程
translation: 生成式奖励模型（GenRMs）和“LLM即裁判”通过产生针对错误原因的正确判断来表现出欺骗性对齐，因为它们被训练和评估为优先考虑结果准确性，这破坏了它们在强化学习与人类反馈（RLHF）中泛化的能力。我们引入了“理由一致性”（Rationale Consistency），一个量化模型推理过程与人类判断之间对齐程度的精细化指标。我们对前沿模型的评估显示，理由一致性有效地区分了最先进的模型并检测到欺骗性对齐，而结果准确性在这两方面都表现不足。为缓解这一差距，我们引入了一种将理由一致性与结果准确性相结合的混合信号用于GenRM的训练。我们的训练方法在RM-Bench（87.1%）和JudgeBench（82%）上取得了最先进的性能，比仅使用结果的基线平均提高了5%。在使用RM进行RLHF时，我们的方法被证明能有效提高性能，特别是在Arena Hard v2上，在创意写作任务中带来了7%的提升。进一步的分析证实，我们的方法逃脱了欺骗性对齐的陷阱，有效地逆转了仅使用结果的训练中观察到的理由一致性下降的趋势。
tldr: GenRM只看结果不看过程会导致模型“欺骗性对齐”，结果对了但理由错了，影响RLHF。我们提出了“理由一致性”指标来衡量推理过程的对齐程度。结合这个指标和结果准确性一起训练GenRM，效果更好（平均提升5%），并且能避免欺骗性对齐，尤其在创意写作等任务上提升更明显。
ai_comments: 这项工作创新性地提出了“理由一致性”来解决生成式奖励模型（GenRM）中存在的“欺骗性对齐”问题，即模型结果正确但推理过程错误。这对于提高RLHF的泛化能力至关重要。然而，其局限性在于“理由一致性”的量化和获取可能需要大量高质量的人工标注数据。
motivation: 生成式奖励模型（GenRMs）和LLM-as-a-Judge存在“欺骗性对齐”问题，即它们产生正确的判断但理由错误，因为它们仅被训练和评估以优先考虑结果准确性，这损害了它们在RLHF中的泛化能力。
method: 提出了一种名为“理由一致性”（Rationale Consistency）的精细化指标，用于量化模型推理过程与人类判断的一致性。然后，引入一种结合理由一致性和结果准确性的混合信号用于GenRM的训练。
results: 理由一致性指标能够有效区分最先进的模型并检测欺骗性对齐，而结果准确性在这两方面都表现不足。结合理由一致性的训练方法在RM-Bench上达到87.1%，在JudgeBench上达到82%，比仅使用结果准确性的基线平均提高5%，并在Arena Hard v2上，特别是在创意写作任务中，提高了7%。
conclusion: 通过结合理由一致性和结果准确性进行训练的混合信号方法，不仅在标准基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，而且成功规避了欺骗性对齐的陷阱，有效提高了模型推理过程与人类判断的一致性。

title: Inference-Time Backdoors via Hidden Instructions in LLM Chat Templates
authors: Ariel Fogel, Omer Hofman, Eilon Cohen, Roman Vainshtein
abstract: Open-weight language models are increasingly used in production settings, raising new security challenges. One prominent threat in this context is backdoor attacks, in which adversaries embed hidden behaviors in language models that activate under specific conditions. Previous work has assumed that adversaries have access to training pipelines or deployment infrastructure. We propose a novel attack surface requiring neither, which utilizes the chat template. Chat templates are executable Jinja2 programs invoked at every inference call, occupying a privileged position between user input and model processing. We show that an adversary who distributes a model with a maliciously modified template can implant an inference-time backdoor without modifying model weights, poisoning training data, or controlling runtime infrastructure. We evaluated this attack vector by constructing template backdoors targeting two objectives: degrading factual accuracy and inducing emission of attacker-controlled URLs, and applied them across eighteen models spanning seven families and four inference engines. Under triggered conditions, factual accuracy drops from 90% to 15% on average while attacker-controlled URLs are emitted with success rates exceeding 80%; benign inputs show no measurable degradation. Backdoors generalize across inference runtimes and evade all automated security scans applied by the largest open-weight distribution platform. These results establish chat templates as a reliable and currently undefended attack surface in the LLM supply chain.
zh_title: 基于LLM聊天模板中隐藏指令的推理时后门
translation: 开放权重语言模型越来越多地用于生产环境，这带来了新的安全挑战。在这种背景下，一个突出的威胁是后门攻击，即攻击者在语言模型中植入在特定条件下激活的隐藏行为。以往的研究假设攻击者能够访问训练流程或部署基础设施。我们提出了一个不需要这些条件的新型攻击面，它利用了聊天模板。聊天模板是每次推理调用时都会调用的可执行Jinja2程序，它处于用户输入和模型处理之间的一个特权位置。我们证明，一个恶意修改了模板的模型的攻击者，可以在不修改模型权重、不污染训练数据或不控制运行时基础设施的情况下，植入一个推理时后门。我们通过构建针对两个目标的模板后门来评估这个攻击向量：降低事实准确性和诱导排放攻击者控制的URL。我们将它们应用于跨越七个系列和四个推理引擎的十八个模型。在触发条件下，事实准确性平均从90%下降到15%，而攻击者控制的URL的排放成功率超过80%；无害输入的性能没有可衡量的下降。后门可以跨推理运行时通用，并能逃避最大的开放权重分发平台所应用的所有自动化安全扫描。这些结果表明，聊天模板是LLM供应链中一个可靠且目前未被防御的攻击面。
tldr: 攻击者可以通过修改LLM的聊天模板来植入推理时后门，无需修改模型权重或控制基础设施，该后门可在触发条件下显著降低模型准确性或诱导特定URL的生成，并且能逃避安全扫描。
ai_comments: 这项研究揭示了一个新颖且令人担忧的LLM安全漏洞，即利用聊天模板进行后门攻击。其创新之处在于攻击者无需访问模型权重或训练数据，仅通过修改模板即可实现攻击。研究结果表明，该攻击在实际场景中具有很高的有效性，并且能够规避现有的安全措施，凸显了加强对LLM供应链安全审查的紧迫性。然而，文章未详细说明防御此类攻击的具体方法。
motivation: 以往的后门攻击假设攻击者能访问训练流程或部署基础设施，本文旨在探索一种无需这些条件的新型攻击面——聊天模板。
method: 通过修改聊天模板（可执行的Jinja2程序）来植入推理时后门，无需修改模型权重、训练数据或控制运行时基础设施。在实验中，针对两种目标（降低事实准确性、诱导URL排放）构建了模板后门，并应用于18个模型。
results: 在触发条件下，事实准确性平均从90%降至15%，攻击者控制的URL的排放成功率超过80%；在非触发条件下，对模型的无害输入没有可衡量的性能下降。该后门可跨推理运行时通用，并能逃避自动化安全扫描。
conclusion: 聊天模板是一个可靠但目前未被防御的LLM供应链攻击面。

title: Six Times to Spare: LDPC Acceleration on DGX Spark for AI-Native Open RAN
authors: Ryan Barker, Fatemeh Afghah
abstract: Low-density parity-check (LDPC) decoding is one of the most computationally intensive kernels in the 5G New Radio (NR) physical layer and must complete within a 0.5\,ms transmission time interval while sharing the budget with FFT, channel estimation, demapping, HARQ, and MAC scheduling. Many open and proprietary stacks still execute LDPC on general-purpose CPUs, raising concerns about missed-slot events and limited scalability as bandwidths, modulation orders, and user multiplexing increase. This paper empirically quantifies the benefit of offloading 5G-style LDPC5G decoding from a Grace CPU to the integrated Blackwell GB10 GPU on an NVIDIA DGX~Spark platform. Using NVIDIA Sionna PHY/SYS on TensorFlow, we construct an NR-like link-level chain with an LDPC5G encoder/decoder, 16-QAM modulation, and AWGN, and sweep both the number of codewords decoded in parallel and the number of belief-propagation iterations, timing only the decoding phase while logging CPU and GPU utilization and power. Across the sweep we observe an average GPU/CPU throughput speedup of approximately $6\times$, with per-codeword CPU latency reaching $\approx 0.71$\,ms at 20 iterations (exceeding the 0.5\,ms slot), while the GB10 GPU remains within 6--24\% of the slot for the same workloads. Resource-usage measurements show that CPU-based LDPC decoding often consumes around ten Grace cores, whereas GPU-based decoding adds only $\approx10-15$\,W over GPU idle while leaving most CPU capacity available for higher-layer tasks. Because our implementation relies on high-level Sionna layers rather than hand-tuned CUDA, these results represent conservative lower bounds on achievable accelerator performance and provide a reusable, scriptable methodology for evaluating LDPC and other physical-layer kernels on future Grace/Blackwell and Aerial/ACAR/AODT platforms.
zh_title: 六次节省：DGX Spark 上的 LDPC 加速用于 AI 原生 Open RAN
translation: 低密度奇偶校验 (LDPC) 解码是 5G 新空口 (NR) 物理层中最具计算密集型的内核之一，必须在 0.5 ms 的传输时间间隔内完成，同时还要与其他内核（如 FFT、信道估计、解映射、HARQ 和 MAC 调度）共享该时间。许多开放和专有堆栈仍然在通用 CPU 上执行 LDPC，这引发了对错过时隙事件和随着带宽、调制阶数和用户复用增加而导致的扩展性受限的担忧。本文实证量化了将 5G 风格的 LDPC5G 解码从 Grace CPU 卸载到 NVIDIA DGX Spark 平台上集成的 Blackwell GB10 GPU 所带来的优势。我们使用 NVIDIA Sionna PHY/SYS 和 TensorFlow 构建了一个类似 NR 的链路级链，包含 LDPC5G 编码器/解码器、16-QAM 调制和 AWGN，并通过改变并行解码的码字数量和信念传播迭代次数，仅对解码阶段进行计时，同时记录 CPU 和 GPU 的利用率及功耗。在整个扫描过程中，我们观察到平均 GPU/CPU 吞吐量加速约为 6 倍，每码字 CPU 延迟在 20 次迭代时达到约 0.71 ms（超过 0.5 ms 的时隙），而 GB10 GPU 在相同工作负载下仅占用时隙的 6-24%。资源使用情况测量表明，基于 CPU 的 LDPC 解码通常消耗约十个 Grace 核心，而基于 GPU 的解码仅比 GPU 空闲状态增加约 10-15W 的功耗，并留下大部分 CPU 容量用于更高层任务。由于我们的实现依赖于高级 Sionna 层而不是手工优化的 CUDA，因此这些结果代表了可实现的加速器性能的保守下限，并为在未来的 Grace/Blackwell 和 Aerial/ACAR/AODT 平台上评估 LDPC 和其他物理层内核提供了可重用、可脚本化的方法。
tldr: 该论文研究了将 5G NR LDPC 解码从 CPU 卸载到 NVIDIA DGX Spark 平台上的 Blackwell GB10 GPU 的优势。实验表明，与 CPU 相比，GPU 可实现大约 6 倍的吞吐量加速，同时功耗和延迟更低，从而为 Open RAN 中的 CPU 密集型任务留出了更多资源。
ai_comments: 该研究在评估 GPU 加速 LDPC 解码方面提供了有价值的实证数据，特别是在 Open RAN 的背景下。其主要贡献在于量化了实际的性能提升，并指出了 CPU 资源释放的潜力。然而，研究集中在 LDPC 解码阶段，未涵盖整个物理层处理流程，并且使用了高级库而非底层优化 CUDA 代码，因此实际性能提升可能更高。未来的工作可以探索更广泛的物理层内核的 GPU 加速，并进行端到端的系统级评估。
motivation: 许多 Open RAN 堆栈在通用 CPU 上执行 LDPC 解码，这可能导致错过时隙事件和扩展性受限，尤其是在带宽、调制阶数和用户复用增加的情况下。
method: 在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 平台上，使用 NVIDIA Sionna PHY/SYS 和 TensorFlow 构建了一个类似 NR 的链路级链，包含 LDPC5G 编码器/解码器、16-QAM 调制和 AWGN。通过改变并行解码的码字数量和信念传播迭代次数，对解码阶段进行计时，并记录 CPU 和 GPU 的利用率及功耗。
results: 与 CPU 相比，GPU/CPU 的吞吐量加速约为 6 倍。CPU 的每码字延迟在 20 次迭代时达到约 0.71 ms（超过 0.5 ms 时隙），而 GB10 GPU 在相同工作负载下仅占用时隙的 6-24%。CPU 上的 LDPC 解码通常消耗约十个 Grace 核心，而 GPU 解码仅比 GPU 空闲状态增加约 10-15W 的功耗，并为上层任务留出大量 CPU 容量。
conclusion: 将 5G NR LDPC 解码从 CPU 卸载到 DGX Spark 上的 GB10 GPU 可显著提高吞吐量（约 6 倍），降低延迟，并减少 CPU 资源消耗，为 Open RAN 提供了可行的加速方案。

title: Safe Adaptive Control of Parabolic PDE-ODE Cascades
authors: Yun Jiang, Ji Wang
abstract: In this paper, we propose a safe adaptive boundary control strategy for a class of parabolic partial differential equation-ordinary differential equation (PDE-ODE) cascaded systems with parametric uncertainties in both the PDE and ODE subsystems. The proposed design is built upon an adaptive Control Barrier Function (aCBF) framework that incorporates high-relative-degree CBFs together with a batch least-squares identification (BaLSI)-based adaptive control that guarantees exact parameter identification in finite time. The proposed control law ensures that: (i) if the system output state initially lies within a prescribed safe set, safety is maintained for all time; otherwise, the output is driven back into the safe region within a preassigned finite time; and (ii) convergence to zero of all plant states is achieved. Numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
zh_title: 抛物型PDE-ODE级联系统的安全自适应控制
translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种安全自适应边界控制策略，用于一类在PDE和ODE子系统中存在参数不确定性的抛物型偏微分方程-常微分方程（PDE-ODE）级联系统。所提出的设计建立在自适应控制屏障函数（aCBF）框架之上，该框架结合了高相对阶的CBFs和基于批量最小二乘识别（BaLSI）的自适应控制，后者保证了有限时间内精确的参数识别。所提出的控制律确保了：（i）如果系统输出状态初始位于预定的安全集中，则安全性在所有时间内保持；否则，输出将在预先设定的有限时间内被驱动回安全区域；以及（ii）实现了所有被控对象状态向零的收敛。提供了数值模拟以证明所提方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种新的方法，用于安全地控制具有未知参数的耦合PDE和ODE系统，该方法利用自适应控制屏障函数和快速参数识别技术，确保系统既安全又最终收敛到零。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将自适应控制、控制屏障函数（CBF）和有限时间参数识别（BaLSI）相结合，用于处理具有参数不确定性的PDE-ODE级联系统，实现了安全性和收敛性的双重保证。其重要性在于为一类复杂的偏微分方程系统提供了严格的安全控制方案。限制是仅在数值模拟中验证了有效性，缺乏更广泛的实验验证。
motivation: 为一类在PDE和ODE子系统中存在参数不确定性的抛物型偏微分方程-常微分方程（PDE-ODE）级联系统设计一种安全自适应边界控制策略。
method: 基于自适应控制屏障函数（aCBF）框架，结合高相对阶CBFs和基于批量最小二乘识别（BaLSI）的自适应控制，后者保证有限时间内精确的参数识别。
results: 所提出的控制律保证了：(i) 如果系统输出状态初始在预设的安全集中，则安全性在所有时间内保持；否则，输出将在预先设定的有限时间内被驱动回安全区域；(ii) 实现了所有系统状态向零的收敛。
conclusion: 数值模拟证明了所提出的安全自适应控制方法的有效性。

title: Approaches to Semantic Textual Similarity in Slovak Language: From Algorithms to Transformers
authors: Lukas Radosky, Miroslav Blstak, Matej Krajcovic, Ivan Polasek
abstract: Semantic textual similarity (STS) plays a crucial role in many natural language processing tasks. While extensively studied in high-resource languages, STS remains challenging for under-resourced languages such as Slovak. This paper presents a comparative evaluation of sentence-level STS methods applied to Slovak, including traditional algorithms, supervised machine learning models, and third-party deep learning tools. We trained several machine learning models using outputs from traditional algorithms as features, with feature selection and hyperparameter tuning jointly guided by artificial bee colony optimization. Finally, we evaluated several third-party tools, including fine-tuned model by CloudNLP, OpenAI's embedding models, GPT-4 model, and pretrained SlovakBERT model. Our findings highlight the trade-offs between different approaches.
comment: This is a preprint of a paper that was presented at the IEEE 24th World Symposium on Applied Machine Intelligence and Informatics (SAMI 2026)
zh_title: 斯洛伐克语的语义文本相似度方法：从算法到Transformer
translation: 语义文本相似度（STS）在许多自然语言处理任务中起着至关重要的作用。虽然在资源丰富的语言中得到了广泛研究，但STS对于斯洛伐克语等资源匮乏的语言仍然具有挑战性。本文对应用于斯洛伐克语的句子级STS方法进行了比较评估，包括传统算法、监督机器学习模型和第三方深度学习工具。我们使用传统算法的输出来训练几个机器学习模型作为特征，并通过人工蜂群优化联合指导特征选择和超参数调整。最后，我们评估了几个第三方工具，包括CloudNLP的微调模型、OpenAI的嵌入模型、GPT-4模型和预训练的SlovakBERT模型。我们的研究结果突显了不同方法之间的权衡。
tldr: 该研究比较了斯洛伐克语的多种语义文本相似度方法，包括传统算法、监督机器学习模型和第三方深度学习工具，并评估了它们在低资源语言上的表现。
ai_comments: 这项研究对于低资源语言的NLP领域具有重要意义，它系统地比较了多种STS方法，并为实际应用提供了有价值的见解。然而，未来可以进一步探索跨语言迁移学习在斯洛伐克语STS任务中的潜力。
motivation: 尽管语义文本相似度在自然语言处理中很重要，但在斯洛伐克语等资源匮乏的语言中仍具挑战性。
method: 比较评估了传统算法、监督机器学习模型（使用人工蜂群优化进行特征选择和超参数调整）以及第三方深度学习工具（如CloudNLP、OpenAI嵌入模型、GPT-4和SlovakBERT）在斯洛伐克语上的句子级STS表现。
results: 研究结果突显了不同方法之间的权衡。
conclusion: 该研究对斯洛伐克语的语义文本相似度方法进行了全面的比较评估，为在资源匮乏的语言中选择和应用STS技术提供了见解。

title: The Complexity of Min-Max Optimization with Product Constraints
authors: Martino Bernasconi, Matteo Castiglioni
abstract: We study the computational complexity of the problem of computing local min-max equilibria of games with a nonconvex-nonconcave utility function $f$. From the work of Daskalakis, Skoulakis, and Zampetakis [DSZ21], this problem was known to be hard in the restrictive case in which players are required to play strategies that are jointly constrained, leaving open the question of its complexity under more natural constraints. In this paper, we settle the question and show that the problem is PPAD-hard even under product constraints and, in particular, over the hypercube.
zh_title: 带乘积约束的最小-最大优化问题的复杂度
translation: 我们研究了具有非凸非凹效用函数 $f$ 的博弈中局部最小-最大均衡的计算复杂度问题。根据 Daskalakis、Skoulakis 和 Zampetakis [DSZ21] 的工作，在玩家需要遵循联合约束策略的限制情况下，该问题已知是困难的，这使得在更自然的约束下的复杂度问题悬而未决。在本文中，我们解决了这个问题，并证明即使在乘积约束下，特别是在超立方体上，该问题也是 PPAD-hard 的。
tldr: 即使在有乘积约束的情况下，求解非凸非凹效用函数的博弈中的局部最小-最大均衡问题也是PPAD-hard的。
ai_comments: 这项工作的重要性在于它解决了计算博弈论中一个长期存在的关于最小-最大均衡复杂性的问题。通过证明即使在更宽松的乘积约束下问题仍然是NP-hard的，这为理解和设计这些博弈的算法提供了重要的理论基础，但也暗示了在实际应用中找到精确解的挑战性。
motivation: 研究在更自然的约束条件下（特别是乘积约束）求解局部最小-最大均衡的计算复杂度，以解决Daskalakis等人[DSZ21]工作中遗留的问题。
method: 通过证明在乘积约束下，特别是在超立方体上的情况，该问题仍然是PPAD-hard的。
results: 证明了即使在乘积约束下，求解非凸非凹效用函数的博弈中的局部最小-最大均衡问题也是PPAD-hard的。
conclusion: 该研究解决了在更自然约束条件下求解局部最小-最大均衡问题的计算复杂度问题，证明了其PPAD-hard的性质。

title: Rethinking the Design Space of Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: On the Importance of Likelihood Estimation Beyond Loss Design
authors: Jaemoo Choi, Yuchen Zhu, Wei Guo, Petr Molodyk, Bo Yuan, Jinbin Bai, Yi Xin, Molei Tao, Yongxin Chen
abstract: Reinforcement learning has been widely applied to diffusion and flow models for visual tasks such as text-to-image generation. However, these tasks remain challenging because diffusion models have intractable likelihoods, which creates a barrier for directly applying popular policy-gradient type methods. Existing approaches primarily focus on crafting new objectives built on already heavily engineered LLM objectives, using ad hoc estimators for likelihood, without a thorough investigation into how such estimation affects overall algorithmic performance. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of the RL design space by disentangling three factors: i) policy-gradient objectives, ii) likelihood estimators, and iii) rollout sampling schemes. We show that adopting an evidence lower bound (ELBO) based model likelihood estimator, computed only from the final generated sample, is the dominant factor enabling effective, efficient, and stable RL optimization, outweighing the impact of the specific policy-gradient loss functional. We validate our findings across multiple reward benchmarks using SD 3.5 Medium, and observe consistent trends across all tasks. Our method improves the GenEval score from 0.24 to 0.95 in 90 GPU hours, which is $4.6\times$ more efficient than FlowGRPO and $2\times$ more efficient than the SOTA method DiffusionNFT without reward hacking.
zh_title: 重新思考扩散模型的强化学习设计空间：关于超越损失函数设计的似然估计重要性
translation: 强化学习已被广泛应用于扩散模型和流模型以完成视觉任务，例如文本到图像生成。然而，由于扩散模型具有难以处理的似然性，这些任务仍然具有挑战性，这为直接应用流行的策略梯度类型方法设置了障碍。现有方法主要侧重于利用已经过度设计的LLM目标来设计新的目标函数，使用临时的似然估计器，而没有对这种估计如何影响整体算法性能进行彻底的研究。在这项工作中，我们通过解耦三个因素来系统分析RL设计空间：i) 策略梯度目标，ii) 似然估计器，和 iii) 滚出采样方案。我们表明，采用仅从最终生成样本计算的基于证据下界（ELBO）的模型似然估计器，是实现有效、高效和稳定RL优化的主导因素，其影响超过了特定策略梯度损失泛函的影响。我们在使用SD 3.5 Medium的多个奖励基准测试中验证了我们的发现，并在所有任务中观察到了一致的趋势。我们的方法在90 GPU小时内将GenEval分数从0.24提高到0.95，比FlowGRPO的效率高出$4.6\times$，比SOTA方法DiffusionNFT的效率高出$2\times$，且没有出现奖励攻击。
tldr: 在扩散模型中使用强化学习时，如何估计似然性比设计损失函数更重要；使用基于最终样本的ELBO似然估计效果最好，比现有方法快得多。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过系统分析解耦了三个关键因素，强调了似然估计（特别是基于ELBO的最终样本估计）在强化学习应用于扩散模型中的主导作用，这超越了传统上对特定策略梯度损失的过度关注，具有重要的理论和实践意义。
motivation: 扩散模型具有难处理的似然性，阻碍了直接应用流行的策略梯度方法；现有方法过度关注基于已有的LLM目标设计的改进，而对似然估计如何影响整体算法性能缺乏深入研究。
method: 通过系统分析解耦了三个因素：i) 策略梯度目标，ii) 似然估计器，和 iii) 滚出采样方案，并验证了基于最终生成样本计算的ELBO模型似然估计器的有效性。
results: 采用基于最终生成样本计算的ELBO模型似然估计器，是有效、高效和稳定RL优化的主导因素。在GenEval分数上，该方法在90 GPU小时内将分数从0.24提高到0.95，比FlowGRPO快4.6倍，比SOTA方法DiffusionNFT快2倍，且没有出现奖励攻击（reward hacking）。
conclusion: 基于最终生成样本计算的基于证据下界（ELBO）的模型似然估计，是实现有效、高效和稳定强化学习优化的主导因素，其影响超过了特定策略梯度损失泛函的影响。

title: Delving into Muon and Beyond: Deep Analysis and Extensions
authors: Xianbiao Qi, Marco Chen, Jiaquan Ye, Yelin He, Rong Xiao
abstract: The Muon optimizer has recently attracted considerable attention for its strong empirical performance and use of orthogonalized updates on matrix-shaped parameters, yet its underlying mechanisms and relationship to adaptive optimizers such as Adam remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we aim to address these questions through a unified spectral perspective. Specifically, we view Muon as the p = 0 endpoint of a family of spectral transformations of the form U \boldsymbolΣ^{p} V' , and consider additional variants with p = 1/2 , p = 1/4 , and p = 1 . These transformations are applied to both first-moment updates, as in momentum SGD, and to root-mean-square (RMS) normalized gradient updates as in Adam. To enable efficient computation, we develop a coupled Newton iteration that avoids explicit singular value decomposition. Across controlled experiments, we find that RMS-normalized updates yield more stable optimization than first-moment updates. Moreover, while spectral compression provides strong stabilization benefits under first-moment updates, the Muon update (p = 0) does not consistently outperform Adam. These results suggest that Muon is best understood as an effective form of spectral normalization, but not a universally superior optimization method. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/Ocram7/BeyondMuon.
comment: This paper studies matrix-based optimizers (e.g., Muon) from a spectral perspective and unifies a range of methods under a common spectral framework

title: AGILE: Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction from Video via Agentic Generation
authors: Jin-Chuan Shi, Binhong Ye, Tao Liu, Junzhe He, Yangjinhui Xu, Xiaoyang Liu, Zeju Li, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen
abstract: Reconstructing dynamic hand-object interactions from monocular videos is critical for dexterous manipulation data collection and creating realistic digital twins for robotics and VR. However, current methods face two prohibitive barriers: (1) reliance on neural rendering often yields fragmented, non-simulation-ready geometries under heavy occlusion, and (2) dependence on brittle Structure-from-Motion (SfM) initialization leads to frequent failures on in-the-wild footage. To overcome these limitations, we introduce AGILE, a robust framework that shifts the paradigm from reconstruction to agentic generation for interaction learning. First, we employ an agentic pipeline where a Vision-Language Model (VLM) guides a generative model to synthesize a complete, watertight object mesh with high-fidelity texture, independent of video occlusions. Second, bypassing fragile SfM entirely, we propose a robust anchor-and-track strategy. We initialize the object pose at a single interaction onset frame using a foundation model and propagate it temporally by leveraging the strong visual similarity between our generated asset and video observations. Finally, a contact-aware optimization integrates semantic, geometric, and interaction stability constraints to enforce physical plausibility. Extensive experiments on HO3D, DexYCB, and in-the-wild videos reveal that AGILE outperforms baselines in global geometric accuracy while demonstrating exceptional robustness on challenging sequences where prior art frequently collapses. By prioritizing physical validity, our method produces simulation-ready assets validated via real-to-sim retargeting for robotic applications.

title: Overstating Attitudes, Ignoring Networks: LLM Biases in Simulating Misinformation Susceptibility
authors: Eun Cheol Choi, Lindsay E. Young, Emilio Ferrara
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proxies for human judgment in computational social science, yet their ability to reproduce patterns of susceptibility to misinformation remains unclear. We test whether LLM-simulated survey respondents, prompted with participant profiles drawn from social survey data measuring network, demographic, attitudinal and behavioral features, can reproduce human patterns of misinformation belief and sharing. Using three online surveys as baselines, we evaluate whether LLM outputs match observed response distributions and recover feature-outcome associations present in the original survey data. LLM-generated responses capture broad distributional tendencies and show modest correlation with human responses, but consistently overstate the association between belief and sharing. Linear models fit to simulated responses exhibit substantially higher explained variance and place disproportionate weight on attitudinal and behavioral features, while largely ignoring personal network characteristics, relative to models fit to human responses. Analyses of model-generated reasoning and LLM training data suggest that these distortions reflect systematic biases in how misinformation-related concepts are represented. Our findings suggest that LLM-based survey simulations are better suited for diagnosing systematic divergences from human judgment than for substituting it.

title: PIO-FVLM: Rethinking Training-Free Visual Token Reduction for VLM Acceleration from an Inference-Objective Perspective
authors: Haokui Zhang, Congyang Ou, Dawei Yan, Peng Wang, Qingsen Yan, Ying Li, Rong Xiao, Chunhua Shen
abstract: Recently, reducing redundant visual tokens in vision-language models (VLMs) to accelerate VLM inference has emerged as a hot topic. However, most existing methods rely on heuristics constructed based on inter-visual-token similarity or cross-modal visual-text similarity, which gives rise to certain limitations in compression performance and practical deployment. In contrast, we propose PIO-FVLM from the perspective of inference objectives, which transforms visual token compression into preserving output result invariance and selects tokens primarily by their importance to this goal. Specially, vision tokens are reordered with the guidance of token-level gradient saliency generated by our designed layer-local proxy loss, a coarse constraint from the current layer to the final result. Then the most valuable vision tokens are selected following the non-maximum suppression (NMS) principle. The proposed PIO-FVLM is training-free and compatible with FlashAttention, friendly to practical application and deployment. It can be deployed independently as an encoder-free method, or combined with encoder compression approaches like VisionZip for use as an encoder-involved method. On LLaVA-Next-7B, PIO-FVLM retains just 11.1% of visual tokens but maintains 97.2% of the original performance, with a 2.67$\times$ prefill speedup, 2.11$\times$ inference speedup, 6.22$\times$ lower FLOPs, and 6.05$\times$ reduced KV Cache overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/ocy1/PIO-FVLM.
zh_title: PIO-FVLM：从推理目标角度重新思考用于VLM加速的无训练视觉标记约简
translation: 近期，减少视觉语言模型（VLMs）中的冗余视觉标记以加速VLM推理已成为一个热门话题。然而，现有的大多数方法依赖于基于视觉标记间相似性或跨模态视觉-文本相似性构建的启发式方法，这在压缩性能和实际部署方面存在一定的局限性。相比之下，我们从推理目标的角度提出了PIO-FVLM，它将视觉标记压缩转化为保持输出结果不变，并主要根据标记对该目标的重要性来选择标记。具体来说，在由我们设计的层局部代理损失（一种从当前层到最终结果的粗略约束）的指导下，视觉标记被重新排序。然后，遵循非最大抑制（NMS）原理选择最有价值的视觉标记。所提出的PIO-FVLM是训练免费的，并且与FlashAttention兼容，有利于实际应用和部署。它可以独立部署为一种无编码器的方法，或者与VisionZip等编码器压缩方法结合使用，作为一种涉及编码器的方法。在LLaVA-Next-7B上，PIO-FVLM仅保留11.1%的视觉标记，但保持了原始性能的97.2%，预填充速度提高了2.67倍，推理速度提高了2.11倍，FLOPs降低了6.22倍，KV缓存开销减少了6.05倍。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ocy1/PIO-FVLM获取。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为PIO-FVLM的训练免费方法，用于在视觉语言模型（VLM）中减少视觉标记数量以加速推理。与以往依赖启发式方法的不同，PIO-FVLM从推理目标出发，通过保持输出结果不变来选择最重要的视觉标记，并利用梯度显著性进行排序和非最大抑制选择。实验表明，PIO-FVLM在LLaVA-Next-7B上仅保留11.1%的视觉标记，性能损失仅为2.8%，同时实现了2.67倍的预填充速度提升和2.11倍的推理速度提升，并显著降低了计算量和KV缓存开销。
ai_comments: 该方法巧妙地将标记选择问题转化为对最终输出影响的优化问题，并利用梯度显著性这一有效的信号来指导选择，克服了传统基于相似性启发式方法的局限性。训练免费和兼容FlashAttention的特性使其易于部署和应用。然而，其在不同VLM架构和任务上的泛化能力，以及对不同类型视觉标记（如细粒度细节）保留效果的进一步评估值得关注。
motivation: 现有视觉标记约简方法大多基于视觉标记间或视觉-文本间的相似性启发式方法，存在压缩性能和实际部署上的局限性。需要一种从推理目标出发，更有效地选择视觉标记以加速VLM推理的方法。
method: PIO-FVLM方法将视觉标记压缩转化为保持输出结果不变的问题。首先，利用提出的层局部代理损失生成标记级梯度显著性，指导视觉标记排序。然后，采用非最大抑制（NMS）原则选择最重要的视觉标记。该方法训练免费，兼容FlashAttention，可独立部署或与编码器压缩方法结合使用。
results: 在LLaVA-Next-7B模型上，PIO-FVLM仅保留11.1%的视觉标记，性能保持了原始的97.2%，实现了2.67倍的预填充速度提升，2.11倍的推理速度提升，FLOPs降低了6.22倍，KV缓存开销减少了6.05倍。
conclusion: PIO-FVLM通过从推理目标角度出发，利用梯度显著性引导的标记选择，成功实现了视觉语言模型的高效推理加速，在保持模型性能的同时显著提高了速度和效率，并且具有良好的部署灵活性。

title: Generalized Schrödinger Bridge on Graphs
authors: Panagiotis Theodoropoulos, Juno Nam, Evangelos Theodorou, Jaemoo Choi
abstract: Transportation on graphs is a fundamental challenge across many domains, where decisions must respect topological and operational constraints. Despite the need for actionable policies, existing graph-transport methods lack this expressivity. They rely on restrictive assumptions, fail to generalize across sparse topologies, and scale poorly with graph size and time horizon. To address these issues, we introduce Generalized Schrödinger Bridge on Graphs (GSBoG), a novel scalable data-driven framework for learning executable controlled continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) policies on arbitrary graphs under state cost augmented dynamics. Notably, GSBoG learns trajectory-level policies, avoiding dense global solvers and thereby enhancing scalability. This is achieved via a likelihood optimization approach, satisfying the endpoint marginals, while simultaneously optimizing intermediate behavior under state-dependent running costs. Extensive experimentation on challenging real-world graph topologies shows that GSBoG reliably learns accurate, topology-respecting policies while optimizing application-specific intermediate state costs, highlighting its broad applicability and paving new avenues for cost-aware dynamical transport on general graphs.

title: REDistill: Robust Estimator Distillation for Balancing Robustness and Efficiency
authors: Ondrej Tybl, Lukas Neumann
abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student by aligning their predictive distributions. However, conventional KD formulations - typically based on Kullback-Leibler divergence - assume that the teacher provides reliable soft targets. In practice, teacher predictions are often noisy or overconfident, and existing correction-based approaches rely on ad-hoc heuristics and extensive hyper-parameter tuning, which hinders generalization. We introduce REDistill (Robust Estimator Distillation), a simple yet principled framework grounded in robust statistics. REDistill replaces the standard KD objective with a power divergence loss, a generalization of KL divergence that adaptively downweights unreliable teacher output while preserving informative logit relationships. This formulation provides a unified and interpretable treatment of teacher noise, requires only logits, integrates seamlessly into existing KD pipelines, and incurs negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k demonstrate that REDistill consistently improves student accuracy in diverse teacher-student architectures. Remarkably, it achieves these gains without model-specific hyper-parameter tuning, underscoring its robustness and strong generalization to unseen teacher-student pairs.

title: Audio ControlNet for Fine-Grained Audio Generation and Editing
authors: Haina Zhu, Yao Xiao, Xiquan Li, Ziyang Ma, Jianwei Yu, Bowen Zhang, Mingqi Yang, Xie Chen
abstract: We study the fine-grained text-to-audio (T2A) generation task. While recent models can synthesize high-quality audio from text descriptions, they often lack precise control over attributes such as loudness, pitch, and sound events. Unlike prior approaches that retrain models for specific control types, we propose to train ControlNet models on top of pre-trained T2A backbones to achieve controllable generation over loudness, pitch, and event roll. We introduce two designs, T2A-ControlNet and T2A-Adapter, and show that the T2A-Adapter model offers a more efficient structure with strong control ability. With only 38M additional parameters, T2A-Adapter achieves state-of-the-art performance on the AudioSet-Strong in both event-level and segment-level F1 scores. We further extend this framework to audio editing, proposing T2A-Editor for removing and inserting audio events at time locations specified by instructions. Models, code, dataset pipelines, and benchmarks will be released to support future research on controllable audio generation and editing.

title: Let Experts Feel Uncertainty: A Multi-Expert Label Distribution Approach to Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
authors: Zhen Zhou, Zhirui Wang, Qi Hong, Yunyang Shi, Ziyuan Gu, Zhiyuan Liu
abstract: Time series forecasting in real-world applications requires both high predictive accuracy and interpretable uncertainty quantification. Traditional point prediction methods often fail to capture the inherent uncertainty in time series data, while existing probabilistic approaches struggle to balance computational efficiency with interpretability. We propose a novel Multi-Expert Learning Distributional Labels (LDL) framework that addresses these challenges through mixture-of-experts architectures with distributional learning capabilities. Our approach introduces two complementary methods: (1) Multi-Expert LDL, which employs multiple experts with different learned parameters to capture diverse temporal patterns, and (2) Pattern-Aware LDL-MoE, which explicitly decomposes time series into interpretable components (trend, seasonality, changepoints, volatility) through specialized sub-experts. Both frameworks extend traditional point prediction to distributional learning, enabling rich uncertainty quantification through Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD). We evaluate our methods on aggregated sales data derived from the M5 dataset, demonstrating superior performance compared to baseline approaches. The continuous Multi-Expert LDL achieves the best overall performance, while the Pattern-Aware LDL-MoE provides enhanced interpretability through component-wise analysis. Our frameworks successfully balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, making them suitable for real-world forecasting applications where both performance and actionable insights are crucial.

title: UniAudio 2.0: A Unified Audio Language Model with Text-Aligned Factorized Audio Tokenization
authors: Dongchao Yang, Yuanyuan Wang, Dading Chong, Songxiang Liu, Xixin Wu, Helen Meng
abstract: We study two foundational problems in audio language models: (1) how to design an audio tokenizer that can serve as an intermediate representation for both understanding and generation; and (2) how to build an audio foundation model that generalizes in few-shot and zero-shot settings, analogous to large language models. To this end, we make the following two contributions. First, we propose ReasoningCodec, a discrete audio codec that factorizes audio into (i) reasoning tokens, which encode text-aligned, high-level analysis and planning representations for audio understanding and hierarchical generation, and (ii) reconstruction tokens, which encode semantic-rich acoustic cues for high-fidelity waveform reconstruction. This design achieves understanding performance comparable to strong continuous representations while improving generation quality and reconstruction fidelity over prior discrete tokenizers. Second, we introduce a unified autoregressive architecture for text and audio, together with multi-stage training and multi-task data construction. Using this framework, we train UniAudio 2.0 on 100B text tokens and 60B audio tokens. Across a wide range of speech, sound, and music tasks, UniAudio 2.0 performs competitively on in-domain evaluations and demonstrates strong few-shot and zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks. Demo, code, and checkpoints will be available at \href{https://dongchaoyang.top/UniAudio2Demo/}{https://dongchaoyang.top/UniAudio2Demo/}.

title: Investigating Disability Representations in Text-to-Image Models
authors: Yang Yian, Yu Fan, Liudmila Zavolokina, Sarah Ebling
abstract: Text-to-image generative models have made remarkable progress in producing high-quality visual content from textual descriptions, yet concerns remain about how they represent social groups. While characteristics like gender and race have received increasing attention, disability representations remain underexplored. This study investigates how people with disabilities are represented in AI-generated images by analyzing outputs from Stable Diffusion XL and DALL-E 3 using a structured prompt design. We analyze disability representations by comparing image similarities between generic disability prompts and prompts referring to specific disability categories. Moreover, we evaluate how mitigation strategies influence disability portrayals, with a focus on assessing affective framing through sentiment polarity analysis, combining both automatic and human evaluation. Our findings reveal persistent representational imbalances and highlight the need for continuous evaluation and refinement of generative models to foster more diverse and inclusive portrayals of disability.

title: Multi-Source Retrieval and Reasoning for Legal Sentencing Prediction
authors: Junjie Chen, Haitao Li, Qilei Zhang, Zhenghua Li, Ya Zhang, Quan Zhou, Cheng Luo, Yiqun Liu, Dongsheng Guo, Qingyao Ai
abstract: Legal judgment prediction (LJP) aims to predict judicial outcomes from case facts and typically includes law article, charge, and sentencing prediction. While recent methods perform well on the first two subtasks, legal sentencing prediction (LSP) remains difficult due to its need for fine-grained objective knowledge and flexible subjective reasoning. To address these limitations, we propose $MSR^2$, a framework that integrates multi-source retrieval and reasoning in LLMs with reinforcement learning. $MSR^2$ enables LLMs to perform multi-source retrieval based on reasoning needs and applies a process-level reward to guide intermediate subjective reasoning steps. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that $MSR^2$ improves both accuracy and interpretability in LSP, providing a promising step toward practical legal AI. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MSR2-FC3B.

title: The Needle is a Thread: Finding Planted Paths in Noisy Process Trees
authors: Maya Le, Paweł Prałat, Aaron Smith, François Théberge
abstract: Motivated by applications in cybersecurity such as finding meaningful sequences of malware-related events buried inside large amounts of computer log data, we introduce the "planted path" problem and propose an algorithm to find fuzzy matchings between two trees. This algorithm can be used as a "building block" for more complicated workflows. We demonstrate usefulness of a few of such workflows in mining synthetically generated data as well as real-world ACME cybersecurity datasets.

title: Static and auto-regressive neural emulation of phytoplankton biomass dynamics from physical predictors in the global ocean
authors: Mahima Lakra, Ronan Fablet, Lucas Drumetz, Etienne Pauthenet, Elodie Martinez
abstract: Phytoplankton is the basis of marine food webs, driving both ecological processes and global biogeochemical cycles. Despite their ecological and climatic significance, accurately simulating phytoplankton dynamics remains a major challenge for biogeochemical numerical models due to limited parameterizations, sparse observational data, and the complexity of oceanic processes. Here, we explore how deep learning models can be used to address these limitations predicting the spatio-temporal distribution of phytoplankton biomass in the global ocean based on satellite observations and environmental conditions. First, we investigate several deep learning architectures. Among the tested models, the UNet architecture stands out for its ability to reproduce the seasonal and interannual patterns of phytoplankton biomass more accurately than other models like CNNs, ConvLSTM, and 4CastNet. When using one to two months of environmental data as input, UNet performs better, although it tends to underestimate the amplitude of low-frequency changes in phytoplankton biomass. Thus, to improve predictions over time, an auto-regressive version of UNet was also tested, where the model uses its own previous predictions to forecast future conditions. This approach works well for short-term forecasts (up to five months), though its performance decreases for longer time scales. Overall, our study shows that combining ocean physical predictors with deep learning allows for reconstruction and short-term prediction of phytoplankton dynamics. These models could become powerful tools for monitoring ocean health and supporting marine ecosystem management, especially in the context of climate change.

title: DRMOT: A Dataset and Framework for RGBD Referring Multi-Object Tracking
authors: Sijia Chen, Lijuan Ma, Yanqiu Yu, En Yu, Liman Liu, Wenbing Tao
abstract: Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT) aims to track specific targets based on language descriptions and is vital for interactive AI systems such as robotics and autonomous driving. However, existing RMOT models rely solely on 2D RGB data, making it challenging to accurately detect and associate targets characterized by complex spatial semantics (e.g., ``the person closest to the camera'') and to maintain reliable identities under severe occlusion, due to the absence of explicit 3D spatial information. In this work, we propose a novel task, RGBD Referring Multi-Object Tracking (DRMOT), which explicitly requires models to fuse RGB, Depth (D), and Language (L) modalities to achieve 3D-aware tracking. To advance research on the DRMOT task, we construct a tailored RGBD referring multi-object tracking dataset, named DRSet, designed to evaluate models' spatial-semantic grounding and tracking capabilities. Specifically, DRSet contains RGB images and depth maps from 187 scenes, along with 240 language descriptions, among which 56 descriptions incorporate depth-related information. Furthermore, we propose DRTrack, a MLLM-guided depth-referring tracking framework. DRTrack performs depth-aware target grounding from joint RGB-D-L inputs and enforces robust trajectory association by incorporating depth cues. Extensive experiments on the DRSet dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

title: LinGO: A Linguistic Graph Optimization Framework with LLMs for Interpreting Intents of Online Uncivil Discourse
authors: Yuan Zhang, Thales Bertaglia
abstract: Detecting uncivil language is crucial for maintaining safe, inclusive, and democratic online spaces. Yet existing classifiers often misinterpret posts containing uncivil cues but expressing civil intents, leading to inflated estimates of harmful incivility online. We introduce LinGO, a linguistic graph optimization framework for large language models (LLMs) that leverages linguistic structures and optimization techniques to classify multi-class intents of incivility that use various direct and indirect expressions. LinGO decomposes language into multi-step linguistic components, identifies targeted steps that cause the most errors, and iteratively optimizes prompt and/or example components for targeted steps. We evaluate it using a dataset collected during the 2022 Brazilian presidential election, encompassing four forms of political incivility: Impoliteness (IMP), Hate Speech and Stereotyping (HSST), Physical Harm and Violent Political Rhetoric (PHAVPR), and Threats to Democratic Institutions and Values (THREAT). Each instance is annotated with six types of civil/uncivil intent. We benchmark LinGO using three cost-efficient LLMs: GPT-5-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, and Claude 3 Haiku, and four optimization techniques: TextGrad, AdalFlow, DSPy, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The results show that, across all models, LinGO consistently improves accuracy and weighted F1 compared with zero-shot, chain-of-thought, direct optimization, and fine-tuning baselines. RAG is the strongest optimization technique and, when paired with Gemini model, achieves the best overall performance. These findings demonstrate that incorporating multi-step linguistic components into LLM instructions and optimize targeted components can help the models explain complex semantic meanings, which can be extended to other complex semantic explanation tasks in the future.

title: Fine-Grained Frame Modeling in Multi-head Self-Attention for Speech Deepfake Detection
authors: Tuan Dat Phuong, Duc-Tuan Truong, Long-Vu Hoang, Trang Nguyen Thi Thu
abstract: Transformer-based models have shown strong performance in speech deepfake detection, largely due to the effectiveness of the multi-head self-attention (MHSA) mechanism. MHSA provides frame-level attention scores, which are particularly valuable because deepfake artifacts often occur in small, localized regions along the temporal dimension of speech. This makes fine-grained frame modeling essential for accurately detecting subtle spoofing cues. In this work, we propose fine-grained frame modeling (FGFM) for MHSA-based speech deepfake detection, where the most informative frames are first selected through a multi-head voting (MHV) module. These selected frames are then refined via a cross-layer refinement (CLR) module to enhance the model's ability to learn subtle spoofing cues. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the baseline model and achieves Equal Error Rate (EER) of 0.90%, 1.88%, and 6.64% on the LA21, DF21, and ITW datasets, respectively. These consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks highlight the effectiveness of our fine-grained modeling for robust speech deepfake detection.

title: Annotation Free Spacecraft Detection and Segmentation using Vision Language Models
authors: Samet Hicsonmez, Jose Sosa, Dan Pineau, Inder Pal Singh, Arunkumar Rathinam, Abd El Rahman Shabayek, Djamila Aouada
abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in open-world zero-shot visual recognition. However, their potential in space-related applications remains largely unexplored. In the space domain, accurate manual annotation is particularly challenging due to factors such as low visibility, illumination variations, and object blending with planetary backgrounds. Developing methods that can detect and segment spacecraft and orbital targets without requiring extensive manual labeling is therefore of critical importance. In this work, we propose an annotation-free detection and segmentation pipeline for space targets using VLMs. Our approach begins by automatically generating pseudo-labels for a small subset of unlabeled real data with a pre-trained VLM. These pseudo-labels are then leveraged in a teacher-student label distillation framework to train lightweight models. Despite the inherent noise in the pseudo-labels, the distillation process leads to substantial performance gains over direct zero-shot VLM inference. Experimental evaluations on the SPARK-2024, SPEED+, and TANGO datasets on segmentation tasks demonstrate consistent improvements in average precision (AP) by up to 10 points. Code and models are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/annotation-free-spacecraft-segmentation.

title: A TEE-based Approach for Preserving Data Secrecy in Process Mining with Decentralized Sources
authors: Davide Basile, Valerio Goretti, Luca Barbaro, Hajo A. Reijers, Claudio Di Ciccio
abstract: Process mining techniques enable organizations to gain insights into their business processes through the analysis of execution records (event logs) stored by information systems. While most process mining efforts focus on intra-organizational scenarios, many real-world business processes span multiple independent organizations. Inter-organizational process mining, though, faces significant challenges, particularly regarding confidentiality guarantees: The analysis of data can reveal information that the participating organizations may not consent to disclose to one another, or to a third party hosting process mining services. To overcome this issue, this paper presents CONFINE, an approach for secrecy-preserving inter-organizational process mining. CONFINE leverages Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to deploy trusted applications that are capable of securely mining multi-party event logs while preserving data secrecy. We propose an architecture supporting a four-stage protocol to secure data exchange and processing, allowing for protected transfer and aggregation of unaltered process data across organizational boundaries. To avoid out-of-memory errors due to the limited capacity of TEEs, our protocol employs a segmentation-based strategy, whereby event logs are transmitted to TEEs in smaller batches. We conduct a formal verification of correctness and a security analysis of the guarantees provided by the TEE core. We evaluate our implementation on real-world and synthetic data, showing that the proposed approach can handle realistic workloads. The results indicate logarithmic memory growth with respect to the event log size and linear growth with the number of provisioning organizations, highlighting scalability properties and opportunities for further optimization.
