title: ATLAS : Adaptive Self-Evolutionary Research Agent with Task-Distributed Multi-LLM Supporters
authors: Ujin Jeon, Jiyong Kwon, Madison Ann Sullivan, Caleb Eunho Lee, Guang Lin
abstract: Recent multi-LLM agent systems perform well in prompt optimization and automated problem-solving, but many either keep the solver frozen after fine-tuning or rely on a static preference-optimization loop, which becomes intractable for long-horizon tasks. We propose ATLAS (Adaptive Task-distributed Learning for Agentic Self-evolution), a task-distributed framework that iteratively develops a lightweight research agent while delegating complementary roles to specialized supporter agents for exploration, hyperparameter tuning, and reference policy management. Our core algorithm, Evolving Direct Preference Optimization (EvoDPO), adaptively updates the phase-indexed reference policy. We provide a theoretical regret analysis for a preference-based contextual bandit under concept drift. In addition, experiments were conducted on non-stationary linear contextual bandits and scientific machine learning (SciML) loss reweighting for the 1D Burgers' equation. Both results show that ATLAS improves stability and performance over a static single-agent baseline.
zh_title: ATLAS：具有任务分布式多LLM支持者的自适应自进化研究代理
translation: 最近的多LLM代理系统在提示优化和自动化问题解决方面表现良好，但许多系统要么在微调后保持解算器冻结，要么依赖静态的偏好优化循环，这对于长时程任务来说变得难以处理。我们提出了ATLAS（Agentic Self-evolution的自适应任务分布式学习），这是一个任务分布式框架，它迭代地开发一个轻量级研究代理，同时将互补角色委托给专业的支持者代理，用于探索、超参数调整和参考策略管理。我们的核心算法，进化直接偏好优化（EvoDPO），自适应地更新阶段索引的参考策略。我们为概念漂移下基于偏好的上下文赌博机提供了理论遗憾分析。此外，还在非平稳线性上下文赌博机和用于1D Burgers方程的科学机器学习（SciML）损失重新加权上进行了实验。两项结果都表明，ATLAS在稳定性和性能上优于静态的单代理基线。
tldr: 针对长时程任务中现有LLM代理系统僵化的缺陷，本文提出了ATLAS，这是一个任务分布式多LLM框架，它使用核心算法EvoDPO来自适应地进化一个轻量级研究代理，并通过实验证明了其在稳定性和性能上的提升。
ai_comments: ATLAS的创新点在于其任务分布式的多LLM结构和核心的EvoDPO算法，有效地将长时程任务的复杂性分解并分配给专业化的支持者代理。这种自进化的设计克服了传统LLM代理系统在微调后策略僵化的局限性，使其能够适应非平稳环境和概念漂移，这对于现实世界中的复杂、持续学习任务至关重要。将理论分析（概念漂移下的遗憾分析）与实际应用（SciML）结合，增强了该方法的可靠性和通用性。
motivation: 现有的多LLM代理系统在微调后往往保持解算器冻结或依赖静态的偏好优化循环，这对于长时程任务来说变得难以处理。
method: 提出了ATLAS（Agentic Self-evolution的自适应任务分布式学习），这是一个任务分布式框架，它迭代地开发一个轻量级研究代理，同时将互补角色（探索、超参数调整、参考策略管理）委托给专业的支持者代理。核心算法是进化直接偏好优化（EvoDPO），它自适应地更新阶段索引的参考策略。此外，还提供了在概念漂移下基于偏好的上下文赌博机的理论遗憾分析。
results: 在非平稳线性上下文赌博机和用于1D Burgers方程的科学机器学习（SciML）损失重新加权上的实验表明，ATLAS在稳定性和性能上优于静态的单代理基线。
conclusion: ATLAS框架通过其自适应的、任务分布式的方法，有效解决了现有单智能体系统在长时程任务中的局限性，显著提高了稳定性和性能。

title: BinaryPPO: Efficient Policy Optimization for Binary Classification
authors: Punya Syon Pandey, Zhijing Jin
abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for binary classification tasks such as toxicity detection, factuality verification, and causal inference. However, SFT often performs poorly in real-world settings with label noise, class imbalance, or sparse supervision. We introduce BinaryPPO, an offline reinforcement learning large language model (LLM) framework that reformulates binary classification as a reward maximization problem. Our method leverages a variant of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with a confidence-weighted reward function that penalizes uncertain or incorrect predictions, enabling the model to learn robust decision policies from static datasets without online interaction. Across eight domain-specific benchmarks and multiple models with differing architectures, BinaryPPO improves accuracy by 40-60 percentage points, reaching up to 99%, substantially outperforming supervised baselines. We provide an in-depth analysis of the role of reward shaping, advantage scaling, and policy stability in enabling this improvement. Overall, we demonstrate that confidence-based reward design provides a robust alternative to SFT for binary classification. Our code is available at https://github.com/psyonp/BinaryPPO.
zh_title: BinaryPPO：高效的二元分类策略优化
translation: 监督微调（SFT）是毒性检测、事实核查和因果推断等二元分类任务的标准方法。然而，SFT在具有标签噪声、类别不平衡或稀疏监督的真实世界设置中通常表现不佳。我们引入了BinaryPPO，一个离线强化学习大型语言模型（LLM）框架，它将二元分类重新表述为一个奖励最大化问题。我们的方法利用了近端策略优化（PPO）的一个变体，并结合了一个置信度加权的奖励函数，该函数惩罚不确定或不正确的预测，使模型能够从静态数据集中学习鲁棒的决策策略，而无需在线交互。在八个特定领域基准测试和多个不同架构的模型上，BinaryPPO的准确率提高了40-60个百分点，最高达到99%，大大优于监督基线。我们深入分析了奖励塑造、优势缩放和策略稳定性在实现这一改进中的作用。总而言之，我们证明了基于置信度的奖励设计为二元分类提供了一种比SFT更鲁棒的替代方案。我们的代码可在https://github.com/psyonp/BinaryPPO获取。
tldr: 针对毒性检测等二元分类任务，本文提出基于PPO的离线强化学习框架BinaryPPO。它使用置信度加权奖励来惩罚不确定预测，从而在有噪声数据上学习鲁棒策略，准确率比传统监督方法提升了40-60个百分点。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将传统的二元分类任务（通常使用SFT）重新构建为离线强化学习（RL）问题。通过引入“置信度加权的奖励函数”，BinaryPPO解决了SFT在现实世界中面临的标签噪声和类别不平衡问题。这种方法有效利用了PPO的策略优化能力，显著提升了模型在鲁棒性方面的性能。高达40-60个百分点的准确率提升是一个极具说服力的结果，为解决传统监督学习在低质量数据上的局限性提供了一个强大的RL范式。
motivation: 传统的监督微调（SFT）是二元分类的标准方法，但在存在标签噪声、类别不平衡或稀疏监督的真实世界设置中，SFT通常表现不佳。因此需要一种更高效、更鲁邦的策略优化方法。
method: 提出BinaryPPO，一个离线强化学习大型语言模型（LLM）框架，将二元分类重构为奖励最大化问题。该方法利用了近端策略优化（PPO）的一个变体，并结合了一个置信度加权的奖励函数，该函数惩罚不确定或不正确的预测，从而在不进行在线交互的情况下，从静态数据集中学习鲁棒的决策策略。
results: 在八个特定领域基准测试和多个不同架构的模型上，BinaryPPO的准确率提高了40-60个百分点，最高达到99%，显著优于监督基线。研究还深入分析了奖励塑造、优势缩放和策略稳定性在改进中的作用。
conclusion: 基于置信度的奖励设计为二元分类任务提供了一种比监督微调（SFT）更鲁棒的替代方案。

title: Every Bit Counts: A Theoretical Study of Precision-Expressivity Tradeoffs in Quantized Transformers
authors: Sayak Chakrabarti, Toniann Pitassi, Josh Alman
abstract:
Quantization reduces the numerical precision of Transformer computations and is widely used to accelerate inference, yet its effect on expressivity remains poorly characterized. We demonstrate a fine-grained theoretical tradeoff between expressivity and precision: For every p we exhibit a function Γ, inspired by the equality function, and prove that a one-layer softmax Transformer can compute Γ, with p bits of precision, but not with p-1 bits of precision.
  This result concretely explains the widely observed phenomenon of empirical loss of expressivity when quantization is used. Practically, it suggests that tasks requiring equality-like comparisons (exact match, membership, etc.) are especially sensitive to quantization. Dropping even one bit can cross a threshold where the model cannot represent the needed comparison reliably. Thus, it paves the way for developing heuristics that will help practitioners choose how much quantization is possible: the precision should be chosen as a function of the length of equality to be checked for the specific task.
  Our proofs combine explicit finite-precision Transformer constructions with communication-complexity lower bounds, yielding a tight "one-bit" threshold.
zh_title: 每一位都很重要：量化Transformer中精度-表达能力权衡的理论研究
translation: 量化降低了Transformer计算的数值精度，并被广泛用于加速推理，但其对表达能力的影响仍缺乏清晰的表征。我们证明了表达能力和精度之间存在一种细粒度的理论权衡：对于每一个 $p$，我们展示了一个受相等函数启发的函数 $\Gamma$，并证明一个单层softmax Transformer可以使用 $p$ 位精度计算 $\Gamma$，但使用 $p-1$ 位精度则不能。这一结果具体解释了在采用量化时普遍观察到的经验性表达能力损失现象。在实践中，它表明需要进行类似相等性比较（精确匹配、成员资格等）的任务对量化特别敏感。即使只减少一位精度，也可能跨越一个阈值，导致模型无法可靠地表示所需的比较。因此，这为开发启发式方法铺平了道路，有助于实践者选择可行的量化程度：应根据特定任务中需要检查的相等性的长度来选择精度。我们的证明结合了显式的有限精度Transformer结构构建与通信复杂度下界，从而得出了一个紧密的“一位”阈值。
tldr: 本文理论证明了量化Transformer中精度和表达能力之间存在精细的权衡：对于一个受相等函数启发的特定函数，单层Transformer需要精确的 $p$ 位精度才能计算它，而 $p-1$ 位则不行。这解释了量化导致的表达能力损失，并建议根据任务所需的“相等性”检查长度来选择量化精度。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新性在于它首次提供了一个具体的、理论上紧密的“一位”阈值来量化精度对Transformer表达能力的影响。通过引入一个类似相等性的函数 $\Gamma$，作者成功地将抽象的“表达能力损失”与具体的数值精度（$p$ 位 vs. $p-1$ 位）联系起来。这一理论突破不仅解释了量化实践中经常观察到的性能下降现象，而且具有重要的实践指导意义，因为它建议了基于任务特性（即需要检查的相等性长度）来设定量化级别的启发式方法。这是一个将复杂工程问题（量化）与基础计算理论（通信复杂度）相结合的典范。
motivation: 量化技术被广泛用于加速Transformer的推理过程，但其对模型表达能力的影响尚未得到充分的理论表征。本文旨在理论上阐明量化（即降低数值精度）与Transformer表达能力之间的精细权衡关系。
method: 结合了显式的有限精度Transformer结构构建（explicit finite-precision Transformer constructions）与通信复杂度下界（communication-complexity lower bounds），从而得出了一个紧密的“一位”阈值。
results: 证明了精度与表达能力之间存在细粒度的理论权衡。具体来说，对于一个受相等函数（equality function）启发的函数 $\Gamma$，一个单层softmax Transformer可以使用 $p$ 位精度计算它，但使用 $p-1$ 位精度则无法计算。这具体解释了量化导致的经验性表达能力损失现象。
conclusion: 任务中涉及类似相等性比较（如精确匹配、成员资格等）的操作对量化特别敏感。实践中，量化精度应根据特定任务中需要检查的“相等性”的长度来选择，以避免模型失去可靠表示所需比较的能力。

title: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
authors: Fahim Tajwar, Guanning Zeng, Yueer Zhou, Yuda Song, Daman Arora, Yiding Jiang, Jeff Schneider, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Haiwen Feng, Andrea Zanette
abstract: Reinforcement learning is the method of choice to train models in sampling-based setups with binary outcome feedback, such as navigation, code generation, and mathematical problem solving. In such settings, models implicitly induce a likelihood over correct rollouts. However, we observe that reinforcement learning does not maximize this likelihood, and instead optimizes only a lower-order approximation. Inspired by this observation, we introduce Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL), a sampling-based framework to approximate maximum likelihood using reinforcement learning techniques. MaxRL addresses the challenges of non-differentiable sampling by defining a compute-indexed family of sample-based objectives that interpolate between standard reinforcement learning and exact maximum likelihood as additional sampling compute is allocated. The resulting objectives admit a simple, unbiased policy-gradient estimator and converge to maximum likelihood optimization in the infinite-compute limit. Empirically, we show that MaxRL Pareto-dominates existing methods in all models and tasks we tested, achieving up to 20x test-time scaling efficiency gains compared to its GRPO-trained counterpart. We also observe MaxRL to scale better with additional data and compute. Our results suggest MaxRL is a promising framework for scaling RL training in correctness based settings.
translation: 强化学习是在基于采样的、具有二元结果反馈的设置中（例如导航、代码生成和数学问题求解）训练模型的首选方法。在此类设置中，模型隐式地诱导了一个关于正确执行路径（rollouts）的似然。然而，我们观察到强化学习并没有最大化这个似然，而是只优化了一个低阶近似。受此观察启发，我们引入了最大似然强化学习（MaxRL），这是一个基于采样的框架，旨在使用强化学习技术来近似最大似然。MaxRL通过定义一个计算索引（compute-indexed）的样本基础目标函数族来解决不可微分采样带来的挑战，该函数族随着额外采样计算量的分配，在标准强化学习和精确最大似然之间进行插值。由此产生的目标函数允许使用一个简单、无偏的策略梯度估计器，并在无限计算的限制下收敛到最大似然优化。从经验上看，我们表明MaxRL在我们测试的所有模型和任务中均帕累托支配现有方法，相较于其经过GRPO训练的对应方法，实现了高达20倍的测试时扩展效率提升。我们还观察到MaxRL能够更好地随着额外数据和计算量的增加而扩展。我们的结果表明，MaxRL是在基于正确性的设置中扩展强化学习训练的一个有前景的框架。
tldr: 现有的强化学习方法无法最大化正确结果的似然。本文提出了最大似然强化学习（MaxRL），它通过定义一系列目标函数来近似最大似然，这些目标函数使用简单、无偏的策略梯度估计器，并在我们测试的所有任务中表现优于现有方法，最高实现了20倍的训练效率提升。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于明确指出标准强化学习（RL）在二元反馈任务中仅优化了正确执行路径似然的低阶近似，并提出了MaxRL框架来直接逼近最大似然。通过引入“计算索引”（compute-indexed）的目标函数族，MaxRL巧妙地桥接了RL的策略梯度方法和直接的最大似然优化，同时解决了不可微分采样的关键挑战。其经验结果，特别是高达20倍的测试时效率提升，凸显了该方法的重要性，表明在注重正确性的任务（如代码或数学求解）中，更精确地对似然进行建模比传统的RL回报优化可能更有效。该方法似乎主要应用于具有明确“正确/错误”二元结果的设置，其在更复杂的、具有稀疏或连续奖励环境中的适用性是值得进一步探索的潜在限制。
motivation: 强化学习在基于采样的、具有二元结果反馈的设置中（如导航、代码生成、数学问题求解）被广泛使用。然而，作者观察到标准的强化学习并没有最大化模型隐含的正确结果的似然，而只是优化了一个低阶近似。
method: 引入了最大似然强化学习（MaxRL），这是一个基于采样的框架，用于使用强化学习技术近似最大似然。MaxRL通过定义一个“计算索引”（compute-indexed）的样本基础目标函数族来解决不可微分采样问题，该函数族随着分配的额外采样计算量，在标准强化学习和精确最大似然之间进行插值。由此产生的目标函数允许使用一个简单、无偏的策略梯度估计器，并在无限计算的限制下收敛到最大似然优化。
results: 在所有测试的模型和任务中，MaxRL均帕累托支配（Pareto-dominates）现有方法，相较于其经过GRPO训练的对应方法，实现了高达20倍的测试时扩展效率提升。MaxRL还被观察到能更好地随着额外数据和计算量的增加而扩展。
conclusion: MaxRL是一个有前景的框架，可用于在基于正确性（correctness based）的设置中扩展强化学习训练。

title: Towards Understanding Steering Strength
authors: Magamed Taimeskhanov, Samuel Vaiter, Damien Garreau
abstract: A popular approach to post-training control of large language models (LLMs) is the steering of intermediate latent representations. Namely, identify a well-chosen direction depending on the task at hand and perturbs representations along this direction at inference time. While many propositions exist to pick this direction, considerably less is understood about how to choose the magnitude of the move, whereas its importance is clear: too little and the intended behavior does not emerge, too much and the model's performance degrades beyond repair. In this work, we propose the first theoretical analysis of steering strength. We characterize its effect on next token probability, presence of a concept, and cross-entropy, deriving precise qualitative laws governing these quantities. Our analysis reveals surprising behaviors, including non-monotonic effects of steering strength. We validate our theoretical predictions empirically on eleven language models, ranging from a small GPT architecture to modern models.
translation: 一种流行的后训练控制大型语言模型（LLMs）的方法是操纵中间潜在表示。具体来说，根据手头的任务确定一个精心选择的方向，并在推理时沿着该方向扰动表示。尽管存在许多选择此方向的建议，但对于如何选择移动的幅度（即转向强度）却知之甚少，而其重要性是显而易见的：太小，预期行为不会出现；太大，模型的性能会受到不可逆转的损害。在这项工作中，我们提出了首次对转向强度的理论分析。我们刻画了它对下一词元概率、概念存在性和交叉熵的影响，推导出了控制这些量的精确定性规律。我们的分析揭示了令人惊讶的行为，包括转向强度的非单调效应。我们在11个语言模型上（范围从小型的GPT架构到现代模型）通过经验验证了我们的理论预测。
tldr: 本文首次对大型语言模型（LLMs）后训练控制中至关重要的“转向强度”进行了理论分析，揭示了其对词元概率、概念存在性和交叉熵的影响，并发现了非单调效应，且在11个模型上进行了验证。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于它是首次对LLM潜在表示“转向强度”这一关键超参数进行系统且深入的理论分析。在现有工作主要集中于寻找最优转向方向的背景下，理解强度的选择机制是实际应用中的一个主要瓶颈。揭示非单调效应尤其重要，这意味着简单的线性调整策略可能不足以优化模型行为，为未来更精细的LLM控制方法奠定了理论基础。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的后训练控制常用方法是操纵中间潜在表示。现有研究多关注选择“转向方向”，但对于如何选择“转向强度”（即移动幅度）知之甚少，尽管其重要性显而易见：强度太小，预期行为不出现；强度太大，模型性能会严重下降。
method: 提出了首次对转向强度的理论分析。具体方法是刻画转向强度对下一词元概率、概念存在性和交叉熵的影响，并推导出控制这些量的精确定性规律。理论预测随后在11个语言模型（包括小型GPT架构和现代模型）上进行了经验验证。
results: 理论分析揭示了令人惊讶的行为，包括转向强度的非单调效应。

title: Neural Probabilistic Amplitude Shaping for Nonlinear Fiber Channels
authors: Mohammad Taha Askari, Lutz Lampe, Amirhossein Ghazisaeidi
abstract: We introduce neural probabilistic amplitude shaping, a joint-distribution learning framework for coherent fiber systems. The proposed scheme provides a 0.5 dB signal-to-noise ratio gain over sequence selection for dual-polarized 64-QAM transmission across a single-span 205 km link.
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures, Submitted to Optical Fiber Communication Conference (OFC) 2026
zh_title: 用于非线性光纤信道的神经概率幅度整形
translation: 我们引入了神经概率幅度整形，这是一种用于相干光纤系统的联合分布学习框架。所提出的方案在单跨度205公里链路上的双极化64-QAM传输中，比序列选择方案提供了0.5 dB的信噪比增益。
tldr: 提出了一种用于相干光纤系统的神经概率幅度整形框架，在205公里双极化64-QAM传输中实现了0.5 dB的信噪比增益。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新在于将神经网络应用于概率幅度整形，形成了一个联合分布学习框架，以优化非线性光纤信道。0.5 dB的信噪比增益在光通信领域是重要的性能提升，表明了该方法在提高相干光纤系统效率方面的潜力。然而，摘要只展示了特定传输场景（205公里、双极化64-QAM）下的结果，其在更长距离或不同调制格式下的性能尚待进一步评估。
motivation: 旨在为相干光纤系统引入一种新的联合分布学习框架，以提高传输性能。
method: 提出了神经概率幅度整形（Neural Probabilistic Amplitude Shaping），这是一种用于相干光纤系统的联合分布学习框架。
results: 在单跨度205公里链路上的双极化64-QAM传输中，该方案比序列选择方案获得了0.5 dB的信噪比增益。
conclusion: 神经概率幅度整形是一种有效的技术，能够通过联合分布学习显著提升非线性光纤信道的性能。

title: Dynamic Mix Precision Routing for Efficient Multi-step LLM Interaction
authors: Yuanzhe Li, Jianing Deng, Jingtong Hu, Tianlong Chen, Song Wang, Huanrui Yang
abstract: Large language models (LLM) achieve strong performance in long-horizon decision-making tasks through multi-step interaction and reasoning at test time. While practitioners commonly believe a higher task success rate necessitates the use of a larger and stronger LLM model, multi-step interaction with a large LLM incurs prohibitive inference cost. To address this problem, we explore the use of low-precision quantized LLM in the long-horizon decision-making process. Based on the observation of diverse sensitivities among interaction steps, we propose a dynamic mix-precision routing framework that adaptively selects between high-precision and low-precision LLMs at each decision step. The router is trained via a two-stage pipeline, consisting of KL-divergence-based supervised learning that identifies precision-sensitive steps, followed by Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to further improve task success rates. Experiments on ALFWorld demonstrate that our approach achieves a great improvement on accuracy-cost trade-off over single-precision baselines and heuristic routing methods.
zh_title: 动态混合精度路由用于高效多步LLM交互
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过在测试时的多步交互和推理，在长周期决策任务中取得了强大的性能。尽管从业者通常认为更高的任务成功率需要使用更大、更强的LLM模型，但与大型LLM的多步交互会产生高昂的推理成本。为了解决这个问题，我们探索了在长周期决策过程中使用低精度量化LLM的方法。基于对交互步骤之间存在不同敏感性的观察，我们提出了一种动态混合精度路由框架，该框架在每个决策步骤自适应地在高精度和低精度LLM之间进行选择。该路由器通过一个两阶段管道进行训练，包括基于KL散度的监督学习来识别精度敏感步骤，随后是群组相对策略优化（GRPO）以进一步提高任务成功率。在ALFWorld上的实验表明，我们的方法在准确率-成本权衡方面比单精度基线和启发式路由方法取得了巨大的改进。
tldr: 为解决多步LLM决策任务中大型模型推理成本过高的问题，本文提出了一种动态混合精度路由框架，它能根据每一步的敏感性自适应地选择高精度或低精度LLM，显著改善了准确率和成本的权衡。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于认识到多步决策过程中的步骤并非对精度同等敏感，并据此设计了一个动态路由机制，实现了计算效率和性能的精细平衡。这种方法对于实际部署需要进行复杂、长序列推理的LLM应用具有重要意义，因为它能有效降低运营成本，同时保持高水平的决策成功率。两阶段训练管道（特别是引入GRPO）是确保路由决策有效性的关键。
motivation: LLM在长周期决策任务中表现出色，但多步交互中持续使用大型LLM会导致过高的推理成本。
method: 提出了一个动态混合精度路由框架，它基于交互步骤的敏感性差异，在每个决策步骤自适应地选择高精度或低精度LLM。该路由器通过两阶段管道训练：首先是基于KL散度的监督学习来识别精度敏感步骤，然后是群组相对策略优化（GRPO）来提高任务成功率。
results: 在ALFWorld上的实验证明，该方法在准确率-成本权衡方面比单精度基线和启发式路由方法有显著改善。

title: On the Feasibility of Hybrid Homomorphic Encryption for Intelligent Transportation Systems
authors: Kyle Yates, Abdullah Al Mamun, Mashrur Chowdhury
abstract: Many Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) applications require strong privacy guarantees for both users and their data. Homomorphic encryption (HE) enables computation directly on encrypted messages and thus offers a compelling approach to privacy-preserving data processing in ITS. However, practical HE schemes incur substantial ciphertext expansion and communication overhead, which limits their suitability for time-critical transportation systems. Hybrid homomorphic encryption (HHE) addresses this challenge by combining a homomorphic encryption scheme with a symmetric cipher, enabling efficient encrypted computation while dramatically reducing communication cost. In this paper, we develop theoretical models of representative ITS applications that integrate HHE to protect sensitive vehicular data. We then perform a parameter-based evaluation of the HHE scheme Rubato to estimate ciphertext sizes and communication overhead under realistic ITS workloads. Our results show that HHE achieves orders-of-magnitude reductions in ciphertext size compared with conventional HE while maintaining cryptographic security, making it significantly more practical for latency-constrained ITS communication.
comment: This version has been submitted to a peer-reviewed journal and is currently under review
zh_title: 混合同态加密在智能交通系统中的可行性研究
translation: 许多智能交通系统（ITS）应用需要对用户及其数据提供强大的隐私保障。同态加密（HE）可以直接在加密消息上进行计算，因此为ITS中的隐私保护数据处理提供了一种引人注目的方法。然而，实用的HE方案会产生大量的密文膨胀和通信开销，这限制了它们在时间关键型交通系统中的适用性。混合同态加密（HHE）通过将同态加密方案与对称密码相结合来解决这一挑战，从而实现高效的加密计算，同时显著降低通信成本。在本文中，我们开发了集成HHE以保护敏感车辆数据的代表性ITS应用的理论模型。然后，我们对HHE方案Rubato进行基于参数的评估，以在实际的ITS工作负载下估计密文大小和通信开销。我们的结果表明，与传统HE相比，HHE在保持加密安全性的同时，实现了密文大小的数量级减少，使其对于延迟受限的ITS通信更加实用。
tldr: 传统同态加密（HE）的密文太大，不适用于时间敏感的智能交通系统（ITS）。混合同态加密（HHE）能大幅减少密文大小，使其成为ITS中隐私保护计算的实用方案。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将混合同态加密（HHE）应用于对延迟要求极高的智能交通系统（ITS），有效解决了传统同态加密（HE）在实际应用中密文膨胀和通信开销过大的瓶颈问题。通过理论建模和对Rubato方案的参数评估，研究证明了HHE能够提供一个在保护数据隐私的同时，满足时间关键型ITS通信需求的实用性解决方案，对于推动HE技术在边缘计算和物联网领域的落地具有重要意义。
motivation: 许多智能交通系统（ITS）应用需要对用户及其数据提供强大的隐私保障。传统的同态加密（HE）方案虽然能实现隐私保护计算，但存在密文膨胀大和通信开销高的问题，限制了其在时间敏感型ITS中的应用。
method: 提出并应用混合同态加密（HHE），该方案结合了同态加密和对称密码，旨在降低通信成本。通过建立集成HHE的代表性ITS应用的理论模型，并对特定的HHE方案Rubato进行基于参数的评估，以估计其在实际ITS工作负载下的密文大小和通信开销。
results: 混合同态加密（HHE）在保持加密安全性的同时，与传统HE相比，密文大小实现了数量级的减少。这使得HHE对于延迟受限的ITS通信更加实用。
conclusion: 混合同态加密（HHE）通过显著减少密文大小和通信开销，证明了其在延迟受限的智能交通系统中进行隐私保护数据处理的可行性和实用性。

title: Composition for Pufferfish Privacy
authors: Jiamu Bai, Guanlin He, Xin Gu, Daniel Kifer, Kiwan Maeng
abstract: When creating public data products out of confidential datasets, inferential/posterior-based privacy definitions, such as Pufferfish, provide compelling privacy semantics for data with correlations. However, such privacy definitions are rarely used in practice because they do not always compose. For example, it is possible to design algorithms for these privacy definitions that have no leakage when run once but reveal the entire dataset when run more than once. We prove necessary and sufficient conditions that must be added to ensure linear composition for Pufferfish mechanisms, hence avoiding such privacy collapse. These extra conditions turn out to be differential privacy-style inequalities, indicating that achieving both the interpretable semantics of Pufferfish for correlated data and composition benefits requires adopting differentially private mechanisms to Pufferfish. We show that such translation is possible through a concept called the $(a,b)$-influence curve, and many existing differentially private algorithms can be translated with our framework into a composable Pufferfish algorithm. We illustrate the benefit of our new framework by designing composable Pufferfish algorithms for Markov chains that significantly outperform prior work.
translation: 当从机密数据集中创建公共数据产品时，鲂鱼（Pufferfish）等基于推断/后验的隐私定义为具有相关性的数据提供了引人注目的隐私语义。然而，由于这些隐私定义不总是可组合的，因此在实践中很少使用。例如，可以为这些隐私定义设计算法，这些算法在运行一次时没有泄露，但在多次运行时会泄露整个数据集。我们证明了确保鲂鱼机制线性组合性的必要和充分条件，从而避免了这种隐私崩溃。这些额外条件结果是差分隐私风格的不等式，表明要同时实现鲂鱼对相关数据可解释的语义和组合性优势，需要将差分隐私机制应用于鲂鱼。我们通过一个名为$(a,b)$-影响曲线的概念表明这种转换是可能的，并且许多现有的差分隐私算法可以通过我们的框架转换为可组合的鲂鱼算法。我们通过为马尔可夫链设计可组合的鲂鱼算法来展示我们新框架的优势，这些算法显著优于现有工作。
tldr: Pufferfish隐私定义在处理相关数据时很有用，但缺乏组合性。本文证明了确保其线性组合性的必要和充分条件，这些条件类似于差分隐私，并通过引入$(a,b)$-影响曲线，使得可以将差分隐私机制转化为可组合的Pufferfish算法，并应用于马尔可夫链，效果显著。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于解决了鲂鱼隐私定义在实际应用中的一个关键障碍——组合性问题。通过将差分隐私的理念引入鲂鱼隐私，并提出$(a,b)$-影响曲线的概念，为处理相关数据隐私提供了一个新的、实用的框架。其重要性在于使得鲂鱼隐私的优势能够更好地在多轮交互或多产品发布场景中发挥作用，避免了隐私泄露的风险。
motivation: 鲂鱼（Pufferfish）等基于推断/后验的隐私定义虽然为相关数据提供了引人注目的隐私语义，但由于它们不总是可组合的，因此在实践中很少使用。例如，为这些隐私定义设计的算法在运行一次时可能没有泄露，但在多次运行时会泄露整个数据集，导致隐私崩溃。
method: 本文证明了确保鲂鱼机制线性组合性的必要和充分条件，以避免隐私崩溃。这些额外条件表现为差分隐私风格的不等式，表明需要将差分隐私机制应用于鲂鱼隐私。通过引入一个名为$(a,b)$-影响曲线的概念，展示了这种转换是可能的。
results: 证明了确保鲂鱼机制线性组合性的必要和充分条件，这些条件是差分隐私风格的不等式。开发了一个框架，通过$(a,b)$-影响曲线将许多现有的差分隐私算法转换为可组合的鲂鱼算法。设计了用于马尔可夫链的可组合鲂鱼算法，其性能显著优于现有工作。
conclusion: 本文提出的框架通过引入差分隐私风格的条件和$(a,b)$-影响曲线，成功解决了鲂鱼隐私的组合性问题，使得在享受鲂鱼隐私语义的同时，能够利用差分隐私的组合性优势，并在实际应用中取得了显著改进。

title: End-to-end reconstruction of OCT optical properties and speckle-reduced structural intensity via physics-based learning
authors: Jinglun Yu, Yaning Wang, Wenhan Guo, Yuan Gao, Yu Sun, Jin U. Kang
abstract: Inverse scattering in optical coherence tomography (OCT) seeks to recover both structural images and intrinsic tissue optical properties, including refractive index, scattering coefficient, and anisotropy. This inverse problem is challenging due to attenuation, speckle noise, and strong coupling among parameters. We propose a regularized end-to-end deep learning framework that jointly reconstructs optical parameter maps and speckle-reduced OCT structural intensity for layer visualization. Trained with Monte Carlo-simulated ground truth, our network incorporates a physics-based OCT forward model that generates predicted signals from the estimated parameters, providing physics-consistent supervision for parameter recovery and artifact suppression. Experiments on the synthetic corneal OCT dataset demonstrate robust optical map recovery under noise, improved resolution, and enhanced structural fidelity. This approach enables quantitative multi-parameter tissue characterization and highlights the benefit of combining physics-informed modeling with deep learning for computational OCT.
zh_title: 基于物理学习的OCT光学特性和散斑抑制结构强度的端到端重建
translation: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）中的逆散射旨在恢复结构图像和内在组织光学特性，包括折射率、散射系数和各向异性。由于衰减、散斑噪声和参数间的强耦合，这个逆问题极具挑战性。我们提出了一种正则化的端到端深度学习框架，用于联合重建光学参数图和用于分层可视化的散斑抑制OCT结构强度。该网络使用蒙特卡洛模拟的真实数据进行训练，并结合了基于物理的OCT前向模型，该模型从估计的参数中生成预测信号，为参数恢复和伪影抑制提供了物理一致性的监督。在合成的角膜OCT数据集上的实验表明，该方法在噪声下实现了鲁棒的光学图恢复、更高的分辨率和增强的结构保真度。这种方法实现了定量的多参数组织表征，并突出了将物理信息建模与深度学习相结合对计算OCT的益处。
tldr: 本文提出了一种正则化的端到端深度学习框架，通过结合物理学的OCT前向模型，实现了光学相干断层扫描（OCT）中组织光学参数和散斑抑制结构强度的同步、鲁棒重建，结果显示出更高的分辨率和结构保真度。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将深度学习的强大映射能力与严格的物理学模型（OCT前向模型）相结合，解决了传统逆散射问题中参数强耦合和噪声敏感性的难题。这种“物理信息学习”（Physics-Informed Learning）方法不仅提高了重建的鲁棒性和精度，尤其是在噪声环境下，还确保了结果的物理一致性，对于实现OCT的定量多参数组织表征具有重要意义。
motivation: 解决光学相干断层扫描（OCT）中逆散射问题恢复组织结构图像和内在光学特性（包括折射率、散射系数和各向异性）的挑战，这些挑战源于衰减、散斑噪声和参数间的强耦合。
method: 提出一个正则化的端到端深度学习框架，用于联合重建光学参数图和散斑抑制的OCT结构强度。该网络使用蒙特卡洛模拟的真实数据进行训练，并嵌入了基于物理的OCT前向模型，以提供物理一致性的监督。
results: 在合成的角膜OCT数据集上的实验表明，该方法在噪声下实现了鲁棒的光学图恢复、更高的分辨率和增强的结构保真度。
conclusion: 该方法实现了定量的多参数组织表征，并突出了将物理信息建模与深度学习相结合对计算OCT的益处。

title: Hierarchical Entity-centric Reinforcement Learning with Factored Subgoal Diffusion
authors: Dan Haramati, Carl Qi, Tal Daniel, Amy Zhang, Aviv Tamar, George Konidaris
abstract: We propose a hierarchical entity-centric framework for offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (GCRL) that combines subgoal decomposition with factored structure to solve long-horizon tasks in domains with multiple entities. Achieving long-horizon goals in complex environments remains a core challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Domains with multiple entities are particularly difficult due to their combinatorial complexity. GCRL facilitates generalization across goals and the use of subgoal structure, but struggles with high-dimensional observations and combinatorial state-spaces, especially under sparse reward. We employ a two-level hierarchy composed of a value-based GCRL agent and a factored subgoal-generating conditional diffusion model. The RL agent and subgoal generator are trained independently and composed post hoc through selective subgoal generation based on the value function, making the approach modular and compatible with existing GCRL algorithms. We introduce new variations to benchmark tasks that highlight the challenges of multi-entity domains, and show that our method consistently boosts performance of the underlying RL agent on image-based long-horizon tasks with sparse rewards, achieving over 150% higher success rates on the hardest task in our suite and generalizing to increasing horizons and numbers of entities. Rollout videos are provided at: https://sites.google.com/view/hecrl
zh_title: 分解子目标扩散的分层实体中心强化学习
translation: 我们提出了一个分层的、以实体为中心的框架，用于离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL），该框架结合了子目标分解和分解结构，以解决具有多个实体的领域中的长时序任务。在复杂环境中实现长时序目标仍然是强化学习（RL）的核心挑战。具有多个实体的领域由于其组合复杂性而特别困难。GCRL有助于跨目标的泛化和子目标结构的使用，但在高维观察和组合状态空间下，尤其是在稀疏奖励的情况下，效果不佳。我们采用了一个两级层次结构，由一个基于价值的GCRL智能体和一个分解的子目标生成条件扩散模型组成。RL智能体和子目标生成器独立训练，并通过基于价值函数的选择性子目标生成进行事后组合，这使得该方法具有模块化特性，并与现有的GCRL算法兼容。我们引入了基准任务的新变体，突出了多实体领域的挑战，并表明我们的方法持续提升了基础RL智能体在基于图像的长时序、稀疏奖励任务上的性能，在我们测试套件中最难的任务上成功率提高了150%以上，并能泛化到更长的时序和更多的实体。
tldr: 我们提出了一个分层的、以实体为中心的框架，使用GCRL智能体和分解的扩散模型来生成子目标，以解决离线环境中困难的长时序多实体任务，在最难的任务上成功率提高了150%以上。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将分层强化学习、实体中心设计与用于分解子目标生成的条件扩散模型进行了模块化结合。这种事后组合（post hoc composition）的模块化设计使其能兼容现有GCRL算法，提高了实用性。该方法成功解决了多实体领域中长时序、组合复杂性任务的挑战，特别是在高维观察和稀疏奖励设置下，展现了扩散模型在RL子目标生成中的潜力。
motivation: 解决强化学习中长时序目标达成的核心挑战，特别是在具有多个实体、组合复杂性高、观察维度高且奖励稀疏的复杂环境中，现有的目标条件强化学习（GCRL）方法表现不佳。
method: 提出了一种分层的、以实体为中心的框架，用于离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）。该框架采用两级层次结构：一个基于价值的GCRL智能体和一个分解的子目标生成条件扩散模型。两者独立训练，并通过基于价值函数的选择性子目标生成进行事后组合（post hoc composition），确保了方法的模块化和兼容性。
results: 该方法持续提升了基础RL智能体在基于图像的长时序、稀疏奖励任务上的性能。在测试套件中最难的任务上，成功率提高了150%以上，并能有效地泛化到更长的时序和更多的实体。同时，该工作还引入了新的基准任务变体来突出多实体领域的挑战。
conclusion: 该方法通过结合子目标分解和分解结构，有效解决了多实体领域中长时序GCRL的挑战，并提供了一个模块化、高性能的解决方案，在复杂任务中展现出优异的泛化能力。

title: Automatic Design of Optimization Test Problems with Large Language Models
authors: Wojciech Achtelik, Hubert Guzowski, Maciej Smołka, Jacek Mańdziuk
abstract: The development of black-box optimization algorithms depends on the availability of benchmark suites that are both diverse and representative of real-world problem landscapes. Widely used collections such as BBOB and CEC remain dominated by hand-crafted synthetic functions and provide limited coverage of the high-dimensional space of Exploratory Landscape Analysis (ELA) features, which in turn biases evaluation and hinders training of meta-black-box optimizers. We introduce Evolution of Test Functions (EoTF), a framework that automatically generates continuous optimization test functions whose landscapes match a specified target ELA feature vector. EoTF adapts LLM-driven evolutionary search, originally proposed for heuristic discovery, to evolve interpretable, self-contained numpy implementations of objective functions by minimizing the distance between sampled ELA features of generated candidates and a target profile. In experiments on 24 noiseless BBOB functions and a contamination-mitigating suite of 24 MA-BBOB hybrid functions, EoTF reliably produces non-trivial functions with closely matching ELA characteristics and preserves optimizer performance rankings under fixed evaluation budgets, supporting their validity as surrogate benchmarks. While a baseline neural-network-based generator achieves higher accuracy in 2D, EoTF substantially outperforms it in 3D and exhibits stable solution quality as dimensionality increases, highlighting favorable scalability. Overall, EoTF offers a practical route to scalable, portable, and interpretable benchmark generation targeted to desired landscape properties.
zh_title: 基于大型语言模型的优化测试问题自动设计
translation: 黑盒优化算法的发展依赖于既多样化又代表真实世界问题景观的基准套件的可用性。广泛使用的集合（如BBOB和CEC）仍以手工合成函数为主，对勘探景观分析（ELA）特征的高维空间覆盖有限，这反过来会使评估产生偏差并阻碍元黑盒优化器的训练。我们引入了测试函数演化（EoTF），这是一个自动生成连续优化测试函数的框架，其景观与指定的ELA特征向量匹配。EoTF调整了最初为启发式发现而提出的LLM驱动的进化搜索，通过最小化生成的候选函数采样ELA特征与目标配置文件之间的距离，来演化可解释、自包含的numpy目标函数实现。在对24个无噪声BBOB函数和24个缓解污染的MA-BBOB混合函数套件进行的实验中，EoTF可靠地生成了具有紧密匹配的ELA特征的非平凡函数，并在固定评估预算下保持了优化器性能排名，支持了它们作为替代基准的有效性。虽然基线神经网络生成器在2D上实现了更高的精度，但EoTF在3D上表现显著优于基线，并且随着维度增加，其解质量保持稳定，突出了其有利的可扩展性。总的来说，EoTF为可扩展、可移植且可解释的、针对所需景观特性的基准生成提供了一条实用的途径。
tldr: 引入EoTF框架，利用大型语言模型驱动的进化搜索，自动生成具有指定勘探景观分析（ELA）特征的连续优化测试函数，解决了现有基准测试集多样性不足和景观覆盖有限的问题，并展示了良好的可扩展性和有效性。
ai_comments: 本研究的关键创新在于将大型语言模型（LLM）与进化搜索相结合，用于自动生成具有特定景观特征的优化测试函数。这解决了传统手工基准测试集在多样性和ELA特征覆盖上的局限性。EoTF生成的函数具有可解释性和可移植性（Numpy实现），这对于优化社区的实际应用非常重要。其在更高维度上的良好可扩展性（优于神经网络基线）是其核心优势，表明该方法在处理复杂、高维优化问题基准化方面具有巨大潜力。
motivation: 现有的黑盒优化算法基准测试套件（如BBOB和CEC）主要由手工合成函数构成，多样性有限，且对勘探景观分析（ELA）特征的高维空间覆盖不足，这导致评估结果存在偏差，并阻碍了元黑盒优化器的训练。
method: 提出了“测试函数演化”（Evolution of Test Functions, EoTF）框架。该框架采用大型语言模型驱动的进化搜索，通过最小化生成的候选函数采样勘探景观分析（ELA）特征与目标配置文件之间的距离，来演化可解释、自包含的numpy目标函数实现。
results: EoTF能可靠地生成具有紧密匹配的ELA特征的非平凡函数。它在固定评估预算下保持了优化器性能排名，证明了其作为替代基准的有效性。虽然基线神经网络生成器在2D上精度更高，但EoTF在3D上表现显著优于基线，并且随着维度增加，其解质量保持稳定，显示出良好的可扩展性。
conclusion: EoTF为可扩展、可移植且可解释的基准生成提供了一条实用的途径，能够针对所需的景观特性进行定制化生成。

title: Automated Dysphagia Screening Using Noninvasive Neck Acoustic Sensing
authors: Jade Chng, Rong Xing, Yunfei Luo, Kristen Linnemeyer-Risser, Tauhidur Rahman, Andrew Yousef, Philip A Weissbrod
abstract: Pharyngeal health plays a vital role in essential human functions such as breathing, swallowing, and vocalization. Early detection of swallowing abnormalities, also known as dysphagia, is crucial for timely intervention. However, current diagnostic methods often rely on radiographic imaging or invasive procedures. In this study, we propose an automated framework for detecting dysphagia using portable and noninvasive acoustic sensing coupled with applied machine learning. By capturing subtle acoustic signals from the neck during swallowing tasks, we aim to identify patterns associated with abnormal physiological conditions. Our approach achieves promising test-time abnormality detection performance, with an AUC-ROC of 0.904 under 5 independent train-test splits. This work demonstrates the feasibility of using noninvasive acoustic sensing as a practical and scalable tool for pharyngeal health monitoring.
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)
zh_title: 使用非侵入性颈部声学传感的自动化吞咽困难筛查
translation: 咽部健康在呼吸、吞咽和发声等基本人体功能中起着至关重要的作用。吞咽异常（也称为吞咽困难）的早期检测对于及时干预至关重要。然而，当前的诊断方法通常依赖于射线成像或侵入性操作。在本研究中，我们提出了一种结合便携式非侵入性声学传感和应用机器学习的自动化框架，用于检测吞咽困难。通过在吞咽任务中捕获颈部发出的细微声学信号，我们旨在识别与异常生理状况相关的模式。我们的方法在5次独立的训练-测试划分下，实现了有希望的测试时间异常检测性能，AUC-ROC为0.904。这项工作证明了使用非侵入性声学传感作为咽部健康监测的实用且可扩展工具的可行性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种使用便携式非侵入性颈部声学传感结合机器学习的自动化框架，用于检测吞咽困难（吞咽异常），该方法在测试中取得了0.904的AUC-ROC性能，证明了其作为咽部健康监测工具的实用性和可扩展性。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新性在于将非侵入性、便携式的声学传感技术应用于吞咽困难的自动化筛查，有效地克服了传统诊断方法（如射线成像或侵入性检查）的局限性，提高了检测的可及性和便利性。0.904的AUC-ROC是一个有前景的性能指标，表明该技术具有实际应用的潜力，可以作为早期、大规模咽部健康监测的实用工具。
motivation: 咽部健康对呼吸、吞咽和发声至关重要。吞咽困难（吞咽异常）的早期检测是及时干预的关键，但目前的诊断方法通常依赖于射线成像或侵入性操作。
method: 提出一个自动化框架，结合便携式非侵入性声学传感和机器学习。该方法通过在吞咽任务中捕获颈部发出的细微声学信号，旨在识别与异常生理状况相关的模式。
results: 在5次独立的训练-测试划分下，该方法实现了有希望的测试时间异常检测性能，AUC-ROC为0.904。
conclusion: 这项工作证明了使用非侵入性声学传感作为咽部健康监测的实用且可扩展工具的可行性。

title: Search-Augmented Masked Diffusion Models for Constrained Generation
authors: Huu Binh Ta, Michael Cardei, Alvaro Velasquez, Ferdinando Fioretto
abstract: Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by iteratively denoising samples corrupted by categorical noise, offering an appealing alternative to autoregressive decoding for structured and symbolic generation. However, standard training targets a likelihood-based objective that primarily matches the data distribution and provides no native mechanism for enforcing hard constraints or optimizing non-differentiable properties at inference time. This work addresses this limitation and introduces Search-Augmented Masked Diffusion (SearchDiff), a training-free neurosymbolic inference framework that integrates informed search directly into the reverse denoising process. At each denoising step, the model predictions define a proposal set that is optimized under a user-specified property satisfaction, yielding a modified reverse transition that steers sampling toward probable and feasible solutions. Experiments in biological design and symbolic reasoning illustrate that SearchDiff substantially improves constraint satisfaction and property adherence, while consistently outperforming discrete diffusion and autoregressive baselines.
comment: Huu Binh Ta and Michael Cardei contributed equally to this work
zh_title: 用于约束生成的搜索增强型掩码扩散模型
translation: 离散扩散模型通过迭代去噪被分类噪声破坏的样本来生成序列，为结构化和符号化生成提供了一种有吸引力的替代自回归解码的方法。然而，标准训练的目标是基于似然的目标函数，它主要匹配数据分布，并且没有在推理时强制执行硬约束或优化不可微属性的本机机制。这项工作解决了这一限制，并引入了搜索增强型掩码扩散（SearchDiff），这是一个无需训练的神经符号推理框架，它将知情搜索直接集成到逆向去噪过程中。在每个去噪步骤中，模型预测定义了一个提议集，该提议集根据用户指定的属性满意度进行优化，从而产生修改后的逆向转换，将采样引导至可能且可行的解决方案。在生物设计和符号推理中的实验表明，SearchDiff显著提高了约束满足度和属性依从性，并持续优于离散扩散和自回归基线模型。
tldr: 离散扩散模型难以满足硬约束。本文提出了SearchDiff，它将知情搜索集成到去噪过程中，以引导生成符合约束和可行的解决方案，显著提高了约束满足度。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将知情搜索（一种经典AI技术）“无需训练”地直接集成到现代生成模型（离散扩散模型）的逆向过程中。这种神经符号方法有效地弥合了概率生成（扩散）与硬约束满足（搜索）之间的差距，这对于生物设计等对可行性和硬规则至关重要的实际应用至关重要。其无需训练的特性也意味着高适应性和低开销。
motivation: 标准离散扩散模型主要针对基于似然的目标进行训练，它主要匹配数据分布，缺乏在推理时强制执行硬约束或优化不可微属性的本机机制。
method: 引入了搜索增强型掩码扩散（SearchDiff），这是一个无需训练的神经符号推理框架。它将知情搜索直接集成到逆向去噪过程中。在每个去噪步骤中，模型预测定义了一个提议集，该提议集根据用户指定的属性满意度进行优化，从而产生修改后的逆向转换，将采样引导至可能且可行的解决方案。
results: 在生物设计和符号推理实验中，SearchDiff显著提高了约束满足度和属性依从性，并持续优于离散扩散和自回归基线模型。

title: Vector Quantized Latent Concepts: A Scalable Alternative to Clustering-Based Concept Discovery
authors: Xuemin Yu, Ankur Garg, Samira Ebrahimi Kahou, Hassan Sajjad
abstract: Deep Learning models encode rich semantic information in their hidden representations. However, it remains challenging to understand which parts of this information models actually rely on when making predictions. A promising line of post-hoc concept-based explanation methods relies on clustering token representations. However, commonly used approaches such as hierarchical clustering are computationally infeasible for large-scale datasets, and K-Means often yields shallow or frequency-dominated clusters. We propose the vector quantized latent concept (VQLC) method, a framework built upon the vector quantized-variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) architecture that learns a discrete codebook mapping continuous representations to concept vectors. We perform thorough evaluations and show that VQLC improves scalability while maintaining comparable quality of human-understandable explanations.
zh_title: 向量量化潜在概念：一种可扩展的替代聚类概念发现的方法
translation: 深度学习模型在其隐藏表示中编码了丰富的语义信息。然而，理解模型在做出预测时实际依赖这些信息的哪些部分仍然具有挑战性。一种有前景的后验概念解释方法依赖于对令牌表示进行聚类。然而，常用的方法（如层次聚类）对于大规模数据集而言计算上不可行，而K-Means通常会产生浅显或受频率主导的聚类。我们提出了向量量化潜在概念（VQLC）方法，这是一个建立在向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）架构之上的框架，它学习一个离散码本，将连续表示映射到概念向量。我们进行了彻底的评估，结果表明VQLC在提高可扩展性的同时，保持了人类可理解的解释的相当质量。
tldr: 针对大规模数据中概念解释的聚类方法效率低或效果差的问题，我们提出了基于VQ-VAE的向量量化潜在概念（VQLC）方法。VQLC通过学习离散概念向量，提高了可扩展性，并提供了与现有方法质量相当的人类可理解的解释。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了向量量化潜在概念（VQLC）方法，将向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）架构应用于后验概念解释领域，以解决现有基于聚类的方法（如层次聚类和K-Means）在大规模数据集上计算效率低下或聚类质量不佳的问题。VQLC通过学习离散码本，实现了将连续表示高效地映射到可理解的概念向量，显著提高了概念发现过程的可扩展性和实用性，同时保持了解释的质量。这是推动概念解释方法在大规模深度学习模型中应用的重要一步。
motivation: 深度学习模型的隐藏表示中编码了丰富的语义信息，但理解模型在做出预测时实际依赖哪些信息仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于聚类的后验概念解释方法（如层次聚类和K-Means）在大规模数据集上计算不可行，或产生的聚类结果浅显且受频率主导。
method: 提出了向量量化潜在概念（VQLC）方法。该框架建立在向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）架构之上，通过学习一个离散码本（codebook），将连续表示映射到概念向量。
results: 彻底的评估表明，VQLC在保持人类可理解的解释质量相当的同时，提高了可扩展性。
conclusion: 向量量化潜在概念（VQLC）方法是传统聚类概念发现方法的一种可扩展的替代方案，它在提高可扩展性的同时，保持了人类可理解的解释的相当质量。

title: AROLA: A Modular Layered Architecture for Scaled Autonomous Racing
authors: Fam Shihata, Mohammed Abdelazim, Ahmed Hussein
abstract: Autonomous racing has advanced rapidly, particularly on scaled platforms, and software stacks must evolve accordingly. In this work, AROLA is introduced as a modular, layered software architecture in which fragmented and monolithic designs are reorganized into interchangeable layers and components connected through standardized ROS 2 interfaces. The autonomous-driving pipeline is decomposed into sensing, pre-processing, perception, localization and mapping, planning, behavior, control, and actuation, enabling rapid module replacement and objective benchmarking without reliance on custom message definitions. To support consistent performance evaluation, a Race Monitor framework is introduced as a lightweight system through which lap timing, trajectory quality, and computational load are logged in real time and standardized post-race analyses are generated. AROLA is validated in simulation and on hardware using the RoboRacer platform, including deployment at the 2025 RoboRacer IV25 competition. Together, AROLA and Race Monitor demonstrate that modularity, transparent interfaces, and systematic evaluation can accelerate development and improve reproducibility in scaled autonomous racing.
zh_title: AROLA：用于规模化自动驾驶竞赛的模块化分层架构
translation: 自动驾驶竞赛，特别是在规模化平台上，已经快速发展，软件栈必须相应地演进。在这项工作中，AROLA被引入作为一个模块化、分层的软件架构，其中零散和单一的设计被重组为通过标准化ROS 2接口连接的可互换层和组件。自动驾驶流程被分解为感知、预处理、识别、定位和建图、规划、行为、控制和执行，从而实现了快速的模块更换和客观的基准测试，而无需依赖自定义消息定义。为了支持一致的性能评估，引入了Race Monitor框架作为一个轻量级系统，通过它实时记录圈速、轨迹质量和计算负载，并生成标准化的赛后分析。AROLA在模拟和使用RoboRacer平台的硬件上得到了验证，包括部署在2025年RoboRacer IV25竞赛中。总而言之，AROLA和Race Monitor证明了模块化、透明接口和系统评估可以加速规模化自动驾驶竞赛的开发并提高其可重复性。
tldr: 本文介绍了AROLA，这是一种采用标准化ROS 2接口的模块化分层软件架构，用于重组规模化自动驾驶竞赛的软件栈，并引入Race Monitor进行系统评估，以提高开发速度和可重复性。
ai_comments: 该论文解决了快速发展的规模化自动驾驶竞赛领域中一个关键的软件挑战：整合和基准测试不同软件组件的难度。其创新之处在于严格执行模块化和标准化接口（ROS 2），这直接解决了竞技机器人中常见的可重复性和自定义消息依赖问题。Race Monitor框架的引入尤其有价值，它提供了一种系统化、客观的性能评估方法，支持了加速开发的核心目标。
motivation: 规模化自动驾驶竞赛发展迅速，但现有的软件栈设计零散且单一，需要一种新的软件架构来重组设计并支持快速演进。
method: 开发了AROLA模块化分层架构，使用标准化的ROS 2接口连接可互换的层和组件；将自动驾驶流程分解为感知、预处理、识别、定位和建图、规划、行为、控制和执行八个阶段；引入了Race Monitor框架，用于实时记录圈速、轨迹质量和计算负载，并生成标准化的赛后分析。
results: AROLA在模拟环境和使用RoboRacer平台的硬件上得到了验证，并已部署在2025年RoboRacer IV25竞赛中。
conclusion: 通过模块化、透明接口和系统评估（通过AROLA和Race Monitor），可以加速规模化自动驾驶竞赛的开发并提高其可重复性。

title: CAPS: Unifying Attention, Recurrence, and Alignment in Transformer-based Time Series Forecasting
authors: Viresh Pati, Yubin Kim, Vinh Pham, Jevon Twitty, Shihao Yang, Jiecheng Lu
abstract: This paper presents $\textbf{CAPS}$ (Clock-weighted Aggregation with Prefix-products and Softmax), a structured attention mechanism for time series forecasting that decouples three distinct temporal structures: global trends, local shocks, and seasonal patterns. Standard softmax attention entangles these through global normalization, while recent recurrent models sacrifice long-term, order-independent selection for order-dependent causal structure. CAPS combines SO(2) rotations for phase alignment with three additive gating paths -- Riemann softmax, prefix-product gates, and a Clock baseline -- within a single attention layer. We introduce the Clock mechanism, a learned temporal weighting that modulates these paths through a shared notion of temporal importance. Experiments on long- and short-term forecasting benchmarks surpass vanilla softmax and linear attention mechanisms and demonstrate competitive performance against seven strong baselines with linear complexity. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/vireshpati/CAPS-Attention.
zh_title: CAPS：在基于Transformer的时间序列预测中统一注意力、循环和对齐
translation: 本文提出了**CAPS**（Clock-weighted Aggregation with Prefix-products and Softmax，时钟加权聚合与前缀乘积和Softmax），这是一种用于时间序列预测的结构化注意力机制，它解耦了三种不同的时间结构：全局趋势、局部冲击和季节性模式。标准的softmax注意力通过全局归一化将这些结构纠缠在一起，而最近的循环模型则牺牲了长期、与顺序无关的选择性，以换取依赖于顺序的因果结构。CAPS在一个注意力层内结合了用于相位对齐的SO(2)旋转和三个加性门控路径——黎曼softmax、前缀乘积门和一个Clock基线。我们引入了Clock机制，这是一种学习到的时间加权，它通过共享的时间重要性概念来调节这些路径。在长短期预测基准上的实验结果表明，CAPS优于普通的softmax和线性注意力机制，并且相对于七个强大的基线模型展示出具有竞争力的性能，同时具有线性复杂度。我们的代码实现可在https://github.com/vireshpati/CAPS-Attention获取。
tldr: CAPS是一种新的结构化注意力机制，用于时间序列预测，它通过结合SO(2)旋转、黎曼softmax、前缀乘积门和Clock基线，有效地解耦了全局趋势、局部冲击和季节性模式。它在线性复杂度的前提下，在长短期预测基准上优于标准注意力机制并具有竞争力。
ai_comments: CAPS的创新点在于其结构化的设计，明确地将时间序列分析中的三个关键要素（全局趋势、局部冲击、季节性模式）解耦，这是标准全局归一化注意力机制难以做到的。通过引入Clock机制和结合循环（prefix-product gates）与对齐（SO(2) rotations），它成功地在一个统一的框架内结合了注意力、循环和对齐的优点，同时保持了Transformer模型的可并行性和线性复杂度，这对于大规模时间序列预测非常重要。
motivation: 现有的标准softmax注意力机制通过全局归一化将时间序列中的三种不同时间结构（全局趋势、局部冲击和季节性模式）纠缠在一起。而最近的循环模型则牺牲了长期、与顺序无关的选择性，转而采用依赖于顺序的因果结构。CAPS旨在解决这些限制，实现时间结构的解耦。
method: 提出了CAPS（Clock-weighted Aggregation with Prefix-products and Softmax），这是一种结构化注意力机制。CAPS在一个注意力层内结合了用于相位对齐的SO(2)旋转和三个加性门控路径：黎曼softmax、前缀乘积门和一个Clock基线。其中，Clock机制是一种学习到的时间加权，它通过共享的时间重要性概念来调节这些路径。该方法旨在解耦时间序列中的三种结构（全局趋势、局部冲击和季节性模式）。
results: 在长短期预测基准上的实验结果表明，CAPS优于普通的softmax和线性注意力机制，并且相对于七个强大的基线模型展示出具有竞争力的性能，同时具有线性复杂度。

title: TabPFN for Zero-shot Parametric Engineering Design Generation
authors: Ke Wang, Yifan Tang, Nguyen Gia Hien Vu, Faez Ahmed, G. Gary Wang
abstract: Deep generative models for engineering design often require substantial computational cost, large training datasets, and extensive retraining when design requirements or datasets change, limiting their applicability in real-world engineering design workflow. In this work, we propose a zero-shot generation framework for parametric engineering design based on TabPFN, enabling conditional design generation using only a limited number of reference samples and without any task-specific model training or fine-tuning. The proposed method generates design parameters sequentially conditioned on target performance indicators, providing a flexible alternative to conventional generative models. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is evaluated on three engineering design datasets, i.e., ship hull design, BlendedNet aircraft, and UIUC airfoil. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive diversity across highly structured parametric design spaces, remains robust to variations in sampling, resolution and parameter dimensionality of geometry generation, and achieves a low performance error (e.g., less than 2% in generated ship hull designs' performance). Compared with diffusion-based generative models, the proposed framework significantly reduces computational overhead and data requirements while preserving reliable generation performance. These results highlight the potential of zero-shot, data-efficient generation as a practical and efficient tool for engineering design, enabling rapid deployment, flexible adaptation to new design settings, and ease of integration into real-world engineering workflows.
zh_title: 基于 TabPFN 的零样本参数化工程设计生成
translation: 用于工程设计的深度生成模型通常需要大量的计算成本、庞大的训练数据集，并且在设计要求或数据集发生变化时需要进行广泛的再训练，这限制了它们在现实世界工程设计工作流程中的适用性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于 TabPFN 的参数化工程设计的零样本生成框架，它仅使用有限数量的参考样本，无需任何特定任务的模型训练或微调，即可实现条件设计生成。所提出的方法根据目标性能指标顺序生成设计参数，为传统生成模型提供了一种灵活的替代方案。该方法的有效性在三个工程设计数据集上进行了评估，即船体设计、BlendedNet 飞机和 UIUC 翼型。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在高度结构化的参数设计空间中实现了具有竞争力的多样性，对几何生成的采样、分辨率和参数维度变化保持鲁棒性，并实现了低性能误差（例如，生成的船体设计性能误差小于 2%）。与基于扩散的生成模型相比，所提出的框架显著减少了计算开销和数据需求，同时保持了可靠的生成性能。这些结果突出了零样本、数据高效生成作为工程设计实用且高效工具的潜力，能够实现快速部署、灵活适应新的设计设置，并易于集成到实际工程工作流程中。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于TabPFN的零样本框架，用于参数化工程设计生成。它仅需少量参考样本，无需重新训练，即可高效、灵活地生成设计，并在保持可靠性能的同时，显著降低了计算和数据需求。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将 TabPFN（一种为表格数据设计的预训练模型）应用于参数化工程设计的零样本生成任务。它直接解决了传统深度生成模型在工程应用中的核心限制：对大量数据和昂贵再训练的依赖。通过实现“零样本”和“数据高效”的生成，该方法显著提高了工程设计工作流程的效率和灵活性，特别是在数据稀疏或设计要求频繁变化的实际场景中具有重要价值。与流行的扩散模型相比，其计算开销和数据需求的显著降低是其主要的优势和实际应用中的关键突破。
motivation: 传统的深度生成模型在工程设计中面临计算成本高昂、需要大量训练数据以及设计要求或数据集变化时需要大量重新训练的问题，限制了它们在实际工程设计工作流程中的适用性。
method: 提出了一种基于 TabPFN 的零样本生成框架。该方法仅使用有限数量的参考样本，无需任何特定任务的模型训练或微调，即可实现条件设计生成。它通过将设计参数顺序生成并以目标性能指标为条件来实现。
results: 该方法在高度结构化的参数设计空间中实现了具有竞争力的多样性；对几何生成的采样、分辨率和参数维度变化保持鲁棒性；并实现了低性能误差（例如，生成的船体设计性能误差小于2%）。与基于扩散的生成模型相比，该框架显著减少了计算开销和数据需求，同时保持了可靠的生成性能。
conclusion: 零样本、数据高效的生成方法在工程设计中具有潜力，是一种实用且高效的工具，能够实现快速部署、灵活适应新的设计设置，并易于集成到实际工程工作流程中。

title: Predicting first-episode homelessness among US Veterans using longitudinal EHR data: time-varying models and social risk factors
authors: Rohan Pandey, Haijuan Yan, Hong Yu, Jack Tsai
abstract: Homelessness among US veterans remains a critical public health challenge, yet risk prediction offers a pathway for proactive intervention. In this retrospective prognostic study, we analyzed electronic health record (EHR) data from 4,276,403 Veterans Affairs patients during a 2016 observation period to predict first-episode homelessness occurring 3-12 months later in 2017 (prevalence: 0.32-1.19%). We constructed static and time-varying EHR representations, utilizing clinician-informed logic to model the persistence of clinical conditions and social risks over time. We then compared the performance of classical machine learning, transformer-based masked language models, and fine-tuned large language models (LLMs). We demonstrate that incorporating social and behavioral factors into longitudinal models improved precision-recall area under the curve (PR-AUC) by 15-30%. In the top 1% risk tier, models yielded positive predictive values ranging from 3.93-4.72% at 3 months, 7.39-8.30% at 6 months, 9.84-11.41% at 9 months, and 11.65-13.80% at 12 months across model architectures. Large language models underperformed encoder-based models on discrimination but showed smaller performance disparities across racial groups. These results demonstrate that longitudinal, socially informed EHR modeling concentrates homelessness risk into actionable strata, enabling targeted and data-informed prevention strategies for at-risk veterans.
zh_title: 使用纵向EHR数据预测美国退伍军人首次无家可归：时变模型和社会风险因素
translation: 美国退伍军人无家可归仍然是一个关键的公共卫生挑战，但风险预测为主动干预提供了一条途径。在这项回顾性预后研究中，我们分析了2016年观察期内4,276,403名退伍军人事务部患者的电子健康记录（EHR）数据，以预测3-12个月后（2017年）发生的首次无家可归事件（流行率：0.32-1.19%）。我们构建了静态和时变的EHR表示，利用临床医生知情的逻辑来模拟临床状况和社会风险随时间的持续性。随后，我们比较了经典机器学习、基于Transformer的掩码语言模型以及微调的大型语言模型（LLMs）的性能。我们证明，将社会和行为因素纳入纵向模型使精确度-召回率曲线下面积（PR-AUC）提高了15-30%。在最高1%的风险层级中，模型在3个月时产生的阳性预测值范围为3.93-4.72%，在12个月时范围为11.65-13.80%。大型语言模型在区分度上不如基于编码器的模型，但在不同种族群体间的性能差异较小。这些结果表明，纵向的、社会知情的EHR建模能够将无家可归的风险集中到可操作的阶层中，从而为高风险退伍军人制定有针对性的、数据驱动的预防策略。
tldr: 本研究利用超过400万退伍军人的纵向电子健康记录（EHR）数据，开发并比较了时变预测模型（包括LLMs和Transformer模型）来预测首次无家可归。结果显示，纳入社会风险因素可显著提高预测精度（PR-AUC提高15-30%），且模型能将风险集中到可操作的阶层，以实现精准干预。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于其使用了大规模、纵向的EHR数据，并明确地将“社会风险因素”纳入时变模型进行预测，这反映了对无家可归这一复杂公共卫生问题进行干预时，需要超越单纯的临床诊断。研究不仅关注了预测性能的提升，还比较了先进的深度学习模型（如Transformer和LLM）与传统方法的有效性，并探讨了模型在种族公平性方面的表现（LLM表现出较小的种族差异），这对于实际部署和伦理考量具有重要意义。其结果表明，预测模型可以将低概率事件的风险集中到可操作的、高回报率的干预目标群体中。
motivation: 美国退伍军人无家可归仍然是一个重大的公共卫生挑战。风险预测提供了一种主动干预的途径，以应对这一挑战。
method: 回顾性预后研究。分析了2016年4,276,403名退伍军人事务部患者的EHR数据，预测3-12个月后（2017年）首次无家可归。构建了静态和时变EHR表示，利用临床医生知情的逻辑来模拟临床状况和社会风险随时间的持续性。比较了经典机器学习、基于Transformer的掩码语言模型和微调的大型语言模型（LLMs）的性能。
results: 1. 将社会和行为因素纳入纵向模型使精确度-召回率曲线下面积（PR-AUC）提高了15-30%。2. 在最高1%的风险层级中，模型在3个月时的阳性预测值（PPV）为3.93-4.72%，在12个月时为11.65-13.80%。3. 大型语言模型在区分度上不如基于编码器的模型，但在不同种族群体间的性能差异较小。
conclusion: 纵向的、社会知情的EHR建模能够将无家可归的风险集中到可操作的阶层中，从而为高风险退伍军人制定有针对性的、数据驱动的预防策略。

title: Time-Critical Multimodal Medical Transportation: Organs, Patients, and Medical Supplies
authors: Elaheh Sabziyan Varnousfaderani, Syed A. M. Shihab, Mohammad Taghizadeh
abstract: Timely transportation of organs, patients, and medical supplies is critical to modern healthcare, particularly in emergencies and transplant scenarios where even short delays can severely impact outcomes. Traditional ground-based vehicles such as ambulances are often hindered by traffic congestion; while air vehicles such as helicopters are faster but costly. Emerging air vehicles -- Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft -- have lower operating costs, but remain limited by range and susceptibility to weather conditions. A multimodal transportation system that integrates both air and ground vehicles can leverage the strengths of each to enhance overall transportation efficiency. This study introduces a constructive greedy heuristic algorithm for multimodal vehicle dispatching for medical transportation. Four different fleet configurations were tested: (i) ambulances only, (ii) ambulances with Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, (iii) ambulances with electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, and (iv) a fully integrated fleet of ambulances, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft. The algorithm incorporates payload consolidation across compatible routes, accounts for traffic congestion in ground operations and weather conditions in aerial operations, while enabling rapid vehicle dispatching compared to computationally intensive optimization models. Using a common set of conditions, we evaluate all four fleet types to identify the most effective configurations for fulfilling medical transportation needs while minimizing operating costs, recharging/fuel costs, and total transportation time.

zh_title: 时间敏感的多式联运医疗运输：器官、患者和医疗用品
translation: 器官、患者和医疗用品的及时运输对现代医疗保健至关重要，特别是在紧急情况和移植场景中，即使是短暂的延误也会严重影响结果。救护车等传统地面车辆经常受到交通拥堵的阻碍；而直升机等空中车辆虽然更快但成本高昂。新兴的空中交通工具——无人机（UAV）和电动垂直起降飞机（eVTOL）——运营成本较低，但仍受到航程和天气条件的限制。整合空地交通工具的多式联运系统可以利用各自的优势来提高整体运输效率。本研究引入了一种用于医疗运输多式联运车辆调度的建设性贪婪启发式算法。测试了四种不同的车队配置：（i）仅救护车，（ii）救护车与无人机，（iii）救护车与电动垂直起降飞机，以及（iv）救护车、无人机和电动垂直起降飞机的完全集成车队。该算法整合了兼容路线的有效载荷，考虑了地面运行中的交通拥堵和空中运行中的天气条件，同时与计算密集型优化模型相比，实现了快速的车辆调度。我们使用一组通用条件评估了所有四种车队类型，以确定满足医疗运输需求同时最小化运营成本、充电/燃料成本和总运输时间的最佳有效配置。
tldr: 针对时间敏感的医疗运输，本文提出了一种整合地面和空中交通工具的多式联运系统，并设计了建设性贪婪启发式算法进行快速车辆调度，旨在最小化成本和时间，并评估了四种车队配置的有效性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个整合救护车、无人机和eVTOL等多种交通工具的多式联运系统，专门解决时间敏感的医疗运输问题。其重要性在于通过提高效率和降低成本，有可能显著改善器官移植和紧急情况下的患者预后。方法上的创新是采用建设性贪婪启发式算法进行快速调度，克服了传统复杂优化模型在实时应用中的计算限制，使其更适用于紧急医疗场景。
motivation: 现代医疗保健中的器官、患者和医疗用品的及时运输至关重要，延迟会严重影响结果。传统地面交通工具（救护车）受交通拥堵限制，传统空中交通工具（直升机）成本高昂。新兴空中交通工具（无人机、eVTOL）受航程和天气限制。因此，需要一个整合空地优势的多式联运系统来提高整体运输效率。
method: 提出了一种用于医疗运输多式联运车辆调度的“建设性贪婪启发式算法”。该算法整合了兼容路线的有效载荷，考虑了地面运行的交通拥堵和空中运行的天气条件，并实现了比计算密集型优化模型更快的车辆调度。通过比较四种不同的车队配置（仅救护车；救护车+无人机；救护车+eVTOL；救护车+无人机+eVTOL的完全集成车队）来评估其有效性。
results: 评估了所有四种车队类型，以确定最有效的配置，旨在最小化运营成本、充电/燃料成本和总运输时间。具体的评估结果（哪个配置最有效）在摘要中未提及。

title: When Noise Lowers The Loss: Rethinking Likelihood-Based Evaluation in Music Large Language Models
authors: Xiaosha Li, Chun Liu, Ziyu Wang
abstract: The rise of music large language models (LLMs) demands robust methods of evaluating output quality, especially in distinguishing high-quality compositions from "garbage music". Curiously, we observe that the standard cross-entropy loss -- a core training metric -- often decrease when models encounter systematically corrupted music, undermining its validity as a standalone quality indicator. To investigate this paradox, we introduce noise injection experiment, where controlled noise signal of varying lengths are injected into musical contexts. We hypothesize that a model's loss reacting positively to these perturbations, specifically a sharp increase ("Peak" area) for short injection, can serve as a proxy for its ability to discern musical integrity. Experiments with MusicGen models in the audio waveform domain confirm that Music LLMs respond more strongly to local, texture-level disruptions than to global semantic corruption. Beyond exposing this bias, our results highlight a new principle: the shape of the loss curve -- rather than its absolute value -- encodes critical information about the quality of the generated content (i.e., model behavior). We envision this profile-based evaluation as a label-free, model-intrinsic framework for assessing musical quality -- opening the door to more principled training objectives and sharper benchmarks.
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026
zh_title: 当噪声降低损失时：重新思考音乐大型语言模型中基于似然的评估
translation: 音乐大型语言模型（LLMs）的兴起要求有强大的方法来评估其输出质量，尤其是在区分高质量作品和“垃圾音乐”方面。奇怪的是，我们观察到核心训练指标——标准交叉熵损失——在模型遇到系统性损坏的音乐时往往会降低，这削弱了其作为独立质量指标的有效性。为了调查这一悖论，我们引入了噪声注入实验，将不同长度的受控噪声信号注入到音乐上下文中。我们假设模型损失对这些扰动的积极反应，特别是对短时注入的急剧增加（“峰值”区域），可以作为其辨别音乐完整性能力的代理指标。在音频波形域对MusicGen模型进行的实验证实，音乐LLMs对局部、纹理层面的破坏反应比对全局语义损坏更强烈。除了揭示这种偏差外，我们的结果还强调了一个新原则：损失曲线的形状——而非其绝对值——编码了关于生成内容质量（即模型行为）的关键信息。我们设想这种基于轮廓的评估是一种无标签、模型内在的框架，用于评估音乐质量——为更规范的训练目标和更严格的基准测试打开了大门。
tldr: 音乐LLM中，标准的交叉熵损失在遇到损坏音乐时反而会降低。作者通过噪声注入实验发现，损失曲线的形状（尤其是对局部噪声的峰值反应）比绝对损失值更能反映模型区分音乐完整性的能力，提出了基于损失曲线轮廓的无标签评估框架。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于揭示了音乐LLMs在评估中对标准似然损失的“反直觉”行为（噪声反而降低损失）。这挑战了传统上将交叉熵损失的绝对值作为模型质量或生成内容质量指标的假设。通过引入噪声注入和关注损失曲线的“形状”或“轮廓”，作者提供了一种新颖的、模型内在的、无标签的评估范式。这对于提升音乐生成模型的训练目标和评估基准具有重要意义，因为它迫使研究者重新思考模型真正“学会了什么”。
motivation: 音乐大型语言模型（LLMs）需要可靠的评估方法来区分高质量作品和“垃圾音乐”。然而，核心训练指标——标准交叉熵损失——在模型遇到系统性损坏的音乐时反而经常降低，削弱了其作为独立质量指标的有效性。
method: 引入噪声注入实验，将不同长度的受控噪声信号注入到音乐上下文中。通过观察模型损失对这些扰动的反应，特别是对短时注入产生急剧增加（“峰值”区域）的反应，来作为模型辨别音乐完整性能力的代理指标。评估侧重于损失曲线的形状而非绝对值。
results: 在音频波形域对MusicGen模型进行的实验证实，音乐LLMs对局部、纹理层面的破坏反应比对全局语义损坏更强烈。结果表明，损失曲线的形状（轮廓）而非其绝对值，编码了关于生成内容质量（即模型行为）的关键信息。
conclusion: 这种基于轮廓的评估被设想为一个无标签、模型内在的框架，用于评估音乐质量，为更规范的训练目标和更严格的基准测试打开了大门。

title: TopoPrune: Robust Data Pruning via Unified Latent Space Topology
authors: Arjun Roy, Prajna G. Malettira, Manish Nagaraj, Kaushik Roy
abstract: Geometric data pruning methods, while practical for leveraging pretrained models, are fundamentally unstable. Their reliance on extrinsic geometry renders them highly sensitive to latent space perturbations, causing performance to degrade during cross-architecture transfer or in the presence of feature noise. We introduce TopoPrune, a framework which resolves this challenge by leveraging topology to capture the stable, intrinsic structure of data. TopoPrune operates at two scales, (1) utilizing a topology-aware manifold approximation to establish a global low-dimensional embedding of the dataset. Subsequently, (2) it employs differentiable persistent homology to perform a local topological optimization on the manifold embeddings, ranking samples by their structural complexity. We demonstrate that our unified dual-scale topological approach ensures high accuracy and precision, particularly at significant dataset pruning rates (e.g., 90%). Furthermore, through the inherent stability properties of topology, TopoPrune is (a) exceptionally robust to noise perturbations of latent feature embeddings and (b) demonstrates superior transferability across diverse network architectures. This study demonstrates a promising avenue towards stable and principled topology-based frameworks for robust data-efficient learning.
zh_title: TopoPrune：通过统一的潜在空间拓扑实现鲁棒数据剪枝
translation: 几何数据剪枝方法虽然对于利用预训练模型很实用，但它们从根本上来说是不稳定的。它们对外在几何结构的依赖使得它们对潜在空间扰动高度敏感，从而导致在跨架构迁移或存在特征噪声时性能下降。我们引入了 TopoPrune 框架，它通过利用拓扑结构捕获数据的稳定内在结构来解决这一挑战。TopoPrune 在两个尺度上运行：（1）利用拓扑感知的流形逼近来建立数据集的全局低维嵌入。随后，（2）它采用可微分持久同调对流形嵌入进行局部拓扑优化，根据样本的结构复杂性对其进行排序。我们证明了我们统一的双尺度拓扑方法能确保高准确性和精确性，尤其是在显著的数据集剪枝率（例如 90%）下。此外，通过拓扑固有的稳定性特性，TopoPrune（a）对潜在特征嵌入的噪声扰动具有极强的鲁棒性，并且（b）在不同的网络架构中展现出卓越的可迁移性。这项研究为建立稳定且基于原理的拓扑框架，以实现鲁棒的数据高效学习，提供了一个有前景的方向。
tldr: TopoPrune是一种新的数据剪枝框架，它使用双尺度拓扑结构（流形逼近和可微分持久同调）来稳定地识别和排序数据，即使在90%的高剪枝率下，也能实现高精度，并且对噪声和跨架构迁移具有鲁棒性，解决了传统几何剪枝方法不稳定的问题。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于将拓扑学原理引入数据剪枝，解决了传统几何剪枝方法固有的不稳定性和对噪声的敏感性问题。通过引入“统一的潜在空间拓扑”和“可微分持久同调”等先进概念，该框架能够捕获数据的内在结构，从而在极高的剪枝率下（如90%）依然保持性能。其强调的鲁棒性和跨架构可迁移性对于实际应用中数据高效学习和模型部署具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的几何数据剪枝方法不稳定，依赖外在几何结构，对潜在空间扰动高度敏感，导致在跨架构迁移或存在特征噪声时性能会下降。
method: TopoPrune是一个双尺度框架：（1）利用拓扑感知的流形逼近来建立数据集的全局低维嵌入。（2）随后采用可微分持久同调对流形嵌入进行局部拓扑优化，根据样本的结构复杂性对其进行排序。
results: 统一的双尺度拓扑方法在显著的数据集剪枝率（例如90%）下仍能确保高准确性和精确性。此外，TopoPrune对潜在特征嵌入的噪声扰动具有极强的鲁棒性，并展现出优越的跨不同网络架构的可迁移性。
conclusion: 本研究展示了一个有前景的方向，即利用稳定且基于原理的拓扑框架来实现鲁棒的数据高效学习。

title: PokeNet: Learning Kinematic Models of Articulated Objects from Human Observations
authors: Anmol Gupta, Weiwei Gu, Omkar Patil, Jun Ki Lee, Nakul Gopalan
abstract: Articulation modeling enables robots to learn joint parameters of articulated objects for effective manipulation which can then be used downstream for skill learning or planning. Existing approaches often rely on prior knowledge about the objects, such as the number or type of joints. Some of these approaches also fail to recover occluded joints that are only revealed during interaction. Others require large numbers of multi-view images for every object, which is impractical in real-world settings. Furthermore, prior works neglect the order of manipulations, which is essential for many multi-DoF objects where one joint must be operated before another, such as a dishwasher. We introduce PokeNet, an end-to-end framework that estimates articulation models from a single human demonstration without prior object knowledge. Given a sequence of point cloud observations of a human manipulating an unknown object, PokeNet predicts joint parameters, infers manipulation order, and tracks joint states over time. PokeNet outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, improving joint axis and state estimation accuracy by an average of over 27% across diverse objects, including novel and unseen categories. We demonstrate these gains in both simulation and real-world environments.
zh_title: PokeNet：从人类观察中学习铰接物体的运动学模型
translation: 关节建模使机器人能够学习铰接物体的关节参数，以便进行有效的操作，然后可用于后续的技能学习或规划。现有方法通常依赖于对物体的先验知识，例如关节的数量或类型。其中一些方法还无法恢复仅在交互过程中才暴露的被遮挡关节。其他人则需要对每个物体进行大量的多视图图像，这在现实世界中是不切实际的。此外，先前的工作忽略了操作的顺序，这对于许多多自由度物体（如洗碗机）至关重要，其中一个关节必须在另一个关节之前操作。我们引入了PokeNet，一个端到端的框架，可以从单次人类演示中估计出关节模型，而无需先验对象知识。给定人类操作未知物体时点云观测的序列，PokeNet预测关节参数，推断操作顺序，并随时间跟踪关节状态。PokeNet优于现有的最先进方法，在各种物体上，包括新颖和未见过的类别，平均将关节轴和状态估计精度提高了超过27%。我们在模拟和真实世界环境中都展示了这些收益。
tldr: PokeNet通过分析单次人类演示的点云序列，无需任何先验知识，就能准确地为机械关节物体（如洗碗机）建立运动学模型，包括关节参数、操作顺序和状态跟踪，性能显著优于现有方法。
ai_comments: PokeNet的主要创新在于能够仅从单次人类演示中学习关节参数、推理操作顺序和跟踪关节状态，而无需任何先验对象知识，并能处理遮挡关节，这解决了现有方法的局限性。其性能提升显著，尤其在关节轴和状态估计精度上超过现有SOTA方法27%。
motivation: 现有方法依赖于对物体的先验知识（如关节数量或类型），难以恢复仅在交互中才暴露的遮挡关节，需要大量多视图图像，并忽略了对许多多自由度物体至关重要的操作顺序。
method: PokeNet是一个端到端的框架，接收人类操作未知物体时点云观测序列作为输入，预测关节参数，推断操作顺序，并实时跟踪关节状态。
results: PokeNet在不同的物体上，包括新颖和未见过的类别，平均将关节轴和状态估计精度提高了超过27%，优于现有的最先进方法。
conclusion: PokeNet在模拟和真实世界环境中均展现了优于现有最先进方法的性能，证明了其从单次人类演示中学习关节模型的能力。

title: Entropy-Guided Dynamic Tokens for Graph-LLM Alignment in Molecular Understanding
authors: Zihao Jing, Qiuhao Zeng, Ruiyi Fang, Yan Sun, Boyu Wang, Pingzhao Hu
abstract: Molecular understanding is central to advancing areas such as scientific discovery, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to understand molecular graphs effectively. Existing graph-LLM bridges often adapt the Q-Former-style connector with fixed-length static tokens, which is originally designed for vision tasks. These designs overlook stereochemistry and substructural context and typically require costly LLM-backbone fine-tuning, limiting efficiency and generalization. We introduce EDT-Former, an Entropy-guided Dynamic Token Transformer that generates tokens aligned with informative molecular patches, thereby preserving both local and global structural features for molecular graph understanding. Beyond prior approaches, EDT-Former enables alignment between frozen graph encoders and LLMs without tuning the LLM backbone (excluding the embedding layer), resulting in computationally efficient finetuning, and achieves stateof-the-art results on MoleculeQA, Molecule-oriented Mol-Instructions, and property prediction benchmarks (TDC, MoleculeNet), underscoring its effectiveness for scalable and generalizable multimodal molecular understanding

title: Framing Responsible Design of AI Mental Well-Being Support: AI as Primary Care, Nutritional Supplement, or Yoga Instructor?
authors: Ned Cooper, Jose A. Guridi, Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang, Beth Kolko, Beth McGinty, Qian Yang
abstract: Millions of people now use non-clinical Large Language Model (LLM) tools like ChatGPT for mental well-being support. This paper investigates what it means to design such tools responsibly, and how to operationalize that responsibility in their design and evaluation. By interviewing experts and analyzing related regulations, we found that designing an LLM tool responsibly involves: (1) Articulating the specific benefits it guarantees and for whom. Does it guarantee specific, proven relief, like an over-the-counter drug, or offer minimal guarantees, like a nutritional supplement? (2) Specifying the LLM tool's "active ingredients" for improving well-being and whether it guarantees their effective delivery (like a primary care provider) or not (like a yoga instructor). These specifications outline an LLM tool's pertinent risks, appropriate evaluation metrics, and the respective responsibilities of LLM developers, tool designers, and users. These analogies - LLM tools as supplements, drugs, yoga instructors, and primary care providers - can scaffold further conversations about their responsible design.
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. To appear at CHI '26

title: Exploring Collaborative Immersive Visualization & Analytics for High-Dimensional Scientific Data through Domain Expert Perspectives
authors: Fahim Arsad Nafis, Jie Li, Simon Su, Songqing Chen, Bo Han
abstract: Cross-disciplinary teams increasingly work with high-dimensional scientific datasets, yet fragmented toolchains and limited support for shared exploration hinder collaboration. Prior immersive visualization and analytics research has emphasized individual interaction, leaving open how multi-user collaboration can be supported at scale. To fill this critical gap, we conduct semi-structured interviews with 20 domain experts from diverse academic, government, and industry backgrounds. Using deductive-inductive hybrid thematic analysis, we identify four collaboration-focused themes: workflow challenges, adoption perceptions, prospective features, and anticipated usability and ethical risks. These findings show how current ecosystems disrupt coordination and shared understanding, while highlighting opportunities for effective multi-user engagement. Our study contributes empirical insights into collaboration practices for high-dimensional scientific data visualization and analysis, offering design implications to enhance coordination, mutual awareness, and equitable participation in next-generation collaborative immersive platforms. These contributions point toward future environments enabling distributed, cross-device teamwork on high-dimensional scientific data.
comment: Conditionally accepted at the Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI 26)

title: Ethical Asymmetry in Human-Robot Interaction - An Empirical Test of Sparrow's Hypothesis
authors: Minyi Wang, Christoph Bartneck, Michael-John Turp, David Kaber
abstract: The ethics of human-robot interaction (HRI) have been discussed extensively based on three traditional frameworks: deontology, consequentialism, and virtue ethics. We conducted a mixed within/between experiment to investigate Sparrow's proposed ethical asymmetry hypothesis in human treatment of robots. The moral permissibility of action (MPA) was manipulated as a subject grouping variable, and virtue type (prudence, justice, courage, and temperance) was controlled as a within-subjects factor. We tested moral stimuli using an online questionnaire with Perceived Moral Permissibility of Action (PMPA) and Perceived Virtue Scores (PVS) as response measures. The PVS measure was based on an adaptation of the established Questionnaire on Cardinal Virtues (QCV), while the PMPA was based on Malle et al. [39] work. We found that the MPA significantly influenced the PMPA and perceived virtue scores. The best-fitting model to describe the relationship between PMPA and PVS was cubic, which is symmetrical in nature. Our study did not confirm Sparrow's asymmetry hypothesis. The adaptation of the QCV is expected to have utility for future studies, pending additional psychometric property assessments.

title: A Parametrized Complexity View on Robust Scheduling with Budgeted Uncertainty
authors: Noam Goldberg, Dvir Shabtay
abstract: In this study, we investigate a robust single-machine scheduling problem under processing time uncertainty. The uncertainty is modeled using the budgeted approach, where each job has a nominal and deviation processing time, and the number of deviations is bounded by Gamma. The objective is to minimize the maximum number of tardy jobs over all possible scenarios. Since the problem is NP-hard in general, we focus on analyzing its tractability under the assumption that some natural parameter of the problem is bounded by a constant. We consider three parameters: the robustness parameter Gamma, the number of distinct due dates in the instance, and the number of jobs with nonzero deviations. Using parametrized-complexity theory, we prove that the problem is W[1]-hard with respect to Gamma, but can be solved in XP time with respect to the same parameter. With respect to the number of different due dates, we establish a stronger hardness result by showing that the problem remains NP-hard even when there are only two different due dates and is solvable in pseudo-polynomial time when the number of due dates is upper bounded by a constant. To complement these results, we show that the case of a common (single) due date, reduces to a robust binary knapsack problem with equal item profits, which we prove to be solvable in polynomial time. Finally, we prove that the problem is solvable in FPT time with respect to the number of nonzero deviations.

title: Beyond the Prompt: Assessing Domain Knowledge Strategies for High-Dimensional LLM Optimization in Software Engineering
authors: Srinath Srinivasan, Tim Menzies
abstract:
Background/Context: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance on low-dimensional software engineering optimization tasks ($\le$11 features) but consistently underperform on high-dimensional problems where Bayesian methods dominate. A fundamental gap exists in understanding how systematic integration of domain knowledge (whether from humans or automated reasoning) can bridge this divide.
  Objective/Aim: We compare human versus artificial intelligence strategies for generating domain knowledge. We systematically evaluate four distinct architectures to determine if structured knowledge integration enables LLMs to generate effective warm starts for high-dimensional optimization.
  Method: We evaluate four approaches on MOOT datasets stratified by dimensionality: (1) Human-in-the-Loop Domain Knowledge Prompting (H-DKP), utilizing asynchronous expert feedback loops; (2) Adaptive Multi-Stage Prompting (AMP), implementing sequential constraint identification and validation; (3) Dimension-Aware Progressive Refinement (DAPR), conducting optimization in progressively expanding feature subspaces; and (4) Hybrid Knowledge-Model Approach (HKMA), synthesizing statistical scouting (TPE) with RAG-enhanced prompting. Performance is quantified via Chebyshev distance to optimal solutions and ranked using Scott-Knott clustering against an established baseline for LLM generated warm starts.
  Note that all human studies conducted as part of this study will comply with the policies of our local Institutional Review Board.

title: Deepfake Pornography is Resilient to Regulatory and Platform Shocks
authors: Alejandro Cuevas, Manoel Horta Ribeiro
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence tools have made it easier to create realistic, synthetic non-consensual explicit imagery (popularly known as deepfake pornography; hereinafter SNCEI) of people. Once created, this SNCEI is often shared on various websites, causing significant harm to victims. This emerging form of sexual abuse was recently criminalized in the US at the federal level by S.146, the TAKE IT DOWN Act. A week after the bill's passage became effectively imminent, the MrDeepfakes website -- one of the most notorious facilitators of SNCEI creation and dissemination -- shut down. Here, we explore the impact of the bill's passage and the subsequent shutdown as a compound intervention on the dissemination of SNCEI. We select three online forums where sexually explicit content is shared, each containing dedicated subforums to organize various types of sexually explicit content. By leveraging each forum's design, we compare activity in subforums dedicated to SNCEI with that in other pornographic genres using a synthetic control, quasi-experimental approach. Across websites, we observed an increase in the sharing and requests for SNCEI, and, in some cases, in new contributors. These results indicate that the compound intervention did not suppress SNCEI activity overall but instead coincided with its redistribution across platforms, with substantial heterogeneity in timing and magnitude. Together, our findings suggest that deplatforming and regulatory signals alone may shift where and when SNCEI is produced and shared, rather than reducing its prevalence.

title: From Task Solving to Robust Real-World Adaptation in LLM Agents
authors: Pouya Pezeshkpour, Estevam Hruschka
abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as specialized agents that plan, call tools, and take actions over extended horizons. Yet many existing evaluations assume a "clean interface" where dynamics are specified and stable, tools and sensors are reliable, and success is captured by a single explicit objective-often overestimating real-world readiness. In practice, agents face underspecified rules, unreliable signals, shifting environments, and implicit, multi-stakeholder goals. The challenge is therefore not just solving tasks, but adapting while solving: deciding what to trust, what is wanted, when to verify, and when to fall back or escalate. We stress-test deployment-relevant robustness under four operational circumstances: partial observability, dynamic environments, noisy signals, and dynamic agent state. We benchmark agentic LLMs in a grid-based game with a simple goal but long-horizon execution. Episodes violate clean-interface assumptions yet remain solvable, forcing agents to infer rules, pay for information, adapt to environmental and internal shifts, and act cautiously under noise. Across five state-of-the-art LLM agents, we find large gaps between nominal task-solving and deployment-like robustness. Performance generally degrades as grid size and horizon increase, but rankings are unstable: weaker models can beat stronger ones when strategy matches the uncertainty regime. Despite no explicit instruction, agents trade off completion, efficiency, and penalty avoidance, suggesting partial objective inference. Ablations and feature analyses reveal model-specific sensitivities and failure drivers, motivating work on verification, safe action selection, and objective inference under partial observability, noise, and non-stationarity.

title: Scaling Small Agents Through Strategy Auctions
authors: Lisa Alazraki, William F. Shen, Yoram Bachrach, Akhil Mathur
abstract: Small language models are increasingly viewed as a promising, cost-effective approach to agentic AI, with proponents claiming they are sufficiently capable for agentic workflows. However, while smaller agents can closely match larger ones on simple tasks, it remains unclear how their performance scales with task complexity, when large models become necessary, and how to better leverage small agents for long-horizon workloads. In this work, we empirically show that small agents' performance fails to scale with task complexity on deep search and coding tasks, and we introduce Strategy Auctions for Workload Efficiency (SALE), an agent framework inspired by freelancer marketplaces. In SALE, agents bid with short strategic plans, which are scored by a systematic cost-value mechanism and refined via a shared auction memory, enabling per-task routing and continual self-improvement without training a separate router or running all models to completion. Across deep search and coding tasks of varying complexity, SALE reduces reliance on the largest agent by 53%, lowers overall cost by 35%, and consistently improves upon the largest agent's pass@1 with only a negligible overhead beyond executing the final trace. In contrast, established routers that rely on task descriptions either underperform the largest agent or fail to reduce cost -- often both -- underscoring their poor fit for agentic workflows. These results suggest that while small agents may be insufficient for complex workloads, they can be effectively "scaled up" through coordinated task allocation and test-time self-improvement. More broadly, they motivate a systems-level view of agentic AI in which performance gains come less from ever-larger individual models and more from market-inspired coordination mechanisms that organize heterogeneous agents into efficient, adaptive ecosystems.

title: On the Sample Efficiency of Inverse Dynamics Models for Semi-Supervised Imitation Learning
authors: Sacha Morin, Moonsub Byeon, Alexia Jolicoeur-Martineau, Sébastien Lachapelle
abstract: Semi-supervised imitation learning (SSIL) consists in learning a policy from a small dataset of action-labeled trajectories and a much larger dataset of action-free trajectories. Some SSIL methods learn an inverse dynamics model (IDM) to predict the action from the current state and the next state. An IDM can act as a policy when paired with a video model (VM-IDM) or as a label generator to perform behavior cloning on action-free data (IDM labeling). In this work, we first show that VM-IDM and IDM labeling learn the same policy in a limit case, which we call the IDM-based policy. We then argue that the previously observed advantage of IDM-based policies over behavior cloning is due to the superior sample efficiency of IDM learning, which we attribute to two causes: (i) the ground-truth IDM tends to be contained in a lower complexity hypothesis class relative to the expert policy, and (ii) the ground-truth IDM is often less stochastic than the expert policy. We argue these claims based on insights from statistical learning theory and novel experiments, including a study of IDM-based policies using recent architectures for unified video-action prediction (UVA). Motivated by these insights, we finally propose an improved version of the existing LAPO algorithm for latent action policy learning.

title: Exposing Vulnerabilities in Explanation for Time Series Classifiers via Dual-Target Attacks
authors: Bohan Wang, Zewen Liu, Lu Lin, Hui Liu, Li Xiong, Ming Jin, Wei Jin
abstract: Interpretable time series deep learning systems are often assessed by checking temporal consistency on explanations, implicitly treating this as evidence of robustness. We show that this assumption can fail: Predictions and explanations can be adversarially decoupled, enabling targeted misclassification while the explanation remains plausible and consistent with a chosen reference rationale. We propose TSEF (Time Series Explanation Fooler), a dual-target attack that jointly manipulates the classifier and explainer outputs. In contrast to single-objective misclassification attacks that disrupt explanation and spread attribution mass broadly, TSEF achieves targeted prediction changes while keeping explanations consistent with the reference. Across multiple datasets and explainer backbones, our results consistently reveal that explanation stability is a misleading proxy for decision robustness and motivate coupling-aware robustness evaluations for trustworthy time series tasks.

title: SVD-ViT: Does SVD Make Vision Transformers Attend More to the Foreground?
authors: Haruhiko Murata, Kazuhiro Hotta
abstract: Vision Transformers (ViT) have been established as large-scale foundation models. However, because self-attention operates globally, they lack an explicit mechanism to distinguish foreground from background. As a result, ViT may learn unnecessary background features and artifacts, leading to degraded classification performance. To address this issue, we propose SVD-ViT, which leverages singular value decomposition (SVD) to prioritize the learning of foreground features. SVD-ViT consists of three components-\textbf{SPC module}, \textbf{SSVA}, and \textbf{ID-RSVD}-and suppresses task-irrelevant factors such as background noise and artifacts by extracting and aggregating singular vectors that capture object foreground information. Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves classification accuracy and effectively learns informative foreground representations while reducing the impact of background noise.

title: Rate-Distortion Analysis of Optically Passive Vision Compression
authors: Ronald Ogden, David Fridovich-Keil, Takashi Tanaka
abstract: The use of remote vision sensors for autonomous decision-making poses the challenge of transmitting high-volume visual data over resource-constrained channels in real-time. In robotics and control applications, many systems can quickly destabilize, which can exacerbate the issue by necessitating higher sampling frequencies. This work proposes a novel sensing paradigm in which an event camera observes the optically generated cosine transform of a visual scene, enabling high-speed, computation-free video compression inspired by modern video codecs. In this study, we simulate this optically passive vision compression (OPVC) scheme and compare its rate-distortion performance to that of a standalone event camera (SAEC). We find that the rate-distortion performance of the OPVC scheme surpasses that of the SAEC and that this performance gap increases as the spatial resolution of the event camera increases.

title: Privately Fine-Tuned LLMs Preserve Temporal Dynamics in Tabular Data
authors: Lucas Rosenblatt, Peihan Liu, Ryan McKenna, Natalia Ponomareva
abstract: Research on differentially private synthetic tabular data has largely focused on independent and identically distributed rows where each record corresponds to a unique individual. This perspective neglects the temporal complexity in longitudinal datasets, such as electronic health records, where a user contributes an entire (sub) table of sequential events. While practitioners might attempt to model such data by flattening user histories into high-dimensional vectors for use with standard marginal-based mechanisms, we demonstrate that this strategy is insufficient. Flattening fails to preserve temporal coherence even when it maintains valid marginal distributions. We introduce PATH, a novel generative framework that treats the full table as the unit of synthesis and leverages the autoregressive capabilities of privately fine-tuned large language models. Extensive evaluations show that PATH effectively captures long-range dependencies that traditional methods miss. Empirically, our method reduces the distributional distance to real trajectories by over 60% and reduces state transition errors by nearly 50% compared to leading marginal mechanisms while achieving similar marginal fidelity.

title: BiTimeCrossNet: Time-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Pediatric Sleep
authors: Saurav Raj Pandey, Harlin Lee
abstract:
We present BiTimeCrossNet (BTCNet), a multimodal self-supervised learning framework for long physiological recordings such as overnight sleep studies. While many existing approaches train on short segments treated as independent samples, BTCNet incorporates information about when each segment occurs within its parent recording, for example within a sleep session. BTCNet further learns pairwise interactions between physiological signals via cross-attention, without requiring task labels or sequence-level supervision.
  We evaluate BTCNet on pediatric sleep data across six downstream tasks, including sleep staging, arousal detection, and respiratory event detection. Under frozen-backbone linear probing, BTCNet consistently outperforms an otherwise identical non-time-aware variant, with gains that generalize to an independent pediatric dataset. Compared to existing multimodal self-supervised sleep models, BTCNet achieves strong performance, particularly on respiration-related tasks.

title: Provable Effects of Data Replay in Continual Learning: A Feature Learning Perspective
authors: Meng Ding, Jinhui Xu, Kaiyi Ji
