title: RDT2: Exploring the Scaling Limit of UMI Data Towards Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Generalization
authors: Songming Liu, Bangguo Li, Kai Ma, Lingxuan Wu, Hengkai Tan, Xiao Ouyang, Hang Su, Jun Zhu
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models hold promise for generalist robotics but currently struggle with data scarcity, architectural inefficiencies, and the inability to generalize across different hardware platforms. We introduce RDT2, a robotic foundation model built upon a 7B parameter VLM designed to enable zero-shot deployment on novel embodiments for open-vocabulary tasks. To achieve this, we collected one of the largest open-source robotic datasets--over 10,000 hours of demonstrations in diverse families--using an enhanced, embodiment-agnostic Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI). Our approach employs a novel three-stage training recipe that aligns discrete linguistic knowledge with continuous control via Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), flow-matching, and distillation for real-time inference. Consequently, RDT2 becomes one of the first models that simultaneously zero-shot generalizes to unseen objects, scenes, instructions, and even robotic platforms. Besides, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in dexterous, long-horizon, and dynamic downstream tasks like playing table tennis. See https://rdt-robotics.github.io/rdt2/ for more information.

title: Multi-Level Testing of Conversational AI Systems
authors: Elena Masserini
abstract: Conversational AI systems combine AI-based solutions with the flexibility of conversational interfaces. However, most existing testing solutions do not straightforwardly adapt to the characteristics of conversational interaction or to the behavior of AI components. To address this limitation, this Ph.D. thesis investigates a new family of testing approaches for conversational AI systems, focusing on the validation of their constituent elements at different levels of granularity, from the integration between the language and the AI components, to individual conversational agents, up to multi-agent implementations of conversational AI systems
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, Accepted at IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE) - Doctoral Symposium Track, 2026
zh_title: 对话式人工智能系统的多层次测试
translation: 对话式人工智能系统将基于人工智能的解决方案与对话界面的灵活性相结合。然而，大多数现有的测试解决方案并不能直接适应对话交互的特性或人工智能组件的行为。为解决这一局限性，本博士论文研究了一系列新的对话式人工智能系统的测试方法，重点关注其构成元素在不同粒度级别上的验证，范围涵盖语言与人工智能组件之间的集成、单个对话代理，直至对话式人工智能系统的多代理实现。
tldr: 针对现有测试方法无法有效验证对话式AI系统的问题，本研究提出了一套多层次的测试方法，用于验证从组件集成到多代理系统的不同粒度的AI构成要素。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了一套多层次的测试方法，以应对现有测试方案难以适应对话交互特性和AI组件行为的局限性。其重要性在于为确保复杂对话式AI系统的可靠性提供了系统性的验证框架。论文的局限性（根据摘要推断）可能在于尚未深入探讨实际部署中大规模系统的性能和维护问题。
motivation: 现有的大多数测试解决方案不能直接适应对话交互的特性或AI组件的行为，这限制了对结合了AI解决方案和对话界面的对话式AI系统的有效测试。
method: 研究了一系列新的测试方法，重点关注从语言与AI组件的集成，到单个对话代理，再到多代理实现的各个粒度级别的构成元素的验证。

title: PQTNet: Pixel-wise Quantitative Thermography Neural Network for Estimating Defect Depth in Polylactic Acid Parts by Additive Manufacturing
authors: Lei Deng, Wenhao Huang, Chao Yang, Haoyuan Zheng, Yinbin Tian, Yue Ma
abstract: Defect depth quantification in additively manufactured (AM) components remains a significant challenge for non-destructive testing (NDT). This study proposes a Pixel-wise Quantitative Thermography Neural Network (PQT-Net) to address this challenge for polylactic acid (PLA) parts. A key innovation is a novel data augmentation strategy that reconstructs thermal sequence data into two-dimensional stripe images, preserving the complete temporal evolution of heat diffusion for each pixel. The PQT-Net architecture incorporates a pre-trained EfficientNetV2-S backbone and a custom Residual Regression Head (RRH) with learnable parameters to refine outputs. Comparative experiments demonstrate the superiority of PQT-Net over other deep learning models, achieving a minimum Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0094 mm and a coefficient of determination (R) exceeding 99%. The high precision of PQT-Net underscores its potential for robust quantitative defect characterization in AM.
zh_title: PQTNet：用于通过增材制造估算聚乳酸部件缺陷深度的像素级定量热成像神经网络
translation: 在增材制造（AM）部件中量化缺陷深度仍然是非破坏性测试（NDT）中的一个重大挑战。本研究提出了一种像素级定量热成像神经网络（PQT-Net）来解决聚乳酸（PLA）部件的这一挑战。一个关键的创新点是一种新颖的数据增强策略，它将热序列数据重构为二维条纹图像，从而为每个像素保留了热扩散的完整时间演变。PQT-Net 架构结合了一个预训练的 EfficientNetV2-S 主干和一个具有可学习参数的自定义残差回归头（RRH）来完善输出。比较实验证明了 PQT-Net 相较于其他深度学习模型的优越性，实现了最小平均绝对误差（MAE）0.0094 毫米和超过 99% 的决定系数（R）。PQT-Net 的高精度凸显了其在 AM 中进行稳健定量缺陷表征的潜力。
tldr: PQT-Net 是一种新的深度学习方法，通过创新的数据增强和 EfficientNetV2-S 架构，实现了对增材制造 PLA 部件中缺陷深度的精确（MAE 0.0094 mm）像素级定量估计。
ai_comments: PQT-Net 的创新点在于使用新颖的数据增强策略将热序列数据重构为二维条纹图像，从而保留了每个像素热扩散的完整时间演变。该方法在缺陷深度估计任务中表现出极高的精度。局限性可能在于仅在聚乳酸（PLA）部件上进行了测试，其普适性有待验证。
motivation: 在增材制造（AM）部件中量化缺陷深度是非破坏性测试（NDT）中的一个重大挑战。
method: PQT-Net 采用了一种新颖的数据增强策略，将热序列数据重构为二维条纹图像，以保留热扩散的时间演变。网络架构结合了预训练的 EfficientNetV2-S 主干和一个带有可学习参数的自定义残差回归头（RRH）。
results: 与其它深度学习模型相比，PQT-Net 表现出卓越的性能，实现了最小平均绝对误差（MAE）0.0094 毫米和超过 99% 的决定系数（R）。
conclusion: PQT-Net 的高精度证明了其在增材制造中进行稳健的定量缺陷表征的潜力。

title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
authors: Menglin Xia, Xuchao Zhang, Shantanu Dixit, Paramaguru Harimurugan, Rujia Wang, Victor Ruhle, Robert Sim, Chetan Bansal, Saravan Rajmohan
abstract: Agent memory systems must accommodate continuously growing information while supporting efficient, context-aware retrieval for downstream tasks. Abstraction is essential for scaling agent memory, yet it often comes at the cost of specificity, obscuring the fine-grained details required for effective reasoning. We introduce Memora, a harmonic memory representation that structurally balances abstraction and specificity. Memora organizes information via its primary abstractions that index concrete memory values and consolidate related updates into unified memory entries, while cue anchors expand retrieval access across diverse aspects of the memory and connect related memories. Building on this structure, we employ a retrieval policy that actively exploits these memory connections to retrieve relevant information beyond direct semantic similarity. Theoretically, we show that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Knowledge Graph (KG)-based memory systems emerge as special cases of our framework. Empirically, Memora establishes a new state-of-the-art on the LoCoMo and LongMemEval benchmarks, demonstrating better retrieval relevance and reasoning effectiveness as memory scales.
zh_title: Memora：平衡抽象与特异性的谐波记忆表示
translation: 智能体内存系统必须能够容纳不断增长的信息，同时支持对下游任务的高效、上下文感知的检索。抽象化对于扩展智能体内存至关重要，但它通常是以牺牲特异性为代价的，从而模糊了有效推理所需的细粒度细节。我们引入了Memora，一种结构上平衡抽象和特异性的谐波记忆表示。Memora通过其主抽象来组织信息，主抽象索引具体记忆值并将相关更新整合到统一的记忆条目中，而线索锚点则扩展了跨越记忆不同方面的检索访问并连接相关的记忆。在此结构的基础上，我们采用了一种主动利用这些记忆连接的检索策略，以检索超越直接语义相似性的相关信息。理论上，我们证明了标准的检索增强生成（RAG）和基于知识图谱（KG）的记忆系统是我们的框架的特例。实证上，Memora在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准测试上建立了新的最先进水平，证明了随着内存规模的扩大，其检索相关性和推理有效性得到了更好的体现。
tldr: Memora是一种新的记忆结构，通过主抽象和线索锚点巧妙地平衡了记忆的抽象可扩展性和具体细节的检索特异性，在内存规模增长时依然保持了高效和准确的检索与推理，超越了现有方法。
ai_comments: Memora的创新在于其“谐波记忆表示”结构，它通过“主抽象”和“线索锚点”的设计，在可扩展的抽象性和必要的细节特异性之间取得了平衡。理论上将RAG和KG视为其特例是一个重要的贡献，表明了其通用性。实验结果（SOTA）证实了其有效性。
motivation: 现有的代理内存系统在处理不断增长的信息和支持高效、上下文感知的检索之间存在矛盾：抽象化有助于扩展，但会牺牲有效推理所需的细节特异性。
method: Memora通过组织信息，使用“主抽象”来索引具体记忆值并整合相关更新到统一的记忆条目中；同时使用“线索锚点”来扩展检索访问并连接相关记忆。检索策略主动利用这些记忆连接进行超越直接语义相似性的检索。
results: Memora在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准测试上建立了新的最先进水平（SOTA），证明了随着内存规模的扩大，其检索相关性和推理有效性得到了提升。
conclusion: Memora通过其结构化设计，成功地在内存规模扩展的同时保持了高检索相关性和推理有效性，建立了新的最先进水平。

title: Invisible Clean-Label Backdoor Attacks for Generative Data Augmentation
authors: Ting Xiang, Jinhui Zhao, Changjian Chen, Zhuo Tang
abstract: With the rapid advancement of image generative models, generative data augmentation has become an effective way to enrich training images, especially when only small-scale datasets are available. At the same time, in practical applications, generative data augmentation can be vulnerable to clean-label backdoor attacks, which aim to bypass human inspection. However, based on theoretical analysis and preliminary experiments, we observe that directly applying existing pixel-level clean-label backdoor attack methods (e.g., COMBAT) to generated images results in low attack success rates. This motivates us to move beyond pixel-level triggers and focus instead on the latent feature level. To this end, we propose InvLBA, an invisible clean-label backdoor attack method for generative data augmentation by latent perturbation. We theoretically prove that the generalization of the clean accuracy and attack success rates of InvLBA can be guaranteed. Experiments on multiple datasets show that our method improves the attack success rate by 46.43% on average, with almost no reduction in clean accuracy and high robustness against SOTA defense methods.
zh_title: 面向生成数据增强的隐形清晰标签后门攻击
translation: 随着图像生成模型的快速发展，生成式数据增强已成为丰富训练图像的有效方法，尤其是在仅有小规模数据集可用时。同时，在实际应用中，生成式数据增强容易受到清晰标签后门攻击的威胁，这类攻击旨在绕过人工检查。然而，基于理论分析和初步实验，我们观察到直接将现有的像素级清晰标签后门攻击方法（例如COMBAT）应用于生成图像会导致较低的攻击成功率。这促使我们超越像素级，转而关注潜在特征级别。为此，我们提出了InvLBA，一种通过潜在扰动实现的、面向生成数据增强的隐形清晰标签后门攻击方法。我们从理论上证明了InvLBA的干净准确率和攻击成功率的泛化性可以得到保证。在多个数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法平均提高了攻击成功率46.43%，同时对干净准确率的降低几乎可以忽略不计，并对最先进的防御方法具有高鲁棒性。
tldr: 针对生成图像的后门攻击，本研究发现像素级攻击效果差，因此提出了一种在生成模型的潜在特征空间中进行扰动的InvLBA方法，该方法在保持模型干净性能的同时，显著提高了攻击成功率并增强了对防御的抵抗力。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地将后门攻击从像素级别转移到生成模型的核心——潜在特征级别，以应对生成数据增强的特殊性，并给出了理论保证。其局限性在于，虽然声称具有高鲁棒性，但未具体说明防御方法的细节。
motivation: 现有的像素级清晰标签后门攻击方法在应用于生成图像时，攻击成功率很低，这促使研究人员将焦点从像素级别转移到生成模型的潜在特征级别。
method: 提出了一种名为InvLBA的、针对生成数据增强的、基于潜在特征扰动的隐形清晰标签后门攻击方法。该方法通过在潜在特征空间中引入扰动来实现后门植入。
results: 与现有方法相比，InvLBA将平均攻击成功率提高了46.43%，同时对干净准确率的影响几乎可以忽略不计，并展现出对现有最先进防御方法的强大鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该方法在多个数据集上显著提高了攻击成功率（平均提高46.43%），同时保持了高干净准确率，并对现有最先进的防御方法表现出高鲁棒性。

title: MIRROR: A Multi-Agent Framework with Iterative Adaptive Revision and Hierarchical Retrieval for Optimization Modeling in Operations Research
authors: Yifan Shi, Jialong Shi, Jiayi Wang, Ye Fan, Jianyong Sun
abstract: Operations Research (OR) relies on expert-driven modeling-a slow and fragile process ill-suited to novel scenarios. While large language models (LLMs) can automatically translate natural language into optimization models, existing approaches either rely on costly post-training or employ multi-agent frameworks, yet most still lack reliable collaborative error correction and task-specific retrieval, often leading to incorrect outputs. We propose MIRROR, a fine-tuning-free, end-to-end multi-agent framework that directly translates natural language optimization problems into mathematical models and solver code. MIRROR integrates two core mechanisms: (1) execution-driven iterative adaptive revision for automatic error correction, and (2) hierarchical retrieval to fetch relevant modeling and coding exemplars from a carefully curated exemplar library. Experiments show that MIRROR outperforms existing methods on standard OR benchmarks, with notable results on complex industrial datasets such as IndustryOR and Mamo-ComplexLP. By combining precise external knowledge infusion with systematic error correction, MIRROR provides non-expert users with an efficient and reliable OR modeling solution, overcoming the fundamental limitations of general-purpose LLMs in expert optimization tasks.
zh_title: MIRROR：一种具有迭代自适应修订和分层检索的多智能体框架，用于运筹学中的优化建模
translation: 我们提出了MIRROR，一个无需微调的端到端多智能体框架，它直接将自然语言优化问题转化为数学模型和求解器代码。MIRROR集成了两个核心机制：（1）用于自动纠错的执行驱动的迭代自适应修订；以及（2）用于从精心策划的示例库中获取相关建模和编码示例的分层检索。实验表明，MIRROR在标准OR基准测试中优于现有方法，在IndustryOR和Mamo-ComplexLP等复杂的工业数据集上取得了显著成果。通过结合精确的外部知识注入和系统的错误纠正，MIRROR为非专家用户提供了一种高效可靠的OR建模解决方案，克服了通用大型语言模型在专家优化任务中的根本局限。
tldr: MIRROR是一个无需微调的多智能体框架，通过自动纠错（迭代修订）和知识检索（分层检索），能可靠地将自然语言优化问题转化为数学模型和代码，比现有方法在OR基准测试中表现更好。
ai_comments: MIRROR的创新之处在于其无需微调的端到端多智能体框架，特别是集成了执行驱动的迭代自适应修订机制和分层检索机制，解决了现有方法在优化建模中缺乏可靠的协同纠错和任务特定检索的问题。其重要性在于为非专家用户提供了一种高效可靠的运筹学建模解决方案。局限性是未在摘要中明确提及，但可能存在于复杂性或通用性方面。
motivation: 运筹学（OR）依赖于专家驱动的建模，这是一种缓慢且脆弱的过程，不适合新颖的场景。现有的利用大型语言模型（LLMs）将自然语言翻译成优化模型的方法，要么需要昂贵的后训练，要么缺乏可靠的协作错误修正和任务特定的检索，常常导致错误的输出。
method: MIRROR是一个无需微调的端到端多智能体框架，它集成了两个核心机制：（1）执行驱动的迭代自适应修订，用于自动纠错；和（2）分层检索，用于从精心策划的示例库中获取相关的建模和编码示例。
results: 实验表明，MIRROR在标准OR基准测试中优于现有方法，在IndustryOR和Mamo-ComplexLP等复杂的工业数据集上取得了显著成果。
conclusion: 通过结合精确的外部知识注入和系统的错误纠正，MIRROR为非专家用户提供了一种高效可靠的运筹学建模解决方案，克服了通用大型语言模型在专家优化任务中的根本局限。

title: MedSAM-Agent: Empowering Interactive Medical Image Segmentation with Multi-turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
authors: Shengyuan Liu, Liuxin Bao, Qi Yang, Wanting Geng, Boyun Zheng, Chenxin Li, Wenting Chen, Houwen Peng, Yixuan Yuan
abstract: Medical image segmentation is evolving from task-specific models toward generalizable frameworks. Recent research leverages Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as autonomous agents, employing reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) to orchestrate specialized tools like the Segment Anything Model (SAM). However, these approaches often rely on single-turn, rigid interaction strategies and lack process-level supervision during training, which hinders their ability to fully exploit the dynamic potential of interactive tools and leads to redundant actions. To bridge this gap, we propose MedSAM-Agent, a framework that reformulates interactive segmentation as a multi-step autonomous decision-making process. First, we introduce a hybrid prompting strategy for expert-curated trajectory generation, enabling the model to internalize human-like decision heuristics and adaptive refinement strategies. Furthermore, we develop a two-stage training pipeline that integrates multi-turn, end-to-end outcome verification with a clinical-fidelity process reward design to promote interaction parsimony and decision efficiency. Extensive experiments across 6 medical modalities and 21 datasets demonstrate that MedSAM-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively unifying autonomous medical reasoning with robust, iterative optimization. Code is available \href{https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/MedSAM-Agent}{here}.

title: Weighted finite difference methods for a nonlinear Klein--Gordon equation with high oscillations in space and time
authors: Yanyan Shi, Christian Lubich
abstract: We consider a nonlinear Klein--Gordon equation in the nonrelativistic limit regime with initial data in the form of a modulated highly oscillatory exponential. In this regime of a small scaling parameter $\varepsilon$, the solution exhibits rapid oscillations in both time and space, posing challenges for numerical approximation. We propose an explicit and an implicit exponentially weighted finite difference method. While the explicit weighted leapfrog method needs to satisfy a CFL-type stability condition, the implicit weighted Crank--Nicolson method is unconditionally stable. Both methods achieve second-order accuracy with time steps and mesh sizes that are not restricted in magnitude by $\varepsilon$. The methods are uniformly convergent in the range from arbitrarily small to moderately bounded $\varepsilon$. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical results.

title: Information-Theoretic Multi-Model Fusion for Target-Oriented Adaptive Sampling in Materials Design
authors: Yixuan Zhang, Zhiyuan Li, Weijia He, Mian Dai, Chen Shen, Teng Long, Hongbin Zhang
abstract: Target-oriented discovery under limited evaluation budgets requires making reliable progress in high-dimensional, heterogeneous design spaces where each new measurement is costly, whether experimental or high-fidelity simulation. We present an information-theoretic framework for target-oriented adaptive sampling that reframes optimization as trajectory discovery: instead of approximating the full response surface, the method maintains and refines a low-entropy information state that concentrates search on target-relevant directions. The approach couples data, model beliefs, and physics/structure priors through dimension-aware information budgeting, adaptive bootstrapped distillation over a heterogeneous surrogate reservoir, and structure-aware candidate manifold analysis with Kalman-inspired multi-model fusion to balance consensus-driven exploitation and disagreement-driven exploration. Evaluated under a single unified protocol without dataset-specific tuning, the framework improves sample efficiency and reliability across 14 single- and multi-objective materials design tasks spanning candidate pools from $600$ to $4 \times 10^6$ and feature dimensions from $10$ to $10^3$, typically reaching top-performing regions within 100 evaluations. Complementary 20-dimensional synthetic benchmarks (Ackley, Rastrigin, Schwefel) further demonstrate robustness to rugged and multimodal landscapes.
zh_title: 材料设计中目标导向的自适应采样的信息论多模型融合
translation: 在有限的评估预算下进行目标导向的发现，需要在高维、异构的设计空间中取得可靠的进展，其中每次新的测量（无论是实验还是高保真模拟）都是昂贵的。我们提出了一个信息论框架用于目标导向的自适应采样，它将优化重构为轨迹发现：该方法不近似完整的响应曲面，而是维护和精炼一个低熵信息状态，将搜索集中在目标相关的方向上。该方法通过维度感知的、自适应的引导蒸馏以及受卡尔曼启发的结构感知候选流形分析与多模型融合，来平衡共识驱动的利用和分歧驱动的探索，从而将数据、模型信念和物理/结构先验耦合起来。该框架在一个统一的协议下进行评估，无需数据集特定的调整，在跨越600到$4 \times 10^6$候选池和10到$10^3$特征维度的14个单目标和多目标材料设计任务中，提高了样本效率和可靠性，通常在100次评估内即可达到最佳性能区域。互补的20维合成基准测试（Ackley、Rastrigin、Schwefel）进一步证明了其对崎岖和多模态地形的鲁棒性。
tldr: 为解决高维材料设计中昂贵的评估问题，我们设计了一个基于信息论的自适应采样框架，它不拟合整个响应面，而是通过精炼低熵信息状态来集中搜索目标方向，并通过多模型融合平衡探索与利用，在大量材料设计任务中，以极少的评估次数（通常<100次）达到了最优性能。
ai_comments: 该方法创新性地将优化重构为轨迹发现，并利用信息论框架来指导在昂贵评估下的高维设计空间中的目标导向自适应采样。其多模型融合机制（受卡尔曼滤波启发）在探索和利用之间取得了很好的平衡。该方法在广泛的材料设计任务上展示了优异的样本效率和可靠性，且无需针对特定数据集进行调优。
motivation: 在材料设计中，目标导向的发现需要在高维、异构的设计空间中进行，同时每个新测量（实验或高保真模拟）的成本都很高昂，因此需要提高样本效率和可靠性。
method: 该方法提出了一个信息论框架，将优化重构为轨迹发现，维护并精炼一个低熵信息状态，以集中搜索于目标相关方向。该方法通过维度感知的预算分配、异构代理池上的自适应引导蒸馏，以及受卡尔曼滤波启发的结构感知候选流形分析与多模型融合，来耦合数据、模型信念和物理/结构先验。
results: 该框架在14个单目标和多目标材料设计任务上，无需特定数据集调优，样本效率和可靠性得到提高，通常在100次评估内即可达到最佳性能区域。在互补的20维合成基准测试（Ackley, Rastrigin, Schwefel）上也证明了对崎岖和多模态地形的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 该信息论框架通过轨迹发现范式，在有限评估预算下实现了目标导向的自适应采样，并在多种材料设计任务和合成基准测试中展现了优于现有方法的样本效率和可靠性。

title: GuardReasoner-Omni: A Reasoning-based Multi-modal Guardrail for Text, Image, and Video
authors: Zhenhao Zhu, Yue Liu, Yanpei Guo, Wenjie Qu, Cancan Chen, Yufei He, Yibo Li, Yulin Chen, Tianyi Wu, Huiying Xu, Xinzhong Zhu, Jiaheng Zhang
abstract: We present GuardReasoner-Omni, a reasoning-based guardrail model designed to moderate text, image, and video data. First, we construct a comprehensive training corpus comprising 148k samples spanning these three modalities. Our training pipeline follows a two-stage paradigm to incentivize the model to deliberate before making decisions: (1) conducting SFT to cold-start the model with explicit reasoning capabilities and structural adherence; and (2) performing RL, incorporating an error-driven exploration reward to incentivize deeper reasoning on hard samples. We release a suite of models scaled at 2B and 4B parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GuardReasoner-Omni achieves superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art baselines across various guardrail benchmarks. Notably, GuardReasoner-Omni (2B) significantly surpasses the runner-up by 5.3% F1 score.

title: Pi-GS: Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with Dense π^3 Initialization
authors: Manuel Hofer, Markus Steinberger, Thomas Köhler
abstract: Novel view synthesis has evolved rapidly, advancing from Neural Radiance Fields to 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), which offers real-time rendering and rapid training without compromising visual fidelity. However, 3DGS relies heavily on accurate camera poses and high-quality point cloud initialization, which are difficult to obtain in sparse-view scenarios. While traditional Structure from Motion (SfM) pipelines often fail in these settings, existing learning-based point estimation alternatives typically require reliable reference views and remain sensitive to pose or depth errors. In this work, we propose a robust method utilizing π^3, a reference-free point cloud estimation network. We integrate dense initialization from π^3 with a regularization scheme designed to mitigate geometric inaccuracies. Specifically, we employ uncertainty-guided depth supervision, normal consistency loss, and depth warping. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Tanks and Temples, LLFF, DTU, and MipNeRF360 datasets.

title: Bayesian Conformal Prediction as a Decision Risk Problem
authors: Fanyi Wu, Veronika Lohmanova, Samuel Kaski, Michele Caprio
abstract: Bayesian posterior predictive densities as non-conformity scores and Bayesian quadrature are used to estimate and minimise the expected prediction set size. Operating within a split conformal framework, BCP provides valid coverage guarantees and demonstrates reliable empirical coverage under model misspecification. Across regression and classification tasks, including distribution-shifted settings such as ImageNet-A, BCP yields prediction sets of comparable size to split conformal prediction, while exhibiting substantially lower run-to-run variability in set size. In sparse regression with nominal coverage of 80 percent, BCP achieves 81 percent empirical coverage under a misspecified prior, whereas Bayesian credible intervals under-cover at 49 percent.
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at EIML 2025 at Eurips

title: From Inexact Gradients to Byzantine Robustness: Acceleration and Optimization under Similarity
authors: Renaud Gaucher, Aymeric Dieuleveut, Hadrien Hendrikx
abstract:
Standard federated learning algorithms are vulnerable to adversarial nodes, a.k.a. Byzantine failures. To solve this issue, robust distributed learning algorithms have been developed, which typically replace parameter averaging by robust aggregations. While generic conditions on these aggregations exist to guarantee the convergence of (Stochastic) Gradient Descent (SGD), the analyses remain rather ad-hoc. This hinders the development of more complex robust algorithms, such as accelerated ones. In this work, we show that Byzantine-robust distributed optimization can, under standard generic assumptions, be cast as a general optimization with inexact gradient oracles (with both additive and multiplicative error terms), an active field of research.
  This allows for instance to directly show that GD on top of standard robust aggregation procedures obtains optimal asymptotic error in the Byzantine setting. Going further, we propose two optimization schemes to speed up the convergence. The first one is a Nesterov-type accelerated scheme whose proof directly derives from accelerated inexact gradient results applied to our formulation. The second one hinges on Optimization under Similarity, in which the server leverages an auxiliary loss function that approximates the global loss. Both approaches allow to drastically reduce the communication complexity compared to previous methods, as we show theoretically and empirically.

title: SCASRec: A Self-Correcting and Auto-Stopping Model for Generative Route List Recommendation
authors: Chao Chen, Longfei Xu, Daohan Su, Tengfei Liu, Hanyu Guo, Yihai Duan, Kaikui Liu, Xiangxiang Chu
abstract: Route recommendation systems commonly adopt a multi-stage pipeline involving fine-ranking and re-ranking to produce high-quality ordered recommendations. However, this paradigm faces three critical limitations. First, there is a misalignment between offline training objectives and online metrics. Offline gains do not necessarily translate to online improvements. Actual performance must be validated through A/B testing, which may potentially compromise the user experience. Second, redundancy elimination relies on rigid, handcrafted rules that lack adaptability to the high variance in user intent and the unstructured complexity of real-world scenarios. Third, the strict separation between fine-ranking and re-ranking stages leads to sub-optimal performance. Since each module is optimized in isolation, the fine-ranking stage remains oblivious to the list-level objectives (e.g., diversity) targeted by the re-ranker, thereby preventing the system from achieving a jointly optimized global optimum. To overcome these intertwined challenges, we propose \textbf{SCASRec} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{C}orrecting and \textbf{A}uto-\textbf{S}topping \textbf{Rec}ommendation), a unified generative framework that integrates ranking and redundancy elimination into a single end-to-end process. SCASRec introduces a stepwise corrective reward (SCR) to guide list-wise refinement by focusing on hard samples, and employs a learnable End-of-Recommendation (EOR) token to terminate generation adaptively when no further improvement is expected. Experiments on two large-scale, open-sourced route recommendation datasets demonstrate that SCASRec establishes an SOTA in offline and online settings. SCASRec has been fully deployed in a real-world navigation app, demonstrating its effectiveness.

title: PWAVEP: Purifying Imperceptible Adversarial Perturbations in 3D Point Clouds via Spectral Graph Wavelets
authors: Haoran Li, Renyang Liu, Hongjia Liu, Chen Wang, Long Yin, Jian Xu
abstract: Recent progress in adversarial attacks on 3D point clouds, particularly in achieving spatial imperceptibility and high attack performance, presents significant challenges for defenders. Current defensive approaches remain cumbersome, often requiring invasive model modifications, expensive training procedures or auxiliary data access. To address these threats, in this paper, we propose a plug-and-play and non-invasive defense mechanism in the spectral domain, grounded in a theoretical and empirical analysis of the relationship between imperceptible perturbations and high-frequency spectral components. Building upon these insights, we introduce a novel purification framework, termed PWAVEP, which begins by computing a spectral graph wavelet domain saliency score and local sparsity score for each point. Guided by these values, PWAVEP adopts a hierarchical strategy, it eliminates the most salient points, which are identified as hardly recoverable adversarial outliers. Simultaneously, it applies a spectral filtering process to a broader set of moderately salient points. This process leverages a graph wavelet transform to attenuate high-frequency coefficients associated with the targeted points, thereby effectively suppressing adversarial noise. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the proposed PWAVEP achieves superior accuracy and robustness compared to existing approaches, advancing the state-of-the-art in 3D point cloud purification. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/a772316182/pwavep

title: Accurate Failure Prediction in Agents Does Not Imply Effective Failure Prevention
authors: Rakshith Vasudev, Melisa Russak, Dan Bikel, Waseem Alshikh
abstract:
Proactive interventions by LLM critic models are often assumed to improve reliability, yet their effects at deployment time are poorly understood. We show that a binary LLM critic with strong offline accuracy (AUROC 0.94) can nevertheless cause severe performance degradation, inducing a 26 percentage point (pp) collapse on one model while affecting another by near zero pp. This variability demonstrates that LLM critic accuracy alone is insufficient to determine whether intervention is safe.
  We identify a disruption-recovery tradeoff: interventions may recover failing trajectories but also disrupt trajectories that would have succeeded. Based on this insight, we propose a pre-deployment test that uses a small pilot of 50 tasks to estimate whether intervention is likely to help or harm, without requiring full deployment. Across benchmarks, the test correctly anticipates outcomes: intervention degrades performance on high-success tasks (0 to -26 pp), while yielding a modest improvement on the high-failure ALFWorld benchmark (+2.8 pp, p=0.014). The primary value of our framework is therefore identifying when not to intervene, preventing severe regressions before deployment.
zh_title: 智能体中准确的失败预测并不意味着有效的失败预防
translation:
LLM批评模型的主动干预通常被认为能提高可靠性，但它们在部署时的效果却知之甚少。我们表明，一个具有强大离线准确率（AUROC 0.94）的二元LLM批评模型，仍然可能导致严重的性能下降，在一个模型上诱发26个百分点的崩溃，而对另一个模型的影响接近零。这种可变性表明，仅凭LLM批评模型的准确性不足以确定干预是否安全。
我们识别出一种“干扰-恢复”的权衡：干预可能会恢复失败的轨迹，但也可能干扰原本会成功的轨迹。基于这一见解，我们提出了一种预部署测试，该测试使用一个包含50个任务的小型试点来估计干预是可能有利还是有害，而无需完全部署。在不同的基准测试中，该测试准确地预测了结果：干预在高成功率任务上会降低性能（0到-26 pp），而在高失败率的ALFWorld基准上产生了适度的改进（+2.8 pp，p=0.014）。因此，我们框架的主要价值在于识别何时不应干预，从而在部署前防止严重的性能衰退。
tldr: LLM批评模型的高预测准确率（AUROC 0.94）可能导致严重的性能下降（高达26个百分点），因为干预存在“干扰-恢复”的权衡。本文提出一个基于小规模试点任务的预部署测试，用于识别何时不应干预，从而防止性能衰退。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于明确区分了失败预测的准确性与失败预防的有效性。它提出了一个关键的“干扰-恢复”权衡，揭示了即使是高准确率的批评模型也可能因干预副作用而损害性能。更重要的是，作者提供了一个低成本（仅需50个试点任务）的预部署测试框架，这对于确保LLM智能体干预机制的安全性和实用性具有重要的工程价值，有助于避免灾难性的性能回归。
motivation: 普遍假设LLM批评模型的主动干预可以提高可靠性，但其在部署时的实际效果知之甚少。
method: 采用一个具有高离线准确率（AUROC 0.94）的二元LLM批评模型进行测试。识别出干预中存在的“干扰-恢复”权衡。基于此，提出一个使用50个任务的小型试点进行预部署测试，以估计干预的利弊。
results: 具有高准确率的批评模型在一个模型上导致了26个百分点的严重性能崩溃，而在另一个模型上影响接近零。所提出的预部署测试成功预测了结果：在高成功率任务上性能下降（0至-26 pp），而在高失败率基准（ALFWorld）上略有改善（+2.8 pp）。
conclusion: 仅凭LLM批评模型的准确性不足以判断干预是否安全。该框架的主要价值在于识别何时不应干预，从而在部署前防止严重的性能衰退。

title: Vigemers: on the number of $k$-mers sharing the same XOR-based minimizer
authors: Florian Ingels, Antoine Limasset, Camille Marchet, Mikaël Salson
abstract: In bioinformatics, minimizers have become an inescapable method for handling $k$-mers (words of fixed size $k$) extracted from DNA or RNA sequencing, whether for sampling, storage, querying or partitioning. According to some fixed order on $m$-mers ($m<k$), the minimizer of a $k$-mer is defined as its smallest $m$-mer -- and acts as its fingerprint. Although minimizers are widely used for partitioning purposes, there is almost no theoretical work on the quality of the resulting partitions. For instance, it has been known for decades that the lexicographic order empirically leads to highly unbalanced partitions that are unusable in practice, but it was not until very recently that this observation was theoretically substantiated. The rejection of the lexicographic order has led the community to resort to (pseudo-)random orders using hash functions. In this work, we extend the theoretical results relating to the partitions obtained by the lexicographical order, departing from it to a (exponentially) large family of hash functions, namely where the $m$-mers are XORed against a fixed key. More precisely, provided a key $γ$ and a $m$-mer $w$, we investigate the function that counts how many $k$-mers admit $w$ as their minimizer (i.e. where $w\oplusγ$ is minimal among all $m$-mers of said $k$-mers). This number, denoted by $π_k^γ(w)$, represents the maximum size of the bucket associated with $w$, if all possible $k$-mers were to be seen and partitioned. We adapt the (lexicographical order) method of the literature to our framework and propose combinatorial equations that allow to compute, using dynamic programming, $π_k^γ(w)$ in $O(km^2)$ time and $O(km)$ space.
zh_title: Vigemers：关于共享相同基于XOR的最小值的$k$-mer的数量。
translation: 在生物信息学中，最小化器已成为处理从DNA或RNA测序中提取的$k$-mer（固定大小$k$的词）的不可或缺的方法，无论是用于采样、存储、查询还是划分。根据$m$-mer（$m<k$）上的某种固定顺序，一个$k$-mer的最小化器被定义为其最小的$m$-mer——并充当其指纹。尽管最小化器广泛用于划分目的，但关于由此产生的划分质量的理论工作几乎没有。例如，几十年来人们就知道字典序在经验上会导致高度不平衡的划分，在实践中无法使用，但直到最近才在理论上证实了这一观察结果。对字典序的拒绝导致社区诉诸使用哈希函数（伪）随机顺序。在这项工作中，我们将与字典序获得的划分相关的理论结果扩展到（指数级）大的哈希函数族，即$m$-mer与固定密钥进行XOR操作的族。更准确地说，给定一个密钥$\gamma$和一个$m$-mer $w$，我们研究了计算有多少$k$-mer接受$w$作为其最小化器（即$w\oplus\gamma$在该$k$-mer的所有$m$-mer中是最小的）的函数。这个数字，记为$\pi_k^\gamma(w)$，代表了与$w$关联的桶的最大尺寸，如果所有的可能$k$-mer都被看到并划分。我们将文献中的（字典序）方法适应到我们的框架中，并提出了组合方程，允许使用动态规划在$O(km^2)$时间和$O(km)$空间内计算$\pi_k^\gamma(w)$。
tldr: 本文研究了在生物信息学中，使用基于XOR的哈希函数作为顺序来定义$k$-mer的最小值时，有多少$k$-mer共享同一个最小值。作者提出了组合方程和动态规划算法，能够在$O(km^2)$时间和$O(km)$空间内计算出给定最小值的最大桶大小。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将$k$-mer最小化器划分质量的理论分析，从已被证明不平衡的传统字典序，扩展到了生物信息学社区实际采用的、基于哈希函数（特别是基于XOR的函数）的伪随机排序。评估划分质量的关键在于计算最大桶大小$\pi_k^\gamma(w)$。通过提供一个高效的$O(km^2)$动态规划算法来计算这个值，这项工作为理论界提供了急需的工具，以便对基于XOR的最小化器在实践中的平衡性提供严格的理论支持，从而弥补了该领域理论研究的空白。
motivation: 尽管最小化器广泛用于$k$-mer的划分，但关于由此产生的划分质量的理论工作很少。传统的字典序会导致高度不平衡的划分，促使社区转向使用哈希函数（如基于XOR的函数）的伪随机序。本文旨在将现有关于字典序的理论结果扩展到基于XOR哈希函数的广泛族群，以理论上评估这些新划分的质量。
method: 1. 定义函数$\pi_k^\gamma(w)$，用于计算有多少$k$-mer将$w$作为其最小化器（即$w \oplus \gamma$在其所有$m$-mer中是最小的）。2. 适应文献中用于字典序的方法到基于XOR的框架。3. 提出组合方程。4. 使用动态规划（DP）方法来计算$\pi_k^\gamma(w)$。
results: 提出了组合方程和动态规划算法，能够在$O(km^2)$时间复杂度和$O(km)$空间复杂度内计算出$\pi_k^\gamma(w)$。$\pi_k^\gamma(w)$代表了与特定$m$-mer $w$相关联的划分桶的最大尺寸。

title: The Personality Trap: How LLMs Embed Bias When Generating Human-Like Personas
authors: Jacopo Amidei, Gregorio Ferreira, Mario Muñoz Serrano, Rubén Nieto, Andreas Kaltenbrunner
abstract: This paper examines biases in large language models (LLMs) when generating synthetic populations from responses to personality questionnaires. Using five LLMs, we first assess the representativeness and potential biases in the sociodemographic attributes of the generated personas, as well as their alignment with the intended personality traits. While LLMs successfully reproduce known correlations between personality and sociodemographic variables, all models exhibit pronounced WEIRD (western, educated, industrialized, rich and democratic) biases, favoring young, educated, white, heterosexual, Western individuals with centrist or progressive political views and secular or Christian beliefs. In a second analysis, we manipulate input traits to maximize Neuroticism and Psychoticism scores. Notably, when Psychoticism is maximized, several models produce an overrepresentation of non-binary and LGBTQ+ identities, raising concerns about stereotyping and the potential pathologization of marginalized groups. Our findings highlight both the potential and the risks of using LLMs to generate psychologically grounded synthetic populations.
zh_title: 人格陷阱：LLMs 在生成类人角色时如何嵌入偏见
translation: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在根据人格问卷的回答生成合成人群时所存在的偏见。我们使用五种LLMs，首先评估了生成的角色的社会人口属性的代表性和潜在偏见，以及它们与预期人格特质的一致性。虽然LLMs成功地重现了人格与社会人口变量之间已知的相关性，但所有模型都表现出明显的WEIRD（西方、受过教育、工业化、富裕和民主）偏见，倾向于年轻、受过教育、白人、异性恋、西方、政治观点中立或进步、信仰世俗或基督教的个体。在第二次分析中，我们操纵输入特质以最大化神经质和精神病质得分。值得注意的是，当精神病质最大化时，一些模型过度代表了非二元和LGBTQ+身份，这引发了对边缘群体刻板印象和潜在病理化的担忧。我们的发现强调了使用LLMs生成具有心理学基础的合成人群的潜力和风险。
tldr: 研究发现，LLMs在根据人格问卷生成合成人群时存在严重的“WEIRD”偏见，倾向于生成西方、受过教育、白人、异性恋等角色。此外，当最大化“精神病质”时，模型会将非二元和LGBTQ+身份过度代表，这引发了对边缘群体刻板印象和病理化的担忧。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将LLMs生成人工角色的能力与心理学中的人格测量（如人格问卷）结合起来，系统地揭示了LLMs在这一过程中的内在偏见。其重要性在于，如果这些合成人群被用于社会科学研究、政策模拟或产品设计，模型中的WEIRD偏见和对边缘群体的刻板印象（特别是将精神病质与LGBTQ+身份关联）可能导致误导性的结果和有害的社会影响。这提醒研究者在使用LLMs创建“类人”数据时，必须极其谨慎地处理和缓解模型继承的训练数据偏见。
motivation: 本文旨在检验大型语言模型（LLMs）在根据人格问卷的回答生成合成人群时所存在的偏见。
method: 使用五种LLMs，首先评估生成的角色的社会人口属性的代表性和潜在偏见，以及它们与预期人格特质的一致性。其次，操纵输入特质以最大化神经质（Neuroticism）和精神病质（Psychoticism）得分进行第二次分析。
results: 1. LLMs成功地重现了人格与社会人口变量之间已知的相关性。2. 所有模型都表现出明显的WEIRD（西方、受过教育、工业化、富裕和民主）偏见，倾向于年轻、受过教育、白人、异性恋、西方、政治观点中立或进步、信仰世俗或基督教的个体。3. 值得注意的是，当精神病质最大化时，一些模型过度代表了非二元和LGBTQ+身份。
conclusion: 研究结果强调了使用LLMs生成具有心理学基础的合成人群的潜力和风险。

title: Composable Visual Tokenizers with Generator-Free Diagnostics of Learnability
authors: Bingchen Zhao, Qiushan Guo, Ye Wang, Yixuan Huang, Zhonghua Zhai, Yu Tian
abstract: We introduce CompTok, a training framework for learning visual tokenizers whose tokens are enhanced for compositionality. CompTok uses a token-conditioned diffusion decoder. By employing an InfoGAN-style objective, where we train a recognition model to predict the tokens used to condition the diffusion decoder using the decoded images, we enforce the decoder to not ignore any of the tokens. To promote compositional control, besides the original images, CompTok also trains on tokens formed by swapping token subsets between images, enabling more compositional control of the token over the decoder. As the swapped tokens between images do not have ground truth image targets, we apply a manifold constraint via an adversarial flow regularizer to keep unpaired swap generations on the natural-image distribution. The resulting tokenizer not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on image class-conditioned generation, but also demonstrates properties such as swapping tokens between images to achieve high level semantic editing of an image. Additionally, we propose two metrics that measures the landscape of the token space that can be useful to describe not only the compositionality of the tokens, but also how easy to learn the landscape is for a generator to be trained on this space. We show in experiments that CompTok can improve on both of the metrics as well as supporting state-of-the-art generators for class conditioned generation.
zh_title: 可组合视觉分词器及生成器无关的可学习性诊断
translation: 我们引入CompTok，这是一个用于学习视觉分词器的训练框架，其分词的组合性得到了增强。CompTok使用一个分词条件的扩散解码器。通过采用InfoGAN风格的目标，我们训练一个识别模型，利用解码图像来预测用于条件化扩散解码器的分词，从而强制解码器不忽略任何分词。为了促进组合控制，除了原始图像外，CompTok还训练于通过在图像间交换分词子集形成的分词，从而使分词对解码器具有更多的组合控制能力。由于图像间交换的分词没有真实图像目标，我们通过对抗流正则化器应用流形约束，以保持不成对的交换生成位于自然图像分布上。由此产生的分词器不仅在图像类别条件生成方面实现了最先进的性能，而且还展示了诸如在图像间交换分词以实现图像高级语义编辑的特性。此外，我们提出了两个指标，用于衡量分词空间的格局，这不仅有助于描述分词的组合性，还有助于描述生成器在该空间上进行训练的学习难度。我们在实验中表明，CompTok可以在这两个指标上有所改进，并支持最先进的类别条件生成器。
tldr: 引入CompTok框架，用于学习具有组合性的视觉分词器。该框架使用扩散解码器和InfoGAN风格目标，并通过交换分词子集实现高级语义编辑。同时提出了用于诊断分词空间可学习性的新指标。
ai_comments: 本文的核心创新在于CompTok框架，它专注于增强视觉分词的组合性。通过结合使用分词条件扩散解码器、InfoGAN风格目标以及图像间分词交换策略，该框架有效地实现了高级语义控制。特别是引入对抗流正则化器来处理交换分词的无标签生成，保持了生成图像的自然性。此外，提出的两个生成器无关的诊断指标，为评估分词空间的可学习性和组合性提供了一种新的、高效的工具，对于未来分词器设计研究具有重要价值。
motivation: 学习具有增强组合性的视觉分词器（CompTok），并确保扩散解码器不会忽略任何分词。此外，旨在提供一种对分词空间可学习性进行诊断的生成器无关方法。
method: 引入CompTok训练框架，使用分词条件扩散解码器。通过InfoGAN风格目标训练识别模型来预测分词，以确保解码器利用所有分词。通过在图像间交换分词子集进行训练以增强组合性控制。对不成对的交换生成应用对抗流正则化器（流形约束）。最后，提出了两个用于衡量分词空间可学习性和组合性的新指标。
results: 在图像类别条件生成方面实现了最先进的性能。展示了通过在图像间交换分词来实现高级语义编辑的能力。实验表明CompTok能够改善提出的两个指标，并支持最先进的类别条件生成器。
conclusion: CompTok框架成功学习了可组合的视觉分词器，提高了图像生成性能，并通过引入新的诊断指标，有效地描述了分词空间的可学习性。

title: MentalSeek-Dx: Towards Progressive Hypothetico-Deductive Reasoning for Real-world Psychiatric Diagnosis
authors: Xiao Sun, Yuming Yang, Junnan Zhu, Jiang Zhong, Xinyu Zhou, Kaiwen Wei
abstract: Mental health disorders represent a burgeoning global public health challenge. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in psychiatric assessment, their clinical utility is severely constrained by benchmarks that lack ecological validity and fine-grained diagnostic supervision. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MentalDx Bench}, the first benchmark dedicated to disorder-level psychiatric diagnosis within real-world clinical settings. Comprising 712 de-identified electronic health records annotated by board-certified psychiatrists under ICD-11 guidelines, the benchmark covers 76 disorders across 16 diagnostic categories. Evaluation of 18 LLMs reveals a critical \textit{paradigm misalignment}: strong performance at coarse diagnostic categorization contrasts with systematic failure at disorder-level diagnosis, underscoring a gap between pattern-based modeling and clinical hypothetico-deductive reasoning. In response, we propose \textbf{MentalSeek-Dx}, a medical-specialized LLM trained to internalize this clinical reasoning process through supervised trajectory construction and curriculum-based reinforcement learning. Experiments on MentalDx Bench demonstrate that MentalSeek-Dx achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with only 14B parameters, establishing a clinically grounded framework for reliable psychiatric diagnosis.
zh_title: MentalSeek-Dx：迈向真实世界精神病学诊断的渐进式假设-演绎推理
translation: 精神健康障碍代表着一个日益严重的全球公共卫生挑战。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在精神病学评估中展示了潜力，但其临床实用性受到缺乏生态有效性和细粒度诊断监督的基准的严重限制。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了**MentalDx Bench**，这是第一个致力于真实世界临床环境中障碍级别精神病学诊断的基准。该基准包含712份经董事会认证的精神病学家根据ICD-11指南标注的去识别化电子健康记录，涵盖16个诊断类别的76种障碍。对18个LLM的评估揭示了一个关键的“范式错位”：在粗略诊断分类上的强大性能与在障碍级别诊断上的系统性失败形成对比，这强调了基于模式的建模与临床假设-演绎推理之间的差距。作为回应，我们提出了**MentalSeek-Dx**，这是一个医学专业化的LLM，通过监督轨迹构建和基于课程的强化学习来内化这种临床推理过程。在MentalDx Bench上的实验证明，MentalSeek-Dx以仅14B的参数实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能，为可靠的精神病学诊断建立了一个具有临床基础的框架。
tldr: LLM在精神诊断上面临挑战，因为现有基准缺乏真实性和细粒度。本文提出了第一个真实世界诊断基准MentalDx Bench和新的LLM模型MentalSeek-Dx，该模型通过模拟临床假设-演绎推理过程，实现了SOTA性能，并为可靠诊断建立了一个临床基础框架。
ai_comments: 本文的主要创新在于构建了首个具有高生态有效性的真实世界精神病学诊断基准（MentalDx Bench），弥补了现有基准在生态有效性和细粒度监督方面的不足。它明确指出了现有大型语言模型（LLMs）在粗粒度分类和细粒度障碍诊断之间存在的“范式错位”问题，这对未来的模型开发具有重要的指导意义。提出的MentalSeek-Dx模型通过模仿临床假设-演绎推理过程，为解决复杂的障碍级别诊断提供了有效的SOTA解决方案，证明了将人类专业推理过程整合到AI模型中的重要性。
motivation: 精神健康障碍是一个日益严重的全球公共卫生挑战。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在精神病学评估中展现了潜力，但其临床实用性受到缺乏生态有效性和细粒度诊断监督的基准的严重限制。本文旨在弥合这一差距。
method: 1. 引入**MentalDx Bench**：首个专注于真实世界临床环境中障碍级别精神病学诊断的基准，包含712份经ICD-11标注的去识别化电子健康记录。2. 提出**MentalSeek-Dx**：一个医学专业化的LLM。3. 训练方法：通过监督轨迹构建（supervised trajectory construction）和基于课程的强化学习（curriculum-based reinforcement learning），使模型内化临床假设-演绎推理过程。
results: 1. 对18个LLM的评估揭示了“范式错位”：模型在粗略诊断分类上表现良好，但在障碍级别诊断上系统性失败。2. MentalSeek-Dx在MentalDx Bench上实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能，且仅使用14B参数。
conclusion: MentalSeek-Dx为可靠的精神病学诊断建立了一个具有临床基础的框架。

title: Tiled Prompts: Overcoming Prompt Underspecification in Image and Video Super-Resolution
authors: Bryan Sangwoo Kim, Jonghyun Park, Jong Chul Ye
abstract: Text-conditioned diffusion models have advanced image and video super-resolution by using prompts as semantic priors, but modern super-resolution pipelines typically rely on latent tiling to scale to high resolutions, where a single global caption causes prompt underspecification. A coarse global prompt often misses localized details (prompt sparsity) and provides locally irrelevant guidance (prompt misguidance) that can be amplified by classifier-free guidance. We propose Tiled Prompts, a unified framework for image and video super-resolution that generates a tile-specific prompt for each latent tile and performs super-resolution under locally text-conditioned posteriors, providing high-information guidance that resolves prompt underspecification with minimal overhead. Experiments on high resolution real-world images and videos show consistent gains in perceptual quality and text alignment, while reducing hallucinations and tile-level artifacts relative to global-prompt baselines.
zh_title: 平铺提示（Tiled Prompts）：克服图像和视频超分辨率中的提示欠规范问题。
translation: 文本条件扩散模型通过使用提示作为语义先验，推动了图像和视频超分辨率的发展，但现代超分辨率管线通常依赖于潜在平铺来扩展到高分辨率，此时单个全局标题会导致提示欠规范问题。一个粗糙的全局提示经常会遗漏局部细节（提示稀疏性），并提供局部不相关的指导（提示误导性），这些问题可能被无分类器指导所放大。我们提出了“平铺提示”（Tiled Prompts），这是一个用于图像和视频超分辨率的统一框架，它为每个潜在图像块生成一个块特定的提示，并在局部文本条件后验下执行超分辨率，提供了高信息量的指导，以最小的开销解决了提示欠规范问题。在针对高分辨率真实世界图像和视频的实验中，相对于全局提示基线，该方法在感知质量和文本对齐方面显示出持续的提升，同时减少了幻觉和块级伪影。
tldr: 针对高分辨率超分中因潜在平铺导致的全局提示欠规范问题，本文提出了“平铺提示”框架，为每个图像块生成局部提示，从而提高了图像质量、文本对齐度，并减少了伪影。
ai_comments: 该工作的创新点在于识别并解决了高分辨率扩散模型中一个关键的实际问题：当使用潜在平铺时，全局提示无法提供足够的局部语义信息（即提示欠规范）。通过引入块特定的局部提示，该方法有效地弥合了全局语义与局部像素生成之间的差距。这对于将扩散模型扩展到实际高分辨率应用，尤其是在需要精细局部细节控制的场景中，具有重要意义。
motivation: 文本条件扩散模型在图像和视频超分辨率中利用提示作为语义先验。然而，现代超分辨率管线依赖于潜在平铺（latent tiling）来处理高分辨率，这导致单个全局标题产生“提示欠规范”问题，即提示稀疏性（缺少局部细节）和提示误导性（提供局部不相关的指导）。
method: 提出了“平铺提示”（Tiled Prompts）框架，这是一个用于图像和视频超分辨率的统一框架。它为每个潜在图像块生成一个块特定的提示（tile-specific prompt），并在局部文本条件后验下执行超分辨率。
results: 在高分辨率真实世界图像和视频上的实验显示，相对于全局提示基线，该方法在感知质量和文本对齐方面持续获得提升，同时减少了幻觉和块级伪影。
conclusion: Tiled Prompts框架通过提供高信息量的指导，以最小的开销解决了提示欠规范问题，从而在图像和视频超分辨率中提高了感知质量和文本一致性。

title: Beyond Exposure: Optimizing Ranking Fairness with Non-linear Time-Income Functions
authors: Xuancheng Li, Tao Yang, Yujia Zhou, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu
abstract: Ranking is central to information distribution in web search and recommendation. Nowadays, in ranking optimization, the fairness to item providers is viewed as a crucial factor alongside ranking relevance for users. There are currently numerous concepts of fairness and one widely recognized fairness concept is Exposure Fairness. However, it relies primarily on exposure determined solely by position, overlooking other factors that significantly influence income, such as time. To address this limitation, we propose to study ranking fairness when the provider utility is influenced by other contextual factors and is neither equal to nor proportional to item exposure. We give a formal definition of Income Fairness and develop a corresponding measurement metric. Simulated experiments show that existing-exposure-fairness-based ranking algorithms fail to optimize the proposed income fairness. Therefore, we propose the Dynamic-Income-Derivative-aware Ranking Fairness algorithm, which, based on the marginal income gain at the present timestep, uses Taylor-expansion-based gradients to simultaneously optimize effectiveness and income fairness. In both offline and online settings with diverse time-income functions, DIDRF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
zh_title: 超越曝光：用非线性时间-收入函数优化排序公平性
translation: 排序是网络搜索和推荐中信息分配的核心。如今，在排序优化中，对物品提供者的公平性被视为与用户排序相关性同等重要的关键因素。目前存在许多公平性概念，其中一个被广泛认可的概念是曝光公平性。然而，它主要依赖于仅由位置决定的曝光，忽略了显著影响收入的其他因素，例如时间。为了解决这一局限性，我们建议研究当提供者效用受其他上下文因素影响且既不等于也不与物品曝光成比例时的排序公平性。我们给出了收入公平性的正式定义，并开发了相应的度量指标。模拟实验表明，现有基于曝光公平性的排序算法无法优化所提出的收入公平性。因此，我们提出了动态收入导数感知排序公平性算法（DIDRF），该算法基于当前时间步的边际收入增益，使用基于泰勒展开的梯度来同时优化有效性和收入公平性。在具有不同时间-收入函数的离线和在线设置中，DIDRF始终优于最先进的方法。
tldr: 现有的排序公平性（曝光公平性）忽略了时间和上下文因素对提供者收入的影响。本文定义了新的“收入公平性”并提出了“动态收入导数感知排序公平性算法”（DIDRF），该算法使用边际收入增益和泰勒展开梯度来同时优化效率和公平性，表现优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于超越了简单的基于位置的曝光公平性，转向更现实的“收入公平性”模型，该模型纳入了非线性的上下文因素（如时间）。这对于提供者收入生成复杂的真实世界平台至关重要。使用边际收入增益和泰勒梯度提供了一种新颖且计算上可行的方法，用于在动态环境中联合优化有效性和公平性这两个相互竞争的目标。
motivation: 排序公平性至关重要。现有的曝光公平性主要依赖于位置决定的曝光，忽略了时间等显著影响收入的其他上下文因素。本文的动机是研究当提供者效用受上下文影响且与曝光不成比例时的排序公平性。
method: 1. 提出了“收入公平性”（Income Fairness）的正式定义和相应的度量指标。2. 提出了**动态收入导数感知排序公平性算法（DIDRF）**。3. DIDRF基于当前时间步的边际收入增益。4. 使用基于泰勒展开的梯度来同时优化有效性和收入公平性。
results: 模拟实验表明，现有基于曝光公平性的排序算法无法优化所提出的收入公平性。DIDRF在离线和在线设置中，对于不同的时间-收入函数，始终优于最先进的方法。
conclusion: 现有的基于曝光公平性的算法不能优化收入公平性。本文提出的DIDRF算法通过考虑非线性时间-收入函数，成功地优化了有效性和所提出的收入公平性，并在各种设置中持续优于现有最先进方法。

title: Dynamics of Implicit Time-Invariant Max-Min-Plus-Scaling Discrete-Event Systems
authors: Sreeshma Markkassery, Ton van den Boom, Bart De Schutter
abstract: Max-min-plus-scaling (MMPS) systems generalize max-plus, min-plus and max-min-plus models with more flexibility in modelling discrete-event dynamics. Especially, implicit MMPS models capture a wide range of real world discrete-event applications. This article analyzes the dynamics of an autonomous, time-invariant implicit MMPS system in a discrete-event framework. First, we provide sufficient conditions under which an implicit MMPS system admits at least one solution to its state-space representation. Then, we analyze its global behavior by determining the key parameters; the growth rates and fixed points. For a solvable MMPS system, we assess the local behavior of the system around its set of fixed points via a normalization procedure. Further, we present the notion of stability for the normalized system. A case study of the urban railway network substantiates the theoretical results.
zh_title: 隐式时不变最大-最小-加-缩放离散事件系统的动力学
translation: 最大-最小-加-缩放（MMPS）系统推广了max-plus、min-plus和max-min-plus模型，在建模离散事件动力学方面具有更大的灵活性。特别是，隐式MMPS模型捕捉了广泛的现实世界离散事件应用。本文在离散事件框架内分析了自主、时不变隐式MMPS系统的动力学。首先，我们提供了隐式MMPS系统状态空间表示至少存在一个解的充分条件。然后，通过确定关键参数（增长率和不动点）来分析其全局行为。对于可解的MMPS系统，我们通过归一化过程评估了系统围绕其不动点集的局部行为。此外，我们提出了归一化系统的稳定性概念。城市轨道交通网络的案例研究证实了理论结果。
tldr: 本文分析了隐式时不变MMPS离散事件系统的动力学，提出了系统存在解的充分条件，并通过确定增长率和不动点来分析其全局和局部行为，同时提出了稳定性概念，并用城市轨道交通网络案例验证了理论。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于将MMPS系统推广到隐式和时不变框架，这使得模型能够更灵活地捕捉现实世界中的复杂离散事件系统。通过系统地分析解的存在性、全局行为（增长率和不动点）以及局部稳定性，该文为理解和控制这类非线性代数系统提供了坚实的理论基础。特别是，将理论应用于城市轨道交通网络，显示了该理论在实际工程问题中的重要应用潜力。
motivation: Max-min-plus-scaling (MMPS) 系统推广了max-plus、min-plus和max-min-plus模型，在建模离散事件动力学方面具有更大的灵活性。特别是隐式MMPS模型能够捕捉广泛的现实世界离散事件应用。
method: 1. 提供了隐式MMPS系统状态空间表示至少存在一个解的充分条件。2. 通过确定关键参数（增长率和不动点）来分析系统的全局行为。3. 对于可解系统，通过归一化过程评估系统围绕其不动点集的局部行为。4. 提出了归一化系统的稳定性概念。
results: 研究确定了系统的增长率和不动点，分析了其全局和局部行为。通过对城市轨道交通网络的案例研究证实了这些理论结果。

title: Robustness as an Emergent Property of Task Performance
authors: Shir Ashury-Tahan, Ariel Gera, Elron Bandel, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer, Leshem Choshen
abstract: Robustness is often regarded as a critical future challenge for real-world applications, where stability is essential. However, as models often learn tasks in a similar order, we hypothesize that easier tasks will be easier regardless of how they are presented to the model. Indeed, in this paper, we show that as models approach high performance on a task, robustness is effectively achieved. Through an empirical analysis of multiple models across diverse datasets and configurations (e.g., paraphrases, different temperatures), we find a strong positive correlation. Moreover, we find that robustness is primarily driven by task-specific competence rather than inherent model-level properties, challenging current approaches that treat robustness as an independent capability. Thus, from a high-level perspective, we may expect that as new tasks saturate, model robustness on these tasks will emerge accordingly. For researchers, this implies that explicit efforts to measure and improve robustness may warrant reduced emphasis, as such robustness is likely to develop alongside performance gains. For practitioners, it acts as a sign that indeed the tasks that the literature deals with are unreliable, but on easier past tasks, the models are reliable and ready for real-world deployment.
zh_title: 鲁棒性是任务性能的一种涌现特性
translation: 鲁棒性通常被认为是现实世界应用中的一项关键未来挑战，其中稳定性至关重要。然而，由于模型通常以相似的顺序学习任务，我们假设无论任务如何呈现给模型，较简单的任务都将更容易。事实上，在本文中，我们表明，随着模型在任务上接近高高性能，鲁棒性也随之有效实现。通过对多种模型在不同数据集和配置（例如，释义、不同温度设置）上进行的实证分析，我们发现两者存在强烈的正相关性。此外，我们发现鲁棒性主要由任务特定的能力驱动，而非固有的模型级别属性，这挑战了当前将鲁棒性视为一种独立能力的方法。因此，从宏观角度来看，我们可以预期，随着新任务的饱和，模型在这些任务上的鲁棒性也将相应涌现。对于研究人员来说，这意味着可以减少对鲁棒性显式测量和改进的强调，因为这种鲁棒性很可能伴随性能提升而发展。对于从业者来说，这表明文献中处理的任务确实是不可靠的，但在较简单的过去任务上，模型是可靠的，并已准备好进行实际部署。
tldr: 模型的鲁棒性并非独立能力，而是随着模型在特定任务上性能接近饱和而自然涌现的。因此，专注于提高性能比独立提高鲁棒性更有效。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一个重要的观点转变，即鲁棒性可能不是需要独立解决的问题，而是模型在掌握特定任务后自然获得的结果。其创新在于将鲁棒性重新定位为“涌现特性”（Emergent Property），而非“独立能力”（Independent Capability）。如果这一结论成立，它将对未来的AI研究方向产生重大影响，特别是可能减少对对抗性训练等专门鲁棒性方法的依赖，转而关注基础任务性能的提升。它也为从业者提供了一个明确的信号：在模型已饱和的“简单”任务上，可以信任模型的稳定性。
motivation: 鲁棒性是现实应用中的关键挑战。作者假设，由于模型学习任务的顺序相似，较简单的任务无论如何呈现都更容易，从而推断鲁棒性可能与任务性能相关。
method: 对多种模型在不同数据集和配置（例如，释义、不同温度设置）上进行了实证分析。
results: 发现模型在任务上接近高性能时，鲁棒性也随之有效实现，两者存在强烈的正相关性。此外，鲁棒性主要由任务特定的能力驱动，而非固有的模型级别属性。
conclusion: 鲁棒性是任务性能的一种涌现特性，而不是一种独立的能力。随着新任务性能的饱和，鲁棒性也将相应涌现。研究人员可以减少对鲁棒性显式测量和改进的强调，从业者应认识到模型在较简单的任务上是可靠的。

title: A Comparative Study of Low-Dissipation Numerical Schemes for Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
authors: Shaoshuai Chu, Michael Herty
abstract: This work provides a comparative assessment of several low-dissipation numerical schemes for hyperbolic conservation laws, highlighting their performance relative to the classical Harten-Lax-van Leer (HLL) schemes. The schemes under consideration include the classical Harten-Lax-van Leer-Contact (HLLC), the recently proposed TV flux splitting, the low-dissipation Central-Upwind (LDCU), and the local characteristic decomposition-based Central-Upwind (LCDCU) schemes. These methods are extended to higher orders of accuracy, up to the fifth order, within both finite-volume and finite-difference frameworks. A series of numerical experiments for the one- and two-dimensional Euler equations of gas dynamics are performed to evaluate the accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency of the studied schemes. The comparison highlights the trade-offs between resolution of contact and shear waves, robustness in the presence of shocks, and computational cost. The investigated low-dissipation schemes show comparable levels of numerical dissipation, with only subtle differences appearing in selected benchmark problems. The results provide practical guidance for selecting efficient low-dissipation solvers for the simulation of complex compressible flows.
