zh_title: 通过利用个人交通平台增强四足机器人的导航效率
translation: 四足机器人由于依赖腿部，在长距离导航效率方面面临局限性。为了改善这些局限，我们引入了一种基于强化学习的主动运输平台骑行方法（RL-ATR），其灵感来源于人类利用个人交通工具（包括Segway）的方式。RL-ATR具有一个运输平台骑行策略和两个状态估计器。该策略根据运输平台特定的控制动力学设计出足够的机动策略，而估计器通过推断不可观测的机器人和平台状态来解决非惯性系中的传感器模糊性。全面的仿真评估验证了该方法在各种运输平台-机器人模型上具有熟练的指令跟踪能力，并且与纯腿部运动相比，能耗有所降低。此外，我们还进行了消融研究，以量化RL-ATR中各个组件的贡献。这种骑行能力可以拓宽四足机器人的运动模式，并有可能扩大其操作范围和提高效率。
tldr: 针对四足机器人长距离导航效率低的问题，本文提出基于强化学习的主动运输平台骑行方法（RL-ATR），使其能“骑乘”个人交通平台，通过仿真验证，该方法显著提高了指令跟踪能力，并降低了能耗。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将四足机器人的灵活性与个人交通工具（如Segway）的效率相结合，以解决长距离导航的能耗和范围限制。RL-ATR框架，特别是其状态估计器设计，巧妙地解决了在非惯性“骑乘”系统中感知和控制的复杂挑战，为未来混合动力或多模式机器人设计提供了新的思路。
motivation: 解决四足机器人因依赖腿部运动而在长距离导航效率方面存在的局限性。
method: 提出基于强化学习的主动运输平台骑行方法（RL-ATR）。RL-ATR包含一个骑行策略和两个状态估计器。骑行策略根据运输平台特定的控制动力学设计机动策略；状态估计器通过推断不可观测的机器人和平台状态来解决非惯性系中的传感器模糊性。
results: 仿真评估验证了该方法在各种运输平台-机器人模型上具有熟练的指令跟踪能力，并且与纯腿部运动相比，能耗有所降低。此外，还进行了消融研究以量化RL-ATR中各组件的贡献。
conclusion: 这种骑行能力拓宽了四足机器人的运动模式，有望扩大其操作范围并提高效率。

title: Towards Distillation-Resistant Large Language Models: An Information-Theoretic Perspective
authors: Hao Fang, Tianyi Zhang, Tianqu Zhuang, Jiawei Kong, Kuofeng Gao, Bin Chen, Leqi Liang, Shu-Tao Xia, Ke Xu
abstract: Proprietary large language models (LLMs) embody substantial economic value and are generally exposed only as black-box APIs, yet adversaries can still exploit their outputs to extract knowledge via distillation. Existing defenses focus exclusively on text-based distillation, leaving the important logit-based distillation largely unexplored. In this work, we analyze this problem and present an effective solution from an information-theoretic perspective. We characterize distillation-relevant information in teacher outputs using the conditional mutual information (CMI) between teacher logits and input queries conditioned on ground-truth labels. This quantity captures contextual information beneficial for model extraction, motivating us to defend distillation via CMI minimization. Guided by our theoretical analysis, we propose learning a transformation matrix that purifies the original outputs to enhance distillation resistance. We further derive a CMI-inspired anti-distillation objective to optimize this transformation, which effectively removes distillation-relevant information while preserving output utility. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and strong distillation algorithms demonstrate that the proposed method significantly degrades distillation performance while preserving task accuracy, effectively protecting models' intellectual property.
zh_title: 迈向抗蒸馏的大型语言模型：一个信息论视角
translation: 专有大型语言模型（LLMs）蕴含着巨大的经济价值，通常仅以黑盒API的形式对外暴露，但对手仍然可以利用它们的输出来通过蒸馏提取知识。现有的防御措施只关注基于文本的蒸馏，而忽略了重要的基于logits的蒸馏。在这项工作中，我们分析了这个问题，并从信息论的角度提出了一种有效的解决方案。我们使用教师模型的logits和输入查询在真实标签条件下的条件互信息（CMI）来表征教师输出中与蒸馏相关的信息。这个量捕获了有利于模型提取的上下文信息，从而促使我们通过最小化CMI来防御蒸馏。在我们的理论分析指导下，我们提出学习一个转换矩阵来净化原始输出，以增强抗蒸馏能力。我们进一步推导了一个受CMI启发的抗蒸馏目标函数来优化这个转换，该目标函数有效地去除了与蒸馏相关的信息，同时保留了输出的实用性。在多个LLMs和强大的蒸馏算法上进行的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法显著降低了蒸馏性能，同时保持了任务准确性，有效地保护了模型的知识产权。
tldr: 针对黑盒专有LLM面临的知识蒸馏风险（特别是logits蒸馏），本文提出了一种基于信息论的方法。通过最小化条件互信息（CMI），学习一个变换矩阵来净化模型输出，从而显著降低蒸馏效果，同时保持模型任务准确性。
ai_comments: 创新点在于首次从信息论视角（利用条件互信息CMI）来量化和最小化教师模型输出中与蒸馏相关的知识，从而为此前未被充分探索的基于logits的蒸馏攻击提供了有效的防御手段。这对于保护通过黑盒API提供服务的专有LLM的知识产权至关重要。
motivation: 专有大型语言模型（LLMs）具有巨大的经济价值，但即使通过黑盒API暴露，攻击者仍可通过蒸馏提取其知识。现有防御措施仅关注基于文本的蒸馏，而忽略了重要的基于logits的蒸馏。
method: 1. 从信息论角度分析知识蒸馏问题。2. 使用教师模型的logits和输入查询在真实标签条件下的条件互信息（CMI）来表征教师输出中与蒸馏相关的信息。3. 提出通过最小化CMI来防御蒸馏。4. 提出学习一个转换矩阵来净化原始输出，增强抗蒸馏性。5. 推导了一个受CMI启发的抗蒸馏目标函数来优化该转换矩阵，以有效去除蒸馏相关信息同时保持输出实用性。
results: 该方法在多个LLMs和强大的蒸馏算法上进行了广泛实验。结果表明，所提出的方法显著降低了蒸馏性能，同时保持了任务准确性，有效地保护了模型的知识产权。

title: Risk Awareness Injection: Calibrating Vision-Language Models for Safety without Compromising Utility
authors: Mengxuan Wang, Yuxin Chen, Gang Xu, Tao He, Hongjie Jiang, Ming Li
abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) extend the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to cross-modal settings, yet remain highly vulnerable to multimodal jailbreak attacks. Existing defenses predominantly rely on safety fine-tuning or aggressive token manipulations, incurring substantial training costs or significantly degrading utility. Recent research shows that LLMs inherently recognize unsafe content in text, and the incorporation of visual inputs in VLMs frequently dilutes risk-related signals. Motivated by this, we propose Risk Awareness Injection (RAI), a lightweight and training-free framework for safety calibration that restores LLM-like risk recognition by amplifying unsafe signals in VLMs. Specifically, RAI constructs an Unsafe Prototype Subspace from language embeddings and performs targeted modulation on selected high-risk visual tokens, explicitly activating safety-critical signals within the cross-modal feature space. This modulation restores the model's LLM-like ability to detect unsafe content from visual inputs, while preserving the semantic integrity of original tokens for cross-modal reasoning. Extensive experiments across multiple jailbreak and utility benchmarks demonstrate that RAI substantially reduces attack success rate without compromising task performance.
zh_title: 风险意识注入：在不损害实用性的前提下校准视觉-语言模型的安全性
translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）将大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力扩展到跨模态设置，但它们仍然极易受到多模态越狱攻击。现有的防御措施主要依赖于安全微调或激进的标记操作，这会产生巨大的训练成本或严重降低实用性。最近的研究表明，LLM固有地识别文本中的不安全内容，而VLM中视觉输入的加入经常稀释风险相关信号。受此启发，我们提出了“风险意识注入”（RAI），这是一种轻量级、免训练的安全校准框架，通过放大VLM中的不安全信号来恢复类LLM的风险识别能力。具体来说，RAI利用语言嵌入构建“不安全原型子空间”，并对选定的高风险视觉标记进行针对性调制，从而在跨模态特征空间中显式激活安全关键信号。这种调制恢复了模型类LLM从视觉输入中检测不安全内容的能力，同时保留了原始标记的语义完整性，以便进行跨模态推理。跨越多个越狱和实用性基准测试的广泛实验表明，RAI在不损害任务性能的前提下，显著降低了攻击成功率。
tldr: 提出了一种轻量级、免训练的“风险意识注入”（RAI）框架，通过放大视觉输入中的不安全信号，增强视觉-语言模型（VLM）的风险识别能力，有效防御多模态越狱攻击，同时保持模型实用性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了RAI这一轻量级、免训练的框架，有效解决了VLM在安全校准上面临的高成本和实用性下降的困境。其核心贡献在于利用语言嵌入构建“不安全原型子空间”并对高风险视觉标记进行针对性调制，实现了在不破坏跨模态推理能力的前提下，精准地放大安全信号。这对于快速部署安全且高效的VLM具有重要意义。
motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）极易受到多模态越狱攻击。现有防御方法成本高昂或严重损害模型实用性。研究发现，大型语言模型（LLM）固有地识别文本中的不安全内容，而VLM中视觉输入的加入稀释了这些风险相关信号。因此，作者旨在提出一种轻量级方法，恢复VLM类LLM的风险识别能力。
method: 提出“风险意识注入”（RAI）框架，这是一种轻量级、免训练的安全校准方法。它通过以下步骤放大不安全信号：1. 利用语言嵌入构建“不安全原型子空间”（Unsafe Prototype Subspace）。2. 对选定的高风险视觉标记进行针对性调制。3. 在跨模态特征空间中显式激活安全关键信号，从而恢复模型检测不安全内容的能力。
results: 在多个越狱和实用性基准测试中进行的广泛实验表明，RAI显著降低了攻击成功率，同时没有损害任务性能（实用性）。
conclusion: RAI框架通过轻量级、免训练的方式，成功校准了视觉-语言模型的安全性，有效防御了多模态越狱攻击，并证明了在跨模态特征空间中放大风险信号的有效性。

title: Feasible strategies for conflict resolution within intuitionistic fuzzy preference-based conflict situations
authors: Guangming Lang, Mingchuan Shang, Mengjun Hu, Jie Zhou, Feng Xu
abstract: In three-way conflict analysis, preference-based conflict situations characterize agents' attitudes towards issues by formally modeling their preferences over pairs of issues. However, existing preference-based conflict models rely exclusively on three qualitative relations, namely, preference, converse, and indifference, to describe agents' attitudes towards issue pairs, which significantly limits their capacity in capturing the essence of conflict. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the concept of an intuitionistic fuzzy preference-based conflict situation that captures agents' attitudes towards issue pairs with finer granularity than that afforded by classical preference-based models. Afterwards, we develop intuitionistic fuzzy preference-based conflict measures within this framework, and construct three-way conflict analysis models for trisecting the set of agent pairs, the agent set, and the issue set. Additionally, relative loss functions built on the proposed conflict functions are employed to calculate thresholds for three-way conflict analysis. Finally, we present adjustment mechanism-based feasible strategies that simultaneously account for both adjustment magnitudes and conflict degrees, together with an algorithm for constructing such feasible strategies, and provide an illustrative example to demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed model.
zh_title: 基于直觉模糊偏好冲突情境的冲突解决可行策略
translation: 在三支冲突分析中，基于偏好的冲突情境通过形式化建模主体对问题对的偏好来刻画主体对问题的态度。然而，现有的基于偏好的冲突模型完全依赖于三种定性关系，即偏好、逆向和无差异，来描述主体对问题对的态度，这显著限制了它们捕获冲突本质的能力。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了直觉模糊偏好冲突情境的概念，它以比经典基于偏好模型更精细的粒度来捕获主体对问题对的态度。随后，我们在该框架内开发了直觉模糊偏好冲突度量，并构建了用于三支划分主体对集合、主体集合和问题集合的三支冲突分析模型。此外，利用基于所提出的冲突函数构建的相对损失函数来计算三支冲突分析的阈值。最后，我们提出了兼顾调整幅度和冲突程度的基于调整机制的可行策略，以及构建此类可行策略的算法，并提供了一个说明性示例来证明所提出模型的有效性和可行性。
tldr: 针对传统偏好冲突模型粒度不足的问题，本文提出了直觉模糊偏好冲突情境，开发了相应的冲突度量和三支分析模型，并设计了考虑调整幅度和冲突程度的可行冲突解决策略。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将传统的定性偏好关系（偏好、逆向、无差异）提升到更精细的直觉模糊偏好表示，从而显著增强了冲突情境建模的粒度。这种方法有效地捕捉了冲突中固有的不确定性和模糊性。通过将直觉模糊框架与三支冲突分析相结合，并最终设计出兼顾冲突程度和调整成本的“可行策略”，该研究为形式化冲突解决理论提供了重要的工具和方法。
motivation: 现有的基于偏好的冲突情境模型仅依赖于三种定性关系（偏好、逆向和无差异）来描述主体对问题对的态度，这严重限制了它们捕获冲突本质的能力。
method: 引入了直觉模糊偏好冲突情境的概念，以实现比经典模型更精细的粒度。在此框架内，开发了直觉模糊偏好冲突度量，并构建了用于三支划分主体对、主体集合和问题集合的三支冲突分析模型。利用基于冲突函数的相对损失函数来计算三支分析的阈值。提出了兼顾调整幅度和冲突程度的基于调整机制的可行策略及其构建算法。
results: 提供了一个说明性示例，证明了所提出模型的有效性和可行性。
conclusion: 提出了一种基于直觉模糊偏好的冲突情境，通过开发直觉模糊冲突度量和基于调整机制的可行策略，实现了对冲突情境更精细的描述和有效的冲突解决。

title: Precision in Practice: Knowledge Guided Code Summarizing Grounded in Industrial Expectations
authors: Jintai Li, Songqiang Chen, Shuo Jin, Xiaoyuan Xie
abstract:
Code summaries are essential for helping developers understand code functionality and reducing maintenance and collaboration costs. Although recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved automatic code summarization, the practical usefulness of generated summaries in industrial settings remains insufficiently explored. In collaboration with documentation experts from the industrial HarmonyOS project, we conducted a questionnaire study showing that over 57.4% of code summaries produced by state-of-the-art approaches were rejected due to violations of developers' expectations for industrial documentation. Beyond semantic similarity to reference summaries, developers emphasize additional requirements, including the use of appropriate domain terminology, explicit function categorization, and the avoidance of redundant implementation details.
  To address these expectations, we propose ExpSum, an expectation-aware code summarization approach that integrates function metadata abstraction, informative metadata filtering, context-aware domain knowledge retrieval, and constraint-driven prompting to guide LLMs in generating structured, expectation-aligned summaries. We evaluate ExpSum on the HarmonyOS project and widely used code summarization benchmarks. Experimental results show that ExpSum consistently outperforms all baselines, achieving improvements of up to 26.71% in BLEU-4 and 20.10% in ROUGE-L on HarmonyOS. Furthermore, LLM-based evaluations indicate that ExpSum-generated summaries better align with developer expectations across other projects, demonstrating its effectiveness for industrial code documentation.
zh_title: 实践中的精准性：基于工业预期的知识引导代码摘要生成
translation: 代码摘要对于帮助开发者理解代码功能、降低维护和协作成本至关重要。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展显著改善了自动代码摘要，但在工业环境中，生成的摘要的实用性仍未得到充分探索。我们与工业鸿蒙（HarmonyOS）项目的文档专家合作进行了一项问卷调查，结果显示，由于违反了开发者对工业文档的期望，超过57.4%的最先进方法生成的代码摘要被拒绝。除了与参考摘要的语义相似性外，开发者还强调了额外的要求，包括使用适当的领域术语、明确的功能分类以及避免冗余的实现细节。为了满足这些期望，我们提出了ExpSum，这是一种预期感知的代码摘要方法，它集成了功能元数据抽象、信息元数据过滤、上下文感知领域知识检索和约束驱动提示，以指导LLMs生成结构化、与期望保持一致的摘要。我们在HarmonyOS项目和广泛使用的代码摘要基准上对ExpSum进行了评估。实验结果表明，ExpSum持续优于所有基线，在HarmonyOS上的BLEU-4指标上提高了高达26.71%，在ROUGE-L指标上提高了20.10%。此外，基于LLM的评估表明，ExpSum生成的摘要更好地符合其他项目的开发者期望，证明了其在工业代码文档方面的有效性。
tldr: 尽管LLMs提高了代码摘要的语义准确性，但在工业界（如HarmonyOS）中，超过57%的SOTA摘要因不符合开发者对术语、分类和冗余度的期望而被拒绝。本文提出了**ExpSum**方法，通过整合元数据处理、领域知识检索和约束驱动提示，显著提高了摘要在工业环境中的质量和实用性，BLEU-4和ROUGE-L指标均有大幅提升。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将代码摘要的研究焦点从单纯追求语义相似性（如BLEU/ROUGE分数）转移到满足实际的“工业期望”和“文档标准”。通过与HarmonyOS项目的紧密合作，作者明确了现实世界中摘要被拒绝的关键原因，这为该领域的研究提供了重要的实践指导。ExpSum通过引入领域知识和结构化约束（如元数据处理和约束驱动提示）来弥补LLM在生成专业、结构化文档方面的不足，有效提高了摘要的实用性和可接受度，对于推动代码摘要技术从实验室走向工业实践具有重要意义。
motivation: 尽管最新的大型语言模型（LLMs）显著改善了自动代码摘要的语义相似性，但在工业实践中，生成的摘要的实用性探索不足。与HarmonyOS的文档专家合作发现，现有最先进方法生成的摘要有超过57.4%因违反开发者对工业文档的期望（如使用适当的领域术语、明确的功能分类、避免冗余细节）而被拒绝。
method: 提出了一种名为**ExpSum**的预期感知代码摘要方法。该方法集成了功能元数据抽象、信息元数据过滤、上下文感知领域知识检索和约束驱动提示，以指导大型语言模型生成结构化且符合预期的摘要。
results: ExpSum在HarmonyOS项目和广泛使用的基准测试中持续优于所有基线方法。在HarmonyOS上，ExpSum在BLEU-4指标上实现了高达26.71%的提升，在ROUGE-L指标上实现了高达20.10%的提升。此外，基于LLM的评估表明，ExpSum生成的摘要更好地符合其他项目的开发者预期。
conclusion: ExpSum方法通过整合工业期望和领域知识，能够生成高质量、符合开发者需求的工业代码文档。

title: Universal Costas Matrices: Towards a General Framework for Costas Array Construction
authors: Fatih Gulec, Vahid Abolghasemi
abstract: Costas arrays are a special type of permutation matrices with ideal autocorrelation and low cross-correlation properties, making them valuable for radar, wireless communication, and integrated sensing and communication applications. This paper presents a novel unified framework for analyzing and discovering new Costas arrays. We introduce Universal Costas Matrices (UCMs) and Universal Costas Frequency Matrices (UCFMs) and investigate their structural characteristics. A framework integrating UCMs and UCFMs is proposed to pave the way for future artificial intelligence-assisted Costas array discovery. Leveraging the structural properties of UCMs and UCFMs, a reconstruction-based search method is developed to generate UCMs from UCFMs. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly accelerates the search process and enhances structural insight into Costas array generation.
comment: Accepted for IEEE International Conference on Communications (ICC) 2026
zh_title: 普遍的科斯塔斯矩阵：迈向科斯塔斯阵列构建的通用框架
translation: 科斯塔斯阵列是一种特殊的置换矩阵，具有理想的自相关和低互相关特性，使其在雷达、无线通信以及集成传感与通信应用中具有重要价值。本文提出了一个新颖的统一框架，用于分析和发现新的科斯塔斯阵列。我们引入了通用科斯塔斯矩阵（UCMs）和通用科斯塔斯频率矩阵（UCFMs），并研究了它们的结构特征。提出了一个整合UCMs和UCFMs的框架，旨在为未来人工智能辅助的科斯塔斯阵列发现铺平道路。利用UCMs和UCFMs的结构特性，开发了一种基于重构的搜索方法，用于从UCFMs生成UCMs。数值结果表明，所提出的方法显著加快了搜索过程，并增强了对科斯塔斯阵列生成的结构洞察。
tldr: 本文提出了一个用于分析和发现科斯塔斯阵列的通用框架，引入了通用科斯塔斯矩阵（UCMs）和通用科斯塔斯频率矩阵（UCFMs）。利用基于重构的搜索方法，该框架显著加快了科斯塔斯阵列的搜索过程并增强了结构洞察，为未来AI辅助发现奠定了基础。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了通用科斯塔斯矩阵（UCMs）和通用科斯塔斯频率矩阵（UCFMs）的新概念，并构建了一个统一的框架来连接它们。这一框架不仅提供了一种新的、结构化的分析视角，而且通过基于重构的搜索方法，解决了传统科斯塔斯阵列搜索计算量大的问题，显著提高了搜索效率。此外，该框架明确地将AI辅助发现作为未来的方向，显示出其在矩阵构建自动化领域的潜在重要性。
motivation: 科斯塔斯阵列是一种具有理想自相关和低互相关特性的特殊置换矩阵，在雷达、无线通信和集成传感与通信等领域具有重要价值。本文的动机是建立一个新颖的统一框架来分析和发现新的科斯塔斯阵列。
method: 引入了通用科斯塔斯矩阵（UCMs）和通用科斯塔斯频率矩阵（UCFMs），并研究了它们的结构特征。提出了一个整合UCMs和UCFMs的框架，旨在为未来人工智能辅助的科斯塔斯阵列发现铺平道路。基于UCMs和UCFMs的结构特性，开发了一种基于重构的搜索方法，用于从UCFMs生成UCMs。
results: 数值结果表明，所提出的方法显著加快了搜索过程，并增强了对科斯塔斯阵列生成的结构洞察。

title: Deep-Learning-Based Control of a Decoupled Two-Segment Continuum Robot for Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection
authors: Yuancheng Shao, Yao Zhang, Jia Gu, Zixi Chen, Di Wu, Yuqiao Chen, Bo Lu, Wenjie Liu, Cesare Stefanini, Peng Qi
abstract: Manual endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is technically demanding, and existing single-segment robotic tools offer limited dexterity. These limitations motivate the development of more advanced solutions. To address this, DESectBot, a novel dual segment continuum robot with a decoupled structure and integrated surgical forceps, enabling 6 degrees of freedom (DoFs) tip dexterity for improved lesion targeting in ESD, was developed in this work. Deep learning controllers based on gated recurrent units (GRUs) for simultaneous tip position and orientation control, effectively handling the nonlinear coupling between continuum segments, were proposed. The GRU controller was benchmarked against Jacobian based inverse kinematics, model predictive control (MPC), a feedforward neural network (FNN), and a long short-term memory (LSTM) network. In nested-rectangle and Lissajous trajectory tracking tasks, the GRU achieved the lowest position/orientation RMSEs: 1.11 mm/ 4.62° and 0.81 mm/ 2.59°, respectively. For orientation control at a fixed position (four target poses), the GRU attained a mean RMSE of 0.14 mm and 0.72°, outperforming all alternatives. In a peg transfer task, the GRU achieved a 100% success rate (120 success/120 attempts) with an average transfer time of 11.8s, the STD significantly outperforms novice-controlled systems. Additionally, an ex vivo ESD demonstration grasping, elevating, and resecting tissue as the scalpel completed the cut confirmed that DESectBot provides sufficient stiffness to divide thick gastric mucosa and an operative workspace adequate for large lesions.These results confirm that GRU-based control significantly enhances precision, reliability, and usability in ESD surgical training scenarios.
zh_title: 基于深度学习的解耦双段连续体机器人在内镜黏膜下剥离术中的控制
translation: 手动内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）对技术要求很高，而现有的单段机器人工具灵活性有限。这些限制促使开发更先进的解决方案。为解决此问题，本研究开发了DESectBot，这是一种新型双段连续体机器人，具有解耦结构和集成的外科手术钳，可实现6自由度的尖端灵活性，以改善ESD中的病灶靶向能力。研究提出了基于门控循环单元（GRUs）的深度学习控制器，用于同步控制尖端位置和方向，有效处理连续体分段之间的非线性耦合。GRU控制器与基于雅可比的逆运动学、模型预测控制（MPC）、前馈神经网络（FNN）和长短期记忆（LSTM）网络进行了基准测试。在嵌套矩形和李萨如轨迹跟踪任务中，GRU实现了最低的位置/方向RMSE：分别为1.11 mm/4.62°和0.81 mm/2.59°。对于固定位置的方向控制（四个目标姿态），GRU获得了0.14 mm和0.72°的平均RMSE，优于所有替代方案。在抓取转移任务中，GRU实现了100%的成功率（120次尝试中成功120次），平均转移时间为11.8秒，标准差显著优于新手控制的系统。此外，离体ESD演示（包括抓取、抬升和切除组织）证实了刀片完成了切割，确认DESectBot提供了足够的刚度来分割厚的胃黏膜，并且操作工作空间足以处理大病灶。这些结果证实，基于GRU的控制显著提高了ESD手术培训场景中的精度、可靠性和可用性。
tldr: 针对内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）的挑战，研究者开发了一种名为DESectBot的解耦双段连续体机器人（6自由度），并提出了一种基于GRU的深度学习控制器。该控制器在精度、可靠性和操作性方面均显著优于传统方法和替代神经网络，并在离体ESD演示中表现出色。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将深度学习（特别是GRU网络）应用于控制解耦的双段连续体机器人，以解决其固有的非线性耦合和高精度操作需求。连续体机器人在微创手术中潜力巨大，但精确控制一直是挑战。通过引入GRU，作者成功地在位置和方向控制方面达到了亚毫米和亚度级别的精度，这对于内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）这种对精度要求极高的手术至关重要。与传统控制方法和替代神经网络的全面对比基准测试，增强了结果的说服力。该工作不仅提出了新的硬件（DESectBot），更重要的是提出了一个高性能的控制范式，对于推动连续体机器人在复杂微创手术中的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 手动内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）对技术要求很高，而现有的单段机器人工具灵活性（dexterity）有限。这些限制促使开发更先进的解决方案。
method: 1. 开发了DESectBot，这是一种新型的双段连续体机器人，具有解耦结构和集成的外科手术钳，可实现6自由度的尖端灵活性。2. 提出了基于门控循环单元（GRUs）的深度学习控制器，用于同步控制尖端位置和方向，有效处理连续体分段之间的非线性耦合。3. 将GRU控制器与基于雅可比的逆运动学、模型预测控制（MPC）、前馈神经网络（FNN）和长短期记忆（LSTM）网络进行了基准测试。4. 进行了嵌套矩形和李萨如轨迹跟踪任务、固定位置方向控制任务、抓取转移任务（peg transfer）以及离体内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）演示。
results: 1. 在嵌套矩形和李萨如轨迹跟踪任务中，GRU实现了最低的位置/方向RMSE：分别为1.11 mm/4.62°和0.81 mm/2.59°。2. 在固定位置的方向控制（四个目标姿态）中，GRU取得了0.14 mm和0.72°的平均RMSE，优于所有替代方案。3. 在抓取转移任务中，GRU实现了100%的成功率（120次尝试中成功120次），平均转移时间为11.8秒，标准差显著优于新手控制的系统。4. 离体ESD演示证实DESectBot提供了足够的刚度来分割厚的胃黏膜，并且操作工作空间足以处理大病灶。
conclusion: 这些结果证实，基于GRU的控制显著提高了ESD手术培训场景中的精度、可靠性和可用性。

title: UnHype: CLIP-Guided Hypernetworks for Dynamic LoRA Unlearning
authors: Piotr Wójcik, Maksym Petrenko, Wojciech Gromski, Przemysław Spurek, Maciej Zieba
abstract: Recent advances in large-scale diffusion models have intensified concerns about their potential misuse, particularly in generating realistic yet harmful or socially disruptive content. This challenge has spurred growing interest in effective machine unlearning, the process of selectively removing specific knowledge or concepts from a model without compromising its overall generative capabilities. Among various approaches, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as an effective and efficient method for fine-tuning models toward targeted unlearning. However, LoRA-based methods often exhibit limited adaptability to concept semantics and struggle to balance removing closely related concepts with maintaining generalization across broader meanings. Moreover, these methods face scalability challenges when multiple concepts must be erased simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce UnHype, a framework that incorporates hypernetworks into single- and multi-concept LoRA training. The proposed architecture can be directly plugged into Stable Diffusion as well as modern flow-based text-to-image models, where it demonstrates stable training behavior and effective concept control. During inference, the hypernetwork dynamically generates adaptive LoRA weights based on the CLIP embedding, enabling more context-aware, scalable unlearning. We evaluate UnHype across several challenging tasks, including object erasure, celebrity erasure, and explicit content removal, demonstrating its effectiveness and versatility. Repository: https://github.com/gmum/UnHype.
zh_title: UnHype：用于动态LoRA遗忘的CLIP引导超网络
translation: 近期大规模扩散模型的进展加剧了人们对其潜在滥用的担忧，特别是在生成逼真但有害或具有社会破坏性的内容方面。这一挑战激发了人们对有效机器遗忘的兴趣，即在不损害模型整体生成能力的前提下，有选择地移除模型中的特定知识或概念。在各种方法中，低秩适应（LoRA）已成为一种有效且高效的、针对性遗忘的模型微调方法。然而，基于LoRA的方法通常对概念语义的适应性有限，并且难以平衡移除密切相关概念与维持更广泛意义上的泛化能力。此外，当需要同时擦除多个概念时，这些方法面临可扩展性挑战。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了UnHype，这是一个将超网络整合到单概念和多概念LoRA训练中的框架。所提出的架构可以直接插入Stable Diffusion以及现代基于流的文本到图像模型中，它展示了稳定的训练行为和有效的概念控制。在推理过程中，超网络根据CLIP嵌入动态生成自适应的LoRA权重，从而实现更具上下文感知、可扩展的遗忘。我们在几项具有挑战性的任务中评估了UnHype，包括物体擦除、名人擦除和显式内容移除，证明了其有效性和多功能性。
tldr: 针对扩散模型的滥用问题，本文提出UnHype框架，它使用CLIP引导的超网络动态生成自适应LoRA权重，从而实现更具上下文感知和可扩展性的机器遗忘，有效擦除物体、名人和显式内容等概念。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于利用CLIP引导的超网络来动态生成LoRA权重，从而实现动态机器遗忘（Dynamic Unlearning）。这有效地解决了传统静态LoRA遗忘方法在概念语义适应性和多概念擦除可扩展性方面的核心局限性。通过使遗忘过程对输入提示（通过CLIP嵌入）具有上下文感知能力，UnHype为大型扩散模型中实用、可扩展的机器遗忘提供了一个重要的方向。
motivation: 大规模扩散模型可能被滥用以生成有害或具有社会破坏性的内容。现有的基于LoRA的机器遗忘方法在概念语义的适应性、平衡相关概念移除与泛化能力，以及同时擦除多个概念时的可扩展性方面存在局限性。
method: 提出了UnHype框架，将超网络（hypernetworks）整合到单概念和多概念的LoRA训练中。该架构可直接应用于Stable Diffusion和基于流的文本到图像模型。在推理过程中，超网络根据CLIP嵌入动态生成自适应的LoRA权重，从而实现更具上下文感知和可扩展性的遗忘。
results: 实现了稳定的训练行为和有效的概念控制。在物体擦除、名人擦除和显式内容移除等具有挑战性的任务中进行了评估，证明了其有效性和多功能性。
conclusion: 通过引入动态生成自适应LoRA权重的CLIP引导超网络，UnHype成功解决了现有LoRA遗忘方法在概念适应性和可扩展性方面的限制，提供了一种有效且通用的机器遗忘解决方案。

title: Verified Critical Step Optimization for LLM Agents
authors: Mukai Li, Qingcheng Zeng, Tianqing Fang, Zhenwen Liang, Linfeng Song, Qi Liu, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu
abstract: As large language model agents tackle increasingly complex long-horizon tasks, effective post-training becomes critical. Prior work faces fundamental challenges: outcome-only rewards fail to precisely attribute credit to intermediate steps, estimated step-level rewards introduce systematic noise, and Monte Carlo sampling approaches for step reward estimation incur prohibitive computational cost. Inspired by findings that only a small fraction of high-entropy tokens drive effective RL for reasoning, we propose Critical Step Optimization (CSO), which focuses preference learning on verified critical steps, decision points where alternate actions demonstrably flip task outcomes from failure to success. Crucially, our method starts from failed policy trajectories rather than expert demonstrations, directly targeting the policy model's weaknesses. We use a process reward model (PRM) to identify candidate critical steps, leverage expert models to propose high-quality alternatives, then continue execution from these alternatives using the policy model itself until task completion. Only alternatives that the policy successfully executes to correct outcomes are verified and used as DPO training data, ensuring both quality and policy reachability. This yields fine-grained, verifiable supervision at critical decisions while avoiding trajectory-level coarseness and step-level noise. Experiments on GAIA-Text-103 and XBench-DeepSearch show that CSO achieves 37% and 26% relative improvement over the SFT baseline and substantially outperforms other post-training methods, while requiring supervision at only 16% of trajectory steps. This demonstrates the effectiveness of selective verification-based learning for agent post-training.
zh_title: 验证关键步骤优化用于大型语言模型智能体
translation: 随着大型语言模型智能体处理日益复杂的长程任务，有效的后训练变得至关重要。先前的工作面临着根本性的挑战：仅基于结果的奖励无法精确地将功劳归因于中间步骤，估计的步骤级奖励引入了系统性噪声，而用于步骤奖励估计的蒙特卡洛采样方法则需要高昂的计算成本。受高熵令牌中只有一小部分驱动有效推理强化学习的发现启发，我们提出了关键步骤优化（CSO），它将偏好学习集中在经过验证的关键步骤上，即那些备选行动能明显将任务结果从失败转变为成功的决策点。至关重要的是，我们的方法从失败的策略轨迹而非专家演示开始，直接针对策略模型的弱点。我们使用过程奖励模型（PRM）来识别候选关键步骤，利用专家模型提出高质量的替代方案，然后使用策略模型本身从这些替代方案继续执行，直到任务完成。只有策略成功执行并纠正结果的替代方案才会被验证并用作DPO训练数据，从而确保了质量和策略可达性。这在关键决策点产生了细粒度、可验证的监督，同时避免了轨迹级的粗糙性和步骤级的噪声。在GAIA-Text-103和XBench-DeepSearch上的实验表明，CSO相对于SFT基线实现了37%和26%的相对提升，并显著优于其他后训练方法，而监督仅需在16%的轨迹步骤上进行。这证明了选择性基于验证的学习对于智能体后训练的有效性。
tldr: 针对LLM智能体后训练中的奖励归因和计算成本问题，本文提出“验证关键步骤优化”（CSO）。CSO从失败轨迹中识别关键决策点，利用专家建议和策略模型执行验证，只使用成功纠正结果的步骤作为DPO数据。CSO在GAIA和XBench上取得了显著优于基线和现有方法的性能提升，且监督数据量极少。
ai_comments: 创新性地提出了“验证关键步骤优化”（CSO），将复杂长程任务的强化学习/偏好学习重点聚焦于少数对结果有决定性影响的关键决策点。该方法通过从失败轨迹中识别弱点，结合专家建议和策略模型自我验证，高效地生成了细粒度、高信噪比的DPO训练数据。其重要性在于它解决了传统奖励归因的噪声和计算成本问题，显著提高了LLM智能体在复杂任务上的性能，同时仅需极少的监督资源。
motivation: 解决LLM智能体在复杂长程任务中有效后训练的难题。现有方法面临挑战：仅基于结果的奖励难以精确归因；估计的步骤级奖励引入噪声；蒙特卡洛采样成本过高。
method: 提出关键步骤优化（CSO）。该方法从失败策略轨迹开始，使用过程奖励模型（PRM）识别候选关键步骤。利用专家模型提出高质量替代方案，然后使用策略模型继续执行这些替代方案。只有成功完成任务的替代方案才会被验证，并用作DPO训练数据。这提供了细粒度、可验证的监督。
results: 在GAIA-Text-103和XBench-DeepSearch上，CSO相对于SFT基线分别实现了37%和26%的相对提升。它显著优于其他后训练方法，且仅在16%的轨迹步骤上需要监督。
conclusion: 验证了选择性基于验证的学习（CSO）对于智能体后训练的有效性。它能够在关键决策点提供细粒度、可验证的监督，同时避免了轨迹级的粗糙性和步骤级的噪声。

title: Socratic-Geo: Synthetic Data Generation and Geometric Reasoning via Multi-Agent Interaction
authors: Zhengbo Jiao, Shaobo Wang, Zifan Zhang, Wei Wang, Bing Zhao, Hu Wei, Linfeng Zhang
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced vision-language understanding. However, even state-of-the-art models struggle with geometric reasoning, revealing a critical bottleneck: the extreme scarcity of high-quality image-text pairs. Human annotation is prohibitively expensive, while automated methods fail to ensure fidelity and training effectiveness. Existing approaches either passively adapt to available images or employ inefficient random exploration with filtering, decoupling generation from learning needs. We propose Socratic-Geo, a fully autonomous framework that dynamically couples data synthesis with model learning through multi-agent interaction. The Teacher agent generates parameterized Python scripts with reflective feedback (Reflect for solvability, RePI for visual validity), ensuring image-text pair purity. The Solver agent optimizes reasoning through preference learning, with failure paths guiding Teacher's targeted augmentation. Independently, the Generator learns image generation capabilities on accumulated "image-code-instruction" triplets, distilling programmatic drawing intelligence into visual generation. Starting from only 108 seed problems, Socratic-Solver achieves 49.11 on six benchmarks using one-quarter of baseline data, surpassing strong baselines by 2.43 points. Socratic-Generator achieves 42.4% on GenExam, establishing new state-of-the-art for open-source models, surpassing Seedream-4.0 (39.8%) and approaching Gemini-2.5-Flash-Image (43.1%).
zh_title: Socratic-Geo：通过多智能体交互实现的合成数据生成和几何推理
translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）极大地推动了视觉-语言理解的进步。然而，即使是目前最先进的模型，在几何推理方面仍面临挑战，这暴露了一个关键瓶颈：高质量图像-文本对的极度稀缺。人工标注成本高得令人望而却步，而自动化方法则难以确保保真度和训练有效性。现有方法要么被动地适应现有图像，要么采用效率低下的随机探索和过滤，将生成与学习需求分离。我们提出了Socratic-Geo，这是一个完全自主的框架，通过多智能体交互将数据合成与模型学习动态耦合。教师智能体生成带有反射反馈（Reflect用于可解性，RePI用于视觉有效性）的参数化Python脚本，确保图像-文本对的纯度。求解器智能体通过偏好学习优化推理，其失败路径指导教师进行有针对性的增强。此外，生成器独立地学习在积累的“图像-代码-指令”三元组上的图像生成能力，将程序化绘图智能提炼为视觉生成。Socratic-Solver仅从108个种子问题开始，使用基线四分之一的数据，在六个基准测试上取得了49.11分，超过强基线2.43分。Socratic-Generator在GenExam上取得了42.4%的成绩，为开源模型树立了新的最先进水平，超过了Seedream-4.0（39.8%）并接近Gemini-2.5-Flash-Image（43.1%）。
tldr: Socratic-Geo是一个多智能体框架，通过让“教师”生成高质量的几何问题代码和“求解器”提供学习反馈，实现数据生成与模型训练的动态耦合。它仅用少量数据就显著提高了几何推理能力，并在图像生成方面达到了开源模型的SOTA。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个高度自主和动态耦合的数据生成范式，解决了传统方法中数据生成与模型学习需求脱节的问题。通过引入“教师”和“求解器”的多智能体交互机制，并利用反射反馈（Reflect和RePI）来确保合成数据的纯度和有效性，极大地提高了数据质量和训练效率。此外，将程序化绘图智能（Python scripts）蒸馏到视觉生成模型中，是解决几何图形生成保真度问题的有效途径，这对于推动几何推理领域开源模型的发展具有重要意义。该方法仅用少量初始数据就实现了显著的性能提升，证明了其数据效率和扩展潜力。
motivation: 解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在几何推理方面表现不佳的问题，其核心瓶颈在于高质量图像-文本对的极度稀缺。现有方法的人工标注成本过高，自动化方法缺乏保真度和训练有效性，且将数据生成与模型学习需求分离。
method:
提出Socratic-Geo，一个完全自主的框架，通过多智能体交互将数据合成与模型学习动态耦合。该框架包含：
1. **Teacher Agent（教师智能体）：** 生成带有反射反馈（Reflect用于可解性，RePI用于视觉有效性）的参数化Python脚本，确保图像-文本对的纯度。
2. **Solver Agent（求解器智能体）：** 通过偏好学习优化推理，其失败路径指导教师进行有针对性的数据增强。
3. **Generator Agent（生成器智能体）：** 独立地在积累的“图像-代码-指令”三元组上学习图像生成能力，将程序化绘图智能提炼为视觉生成。
results:
Socratic-Solver：仅使用基线四分之一的数据，在六个基准测试上达到49.11分，超过强基线2.43分。
Socratic-Generator：在GenExam上达到42.4%，超越Seedream-4.0（39.8%），并接近Gemini-2.5-Flash-Image（43.1%），为开源模型树立了新的最先进水平（SOTA）。
conclusion: Socratic-Geo框架通过动态耦合数据合成与模型学习，有效地解决了高质量几何推理数据稀缺的问题，并在求解器和生成器性能上均达到或接近最先进水平。

title: Most Convolutional Networks Suffer from Small Adversarial Perturbations
authors: Amit Daniely, Idan Mehalel
abstract: The existence of adversarial examples is relatively understood for random fully connected neural networks, but much less so for convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The recent work [Daniely, 2025] establishes that adversarial examples can be found in CNNs, in some non-optimal distance from the input. We extend over this work and prove that adversarial examples in random CNNs with input dimension $d$ can be found already in $\ell_2$-distance of order $\lVert x \rVert /\sqrt{d}$ from the input $x$, which is essentially the nearest possible. We also show that such adversarial small perturbations can be found using a single step of gradient descent. To derive our results we use Fourier decomposition to efficiently bound the singular values of a random linear convolutional operator, which is the main ingredient of a CNN layer. This bound might be of independent interest.
zh_title: 大多数卷积网络都容易受到微小对抗性扰动的影响
translation: 对抗性示例的存在性对于随机全连接神经网络来说相对清楚，但对于卷积神经网络（CNN）则知之甚少。最近的工作[Daniely, 2025]确定了在CNN中可以找到对抗性示例，但与输入之间的距离是非最优的。我们扩展了这项工作，并证明了在输入维度为 $d$ 的随机CNN中，对抗性示例可以在距离输入 $x$ 仅为 $\ell_2$ 范数 $\lVert x \rVert /\sqrt{d}$ 的范围内找到，这本质上是最近的距离。我们还表明，可以使用单步梯度下降找到此类微小的对抗性扰动。为了得出我们的结果，我们使用傅里叶分解来有效界定随机线性卷积算子（它是CNN层的主要组成部分）的奇异值。这个界限本身可能具有独立的理论价值。
tldr: 研究证明随机卷积神经网络（CNN）容易受到极小的（接近最优距离 $\lVert x \rVert /\sqrt{d}$）对抗性扰动的影响，并且这些扰动可以通过单步梯度下降找到。
ai_comments: 本文的主要创新在于为随机卷积神经网络的对抗性示例提供了接近最优的距离界限（$\lVert x \rVert /\sqrt{d}$），极大地推进了对CNN鲁棒性理论的理解。通过利用傅里叶分解来分析卷积算子的奇异值，研究提供了一种强大的理论工具。这项工作的重要性在于，它从理论上证明了CNN对微小扰动的脆弱性是结构固有的，而非训练特有的。但需要注意，结果是针对“随机”CNN得出的，其对实际训练模型的泛化程度可能需要进一步验证。
motivation: 现有研究对全连接神经网络的对抗性示例理解较多，但对卷积神经网络（CNN）的研究较少。先前的研究[Daniely, 2025]证明了对抗性示例的存在，但距离是非最优的。本文旨在证明随机CNN中存在距离输入最近（接近最优）的对抗性示例。
method: 使用傅里叶分解来有效界定随机线性卷积算子的奇异值。在实践中，可以通过单步梯度下降找到这些微小的对抗性扰动。
results: 证明了在输入维度为 $d$ 的随机CNN中，对抗性示例可以在距离输入 $x$ 仅为 $\ell_2$ 范数 $\lVert x \rVert /\sqrt{d}$ 的范围内找到，这本质上是最近的距离。同时表明，可以通过单步梯度下降找到此类微小的对抗性扰动。
conclusion: 随机卷积神经网络本质上容易受到极小的（接近最优距离）对抗性扰动的影响。用于推导结果的随机线性卷积算子的奇异值界限具有独立的理论价值。

title: SWE-Master: Unleashing the Potential of Software Engineering Agents via Post-Training
authors: Huatong Song, Lisheng Huang, Shuang Sun, Jinhao Jiang, Ran Le, Daixuan Cheng, Guoxin Chen, Yiwen Hu, Zongchao Chen, Wayne Xin Zhao, Yang Song, Tao Zhang, Ji-Rong Wen
abstract: In this technical report, we present SWE-Master, an open-source and fully reproducible post-training framework for building effective software engineering agents. SWE-Master systematically explores the complete agent development pipeline, including teacher-trajectory synthesis and data curation, long-horizon SFT, RL with real execution feedback, and inference framework design. Starting from an open-source base model with limited initial SWE capability, SWE-Master demonstrates how systematical optimization method can elicit strong long-horizon SWE task solving abilities. We evaluate SWE-Master on SWE-bench Verified, a standard benchmark for realistic software engineering tasks. Under identical experimental settings, our approach achieves a resolve rate of 61.4\% with Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, substantially outperforming existing open-source baselines. By further incorporating test-time scaling~(TTS) with LLM-based environment feedback, SWE-Master reaches 70.8\% at TTS@8, demonstrating a strong performance potential. SWE-Master provides a practical and transparent foundation for advancing reproducible research on software engineering agents. The code is available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/SWE-Master.
zh_title: SWE-Master：通过后训练释放软件工程智能体的潜力
translation: 在这份技术报告中，我们介绍了SWE-Master，一个用于构建有效软件工程智能体的开源且完全可复现的后训练框架。SWE-Master系统地探索了完整的智能体开发流程，包括教师轨迹合成和数据整理、长程SFT、带有真实执行反馈的RL以及推理框架设计。从一个初始SWE能力有限的开源基模型开始，SWE-Master展示了系统的优化方法如何能够激发强大的长程SWE任务解决能力。我们在SWE-bench Verified（一个用于现实软件工程任务的标准基准）上评估了SWE-Master。在相同的实验设置下，我们的方法在使用Qwen2.5-Coder-32B时达到了61.4%的解决率，大幅优于现有开源基线。通过进一步结合基于LLM的环境反馈的测试时扩展（TTS@8），SWE-Master达到了70.8%，展示了强大的性能潜力。SWE-Master为推进软件工程智能体的可复现研究提供了一个实用且透明的基础。代码可在https://github.com/RUCAIBox/SWE-Master获取。
tldr: SWE-Master是一个开源、可复现的软件工程智能体后训练框架。它系统性地优化了整个开发流程，从初始能力有限的基模型出发，在SWE-bench Verified上实现了61.4%的解决率（使用Qwen2.5-Coder-32B），显著优于现有基线，并在应用测试时扩展（TTS@8）后达到70.8%。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个系统化、端到端的后训练框架（SWE-Master），用于提升软件工程智能体的长程任务解决能力。其重要性在于，它不仅提供了高性能的结果（在SWE-bench Verified上达到70.8%），更强调了“开源”和“可复现性”，这对于推动整个SWE智能体研究领域的基础设施建设和透明度至关重要。通过结合SFT、RL和实际执行反馈，该框架提供了一个实用的蓝图，说明如何将基础大模型转化为高效率的专业级软件工程师智能体。
motivation: 旨在构建有效的软件工程智能体，并展示如何通过系统的优化方法，从初始SWE能力有限的开源基模型中激发出强大的长程SWE任务解决能力。
method: 提出了SWE-Master，一个开源、完全可复现的后训练框架。该方法系统地探索了完整的智能体开发流程，包括教师轨迹合成和数据整理、长程SFT（监督微调）、带有真实执行反馈的RL（强化学习）以及推理框架设计。
results: 在SWE-bench Verified基准测试上，使用Qwen2.5-Coder-32B实现了61.4%的解决率，大幅优于现有开源基线。通过进一步结合测试时扩展（TTS@8）和基于LLM的环境反馈，解决率达到了70.8%。
conclusion: SWE-Master为推进软件工程智能体领域的可复现研究提供了一个实用且透明的基础。

title: FactNet: A Billion-Scale Knowledge Graph for Multilingual Factual Grounding
authors: Yingli Shen, Wen Lai, Jie Zhou, Xueren Zhang, Yudong Wang, Kangyang Luo, Shuo Wang, Ge Gao, Alexander Fraser, Maosong Sun
abstract: While LLMs exhibit remarkable fluency, their utility is often compromised by factual hallucinations and a lack of traceable provenance. Existing resources for grounding mitigate this but typically enforce a dichotomy: they offer either structured knowledge without textual context (e.g., knowledge bases) or grounded text with limited scale and linguistic coverage. To bridge this gap, we introduce FactNet, a massive, open-source resource designed to unify 1.7 billion atomic assertions with 3.01 billion auditable evidence pointers derived exclusively from 316 Wikipedia editions. Unlike recent synthetic approaches, FactNet employs a strictly deterministic construction pipeline, ensuring that every evidence unit is recoverable with byte-level precision. Extensive auditing confirms a high grounding precision of 92.1%, even in long-tail languages. Furthermore, we establish FactNet-Bench, a comprehensive evaluation suite for Knowledge Graph Completion, Question Answering, and Fact Checking. FactNet provides the community with a foundational, reproducible resource for training and evaluating trustworthy, verifiable multilingual systems.
zh_title: FactNet：一个用于多语言事实验证的十亿级知识图谱
translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出非凡的流畅性，但其效用常常因事实幻觉和缺乏可追溯的出处而受损。现有的验证资源虽然能减轻这一问题，但通常存在二分法：它们要么提供缺乏文本上下文的结构化知识（例如，知识库），要么提供规模和语言覆盖有限的验证文本。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了FactNet，这是一个大规模、开源的资源，旨在统一17亿个原子断言和30.1亿个可审计的证据指针，这些证据完全来源于316个维基百科版本。与近期合成方法不同，FactNet采用严格的确定性构建流程，确保每个证据单元都能以字节级精度恢复。广泛的审计证实了92.1%的高验证精度，即使在长尾语言中也是如此。此外，我们建立了FactNet-Bench，一个用于知识图谱补全、问答和事实核查的综合评估套件。FactNet为社区提供了一个基础性、可复现的资源，用于训练和评估可信、可验证的多语言系统。
tldr: 引入FactNet，一个基于316个维基百科版本构建的十亿级多语言知识图谱，包含17亿断言和30.1亿证据指针，具有92.1%的高验证精度。它提供了一个可信、可验证的LLM训练和评估基础资源，并附带了FactNet-Bench评估套件。
ai_comments: FactNet的关键创新在于打破了现有验证资源的结构化知识（缺乏上下文）与验证文本（规模有限）之间的二分法。其重要性在于提供了一个大规模、可复现且具有高精度事实验证能力的资源，这对于提高LLMs的可靠性和可信度至关重要。通过严格的确定性构建流程和字节级精度保证，FactNet显著增强了知识来源的可审计性，并覆盖了长尾语言，解决了多语言系统中的核心挑战。
motivation: 解决大型语言模型（LLMs）普遍存在的“事实幻觉”和缺乏可追溯出处的问题。现有的事实验证资源存在局限性，要么是缺乏文本上下文的结构化知识，要么是规模和语言覆盖有限的验证文本。
method: 引入FactNet，一个从316个维基百科版本中提取的大规模开源资源。它统一了17亿个原子断言和30.1亿个可审计的证据指针。采用严格的确定性构建流程，确保每个证据单元都能以字节级精度恢复。同时，建立了FactNet-Bench评估套件，用于知识图谱补全、问答和事实核查。
results: 广泛的审计证实了FactNet具有92.1%的高验证精度，即使在长尾语言中也表现良好。
conclusion: FactNet为社区提供了一个基础性、可复现的资源，用于训练和评估可信、可验证的多语言系统。

title: AesRec: A Dataset for Aesthetics-Aligned Clothing Outfit Recommendation
authors: Wenxin Ye, Lin Li, Ming Li, Yang Shen, Kanghong Wang, Jimmy Xiangji Huang
abstract: Clothing recommendation extends beyond merely generating personalized outfits; it serves as a crucial medium for aesthetic guidance. However, existing methods predominantly rely on user-item-outfit interaction behaviors while overlooking explicit representations of clothing aesthetics. To bridge this gap, we present the AesRec benchmark dataset featuring systematic quantitative aesthetic annotations, thereby enabling the development of aesthetics-aligned recommendation systems. Grounded in professional apparel quality standards and fashion aesthetic principles, we define a multidimensional set of indicators. At the item level, six dimensions are independently assessed: silhouette, chromaticity, materiality, craftsmanship, wearability, and item-level impression. Transitioning to the outfit level, the evaluation retains the first five core attributes while introducing stylistic synergy, visual harmony, and outfit-level impression as distinct metrics to capture the collective aesthetic impact. Given the increasing human-like proficiency of Vision-Language Models in multimodal understanding and interaction, we leverage them for large-scale aesthetic scoring. We conduct rigorous human-machine consistency validation on a fashion dataset, confirming the reliability of the generated ratings. Experimental results based on AesRec further demonstrate that integrating quantified aesthetic information into clothing recommendation models can provide aesthetic guidance for users while fulfilling their personalized requirements.
zh_title: AesRec：一个用于美学对齐服装搭配推荐的数据集
translation: 服装推荐不仅仅是生成个性化搭配；它还是美学指导的关键媒介。然而，现有方法主要依赖用户-物品-搭配的交互行为，而忽略了服装美学的显式表示。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了AesRec基准数据集，该数据集具有系统的量化美学标注，从而能够开发美学对齐的推荐系统。基于专业的服装质量标准和时尚美学原则，我们定义了一套多维指标。在物品级别，独立评估六个维度：廓形、色度、材质、工艺、耐穿性和物品级印象。过渡到搭配级别，评估保留了前五个核心属性，同时引入了风格协同性、视觉和谐性和搭配级印象作为独特的指标，以捕捉整体的美学影响。鉴于视觉-语言模型在多模态理解和交互方面日益具备类人熟练度，我们利用它们进行大规模美学评分。我们在一个时尚数据集上进行了严格的人机一致性验证，证实了生成评分的可靠性。基于AesRec的实验结果进一步证明，将量化的美学信息整合到服装推荐模型中，可以在满足用户个性化需求的同时，提供美学指导。
tldr: AesRec是一个新的服装推荐数据集，它使用VLMs和专业标准来量化服装美学，帮助推荐系统不仅能个性化，还能提供时尚美学指导。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于它明确解决了现有服装推荐模型忽略美学指导的问题。通过引入一个具有专业、多维度量化美学标注的基准数据集（AesRec），它为研究人员提供了一个评估和开发“美学对齐”推荐系统的工具。利用先进的视觉-语言模型进行大规模评分，并进行严格的人机一致性验证，确保了数据的可靠性和扩展性，这是推动该领域从行为推荐转向质量和美学推荐的关键一步。
motivation: 现有服装推荐方法主要依赖用户-物品-搭配的交互行为，忽略了服装美学的显式表示。然而，服装推荐应作为美学指导的关键媒介。
method: 提出了AesRec基准数据集，包含系统的量化美学标注。基于专业服装质量标准和时尚美学原则，定义了多维指标（包括物品级的六个维度和搭配级的八个维度）。利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）进行大规模美学评分，并进行了严格的人机一致性验证。
results: 人机一致性验证确认了生成评分的可靠性。基于AesRec的实验结果表明，将量化的美学信息整合到服装推荐模型中，可以在满足个性化需求的同时，为用户提供美学指导。
conclusion: AesRec数据集的提出及其量化美学评分方法，为开发能够提供美学指导的、美学对齐的服装搭配推荐系统提供了基础和基准。

title: Learning-based Initialization of Trajectory Optimization for Path-following Problems of Redundant Manipulators
authors: Minsung Yoon, Mincheul Kang, Daehyung Park, Sung-Eui Yoon
abstract: Trajectory optimization (TO) is an efficient tool to generate a redundant manipulator's joint trajectory following a 6-dimensional Cartesian path. The optimization performance largely depends on the quality of initial trajectories. However, the selection of a high-quality initial trajectory is non-trivial and requires a considerable time budget due to the extremely large space of the solution trajectories and the lack of prior knowledge about task constraints in configuration space. To alleviate the issue, we present a learning-based initial trajectory generation method that generates high-quality initial trajectories in a short time budget by adopting example-guided reinforcement learning. In addition, we suggest a null-space projected imitation reward to consider null-space constraints by efficiently learning kinematically feasible motion captured in expert demonstrations. Our statistical evaluation in simulation shows the improved optimality, efficiency, and applicability of TO when we plug in our method's output, compared with three other baselines. We also show the performance improvement and feasibility via real-world experiments with a seven-degree-of-freedom manipulator.
comment: Accepted to ICRA 2023. Project Page
zh_title: 基于学习的冗余机械臂路径跟随问题轨迹优化初始化
translation: 轨迹优化（TO）是生成冗余机械臂沿六维笛卡尔路径运动的关节轨迹的有效工具。优化性能在很大程度上取决于初始轨迹的质量。然而，由于解轨迹空间极其庞大，且缺乏关于构型空间任务约束的先验知识，选择高质量的初始轨迹并非易事，并且需要大量的计算时间。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了一种基于学习的初始轨迹生成方法，该方法通过采用示例引导强化学习，在短时间内生成高质量的初始轨迹。此外，我们提出了一种零空间投影模仿奖励，通过有效学习专家演示中捕获的运动学可行运动来考虑零空间约束。我们在模拟中的统计评估显示，与其它三种基线方法相比，当我们使用我们方法的输出作为初始化时，轨迹优化（TO）的优化性、效率和适用性均有所提高。我们还通过七自由度机械臂的真实世界实验展示了性能的提升和可行性。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于示例引导强化学习的方法，用于快速生成高质量的冗余机械臂轨迹优化初始化轨迹，并通过引入零空间投影模仿奖励来考虑运动学可行性，显著提高了轨迹优化的性能和效率。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新点在于利用学习方法弥合了高级路径规划和低级轨迹优化之间的差距，特别解决了轨迹优化的初始化瓶颈问题。使用“零空间投影模仿奖励”是一种巧妙的方法，它将运动学可行性（冗余机器人技术的关键方面）有效地整合到强化学习框架中，使得学习到的初始轨迹与后续优化高度相关且有效。这种方法显著提高了轨迹优化在复杂冗余系统中的实用性。
motivation: 轨迹优化（TO）的性能在很大程度上取决于初始轨迹的质量。然而，由于解轨迹空间极其庞大且缺乏关于构型空间任务约束的先验知识，选择高质量的初始轨迹非常困难且耗时。
method: 提出了一种基于学习的初始轨迹生成方法，采用示例引导强化学习（example-guided reinforcement learning）。此外，引入了一种零空间投影模仿奖励（null-space projected imitation reward），以便通过有效学习专家演示中捕获的运动学可行运动来考虑零空间约束。
results: 模拟中的统计评估表明，与三种基线方法相比，将所提出的方法输出作为初始化轨迹后，轨迹优化（TO）的优化性、效率和适用性均有所提高。实际世界中对七自由度机械臂的实验也证实了性能的提升和可行性。
conclusion: 所提出的基于学习的初始化方法能够快速生成高质量的初始轨迹，从而显著提高冗余机械臂路径跟随问题的轨迹优化的性能、效率和适用性。

title: On (Im)possibility of Network Oblivious Transfer via Noisy Channels and Non-Signaling Correlations
authors: Hadi Aghaee, Christian Deppe, Holger Boche
abstract: This work investigates the fundamental limits of implementing network oblivious transfer via noisy multiple access channels and broadcast channels between honest-but-curious parties when the parties have access to general tripartite non-signaling correlations. By modeling the shared resource as an arbitrary tripartite non-signaling box, we obtain a unified perspective on both the channel behavior and the resulting correlations. Our main result demonstrates that perfect oblivious transfer is impossible. In the asymptotic regime, we further show that even negligible leakage cannot be achieved, as repeated use of the resource amplifies the receiver(s)'s ability to distinguish messages that were not intended for him/them. In contrast, the receiver(s)'s own privacy is not subject to a universal impossibility limitation.
zh_title: 关于通过噪声信道和非信号关联实现网络不经意传输的（不）可能性
translation: 这项工作研究了在诚实但好奇的参与方之间，当他们可以使用一般三方非信号关联时，通过噪声多址接入信道和广播信道实现网络不经意传输的根本限制。通过将共享资源建模为任意三方非信号盒，我们获得了关于信道行为和由此产生的关联的统一视角。我们的主要结果表明，完美的网络不经意传输是不可能的。在渐近状态下，我们进一步表明，即使是可忽略的泄露也无法实现，因为重复使用资源会放大接收方区分非目标消息的能力。相比之下，接收方自身的隐私不受普遍的不可能性限制。
tldr: 本文研究了在存在噪声信道和非信号关联的情况下实现网络不经意传输（OT）的根本限制。主要结果证明了完美的OT是不可能的，并且在渐近状态下，即使是可忽略的消息泄露也无法避免，但接收方自身的隐私没有遇到普遍的不可能性限制。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于提供了一个统一的框架（三方非信号盒）来分析噪声信道和非信号关联对网络不经意传输（OT）的影响。其重要性在于确立了在这些资源限制下，完美和渐近安全（无泄露）的网络不经意传输的根本不可能性，为理解安全协议的理论限制提供了基础。
motivation: 探究在诚实但好奇的参与方之间，通过噪声多址接入信道和广播信道以及一般三方非信号关联实现网络不经意传输的根本限制。
method: 将共享资源（包括信道行为和关联）建模为任意三方非信号盒，以获得关于信道行为和由此产生的关联的统一视角。
results: 完美的网络不经意传输（OT）是不可能的。在渐近状态下，即使是可忽略的消息泄露也无法实现，因为重复使用资源会放大接收方区分非目标消息的能力。相比之下，接收方自身的隐私不受普遍的不可能性限制。
conclusion: 完美的网络不经意传输是不可能的，且消息泄露在渐近状态下无法避免。然而，接收方自身的隐私不受普遍的不可能性限制。

title: CoCoEmo: Composable and Controllable Human-Like Emotional TTS via Activation Steering
authors: Siyi Wang, Shihong Tan, Siyi Liu, Hong Jia, Gongping Huang, James Bailey, Ting Dang
abstract: Emotional expression in human speech is nuanced and compositional, often involving multiple, sometimes conflicting, affective cues that may diverge from linguistic content. In contrast, most expressive text-to-speech systems enforce a single utterance-level emotion, collapsing affective diversity and suppressing mixed or text-emotion-misaligned expression. While activation steering via latent direction vectors offers a promising solution, it remains unclear whether emotion representations are linearly steerable in TTS, where steering should be applied within hybrid TTS architectures, and how such complex emotion behaviors should be evaluated. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of activation steering for emotional control in hybrid TTS models, introducing a quantitative, controllable steering framework, and multi-rater evaluation protocols that enable composable mixed-emotion synthesis and reliable text-emotion mismatch synthesis. Our results demonstrate, for the first time, that emotional prosody and expressive variability are primarily synthesized by the TTS language module instead of the flow-matching module, and also provide a lightweight steering approach for generating natural, human-like emotional speech.
zh_title: CoCoEmo：通过激活控制实现可组合且可控的类人情感文本转语音
translation: 人类语音中的情感表达是细致入微且具有组合性的，通常涉及多种，有时甚至是相互冲突的情感线索，这些线索可能与语言内容有所不同。相比之下，大多数富有表现力的文本转语音系统强制执行单一的话语级情感，从而压制了情感多样性，并抑制了混合表达或文本与情感不一致的表达。虽然通过潜在方向向量进行激活控制提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但目前尚不清楚情感表征在TTS中是否可以线性控制，控制应该应用于混合TTS架构中的哪个部分，以及如何评估这种复杂的情感行为。本文首次对混合TTS模型中的情感控制的激活控制进行了系统分析，引入了一个定量的、可控的控制框架和多评估者评估协议，从而实现了可组合的混合情感合成和可靠的文本-情感不匹配合成。我们的结果首次证明，情感韵律和表达变异性主要由TTS语言模块而非流匹配模块合成，并提供了一种轻量级的控制方法来生成自然的、类人的情感语音。
tldr: 本文提出了CoCoEmo，一个通过激活控制（Activation Steering）实现对混合TTS模型中复杂情感（如混合情感和情感不匹配）进行精确、轻量级控制的框架，并发现情感表达主要由语言模块而非流匹配模块合成。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次系统地将激活控制应用于混合TTS模型，以解决复杂、可组合情感（如混合情感和文本-情感不匹配）的合成难题。该研究通过引入定量控制框架和多评估者评估协议，有效解决了传统TTS系统情感表达单一的问题。更重要的是，研究首次揭示了情感韵律和表达变异性主要由TTS的语言模块而非流匹配模块合成，这一发现对未来混合TTS架构的设计具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 人类情感表达是细致入微且具有组合性的，通常涉及多种情感线索，可能与语言内容不一致。现有的情感文本转语音（TTS）系统通常只强制执行单一的、话语级别的情感，从而压制了情感多样性、混合情感或文本与情感不一致的表达。
method: 提出了第一个针对混合TTS模型中情感控制的激活控制的系统分析框架。引入了一个定量的、可控的控制框架（CoCoEmo），以及多评估者评估协议，以实现可组合的混合情感合成和可靠的文本-情感不匹配合成。
results: 首次证明情感韵律和表达变异性主要由TTS语言模块（而非流匹配模块）合成。同时，提供了一种轻量级的控制方法来生成自然的、类人的情感语音。
conclusion: 激活控制是一种有效的、轻量级的方法，可以实现对混合TTS模型中复杂、可组合情感（包括混合情感和情感不匹配）的精确控制，从而生成更自然、类人的情感语音。

title: Origin Lens: A Privacy-First Mobile Framework for Cryptographic Image Provenance and AI Detection
authors: Alexander Loth, Dominique Conceicao Rosario, Peter Ebinger, Martin Kappes, Marc-Oliver Pahl
abstract: The proliferation of generative AI poses challenges for information integrity assurance, requiring systems that connect model governance with end-user verification. We present Origin Lens, a privacy-first mobile framework that targets visual disinformation through a layered verification architecture. Unlike server-side detection systems, Origin Lens performs cryptographic image provenance verification and AI detection locally on the device via a Rust/Flutter hybrid architecture. Our system integrates multiple signals - including cryptographic provenance, generative model fingerprints, and optional retrieval-augmented verification - to provide users with graded confidence indicators at the point of consumption. We discuss the framework's alignment with regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, DSA) and its role in verification infrastructure that complements platform-level mechanisms.
zh_title: Origin Lens：一种用于加密图像溯源和AI检测的隐私优先移动框架
translation: 生成式AI的激增对信息完整性保证提出了挑战，需要能够将模型治理与终端用户验证联系起来的系统。我们提出了Origin Lens，这是一个隐私优先的移动框架，旨在通过分层验证架构解决视觉虚假信息问题。与服务器端检测系统不同，Origin Lens通过Rust/Flutter混合架构，在设备本地执行加密图像溯源验证和AI检测。我们的系统集成了多种信号——包括加密溯源、生成模型指纹和可选的检索增强验证——以便在消费点为用户提供分级的信任指标。我们讨论了该框架与监管要求（欧盟AI法案、DSA）的契合度，及其在补充平台级机制的验证基础设施中的作用。
tldr: Origin Lens是一个隐私优先的移动框架，它使用Rust/Flutter混合架构在用户设备上本地执行加密图像溯源和AI检测，以应对生成式AI带来的虚假信息挑战，并提供分级的信任指标。
ai_comments: 该框架的创新点在于其“隐私优先”的设计理念，将复杂的加密图像溯源和AI检测功能转移到移动设备本地执行，而非依赖服务器端。这种方法不仅加快了验证速度，使信息在消费点即可得到即时反馈，而且通过利用Rust/Flutter混合架构，确保了高性能和跨平台兼容性。此外，它通过整合加密溯源和生成模型指纹等多种信号，提高了对抗深度伪造和AI生成内容时的验证鲁棒性和用户信任度，同时积极响应了如欧盟AI法案等新兴的监管要求。
motivation: 生成式AI的激增对信息完整性保证提出了挑战，需要能够将模型治理与终端用户验证联系起来的系统，以对抗视觉虚假信息。
method: 提出了Origin Lens，一个隐私优先的移动框架，采用分层验证架构。它通过Rust/Flutter混合架构在设备本地执行加密图像溯源验证和AI检测。系统集成了多重信号，包括加密溯源、生成模型指纹和可选的检索增强验证。
results: 为用户在消费点提供分级的信任指标（graded confidence indicators）。
conclusion: 该框架与监管要求（欧盟AI法案、DSA）保持一致，并在验证基础设施中发挥作用，补充了平台级别的机制。

title: SWE-World: Building Software Engineering Agents in Docker-Free Environments
authors: Shuang Sun, Huatong Song, Lisheng Huang, Jinhao Jiang, Ran Le, Zhihao Lv, Zongchao Chen, Yiwen Hu, Wenyang Luo, Wayne Xin Zhao, Yang Song, Hongteng Xu, Tao Zhang, Ji-Rong Wen
abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled software engineering agents to tackle complex code modification tasks. Most existing approaches rely on execution feedback from containerized environments, which require dependency-complete setup and physical execution of programs and tests. While effective, this paradigm is resource-intensive and difficult to maintain, substantially complicating agent training and limiting scalability. We propose SWE-World, a Docker-free framework that replaces physical execution environments with a learned surrogate for training and evaluating software engineering agents. SWE-World leverages LLM-based models trained on real agent-environment interaction data to predict intermediate execution outcomes and final test feedback, enabling agents to learn without interacting with physical containerized environments. This design preserves the standard agent-environment interaction loop while eliminating the need for costly environment construction and maintenance during agent optimization and evaluation. Furthermore, because SWE-World can simulate the final evaluation outcomes of candidate trajectories without real submission, it enables selecting the best solution among multiple test-time attempts, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling (TTS) in software engineering tasks. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified demonstrate that SWE-World raises Qwen2.5-Coder-32B from 6.2\% to 52.0\% via Docker-free SFT, 55.0\% with Docker-free RL, and 68.2\% with further TTS. The code is available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/SWE-World
zh_title: SWE-World：在无 Docker 环境中构建软件工程智能体
translation: 近期大型语言模型（LLMs）的进展使得软件工程智能体能够处理复杂的代码修改任务。现有的大多数方法依赖于容器化环境的执行反馈，这需要完整的依赖设置以及程序和测试的物理执行。尽管有效，但这种范式是资源密集型且难以维护的，极大地复杂了智能体的训练并限制了可扩展性。我们提出了 SWE-World，一个无 Docker 框架，它用一个学习到的替代模型取代了物理执行环境，用于训练和评估软件工程智能体。SWE-World 利用基于 LLM 的模型，这些模型通过真实的智能体-环境交互数据训练，以预测中间执行结果和最终测试反馈，使得智能体无需与物理容器化环境交互即可学习。这种设计保留了标准的智能体-环境交互循环，同时消除了智能体优化和评估过程中对昂贵环境构建和维护的需求。此外，由于 SWE-World 可以在不进行真实提交的情况下模拟候选轨迹的最终评估结果，它能够在多次测试时尝试中选择最佳解决方案，从而促进软件工程任务中有效的测试时扩展（TTS）。在 SWE-bench Verified 上的实验表明，SWE-World 通过无 Docker SFT 将 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 的性能从 6.2\% 提升到 52.0\%，通过无 Docker RL 提升到 55.0\%，并结合进一步的 TTS 达到 68.2\%。代码可在 https://github.com/RUCAIBox/SWE-World 获取。
tldr: 提出SWE-World，一个无Docker的框架，用LLM学习到的替代模型模拟代码执行反馈，大幅降低训练成本并提高可扩展性。在SWE-bench上的性能从6.2%提升到68.2%。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将智能体训练和评估与昂贵且资源密集型的物理执行环境（Docker容器）解耦。通过引入基于LLM的学习到的替代模型，该框架极大地提高了软件工程智能体训练的可扩展性和效率，解决了该领域的一个关键瓶颈。性能的巨大提升（6.2%到68.2%）有力证明了模拟环境方法的有效性。
motivation: 现有的软件工程智能体依赖于容器化环境（如Docker）的执行反馈，但这资源密集、难以维护，需要完整的依赖设置和物理执行，从而严重限制了智能体训练的可扩展性和效率。
method: 提出 SWE-World，一个无 Docker 框架。它用一个基于 LLM 的“学习到的替代模型”取代物理执行环境，该模型通过真实智能体-环境交互数据训练，用于预测中间执行结果和最终测试反馈。该框架保持了标准智能体-环境交互循环，并通过模拟最终评估结果实现了有效的测试时扩展（TTS）。
results: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的实验表明，SWE-World 将 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 的性能从 6.2% 提升到：通过无 Docker SFT 达到 52.0%，通过无 Docker RL 达到 55.0%，以及进一步结合 TTS 达到 68.2%。
conclusion: SWE-World通过用学习到的替代模型取代物理容器化环境，提供了一种可扩展且资源高效的软件工程智能体训练和评估框架，并在标准基准测试上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: RankSteer: Activation Steering for Pointwise LLM Ranking
authors: Yumeng Wang, Catherine Chen, Suzan Verberne
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong performance as zero-shot rankers, yet their effectiveness is highly sensitive to prompt formulation, particularly role-play instructions. Prior analyses suggest that role-related signals are encoded along activation channels that are largely separate from query-document representations, raising the possibility of steering ranking behavior directly at the activation level rather than through brittle prompt engineering. In this work, we propose RankSteer, a post-hoc activation steering framework for zero-shot pointwise LLM ranking. We characterize ranking behavior through three disentangled and steerable directions in representation space: a \textbf{decision direction} that maps hidden states to relevance scores, an \textbf{evidence direction} that captures relevance signals not directly exploited by the decision head, and a \textbf{role direction} that modulates model behavior without injecting relevance information. Using projection-based interventions at inference time, RankSteer jointly controls these directions to calibrate ranking behavior without modifying model weights or introducing explicit cross-document comparisons. Experiments on TREC DL 20 and multiple BEIR benchmarks show that RankSteer consistently improves ranking quality using only a small number of anchor queries, demonstrating that substantial ranking capacity remains under-utilized in pointwise LLM rankers. We further provide a geometric analysis revealing that steering improves ranking by stabilizing ranking geometry and reducing dispersion, offering new insight into how LLMs internally represent and calibrate relevance judgments.
zh_title: RankSteer：用于点对点LLM排序的激活引导
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）最近在零样本排序器方面表现出强大的性能，但它们的有效性对提示措辞高度敏感，尤其是对角色扮演指令。先前的分析表明，角色相关的信号是沿着与查询-文档表示基本分离的激活通道编码的，这提出了在激活层面而非通过脆弱的提示工程直接引导排序行为的可能性。在这项工作中，我们提出了RankSteer，一个用于零样本点对点LLM排序的后验激活引导框架。我们通过表示空间中三个可解耦且可引导的方向来表征排序行为：一个将隐藏状态映射到相关性分数的**决策方向**；一个捕获未被决策头直接利用的相关性信号的**证据方向**；以及一个在不注入相关性信息的情况下调节模型行为的**角色方向**。RankSteer在推理时使用基于投影的干预措施，联合控制这些方向来校准排序行为，而无需修改模型权重或引入明确的跨文档比较。在TREC DL 20和多个BEIR基准测试上的实验表明，RankSteer仅使用少量锚点查询就持续提高了排序质量，这表明点对点LLM排序器中仍有大量排序能力未被充分利用。我们进一步提供了一个几何分析，揭示引导通过稳定排序几何结构和减少分散性来改善排序，为LLM如何在内部表示和校准相关性判断提供了新的见解。
tldr: RankSteer通过直接引导LLM的内部激活（决策、证据、角色方向），解决了点对点LLM排序中对提示的敏感性问题，从而在不修改模型权重的情况下显著提高了零样本排序性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将LLM排序校准从脆弱的提示工程转移到直接的激活引导，提供了一种对模型行为更精细、更鲁棒的控制方法。通过将排序行为解耦为决策、证据和角色三个可控方向，RankSteer提供了一个新颖的框架来理解和调整LLM的内部相关性判断机制。该方法在不修改模型权重的情况下，仅利用少量锚点查询就实现了显著的性能提升，这强调了激活引导在释放点对点LLM排序器未充分利用的潜力方面的巨大价值和重要性。
motivation: 解决零样本LLM排序器对提示（尤其是角色扮演指令）敏感的问题，并利用激活通道中编码的角色相关信号来实现排序行为的直接引导。
method: 提出RankSteer框架，这是一种用于零样本点对点LLM排序的后验激活引导方法。它在表示空间中定义了决策、证据和角色三个可解耦且可引导的方向，并在推理时使用基于投影的干预措施来联合控制这些方向，以校准排序行为，且不修改模型权重。
results: 在TREC DL 20和多个BEIR基准测试上，RankSteer仅使用少量锚点查询就持续提高了排序质量。几何分析显示，引导通过稳定排序几何结构和减少分散性来改善排序。
conclusion: 排名能力在点对点LLM排序器中仍未得到充分利用。该方法提供了一种新的见解，即LLM如何在内部表示和校准相关性判断。

title: ConsistentRFT: Reducing Visual Hallucinations in Flow-based Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
authors: Xiaofeng Tan, Jun Liu, Yuanting Fan, Bin-Bin Gao, Xi Jiang, Xiaochen Chen, Jinlong Peng, Chengjie Wang, Hongsong Wang, Feng Zheng
abstract: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) on flow-based models is crucial for preference alignment. However, they often introduce visual hallucinations like over-optimized details and semantic misalignment. This work preliminarily explores why visual hallucinations arise and how to reduce them. We first investigate RFT methods from a unified perspective, and reveal the core problems stemming from two aspects, exploration and exploitation: (1) limited exploration during stochastic differential equation (SDE) rollouts, leading to an over-emphasis on local details at the expense of global semantics, and (2) trajectory imitation process inherent in policy gradient methods, distorting the model's foundational vector field and its cross-step consistency. Building on this, we propose ConsistentRFT, a general framework to mitigate these hallucinations. Specifically, we design a Dynamic Granularity Rollout (DGR) mechanism to balance exploration between global semantics and local details by dynamically scheduling different noise sources. We then introduce a Consistent Policy Gradient Optimization (CPGO) that preserves the model's consistency by aligning the current policy with a more stable prior. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ConsistentRFT significantly mitigates visual hallucinations, achieving average reductions of 49\% for low-level and 38\% for high-level perceptual hallucinations. Furthermore, ConsistentRFT outperforms other RFT methods on out-of-domain metrics, showing an improvement of 5.1\% (v.s. the baseline's decrease of -0.4\%) over FLUX1.dev. This is \href{https://xiaofeng-tan.github.io/projects/ConsistentRFT}{Project Page}.

title: On singular Galerkin discretizations for three models in high-frequency scattering
authors: T. Chaumont-Frelet, S. Sauter
abstract: We consider three common mathematical models for time-harmonic high frequency scattering: the Helmholtz equation in two and three spatial dimensions, a transverse magnetic problem in two dimensions, and Maxwell's equation in three dimensions with dissipative boundary conditions such that the continuous problem is well posed. In this paper, we construct meshes for popular (low order) Galerkin finite element discretizations such that the discrete system matrix becomes singular and the discrete problem is not well posed. This implies that a condition "the finite element space has to be sufficiently rich" in the form of a resolution condition - typically imposed for discrete well-posedness - is not an artifact from the proof by a compact perturbation argument but necessary for discrete stability of the Galerkin discretization.

title: ProAct: A Benchmark and Multimodal Framework for Structure-Aware Proactive Response
authors: Xiaomeng Zhu, Fengming Zhu, Weijie Zhou, Ye Tian, Zhenlin Hu, Yufei Huang, Yuchun Guo, Xinyu Wu, Zhengyou Zhang, Fangzhen Lin, Xuantang Xiong
abstract: While passive agents merely follow instructions, proactive agents align with higher-level objectives, such as assistance and safety by continuously monitoring the environment to determine when and how to act. However, developing proactive agents is hindered by the lack of specialized resources. To address this, we introduce ProAct-75, a benchmark designed to train and evaluate proactive agents across diverse domains, including assistance, maintenance, and safety monitoring. Spanning 75 tasks, our dataset features 91,581 step-level annotations enriched with explicit task graphs. These graphs encode step dependencies and parallel execution possibilities, providing the structural grounding necessary for complex decision-making. Building on this benchmark, we propose ProAct-Helper, a reference baseline powered by a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) that grounds decision-making in state detection, and leveraging task graphs to enable entropy-driven heuristic search for action selection, allowing agents to execute parallel threads independently rather than mirroring the human's next step. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProAct-Helper outperforms strong closed-source models, improving trigger detection mF1 by 6.21%, saving 0.25 more steps in online one-step decision, and increasing the rate of parallel actions by 15.58%.

title: DiscoverLLM: From Executing Intents to Discovering Them
authors: Tae Soo Kim, Yoonjoo Lee, Jaesang Yu, John Joon Young Chung, Juho Kim
abstract: To handle ambiguous and open-ended requests, Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to interact with users to surface intents they have not yet expressed (e.g., ask clarification questions). However, users are often ambiguous because they have not yet formed their intents: they must observe and explore outcomes to discover what they want. Simply asking "what kind of tone do you want?" fails when users themselves do not know. We introduce DiscoverLLM, a novel and generalizable framework that trains LLMs to help users form and discover their intents. Central to our approach is a novel user simulator that models cognitive state with a hierarchy of intents that progressively concretize as the model surfaces relevant options -- where the degree of concretization serves as a reward signal that models can be trained to optimize. Resulting models learn to collaborate with users by adaptively diverging (i.e., explore options) when intents are unclear, and converging (i.e., refine and implement) when intents concretize. Across proposed interactive benchmarks in creative writing, technical writing, and SVG drawing, DiscoverLLM achieves over 10% higher task performance while reducing conversation length by up to 40%. In a user study with 75 human participants, DiscoverLLM improved conversation satisfaction and efficiency compared to baselines.

title: Failure is Feedback: History-Aware Backtracking for Agentic Traversal in Multimodal Graphs
authors: Joohyung Yun, Doyup Lee, Wook-Shin Han
abstract: Open-domain multimodal document retrieval aims to retrieve specific components (paragraphs, tables, or images) from large and interconnected document corpora. Existing graph-based retrieval approaches typically rely on a uniform similarity metric that overlooks hop-specific semantics, and their rigid pre-defined plans hinder dynamic error correction. These limitations suggest that a retriever should adapt its reasoning to the evolving context and recover intelligently from dead ends. To address these needs, we propose Failure is Feedback (FiF), which casts subgraph retrieval as a sequential decision process and introduces two key innovations. (i) We introduce a history-aware backtracking mechanism; unlike standard backtracking that simply reverts the state, our approach piggybacks on the context of failed traversals, leveraging insights from previous failures. (ii) We implement an economically-rational agentic workflow. Unlike conventional agents with static strategies, our orchestrator employs a cost-aware traversal method to dynamically manage the trade-off between retrieval accuracy and inference costs, escalating to intensive LLM-based reasoning only when the prior failure justifies the additional computational investment. Extensive experiments show that FiF achieves state-of-the-art retrieval on the benchmarks of MultimodalQA, MMCoQA and WebQA.

title: When control meets large language models: From words to dynamics
authors: Komeil Nosrati, Aleksei Tepljakov, Juri Belikov, Eduard Petlenkov
abstract: While large language models (LLMs) are transforming engineering and technology through enhanced control capabilities and decision support, they are simultaneously evolving into complex dynamical systems whose behavior must be regulated. This duality highlights a reciprocal connection in which prompts support control system design while control theory helps shape prompts to achieve specific goals efficiently. In this study, we frame this emerging interconnection of LLM and control as a bidirectional continuum, from prompt design to system dynamics. First, we investigate how LLMs can advance the field of control in two distinct capacities: directly, by assisting in the design and synthesis of controllers, and indirectly, by augmenting research workflows. Second, we examine how control concepts help LLMs steer their trajectories away from undesired meanings, improving reachability and alignment via input optimization, parameter editing, and activation-level interventions. Third, we look into deeper integrations by treating LLMs as dynamic systems within a state-space framework, where their internal representations are closely linked to external control loops. Finally, we identify key challenges and outline future research directions to understand LLM behavior and develop interpretable and controllable LLMs that are as trustworthy and robust as their electromechanical counterparts, thereby ensuring they continue to support and safeguard society.

title: On the Complexity of Maximal/Closed Frequent Tree Mining for Bounded Height Trees
authors: Kenta Komoto, Kazuhiro Kurita, Hirotaka Ono
abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of enumerating all frequent maximal/closed trees. This is a classical and central problem in data mining. Although many practical algorithms have been developed for this problem, its complexity under ``realistic assumptions'' on tree height has not been clarified. More specifically, while it was known that the mining problem becomes hard when the tree height is at least 60, the complexity for cases where the tree height is smaller has not yet been clarified. We resolve this gap by establishing results for these tree mining problems under several settings, including ordered and unordered trees, as well as maximal and closed variants.

title: Model-based Optimal Control for Rigid-Soft Underactuated Systems
authors: Daniele Caradonna, Nikhil Nair, Anup Teejo Mathew, Daniel Feliu Talegón, Imran Afgan, Egidio Falotico, Cosimo Della Santina, Federico Renda
abstract: Continuum soft robots are inherently underactuated and subject to intrinsic input constraints, making dynamic control particularly challenging, especially in hybrid rigid-soft robots. While most existing methods focus on quasi-static behaviors, dynamic tasks such as swing-up require accurate exploitation of continuum dynamics. This has led to studies on simple low-order template systems that often fail to capture the complexity of real continuum deformations. Model-based optimal control offers a systematic solution; however, its application to rigid-soft robots is often limited by the computational cost and inaccuracy of numerical differentiation for high-dimensional models. Building on recent advances in the Geometric Variable Strain model that enable analytical derivatives, this work investigates three optimal control strategies for underactuated soft systems-Direct Collocation, Differential Dynamic Programming, and Nonlinear Model Predictive Control-to perform dynamic swing-up tasks. To address stiff continuum dynamics and constrained actuation, implicit integration schemes and warm-start strategies are employed to improve numerical robustness and computational efficiency. The methods are evaluated in simulation on three Rigid-Soft and high-order soft benchmark systems-the Soft Cart-Pole, the Soft Pendubot, and the Soft Furuta Pendulum- highlighting their performance and computational trade-offs.

title: A-RAG: Scaling Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Hierarchical Retrieval Interfaces
authors: Mingxuan Du, Benfeng Xu, Chiwei Zhu, Shaohan Wang, Pengyu Wang, Xiaorui Wang, Zhendong Mao
abstract: Frontier language models have demonstrated strong reasoning and long-horizon tool-use capabilities. However, existing RAG systems fail to leverage these capabilities. They still rely on two paradigms: (1) designing an algorithm that retrieves passages in a single shot and concatenates them into the model's input, or (2) predefining a workflow and prompting the model to execute it step-by-step. Neither paradigm allows the model to participate in retrieval decisions, preventing efficient scaling with model improvements. In this paper, we introduce A-RAG, an Agentic RAG framework that exposes hierarchical retrieval interfaces directly to the model. A-RAG provides three retrieval tools: keyword search, semantic search, and chunk read, enabling the agent to adaptively search and retrieve information across multiple granularities. Experiments on multiple open-domain QA benchmarks show that A-RAG consistently outperforms existing approaches with comparable or lower retrieved tokens, demonstrating that A-RAG effectively leverages model capabilities and dynamically adapts to different RAG tasks. We further systematically study how A-RAG scales with model size and test-time compute. We will release our code and evaluation suite to facilitate future research. Code and evaluation suite are available at https://github.com/Ayanami0730/arag.

title: Ontology-to-tools compilation for executable semantic constraint enforcement in LLM agents
authors: Xiaochi Zhou, Patrick Bulter, Changxuan Yang, Simon D. Rihm, Thitikarn Angkanaporn, Jethro Akroyd, Sebastian Mosbach, Markus Kraft
abstract: We introduce ontology-to-tools compilation as a proof-of-principle mechanism for coupling large language models (LLMs) with formal domain knowledge. Within The World Avatar (TWA), ontological specifications are compiled into executable tool interfaces that LLM-based agents must use to create and modify knowledge graph instances, enforcing semantic constraints during generation rather than through post-hoc validation. Extending TWA's semantic agent composition framework, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and associated agents are integral components of the knowledge graph ecosystem, enabling structured interaction between generative models, symbolic constraints, and external resources. An agent-based workflow translates ontologies into ontology-aware tools and iteratively applies them to extract, validate, and repair structured knowledge from unstructured scientific text. Using metal-organic polyhedra synthesis literature as an illustrative case, we show how executable ontological semantics can guide LLM behaviour and reduce manual schema and prompt engineering, establishing a general paradigm for embedding formal knowledge into generative systems.

title: Exploiting Multi-Core Parallelism in Blockchain Validation and Construction
authors: Arivarasan Karmegam, Lucianna Kiffer, Antonio Fernández Anta
abstract: Blockchain validators can reduce block processing time by exploiting multi-core CPUs, but deterministic execution must preserve a given total order while respecting transaction conflicts and per-block runtime limits. This paper systematically examines how validators can exploit multi-core parallelism during both block construction and execution without violating blockchain semantics. We formalize two validator-side optimization problems: (i) executing an already ordered block on \(p\) cores to minimize makespan while ensuring equivalence to sequential execution; and (ii) selecting and scheduling a subset of mempool transactions under a runtime limit \(B\) to maximize validator reward. For both, we develop exact Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulations that capture conflict, order, and capacity constraints, and propose fast deterministic heuristics that scale to realistic workloads. Using Ethereum mainnet traces and including a Solana-inspired declared-access baseline (Sol) for ordered-block scheduling and a simple reward-greedy baseline (RG) for block construction, we empirically quantify the trade-offs between optimality and runtime.

title: Hierarchical Concept-to-Appearance Guidance for Multi-Subject Image Generation
authors: Yijia Xu, Zihao Wang, Jinshi Cui
abstract: Multi-subject image generation aims to synthesize images that faithfully preserve the identities of multiple reference subjects while following textual instructions. However, existing methods often suffer from identity inconsistency and limited compositional control, as they rely on diffusion models to implicitly associate text prompts with reference images. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Concept-to-Appearance Guidance (CAG), a framework that provides explicit, structured supervision from high-level concepts to fine-grained appearances. At the conceptual level, we introduce a VAE dropout training strategy that randomly omits reference VAE features, encouraging the model to rely more on robust semantic signals from a Visual Language Model (VLM) and thereby promoting consistent concept-level generation in the absence of complete appearance cues. At the appearance level, we integrate the VLM-derived correspondences into a correspondence-aware masked attention module within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This module restricts each text token to attend only to its matched reference regions, ensuring precise attribute binding and reliable multi-subject composition. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the multi-subject image generation, substantially improving prompt following and subject consistency.

title: CRL-VLA: Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning
authors: Qixin Zeng, Shuo Zhang, Hongyin Zhang, Renjie Wang, Han Zhao, Libang Zhao, Runze Li, Donglin Wang, Chao Huang
abstract: Lifelong learning is critical for embodied agents in open-world environments, where reinforcement learning fine-tuning has emerged as an important paradigm to enable Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to master dexterous manipulation through environmental interaction. Thus, Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) is a promising pathway for deploying VLA models in lifelong robotic scenarios, yet balancing stability (retaining old skills) and plasticity (learning new ones) remains a formidable challenge for existing methods. We introduce CRL-VLA, a framework for continual post-training of VLA models with rigorous theoretical bounds. We derive a unified performance bound linking the stability-plasticity trade-off to goal-conditioned advantage magnitude, scaled by policy divergence. CRL-VLA resolves this dilemma via asymmetric regulation: constraining advantage magnitudes on prior tasks while enabling controlled growth on new tasks. This is realized through a simple but effective dual-critic architecture with novel Goal-Conditioned Value Formulation (GCVF), where a frozen critic anchors semantic consistency and a trainable estimator drives adaptation. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that CRL-VLA effectively harmonizes these conflicting objectives, outperforming baselines in both anti-forgetting and forward adaptation.

title: HetroD: A High-Fidelity Drone Dataset and Benchmark for Autonomous Driving in Heterogeneous Traffic
authors: Yu-Hsiang Chen, Wei-Jer Chang, Christian Kotulla, Thomas Keutgens, Steffen Runde, Tobias Moers, Christoph Klas, Wei Zhan, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Yi-Ting Chen
abstract: We present HetroD, a dataset and benchmark for developing autonomous driving systems in heterogeneous environments. HetroD targets the critical challenge of navi- gating real-world heterogeneous traffic dominated by vulner- able road users (VRUs), including pedestrians, cyclists, and motorcyclists that interact with vehicles. These mixed agent types exhibit complex behaviors such as hook turns, lane splitting, and informal right-of-way negotiation. Such behaviors pose significant challenges for autonomous vehicles but remain underrepresented in existing datasets focused on structured, lane-disciplined traffic. To bridge the gap, we collect a large- scale drone-based dataset to provide a holistic observation of traffic scenes with centimeter-accurate annotations, HD maps, and traffic signal states. We further develop a modular toolkit for extracting per-agent scenarios to support downstream task development. In total, the dataset comprises over 65.4k high- fidelity agent trajectories, 70% of which are from VRUs. HetroD supports modeling of VRU behaviors in dense, het- erogeneous traffic and provides standardized benchmarks for forecasting, planning, and simulation tasks. Evaluation results reveal that state-of-the-art prediction and planning models struggle with the challenges presented by our dataset: they fail to predict lateral VRU movements, cannot handle unstructured maneuvers, and exhibit limited performance in dense and multi-agent scenarios, highlighting the need for more robust approaches to heterogeneous traffic. See our project page for more examples: https://hetroddata.github.io/HetroD/
