We introduce SimGym, a scalable system for rapid offline A/B testing using traffic-grounded synthetic buyers powered by Large Language Model agents operating in a live browser. SimGym extracts per-shop buyer profiles and intents from production interaction data, identifies distinct behavioral archetypes, and simulates cohort-weighted sessions across control and treatment storefronts. We validate SimGym against real human outcomes from real UI changes on a major e-commerce platform under confounder control. Even without alignment post training, SimGym agents achieve state of the art alignment with observed outcome shifts and reduces experiment cycles from weeks to under an hour , enabling rapid experimentation without exposure to real buyers.
zh_title: SimGym：用于电子商务离线A/B测试的流量驱动的浏览器代理
translation: A/B测试仍然是评估电子商务UI更改的黄金标准，但它会分散流量，需要数周时间才能达到显著性，并有损害用户体验的风险。我们介绍了SimGym，一个利用在实时浏览器中运行的大型语言模型代理驱动的流量驱动的合成买家，进行快速离线A/B测试的可扩展系统。SimGym从生产交互数据中提取每个店铺的买家画像和意图，识别出不同的行为原型，并在对照和处理后的店面跨度中模拟经过群体加权的会话。我们在一个主要电子商务平台上的真实UI更改的真实人类结果下，在混杂因素控制下验证了SimGym。即使在没有事后对齐的情况下，SimGym代理也能实现与观察到的结果变化的先进对齐，并将实验周期从数周缩短到不到一小时，从而能够在不暴露真实买家的情况下实现快速实验。
tldr: SimGym使用LLM驱动的浏览器代理进行离线A/B测试，能从真实流量中学习买家行为，并将测试时间从数周缩短到一小时内，效果与真实测试相当，解决了传统A/B测试耗时长和有风险的问题。
ai_comments: SimGym的创新之处在于使用基于LLM的代理在真实浏览器环境中进行流量驱动的模拟，实现了快速的离线A/B测试。其重要性在于极大地缩短了实验周期，并将风险从真实用户转移到模拟环境中。局限性在于摘要中未明确提及模型对复杂、罕见用户行为的覆盖能力。
motivation: A/B测试是评估电子商务UI更改的黄金标准，但它会分散流量，需要数周时间才能达到显著性，并有损害用户体验的风险。
method: SimGym提取生产交互数据中的每个店铺买家画像和意图，识别出不同的行为原型，并在对照和处理后的店面跨度中模拟经过群体加权的会话。它使用由在实时浏览器中运行的大型语言模型代理驱动的流量驱动的合成买家。
results: 即使在没有事后对齐的情况下，SimGym代理也能实现与观察到的结果变化的先进对齐，并将实验周期从数周缩短到不到一小时。
conclusion: SimGym代理实现了与观察到的结果变化的先进对齐，并将实验周期从数周缩短到不到一小时，从而能够在不暴露真实买家的情况下实现快速实验。

title: A Meta-Knowledge-Augmented LLM Framework for Hyperparameter Optimization in Time-Series Forecasting
authors: Ons Saadallah, Mátyás andó, Tamás Gábor Orosz
abstract: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) plays a central role in the performance of deep learning models, yet remains computationally expensive and difficult to interpret, particularly for time-series forecasting. While Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a standard approach, it typically treats tuning tasks independently and provides limited insight into its decisions. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to incorporate structured prior knowledge and reasoning into optimization pipelines. We introduce LLM-AutoOpt, a hybrid HPO framework that combines BO with LLM-based contextual reasoning. The framework encodes dataset meta-features, model descriptions, historical optimization outcomes, and target objectives as structured meta-knowledge within LLM prompts, using BO to initialize the search and mitigate cold-start effects. This design enables context-aware and stable hyperparameter refinement while exposing the reasoning behind optimization decisions. Experiments on a multivariate time series forecasting benchmark demonstrate that LLM-AutoOpt achieves improved predictive performance and more interpretable optimization behavior compared to BO and LLM baselines without meta-knowledge.
zh_title: 一种用于时间序列预测中超参数优化的元知识增强型LLM框架
translation: 超参数优化（HPO）在深度学习模型的性能中起着核心作用，但尤其是在时间序列预测中，它仍然计算成本高昂且难以解释。虽然贝叶斯优化（BO）是一种标准方法，但它通常将调优任务独立对待，并为其决策提供有限的洞察力。大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为将结构化先验知识和推理纳入优化流程提供了新的机会。我们引入LLM-AutoOpt，一个结合了BO和基于LLM的上下文推理的混合HPO框架。该框架将数据集元特征、模型描述、历史优化结果和目标等结构化元知识编码到LLM提示中，并使用BO来初始化搜索并减轻冷启动效应。这种设计使得上下文感知和稳定的超参数细化成为可能，同时揭示了优化决策背后的推理过程。在多元时间序列预测基准测试上的实验表明，与没有元知识的BO和LLM基线相比，LLM-AutoOpt 实现了改进的预测性能和更具可解释性的优化行为。
tldr: 研究人员提出了一种名为LLM-AutoOpt的混合框架，它使用大型语言模型（LLM）来增强贝叶斯优化（BO）进行时间序列预测的超参数优化。通过将数据特征和历史结果作为“元知识”输入给LLM，该方法不仅提高了优化性能，还让优化过程更具可解释性，解决了传统HPO计算昂贵且不透明的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM）的上下文推理能力与贝叶斯优化（BO）相结合，形成一个混合框架LLM-AutoOpt，用于时间序列预测中的超参数优化。这不仅提高了性能，还增强了优化决策的可解释性。其主要局限性可能在于LLM的推理成本和集成复杂性。
motivation: 超参数优化（HPO）在深度学习模型性能中至关重要，但计算成本高昂且难以解释，尤其是在时间序列预测中。标准的贝叶斯优化（BO）独立处理调优任务，缺乏决策洞察力。大型语言模型（LLM）的进步为将结构化先验知识和推理纳入优化流程提供了新机会。
method: LLM-AutoOpt 是一个混合超参数优化框架，结合了贝叶斯优化（BO）和基于LLM的上下文推理。它将数据集元特征、模型描述、历史优化结果和目标等结构化元知识编码到LLM提示中，并使用BO来初始化搜索以减轻冷启动效应。
results: LLM-AutoOpt 实现了上下文感知的稳定超参数细化，并揭示了优化决策背后的推理过程，在多元时间序列预测基准测试中，性能优于BO和无元知识的LLM基线。
conclusion: LLM-AutoOpt 框架在多元时间序列预测基准测试中，实现了比纯BO和无元知识LLM基线更好的预测性能和更具可解释性的优化行为。

title: SentiFuse: Deep Multi-model Fusion Framework for Robust Sentiment Extraction
authors: Hieu Minh Duong, Rupa Ghosh, Cong Hoan Nguyen, Eugene Levin, Todd Gary, Long Nguyen
abstract: Sentiment analysis models exhibit complementary strengths, yet existing approaches lack a unified framework for effective integration. We present SentiFuse, a flexible and model-agnostic framework that integrates heterogeneous sentiment models through a standardization layer and multiple fusion strategies. Our approach supports decision-level fusion, feature-level fusion, and adaptive fusion, enabling systematic combination of diverse models. We conduct experiments on three large-scale social-media datasets: Crowdflower, GoEmotions, and Sentiment140. These experiments show that SentiFuse consistently outperforms individual models and naive ensembles. Feature-level fusion achieves the strongest overall effectiveness, yielding up to 4\% absolute improvement in F1 score over the best individual model and simple averaging, while adaptive fusion enhances robustness on challenging cases such as negation, mixed emotions, and complex sentiment expressions. These results demonstrate that systematically leveraging model complementarity yields more accurate and reliable sentiment analysis across diverse datasets and text types.
zh_title: SentiFuse：用于鲁棒情感提取的深度多模型融合框架
translation: 情感分析模型表现出互补的优势，但现有方法缺乏一个有效的整合的统一框架。我们提出了SentiFuse，一个灵活且模型无关的框架，通过标准化层和多种融合策略来整合异构情感模型。我们的方法支持决策级融合、特征级融合和自适应融合，能够系统地组合不同的模型。我们在三个大规模社交媒体数据集上进行了实验：Crowdflower、GoEmotions和Sentiment140。这些实验表明，SentiFuse持续优于单独的模型和朴素的集成。特征级融合实现了最强的整体效果，与最佳的单独模型和简单的平均值相比，F1分数绝对提高了4%。自适应融合提高了在否定、混合情感和复杂情感表达等挑战性情况下的鲁棒性。这些结果表明，系统地利用模型互补性可以提高跨不同数据集和文本类型的准确性和可靠性的情感分析。
tldr: SentiFuse是一个新框架，通过融合多种情感分析模型来提高准确性和鲁棒性，实验证明其优于单一模型和简单集成。
ai_comments: SentiFuse框架的创新之处在于其模型无关性和对多种融合策略的支持，解决了现有情感分析模型集成困难的问题。其在多个数据集上的优异表现证明了模型融合的有效性，尤其是在处理复杂情感场景时。未来的工作可以进一步探索更复杂的融合机制或将其应用于其他自然语言处理任务。
motivation: 现有方法缺乏整合不同情感分析模型的统一框架，尽管这些模型具有互补的优势。
method: SentiFuse框架通过标准化层和多种融合策略（决策级、特征级、自适应融合）整合异构情感模型。
results: SentiFuse在三个大型社交媒体数据集上持续优于单独模型和朴素集成。特征级融合效果最好，F1分数比最佳单一模型和简单平均值高出4%。自适应融合提高了对否定、混合情感和复杂情感表达等情况的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 系统地利用模型互补性可以提高跨不同数据集和文本类型的准确性和可靠性的情感分析。

title: Towards a Novel Wearable Robotic Vest for Hemorrhage Suppression
authors: Harshith Jella, Pejman Kheradmand, Joseph Klein, Behnam Moradkhani, Yash Chitalia
abstract: This paper introduces a novel robotic system designed to manage severe bleeding in emergency scenarios, including unique environments like space stations. The robot features a shape-adjustable "ring mechanism", transitioning from a circular to an elliptical configuration to adjust wound coverage across various anatomical regions. We developed various arms for this ring mechanism with varying flexibilities to improve adaptability when applied to non-extremities of the body (abdomen, back, neck, etc.). To apply equal and constant pressure across the wound, we developed an inflatable ring and airbag balloon that are compatible with this shape-changing ring mechanism. A series of experiments focused on evaluating various ring arm configurations to characterize their bending stiffness. Subsequent experiments measured the force exerted by the airbag balloon system using a digital scale. Despite its promising performance, certain limitations related to coverage area are identified. The shape-changing effect of the device is limited to scenarios involving partially inflated or deflated airbag balloons, and cannot fully conform to complex anatomical regions. Finally, the device was tested on casualty simulation kits, where it successfully demonstrated its ability to control simulated bleeding.
zh_title: 面向出血抑制的可穿戴机器人背带的新研究
translation: 本文介绍了一种旨在管理紧急情况下（包括太空站等独特环境）严重出血的新型机器人系统。该机器人具有形状可调的“环形机构”，可转变为椭圆形配置，以适应不同解剖区域的伤口覆盖。我们为该环形机构开发了具有不同柔韧性的各种机械臂，以提高其在应用于身体非四肢部位（腹部、背部、颈部等）时的适应性。为了在整个伤口上施加均匀且恒定的压力，我们开发了一种与这种形状变化的环形机构兼容的可充气环和气囊。一系列实验着重于评估各种环形臂配置以表征其弯曲刚度。后续实验使用数字秤测量了气囊系统施加的力。尽管其性能前景广阔，但识别出与覆盖范围相关的某些局限性。该装置的形状变化效应仅限于部分充气或放气气囊的情况，无法完全适应复杂的解剖区域。最后，该装置在伤亡模拟套件上进行了测试，成功证明了其控制模拟出血的能力。
tldr: 研究人员开发了一种可穿戴的、形状可变的机器人背心，利用可充气的环形装置对伤口施加均匀压力以控制严重出血，并在模拟测试中证明了其有效性，但其对复杂身体部位的适应性有限。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于设计了一个形状可调的“环形机构”和兼容的气囊系统，以期实现对不同解剖位置伤口的均匀压力控制。重要性在于其在紧急情况（包括太空站）下控制严重出血的潜力。局限性在于其形状变化能力依赖于气囊的充气/放气状态，且无法完全适应复杂的解剖区域。
motivation: 设计一个用于在紧急情况下（包括太空站等独特环境）管理严重出血的机器人系统。
method: 开发了具有不同柔韧性的机械臂并评估其弯曲刚度；使用数字秤测量了气囊系统的作用力；在伤亡模拟套件上测试了设备的止血能力。
results: 实验表征了不同环形臂配置的弯曲刚度；测量了气囊系统的作用力；在模拟测试中成功控制了模拟出血。
conclusion: 该设备成功地在伤亡模拟套件上演示了控制模拟出血的能力，尽管存在一些关于覆盖范围的局限性。

title: Dimension-Free Multimodal Sampling via Preconditioned Annealed Langevin Dynamics
authors: Lorenzo Baldassari, Josselin Garnier, Knut Solna, Maarten V. de Hoop
abstract: Designing algorithms that can explore multimodal target distributions accurately across successive refinements of an underlying high-dimensional problem is a central challenge in sampling. Annealed Langevin dynamics (ALD) is a widely used alternative to classical Langevin since it often yields much faster mixing on multimodal targets, but there is still a gap between this empirical success and existing theory: when, and under which design choices, can ALD be guaranteed to remain stable as dimension increases? In this paper, we help bridge this gap by providing a uniform-in-dimension analysis of continuous-time ALD for multimodal targets that can be well-approximated by Gaussian mixture models. Along an explicit annealing path obtained by progressively removing Gaussian smoothing of the target, we identify sufficient spectral conditions - linking smoothing covariance and the covariances of the Gaussian components of the mixture - under which ALD achieves a prescribed accuracy within a single, dimension-uniform time horizon. We then establish dimension-robustness to imperfect initialization and score approximation: under a misspecified-mixture score model, we derive explicit conditions showing that preconditioning the ALD algorithm with a sufficiently decaying spectrum is necessary to prevent error terms from accumulating across coordinates and destroying dimension-uniform control. Finally, numerical experiments illustrate and validate the theory.
zh_title: 通过预处理的退火朗之万动力学实现维度无关的多模态采样
translation: 设计能够跨越底层高维问题连续细化来准确探索多模态目标分布的算法是一个核心挑战。退火朗之万动力学（ALD）是经典朗之万动力学的一种被广泛采用的替代方案，因为它通常在多模态目标上具有快得多的混合速度，但这种经验上的成功与现有理论之间仍然存在差距：ALD何时以及在何种设计选择下可以保证随着维度的增加而保持稳定？在本文中，我们通过对可以被高斯混合模型很好近似的多模态目标的连续时间ALD进行统一的维度分析，帮助弥合这一差距。沿着通过逐步移除目标的高斯平滑获得的明确退火路径，我们确定了充分的谱条件——将平滑协方差与混合体高斯分量的协方差联系起来——在此条件下，ALD可以在单一的、与维度无关的时间范围内达到预定的精度。然后，我们建立了对不完美初始化和分数函数近似的维度鲁棒性：在混合模型分数函数模型出现偏差的情况下，我们推导出明确的条件，表明使用具有足够衰减谱的预处理ALD算法是必要的，以防止误差项在坐标间累积并破坏维度均匀控制。最后，数值实验说明并验证了该理论。
tldr: 我们分析了退火朗之万动力学（ALD）在高维多模态采样中的维度稳定性。我们找到了一个明确的退火路径和谱条件，保证ALD在固定时间内保持精度，并且证明了预处理对于在模型不完美时保持维度鲁棒性至关重要。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提供了连续时间预处理退火朗之万动力学（ALD）的统一维度分析，解决了ALD在高维多模态分布采样中稳定性随维度增加而下降的理论空白。重要性在于为高维采样算法的设计和稳定性分析提供了理论基础。其局限性可能在于理论分析是基于目标分布可以被高斯混合模型很好近似的假设。
motivation: 设计能够准确探索多模态目标分布的算法，尤其是在底层高维问题连续细化过程中，是采样中的一个核心挑战。ALD虽然在实践中表现良好，但在理论上缺乏关于其在高维情况下保持稳定性的保证。
method: 对连续时间退火朗之万动力学（ALD）进行统一的、与维度无关的分析，特别关注通过逐步移除高斯平滑来获得的显式退火路径。论文识别了将平滑协方差和高斯混合模型分量协方差联系起来的谱条件。此外，还分析了预处理如何确保在分数函数模型不正确时保持维度均匀控制。
results: 论文识别了充分的谱条件，保证ALD在特定退火路径上能在单一的、与维度无关的时间范围内达到预设精度。同时，论文推导了预处理（具有足够衰减谱）的必要性，以确保在分数函数模型有误时，误差项不会跨坐标累积，从而保持维度均匀控制。
conclusion: 论文通过识别充分的谱条件，证明了在特定退火路径下，ALD可以在一个统一的、与维度无关的时间范围内达到预设精度。此外，论文还确立了对不完美初始化和分数函数近似的鲁棒性，并表明预处理是防止误差在坐标间累积的关键。

title: The Algorithmic Self-Portrait: Deconstructing Memory in ChatGPT
authors: Abhisek Dash, Soumi Das, Elisabeth Kirsten, Qinyuan Wu, Sai Keerthana Karnam, Krishna P. Gummadi, Thorsten Holz, Muhammad Bilal Zafar, Savvas Zannettou
abstract:
To enable personalized and context-aware interactions, conversational AI systems have introduced a new mechanism: Memory. Memory creates what we refer to as the Algorithmic Self-portrait - a new form of personalization derived from users' self-disclosed information divulged within private conversations. While memory enables more coherent exchanges, the underlying processes of memory creation remain opaque, raising critical questions about data sensitivity, user agency, and the fidelity of the resulting portrait.
  To bridge this research gap, we analyze 2,050 memory entries from 80 real-world ChatGPT users. Our analyses reveal three key findings: (1) A striking 96% of memories in our dataset are created unilaterally by the conversational system, potentially shifting agency away from the user; (2) Memories, in our dataset, contain a rich mix of GDPR-defined personal data (in 28% memories) along with psychological insights about participants (in 52% memories); and (3)~A significant majority of the memories (84%) are directly grounded in user context, indicating faithful representation of the conversations. Finally, we introduce a framework-Attribution Shield-that anticipates these inferences, alerts about potentially sensitive memory inferences, and suggests query reformulations to protect personal information without sacrificing utility.
comment: This paper has been accepted at The ACM Web Conference 2026
zh_title: 算法自画像：解构ChatGPT中的记忆
translation: 为了实现个性化和上下文感知的交互，对话式人工智能系统引入了一种新机制：记忆。记忆创造了我们称之为算法自画像的东西——一种源于用户在私密对话中泄露的自我披露信息的新型个性化。虽然记忆使得交流更加连贯，但记忆创建的底层过程是不透明的，引发了关于数据敏感性、用户代理权和所得肖像保真度的关键问题。为了弥合这一研究空白，我们分析了来自80位真实世界ChatGPT用户的2,050个记忆条目。我们的分析揭示了三个关键发现：（1）我们数据集中惊人的96%的记忆是由对话系统单方面创建的，潜在地将代理权从用户手中转移；（2）在我们数据集中，记忆包含了丰富的GDPR定义下的个人数据（占28%的记忆）以及关于参与者的心理见解（占52%的记忆）；（3）绝大多数记忆（84%）直接以用户上下文为基础，表明了对话的忠实表征。最后，我们引入了一个框架——归因护盾（Attribution Shield）——可以预期这些推断，提醒用户注意可能敏感的记忆推断，并建议查询重构，以在不牺牲效用的情况下保护个人信息。
tldr: ChatGPT的“记忆”功能通过分析用户对话创建了一个“算法自画像”，但系统单方面创建了绝大多数记忆（96%），且这些记忆富含敏感的个人数据（28%）和心理洞察（52%）。为解决隐私和代理权问题，作者提出了“归因护盾”框架来预警和保护信息。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次系统地分析了ChatGPT的“记忆”机制及其产生的“算法自画像”，并提出了“归因护盾”（Attribution Shield）框架来应对数据敏感性问题。其重要性在于揭示了当前个性化AI系统中用户代理权力的转移和数据隐私的风险。局限性可能在于样本量（80位用户，2050条记忆）的代表性，以及对记忆内容分析的深度。
motivation: 对话式AI系统引入了“记忆”机制以实现个性化和上下文感知的交互，但记忆创建的底层过程不透明，引发了关于数据敏感性、用户代理权和生成肖像保真度的关键问题。
method: 分析了来自80位真实世界ChatGPT用户的2,050个记忆条目。
results: 研究发现：（1）96%的记忆是系统单方面创建的，可能将代理权从用户转移；（2）记忆中包含GDPR定义的个人数据（占28%）和关于参与者的心理见解（占52%）；（3）84%的记忆直接基于用户上下文，表明了对话的忠实表征。
conclusion: 研究人员提出了一个名为“归因护盾”（Attribution Shield）的框架，该框架可以预测这些推断，提醒用户注意可能敏感的记忆推断，并建议查询重构以在不牺牲效用的情况下保护个人信息。

title: Understanding QA generation: Extracting Parametric and Contextual Knowledge with CQA for Low Resource Bangla Language
authors: Umme Abira Azmary, MD Ikramul Kayes, Swakkhar Shatabda, Farig Yousuf Sadeque
abstract: Question-Answering (QA) models for low-resource languages like Bangla face challenges due to limited annotated data and linguistic complexity. A key issue is determining whether models rely more on pre-encoded (parametric) knowledge or contextual input during answer generation, as existing Bangla QA datasets lack the structure required for such analysis. We introduce BanglaCQA, the first Counterfactual QA dataset in Bangla, by extending a Bangla dataset while integrating counterfactual passages and answerability annotations. In addition, we propose fine-tuned pipelines for encoder-decoder language-specific and multilingual baseline models, and prompting-based pipelines for decoder-only LLMs to disentangle parametric and contextual knowledge in both factual and counterfactual scenarios. Furthermore, we apply LLM-based and human evaluation techniques that measure answer quality based on semantic similarity. We also present a detailed analysis of how models perform across different QA settings in low-resource languages, and show that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting reveals a uniquely effective mechanism for extracting parametric knowledge in counterfactual scenarios, particularly in decoder-only LLMs. Our work not only introduces a novel framework for analyzing knowledge sources in Bangla QA but also uncovers critical findings that open up broader directions for counterfactual reasoning in low-resource language settings.
zh_title: 理解QA生成：使用CQA提取孟加拉语低资源语言的参数化和上下文知识
translation: 问答（QA）模型对于像孟加拉语这样的低资源语言来说，面临着标注数据有限和语言复杂性带来的挑战。一个关键问题是确定模型在生成答案时更多地依赖预先编码（参数化）的知识还是上下文输入，因为现有的孟加拉语QA数据集缺乏进行此类分析所需的结构。我们通过扩展一个孟加拉语数据集并整合反事实段落和可回答性注释，推出了BanglaCQA，这是孟加拉语中首个反事实QA数据集。此外，我们提出了用于语言特定和多语言基线模型的微调流水线，以及用于仅解码器LLM的基于提示的流水线，以在事实和反事实场景中区分参数化和上下文知识。我们还应用了基于LLM和人类的评估技术，根据语义相似度来衡量答案质量。我们还对模型在低资源语言不同QA设置下的表现进行了详细分析，并表明链式思考（CoT）提示在反事实场景下揭示了一种独特的有效机制，用于提取参数化知识，尤其是在仅解码器LLM中。我们的工作不仅提出了一个分析孟加拉语QA知识来源的新框架，而且还揭示了关键发现，为反事实推理在低资源语言环境中的应用开辟了更广泛的方向。
tldr: 本研究提出了BanglaCQA数据集和新的分析方法，以解决孟加拉语等低资源语言的QA问题，并研究模型如何利用参数化知识和上下文知识来生成答案，特别是在反事实场景下。
ai_comments: 这项研究在解决低资源语言的QA问题方面具有重要意义，特别是通过引入反事实数据集和创新的分析方法来理解模型知识利用。然而，评估方法的局限性以及模型在实际应用中的泛化能力仍有待进一步研究。
motivation: 低资源语言（如孟加拉语）的QA模型在数据稀疏和语言复杂性方面面临挑战，并且现有数据集无法分析模型在生成答案时是依赖预编码知识还是上下文输入。
method: 创建了首个孟加拉语反事实QA数据集BanglaCQA，并提出了用于区分参数化知识和上下文知识的两种模型流水线：一种是针对语言特定和多语言基线模型的微调流水线，另一种是针对仅解码器LLM的提示工程流水线。此外，还采用了基于LLM和人类的评估方法来衡量语义相似度，并分析了模型在不同QA设置下的表现。
results: Chain-of-Thought（CoT）提示在反事实场景下，尤其是在仅解码器LLM中，揭示了一种提取参数化知识的独特有效机制。研究还展示了模型在低资源语言QA设置下的表现分析。
conclusion: 本研究提出了一个分析孟加拉语QA知识来源的新框架，并发现了关于反事实推理在低资源语言环境中更广泛应用的关键见解。

title: Provable Cooperative Multi-Agent Exploration for Reward-Free MDPs
authors: Idan Barnea, Orin Levy, Yishay Mansour
abstract:
We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning in the setting of reward-free exploration, where multiple agents jointly explore an unknown MDP in order to learn its dynamics (without observing rewards). We focus on a tabular finite-horizon MDP and adopt a phased learning framework. In each learning phase, multiple agents independently interact with the environment. More specifically, in each learning phase, each agent is assigned a policy, executes it, and observes the resulting trajectory. Our primary goal is to characterize the tradeoff between the number of learning phases and the number of agents, especially when the number of learning phases is small.
  Our results identify a sharp transition governed by the horizon $H$. When the number of learning phases equals $H$, we present a computationally efficient algorithm that uses only $\tilde{O}(S^6 H^6 A / ε^2)$ agents to obtain an $ε$ approximation of the dynamics (i.e., yields an $ε$-optimal policy for any reward function). We complement our algorithm with a lower bound showing that any algorithm restricted to $ρ< H$ phases requires at least $A^{H/ρ}$ agents to achieve constant accuracy. Thus, we show that it is essential to have an order of $H$ learning phases if we limit the number of agents to be polynomial.
zh_title: 可证明的合作多智能体无奖励MDP探索
translation: 我们研究在无奖励探索设置下的合作多智能体强化学习，其中多个智能体共同探索未知的MDP以学习其动力学（不观察奖励）。我们关注表格有限时间范围MDP并采用分阶段学习框架。在每个学习阶段，多个智能体独立地与环境进行交互。更具体地说，在每个学习阶段，每个智能体被分配一个策略，执行它，并观察由此产生的轨迹。我们的主要目标是表征学习阶段数和智能体数量之间的权衡，尤其是在学习阶段数很少的情况下。我们的结果确定了一个由时间范围$H$决定的急剧转变。当学习阶段数等于$H$时，我们提出了一个计算高效的算法，仅使用$	ilde{O}(S^6 H^6 A / ε^2)$个智能体即可获得动力学的$ε$近似（即，为任何奖励函数产生$ε$-最优策略）。我们用一个下界来补充我们的算法，该下界表明，任何限制在$ρ< H$个阶段的算法都需要至少$A^{H/ρ}$个智能体才能实现恒定精度。因此，我们表明，如果我们将智能体数量限制为多项式，那么拥有大约H个学习阶段是必不可少的。
keywords: 智能体数量-阶段数权衡
tldr: 多智能体在无奖励的MDP环境中进行探索，学习环境动力学。研究发现学习阶段数和智能体数量的权衡很重要，当学习阶段数等于时间范围H时，存在一个高效算法，但如果学习阶段数少于H，则需要指数级数量的智能体。
ai_comments: 该研究为无奖励设置下的多智能体探索问题提供了一个重要的理论分析，揭示了学习阶段数和智能体数量之间的关键权衡。算法效率和下界结果都很有说服力，但实际应用中的计算复杂度和可扩展性仍需进一步探讨。
motivation: 研究在无奖励探索设置下的合作多智能体强化学习，目标是学习未知MDP的动力学。
method: 采用分阶段学习框架，在每个阶段，智能体独立与环境交互并执行分配的策略，观察轨迹。主要研究学习阶段数和智能体数量之间的权衡。
results: 当学习阶段数等于时间范围H时，提出了一种计算高效的算法，需要$	ilde{O}(S^6 H^6 A / ε^2)$个智能体来获得动力学的$ε$近似。证明了任何少于H个学习阶段的算法都需要至少$A^{H/ρ}$个智能体才能获得恒定精度。
conclusion: 为了在智能体数量有限的情况下获得动力学的精确近似，需要大约H个学习阶段。学习阶段数和智能体数量之间存在一个关键的权衡。

title: Modeling Topological Impact on Node Attribute Distributions in Attributed Graphs
authors: Amirreza Shiralinasab Langari, Leila Yeganeh, Kim Khoa Nguyen
abstract:
We investigate how the topology of attributed graphs influences the distribution of node attributes. This work offers a novel perspective by treating topology and attributes as structurally distinct but interacting components. We introduce an algebraic approach that combines a graph's topology with the probability distribution of node attributes, resulting in topology-influenced distributions. First, we develop a categorical framework to formalize how a node perceives the graph's topology. We then quantify this point of view and integrate it with the distribution of node attributes to capture topological effects. We interpret these topology-conditioned distributions as approximations of the posteriors $P(\cdot \mid v)$ and $P(\cdot \mid \mathcal{G})$.
  We further establish a principled sufficiency condition by showing that, on complete graphs, where topology carries no informative structure, our construction recovers the original attribute distribution. To evaluate our approach, we introduce an intentionally simple testbed model, $\textbf{ID}$, and use unsupervised graph anomaly detection as a probing task.
zh_title: 关于属性图中节点属性分布的拓扑影响建模
translation: 我们研究了属性图的拓扑结构如何影响节点属性的分布。这项工作通过将拓扑和属性视为结构上不同但相互作用的组成部分，提供了一个新颖的视角。我们引入了一种代数方法，将图的拓扑与节点属性的概率分布相结合，从而得到受拓扑影响的分布。首先，我们建立了一个分类框架，以形式化节点如何感知图的拓扑。然后，我们量化这一观点并将其与节点属性的分布相结合，以捕捉拓扑效应。我们将这些受拓扑条件限制的分布解释为后验概率 $P(\cdot \mid v)$ 和 $P(\cdot \mid \mathcal{G})$ 的近似值。我们进一步通过证明在完全图上（其中拓扑不携带信息结构），我们的构造可以恢复原始属性分布，从而建立了一个合理的充分条件。为了评估我们的方法，我们引入了一个有意设计的简单测试模型 $\textbf{ID}$，并使用无监督图异常检测作为探测任务。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种代数方法，通过将图拓扑和节点属性视为相互作用的独立部分，来建模拓扑如何影响属性的概率分布，并在异常检测任务上进行了初步验证。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将拓扑结构和节点属性视为相互作用的独立组件，并引入了代数方法来建模拓扑对属性分布的影响。其重要性在于提供了一种量化拓扑对属性影响的理论框架。局限性在于测试模型（ID）被描述为“有意地简单”，可能未充分展示方法的全部潜力。
motivation: 研究动机是探究图的拓扑结构如何影响节点属性的分布，并提供一种新的视角，将拓扑和属性视为结构上不同但相互作用的组件。
method: 首先，建立一个分类框架来形式化节点如何感知图的拓扑；然后，量化这种观点并将其与节点属性的分布相结合，以捕获拓扑效应，从而得到拓扑影响的分布。
results: 提出了拓扑影响的分布，可解释为后验概率 $P(\cdot \mid v)$ 和 $P(\cdot \mid \mathcal{G})$ 的近似值。在完全图上，证明了当拓扑不携带信息结构时，该构造可以恢复原始属性分布。在无监督图异常检测任务上，使用 $\textbf{ID}$ 模型进行了评估。
conclusion: 未在摘要中明确说明结论，但研究建立了在完全图上，当拓扑不携带信息结构时，其构造可以恢复原始属性分布的充分条件。

title: Cross-Paradigm Evaluation of Gaze-Based Semantic Object Identification for Intelligent Vehicles
authors: Penghao Deng, Jidong J. Yang, Jiachen Bian
abstract: Understanding where drivers direct their visual attention during driving, as characterized by gaze behavior, is critical for developing next-generation advanced driver-assistance systems and improving road safety. This paper tackles this challenge as a semantic identification task from the road scenes captured by a vehicle's front-view camera. Specifically, the collocation of gaze points with object semantics is investigated using three distinct vision-based approaches: direct object detection (YOLOv13), segmentation-assisted classification (SAM2 paired with EfficientNetV2 versus YOLOv13), and query-based Vision-Language Models, VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-7b versus Qwen2.5-VL-32b). The results demonstrate that the direct object detection (YOLOv13) and Qwen2.5-VL-32b significantly outperform other approaches, achieving Macro F1-Scores over 0.84. The large VLM (Qwen2.5-VL-32b), in particular, exhibited superior robustness and performance for identifying small, safety-critical objects such as traffic lights, especially in adverse nighttime conditions. Conversely, the segmentation-assisted paradigm suffers from a "part-versus-whole" semantic gap that led to large failure in recall. The results reveal a fundamental trade-off between the real-time efficiency of traditional detectors and the richer contextual understanding and robustness offered by large VLMs. These findings provide critical insights and practical guidance for the design of future human-aware intelligent driver monitoring systems.
zh_title: 面向智能汽车的基于注视点的语义对象识别的跨范式评估
translation: 理解驾驶员在驾驶过程中视觉注意力的方向，即注视行为，对于开发下一代高级驾驶辅助系统和提高道路安全至关重要。本文将这一挑战视为一项语义识别任务，从车辆前视摄像头捕获的道路场景中提取。具体来说，我们研究了注视点与对象语义的搭配，使用了三种不同的视觉方法：直接目标检测（YOLOv13），分割辅助分类（SAM2 结合 EfficientNetV2 或 YOLOv13），以及基于查询的视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-7b 或 Qwen2.5-VL-32b）。结果表明，直接目标检测（YOLOv13）和 Qwen2.5-VL-32b 的表现显著优于其他方法，宏观 F1 分数超过 0.84。特别是大型视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-32b）在识别小型、安全关键对象（如交通信号灯）方面表现出卓越的鲁棒性和性能，尤其是在不利的夜间条件下。相反，分割辅助范式因“部分与整体”的语义鸿沟而导致召回率大幅下降。结果揭示了传统检测器的实时效率与大型视觉语言模型提供的更丰富的上下文理解和鲁棒性之间的基本权衡。这些发现为设计未来面向人类的智能驾驶员监控系统提供了关键的见解和实用的指导。
tldr: 该研究评估了三种不同的计算机视觉方法（目标检测、分割辅助分类和视觉语言模型）在识别驾驶员注视点对应的道路场景中的语义对象方面的性能。结果表明，直接目标检测（YOLOv13）和大型视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-32b）表现最佳，其中大型视觉语言模型在识别关键小目标（如交通信号灯）方面尤其鲁棒，即使在夜间恶劣条件下也是如此。研究还指出了传统检测器的实时效率与大型视觉语言模型提供的丰富上下文理解和鲁棒性之间的权衡，为未来设计面向人类的智能驾驶员监控系统提供了指导。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过比较不同计算机视觉范式在智能汽车驾驶员注视点语义识别任务上的表现，提供了有价值的见解。它不仅突出了大型视觉语言模型在处理复杂场景和识别关键目标方面的潜力，还指出了传统目标检测方法的效率优势。研究中提到的“部分与整体”语义鸿沟是一个值得关注的挑战，对于分割辅助方法的设计具有重要意义。然而，该研究可能未充分讨论不同模型在实际部署中的计算成本和延迟，这对于实时系统至关重要。此外，对于模型在更广泛的驾驶场景和多样化数据集上的泛化能力，也需要进一步的评估。
motivation: 为了开发下一代高级驾驶辅助系统和提高道路安全，理解驾驶员在驾驶过程中视觉注意力的方向（以注视行为为特征）至关重要。
method: 本研究将驾驶员注视点与道路场景中的对象语义进行关联，并采用了三种不同的视觉方法进行评估：1. 直接目标检测（YOLOv13）。2. 分割辅助分类（SAM2 结合 EfficientNetV2 或 YOLOv13）。3. 基于查询的视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-7b 或 Qwen2.5-VL-32b）。
results: 直接目标检测（YOLOv13）和大型视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-32b）表现显著优于其他方法，宏观 F1 分数超过 0.84。特别是大型视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-32b）在识别小型、安全关键对象（如交通信号灯）方面表现出卓越的鲁棒性和性能，尤其是在不利的夜间条件下。分割辅助方法因“部分与整体”的语义鸿沟导致召回率大幅下降。研究结果揭示了传统检测器的实时效率与大型视觉语言模型提供的更丰富的上下文理解和鲁棒性之间的基本权衡。
conclusion: 研究结果为设计未来面向人类的智能驾驶员监控系统提供了关键的见解和实用的指导，并揭示了不同方法在效率、上下文理解和鲁棒性之间的权衡。

title: Rectified LpJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures with Sparse and Maximum-Entropy Representations
authors: Yilun Kuang, Yash Dagade, Tim G. J. Rudner, Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun
abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) learn view-invariant representations and admit projection-based distribution matching for collapse prevention. Existing approaches regularize representations towards isotropic Gaussian distributions, but inherently favor dense representations and fail to capture the key property of sparsity observed in efficient representations. We introduce Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization (RDMReg), a sliced two-sample distribution-matching loss that aligns representations to a Rectified Generalized Gaussian (RGG) distribution. RGG enables explicit control over expected $\ell_0$ norm through rectification, while preserving maximum-entropy up to rescaling under expected $\ell_p$ norm constraints. Equipping JEPAs with RDMReg yields Rectified LpJEPA, which strictly generalizes prior Gaussian-based JEPAs. Empirically, Rectified LpJEPA learns sparse, non-negative representations with favorable sparsity-performance trade-offs and competitive downstream performance on image classification benchmarks, demonstrating that RDMReg effectively enforces sparsity while preserving task-relevant information.
zh_title: 矩化LpJEPA：具有稀疏和最大熵表示的联合嵌入预测架构
translation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）学习视图不变的表示，并允许基于投影的分布匹配以防止崩溃。现有方法将表示正则化到各向同性高斯分布，但固有地偏爱密集表示，并且未能捕获有效表示中观察到的关键稀疏性。我们引入了矩化分布匹配正则化（RDMReg），一种切片两样本分布匹配损失，用于将表示与矩化广义高斯（RGG）分布对齐。RGG通过矩化实现了对期望 $\ell_0$ 范数的显式控制，同时在期望 $\ell_p$ 范数约束下保持最大熵（在重新缩放的情况下）。用RDMReg装备JEPA，产生了矩化LpJEPA，它严格泛化了先前的基于高斯的JEPA。经验上，Rectified LpJEPA学习到稀疏的、非负的表示，具有良好的稀疏性-性能权衡，并在图像分类基准测试上具有竞争力的下游性能，证明了RDMReg能有效地强制执行稀疏性，同时保留任务相关信息。
tldr: Rectified LpJEPA通过引入RDMReg和RGG分布，成功地将稀疏性引入JEPA模型中，克服了传统JEPA偏爱密集表示的缺点，并在图像分类任务上展示了优异的稀疏表示学习能力。
ai_comments: 该方法通过引入RDMReg，解决了现有JEPA方法倾向于学习密集表示的问题，并成功地将稀疏性引入到表示学习中，这在生物学上是合理的，并且在实验中证明了其有效性。其主要创新在于使用RGG分布来替代高斯分布进行正则化。
motivation: 现有的JEPA方法倾向于正则化表示以趋向于各向同性的高斯分布，但这固有地偏爱密集表示，并且未能捕获高效表示中观察到的关键稀疏性。
method: 引入了矩化分布匹配正则化（Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization, RDMReg），这是一种切片两样本分布匹配损失，用于将表示与矩化广义高斯（Rectified Generalized Gaussian, RGG）分布对齐。RGG分布通过矩化实现了对期望 $\ell_0$ 范数的显式控制，同时在期望 $\ell_p$ 范数约束下保持最大熵。
results: Rectified LpJEPA学习到了稀疏的、非负的表示，并在稀疏性-性能权衡方面表现良好，在图像分类基准测试上取得了具有竞争力的下游性能。
conclusion: RDMReg能有效地强制学习稀疏的、非负的表示，同时保留了对下游任务相关的关键信息，从而在图像分类基准测试上取得了具有竞争力的性能。

title: A $5$-Approximation Analysis for the Cover Small Cuts Problem
authors: Miles Simmons, Ishan Bansal, Joe Cheriyan
abstract: In the Cover Small Cuts problem, we are given a capacitated (undirected) graph $G=(V,E,u)$ and a threshold value $λ$, as well as a set of links $L$ with end-nodes in $V$ and a non-negative cost for each link $\ell\in L$; the goal is to find a minimum-cost set of links such that each non-trivial cut of capacity less than $λ$ is covered by a link. Bansal, Cheriyan, Grout, and Ibrahimpur (arXiv:2209.11209, Algorithmica 2024) showed that the WGMV primal-dual algorithm, due to Williamson, Goemans, Mihail, and Vazirani (Combinatorica, 1995), achieves approximation ratio $16$ for the Cover Small Cuts problem; their analysis uses the notion of a pliable family of sets that satisfies a combinatorial property. Later, Bansal (arXiv:2308.15714v2, IPCO 2025) and then Nutov (arXiv:2504.03910, MFCS 2025) proved that the same algorithm achieves approximation ratio $6$. We show that the same algorithm achieves approximation ratio $5$, by using a stronger notion, namely, a pliable family of sets that satisfies symmetry and structural submodularity.
zh_title: Cover Small Cuts 问题的 5-近似分析
translation: 在 Cover Small Cuts 问题中，我们给定一个有容量的（无向）图 $G=(V,E,u)$ 和一个阈值 $λ$，以及一组链接 $L$，每个链接 $\ell\in L$ 都有一个非负成本；目标是找到一组成本最小的链接，使得每个容量小于 $λ$ 的非平凡割都被一个链接覆盖。Bansal, Cheriyan, Grout, 和 Ibrahimpur (arXiv:2209.11209, Algorithmica 2024) 表明，由 Williamson, Goemans, Mihail, 和 Vazirani (Combinatorica, 1995) 提出的 WGMV 原对偶算法，对于 Cover Small Cuts 问题能达到 16 的近似比；他们的分析使用了满足组合性质的可塑集族的概念。之后，Bansal (arXiv:2308.15714v2, IPCO 2025) 和 Nutov (arXiv:2504.03910, MFCS 2025) 证明了同一算法能达到 6 的近似比。我们证明了同一算法能达到 5 的近似比，方法是使用一个更强的概念，即满足对称性和结构次模性的可塑集族。
tldr: 该论文改进了 Cover Small Cuts 问题的 WGMV 算法的近似比，从之前的 6 提高到 5，通过引入满足对称性和结构次模性的可塑集族。
ai_comments: 这项工作在 Cover Small Cuts 问题的算法分析方面取得了显著进展，将已知的近似比从 6 提高到 5，这是一个重要的理论进步。通过引入对称性和结构次模性等更强的组合性质来分析算法，展示了深入理解问题结构的重要性。未来的工作可以探索这些新的组合性质是否能应用于其他相关图算法问题，或者能否进一步改进近似比。
motivation: 之前的研究表明 WGMV 算法在 Cover Small Cuts 问题上的近似比为 16，之后被改进为 6。本研究旨在进一步提升该算法的近似比。
method: 通过使用满足对称性和结构次模性的可塑集族，改进了 WGMV 算法的分析，从而证明了其 5-近似比。
results: 证明了 WGMV 算法对于 Cover Small Cuts 问题具有 5-近似比。
conclusion: 通过引入更强的可塑集族性质（对称性和结构次模性），成功地将 Cover Small Cuts 问题的 WGMV 算法的近似比从 6 提高到了 5。

title: Understanding vision transformer robustness through the lens of out-of-distribution detection
authors: Joey Kuang, Alexander Wong
abstract: Vision transformers have shown remarkable performance in vision tasks, but enabling them for accessible and real-time use is still challenging. Quantization reduces memory and inference costs at the risk of performance loss. Strides have been made to mitigate low precision issues mainly by understanding in-distribution (ID) task behaviour, but the attention mechanism may provide insight on quantization attributes by exploring out-of-distribution (OOD) situations. We investigate the behaviour of quantized small-variant popular vision transformers (DeiT, DeiT3, and ViT) on common OOD datasets. ID analyses show the initial instabilities of 4-bit models, particularly of those trained on the larger ImageNet-22k, as the strongest FP32 model, DeiT3, sharply drop 17% from quantization error to be one of the weakest 4-bit models. While ViT shows reasonable quantization robustness for ID calibration, OOD detection reveals more: ViT and DeiT3 pretrained on ImageNet-22k respectively experienced a 15.0% and 19.2% average quantization delta in AUPR-out between full precision to 4-bit while their ImageNet-1k-only counterparts experienced a 9.5% and 12.0% delta. Overall, our results suggest pretraining on large scale datasets may hinder low-bit quantization robustness in OOD detection and that data augmentation may be a more beneficial option.
zh_title: 从分布外检测的角度理解Vision Transformer的鲁棒性
translation: Vision Transformer在视觉任务中表现出卓越的性能，但使其可访问和实时使用仍然具有挑战性。量化以牺牲性能为代价来降低内存和推理成本。减轻低精度问题的努力主要通过理解分布内（ID）任务行为来实现，但注意力机制可能通过探索分布外（OOD）情况来提供关于量化属性的见解。我们研究了量化的、小型流行的Vision Transformer（DeiT、DeiT3和ViT）在常见OOD数据集上的行为。ID分析显示了4位模型的初始不稳定性，特别是那些在较大的ImageNet-22k上训练的模型，其中最强的FP32模型DeiT3从量化误差来看急剧下降了17%，成为最弱的4位模型之一。虽然ViT在ID校准方面表现出合理的量化鲁棒性，但OOD检测揭示了更多：在ImageNet-22k上预训练的ViT和DeiT3，其AUPR-out从全精度到4位的平均量化差异分别为15.0%和19.2%，而其仅在ImageNet-1k上训练的对应模型差异分别为9.5%和12.0%。总体而言，我们的结果表明，在大规模数据集上预训练可能会阻碍低比特量化在OOD检测中的鲁棒性，而数据增强可能是更有益的选择。
tldr: 研究发现，Vision Transformer量化后，在分布外检测任务上的鲁棒性受预训练数据规模影响很大，大规模预训练（如ImageNet-22k）反而可能削弱4位量化的OOD鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地通过研究模型在分布外（OOD）情况下的行为来理解量化对Vision Transformer（ViT）鲁棒性的影响，这与以往主要关注分布内（ID）行为的研究有所不同。结果表明大规模预训练可能会损害低比特量化的OOD检测鲁棒性。
motivation: 尽管Vision Transformer性能优异，但其在可访问和实时使用方面仍面临挑战。量化可以降低成本，但有性能损失的风险。以往的研究主要关注ID行为来减轻低精度问题，而注意力机制可能通过探索OOD情况来提供关于量化属性的见解。
method: 研究了量化的、小型流行的Vision Transformer（DeiT、DeiT3和ViT）在常见OOD数据集上的行为，并比较了全精度（FP32）与4位量化模型在ID任务和OOD检测任务上的性能差异。
results: ID分析显示，4位模型（尤其是那些在ImageNet-22k上训练的模型）存在初始不稳定性。ViT和DeiT3在ImageNet-22k上预训练的模型，其AUPR-out的平均量化差异（从全精度到4位）分别为15.0%和19.2%，而仅在ImageNet-1k上预训练的模型差异分别为9.5%和12.0%。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，在大规模数据集上预训练可能会阻碍低比特量化在OOD检测中的鲁棒性，而数据增强可能是更有益的选择。

title: Beyond Taylor: Divergence-Based Functional Expansions and Their Application to Numerical Integration
authors: Junping Wang
abstract:
This paper introduces a new functional expansion framework that extends classical ideas beyond the Taylor series. Unlike traditional Taylor expansions based on local polynomial approximations, the proposed approach arises from exact differential identities that link a function and its derivatives through polynomial weight factors. This formulation expresses smooth functions via divergence-based relations connecting derivatives of all orders with systematically scaled polynomial coefficients. This framework provides a natural foundation for constructing high-order numerical quadrature formulas, particularly for multi-dimensional domains. By exploiting the divergence structure, volume integrals are systematically transformed into boundary integrals using the Divergence Theorem, recursively reducing the integration domain from an $n$-dimensional body to its $(n-1)$-dimensional facets, and ultimately to its vertices.
  The article further enhances the framework's accuracy by introducing a complex-shift technique. It is demonstrated that by positioning the expansion center at specific roots of unity in the complex plane, lower-order error terms are annihilated, yielding high-order real-valued quadrature rules with minimal function evaluations. Additionally, a rigorous geometric analysis of the affine transformations required for surface integration is provided, deriving explicit formulas for the transformation of normal vectors and surface measures. The proposed method offers a robust, systematic, and computationally efficient alternative to tessellation-based quadrature for arbitrary flat-faced polytopes.
zh_title: 超越泰勒：基于散度的函数展开及其在数值积分中的应用
translation: 本文介绍了一种新的函数展开框架，它将经典的泰勒级数思想推向了新的高度。与基于局部多项式逼近的传统泰勒展开不同，所提出的方法源于将函数及其导数通过多项式权重因子联系起来的精确微分恒等式。这种表述通过连接所有阶导数与系统缩放的多项式系数的基于散度的关系来表达光滑函数。该框架为构建高阶数值求积公式提供了一个自然的理论基础，尤其适用于多维域。通过利用散度结构，体积积分被系统地转化为边界积分，利用散度定理，积分域递归地从 $n$ 维体降低到其 $(n-1)$ 维面，并最终归结到顶点。本文进一步通过引入复数平移技术来提高框架的精度。实验证明，通过将展开中心置于复平面上的特定单位根处，可以消除低阶误差项，从而产生具有最小函数评估次数的高阶实值求积规则。此外，还提供了对表面积分所需的仿射变换的严格几何分析，推导出了法向量和表面度量的变换的显式公式。所提出的方法为任意平坦多面体的基于剖分的求积法提供了一种稳健、系统且计算高效的替代方案。
tldr: 提出了一种基于散度的函数展开方法，超越了泰勒级数，并将其应用于高维数值积分。该方法通过散度定理递归地降低积分维度，并利用复数平移技术实现了高阶、低成本的实值积分。
ai_comments: 该工作的主要创新在于提出了一个基于散度的函数展开框架，它超越了经典的泰勒级数，并将其直接应用于高阶数值积分的构建。方法论的严谨性和在多维积分中的系统性应用是其重要贡献。局限性可能在于复杂平坦多面体之外的适用性，以及复数域操作在实际计算中的开销。
motivation: 经典泰勒展开基于局部多项式逼近，而本文旨在提供一个超越泰勒级数的函数展开新框架，该框架能自然地为高阶数值积分公式的构建提供基础，特别是针对多维域。
method: 提出了一种基于精确微分恒等式的函数展开新框架，它通过多项式权重因子将函数与其导数联系起来。该框架利用散度结构，通过散度定理将体积积分系统地转化为边界积分，递归地降低积分维度。此外，引入了复数平移技术来提高精度，并通过几何分析推导出表面积分所需的仿射变换的显式公式。
results: 构建了一个新的函数展开框架，该框架能够系统地将n维体积积分转化为其(n-1)维边界积分，最终归结到顶点。通过复数平移技术，成功获得了具有最小函数评估次数的高阶实值数值积分规则。同时，导出了表面积分所需的仿射变换（法向量和表面度量）的显式公式。
conclusion: 提出的基于散度的函数展开框架提供了一种系统、稳健且计算高效的数值积分替代方案，尤其适用于任意平坦多面体的积分。通过复数平移技术，可以获得高阶实值积分规则。

title: Agyn: A Multi-Agent System for Team-Based Autonomous Software Engineering
authors: Nikita Benkovich, Vitalii Valkov
abstract: Large language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in individual software engineering tasks, yet most autonomous systems still treat issue resolution as a monolithic or pipeline-based process. In contrast, real-world software development is organized as a collaborative activity carried out by teams following shared methodologies, with clear role separation, communication, and review. In this work, we present a fully automated multi-agent system that explicitly models software engineering as an organizational process, replicating the structure of an engineering team. Built on top of agyn, an open-source platform for configuring agent teams, our system assigns specialized agents to roles such as coordination, research, implementation, and review, provides them with isolated sandboxes for experimentation, and enables structured communication. The system follows a defined development methodology for working on issues, including analysis, task specification, pull request creation, and iterative review, and operates without any human intervention. Importantly, the system was designed for real production use and was not tuned for SWE-bench. When evaluated post hoc on SWE-bench 500, it resolves 72.4% of tasks, outperforming single-agent baselines using comparable language models. Our results suggest that replicating team structure, methodology, and communication is a powerful paradigm for autonomous software engineering, and that future progress may depend as much on organizational design and agent infrastructure as on model improvements.
zh_title: Agyn：一个用于团队式自主软件工程的多智能体系统
translation: 大型语言模型在个体软件工程任务中展现出强大的能力，然而大多数自主系统仍然将问题解决视为一个单体或基于流水线的过程。与此相反，现实世界的软件开发是遵循共享方法论、具有明确角色分离、沟通和评审的协作活动。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个完全自动化的多智能体系统，它明确地将软件工程建模为一个组织过程，复制了工程团队的结构。我们的系统建立在用于配置智能体团队的开源平台agyn之上，为协调、研究、实现和评审等角色分配了专业智能体，为实验提供了隔离的沙盒，并实现了结构化的沟通。该系统遵循定义好的开发方法论来处理问题，包括分析、任务规范、拉取请求创建和迭代评审，并且在没有任何人工干预的情况下运行。重要的是，该系统是为真实生产使用而设计的，并未针对SWE-bench进行调优。当事后在SWE-bench 500上进行评估时，它解决了72.4%的任务，优于使用相当语言模型的单智能体基线。我们的结果表明，复制团队结构、方法论和沟通是自主软件工程的强大范式，并且未来的进展可能在同等程度上依赖于组织设计和智能体基础设施，以及模型改进。
tldr: Agyn是一个多智能体系统，它通过模拟真实工程团队的结构、角色和协作流程（而非单体流水线）来进行全自动软件工程。它在SWE-bench 500上实现了72.4%的解决率，证明了组织设计在自主软件工程中的重要性。
ai_comments: 该系统创新的核心在于将软件工程视为一个组织过程，明确建模了工程团队的结构、角色分离、沟通和评审机制，而不是简单地将其视为单体或流水线任务。其重要性在于证明了复制团队结构和方法论是实现自主软件工程的有效范式。局限性在于其评估是事后（post hoc）进行的，且系统是为真实生产使用设计的，而非专门针对SWE-bench优化。
motivation: 现有的大型语言模型在个体软件工程任务上表现出色，但大多数自主系统仍将问题解决视为单体或流水线过程。与此相反，现实世界的软件开发是团队协作活动，具有明确的角色分离、沟通和评审。因此，需要一个能复制这种工程团队结构的系统。
method: 构建了一个完全自动化的多智能体系统，该系统明确地将软件工程建模为一个组织过程，复制了工程团队的结构。系统基于开源平台agyn，为协调、研究、实现和评审等角色分配专业智能体，提供隔离的沙盒，并启用结构化沟通。系统遵循分析、任务规范、拉取请求创建和迭代评审等定义的开发方法论，全程无需人工干预。
results: 在SWE-bench 500上进行事后评估时，该系统解决了72.4%的任务，优于使用相当语言模型的单智能体基线。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，复制团队结构、方法论和沟通是自主软件工程的强大范式，未来的进展可能同样依赖于组织设计和代理基础设施，而不仅仅是模型本身的改进。

title: P-EAGLE: Parallel-Drafting EAGLE with Scalable Training
authors: Mude Hui, Xin Huang, Jaime Campos Salas, Yue Sun, Nathan Pemberton, Xiang Song, Ashish Khetan, George Karypis
abstract: Reasoning LLMs produce longer outputs, requiring speculative decoding drafters trained on extended sequences. Parallel drafting - predicting multiple tokens per forward pass - offers latency benefits over sequential generation, but training complexity scales quadratically with the product of sequence length and parallel positions, rendering long-context training impractical. We present P(arallel)-EAGLE, which transforms EAGLE from autoregressive to parallel multi-token prediction via a learnable shared hidden state. To scale training to long contexts, we develop a framework featuring attention mask pre-computation and sequence partitioning techniques, enabling gradient accumulation within individual sequences for parallel-prediction training. We implement P-EAGLE in vLLM and demonstrate speedups of 1.10-1.36x over autoregressive EAGLE-3 across GPT-OSS 120B, 20B, and Qwen3-Coder 30B.
zh_title: P-EAGLE：具有可扩展训练的并行草稿EAGLE
translation: 推理大型语言模型会产生更长的输出，需要针对扩展序列训练的投机解码起草器。并行草稿——每前向传播预测多个令牌——比顺序生成具有延迟优势，但训练复杂度与序列长度和并行位置的乘积呈二次方增长，使得长上下文训练不切实际。我们提出了P(arallel)-EAGLE，它通过一个可学习的共享隐藏状态将EAGLE从自回归转变为并行多令牌预测。为将训练扩展到长上下文，我们开发了一个包含注意力掩码预计算和序列分区技术的框架，以实现并行预测训练中的梯度累积。我们在vLLM中实现了P-EAGLE，并在GPT-OSS 120B、20B和Qwen3-Coder 30B上展示了比自回归EAGLE-3高1.10-1.36倍的速度提升。
tldr: 为加速长文本LLM的推理，研究人员将EAGLE模型改为并行草稿（P-EAGLE），并通过新的训练技术（如序列分区）克服了并行训练的二次复杂度瓶颈，成功在多个大型模型上实现了显著的速度提升。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了P-EAGLE，通过学习到的共享隐藏状态将EAGLE模型从自回归模式转换为并行多令牌预测，并设计了可扩展的训练框架来解决并行草稿训练中复杂度随序列长度和并行度二次增长的问题。其重要性在于实现了长上下文场景下的高效推理。方法的局限性可能在于引入共享隐藏状态和新的训练框架可能增加模型的复杂性。
motivation: 推理大型语言模型（LLMs）会产生更长的输出，需要针对扩展序列训练的投机解码起草器。并行草稿（一次预测多个令牌）有延迟优势，但其训练复杂度随序列长度和并行位置的乘积呈二次方增长，使得长上下文训练不切实际。
method: P-EAGLE通过学习到的共享隐藏状态将EAGLE模型从自回归转换为并行多令牌预测。为扩展训练到长上下文，开发了一个包含注意力掩码预计算和序列分区技术的框架，以实现并行预测训练中的梯度累积。
results: 在GPT-OSS 120B、20B和Qwen3-Coder 30B模型上，与自回归EAGLE-3相比，P-EAGLE实现了1.10-1.36倍的速度提升。
conclusion: P-EAGLE在GPT-OSS 120B、20B和Qwen3-Coder 30B模型上实现了比自回归EAGLE-3高1.10-1.36倍的速度提升。

title: Legal Infrastructure for Transformative AI Governance
authors: Gillian K. Hadfield
abstract: Most of our AI governance efforts focus on substance: what rules do we want in place? What limits or checks do we want to impose on AI development and deployment? But a key role for law is not only to establish substantive rules but also to establish legal and regulatory infrastructure to generate and implement rules. The transformative nature of AI calls especially for attention to building legal and regulatory frameworks. In this PNAS Perspective piece I review three examples I have proposed: the creation of registration regimes for frontier models; the creation of registration and identification regimes for autonomous agents; and the design of regulatory markets to facilitate a role for private companies to innovate and deliver AI regulatory services.
zh_title: 变革性人工智能治理的法律基础设施
translation: 我们的大多数人工智能治理工作都集中在实质内容上：我们希望有哪些规则？我们希望对人工智能的开发和部署施加哪些限制或检查？但法律的一个关键作用不仅是建立实质性规则，还在于建立产生和实施规则的法律和监管基础设施。人工智能的变革性尤其需要关注构建法律和监管框架。在这篇PNAS观点文章中，我回顾了自己提出的三个例子：为前沿模型创建注册制度；为自主代理创建注册和识别制度；以及设计监管市场以促进私营公司在创新和提供人工智能监管服务方面的作用。
tldr: AI治理的重点应放在构建法律和监管基础设施上，而不是仅仅关注实体规则。作者提出了注册前沿模型、注册自主代理和设计监管市场的三个具体基础设施建议。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它将AI治理的焦点从实体规则（“我们想要什么规则”）转移到了法律和监管基础设施的建设上，强调了支持规则生成和实施的结构性要素。这对于应对AI的变革性影响至关重要。文章提出的三个具体建议具有很强的实践指导意义。
motivation: AI的变革性要求我们不仅要关注实体规则（如限制或检查），更要关注建立能够生成和实施这些规则的法律和监管基础设施。
method: 通过回顾作者提出的三个具体建议（前沿模型注册、自主代理注册与识别、监管市场设计）来阐述构建法律和监管框架的必要性。
results: 提出了三个具体的法律和监管基础设施建议：前沿模型的注册制度、自主代理的注册和识别制度，以及旨在促进私营部门创新和提供AI监管服务的监管市场的设计。

title: ConPress: Learning Efficient Reasoning from Multi-Question Contextual Pressure
authors: Jie Deng, Shining Liang, Jun Li, Hongzhi Li, Yutao Xie
abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) typically solve reasoning-intensive tasks by generating long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, leading to substantial inference overhead. We identify a reproducible inference-time phenomenon, termed Self-Compression: when multiple independent and answerable questions are presented within a single prompt, the model spontaneously produces shorter reasoning traces for each question. This phenomenon arises from multi-question contextual pressure during generation and consistently manifests across models and benchmarks. Building on this observation, we propose ConPress (Learning from Contextual Pressure), a lightweight self-supervised fine-tuning approach. ConPress constructs multi-question prompts to induce self-compression, samples the resulting model outputs, and parses and filters per-question traces to obtain concise yet correct reasoning trajectories. These trajectories are directly used for supervised fine-tuning, internalizing compressed reasoning behavior in single-question settings without external teachers, manual pruning, or reinforcement learning. With only 8k fine-tuning examples, ConPress reduces reasoning token usage by 59% on MATH500 and 33% on AIME25, while maintaining competitive accuracy.
zh_title: ConPress：从多问题上下文压力中学习高效推理
translation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通常通过生成冗长的思维链（CoT）轨迹来解决推理密集型任务，这带来了大量的推理开销。我们发现了一种可复现的推理时间现象，称为自压缩（Self-Compression）：当单个提示中包含多个独立且可回答的问题时，模型会自发地为每个问题生成更短的推理轨迹。这种现象源于生成过程中的多问题上下文压力，并在模型和基准测试中一致出现。基于这一观察，我们提出了 ConPress（从上下文压力中学习），一种轻量级的自监督微调方法。ConPress 构建多问题提示以诱导自压缩，采样所得的模型输出，并解析和过滤每题的轨迹以获得简洁但正确的推理路径。这些轨迹直接用于监督微调，在没有外部教师、手动修剪或强化学习的情况下，将压缩的推理行为内化到单问题设置中。仅使用 8k 个微调示例，ConPress 在 MATH500 上将推理令牌使用量减少了 59%，在 AIME25 上减少了 33%，同时保持了具有竞争力的准确性。
tldr: 通过向大型推理模型提出多个问题来“施加压力”，迫使它们生成更短的推理链（自压缩），然后用这些短链来微调模型，从而在不损失准确性的情况下大幅降低推理成本。
ai_comments: ConPress 的创新之处在于利用了“自压缩”这一可复现的推理现象，通过构造多问题提示来诱导模型生成更短的推理轨迹，并将其用于自监督微调，从而在不引入外部教师或强化学习的情况下实现了推理效率的显著提升。限制在于其效果是基于对“上下文压力”现象的观察和利用，可能对特定任务或模型泛化性有待进一步验证。
motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在解决推理密集型任务时会生成冗长的思维链（CoT）轨迹，导致显著的推理开销。研究人员观察到“自压缩”现象，即当提示中包含多个独立可回答的问题时，模型会自发地为每个问题生成更短的推理轨迹，以此为动机来减轻推理开销。
method: ConPress 是一种轻量级的自监督微调方法，它首先构建多问题提示以诱导模型的“自压缩”现象，然后采样输出并解析出每道题的简洁且正确的推理轨迹，最后用这些轨迹进行监督微调，以习得压缩的推理行为。
results: 使用仅 8k 的微调示例，ConPress 在 MATH500 上将推理令牌使用量减少了 59%，在 AIME25 上减少了 33%，同时保持了具有竞争力的准确性。
conclusion: ConPress 成功地通过轻量级的自监督微调方法，将由多问题上下文压力诱导的压缩推理行为内化到模型中，实现了在保持竞争性准确率的同时，大幅降低了推理时的推理令牌使用量。

title: A Statistical Theory of Gated Attention through the Lens of Hierarchical Mixture of Experts
authors: Viet Nguyen, Tuan Minh Pham, Thinh Cao, Tan Dinh, Huy Nguyen, Nhat Ho, Alessandro Rinaldo
abstract: Self-attention has greatly contributed to the success of the widely used Transformer architecture by enabling learning from data with long-range dependencies. In an effort to improve performance, a gated attention model that leverages a gating mechanism within the multi-head self-attention has recently been proposed as a promising alternative. Gated attention has been empirically demonstrated to increase the expressiveness of low-rank mapping in standard attention and even to eliminate the attention sink phenomenon. Despite its efficacy, a clear theoretical understanding of gated attention's benefits remains lacking in the literature. To close this gap, we rigorously show that each entry in a gated attention matrix or a multi-head self-attention matrix can be written as a hierarchical mixture of experts. By recasting learning as an expert estimation problem, we demonstrate that gated attention is more sample-efficient than multi-head self-attention. In particular, while the former needs only a polynomial number of data points to estimate an expert, the latter requires exponentially many data points to achieve the same estimation error. Furthermore, our analysis also provides a theoretical justification for why gated attention yields higher performance when a gate is placed at the output of the scaled dot product attention or the value map rather than at other positions in the multi-head self-attention architecture.
comment: Viet Nguyen, Tuan Minh Pham, and Thinh Cao contributed equally to this work
zh_title: 带门控的注意力统计理论：基于层级专家混合模型
translation: 自注意力通过实现长程依赖数据的学习，极大地促进了广泛使用的Transformer架构的成功。为了提高性能，最近提出了一种利用多头自注意力内部门控机制的门控注意力模型，作为一种有前景的替代方案。门控注意力已被证明在经验上能提高标准注意力中低秩映射的表达能力，甚至能消除注意力沉没现象。尽管其有效性得到证实，但文献中仍缺乏对其益处的清晰理论理解。为了弥合这一差距，我们严格证明了门控注意力矩阵或多头自注意力矩阵中的每个条目都可以表示为层级专家混合模型。通过将学习重构为专家估计问题，我们证明了门控注意力比多头自注意力具有更高的样本效率。特别是，前者仅需多项式数量的数据点即可估计专家，而后者需要指数级数量的数据点才能达到相同的估计误差。此外，我们的分析还为门控注意力在输出端（相对于值映射或点积注意力）而非多头自注意力架构的其他位置放置门控时能产生更高性能提供了理论依据。
tldr: 尽管门控注意力模型在实践中表现出色，但缺乏理论解释。本文提出了一种将门控注意力矩阵和多头自注意力矩阵的每个条目表示为层级专家混合模型的方法，并证明门控注意力比多头自注意力具有更高的样本效率，前者仅需多项式数量的数据点即可估计专家，而后者需要指数级数量的数据点才能达到相同的估计误差。此外，本文还为门控注意力在多头自注意力架构中的最佳门控位置提供了理论依据。
ai_comments: 这项研究为门控注意力机制提供了重要的理论基础，解决了现有文献中缺乏理论理解的问题。通过将门控注意力与层级专家混合模型联系起来，并证明其更高的样本效率，该研究为未来的模型设计和优化提供了有价值的见解。然而，理论分析的实际应用和对不同类型数据的泛化能力仍有待进一步研究。
motivation: 填补现有文献中对门控注意力模型理论理解的空白，并解释其益处。
method: 将门控注意力矩阵和多头自注意力矩阵中的每个条目表示为层级专家混合模型，并将学习重构为专家估计问题。
results: 证明门控注意力比多头自注意力更具样本效率，前者仅需多项式数量的数据点即可估计专家，而后者需要指数级数量的数据点才能达到相同的估计误差。此外，该分析还为门控注意力在多头自注意力架构中的最佳门控位置提供了理论依据。
conclusion: 门控注意力模型可以通过层级专家混合模型进行理论解释，并且比多头自注意力模型具有更高的样本效率。本文的分析为门控注意力模型的有效性提供了理论基础。

title: Learning to Guide Local Search for MPE Inference in Probabilistic Graphical Models
authors: Brij Malhotra, Shivvrat Arya, Tahrima Rahman, Vibhav Giridhar Gogate
abstract: Most Probable Explanation (MPE) inference in Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs) is a fundamental yet computationally challenging problem arising in domains such as diagnosis, planning, and structured prediction. In many practical settings, the graphical model remains fixed while inference must be performed repeatedly for varying evidence patterns. Stochastic Local Search (SLS) algorithms scale to large models but rely on myopic best-improvement rule that prioritizes immediate likelihood gains and often stagnate in poor local optima. Heuristics such as Guided Local Search (GLS+) partially alleviate this limitation by modifying the search landscape, but their guidance cannot be reused effectively across multiple inference queries on the same model. We propose a neural amortization framework for improving local search in this repeated-query regime. Exploiting the fixed graph structure, we train an attention-based network to score local moves by predicting their ability to reduce Hamming distance to a near-optimal solution. Our approach integrates seamlessly with existing local search procedures, using this signal to balance short-term likelihood gains with long-term promise during neighbor selection. We provide theoretical intuition linking distance-reducing move selection to improved convergence behavior, and empirically demonstrate consistent improvements over SLS and GLS+ on challenging high-treewidth benchmarks in the amortized inference setting.

title: Rod Flow: A Continuous-Time Model for Gradient Descent at the Edge of Stability
authors: Eric Regis, Sinho Chewi
abstract: How can we understand gradient-based training over non-convex landscapes? The edge of stability phenomenon, introduced in Cohen et al. (2021), indicates that the answer is not so simple: namely, gradient descent (GD) with large step sizes often diverges away from the gradient flow. In this regime, the "Central Flow", recently proposed in Cohen et al. (2025), provides an accurate ODE approximation to the GD dynamics over many architectures. In this work, we propose Rod Flow, an alternative ODE approximation, which carries the following advantages: (1) it rests on a principled derivation stemming from a physical picture of GD iterates as an extended one-dimensional object -- a "rod"; (2) it better captures GD dynamics for simple toy examples and matches the accuracy of Central Flow for representative neural network architectures, and (3) is explicit and cheap to compute. Theoretically, we prove that Rod Flow correctly predicts the critical sharpness threshold and explains self-stabilization in quartic potentials. We validate our theory with a range of numerical experiments.

title: Causal Preference Elicitation
authors: Edwin V. Bonilla, He Zhao, Daniel M. Steinberg
abstract: We propose causal preference elicitation, a Bayesian framework for expert-in-the-loop causal discovery that actively queries local edge relations to concentrate a posterior over directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). From any black-box observational posterior, we model noisy expert judgments with a three-way likelihood over edge existence and direction. Posterior inference uses a flexible particle approximation, and queries are selected by an efficient expected information gain criterion on the expert's categorical response. Experiments on synthetic graphs, protein signaling data, and a human gene perturbation benchmark show faster posterior concentration and improved recovery of directed effects under tight query budgets.

title: Ebisu: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Japanese Finance
authors: Xueqing Peng, Ruoyu Xiang, Fan Zhang, Mingzi Song, Mingyang Jiang, Yan Wang, Lingfei Qian, Taiki Hara, Yuqing Guo, Jimin Huang, Junichi Tsujii, Sophia Ananiadou
abstract: Japanese finance combines agglutinative, head-final linguistic structure, mixed writing systems, and high-context communication norms that rely on indirect expression and implicit commitment, posing a substantial challenge for LLMs. We introduce Ebisu, a benchmark for native Japanese financial language understanding, comprising two linguistically and culturally grounded, expert-annotated tasks: JF-ICR, which evaluates implicit commitment and refusal recognition in investor-facing Q&A, and JF-TE, which assesses hierarchical extraction and ranking of nested financial terminology from professional disclosures. We evaluate a diverse set of open-source and proprietary LLMs spanning general-purpose, Japanese-adapted, and financial models. Results show that even state-of-the-art systems struggle on both tasks. While increased model scale yields limited improvements, language- and domain-specific adaptation does not reliably improve performance, leaving substantial gaps unresolved. Ebisu provides a focused benchmark for advancing linguistically and culturally grounded financial NLP. All datasets and evaluation scripts are publicly released.
zh_title: Ebisu：日语金融领域大型语言模型的基准测试
translation: 日语金融结合了粘着性、后置性语言结构、混合书写系统以及依赖间接表达和隐性承诺的高语境交流规范，对大型语言模型构成了重大挑战。我们引入了Ebisu，一个用于原生日语金融语言理解的基准测试，它包含两个在语言学和文化上都有根据、并经过专家注释的任务：JF-ICR，评估投资者问答中的隐性承诺和拒绝识别；以及JF-TE，评估专业披露中嵌套金融术语的分层提取和排序。我们评估了一系列跨越通用、日语适配和金融模型的开源和专有大型语言模型。结果表明，即使是最先进的系统在这两个任务上都表现挣扎。虽然模型规模的增加带来了有限的改进，但语言和领域特定的适应性并不能可靠地提高性能，留下了大量的差距。Ebisu为推进语言和文化基础的金融自然语言处理提供了一个集中的基准测试。所有数据集和评估脚本都已公开。
tldr: 研究人员创建了一个名为Ebisu的新型日语金融语言理解基准，发现当前最先进的大型语言模型在处理日语金融文本的复杂性（如隐性表达）方面表现不佳，且模型规模或领域适应性并未带来显著改进。
ai_comments: Ebisu的创新之处在于它针对日语金融语言的独特性设计了基准测试，特别是关注了隐性承诺和分层术语提取等高难度任务。其重要性在于揭示了现有LLM在处理高度专业化和文化敏感的日语金融文本时存在的显著性能差距。局限性可能在于其任务的专业性和文化依赖性，可能限制了其在其他领域或语言中的直接适用性。
motivation: 日语金融语言的特性（粘着性、后置性结构、混合书写系统、依赖间接表达和隐性承诺的高语境交流规范）对大型语言模型构成了重大挑战。
method: 引入了Ebisu基准测试，包含两个专家注释的任务：JF-ICR（评估投资者问答中的隐性承诺和拒绝识别）和JF-TE（评估专业披露中嵌套金融术语的分层提取和排序）。评估了一系列开源和专有的大型语言模型。
results: 结果显示，即使是最先进的系统在这两个任务上表现都很吃力。模型规模的增加带来的改进有限，而语言和领域特定的适应性并不能可靠地提高性能，留下了大量的差距。
conclusion: Ebisu提供了一个专注于推进语言和文化基础的金融自然语言处理的基准测试。所有数据集和评估脚本已公开。

title: How Users Perceive Mixed-Initiative AI: Attitudes Toward Assistance in Problem Solving
authors: Yunhao Luo, Arthur Caetano, Avinash Ajit Nargund, Tobias Höllerer, Misha Sra
abstract: In mixed-initiative systems, the mode of AI assistance delivery can be as consequential as the assistance itself. We investigated two assistance delivery modes: on-demand help (users request via Button) and pre-scheduled help (assistance delivered at user-selected intervals, with user actions resetting the Timer). To evaluate these modes, we selected Rush Hour puzzles as the human-AI collaborative task because they capture elements of real-world problem solving such as analysis, resource management, and decision-making under constraints. To enhance ecological validity, we imposed monetary costs for both time and AI assistance, simulating scenarios where people must balance implicit or explicit trade-offs such as time pressure, financial limitations, or opportunity costs. Although task performance was comparable across modes, participants who used the pre-scheduled (Timer) mode reported more positive perceptions of the AI, even when their ending budget was low. This suggests that assistance delivery mode can shape user experience independent of task outcomes, indicating that human-AI systems may need to consider how AI assistance is delivered alongside improving task performance.
comment: ACM IUI '26 | 31st International Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces

title: Multi-Scale Wavelet Transformers for Operator Learning of Dynamical Systems
authors: Xuesong Wang, Michael Groom, Rafael Oliveira, He Zhao, Terence O'Kane, Edwin V. Bonilla
abstract: Recent years have seen a surge in data-driven surrogates for dynamical systems that can be orders of magnitude faster than numerical solvers. However, many machine learning-based models such as neural operators exhibit spectral bias, attenuating high-frequency components that often encode small-scale structure. This limitation is particularly damaging in applications such as weather forecasting, where misrepresented high frequencies can induce long-horizon instability. To address this issue, we propose multi-scale wavelet transformers (MSWTs), which learn system dynamics in a tokenized wavelet domain. The wavelet transform explicitly separates low- and high-frequency content across scales. MSWTs leverage a wavelet-preserving downsampling scheme that retains high-frequency features and employ wavelet-based attention to capture dependencies across scales and frequency bands. Experiments on chaotic dynamical systems show substantial error reductions and improved long horizon spectral fidelity. On the ERA5 climate reanalysis, MSWTs further reduce climatological bias, demonstrating their effectiveness in a real-world forecasting setting.

title: Sleep Reveals the Nonce: Breaking ECDSA using Sleep-Based Power Side-Channel Vulnerability
authors: Sahan Sanjaya, Prabhat Mishra
abstract: Security of Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) depends on the secrecy of the per-signature nonce. Even partial nonce leakage can expose the long-term private key through lattice-based cryptanalysis. In this paper, we introduce a previously unexplored power side-channel vulnerability that exploits sleep-induced power spikes to extract ECDSA nonces. Unlike conventional power-based side-channel attacks, this vulnerability leverages power fluctuations generated during processor context switches invoked by sleep functions. These fluctuations correlate with nonce-dependent operations in scalar multiplication, enabling nonce recovery even under constant-time and masked implementations. We evaluate the attack across multiple cryptographic libraries, RustCrypto, BearSSL, and GoCrypto, and processor architectures, including ARM and RISC-V. Our experiments show that subtle variations in the power envelope during sleep-induced context switches provide sufficient leakage for practical ECDSA nonce extraction, recovering 20 bits of the nonce. These results establish sleep-induced power spikes as a practical cross-platform side-channel threat and highlight the need to reconsider design choices in cryptographic systems.

title: DuoLungo: Usability Study of Duo 2FA
authors: Renascence Tarafder Prapty, Gene Tsudik
abstract:
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enhances login security by requiring multiple authentication factors. Its adoption has increased in response to more frequent and sophisticated attacks. Duo is widely used by organizations including Fortune 500 companies and major educational institutions, yet its usability has not been examined thoroughly or recently. Earlier studies focused on technical challenges during initial deployment but did not measure core usability metrics such as task completion time or System Usability Scale (SUS) scores. These results are also outdated, originating from a time when MFA was less familiar to typical users.
  We conducted a long-term, large-scale Duo usability study at the University of California Irvine during the 2024-2025 academic year, involving 2559 participants. Our analysis uses authentication log data and a survey of 57 randomly selected users. The average overhead of a Duo Push task is nearly 8 seconds, which participants described as short to moderate. Overhead varies with time of day, field of study, and education level. The rate of authentication failures due to incomplete Duo tasks is 4.35 percent, and 43.86 percent of survey respondents reported at least one Duo login failure. The Duo SUS score is 70, indicating good usability. Participants generally find Duo easy to use but somewhat annoying, while also reporting an increased sense of account security. They also described common issues and offered suggestions for improvement.

title: Predicting and improving test-time scaling laws via reward tail-guided search
authors: Muheng Li, Jian Qian, Wenlong Mou
abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a critical avenue for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). Though the straight-forward ''best-of-$N$'' (BoN) strategy has already demonstrated significant improvements in performance, it lacks principled guidance on the choice of $N$, budget allocation, and multi-stage decision-making, thereby leaving substantial room for optimization. While many works have explored such optimization, rigorous theoretical guarantees remain limited. In this work, we propose new methodologies to predict and improve scaling properties via tail-guided search. By estimating the tail distribution of rewards, our method predicts the scaling law of LLMs without the need for exhaustive evaluations. Leveraging this prediction tool, we introduce Scaling-Law Guided (SLG) Search, a new test-time algorithm that dynamically allocates compute to identify and exploit intermediate states with the highest predicted potential. We theoretically prove that SLG achieves vanishing regret compared to perfect-information oracles, and achieves expected rewards that would otherwise require a polynomially larger compute budget required when using BoN. Empirically, we validate our framework across different LLMs and reward models, confirming that tail-guided allocation consistently achieves higher reward yields than Best-of-$N$ under identical compute budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/PotatoJnny/Scaling-Law-Guided-search.

title: OpInf-LLM: Parametric PDE Solving with LLMs via Operator Inference
authors: Zhuoyuan Wang, Hanjiang Hu, Xiyu Deng, Saviz Mowlavi, Yorie Nakahira
abstract: Solving diverse partial differential equations (PDEs) is fundamental in science and engineering. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation, symbolic reasoning, and tool use, but reliably solving PDEs across heterogeneous settings remains challenging. Prior work on LLM-based code generation and transformer-based foundation models for PDE learning has shown promising advances. However, a persistent trade-off between execution success rate and numerical accuracy arises, particularly when generalization to unseen parameters and boundary conditions is required. In this work, we propose OpInf-LLM, an LLM parametric PDE solving framework based on operator inference. The proposed framework leverages a small amount of solution data to enable accurate prediction of diverse PDE instances, including unseen parameters and configurations, and provides seamless integration with LLMs for natural language specification of PDE solving tasks. Its low computational demands and unified tool interface further enable a high execution success rate across heterogeneous settings. By combining operator inference with LLM capabilities, OpInf-LLM opens new possibilities for generalizable reduced-order modeling in LLM-based PDE solving.

title: Draw2Learn: A Human-AI Collaborative Tool for Drawing-Based Science Learning
authors: Yuqi Hang
abstract: Drawing supports learning by externalizing mental models, but providing timely feedback at scale remains challenging. We present Draw2Learn, a system that explores how AI can act as a supportive teammate during drawing-based learning. The design translates learning principles into concrete interaction patterns: AI generates structured drawing quests, provides optional visual scaffolds, monitors progress, and delivers multidimensional feedback. We collected formative user feedback during system development and open-ended comments. Feedback showed positive ratings for usability, usefulness, and user experience, with themes highlighting AI scaffolding value and learner autonomy. This work contributes a design framework for teammate-oriented AI in generative learning and identifies key considerations for future research.

title: Geometric Generalization of Neural Operators from Kernel Integral Perspective
authors: Mingyu Han, Daniel Zhengyu Huang, Yuhan Wang, Yanshu Zhang, Jiayi Zhou
abstract: Neural operators are neural network-based surrogate models for approximating solution operators of parametric partial differential equations, enabling efficient many-query computations in science and engineering. Many applications, including engineering design, involve variable and often nonparametric geometries, for which generalization to unseen geometries remains a central practical challenge. In this work, we adopt a kernel integral perspective motivated by classical boundary integral formulations and recast operator learning on variable geometries as the approximation of geometry-dependent kernel operators, potentially with singularities. This perspective clarifies a mechanism for geometric generalization and reveals a direct connection between operator learning and fast kernel summation methods. Leveraging this connection, we propose a multiscale neural operator inspired by Ewald summation for learning and efficiently evaluating unknown kernel integrals, and we provide theoretical accuracy guarantees for the resulting approximation. Numerical experiments demonstrate robust generalization across diverse geometries for several commonly used kernels and for a large-scale three-dimensional fluid dynamics example.

title: Implementation Challenges in Quantum Key Distribution
authors: Abel C. H. Chen
abstract: In recent years, quantum computing technologies have steadily matured and have begun to find practical applications across various domains. One important area is network communication security, where Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) enables communicating parties to establish a shared secret that can then be used to generate symmetric keys for subsequent encryption and decryption. This study focuses on implementing and comparing two well-known QKD protocols, namely BB84 and E91, within an actual quantum computing environment. It also proposes the use of SX gate operations to generate uniform quantum superposition states. By leveraging the properties of quantum superposition and quantum entanglement, the study illustrates how communicating parties can securely obtain a shared secret while preventing adversaries from intercepting it. The experiments are conducted using the IBM Quantum Platform to demonstrate the feasibility of the BB84 and E91 protocols on actual quantum hardware. The evaluation considers several metrics, including entropy, Independent and Identically Distributed (IID), and error-rate verifications.

title: Third-Order Geometric-Volume Conservation in Cahn--Hilliard Models
authors: Josef Musil
abstract: Degenerate Cahn-Hilliard phase-field models provide a robust approximation of surface-diffusion-driven interface motion without explicit front tracking. In computations, however, the geometric volume enclosed by the interface -- the region where the order parameter $φ$ is positive -- may drift at finite interface thickness, producing artificial shrinkage or growth even when the sharp-interface limit conserves volume. We revisit and extend the improved-conservation framework of Zhou et al., where one replaces classical mass conservation by the exact conservation of a designed monotone mapping $Q(φ)$ that more accurately approximates a step function. Building on this framework, we (i) carry out the matched-asymptotic analysis in the unscaled physical time formulation, (ii) derive a simplified representation of the first-order inner correction to the interface profile, and (iii) identify an integral-moment cancellation condition that controls the leading geometric-volume defect. This mechanism becomes a practical design rule: we select regularization kernels within parameterized families -- including exponential and Pade-type -- to reach effective higher-order behavior and satisfy the cancellation condition at moderate parameter values. As a result, the proposed kernels achieve formal third-order accuracy in geometric-volume conservation with respect to interface thickness. Finally, we describe an unconditional energy-dissipative numerical discretization that exactly preserves the discrete conserved quantity. Numerical benchmarks on multi-scale droplet coarsening and shape relaxation demonstrate that the moment-balanced kernels virtually eliminate artificial drift and prevent premature extinction of small droplets.

title: Optimal Sizing of Charging Energy Hubs for Heavy-Duty Electric Transport through Co-Optimization
authors: M. Izadi, D. Fernandez Zapico, M. Salazar, T. Hofman
abstract: Electrification of heavy-duty vehicles places substantial stress on distribution grids, and Charging Energy Hubs (CEHs) mitigate these impacts by integrating charging infrastructure with renewable energy sources and battery storage. Optimal sizing of CEH components is therefore a critical investment decision, yet challenging because design choices depend strongly on operational dynamics. This work presents a mixed-integer linear programming model for the optimal sizing of CEH components, using a co-design approach that jointly optimizes component sizing and operational decisions. A case study for a heavy-duty fleet demonstrates the effectiveness of the method for cost-efficient, scalable, and grid-compliant CEH planning.

title: Governance at the Edge of Architecture: Regulating NeuroAI and Neuromorphic Systems
authors: Afifah Kashif, Abdul Muhsin Hameed, Asim Iqbal
abstract: Current AI governance frameworks, including regulatory benchmarks for accuracy, latency, and energy efficiency, are built for static, centrally trained artificial neural networks on von Neumann hardware. NeuroAI systems, embodied in neuromorphic hardware and implemented via spiking neural networks, break these assumptions. This paper examines the limitations of current AI governance frameworks for NeuroAI, arguing that assurance and audit methods must co-evolve with these architectures, aligning traditional regulatory metrics with the physics, learning dynamics, and embodied efficiency of brain-inspired computation to enable technically grounded assurance.

title: TreeLoc: 6-DoF LiDAR Global Localization in Forests via Inter-Tree Geometric Matching
authors: Minwoo Jung, Nived Chebrolu, Lucas Carvalho de Lima, Haedam Oh, Maurice Fallon, Ayoung Kim
abstract: Reliable localization is crucial for navigation in forests, where GPS is often degraded and LiDAR measurements are repetitive, occluded, and structurally complex. These conditions weaken the assumptions of traditional urban-centric localization methods, which assume that consistent features arise from unique structural patterns, necessitating forest-centric solutions to achieve robustness in these environments. To address these challenges, we propose TreeLoc, a LiDAR-based global localization framework for forests that handles place recognition and 6-DoF pose estimation. We represent scenes using tree stems and their Diameter at Breast Height (DBH), which are aligned to a common reference frame via their axes and summarized using the tree distribution histogram (TDH) for coarse matching, followed by fine matching with a 2D triangle descriptor. Finally, pose estimation is achieved through a two-step geometric verification. On diverse forest benchmarks, TreeLoc outperforms baselines, achieving precise localization. Ablation studies validate the contribution of each component. We also propose applications for long-term forest management using descriptors from a compact global tree database. TreeLoc is open-sourced for the robotics community at https://github.com/minwoo0611/TreeLoc.
