Utilizing fractional differentiability to identify seabed roughness, the paper presents a robust numerical algorithm to estimate the seabed and quantify uncertainties. Extensive numerical experiments validate the effectiveness of this method, offering a promising avenue for large-scale seabed exploration.

title: Vortex Stretching in the Navier-Stokes Equations and Information Dissipation in Diffusion Models: A Reformulation from a Partial Differential Equation Viewpoint
authors: Tsuyoshi Yoneda
abstract: We present a new inverse-time formulation of vortex stretching in the Navier-Stokes equations, based on a PDE framework inspired by score-based diffusion models. By absorbing the ill-posed backward Laplacian arising from time reversal into a drift term expressed through a score function, the inverse-time dynamics are formulated in a Lagrangian manner. Using a discrete Lagrangian flow of an axisymmetric vortex-stretching field, the score function is learned with a neural network and employed to construct backward-time particle trajectories. Numerical results demonstrate that information about initial positions is rapidly lost in the compressive direction, whereas it is relatively well preserved in the stretching direction.

title: Computationally Tractable Robust Nonlinear Model Predictive Control using DC Programming
authors: Martin Doff-Sotta, Zaheen A-Rahman, Mark Cannon
abstract: We propose a computationally tractable, tube-based robust nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) framework using difference-of-convex (DC) functions and sequential convex programming. For systems with differentiable discrete time dynamics, we show how to construct systematic, data-driven DC model representations using polynomials and machine learning techniques. We develop a robust tube MPC scheme that convexifies the online optimization by linearizing the concave components of the model, and we provide guarantees of recursive feasibility and robust stability. We present three data-driven procedures for computing DC models and compare performance using a planar vertical take-off and landing (PVTOL) aircraft case study.

title: Robust Machine Learning Framework for Reliable Discovery of High-Performance Half-Heusler Thermoelectrics
authors: Shoeb Athar, Adrien Mecibah, Philippe Jund
abstract: Machine learning (ML) can facilitate efficient thermoelectric (TE) material discovery essential to address the environmental crisis. However, ML models often suffer from poor experimental generalizability despite high metrics. This study presents a robust workflow, applied to the half-Heusler (hH) structural prototype, for figure of merit (zT) prediction, to improve the generalizability of ML models. To resolve challenges in dataset handling and feature filtering, we first introduce a rigorous PCA-based splitting method that ensures training and test sets are unbiased and representative of the full chemical space. We then integrate Bayesian hyperparameter optimization with k-best feature filtering across three architectures-Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Networks - while employing SISSO symbolic regression for physical insight and comparison. Using SHAP and SISSO analysis, we identify A-site dopant concentration (xA'), and A-site Heat of Vaporization (HVA) as the primary drivers of zT besides Temperature (T). Finally, a high-throughput screening of approximately 6.6x10^8 potential compositions, filtered by stability constraints, yielded several novel high-zT candidates. Breaking from the traditional focus of improving test RMSE/R^2 values of the models, this work shifts the attention on establishing the test set a true proxy for model generalizability and strengthening the often neglected modules of the existing ML workflows for the data-driven design of next-generation thermoelectric materials.

title: Equivalence of Privacy and Stability with Generalization Guarantees in Quantum Learning
authors: Ayanava Dasgupta, Naqueeb Ahmad Warsi, Masahito Hayashi
abstract: We present a unified information-theoretic framework to analyze the generalization performance of differentially private (DP) quantum learning algorithms. By leveraging the connection between privacy and algorithmic stability, we establish that $(\varepsilon, δ)$-Quantum Differential Privacy (QDP) imposes a strong constraint on the mutual information between the training data and the algorithm's output. We derive a rigorous, mechanism-agnostic upper bound on this mutual information for learning algorithms satisfying a 1-neighbor privacy constraint. Furthermore, we connect this stability guarantee to generalization, proving that the expected generalization error of any $(\varepsilon, δ)$-QDP learning algorithm is bounded by the square root of the privacy-induced stability term. Finally, we extend our framework to the setting of an untrusted Data Processor, introducing the concept of Information-Theoretic Admissibility (ITA) to characterize the fundamental limits of privacy in scenarios where the learning map itself must remain oblivious to the specific dataset instance.
comment: 31 pages, 3 figures; Major revision including a new probabilistic bound on generalization error (Theorem 2) and a new complementary lower bound on the expected true loss (Theorem 3); Appendices have been expanded to include further proofs and details

title: Trees with maximum $σ$-irregularity under a prescribed maximum degree 6
authors: Milan Bašić
abstract: The sigma-irregularity index $σ(G) = \sum_{uv \in E(G)} (d_G(u) - d_G(v))^2$ measures the total degree imbalance along the edges of a graph. We study extremal problems for $σ(T)$ within the class of trees of fixed order $n$ and bounded maximum degree $Δ= 6$. Using a penalty-function framework combined with handshake identities and congruence arguments, we determine the exact maximum value of $σ(T)$ for every residue class of $n$ modulo $6$, showing that the possible minimum values of the penalty function are $0, 10, 20, 22, 30,$ and $40$. For each case, we provide a complete characterization of all maximizing trees in terms of degree counts and edge multiplicities. In five of the six residue classes, all extremal trees contain only vertices of degrees $1, 2,$ and $6$, while for $n \equiv 3 \pmod{6}$ an additional exceptional family arises involving vertices of degree $3$. These results extend earlier work on sigma-irregularity for smaller degree bounds and illustrate the rapidly growing combinatorial complexity of the problem as the maximum degree increases.

title: AI Meets Plasticity: A Comprehensive Survey
authors: Hadi Bakhshan, Sima Farshbaf, Junior Ramirez Machado, Fernando Rastellini Canela, Josep Maria Carbonell
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly emerging as a new paradigm of scientific discovery, namely data-driven science, across nearly all scientific disciplines. In materials science and engineering, AI has already begun to exert a transformative influence, making it both timely and necessary to examine its interaction with materials plasticity. In this study, we present a holistic survey of the convergence between AI and plasticity, highlighting state-of-the-art AI methodologies employed to discover, construct surrogate models for, and emulate the plastic behavior of materials. From a materials science perspective, we examine cause-and-effect relationships governing plastic deformation, including microstructural characterization and macroscopic responses described through plasticity constitutive models. From the perspective of AI methodology, we review a broad spectrum of applied approaches, ranging from frequentist techniques such as classical machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and physics-informed models to probabilistic frameworks that incorporate uncertainty quantification and generative AI methods. These data-driven approaches are discussed in the context of materials characterization and plasticity-related applications. The primary objective of this survey is to develop a comprehensive and well-organized taxonomy grounded in AI methodologies, with particular emphasis on distinguishing critical aspects of these techniques, including model architectures, data requirements, and predictive performance within the specific domain of materials plasticity. By doing so, this work aims to provide a clear road map for researchers and practitioners in the materials community, while offering deeper physical insight and intuition into the role of AI in advancing materials plasticity and characterization, an area of growing importance in the emerging AI-driven era.

title: The Domain of RSD Characterization by Efficiency, Symmetry, and Strategy-Proofness
authors: Maor Ben Zaquen, Ron Holzman
abstract:
Given a set of $n$ individuals with strict preferences over $m$ indivisible objects, the Random Serial Dictatorship (RSD) mechanism is a method for allocating objects to individuals in a way that is efficient, fair, and incentive-compatible. A random order of individuals is first drawn, and each individual, following this order, selects their most preferred available object. The procedure continues until either all objects have been assigned or all individuals have received an object.
  RSD is widely recognized for its application in fair allocation problems involving indivisible goods, such as school placements and housing assignments. Despite its extensive use, a comprehensive axiomatic characterization has remained incomplete. For the balanced case $n=m=3$, Bogomolnaia and Moulin have shown that RSD is uniquely characterized by Ex-Post Efficiency, Equal Treatment of Equals, and Strategy-Proofness. The possibility of extending this characterization to larger markets had been a long-standing open question, which Basteck and Ehlers recently answered in the negative for all markets with $n,m\geq5$.
  This work completes the picture by identifying exactly for which pairs $\left(n,m\right)$ these three axioms uniquely characterize the RSD mechanism and for which pairs they admit multiple mechanisms. In the latter cases, we construct explicit alternatives satisfying the axioms and examine whether augmenting the set of axioms could rule out these alternatives.

title: Global stabilization and finite element analysis of the viscous Burgers' equation with memory subject to Neumann boundary feedback control
authors: Shishu Pal Singh, Sudeep Kundu
abstract: This paper presents a global stabilization result of the viscous Burgers' equation with the memory term by applying Neumann boundary feedback control laws. We construct suitable feedback control inputs using the control Lyapunov functional and establish stabilization in the \(L^{2}, H^{1},\) and \(H^{2}\)-norms. The existence and uniqueness of the solution are established through the Faedo-Galerkin method. Moreover, we show the global stabilization where the diffusion coefficient $ν$ is unknown. Then, we apply a \(C^{0}\)-conforming finite element method to the spatial variable while keeping the time variable continuous. Furthermore, we obtain global stabilization of the semi-discrete scheme and optimal error estimates for the state variable in the \(L^{\infty}\), \(L^{2}\), and \(H^{1}\)-norms, using the Ritz-Volterra projection. Additionally, error estimates for the feedback control laws are established. Lastly, we present some numerical simulations to demonstrate the theoretical findings.

title: On Poly-Quadratic Stabilizability and Detectability of Polytopic LPV Systems
authors: T.J. Meijer, V.S. Dolk, W.P.M.H. Heemels
abstract: In this technical communique, we generalize the well-known Lyapunov-based stabilizability and detectability tests for discrete-time linear time-invariant systems to polytopic linear parameter-varying systems using the class of so-called poly-quadratic Lyapunov functions.
zh_title: 关于多二次稳定性和可检测性的多面体LPV系统
translation: 在这篇技术交流文章中，我们使用一类所谓的多二次李雅普诺夫函数，将离散时间线性时不变系统众所周知的基于李雅普诺夫的稳定性和可检测性测试推广到多面体线性参数变化系统。
keywords: 多二次李雅普诺夫函数
tldr: 本文使用多二次李雅普诺夫函数，将离散时间LTI系统的稳定性和可检测性测试推广到多面体LPV系统。
ai_comments: 本文的创新在于引入多二次李雅普诺夫函数来处理参数变化的系统（LPV系统）的稳定性和可检测性问题，这超越了传统的二次李雅普诺夫函数，为分析更复杂的系统提供了一种新的工具。其重要性在于将成熟的LTI系统分析方法推广到更具实际意义的LPV系统，有助于系统控制和状态估计的设计。
motivation: 推广离散时间线性时不变（LTI）系统已知的基于李雅普诺夫的稳定性和可检测性测试。
method: 使用多二次李雅普诺夫函数（poly-quadratic Lyapunov functions）将测试推广到多面体线性参数变化系统（polytopic LPV systems）。

title: Unified ROI-based Image Compression Paradigm with Generalized Gaussian Model
authors: Kai Hu, Junfu Tan, Fang Xu, Ramy Samy, Yu Liu
abstract: Region-of-Interest (ROI)-based image compression allocates bits unevenly according to the semantic importance of different regions. Such differentiated coding typically induces a sharp-peaked and heavy-tailed distribution. This distribution characteristic mathematically necessitates a probability model with adaptable shape parameters for accurate description. However, existing methods commonly use a Gaussian model to fit this distribution, resulting in a loss of coding performance. To systematically analyze the impact of this distribution on ROI coding, we develop a unified rate-distortion optimization theoretical paradigm. Building on this paradigm, we propose a novel Generalized Gaussian Model (GGM) to achieve flexible modeling of the latent variables distribution. To support stable optimization of GGM, we introduce effective differentiable functions and further propose a dynamic lower bound to alleviate train-test mismatch. Moreover, finite differences are introduced to solve the gradient computation after GGM fits the distribution. Experiments on COCO2017 demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art in both ROI reconstruction and downstream tasks (e.g., Segmentation, Object Detection). Furthermore, compared to classical probability models, our GGM provides a more precise fit to feature distributions and achieves superior coding performance. The project page is at https://github.com/hukai-tju/ROIGGM.

title: Towards knowledge-based workflows: a semantic approach to atomistic simulations for mechanical and thermodynamic properties
authors: Abril Azocar Guzman, Hoang-Thien Luu, Sarath Menon, Tilmann Hickel, Nina Merkert, Stefan Sandfeld
abstract: Mechanical and thermodynamic properties, including the influence of crystal defects, are critical for evaluating materials in engineering applications. Molecular dynamics simulations provide valuable insight into these mechanisms at the atomic scale. However, current practice often relies on fragmented scripts with inconsistent metadata and limited provenance, which hinders reproducibility, interoperability, and reuse. FAIR data principles and workflow-based approaches offer a path to address these limitations. We present reusable atomistic workflows that incorporate metadata annotation aligned with application ontologies, enabling automatic provenance capture and FAIR-compliant data outputs. The workflows cover key mechanical and thermodynamic quantities, including equation of state, elastic tensors, mechanical loading, thermal properties, defect formation energies, and nanoindentation. We demonstrate validation of structure-property relations such as the Hall-Petch effect and show that the workflows can be reused across different interatomic potentials and materials within a coherent semantic framework. The approach provides AI-ready simulation data, supports emerging agentic AI workflows, and establishes a generalizable blueprint for knowledge-based mechanical and thermodynamic simulations.
zh_title: 面向知识型工作流：用于机械和热力学性质的原子模拟的语义方法
translation: 机械和热力学性质，包括晶体缺陷的影响，对于评估工程应用中的材料至关重要。分子动力学模拟在原子尺度上为这些机制提供了有价值的见解。然而，当前的实践通常依赖于零散的脚本，这些脚本具有不一致的元数据和有限的溯源信息，从而阻碍了可重复性、互操作性和重用性。FAIR 数据原则和基于工作流的方法为解决这些限制提供了途径。我们提出了可重用的原子模拟工作流，这些工作流整合了与应用本体对齐的元数据注释，从而实现了自动溯源捕获和符合 FAIR 标准的数据输出。这些工作流涵盖了关键的机械和热力学量，包括状态方程、弹性张量、机械加载、热性质、缺陷形成能和纳米压痕。我们演示了结构-性质关系（如 Hall-Petch 效应）的验证，并表明这些工作流可以在连贯的语义框架内，跨越不同的原子间势和材料进行重用。该方法提供了可用于 AI 的模拟数据，支持新兴的代理式 AI 工作流，并为知识型机械和热力学模拟建立了可泛化的蓝图。
tldr: 我们创建了可重用、语义化且符合 FAIR 原则的原子模拟工作流（MD），用于计算关键材料性质（机械、热力学）。这解决了可重复性问题，自动捕获溯源信息，并生成了可用于 AI 的数据。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新在于将传统的原子模拟（MD）与现代数据科学原则（FAIR、本体论、语义框架）相结合。通过将模拟过程形式化为具有丰富元数据的结构化、可重用工作流，作者直接解决了计算材料科学中长期存在的重现性挑战。由此产生的“AI 就绪”数据使这项工作成为将模拟结果整合到更大的数据驱动材料发现和代理式 AI 系统中的关键推动步骤。这种从零散脚本到知识型工作流的转变是一项重大的方法论进步。
motivation: 机械和热力学性质对工程应用至关重要，分子动力学（MD）模拟提供了有价值的见解。然而，目前的实践依赖于零散的脚本、不一致的元数据和有限的溯源信息，严重阻碍了模拟结果的可重复性、互操作性和重用性。
method: 采用基于 FAIR 数据原则和工作流的方法。提出了可重用的原子模拟工作流，这些工作流整合了与应用本体对齐的元数据注释，从而实现自动溯源捕获和生成符合 FAIR 标准的数据输出。工作流涵盖了关键的机械和热力学模拟（包括状态方程、弹性张量、机械加载、热性质、缺陷形成能和纳米压痕）。
results: 验证了结构-性质关系（如 Hall-Petch 效应）。证明了工作流可以在连贯的语义框架内，跨越不同的原子间势和材料进行重用。
conclusion: 该方法提供了可用于 AI 的模拟数据，支持新兴的代理式 AI 工作流，并为知识型机械和热力学模拟建立了可泛化的蓝图。

title: Robust Sublinear Convergence Rates for Iterative Bregman Projections
authors: Gabriel Peyré
abstract: Entropic regularization provides a simple way to approximate linear programs whose constraints split into two (or more) tractable blocks. The resulting objectives are amenable to cyclic Kullback-Leibler (KL) Bregman projections, with the classical Sinkhorn algorithm for optimal transport (balanced, unbalanced, gradient flows, barycenters, \dots) as the canonical example. Assuming uniformly bounded primal mass and dual radius, we prove that the dual objective of these KL projections decreases at an $O(1/k)$ rate with a constant that scales only linearly in $1/γ$, where $γ$ is the entropic regularization parameter. This extends the guarantees known for entropic optimal transport to any such linearly constrained problem. Following the terminology introduced in [Chizat et al 2025], we call such rates "robust", because this mild dependence on $γ$ underpins favorable complexity bounds for approximating the unregularized problem via alternating KL projections. The crucial aspect of the analysis is that the dual radius should be measured according to a block-quotient dual seminorm, which depends on the structure of the split of the constraint into blocks. As an application, we derive the flow-Sinkhorn algorithm for the Wasserstein-1 distance on graphs. It achieves $ε$-additive accuracy on the transshipment cost in $O(p/ε^{4})$ arithmetic operations, where $p$ is the number of edges.
zh_title: 迭代Bregman投影的鲁棒次线性收敛速率
translation: 熵正则化提供了一种简单的方法来近似那些约束可以分成两个（或更多）可处理块的线性规划。由此产生的目标适用于循环Kullback-Leibler（KL）Bregman投影，其中用于最优传输（平衡、不平衡、梯度流、重心等）的经典Sinkhorn算法是典型示例。假设原始质量和对偶半径一致有界，我们证明这些KL投影的对偶目标以$O(1/k)$的速率下降，其常数仅与$1/γ$线性相关，其中$γ$是熵正则化参数。这将熵最优传输已知的保证扩展到任何此类线性约束问题。遵循[Chizat et al 2025]中引入的术语，我们将此类速率称为“鲁棒”，因为这种对$γ$的轻微依赖性支撑了通过交替KL投影近似非正则化问题的有利复杂性界限。分析的关键在于对偶半径应根据块商对偶半范数进行测量，这取决于约束分解为块的结构。作为一个应用，我们推导了图上Wasserstein-1距离的flow-Sinkhorn算法。它以$O(p/ε^{4})$的算术操作实现了转运成本的$ε$-加性精度，其中$p$是边的数量。
tldr: 该研究证明了带有熵正则化的线性规划的循环KL Bregman投影具有$O(1/k)$的鲁棒次线性收敛速率，并将其推广到任意线性约束问题，同时提出了Wasserstein-1距离的flow-Sinkhorn算法。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过证明熵正则化线性规划中循环KL Bregman投影的鲁棒次线性收敛速率，在优化领域做出了重要贡献。其创新之处在于将对偶半径的测量与块商对偶半范数结合，并成功将现有保证推广到更广泛的问题。这种对正则化参数$γ$的轻微依赖性对于实际应用中近似非正则化问题具有重要意义。提出的flow-Sinkhorn算法也展示了理论成果的实用性。
motivation: 熵正则化为近似线性规划提供了一种简单的方法，特别是当其约束可以分解为可处理的块时。理解这些迭代算法的收敛速率对于有效近似非正则化问题至关重要。
method: 该研究利用循环Kullback-Leibler (KL) Bregman投影，并假设原始质量和对偶半径有界。分析的关键在于对偶半径应根据块商对偶半范数进行测量。作为应用，推导了用于图上Wasserstein-1距离的flow-Sinkhorn算法。
results: 证明了这些KL投影的对偶目标以$O(1/k)$的速率下降，常数仅与$1/γ$线性相关，其中$γ$是熵正则化参数。这种收敛速率被称为“鲁棒”。Flow-Sinkhorn算法在图上的Wasserstein-1距离中，以$O(p/ε^{4})$的算术操作实现了转运成本的$ε$-加性精度。
conclusion: 该研究将熵最优传输已知的收敛保证推广到任何此类线性约束问题，并表明这种对$γ$的轻微依赖性为通过交替KL投影近似非正则化问题提供了有利的复杂性界限。

title: Superstable Geometry in Triadic Percolation
authors: Fatemeh Aghaei, Abbas Ali Saberi, Holger Kantz, Juergen Kurths
abstract: Triadic percolation turns bond percolation into a dynamical problem governed by an effective one-dimensional unimodal map. We show that the geometry of superstable cycles provides a direct, map-agnostic probe of local nonlinearity: specifically, the distance from the map's maximum to a distinguished next-to-maximum point on the attracting $2^n$-cycle (which coincides with a preimage of the maximum at $2^n$-superstability) scales as $|Δp|^γ$ with $γ= 1/z$, where $z$ is the nonflat order of the maximum. This prediction is verified across canonical unimodal families and heterogeneous triadic ensembles, with Lyapunov spectra corroborating the one-dimensional reduction. A derivative condition on the activation kernel fixes the local nonlinearity order $z$ (and thus, under standard unimodal-map hypotheses, the associated $z$-logistic universality class) and gives conditions under which $z>2$ can be realized. The diagnostic operates directly on orbit data under standard regularity assumptions, providing a practical tool to classify universality in higher-order networks.
zh_title: 三元渗流中的超稳定几何
translation: 三元渗流将键渗流转化为一个由有效一维单峰映射控制的动力学问题。我们证明了超稳定循环的几何特性提供了一种直接的、与映射无关的局部非线性探针：具体来说，吸引$2^n$周期循环上（这与$2^n$超稳定性下最大值的一个原像重合）从映射最大值到一个显著的次最大值点的距离以$|\Delta p|^\gamma$标度，其中$\gamma= 1/z$，$z$是最大值的非平坦阶数。这一预测在规范单峰族和异构三元集合中得到了验证，Lyapunov谱佐证了其一维简化。激活核上的导数条件确定了局部非线性阶数$z$（因此，在标准单峰映射假设下，确定了相关的$z$-logistic普适性类别），并给出了实现$z>2$的条件。该诊断方法在标准正则性假设下直接对轨道数据进行操作，为分类高阶网络中的普适性提供了一个实用工具。
tldr: 该研究表明，三元渗流可通过一维单峰映射描述。利用超稳定循环的几何特性，可以独立于映射本身地探测局部非线性（$z$），其特征是标度律$\gamma=1/z$。这提供了一种分类高阶网络普适性的实用工具。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提供了一种将渗流理论与动力学系统联系起来的通用诊断方法。通过证明超稳定循环的几何特性（标度律$\gamma=1/z$）可以直接且独立于映射本身地揭示局部非线性阶数$z$，该研究为分类高阶网络中的普适性类别提供了一个实用且强大的工具。这扩展了单峰映射（如logistic映射族）的普适性概念在复杂网络领域的应用。
motivation: 将键渗流转化为由有效一维单峰映射控制的动力学问题——三元渗流。研究的动机是提供一种独立于映射本身的、直接的探针，以揭示局部非线性特性。
method: 研究三元渗流所对应的有效一维单峰映射的超稳定循环的几何特性。具体方法是测量吸引$2^n$周期循环上，从映射最大值到特定次最大值点的距离的标度行为，该距离以$|\Delta p|^\gamma$标度，其中$\gamma = 1/z$（$z$为最大值的非平坦阶数）。通过规范单峰族和异构三元集合进行验证，并使用Lyapunov谱和激活核的导数条件进行佐证。
results: 超稳定循环的几何特性提供了一种直接的、与映射无关的局部非线性探针。该距离的标度律为$|\Delta p|^\gamma$，其中$\gamma = 1/z$（$z$为最大值的非平坦阶数）。该预测在不同集合中得到了证实。激活核上的导数条件确定了局部非线性阶数$z$，从而确定了相关的$z$-logistic普适性类别，并给出了实现$z>2$的条件。
conclusion: 基于轨道数据且在标准正则性假设下运行的诊断方法，是一种通过确定局部非线性阶数$z$来分类高阶网络中普适性的实用工具。

title: Vulnerability-Amplifying Interaction Loops: a systematic failure mode in AI chatbot mental-health interactions
authors: Veith Weilnhammer, Kevin YC Hou, Raymond Dolan, Matthew M Nour
abstract: Millions of users turn to consumer AI chatbots to discuss behavioral and mental health concerns. While this presents unprecedented opportunities to deliver population-level support, it also highlights an urgent need to develop rigorous and scalable safety evaluations. Here we introduce SIM-VAIL, an AI chatbot auditing framework that captures how harmful AI chatbot responses manifest across a range of mental-health contexts. SIM-VAIL pairs a simulated human user, harboring a distinct psychiatric vulnerability and conversational intent, with an audited frontier AI chatbot. It scores conversation turns on 13 clinically relevant risk dimensions, enabling context-dependent, temporally resolved assessment of mental-health risk. Across 810 conversations, encompassing over 90,000 turn-level ratings and 30 psychiatric user profiles, we find that significant risk occurs across virtually all user phenotypes. Risk manifested across most of the 9 consumer AI chatbot models audited, albeit mitigated in more modern variants. Rather than arising abruptly, risk accumulated over multiple turns. Risk profiles were phenotype-dependent, indicating that behaviors that appear supportive in general settings are liable to be maladaptive when they align with mechanisms that sustain a user's vulnerability. Multivariate risk patterns revealed trade-offs across dimensions, suggesting that mitigation targeting one harm domain can exacerbate others. These findings identify a novel failure mode in human-AI interactions, which we term Vulnerability-Amplifying Interaction Loops (VAILs), and underscore the need for multi-dimensional approaches to risk quantification. SIM-VAIL provides a scalable evaluation framework for quantifying how mental-health risk is distributed across user phenotypes, conversational trajectories, and clinically grounded behavioral dimensions, offering a foundation for targeted safety improvements.
zh_title: 易感性增强交互循环：AI聊天机器人心理健康交互中的系统性故障模式
translation: 数百万用户求助于消费级AI聊天机器人来讨论行为和心理健康问题。虽然这为提供群体级支持带来了前所未有的机遇，但也凸显了开发严格且可扩展的安全评估方法的迫切需求。本文介绍了SIM-VAIL，这是一个AI聊天机器人审计框架，它捕获了有害的AI聊天机器人响应如何在各种心理健康背景下表现出来。SIM-VAIL将具有独特精神病学易感性和对话意图的模拟人类用户与被审计的前沿AI聊天机器人配对。它根据13个临床相关的风险维度对对话回合进行评分，从而实现上下文依赖、时间解析的心理健康风险评估。在涵盖超过90,000个回合级评分和30个精神病理用户档案的810个对话中，我们发现几乎所有用户表型都存在显著风险。风险体现在大多数被审计的9个消费级AI聊天机器人模型中，尽管在更现代的版本中有所缓解。风险并非突然产生，而是经过多轮累积。风险模式取决于表型，表明在一般设置中看似支持的行为，如果与维持用户易感性的机制相一致，则很可能会产生适应不良。多变量风险模式揭示了维度间的权衡，表明针对某一伤害领域的缓解措施可能会加剧其他伤害。这些发现识别出一种新颖的人机交互故障模式，我们称之为易感性增强交互循环（VAILs），并强调了对风险量化采取多维度方法的必要性。SIM-VAIL提供了一个可扩展的评估框架，用于量化心理健康风险在用户表型、对话轨迹和临床行为维度上的分布，为有针对性的安全改进提供了基础。
tldr: 针对数百万用户用于心理健康的AI聊天机器人，本文提出了SIM-VAIL框架来系统性评估风险。研究发现，风险并非突然出现，而是通过多轮交互累积，形成了“易感性增强交互循环”（VAILs），并且风险模式具有用户表型依赖性，突出需要多维度风险量化方法。
ai_comments: 这项工作非常重要，因为它解决了AI在敏感领域（如心理健康）的系统性安全问题。其创新点在于引入了“易感性增强交互循环”（VAILs）这一新颖的故障模式概念，并提出了SIM-VAIL这一结合了临床相关风险维度和用户表型模拟的审计框架。研究结果揭示了风险累积的渐进性以及支持性行为可能带来的潜在适应不良后果，这对于指导未来AI模型的安全设计和缓解策略具有关键意义，尤其是在需要精细化、上下文敏感的风险管理方面。
motivation: 鉴于数百万用户使用消费级AI聊天机器人讨论行为和心理健康问题，这既提供了支持机会，也凸显了开发严格且可扩展的安全评估方法的迫切需求。
method: 引入了SIM-VAIL审计框架。该框架将具有特定精神病理易感性和对话意图的模拟人类用户与被审计的前沿AI聊天机器人配对。它根据13个临床相关的风险维度对对话回合进行评分，从而实现上下文依赖和时间解析的心理健康风险评估。
results: 在涵盖30个精神病理用户档案的810个对话中，几乎所有用户表型都存在显著风险，并且在大多数被审计的9个消费级AI聊天机器人模型中均有体现。风险是经过多轮交互累积而非突然产生。风险模式取决于用户表型，表明在一般设置中看似支持的行为在与用户易感性机制对齐时可能会产生适应不良。多变量风险模式揭示了维度间的权衡，即针对某一伤害领域的缓解措施可能加剧其他伤害。
conclusion: 这些发现识别出一种新颖的人机交互故障模式，即易感性增强交互循环（VAILs），并强调了对风险量化采取多维度方法的必要性。SIM-VAIL提供了一个可扩展的评估框架，可用于量化心理健康风险在用户表型、对话轨迹和临床行为维度上的分布，为有针对性的安全改进奠定基础。

title: SSNAPS: Audio-Visual Separation of Speech and Background Noise with Diffusion Inverse Sampling
authors: Yochai Yemini, Yoav Ellinson, Rami Ben-Ari, Sharon Gannot, Ethan Fetaya
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of audio-visual single-microphone speech separation and enhancement in the presence of real-world environmental noise. Our approach is based on generative inverse sampling, where we model clean speech and ambient noise with dedicated diffusion priors and jointly leverage them to recover all underlying sources. To achieve this, we reformulate a recent inverse sampler to match our setting. We evaluate on mixtures of 1, 2, and 3 speakers with noise and show that, despite being entirely unsupervised, our method consistently outperforms leading supervised baselines in \ac{WER} across all conditions. We further extend our framework to handle off-screen speaker separation. Moreover, the high fidelity of the separated noise component makes it suitable for downstream acoustic scene detection. Demo page: https://ssnapsicml.github.io/ssnapsicml2026/
zh_title: SSNAPS：基于扩散逆采样的音视频语音与背景噪声分离
translation: 本文解决了在存在真实世界环境噪声的情况下，音视频单麦克风语音分离和增强的挑战。我们的方法基于生成式逆采样，我们使用专用的扩散先验对纯净语音和环境噪声进行建模，并联合利用它们来恢复所有潜在声源。为此，我们重新构建了一种最近的逆采样器以匹配我们的设置。我们在混合了1、2和3个说话人及噪声的条件下进行了评估，结果表明，尽管我们的方法是完全无监督的，但它在所有条件下的词错误率（WER）上持续优于领先的监督基线。我们进一步将我们的框架扩展到处理屏幕外说话人分离。此外，分离出的噪声成分具有高保真度，使其适用于下游声学场景检测。
tldr: SSNAPS是一种无监督的音视频语音分离方法，利用扩散逆采样和专门的先验模型来分离语音和噪声。它在各种条件下（包括多说话人）的词错误率（WER）上持续优于领先的监督基线，并且还适用于屏幕外说话人分离和声学场景检测。
ai_comments: 论文的主要创新在于将生成式逆采样与专用于语音和环境噪声的扩散先验结合起来，实现音视频源分离。其重要性在于证明了该方法在完全无监督的情况下，能够在词错误率（WER）上持续超越主流的监督学习基线，这对于减少对大量标记数据的依赖具有重要意义。此外，该框架处理多说话人、屏幕外分离和声学场景检测的扩展性也极大地提升了其实用价值。
motivation: 解决在存在真实世界环境噪声的情况下，音视频单麦克风语音分离和增强的挑战。
method: 该方法基于生成式逆采样（generative inverse sampling），使用专用的扩散先验（diffusion priors）对纯净语音和环境噪声进行建模，并联合利用它们来恢复所有潜在声源。为此，作者重新构建了一种最近的逆采样器以适应其设置。该方法是完全无监督的。
results: 在混合了1、2和3个说话人及噪声的所有条件下，该方法在词错误率（WER）上持续优于领先的监督基线。该框架被进一步扩展以处理屏幕外说话人分离。此外，分离出的噪声成分具有高保真度，使其适用于下游声学场景检测。
conclusion: SSNAPS作为一种基于扩散逆采样的无监督音视频语音分离方法，在真实环境噪声中展现出卓越的性能，并在词错误率方面超越了主流的监督基线。其分离出的噪声成分也具有实用的高保真度。

title: Approximating Univariate Factored Distributions via Message-Passing Algorithms
authors: Zilu Zhao, Dirk Slock
abstract: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) commonly arise in communication systems, particularly in bilinear joint estimation and detection problems. Although the product of GMMs is still a GMM, as the number of factors increases, the number of components in the resulting product GMM grows exponentially. To obtain a tractable approximation for a univariate factored probability density function (PDF), such as a product of GMMs, we investigate iterative message-passing algorithms. Based on Belief Propagation (BP), we propose a Variable Duplication and Gaussian Belief Propagation (VDBP)-based algorithm. The key idea of VDBP is to construct a multivariate measurement model whose marginal posterior is equal to the given univariate factored PDF. We then apply Gaussian BP (GaBP) to transform the global inference problem into local ones. Expectation propagation (EP) is another branch of message passing algorithms. In addition to converting the global approximation problem into local ones, it features a projection operation that ensures the intermediate functions (messages) belong to a desired family. Due to this projection, EP can be used to approximate the factored PDF directly. However, even if every factor is integrable, the division operation in EP may still cause the algorithm to fail when the mean and variance of a non-integrable belief are required. Therefore, this paper proposes two methods that combine EP with our previously proposed techniques for handling non-integrable beliefs to approximate univariate factored distributions.
zh_title: 通过消息传递算法近似单变量因子分解分布
translation: 高斯混合模型（GMMs）常见于通信系统，尤其是在双线性联合估计和检测问题中。尽管GMMs的乘积仍然是GMM，但随着因子数量的增加，所得乘积GMM中的组件数量呈指数级增长。为了获得单变量因子分解概率密度函数（PDF）（例如GMMs的乘积）的可处理近似，我们研究了迭代消息传递算法。基于信念传播（BP），我们提出了一种基于变量复制和高斯信念传播（VDBP）的算法。VDBP的关键思想是构建一个多元测量模型，其边际后验等于给定的单变量因子分解PDF。然后我们应用高斯BP（GaBP）将全局推理问题转化为局部问题。期望传播（EP）是消息传递算法的另一个分支。除了将全局近似问题转化为局部问题外，它还具有确保中间函数（消息）属于所需族的投影操作。由于这种投影，EP可用于直接近似因子分解PDF。然而，即使每个因子都可积分，当需要不可积分信念的均值和方差时，EP中的除法操作仍可能导致算法失败。因此，本文提出了两种方法，将EP与我们先前提出的处理不可积分信念的技术相结合，以近似单变量因子分解分布。
keywords: 变量复制和高斯信念传播
tldr: 针对高斯混合模型（GMMs）乘积的指数级增长问题，本文提出了两种消息传递算法（基于VDBP和改进的EP）来近似单变量因子分解概率密度函数。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了两种不同的消息传递框架（VDBP和改进的EP）来解决高斯混合模型乘积的计算复杂度爆炸问题。VDBP通过巧妙地将单变量问题嵌入到多元高斯推理框架中，利用了GaBP的效率。对EP的改进则直接解决了其在处理不可积分信念时的鲁棒性缺陷。这对于需要实时处理复杂概率分布（如通信系统中的联合估计）的工程应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 高斯混合模型（GMMs）的乘积（常见于通信系统中的联合估计和检测问题）的组件数量会随因子数量的增加呈指数级增长，因此需要一种可处理的方法来近似单变量因子分解概率密度函数（PDF）。
method:
提出了两种消息传递算法：
1. **变量复制和高斯信念传播（VDBP）算法：** 基于信念传播（BP），构建一个多元测量模型，使其边际后验等于目标单变量因子分解PDF，然后应用高斯BP（GaBP）将全局推理转化为局部推理。
2. **改进的期望传播（EP）算法：** 将EP与作者先前提出的处理不可积分信念的技术相结合，以克服标准EP在进行除法操作时可能因不可积分信念的均值和方差计算导致的失败问题。
results: 提出了基于VDBP和改进EP的两种迭代消息传递算法，用于近似单变量因子分解分布。具体的性能指标未在摘要中提及。
conclusion: 本文提出了两种结合了消息传递原理（VDBP和改进的EP）的方法来近似单变量因子分解概率密度函数，旨在解决GMMs乘积的复杂性问题。

title: Online Social Welfare Function-based Resource Allocation
authors: Kanad Pardeshi, Samsara Foubert, Aarti Singh
abstract: In many real-world settings, a centralized decision-maker must repeatedly allocate finite resources to a population over multiple time steps. Individuals who receive a resource derive some stochastic utility; to characterize the population-level effects of an allocation, the expected individual utilities are then aggregated using a social welfare function (SWF). We formalize this setting and present a general confidence sequence framework for SWF-based online learning and inference, valid for any monotonic, concave, and Lipschitz-continuous SWF. Our key insight is that monotonicity alone suffices to lift confidence sequences from individual utilities to anytime-valid bounds on optimal welfare. Building on this foundation, we propose SWF-UCB, a SWF-agnostic online learning algorithm that achieves near-optimal $\tilde{O}(n+\sqrt{nkT})$ regret (for $k$ resources distributed among $n$ individuals at each of $T$ time steps). We instantiate our framework on three normatively distinct SWF families: Weighted Power Mean, Kolm, and Gini, providing bespoke oracle algorithms for each. Experiments confirm $\sqrt{T}$ scaling and reveal rich interactions between $k$ and SWF parameters. This framework naturally supports inference applications such as sequential hypothesis testing, optimal stopping, and policy evaluation.
zh_title: 基于在线社会福利函数的资源分配
translation: 在许多现实世界的环境中，一个集中的决策者必须在多个时间步内反复向人群分配有限资源。获得资源的个体获得一些随机效用；为了表征分配对人群层面的影响，使用社会福利函数（SWF）聚合预期的个体效用。我们形式化了这种设置，并提出了一个通用的基于置信序列的框架，用于基于SWF的在线学习和推理，该框架适用于任何单调、凹且利普希茨连续的SWF。我们的关键见解是，仅单调性就足以将置信序列从个体效用提升到最优福利的随时有效界限。在此基础上，我们提出了SWF-UCB，这是一种与SWF无关的在线学习算法，实现了近乎最优的$\tilde{O}(n+\sqrt{nkT})$遗憾（其中$k$个资源在$T$个时间步中的每一步分配给$n$个个体）。我们针对三种规范上不同的SWF家族实例化了该框架：加权幂平均（Weighted Power Mean）、科尔姆（Kolm）和基尼（Gini），并为每个家族提供了定制的预言机算法。实验证实了$\sqrt{T}$的缩放特性，并揭示了$k$与SWF参数之间丰富的相互作用。该框架自然支持序列假设检验、最优停止和策略评估等推理应用。
tldr: 提出了一种通用的置信序列框架和近乎最优的SWF-UCB算法，用于在线资源分配，该算法适用于任何单调、凹且利普希茨连续的社会福利函数。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于弥合了标准在线学习技术（通常侧重于最大化简单总和或平均值）与由社会福利函数（SWF）定义的复杂规范目标之间的差距。关键的技术洞察是：仅单调性就足以将置信序列提升到最优福利界限，这使得可以创建一个单一的、与SWF无关的算法（SWF-UCB），同时仍能保证在各种福利定义（从功利主义到高度平均主义的科尔姆或基尼）下实现近乎最优的遗憾。这极大地扩展了在线学习在公平和资源分配等领域的适用性。
motivation: 集中式决策者需要在多个时间步内反复向人群分配有限资源，并使用社会福利函数（SWF）聚合预期的个体效用，以表征和优化群体层面的分配效果。
method: 提出了一种通用的置信序列框架，适用于任何单调、凹且利普希茨连续的社会福利函数。核心方法是利用单调性将个体效用上的置信序列提升到最优福利的随时有效界限。在此基础上，提出了与SWF无关的在线学习算法SWF-UCB，并针对加权幂平均（Weighted Power Mean）、科尔姆（Kolm）和基尼（Gini）等SWF族提供了定制的预言机算法。
results: SWF-UCB算法实现了近乎最优的$\tilde{O}(n+\sqrt{nkT})$遗憾（其中$k$是资源数，$n$是人数，$T$是时间步）。实验证实了$\sqrt{T}$的缩放特性，并揭示了资源数$k$与SWF参数之间丰富的相互作用。该框架还支持序列假设检验、最优停止和策略评估等推理应用。
conclusion: 提出了一种通用的、基于置信序列的框架和SWF-UCB算法，用于在线社会福利函数驱动的资源分配，该框架在保持近乎最优遗憾的同时，适用于多种规范不同的SWF，并支持多种推理应用。

title: Regret of $H_\infty$ Preview Controllers
authors: Jietian Liu, Peter Seiler
abstract: This paper studies preview control in both the $H_\infty$ and regret-optimal settings. The plant is modeled as a discrete-time, linear time-invariant system subject to external disturbances. The performance baseline is the optimal non-causal controller that has full knowledge of the disturbance sequence. We first review the construction of the $H_\infty$ preview controller with $p$-steps of disturbance preview. We then show that the closed-loop $H_\infty$ performance of this preview controller converges as $p\to \infty$ to the performance of the optimal non-causal controller. Furthermore, we prove that the optimal regret of the preview controller converges to zero. These results demonstrate that increasing preview length allows controllers to asymptotically achieve non-causal performance in both the $H_\infty$ and regret frameworks. A numerical example illustrates the theoretical results.
translation: 本文研究了$H_\infty$和遗憾最优设置下的预见控制。该被控对象被建模为受外部干扰的离散时间线性时不变系统。性能基线是具有干扰序列完整知识的最优非因果控制器。我们首先回顾了具有$p$步干扰预见的$H_\infty$预见控制器的构造。然后，我们证明了当$p\to \infty$时，该预见控制器的闭环$H_\infty$性能收敛到最优非因果控制器的性能。此外，我们证明了预见控制器的最优遗憾值收敛到零。这些结果表明，增加预见长度允许控制器在$H_\infty$和遗憾框架下渐近地实现非因果性能。一个数值示例说明了这些理论结果。
tldr: 本文研究了离散LTI系统中的$H_\infty$预见控制。结果表明，随着预见长度的增加，$H_\infty$性能和最优遗憾值都渐近收敛到最优非因果控制器的性能，遗憾值趋于零。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将$H_\infty$控制与遗憾最优框架相结合来分析预见控制的性能极限。证明了预见长度是弥补因果控制器与最优非因果控制器之间性能差距的关键因素。这一结果对于实时控制系统设计具有重要意义，它量化了提前获取未来信息（预见）带来的性能提升，并提供了实现渐近最优性能的理论保证。
motivation: 研究$H_\infty$和遗憾最优设置下的预见控制，并以具有完整干扰序列知识的最优非因果控制器作为性能基线，探讨预见长度对控制器性能的影响。
method: 1. 将系统建模为受外部干扰的离散时间线性时不变（LTI）系统。2. 回顾具有$p$步干扰预见的$H_\infty$预见控制器的构造。3. 理论证明闭环$H_\infty$性能和最优遗憾值的收敛性。4. 使用数值示例验证理论结果。
results: 1. 随着预见长度$p \to \infty$，闭环$H_\infty$性能收敛到最优非因果控制器的性能。2. 预见控制器的最优遗憾值收敛到零。
conclusion: 增加预见长度允许控制器在$H_\infty$和遗憾框架下渐近地达到非因果性能。

title: Importance Weighted Variational Inference without the Reparameterization Trick
authors: Kamélia Daudel, Minh-Ngoc Tran, Cheng Zhang
abstract: Importance weighted variational inference (VI) approximates densities known up to a normalizing constant by optimizing bounds that tighten with the number of Monte Carlo samples $N$. Standard optimization relies on reparameterized gradient estimators, which are well-studied theoretically yet restrict both the choice of the data-generating process and the variational approximation. While REINFORCE gradient estimators do not suffer from such restrictions, they lack rigorous theoretical justification. In this paper, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of REINFORCE gradient estimators in importance weighted VI, leveraging this theoretical foundation to diagnose and resolve fundamental deficiencies in current state-of-the-art estimators. Specifically, we introduce and examine a generalized family of variational inference for Monte Carlo objectives (VIMCO) gradient estimators. We prove that state-of-the-art VIMCO gradient estimators exhibit a vanishing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) as $N$ increases, which prevents effective optimization. To overcome this issue, we propose the novel VIMCO-$\star$ gradient estimator and show that it averts the SNR collapse of existing VIMCO gradient estimators by achieving a $\sqrt{N}$ SNR scaling instead. We demonstrate its superior empirical performance compared to current VIMCO implementations in challenging settings where reparameterized gradients are typically unavailable.
zh_title: 无重参数化技巧的重要性加权变分推断
translation: 重要性加权变分推断（VI）通过优化随着蒙特卡洛样本数 $N$ 增加而收紧的界限，来近似已知其归一化常数的密度。标准优化依赖于重参数化梯度估计器，这些估计器在理论上得到了充分研究，但限制了数据生成过程和变分近似的选择。虽然REINFORCE梯度估计器不受此类限制，但它们缺乏严格的理论依据。在本文中，我们首次对重要性加权变分推断中的REINFORCE梯度估计器进行了全面的分析，并利用这一理论基础来诊断和解决当前最先进估计器中的根本缺陷。具体而言，我们引入并检验了广义的变分推断蒙特卡洛目标（VIMCO）梯度估计器族。我们证明了最先进的VIMCO梯度估计器随着 $N$ 的增加，其信噪比（SNR）会消失，从而阻碍了有效优化。为了克服这个问题，我们提出了新颖的VIMCO-$\star$梯度估计器，并表明它通过实现 $\sqrt{N}$ 的SNR缩放，避免了现有VIMCO梯度估计器的SNR崩溃。我们证明了在重参数化梯度通常不可用的挑战性设置中，其经验性能优于当前的VIMCO实现。
tldr: 本文对重要性加权变分推断中的REINFORCE梯度估计器进行了首次综合理论分析，发现现有VIMCO估计器存在信噪比（SNR）崩溃问题。我们提出了VIMCO-$\star$估计器，证明其实现了$\sqrt{N}$的SNR缩放，并在经验上表现出优越性。
ai_comments: 本文的重要性在于它弥补了重要性加权变分推断（IWVI）领域的一个关键理论空白。通过提供对REINFORCE/VIMCO梯度估计器的首次严格理论分析，它不仅解释了现有方法（如VIMCO）为何在样本数增加时优化困难（即SNR崩溃），还提出了一个具有理论保证的改进方案（VIMCO-$\star$）。VIMCO-$\star$实现$\sqrt{N}$的SNR缩放这一理论结果，直接解决了非重参数化方法中梯度估计质量随样本增加而下降的根本性限制，极大地扩展了VI可应用的概率模型范围，特别是对于那些无法使用重参数化技巧的模型。
motivation: 标准的重要性加权变分推断（IWVI）优化依赖于重参数化梯度估计器，但这限制了数据生成过程和变分近似的选择。虽然REINFORCE估计器没有这些限制，但缺乏严格的理论基础。本文旨在为IWVI中的REINFORCE估计器提供理论基础，并解决现有最先进估计器中的根本缺陷。
method: 提供了重要性加权变分推断中REINFORCE梯度估计器的首次综合理论分析。引入并检验了广义的变分推断蒙特卡洛目标（VIMCO）梯度估计器族。基于理论分析，提出了新颖的VIMCO-$\star$梯度估计器。
results: 证明了现有最先进的VIMCO梯度估计器在样本数$N$增加时信噪比（SNR）会消失，从而阻碍了有效优化。提出的VIMCO-$\star$估计器避免了SNR崩溃，实现了$\sqrt{N}$的SNR缩放。在重参数化梯度通常不可用的挑战性设置中，VIMCO-$\star$的经验性能优于当前的VIMCO实现。
conclusion: VIMCO-$\star$梯度估计器通过避免现有VIMCO估计器的信噪比崩溃问题（实现了$\sqrt{N}$的SNR缩放），解决了重要性加权变分推断中无重参数化技巧时的优化难题，并在实际应用中展现出卓越的性能。

title: Free-space and Satellite-Based Quantum Communication: Principles, Implementations, and Challenges
authors: Georgi Gary Rozenman, Alona Maslennikov, Sara P. Gandelman, Yuval Reches, Sahar Delfan, Neel Kanth Kundu, Leyi Zhang, Ruiqi Liu
abstract: Satellite-based quantum communications represent a critical advancement in the pursuit of secure, global-scale quantum networks. Leveraging the principles of quantum mechanics, these systems offer unparalleled security through Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and other quantum communication protocols. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of satellite-based quantum communications, focusing on the evolution from terrestrial to space-based systems. We explore the distinct advantages and challenges of discrete-variable (DV) and continuous-variable (CV) quantum communication technologies in the context of satellite deployments. The paper also discusses key milestones such as the successful implementation of quantum communication via the Micius satellite and outlines the primary challenges, including atmospheric turbulence and the development of quantum repeaters, that must be addressed to achieve a global quantum internet. This review aims to consolidate recent advancements in the field, providing insights and perspectives on the future directions and potential innovations that will drive the continued evolution of satellite-based quantum communications.
zh_title: 自由空间和基于卫星的量子通信：原理、实现和挑战
translation: 基于卫星的量子通信代表着在追求安全、全球规模量子网络方面的一个关键进展。这些系统利用量子力学原理，通过量子密钥分发（QKD）和其他量子通信协议提供无与伦比的安全性。本综述全面概述了基于卫星的量子通信的当前状态，重点关注从地面系统到天基系统的演变。我们探讨了离散变量（DV）和连续变量（CV）量子通信技术在卫星部署背景下的独特优势和挑战。本文还讨论了关键里程碑，例如通过“墨子号”卫星成功实现量子通信，并概述了实现全球量子互联网必须解决的主要挑战，包括大气湍流和量子中继器的开发。本综述旨在整合该领域的最新进展，为推动卫星量子通信的持续发展提供见解和展望。
tldr: 本文综述了卫星量子通信的现状，包括其原理、DV/CV技术、关键挑战（如大气湍流和量子中继器）以及实现全球量子互联网的未来方向。
ai_comments: 这篇综述的重要性在于它系统地梳理了卫星量子通信这一前沿领域的技术现状和挑战。它不仅强调了QKD带来的安全优势，还区分了DV和CV两种主要技术路径，并明确指出了当前实现全球量子互联网的关键技术瓶颈（如量子中继器）。对于规划未来研究方向和投资路线图具有重要的参考价值。
motivation: 追求安全、全球规模的量子网络，并提供对卫星量子通信现状的全面综述，突出其优势和挑战。
method: 综述（回顾和整合当前领域进展）。
results: 探讨了从地面系统到天基系统的演变，分析了DV和CV量子通信技术的独特优势和挑战，并讨论了墨子号卫星等关键里程碑。
conclusion: 旨在整合该领域的最新进展，为推动卫星量子通信的持续发展提供见解和展望。

title: WAKESET: A Large-Scale, High-Reynolds Number Flow Dataset for Machine Learning of Turbulent Wake Dynamics
authors: Zachary Cooper-Baldock, Paulo E. Santos, Russell S.A. Brinkworth, Karl Sammut
abstract: Machine learning (ML) offers transformative potential for computational fluid dynamics (CFD), promising to accelerate simulations, improve turbulence modelling, and enable real-time flow prediction and control-capabilities that could fundamentally change how engineers approach fluid dynamics problems. However, the exploration of ML in fluid dynamics is critically hampered by the scarcity of large, diverse, and high-fidelity datasets suitable for training robust models. This limitation is particularly acute for highly turbulent flows, which dominate practical engineering applications yet remain computationally prohibitive to simulate at scale. High-Reynolds number turbulent datasets are essential for ML models to learn the complex, multi-scale physics characteristic of real-world flows, enabling generalisation beyond the simplified, low-Reynolds number regimes often represented in existing datasets. This paper introduces WAKESET, a novel, large-scale CFD dataset of highly turbulent flows, designed to address this critical gap. The dataset captures the complex hydrodynamic interactions during the underwater recovery of an autonomous underwater vehicle by a larger extra-large uncrewed underwater vehicle. It comprises 1,091 high-fidelity Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes simulations, augmented to 4,364 instances, covering a wide operational envelope of speeds (up to Reynolds numbers of 1.09 x 10^8) and turning angles. This work details the motivation for this new dataset by reviewing existing resources, outlines the hydrodynamic modelling and validation underpinning its creation, and describes its structure. The dataset's focus on a practical engineering problem, its scale, and its high turbulence characteristics make it a valuable resource for developing and benchmarking ML models for flow field prediction, surrogate modelling, and autonomous navigation in complex underwater environments.
zh_title: WAKESET：一个用于湍流尾流动力学机器学习的大规模、高雷诺数流场数据集
translation: 机器学习（ML）为计算流体力学（CFD）提供了变革性的潜力，有望加速模拟、改进湍流建模并实现实时流场预测和控制——这些能力可以从根本上改变工程师处理流体力学问题的方式。然而，流体力学中ML的探索受到缺乏适用于训练鲁棒模型的大规模、多样化和高保真度数据集的严重阻碍。对于主导实际工程应用但计算上难以大规模模拟的高度湍流流场而言，这种局限性尤为突出。高雷诺数湍流数据集对于ML模型学习真实世界流场中复杂的多尺度物理特性至关重要，从而能够泛化到现有数据集中通常代表的简化低雷诺数状态之外。本文介绍了WAKESET，这是一个新颖的、大规模的CFD高度湍流流场数据集，旨在解决这一关键空白。该数据集捕获了自主水下航行器被更大的超大型无人水下航行器水下回收过程中的复杂水动力相互作用。它包含1,091次高保真度的雷诺平均纳维-斯托克斯模拟，并增强至4,364个实例，涵盖了广泛的速度（雷诺数高达$1.09 \times 10^8$）和转弯角操作范围。本文通过回顾现有资源，详细阐述了创建该数据集的动机，概述了支撑其创建的水动力建模和验证，并描述了其结构。该数据集对实际工程问题的关注、其规模和高湍流特性，使其成为开发和基准测试用于流场预测、代理建模和复杂水下环境中自主导航的ML模型的宝贵资源。
tldr: 引入了WAKESET，这是一个大规模、高雷诺数（高达$1.09 \times 10^8$）的CFD数据集，包含1,091次RANS模拟（增强至4,364个实例），用于水下回收场景，旨在解决现有流体力学ML数据集缺乏高湍流特性的问题。
ai_comments: WAKESET的创新性在于其规模和对高雷诺数湍流的关注，这直接解决了阻碍ML模型在实际工程应用中泛化的核心限制。现有的CFD数据集往往集中于计算成本较低的低雷诺数或简化场景，而WAKESET通过提供超过千次的高保真RANS模拟，为理解和预测复杂的、多尺度的尾流动力学提供了必要的训练基础。其针对水下航行器回收这一实际工程场景的设计，进一步增强了其在自主导航和实时控制应用中的实用性和重要性。
motivation: 机器学习在计算流体力学（CFD）中的应用受到缺乏大规模、多样化和高保真度数据集的严重阻碍，尤其是在主导实际工程应用但计算成本高昂的高湍流流场方面。需要高雷诺数湍流数据集来训练能够泛化到现实世界复杂物理现象的ML模型。
method: 引入WAKESET数据集，该数据集基于1,091次高保真度的雷诺平均纳维-斯托克斯（RANS）模拟，随后增强至4,364个实例。数据集捕获了自主水下航行器（AUV）被更大的超大型无人水下航行器（XLUUV）回收过程中的复杂水动力相互作用，覆盖了广泛的速度和转弯角操作范围。
results: WAKESET数据集包含1,091次RANS模拟，增强后达到4,364个实例，覆盖了高达$1.09 \times 10^8$的雷诺数。该数据集的规模、高湍流特性和对实际工程问题的关注，使其成为开发和基准测试用于流场预测、代理建模和复杂水下环境中自主导航的ML模型的宝贵资源。

title: The Dynamic Search for the Minimal Dynamic Extension
authors: Rollen S. D'Souza
abstract: Identifying the dynamic precompensator that renders a nonlinear control system feedback linearizable is a challenging problem. Researchers have explored the problem -- dynamic feedback linearization -- and produced existence conditions and constructive procedures for the dynamic precompensator. These remain, in general, either computationally expensive or restrictive. Treating the challenge as intrinsic, this article views the problem as a search problem over a category. Dynamic programming applies and, upon restriction to a finite category, classic search algorithms find the minimal dynamic extension. Alternatively, a heuristic aiming towards feedback linearizable systems can be employed to select amongst the infinitely-many extensions. This framing provides a distinctive, birds-eye view of the search for the dynamic precompensator.
comment: 8 pages. Submitted to the 27th International Symposium on Mathematical Theory of Networks and Systems (MTNS)
zh_title: 寻找最小动态扩展的动态搜索
translation: 确定使非线性控制系统实现反馈线性化的动态前置补偿器是一个具有挑战性的问题。研究人员已经探索了动态反馈线性化这一问题，并提出了动态前置补偿器的存在条件和构造程序。然而，这些方法通常在计算上成本高昂或具有限制性。本文将这一挑战视为内在问题，将其视为在某一范畴上的搜索问题。动态规划适用于此，并且在限制于有限范畴的情况下，经典搜索算法可以找到最小动态扩展。另外，可以采用旨在实现反馈线性化系统的启发式方法，从无限多的扩展中进行选择。这种框架为动态前置补偿器的搜索提供了一种独特的、鸟瞰式的视角。
tldr: 寻找动态反馈线性化所需的动态前置补偿器很困难。本文将此框定为一个范畴搜索问题，并建议使用动态规划或启发式算法来寻找最小动态扩展。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将动态反馈线性化这一具有挑战性的问题，重新概念化为一种范畴上的搜索问题。通过引入动态规划和经典搜索算法（在有限范畴限制下）来解决寻找最小动态扩展的问题，文章为动态前置补偿器的搜索提供了一种新颖且全局性的视角。这种方法可能有助于克服现有方法在计算成本高昂或限制性方面的不足。
motivation: 确定使非线性控制系统实现反馈线性化的动态前置补偿器是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有的动态反馈线性化方法通常在计算上成本高昂或具有限制性。
method: 将寻找动态前置补偿器的问题视为在某一范畴上的搜索问题。通过应用动态规划，并将其限制在一个有限范畴内，使用经典的搜索算法来找到最小动态扩展。此外，也可以采用旨在实现反馈线性化系统的启发式方法从无限多的扩展中进行选择。

title: Robust Generalization with Adaptive Optimal Transport Priors for Decision-Focused Learning
authors: Haixiang Sun, Andrew L. Liu
abstract: Few-shot learning requires models to generalize under limited supervision while remaining robust to distribution shifts. Existing Sinkhorn Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) methods provide theoretical guarantees but rely on a fixed reference distribution, which limits their adaptability. We propose a Prototype-Guided Distributionally Robust Optimization (PG-DRO) framework that learns class-adaptive priors from abundant base data via hierarchical optimal transport and embeds them into the Sinkhorn DRO formulation. This design enables few-shot information to be organically integrated into producing class-specific robust decisions that are both theoretically grounded and efficient, and further aligns the uncertainty set with transferable structural knowledge. Experiments show that PG-DRO achieves stronger robust generalization in few-shot scenarios, outperforming both standard learners and DRO baselines.
zh_title: 具有自适应最优传输先验的决策聚焦学习的鲁棒泛化
translation: 少数样本学习要求模型在有限监督下进行泛化，同时对分布偏移保持鲁棒性。现有的Sinkhorn分布鲁棒优化（DRO）方法提供了理论保证，但依赖于固定的参考分布，这限制了它们的适应性。我们提出了一种原型引导的分布鲁棒优化（PG-DRO）框架，该框架通过分层最优传输从大量基础数据中学习类别自适应先验，并将其嵌入到Sinkhorn DRO公式中。这种设计使得少数样本信息能够有机地整合，从而产生类别特定的鲁棒决策，这些决策既有理论基础又高效，并且进一步使不确定性集合与可迁移的结构性知识对齐。实验表明，PG-DRO在少数样本场景中实现了更强的鲁棒泛化，优于标准学习器和DRO基线方法。
tldr: 传统的分布鲁棒优化（DRO）在少数样本学习中因先验固定而受限。我们提出了PG-DRO，它使用分层最优传输学习自适应的、类别特定的先验，显著提高了模型的鲁棒泛化能力。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于解决了现有分布鲁棒优化（DRO）方法在少数样本学习中因采用固定参考分布而导致的适应性不足问题。通过引入原型引导和分层最优传输，PG-DRO成功地将基础数据中的结构性知识转化为类别自适应先验，并将其融入Sinkhorn DRO框架。这不仅为鲁棒决策提供了更强的理论基础，而且在实际的少数样本泛化能力上取得了显著提升，为决策聚焦学习提供了一个更灵活、更具鲁棒性的泛化范式。
motivation: 少数样本学习（few-shot learning）需要在有限监督下泛化，同时对分布偏移保持鲁棒性。现有的Sinkhorn分布鲁棒优化（DRO）方法依赖于固定的参考分布，限制了它们的适应性。
method: 提出了一种原型引导的分布鲁棒优化（PG-DRO）框架。该框架通过分层最优传输（hierarchical optimal transport）从基础数据中学习类别自适应先验，并将其嵌入到Sinkhorn DRO公式中。
results: PG-DRO在少数样本场景中实现了更强的鲁棒泛化，优于标准学习器和现有的DRO基线方法。
conclusion: PG-DRO的设计能够将少数样本信息有机地整合，以产生类别特定的鲁棒决策，这些决策既有理论基础又高效，并且使不确定性集合与可迁移的结构性知识对齐。

title: Non-Uniform Noise-to-Signal Ratio in the REINFORCE Policy-Gradient Estimator
authors: Haoyu Han, Heng Yang
abstract: Policy-gradient methods are widely used in reinforcement learning, yet training often becomes unstable or slows down as learning progresses. We study this phenomenon through the noise-to-signal ratio (NSR) of a policy-gradient estimator, defined as the estimator variance (noise) normalized by the squared norm of the true gradient (signal). Our main result is that, for (i) finite-horizon linear systems with Gaussian policies and linear state-feedback, and (ii) finite-horizon polynomial systems with Gaussian policies and polynomial feedback, the NSR of the REINFORCE estimator can be characterized exactly-either in closed form or via numerical moment-evaluation algorithms-without approximation. For general nonlinear dynamics and expressive policies (including neural policies), we further derive a general upper bound on the variance. These characterizations enable a direct examination of how NSR varies across policy parameters and how it evolves along optimization trajectories (e.g. SGD and Adam). Across a range of examples, we find that the NSR landscape is highly non-uniform and typically increases as the policy approaches an optimum; in some regimes it blows up, which can trigger training instability and policy collapse.
zh_title: REINFORCE策略梯度估计器中非均匀的信噪比
translation: 策略梯度方法在强化学习中被广泛使用，但随着学习的进行，训练经常变得不稳定或减慢。我们通过策略梯度估计器的信噪比（NSR）来研究这一现象，NSR定义为估计器方差（噪声）除以真实梯度范数的平方（信号）。我们的主要结果是，对于（i）具有高斯策略和线性状态反馈的有限时域线性系统，以及（ii）具有高斯策略和多项式反馈的有限时域多项式系统，REINFORCE估计器的NSR可以被精确地刻画——无论是通过闭式解析还是通过数值矩评估算法——无需近似。对于一般的非线性动力学和表达性策略（包括神经策略），我们进一步推导了方差的通用上界。这些刻画使得能够直接检查NSR如何随着策略参数变化，以及它如何沿着优化轨迹（例如SGD和Adam）演变。在各种示例中，我们发现NSR图景是高度非均匀的，并且通常随着策略接近最优值而增加；在某些情况下，它会爆炸，这可能引发训练不稳定和策略崩溃。
tldr: REINFORCE策略梯度估计器的信噪比（NSR）是非均匀的，并且在接近最优策略时通常会增加甚至爆炸，这解释了训练不稳定和策略崩溃的原因。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于，为特定的策略梯度设置提供了信噪比（NSR）的精确解析刻画，超越了标准的近似方法。这种理论分析将策略梯度中常见的经验不稳定现象（训练减慢、策略崩溃）直接与一个可量化的指标（NSR在最优值附近爆炸）联系起来。这为理解和改进REINFORCE类算法的收敛性提供了坚实的理论基础。局限性在于，精确的解析刻画仅限于较简单的有限时域线性/多项式系统，虽然为更复杂的策略提供了通用方差上界。
motivation: 策略梯度方法在强化学习训练过程中经常变得不稳定或速度减慢。本文旨在通过研究REINFORCE估计器的信噪比（NSR）来探究和理解这一现象。
method: 将信噪比（NSR）定义为估计器方差与真实梯度范数平方的比值。对于有限时域线性系统和多项式系统，推导了REINFORCE估计器NSR的精确解析（闭式或数值矩评估）。对于一般的非线性动力学和表达性策略，推导了方差的通用上界。利用这些刻画来检查NSR如何沿着优化轨迹演变。
results: NSR图景是高度非均匀的。NSR通常随着策略接近最优值而增加。在某些情况下，NSR会爆炸（blows up），从而引发训练不稳定和策略崩溃。
conclusion: REINFORCE策略梯度估计器中NSR的非均匀性以及在策略接近最优值时NSR的增加（甚至爆炸），是导致训练不稳定和策略崩溃的关键因素。

title: Hierarchical Locally Recoverable Codes on surfaces
authors: Carolina Araujo, Luana Costa, Beth Malmskog, Jorge Mello, Eliza Menezes, Cecília Salgado, Lara Vicino
abstract: We construct locally recoverable codes with hierarchy from surfaces in $\mathbb{A}^3$ admitting a fibration by curves of Artin-Schreier or Kummer type. We derive the parameters of our codes by leveraging the geometry and arithmetic of the fibration, which is obtained by projection onto one of the coordinates. As a byproduct, we obtain estimates for (and in one case an explicit count of) the number of rational points in certain families of surfaces.
zh_title: 分层局部可恢复码（在曲面上）
translation: 我们利用 $\mathbb{A}^3$ 中具有Artin-Schreier或Kummer型曲线纤维化的曲面，构造了具有分层结构的局部可恢复码。我们通过利用纤维化（通过投影到一个坐标上获得）的几何和算术特性来推导我们代码的参数。作为副产品，我们获得了某些曲面族中理点数量的估计值（在一种情况下获得了精确计数）。
tldr: 本文基于具有Artin-Schreier或Kummer型曲线纤维化的三维空间曲面，构造了分层局部可恢复码（HLRCs），并利用纤维化的几何和算术性质确定了代码参数，同时附带获得了某些曲面理点数量的估计。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将代数几何中的曲面（特别是具有Artin-Schreier或Kummer型曲线纤维化结构的曲面）与编码理论中的分层局部可恢复码（HLRCs）相结合。利用曲面的几何和算术特性来推导和确定代码参数，展示了代数编码理论的强大潜力。此外，研究还提供了一个有趣的跨学科副产品：通过编码构造附带解决了代数几何中关于曲面理点计数的难题，表明了这种构造方法的广泛适用性和价值。
motivation: 构造具有分层结构的新型局部可恢复码（LRCs）。
method: 利用三维空间 $\mathbb{A}^3$ 中具有Artin-Schreier或Kummer型曲线纤维化的曲面来构造代码。通过将曲面投影到一个坐标上获得纤维化，并利用其几何和算术性质来推导代码参数。
results: 成功构造了代码并确定了它们的参数。作为副产品，获得了某些曲面族中理点数量的估计值（在一种情况下获得了精确计数）。

title: A texture-based framework for foundational ultrasound models
authors: Tal Grutman, Carmel Shinar, Tali Ilovitsh
abstract: Ultrasound is the most widely used medical imaging modality, yet the images it produces are fundamentally unique, arising from tissue-dependent scattering, reflection, and speed-of-sound variations that produce a constrained set of characteristic textures that differ markedly from natural-image statistics. These acoustically driven patterns make ultrasound challenging for algorithms originally designed for natural images. To bridge this gap, the field has increasingly turned to foundation models, hoping to leverage their generalization capabilities. However, these models often falter in ultrasound applications because they are not designed for ultrasound physics, they are merely trained on ultrasound data. Therefore, it is essential to integrate ultrasound-specific domain knowledge into established learning frameworks. We achieve this by reformulating self-supervised learning as a texture-analysis problem, introducing texture ultrasound semantic analysis (TUSA). Using TUSA, models learn to leverage highly scalable contrastive methods to extract true domain-specific representations directly from simple B-mode images. We train a TUSA model on a combination of open-source, simulated, and in vivo data. The latent space is compared to several larger foundation models, demonstrating that our approach gives TUSA models better generalizability for difficult downstream tasks on unique online datasets as well as a clinical eye dataset collected for this study. Our model achieves higher accuracy in detecting COVID (70%), spinal hematoma (100%) and vitreous hemorrhage (97%) and correlates more closely with quantitative parameters like liver steatosis (r = 0.83), ejection fraction (r = 0.63), and oxygen saturation (r = 0.38). We open-source the model weights and training script: https://github.com/talg2324/tusa
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
zh_title: 基于纹理的超声基础模型框架
translation: 超声是最广泛使用的医学成像模式，但其生成的图像具有根本性的独特性，源于组织依赖性的散射、反射和声速变化，产生了与自然图像统计数据明显不同的、受限的特征纹理集。这些声学驱动的模式使得最初为自然图像设计的算法难以应对超声图像。为了弥合这一差距，该领域越来越多地转向基础模型，希望利用其泛化能力。然而，这些模型在超声应用中往往会失败，因为它们并非专为超声物理学设计，而仅仅是在超声数据上进行训练。因此，将超声特有的领域知识整合到已建立的学习框架中至关重要。我们通过将自监督学习重新表述为一个纹理分析问题来实现这一点，引入了纹理超声语义分析（TUSA）。使用TUSA，模型学习利用高度可扩展的对比方法，直接从简单的B型图像中提取真正的领域特定表示。我们在开源、模拟和体内数据的组合上训练了一个TUSA模型。模型的潜在空间与几个更大的基础模型进行了比较，结果表明我们的方法赋予TUSA模型更好的泛化能力，适用于独特的在线数据集以及为本研究收集的临床眼部数据集上的困难下游任务。我们的模型在检测COVID（70%）、脊髓血肿（100%）和玻璃体出血（97%）方面取得了更高的准确性，并与肝脂肪变性（r = 0.83）、射血分数（r = 0.63）和血氧饱和度（r = 0.38）等定量参数更密切相关。我们开源了模型权重和训练脚本：https://github.com/talg2324/tusa
tldr: 针对超声图像独特的纹理特征，本文提出了纹理超声语义分析（TUSA）框架，将自监督学习重构为纹理分析问题，从而更好地整合超声物理学知识。TUSA模型在各种下游任务中表现出比现有基础模型更强的泛化能力和更高的准确性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于明确指出并解决了现有医学基础模型（Foundation Models）在超声领域应用的根本缺陷——即缺乏对超声物理学（声学驱动的纹理）的内置理解。通过将自监督学习（SSL）巧妙地转化为纹理分析问题，作者成功地将领域知识（纹理/物理学）集成到模型学习过程中，这提供了一种更具生物学和物理学合理性的方法来构建医学基础模型。其重要性在于，它为处理具有独特物理特性（如超声、MRI相位等）的医学图像模态提供了一个新的、更有效的范式，有望显著提高模型的泛化能力和临床实用性。
motivation: 超声图像因其独特的声学驱动纹理（与自然图像统计数据显著不同）而对传统算法构成挑战。现有的基础模型虽然在超声数据上进行训练，但并未整合超声物理学知识，因此在应用中表现不佳。作者的动机是整合超声特有的领域知识到学习框架中，以弥合这一差距。
method: 通过将自监督学习（SSL）重新表述为纹理分析问题，引入了“纹理超声语义分析”（TUSA）框架。TUSA利用高度可扩展的对比方法，直接从简单的B型图像中提取真正的领域特定表示。模型在开源、模拟和体内数据的组合上进行训练。
results: TUSA模型在困难的下游任务中表现出比其他更大的基础模型更好的泛化能力。具体而言，模型在检测COVID（70%）、脊髓血肿（100%）和玻璃体出血（97%）方面取得了更高的准确性，并与肝脂肪变性（r = 0.83）、射血分数（r = 0.63）和血氧饱和度（r = 0.38）等定量参数更密切相关。

title: Erdős Matching (Conjecture) Theorem
authors: Tapas Kumar Mishra
abstract:
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a family of $k$-sized subsets of $[n]$ that does not contain $s$ pairwise disjoint subsets.
  The Erdős Matching Conjecture, a celebrated and long-standing open problem in extremal combinatorics, asserts the maximum cardinality of $\mathcal{F}$ is upper bounded by
  $\max\left\{\binom{sk-1}{k}, \binom{n}{k}-\allowbreak \binom{n-s+1}{k}\right\}$.
  These two bounds correspond to the sizes of two canonical extremal families: one in which all subsets are contained within a ground set of $sk-1$ elements, and one in which every subset intersects a fixed set of $s-1$ elements.
  In this paper, we prove the conjecture.
zh_title: 埃尔德什匹配（猜想）定理
translation: 设 $\mathcal{F}$ 是 $[n]$ 的 $k$ 元素子集的族，且它不包含 $s$ 个两两不相交的子集。埃尔德什匹配猜想是极值组合学中一个著名且悬而未决的长期开放问题，它断言 $\mathcal{F}$ 的最大基数上限为 $\max\left\{\binom{sk-1}{k}, \binom{n}{k}-\binom{n-s+1}{k}\right\}$。这两个界限对应于两个典型的极值族的大小：一个是所有子集都包含在 $sk-1$ 个元素的基集内；另一个是每个子集都与一个固定的 $s-1$ 个元素的集合相交。在本文中，我们证明了这个猜想。
tldr: 证明了著名的埃尔德什匹配猜想。
ai_comments: 本文解决了极值组合学中一个长达数十年、极具挑战性的著名开放问题——埃尔德什匹配猜想。该猜想的证明是该领域的一个重大里程碑，它精确地确定了在禁止特定大小的匹配时，集合族可能达到的最大尺寸。
motivation: 解决极值组合学中一个著名且悬而未决的长期开放问题——埃尔德什匹配猜想。
results: 证明了埃尔德什匹配猜想：对于一个不包含 $s$ 个两两不相交子集的 $k$ 元素子集族 $\mathcal{F}$，其最大基数上限为 $\max\left\{\binom{sk-1}{k}, \binom{n}{k}-\binom{n-s+1}{k}\right\}$。
conclusion: 埃尔德什匹配猜想已被证明成立。

title: Density-Informed Pseudo-Counts for Calibrated Evidential Deep Learning
authors: Pietro Carlotti, Nevena Gligić, Arya Farahi
abstract: Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) is a popular framework for uncertainty-aware classification that models predictive uncertainty via Dirichlet distributions parameterized by neural networks. Despite its popularity, its theoretical foundations and behavior under distributional shift remain poorly understood. In this work, we provide a principled statistical interpretation by proving that EDL training corresponds to amortized variational inference in a hierarchical Bayesian model with a tempered pseudo-likelihood. This perspective reveals a major drawback: standard EDL conflates epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, leading to systematic overconfidence on out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. To address this, we introduce Density-Informed Pseudo-count EDL (DIP-EDL), a new parametrization that decouples class prediction from the magnitude of uncertainty by separately estimating the conditional label distribution and the marginal covariate density. This separation preserves evidence in high-density regions while shrinking predictions toward a uniform prior for OOD data. Theoretically, we prove that DIP-EDL achieves asymptotic concentration. Empirically, we show that our method enhances interpretability and improves robustness and uncertainty calibration under distributional shift.
zh_title: 用于校准的证据深度学习的密度信息伪计数
translation: 证据深度学习（EDL）是一种流行且能感知不确定性的分类框架，它通过由神经网络参数化的狄利克雷分布来建模预测不确定性。尽管它很受欢迎，但其理论基础和在分布偏移下的行为仍然知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们提供了一个有原则的统计解释，证明EDL训练对应于在一个具有回火伪似然的分层贝叶斯模型中的摊销变分推断。这一视角揭示了一个主要缺陷：标准EDL混淆了认知不确定性和偶然不确定性，导致对分布外（OOD）输入系统性地过度自信。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了密度信息伪计数EDL（DIP-EDL），这是一种新的参数化方法，它通过分别估计条件标签分布和边缘协变量密度，将类别预测与不确定性的大小解耦。这种分离在高密度区域保留了证据，同时将OOD数据的预测收缩至均匀先验。在理论上，我们证明了DIP-EDL实现了渐近集中。在经验上，我们表明我们的方法增强了解释性，并在分布偏移下提高了鲁棒性和不确定性校准。
tldr: 证据深度学习（EDL）在分布偏移下表现不佳且过度自信。本文提出了密度信息伪计数EDL（DIP-EDL），通过分离条件标签分布和边缘协变量密度，解决了EDL的问题，显著提高了OOD数据的校准和鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于为流行的证据深度学习（EDL）框架提供了严格的统计学解释，证明其对应于一个具有回火伪似然的分层贝叶斯模型的摊销变分推断，并明确指出了其在分布偏移下过度自信的根本原因（不确定性混淆）。提出的DIP-EDL通过引入密度信息来解耦预测和不确定性大小，提供了一种解决深度学习中OOD不确定性校准问题的有效且有理论支撑的方法。这对提高EDL在实际应用中（尤其是在安全关键领域）的可靠性和鲁棒性具有重要意义。
motivation: 证据深度学习（EDL）的理论基础和在分布偏移下的行为尚不清楚。标准EDL混合了认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）和偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty），导致对分布外（OOD）输入系统性地过度自信。
method: 提出了密度信息伪计数EDL（DIP-EDL）。该方法通过分别估计条件标签分布和边缘协变量密度，解耦了类别预测和不确定性大小。这使得模型在高密度区域保留证据，同时将OOD数据的预测收缩至均匀先验。理论上证明了DIP-EDL实现了渐近集中。
results: 经验证明，该方法增强了解释性，并在分布偏移下提高了鲁棒性和不确定性校准。
conclusion: DIP-EDL通过引入密度信息伪计数，成功地解决了标准EDL混合不确定性并导致OOD过度自信的问题，显著提高了模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性和不确定性校准。

title: From Discrete to Continuous Mixed Populations of Conformists, Nonconformists, and Imitators
authors: Azadeh Aghaeeyan, Pouria Ramazi
abstract:
In two-strategy decision-making problems, individuals often imitate the highest earners or choose either the common or rare strategy.
  Individuals who benefit from the common strategy are conformists, whereas those who profit by choosing the less common one are called nonconformists.
  The population proportions of the two strategies may undergo perpetual fluctuations
  in finite, discrete, heterogeneous populations of imitators, conformists, and nonconformists.
  How these fluctuations evolve as population size increases was left as an open question and is addressed in this paper.
  We show that the family of Markov chains describing the discrete population dynamics forms a generalized stochastic approximation process for a differential inclusion--the continuous-time dynamics.
  Furthermore, we prove that the continuous-time dynamics always equilibrate.
  Then, by leveraging results from the stochastic approximation theory, we show that the amplitudes of fluctuations in the proportions of the two strategies in the population approach zero with probability one when the population size grows to infinity.
  Our results suggest that large-scale perpetual fluctuations are unlikely in large, well-mixed populations consisting of these three types, particularly when imitators follow the highest earners.
zh_title: 从离散到连续的顺从者、非顺从者和模仿者混合种群
translation: 在双策略决策问题中，个体通常会模仿收益最高者，或选择常见或罕见的策略。从常见策略中获益的个体是顺从者，而通过选择不常见策略获益的个体则被称为非顺从者。在由模仿者、顺从者和非顺从者组成的有限、离散、异质种群中，两种策略的种群比例可能会经历持续的波动。本文解决了当种群规模增大时这些波动如何演变这一悬而未决的问题。我们证明了描述离散种群动态的马尔可夫链构成了一个微分包含（即连续时间动态）的广义随机逼近过程。此外，我们证明了连续时间动态总是达到均衡。然后，通过利用随机逼近理论的成果，我们证明了当种群规模趋于无穷大时，种群中两种策略比例的波动幅度以概率一趋近于零。我们的结果表明，在由这三类个体组成的大型、充分混合的种群中，特别是在模仿者遵循最高收益者的情况下，大规模的持续波动是不太可能发生的。
tldr: 研究发现，在由顺从者、非顺从者和模仿者组成的混合种群中，当种群规模趋于无穷大时，策略比例的波动幅度会趋近于零，这意味着大规模的持续波动在大型种群中是不太可能发生的。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于，它利用广义随机逼近理论，严谨地将描述有限离散种群动态的马尔可夫链与连续时间动态（微分包含）联系起来。这解决了群体动态领域中一个重要的开放问题，即在由顺从者、非顺从者和模仿者组成的种群中，随着种群规模增大，策略比例的持续波动是否会持续。研究结果表明波动幅度趋于零，对理解大规模社会或生物种群中的集体决策和均衡状态具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的研究发现，在有限、离散的顺从者、非顺从者和模仿者混合种群中，两种策略的种群比例可能会经历持续的波动。本文旨在解决一个悬而未决的问题：当种群规模增大时，这些波动如何演变。
method: 将描述离散种群动态的马尔可夫链证明为微分包含（即连续时间动态）的广义随机逼近过程。然后，利用随机逼近理论的成果进行分析。
results: 1. 描述离散种群动态的马尔可夫链是连续时间动态（微分包含）的广义随机逼近过程。2. 连续时间动态总是达到均衡。3. 当种群规模趋于无穷大时，策略比例波动的幅度以概率一趋近于零。
conclusion: 结果表明，在由这三类个体组成的大型、充分混合的种群中，特别是在模仿者遵循最高收益者的情况下，大规模的持续波动是不太可能发生的。

title: Community-Level Modeling of Gyral Folding Patterns for Robust and Anatomically Informed Individualized Brain Mapping
authors: Minheng Chen, Tong Chen, Yan Zhuang, Chao Cao, Jing Zhang, Tianming Liu, Lu Zhang, Dajiang Zhu
abstract: Cortical folding exhibits substantial inter-individual variability while preserving stable anatomical landmarks that enable fine-scale characterization of cortical organization. Among these, the three-hinge gyrus (3HG) serves as a key folding primitive, showing consistent topology yet meaningful variations in morphology, connectivity, and function. Existing landmark-based methods typically model each 3HG independently, ignoring that 3HGs form higher-order folding communities that capture mesoscale structure. This simplification weakens anatomical representation and makes one-to-one matching sensitive to positional variability and noise. We propose a spectral graph representation learning framework that models community-level folding units rather than isolated landmarks. Each 3HG is encoded using a dual-profile representation combining surface topology and structural connectivity. Subject-specific spectral clustering identifies coherent folding communities, followed by topological refinement to preserve anatomical continuity. For cross-subject correspondence, we introduce Joint Morphological-Geometric Matching, jointly optimizing geometric and morphometric similarity. Across over 1000 Human Connectome Project subjects, the resulting communities show reduced morphometric variance, stronger modular organization, improved hemispheric consistency, and superior alignment compared with atlas-based and landmark-based or embedding-based baselines. These findings demonstrate that community-level modeling provides a robust and anatomically grounded framework for individualized cortical characterization and reliable cross-subject correspondence.
zh_title: 脑回折叠模式的社区级建模，用于稳健且解剖学知情的个体化大脑图谱绘制
translation: 皮层折叠表现出显著的个体间差异，但同时保留了稳定的解剖学地标，从而能够对皮层组织进行精细尺度的表征。其中，三铰链脑回（3HG）作为关键的折叠基元，显示出一致的拓扑结构，但在形态、连接和功能上存在有意义的变异。现有的基于地标的方法通常独立建模每个3HG，忽略了3HG形成了捕获中尺度结构的更高阶折叠社区。这种简化削弱了解剖学表征，并使得一对一匹配对位置变异性和噪声敏感。我们提出了一个谱图表示学习框架，该框架对社区级折叠单元而非孤立地标进行建模。每个3HG都使用结合了表面拓扑和结构连接的双剖面表示进行编码。主体特定的谱聚类识别出连贯的折叠社区，随后进行拓扑精修以保持解剖学连续性。对于跨主体对应，我们引入了联合形态-几何匹配，共同优化几何和形态测量相似性。在超过1000名人类连接组计划（HCP）受试者中，所得社区与基于图谱、基于地标或基于嵌入的基线方法相比，显示出更低的形态测量方差、更强的模块化组织、更高的半球一致性和更优越的对齐效果。这些发现表明，社区级建模为个体化皮层表征和可靠的跨主体对应提供了一个稳健且具有解剖学基础的框架。
tldr: 提出了一种新的谱图学习框架，将大脑折叠地标（3HG）建模为“折叠社区”，从而实现更稳健、更准确的个体化脑图谱绘制和跨主体对齐。
ai_comments: 创新点在于将建模单元从孤立的解剖学地标（3HG）转移到更高阶的社区，从而更好地捕获皮层组织的中尺度结构。双剖面编码（拓扑+连接性）和联合匹配优化增强了个体化图谱绘制的解剖学基础和稳健性，解决了传统基于地标方法中存在的关键限制（变异性和噪声敏感性）。这项工作为神经科学中更可靠、更具生物学依据的跨主体比较奠定了基础。
motivation: 现有方法独立建模单个折叠地标（如3HG），忽略了它们形成的更高阶的折叠社区，导致解剖学表征弱化，且跨主体匹配对噪声和位置变异性敏感。
method: 提出一个谱图表示学习框架，对社区级折叠单元进行建模。每个3HG使用结合表面拓扑和结构连接的双剖面表示进行编码。随后进行主体特定的谱聚类以识别连贯的折叠社区，并进行拓扑精修。最后，引入联合形态-几何匹配进行跨主体对应，共同优化几何和形态测量相似性。
results: 在超过1000名HCP受试者上测试，结果显示，相比基于图谱、基于地标或基于嵌入的基线方法，新社区模型具有更低的形态测量方差、更强的模块化组织、更高的半球一致性和更优越的对齐效果。
conclusion: 社区级建模为个体化皮层表征和可靠的跨主体对应提供了一个稳健且具有解剖学基础的框架。

title: Rethinking Multinomial Logistic Mixture of Experts with Sigmoid Gating Function
authors: Tuan Minh Pham, Thinh Cao, Viet Nguyen, Huy Nguyen, Nhat Ho, Alessandro Rinaldo
abstract: The sigmoid gate in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models has been empirically shown to outperform the softmax gate across several tasks, ranging from approximating feed-forward networks to language modeling. Additionally, recent efforts have demonstrated that the sigmoid gate is provably more sample-efficient than its softmax counterpart under regression settings. Nevertheless, there are three notable concerns that have not been addressed in the literature, namely (i) the benefits of the sigmoid gate have not been established under classification settings; (ii) existing sigmoid-gated MoE models may not converge to their ground-truth; and (iii) the effects of a temperature parameter in the sigmoid gate remain theoretically underexplored. To tackle these open problems, we perform a comprehensive analysis of multinomial logistic MoE equipped with a modified sigmoid gate to ensure model convergence. Our results indicate that the sigmoid gate exhibits a lower sample complexity than the softmax gate for both parameter and expert estimation. Furthermore, we find that incorporating a temperature into the sigmoid gate leads to a sample complexity of exponential order due to an intrinsic interaction between the temperature and gating parameters. To overcome this issue, we propose replacing the vanilla inner product score in the gating function with a Euclidean score that effectively removes that interaction, thereby substantially improving the sample complexity to a polynomial order.
comment: Tuan Minh Pham, Thinh Cao, and Viet Nguyen contributed equally to this work
zh_title: 重新思考使用 Sigmoid 门控函数的多项式逻辑混合专家模型
translation: Sigmoid 门控在混合专家模型（MoE）中已被经验证明在从逼近前馈网络到语言建模的多种任务中均优于 Softmax 门控。此外，最近的研究表明，在回归设置下，Sigmoid 门控在理论上比其 Softmax 对应物具有更高的样本效率。然而，文献中仍有三个值得关注的问题尚未解决：(i) Sigmoid 门控的优势尚未在分类设置中得到确立；(ii) 现有的 Sigmoid 门控 MoE 模型可能无法收敛到它们的真实值；(iii) Sigmoid 门控中温度参数的影响在理论上尚未得到充分探索。为了解决这些开放性问题，我们对配备了修改后的 Sigmoid 门控（以确保模型收敛）的多项式逻辑 MoE 进行了全面的分析。我们的结果表明，Sigmoid 门控在参数和专家估计方面都表现出比 Softmax 门控更低的样本复杂度。此外，我们发现，由于温度和门控参数之间存在内在相互作用，将温度引入 Sigmoid 门控会导致样本复杂度呈指数级。为了克服这个问题，我们提出用欧几里得得分来替换门控函数中的传统内积得分，这有效地消除了这种相互作用，从而将样本复杂度大幅提高到多项式级别。
tldr: 本文重新分析了使用 Sigmoid 门控的多项式逻辑 MoE 模型，解决了其在分类设置中的优势、收敛性和温度参数的理论影响。研究证明 Sigmoid 门控比 Softmax 门控具有更低的样本复杂度。为解决温度参数引入的指数级复杂度，作者提出用欧几里得得分替换内积得分，将复杂度成功降低至多项式级别。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将 Sigmoid 门控混合专家模型（MoE）的理论分析扩展到分类设置，并解决了困扰该模型收敛性和效率的实际问题。特别值得注意的是，作者不仅识别了温度参数与门控参数相互作用导致的指数级样本复杂度这一理论限制，还提出了一个实用的解决方案——用欧几里得得分（Euclidean score）替换内积得分。这一改进对于构建理论基础更坚实、应用更广泛的 MoE 模型具有重要意义，尤其是在追求更高样本效率的领域。
motivation: 尽管 Sigmoid 门控的混合专家模型（MoE）在回归设置中表现出优越性和更高的样本效率，但仍存在三个未解决的问题：(i) Sigmoid 门控在分类设置中的优势尚未确立；(ii) 现有模型可能无法收敛到真实值；(iii) 温度参数的影响缺乏理论探索。本文旨在解决这些开放性问题。
method: 对配备了修改后的 Sigmoid 门控（以确保模型收敛）的多项式逻辑 MoE 进行了全面的理论分析。具体方法包括：理论分析 Sigmoid 门控在分类设置下的样本复杂度，并研究温度参数对样本复杂度的影响。为解决温度参数引入的指数级复杂度问题，提出用欧几里得得分替换门控函数中的传统内积得分。
results: (i) Sigmoid 门控在参数和专家估计方面均表现出比 Softmax 门控更低的样本复杂度。(ii) 在 Sigmoid 门控中引入温度参数会导致样本复杂度呈指数级。(iii) 提出使用欧几里得得分替换内积得分后，成功消除了导致指数级复杂度的相互作用，从而将样本复杂度大幅降低到多项式级别。
conclusion: 通过对多项式逻辑 MoE 进行重新设计和分析，证明了 Sigmoid 门控在分类设置下依然具有样本效率优势。同时，通过引入欧几里得得分来解决温度参数带来的指数级样本复杂度问题，显著改善了模型的理论性能，将其样本复杂度降低到多项式级别。

title: Totally $Δ$-Modular Tree Decompositions of Graphic Matrices for Integer Programming
authors: Caleb McFarland
abstract: We introduce the tree-decomposition-based parameter totally $Δ$-modular treewidth (TDM-treewidth) for matrices with two nonzero entries per row. We show how to solve integer programs whose matrices have bounded TDM-treewidth when variables are bounded. This extends previous graph-based decomposition parameters for matrices with at most two nonzero entries per row to include matrices with entries outside of $\{-1,0,1\}$. We also give an analogue of the Grid Theorem of Robertson and Seymour for matrices of bounded TDM-treewidth in the language of rooted signed graphs.
zh_title: 整数规划中图矩阵的完全 $\Delta$-模树分解
translation: 我们为每行有两个非零项的矩阵引入了基于树分解的参数：完全 $\Delta$-模树宽（TDM-treewidth）。我们展示了当变量有界时，如何求解其矩阵具有有界 TDM-treewidth 的整数规划问题。这扩展了先前针对每行至多有两个非零项矩阵的基于图的分解参数，使其能够包含矩阵项超出 $\{-1,0,1\}$ 集合的矩阵。我们还以带根符号图的语言，给出了有界 TDM-treewidth 矩阵的 Robertson 和 Seymour 网格定理的类比。
tldr: 引入了完全 $\Delta$-模树宽（TDM-treewidth）参数来处理每行有两个非零项的矩阵。当变量有界时，使用此参数可以求解相应的整数规划问题，并将先前的分解方法扩展到包含非 $\{-1,0,1\}$ 项的矩阵，同时提供了一个网格定理的类比。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了 TDM-treewidth 这一新的矩阵分解参数，有效地将图论中的分解技术应用于更广泛的整数规划问题。它的重要性在于打破了传统上对矩阵项必须属于 $\{-1,0,1\}$ 集合的限制（例如在全单模或全双模矩阵中），从而显著拓宽了基于分解的整数规划求解方法的适用范围。通过引入 Robertson 和 Seymour 网格定理的类比，论文也在理论上建立了该参数与结构图论的联系。
motivation: 扩展现有的基于图的分解参数，使其能够处理每行至多有两个非零项，且矩阵元素可以超出 $\{-1,0,1\}$ 集合的矩阵所对应的整数规划问题。
method: 引入了基于树分解的新参数：完全 $\Delta$-模树宽（TDM-treewidth），专门用于每行有两个非零项的矩阵。
results: 1) 证明了当变量有界且矩阵具有有界 TDM-treewidth 时，可以求解相应的整数规划问题。2) 在带根符号图的语言中，给出了有界 TDM-treewidth 矩阵的 Robertson 和 Seymour 网格定理的类比。

title: MarkCleaner: High-Fidelity Watermark Removal via Imperceptible Micro-Geometric Perturbation
authors: Xiaoxi Kong, Jieyu Yuan, Pengdi Chen, Yuanlin Zhang, Chongyi Li, Bin Li
abstract: Semantic watermarks exhibit strong robustness against conventional image-space attacks. In this work, we show that such robustness does not survive under micro-geometric perturbations: spatial displacements can remove watermarks by breaking the phase alignment. Motivated by this observation, we introduce MarkCleaner, a watermark removal framework that avoids semantic drift caused by regeneration-based watermark removal. Specifically, MarkCleaner is trained with micro-geometry-perturbed supervision, which encourages the model to separate semantic content from strict spatial alignment and enables robust reconstruction under subtle geometric displacements. The framework adopts a mask-guided encoder that learns explicit spatial representations and a 2D Gaussian Splatting-based decoder that explicitly parameterizes geometric perturbations while preserving semantic content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MarkCleaner achieves superior performance in both watermark removal effectiveness and visual fidelity, while enabling efficient real-time inference. Our code will be made available upon acceptance.
zh_title: MarkCleaner：通过难以察觉的微几何扰动实现高保真水印去除
translation: 语义水印对传统的图像空间攻击表现出强大的鲁棒性。在这项工作中，我们表明这种鲁棒性在微几何扰动下不会持续存在：空间位移可以通过破坏相位对齐来去除水印。受这一观察的启发，我们引入了MarkCleaner，这是一个水印去除框架，它避免了基于重生成的水印去除所导致的语义漂移。具体来说，MarkCleaner采用微几何扰动监督进行训练，这鼓励模型将语义内容与严格的空间对齐分离，并实现在细微几何位移下的鲁棒重建。该框架采用了一个学习显式空间表示的掩码引导编码器，以及一个基于2D高斯溅射的解码器，该解码器明确地参数化了几何扰动，同时保留了语义内容。广泛的实验证明，MarkCleaner在水印去除有效性和视觉保真度方面均实现了卓越的性能，同时还支持高效的实时推理。我们的代码将在被接收后公开。
tldr: MarkCleaner是一种新的水印去除框架，它利用微小的几何扰动来破坏水印的相位对齐，从而高效、高保真地去除水印，同时避免了传统方法导致的语义漂移。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将“微几何扰动”作为一种新的攻击策略来专门针对语义水印的相位对齐弱点。这提供了一种与传统的图像空间攻击或基于内容重绘的方法截然不同的高保真去除机制。引入基于2D高斯溅射的解码器来显式参数化这些难以察觉的几何变化，是实现高保真度的关键技术贡献，解决了水印去除中常见的语义漂移问题，同时实现了实时推理，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 语义水印对传统的图像空间攻击具有很强的鲁棒性。然而，研究发现，这种鲁棒性在微几何扰动下会失效，因为空间位移可以通过破坏相位对齐来去除水印。基于此观察，作者旨在开发一种避免基于重生成的水印去除所导致的语义漂移的框架。
method: 提出的方法是MarkCleaner框架。它采用微几何扰动监督进行训练，以鼓励模型将语义内容与严格的空间对齐分离，从而在细微几何位移下实现鲁棒重建。该框架包括一个学习显式空间表示的掩码引导编码器，以及一个基于2D高斯溅射（2D Gaussian Splatting）的解码器，该解码器明确地参数化了几何扰动，同时保留了语义内容。
results: 广泛的实验证明，MarkCleaner在水印去除有效性和视觉保真度方面均实现了卓越的性能，同时还支持高效的实时推理。

title: Regularization for Multi-Phase 2D Euler Equations via Competing Transport Markers
authors: Trinh T. Nguyen
abstract: We introduce a novel regularization framework for the two-dimensional incompressible Euler equation that exactly preserves the transport structure of multi-phase vorticity fields. The key step is a reformulation of multi-phase vortex patch data in terms of a finite family of passively advected scalar marker functions: at each point, the local vorticity is determined by a smooth, pointwise selection rule arising from competition among these markers. The scheme introduces no spatial diffusion or mollification; all regularization originates solely from the marker selection mechanism. As the sharpness parameter $β\to\infty$, we prove uniform convergence of the transported marker functions on finite time intervals. Moreover, under a geometric nondegeneracy condition on the underlying Euler interface network, we establish Hausdorff convergence of the evolving interfacial structures and exponential-in-$β$ pointwise convergence of the regularized vorticity away from the tie sets to the corresponding sharp multi-phase vortex patch solution. Finally, we show that the loss of pointwise convergence coincides precisely with the onset of geometric degeneracy in the Euler interface dynamics.
zh_title: 基于竞争输运标记物的多相二维欧拉方程正则化
translation: 我们引入了一种用于二维不可压欧拉方程的新型正则化框架，该框架能精确保持多相涡量场的输运结构。关键步骤在于，通过有限族被动平流标量标记函数重新表述多相涡斑数据：在每个点上，局部涡量由这些标记物竞争产生的平滑、逐点选择规则确定。该方案不引入空间扩散或平滑化；所有正则化仅源于标记物选择机制。我们证明了当锐度参数 $β\to\infty$ 时，输运标记函数在有限时间间隔内的一致收敛性。此外，在底层欧拉界面网络满足几何非退化条件的情况下，我们建立了演化界面结构的豪斯多夫收敛性，以及正则化涡量在远离连接集处到相应尖锐多相涡斑解的指数级（以$β$为指数）逐点收敛性。最后，我们表明逐点收敛的丧失恰好与欧拉界面动力学中几何退化的发生相吻合。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于竞争输运标记物的新型正则化框架，用于解决二维多相欧拉方程。该方法在不引入空间扩散的情况下，能精确保持输运结构，并在正则化参数趋于无穷大时，证明了其解收敛于尖锐的多相涡斑解，除非发生几何退化。
ai_comments: 本文的创新性在于提出了一种新颖的正则化机制，即利用竞争输运标记物来代替传统的空间扩散或平滑化，从而确保了多相涡量场输运结构的精确保持。这种方法为研究具有尖锐界面的流体动力学提供了理论上更严格且物理保守的框架。其重要性体现在强大的收敛性证明上（包括豪斯多夫收敛和指数级逐点收敛）。然而，强收敛依赖于“几何非退化条件”，这一点也暗示了该方法在处理界面动力学中几何退化（如界面连接或断裂）时的潜在局限性。
motivation: 针对二维不可压欧拉方程，开发一种新型正则化框架，该框架能够精确保持多相涡量场的输运结构，避免引入空间扩散或平滑化。
method: 通过有限族被动平流标量标记函数重新表述多相涡斑数据。局部涡量由这些标记物竞争产生的平滑、逐点选择规则确定。正则化仅源于标记物选择机制，不依赖于空间扩散或平滑化。
results: 证明了在有限时间间隔内，当锐度参数 $\beta \to \infty$ 时，输运标记函数的一致收敛性。在欧拉界面网络几何非退化条件下，建立了演化界面结构的豪斯多夫收敛性，以及正则化涡量在远离连接集处的指数级（以$β$为指数）逐点收敛性。同时，证明了逐点收敛的丧失恰好与欧拉界面动力学中几何退化的发生相吻合。

title: A new criterion for the absolute irreducibility of multivariate polynomials over finite fields
authors: Carlos Agrinsoni, Heeralal Janwa, Moises Delgado
abstract:
A key property of an algebraic variety is whether it is absolutely irreducible, meaning that it remains irreducible over the algebraic closure of its defining field, and determining absolute irreducibility is important in algebraic geometry and its applications in coding theory, cryptography, and other fields.
  Among the applications of absolute irreducibility are bounding the number of rational points via the Weil conjectures and establishing exceptional APN and permutation properties of functions over finite fields. In this article, we present a new criterion for the absolute irreducibility of hypersurfaces defined by multivariate polynomials over finite fields. Our criterion does not require testing for irreducibility in the ground or extension fields, assuming that the leading form is square-free. We just require multivariate GCD computations and the square-free property. Since almost all polynomials are known to be square-free, our absolute irreducibility criterion is valid for almost all multivariate polynomials.
zh_title: 多元多项式在有限域上绝对不可约性的新判别准则
translation: 代数簇的一个关键性质是它是否绝对不可约，这意味着它在其定义域的代数闭包上保持不可约性。确定绝对不可约性在代数几何及其在编码理论、密码学和其他领域的应用中非常重要。绝对不可约性的应用包括通过Weil猜想对有理点的数量进行界定，以及确定有限域上函数的特殊APN和置换性质。在本文中，我们提出了一种判别由有限域上多元多项式定义的超曲面绝对不可约性的新准则。我们的准则不需要测试基域或扩域中的不可约性，前提是其首项形式是无平方因子的。我们只需要进行多元最大公约数（GCD）计算和无平方因子性质的验证。由于已知几乎所有多项式都是无平方因子的，因此我们的绝对不可约性准则对几乎所有多元多项式都有效。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的判别多元多项式在有限域上绝对不可约性的准则。该准则仅要求计算多元最大公约数（GCD）和验证其首项形式是无平方因子（square-free）的，避免了在基域或扩域中进行不可约性测试，适用于几乎所有多元多项式。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提供了一种计算上更简便的绝对不可约性判定方法。传统的绝对不可约性测试通常涉及在代数闭包或其扩域上进行复杂的因式分解或不可约性检查，计算成本高昂。通过将问题简化为多元GCD计算和验证无平方因子性质，作者极大地提高了判定效率和实用性。特别是其适用范围涵盖了“几乎所有”多元多项式，表明它具有广泛的理论和应用价值，尤其是在需要高效判断代数簇性质的密码学和编码理论领域。
motivation: 绝对不可约性是代数簇的一个关键性质，在代数几何、编码理论和密码学等领域非常重要。其应用包括通过Weil猜想确定有理点的数量界限，以及确定有限域上函数的特殊APN和置换性质。
method: 提出了一种用于有限域上多元多项式定义的超曲面绝对不可约性的新判别准则。该准则假设首项形式是无平方因子的，并且不需要测试基域或扩域中的不可约性。它只需要进行多元最大公约数（GCD）的计算和无平方因子性质的验证。
results: 提出了一种新的绝对不可约性准则，该准则仅依赖于多元GCD计算和无平方因子性质。由于已知几乎所有多项式都是无平方因子的，因此该准则适用于几乎所有多元多项式。

title: Inference-Aware Meta-Alignment of LLMs via Non-Linear GRPO
authors: Shokichi Takakura, Akifumi Wachi, Rei Higuchi, Kohei Miyaguchi, Taiji Suzuki
abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse human preferences is fundamentally challenging since criteria can often conflict with each other. Inference-time alignment methods have recently gained popularity as they allow LLMs to be aligned to multiple criteria via different alignment algorithms at inference time. However, inference-time alignment is computationally expensive since it often requires multiple forward passes of the base model. In this work, we propose inference-aware meta-alignment (IAMA), a novel approach that enables LLMs to be aligned to multiple criteria with limited computational budget at inference time. IAMA trains a base model such that it can be effectively aligned to multiple tasks via different inference-time alignment algorithms. To solve the non-linear optimization problems involved in IAMA, we propose non-linear GRPO, which provably converges to the optimal solution in the space of probability measures.
zh_title: LLM的推理感知元对齐通过非线性GRPO实现
translation: 将大型语言模型（LLMs）对齐到多样化的人类偏好从根本上具有挑战性，因为标准往往相互冲突。推理时对齐方法最近获得了普及，因为它们允许LLMs在推理时通过不同的对齐算法对齐到多个标准。然而，推理时对齐的计算成本很高，因为它通常需要基础模型进行多次前向传播。在这项工作中，我们提出了推理感知元对齐（IAMA），这是一种新颖的方法，使LLMs能够在推理时以有限的计算预算对齐到多个标准。IAMA训练一个基础模型，使其能够通过不同的推理时对齐算法有效地对齐到多个任务。为了解决IAMA中涉及的非线性优化问题，我们提出了非线性GRPO，它被证明可以在概率测度空间中收敛到最优解。
tldr: 本文提出了推理感知元对齐（IAMA）方法，通过训练基础模型使其能高效地在推理时对齐多种偏好，解决了现有推理时对齐计算成本高的问题。IAMA使用新颖的非线性GRPO优化器，并证明了其收敛性。
ai_comments: 创新点在于提出了IAMA框架，将“推理时对齐”的概念提升到“元对齐”的层面，旨在解决现有方法计算资源消耗过大的痛点。通过预先训练（元对齐）基础模型，使其具备快速、高效适应多种对齐标准的能力。方法论上的重要性在于引入了非线性GRPO优化器，并提供了严格的收敛性证明，这为解决复杂的非线性优化问题提供了理论保障。
motivation: 1. 将大型语言模型（LLMs）对齐到多样化的人类偏好具有挑战性，因为标准可能相互冲突。2. 现有的推理时对齐方法虽然流行，但计算成本高昂，通常需要基础模型进行多次前向传播。
method: 提出了推理感知元对齐（IAMA）方法。IAMA训练一个基础模型，使其能够在推理时通过不同的对齐算法有效地对齐到多个任务和标准，同时限制计算预算。为了解决IAMA中涉及的非线性优化问题，提出并使用了非线性GRPO（Non-Linear GRPO）方法。
results: 提出的非线性GRPO被证明可以在概率测度空间中收敛到最优解。

title: HuPER: A Human-Inspired Framework for Phonetic Perception
authors: Chenxu Guo, Jiachen Lian, Yisi Liu, Baihe Huang, Shriyaa Narayanan, Cheol Jun Cho, Gopala Anumanchipalli
abstract: We propose HuPER, a human-inspired framework that models phonetic perception as adaptive inference over acoustic-phonetics evidence and linguistic knowledge. With only 100 hours of training data, HuPER achieves state-of-the-art phonetic error rates on five English benchmarks and strong zero-shot transfer to 95 unseen languages. HuPER is also the first framework to enable adaptive, multi-path phonetic perception under diverse acoustic conditions. All training data, models, and code are open-sourced. Code and demo avaliable at https://github.com/HuPER29/HuPER.
zh_title: HuPER：一个受人类启发的语音感知框架
translation: 我们提出了HuPER，这是一个受人类启发的框架，它将语音感知建模为对声学-语音证据和语言知识的自适应推理。HuPER仅用100小时的训练数据，就在五个英语基准测试中实现了最先进的语音错误率，并对95种未见语言具有强大的零样本迁移能力。HuPER也是第一个能够在不同声学条件下实现自适应、多路径语音感知的框架。所有训练数据、模型和代码均已开源。代码和演示可在https://github.com/HuPER29/HuPER获取。
tldr: HuPER是一个受人类启发的语音感知框架，它通过声学-语音证据和语言知识的自适应推理，仅用100小时训练数据就在英语基准测试中达到了最先进的错误率，并能零样本迁移到95种语言。
ai_comments: HuPER的创新性在于它明确地将人类语音感知机制（即结合声学信息和语言知识进行自适应推理）引入到模型设计中。其重要性体现在其极高的资源效率（仅100小时训练数据）和强大的跨语言泛化能力（95种语言的零样本迁移），这对于低资源语言的语音处理具有巨大潜力。该框架还解决了在不同声学条件下实现自适应感知的难题，是该领域的关键一步。
motivation: 旨在建立一个受人类启发的框架来建模语音感知过程，通过结合声学-语音证据和语言知识进行自适应推理。
method: HuPER将语音感知建模为基于声学-语音证据和语言知识的自适应推理。它是第一个能够在不同声学条件下实现自适应、多路径语音感知的框架。
results: 仅用100小时训练数据，HuPER在五个英语基准测试上实现了最先进的语音错误率，并对95种未见语言展现出强大的零样本迁移能力。
conclusion: HuPER是一个高效且强大的语音感知框架，在低资源设置下取得了SOTA性能，并具有跨语言泛化能力。所有训练数据、模型和代码均已开源。

title: Visible Light Positioning With Lamé Curve LEDs: A Generic Approach for Camera Pose Estimation
authors: Wenxuan Pan, Yang Yang, Dong Wei, Zhiyu Zhu, Jintao Wang, Huan Wu, Yao Nie
abstract: Camera-based visible light positioning (VLP) is a promising technique for accurate and low-cost indoor camera pose estimation (CPE).
